But my last order seemed to have a lot fewer. For an easy way to get your boiled peanut fix, I'd recommend this one

I love boiled peanuts and have tried a few brands but this one is by far the worst.  Most of the peanuts were soggy or empty.  Also, very small.  I wont order these again.  If on Amazon, I recommend these: http://www.amazon.com/Margaret-Holmes-Green-Boiled-Peanuts/dp/B001YXO0EO/ref=sr_1_1?ie=UTF8&qid=1325488826&sr=8-1

column9: As good as other brands, better price
column10: For those of you wondering if these are as good as the peanut patch brand (which incidentally is the only other brand ive seen either here or in stores), well these are just as good. Despite the previous reviews, I have not found many empty shells at all, and the 3 cans I've been thru so far have all been of consistently good size and flavor. Decent price with prime shipping, the others cost more to ship than the actual product.All in all very satisfied with purchase, will likely order more.

column9: low quality produt - avoid unless desperate
column10: the few boiled peanuts that are good in the can taste great... beyond that, i can't find much positive to say about these. more than 50% of the product was rotten/mushy/empty shells/tiny undeveloped peanuts. they clearly put the absolute dregs of the peanuts they have in the "boiled peanuts" bin when they sort them at the processing facility. i bought a 6-pack an this was my experience with all 6 cans, so it was no fluke.also, i emailed the peanut shop about this, thinking that they might be concerned... sadly, they weren't! at all. all they would say was contact amazon.

i was a bit worried about the negative reviews about these peanuts.  I decided to take a chance and order these.  They are quite good considering they are canned.  I actually like them better than some frozen boiled peanuts I ordered from another site.

I look to buy boiled peanuts fresh every time I go down south. The next best thing to fresh boiled peanuts are boiled peanuts in a can.  I didn't know they existed until I googled them and found them on Amazon.  They are not as good as fresh but they satisfy the taste.  These are just a little bit too salty but tasty.

My husband LOVES these and I have had to order a couple time to send them to him.  He shares them with his Soldiers where they are at and has even gotten a couple of the other Soldiers there ordering them too.So glad I found them.

column9: A full bodied as coffer and no bitter tanin-like aftertaste
column10: I decided to give up coffee because of all the brouhaha over cortisol ... but boy did I miss it. Tea was a poor substitute (so I thought), because the longer you brew it the more bitter it becomes. Then I discovered Taylors of Harrogate Scottish Breakfast Tea.  Wow - you can brew it to full-bodied deliciousness and it never gets bitter. It's especially tasty with milk in the morning. Not just a substitute for coffee (which it certainly is), but a wonderful, refreshing way to start the day, all in its own right!STRONGLY recommended!!

This is the best tea I ever drank.  A bag makes more then one cup.  Taste is great.  I have even got a collection of these teas and given them for Christmas presents now I have more people hooked in it.

column9: Not Scottish At All, Just Good English Tea
column10: The last time I visited Scotland was 1999 when I led a couple of my Birmingham wrestlers to the Isle of Bute to participate in the Scottish Highland Games.  What I remember most besides wrestling upon slippery wet grass was drinking the best cup of hot tea ever!  So I was keen to relive those bone-warming memories and recently bought a box of Taylors of Harrogate Scottish Breakfast Tea via Amazon.The package arrived promptly from a seller in a neighboring state.  I carefully opened the tightly-wrapped package containing the box of tea, then opened the box near my nose in order to greet a nice whiff of tea scent.  The tea kettle was placed on the stove and the burner turned on high to bring the water to a boil.  A tea bag was placed into a 12-ounce mug and then the boiling water was slowly poured into it, stopping about 2/3rds of the way.  I then added regular whole milk, stopping at 3/4ths of the way.  Finally I topped it off with more hot water from the kettle. I waited 4 minutes before attempting to sip the tea, as attempts made earlier than that bring a risk of mouth and tongue cancer.The tea was exactly as I remembered warm and soothing tea, from - not Scotland, but England!  It tasted just like PG Tips tea that I drank in Birmingham, England. 'Perhaps it was the milk?', I thought. 'Maybe Scottish milk has a higher milk fat content than American milk?', I wondered.  What was it about that tea on Bute that I couldn't find in my cup of Scottish Breakfast tea?Then I began reading the box.  Taylors of Harrogate is in Harrogate - Harrogate, England!  Not Scotland.  This tea isn't Scottish at all.  That said, however, Scottish tea 'officionados' maintain that English breakfast tea got its start in Scotland.  It was invented in 1892 by a Master Drysdale of Scotland as simply 'Breakfast Tea' and soon the Queen of England and many other 'Southerners' were drinking it. Maybe all 'breakfast tea' is Scottish after all?  I don't know what distinguishes them, but I guess I'll have to make another trip to the Isle of Bute to recreate my best experience drinking hot tea.So there you have it, my cup of Scottish Breakfast tea was just as good as Tetley's British Blend; it just cost me a bit more.  :-)

Although I love tea and drink it all the time, I thought the Scottish Breakfast Tea was just okay.  I also ordered Taylors of Harrogate Earl Grey Tea, and it is WONDERFUL! The best Earl Grey Tea I have had. As for Breakfast Tea, I guess my favorite is still Trader Joe's Irish Breakfast Tea.
rich flavor, hard to go back to drinking anything else. This is for all those real tea lovers out there
This has been a great snack with a coffee flavor and some chocolate.  Sometimes the coffee flavor seems a bit strong for me, but I'm a wimp and it sometimes depends on my mood.

These chips are delicious. The chips arrived early which worked out perfect for us. My husband came home for a two week vacation from Afghanistan and he loved the chips.  The chips are not greasy like chips in the US.  I will definitely be purchasing these chips again soon.  We are hooked!

Chipsfrisch are delicious and taste unlike anything here in the States.  My husband discovered them on a business trip, and we're a little bit addicted now.  These chips are very potato-y, light and crispy, with a fresh paprika flavor.  For potato chip fans, they're definitely worth the extra cost!

column9: The only chocolate cake mix I will buy
column10: This is my favorite cake mix to use!  Sometimes I follow the directions on the back, but more often this is what I'll add to the cake mix:  1 cup water, 1 cup mayonnaise, 3 large eggs, and 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract.  It makes it dark and moist, and people NEVER suspect I started with a cake mix.  Even my mother-in-law wanted to know how I got my cake so dark, and she uses cake mixes too (but another, cheaper, brand).Be sure not to mix/beat the batter for too long, as this will make the cake come out with a "tough" texture, instead of the tender crumb you get when you mix it just enough to blend the ingredients.  Don't worry about a few little balls of powdered mix in your batter, they will bake out.  If you're really worried about those little balls of powdered mix in your batter, run the cake mix (and *just* the cake mix, no other ingredients!) through a fine wire sieve, or a flour sifter.  This will break up those little clumps.If you love chocolate, this is the cake mix to buy.

column9: super easy to make and super moist and chocolatey
column10: I can't cook or bake at all, but I had no trouble making this cake.  it's great.. came out very fluffy and moist with lots of chocolate flavor.  some chocolate fudge frosting and it's just as good as the chocolate fudge cake they serve in a restaurant.
As far as going natural this is very good, it is a lot sweeter than the processed white sugar that is on the market. This is the only sugar that I buy.

My mom is Greek, so obviously I've been to Greece tons of times. Athens more specifically. I love Greece it's so beautiful, fresh foods in the markets, fresh bakeries, etc. Ok ok, I'm getting ahead of myself :)In the heart of Athens, Greece, there's a store named Alpha/Beta where we used to go all the time and it never failed, every time we went in there we always left with some ION Chocolate.I haven't been back to Greece in YEARS but I just found out that Amazon.com sold this chocolate, and I got it in a timely matter and it tastes just like I last remember. A little taste of Greece is back in my life! :) :) :)5/5 Stars :D
I'm a huge chocolate fan and really love the taste of this milk chocolate bar. Far better taste than any other milk chocolate bars offered in the US. Melts in your mouth.... Yummy!!!

Back in Germany I would buy organic sunflower oil from Rapunzel or another brand, but now in the USA, I am having a big problem to find an appropriate oil for the autumn months.In a local health food store 3 years ago I actually found Rapunzel Sunflower Oil, and I bought every single bottle they had. But last year I ran out, and the problem began anew. What to cook with potatoe dishes now?Then I saw this offer, and since I know their nut oils are really of good quality (yes really, no sarcasm here), I trusted them and ordered this set of 4 cans. Another reviewer mentioned the cute tins, but hey, what good are cute tins if the product does not keep what the ad promised???OK, maybe it was my own fault to assume the term "organic" must automatically mean "unrefined". Stupid me, I really did assume that! But this oil is refined!It has no taste nor aroma at all! It is just like all other refined industrial oils ("cooking oil") from any american supermarket, only more expensive. I felt betrayed here.I didn't return it, as there was nothing technically wrong with it. I mean, there was nothing spoilt or broken, so I just used the tins up during the autumn and winter.But I will absolutely not order this again, as "organic" is not good enough! It must be "unrefined", and that it is not.

I have been experimenting with various "healthy" cooking oils. The obvious popular choice is extra virgin olive oil however, extra virgin olive oil has a rather strong taste which isn't suitable for all dishes and it has a rather low smoke point making it unsuitable for high-temperature cooking. I had gained some interest in high-oleic sunflower seed oil based on some research I had done on-line.High-oleic sunflower oil has an excellent mix of fats in terms of health, stability and suitability to high-heat cooking. The product description was not that clear if this was high-oleic sunflower oil or "normal" sunflower oil. After purchasing the oil, I was able to verify with the nutrition label that this is high-oleic oil.High-oleic sunflower oil is difficult to find "locally" and when found it is very expensive. Amazon's price is substantially cheaper than I am able to find locally though unless you are rich I still doubt you would be frying a turkey in this oil.This is an excellent oil for anyone looking for a relatively healthy cooking oil for high-temperature cooking or who objects to the taste of olive oil. The oil has a very mild flavor and appears to stand up to its reputation for having a high smoke point in the dishes I've cooked with it so far.As another reviewer pointed out the cans _are_ also rather cute and they do look nice in the pantry next to the home-canned veggies. I hope Amazon will continue to carry this oil.

For some reason sunflower oil has become hard to find. I am glad that it was available here. I ordered on-line through another seller and had to cancel after almost two months. "Out of stock" was the reason. Supermarkets in my area have stopped selling sunflower oil.

column9: The oil is fine, the can is adorable
column10: I bought the sunflower oil for cosmetic use.  It is fine quality.  The can it comes in is about the cutest thing around.  I know it is silly to buy things for cute packaging but I am really tempted to buy my other oils from this company so I have more adorable tins.

We were given a bag of these from some college kids who were thankful we delivered something for them as they did not have a truck.  They sat on the counter for a while before I tried them and then - they were addictive!  There are 24 smaller bags inside with maybe a Tablespoon or two full of hot peas inside each.  They are spicy but not unbearably hot like Wasabi Peas.The only reason this got 4 Stars instead of 5 is because of the price.  Currently, $5.35 per bag is being charged plus shipping.  I purchase them at our local Asian grocery store and they are $2.59.  That is a pretty big price difference.  So, if you have an Asian grocery near you, try them first - if not, go ahead and purchase them here because you will love them!
the add presents this item as having 48 items in it ,then it states you get only 36 pieces. This is cheating !!!!!!!!!!
This stuff is easy to make and absolutely delicious. It takes me back to those magical evenings at Delhi University when we would stroll over from the dorm to the bhel puri walla.

We love all Pappadams!!!!!!  Besides fried, you can cook them in microwave ( a few seconds) and one of our favorite is to break up a couple of them into soup stock as noodles. This is a first rate brand!

Mint is one of my favorite herbs so when I ran across this chutney in the supermarket the other day, I had to purchase a jar.  I was completely impressed by this high quality blend.  The taste is not overpowering.  While this chutney is made with serrano peppers and cumin powder, I did not find the chutney to be hot.  The heat provided from the peppers and cumin blends fabulously with the coriander and mint and the eating experience is marked by a progression of different flavors with the first taste being a sugary coriander and mint blend followed by the heat of the pepper and cumin powder.The first ingredient for the chutney is water but I did not find the blend to be watery.  I eat my chutney with poppadums (either ready made by Truly Indian or the cook your own version by Lijjat) and I had no problem with this chutney staying on the poppadum.  The second ingredient in this chutney is coriander and the user can definitely taste its presence.I purchased this product at my local Meijer supermarket (in the international foods section despite being made in the United States).  I paid about 5 dollars for a 7.5 ounce jar.I love this product and will purchase again.  Swad makes other chutneys, including a coriander chutney for those interested in other flavors.Amazon does not yet have the product ingredients posted. Here they are:  Water, coriander, mint, serrano peppers, coconut, salt, soybean oil, cumin powder, sugar, coriander powder, citric acid, guar gum, xanthum gum, FD&C Blue #1 and Yellow #5.There are approximately 12 servings per 7.5 ounce jar.  Each 1 tablespoon serving has 15 calories, 1 gram of fat, .5 grams saturated fat, and 260 mg of sodium.

column9: A little costly but really tasty
column10: Not hot at all which i prefer. And good enough minty taste, i can eat just this and rice and feel satisfied

Nutrageous bars are THE best candy bar ever. The secret is in the nuts, they truly are loaded up with peanuts, not peanuts chopped to a paste but real actual nuts. That and the combination of chocolate and peanut butter is to die for. The problem is you cannot find Nutrageous anywhere anymore. So glad to find them here.

This coffee is very fresh upon arrival and doesn't last long enough in this household to go stale! We do keep it in the freezer but it is wonderful and just what we like...we look forwrd to it every morning.....this is a bolder tasting coffee. Great taste and even better value. I highly recommend it for serious coffee drinkers.

Coffee Bean Direct coffees are better than starbucks!  I buy the ground and the whole beans of the dark house blend and everyone seems to like it.  It is a great cup of coffee and the price is great.  If you are a coffee lover, it is for you!

I got this as part of their sampler pack, to see if I'd like any of their coffees.  Many of the other varieties I am not fond of, as they are much too light and beany for my taste.  This one of the last ones I've tried and really, it's wonderful.  It's nice and rich and dark.  It brews a very satisfying cup of coffee.  It's close to Starbucks Verona coffee (the only starbucks beans I like enough to buy), but slightly less in-your-face.  I highly recommend it for people who don't like weak coffee.

My concern was that we don't drink a lot of coffee every day and I was worried that 5 lbs. of coffee wouldn't stay fresh. However, we can close the package tight enough that it does stay fresh. The coffee is excellent, the price is great, and the convenience very nice.

Truly had higher expectations of the flavor with this coffee.  Not real smooth and a bit bitter.  5 lbs so I may like it better by the time I finish the bag.  I may mix it with some of my favorite brand LOL to see if it can mix well into a smoother blend.

I am very impressed so far by the coffee I've received from Coffee Bean Direct.  My wife and I have tried the Italian Espresso roast and now the Dark House Blend, and both have been aromatic and full-flavored (though I tend to like the bolder Italian a bit more).  My next purchase will be the Sumatra.

I bought this coffee to add variety to my morning coffees.  I was not impressed.  It is not a bad coffee but it is not a great coffee by any means.  I regularly buy the regular French Roast by Coffee Bean Direct which for me is consistently the best tasting. They sell this Dark House Blend more expensive than the French Roast which makes no sense to me especially now after tasting it.  I will not buy this Dark House Blend coffee again.

column9: High quality and very reasonably priced
column10: This is a fantastic product at a very reasonable price.  I go through about 3/4 lb of coffee per week, so this bulk size allows me to skip frequent trips to the grocery store, but the price is extremely reasonable.  And the quality of the coffee is just as good as the expensive varieties you can buy at the store.  I'm very impressed with this product.

This is VERY tasty coffee for the money- milk chocolate notes,mild acidity, every bit as good as Starbucks, Allegro etc. blends. Only downside is, direct from Coffee Direct it's roasted within 3-4 days, through Amazon it can be 6 weeks old or older so check the freshness code on your bag. Also whole bean coffee should ideally be used up within 2 weeks of opening or it deteriorates so we share our bag with friends. Really though we haven't noticed the flavor going off much in a month but I wouldn't let it sit around longer than that.

Ordered from this company back when they first started, City Roast Colombian flavor, it was very good coffee, and I thought I had found my favorite. However, recently ordered Dark Roast House Blend and this is the best. Smooth, full bodied, excellent flavor, but not bitter. We mix it half and half with Great Value Dark Roast to stretch the cost. I don't think you will be disappointed! We recently had a friend visit who has been an avid coffee drinker x 50 years and he commented it was the best coffee he ever drank!

column9: A Great Start to the Day
column10: I have been a long-time customer of Coffee Bean Direct, and have seen it grow from a company  having a few choices to one with many.  Their Dark House Blend provides us with a good start to the day. The coffee is bold, but not overpowering.  It is smooth for those who take their coffee black, but is also a great blend for a mocha.  A good company with good products.  Whether the Dark House Blend or another variety, Coffee Bean Direct is a company offering great value for your coffee dollar.

A very good coffee, flavorful, fresh. Makes a good dark brew. My wife uses it for espresso, while I prefer the French press. I have not tried it in drip. Much better than the darker beans we can get at Wally World or erratically at our local grocery store in rural Texas at a much higher price. With the subscription delivery, cannot be beat for quality, convenience, and price.

column9: Super Coffee Supply for Serious Coffee Drinkers
column10: You will not be disappointed by purchasing coffee from this supplier.  You will have to be serious or have a few family members or friends who also enjoy coffee as much as you do.  I have used the dark house blend, the italian roast, the brazilian dark roast and the french roast.  All are superiour coffee beans for the price, especially given the economy these days.  Just ordered 15#s for Christmas distribution.

I am a fan of dark roast beans and have been having trouble finding one that is dark enough to stand up to cream and yet not have a burned or bitter flavor. I finally found it. This is really fabulous coffee!! And the price is good enough that I save a lot of money by brewing my own in the morning and filling a travel mug for the commute.
sure beats folgers. no bitter lingering after taste. play around with grinding.  i like it best around medium grind with bunn drip.

We really wanted to love this coffee, but really only found it OK. It has been a long time since we had anything like Folgers. I'm sure this is better than that but does not beat even COSTCO in our opinion.
We liked  the coffee very much - normally drink "kirkland select" (2 lb bags) from Costco. Not sure I'll reorder because the 5 lb bag is so big that storage is a problem.

I get tired of labels selectively enhancing numbers to mislead, so these get a star off for that.Big bolded letters it says: "10 bars" below, in smaller letters you'll see a small pack has 2 bars. At least they have the decency to call a serving (at the back on small letters: 2 bars).The bars are very small, so it's no surprise that this is the case.On a positive note, the oats are organic, as are a lot of the ingredients. The bars crumble a bit much, so you might lose a piece or two to the floor.Overall, given the quality of the ingredients, and the decent taste, these are a good choice. However, a lot of the time the cost per bar* (10 bars in a box, 2 per pack) is close to a dollar, an honestly, anything over 50 cents is way too much for the size of these, and you would be better off with any of the other products out there that fill you up even more (1 dollar protein bars come to mind - they weigh a lot more than 2 of these).

column9: Not a fan of granola bars, but the taste of these wowed me
column10: I don't typically buy or snack on granola bars. They are often more chewy than like a crisp cookie and taste of honey and artificial ingredients. In fact, I would never have tried these were there not a sample bowl of them at a local grocery store.I was more than shocked...it almost tasted like a homemade oatmeal cookie.  In fact it was so good I returned for seconds and bought 2 boxes of these and 3 other flavors as well. Although the chocolate chip is a close second, these are hands down the best in my opinion.Surprisingly the calorie count on the box is for TWO bars. While many manufacturers try to sneak in calories by doing things like saying there are 2 servings in soda can or 2 servings in a single frozen dinner so the calorie count looks smaller, they were more than generous. TWO bars of most of their flavors have only 160 calories and for a mega sweet fix that satisfies me plenty with just one bar, that wowed me.This is an organic bar and they are actually vegan. Not that they advertise this anywhere, I just read labels and was surprised to see no dairy or eggs listed. One servings gives you 40% of your daily recommended serving of whole grains yet it tastes like a cookie or dessert...and that also means a nice doce of fiber.While I wouldn't fool myself into thinking that I'm eating HEALTHY just because of the whole grains and organic ingredients...it is, afterall, sweet and has 11g of sugar (but that's for two bars, remember, and one is plenty filling for me so that's not so bad for a sweet snack.) I do feel I am eating healthier than most alternatives when I'm craving a sweet snack that I can tote in a purse or keep in my desk drawer. Most bow far deeper into the less healthy alternatives of preservatives to keep them shelf-stable, or far more sugar.Not to be confused with a protein bar or one packed with vitamins, of which it's not, it's still a healthy alternative to the afternoon candy bar or morning donut in the break room and in my opinion it tastes way better than either.

I'm not stupid. I have nearly a degree from a major university. I read this description over and over, and still it didn't make any sense. Ten bars! Pack of two! Two boxes! Forty-eight! Hike!Like me, you'll probably be surprised by the dearth of product. You get two boxes. Each contains five packets. Each packet has 2 bars, sure -- but the weight of each packet is 1.5 oz, which is less than two-thirds the weight of ONE regular Clif bar. These bars are maybe 1 1/2" wide, 4" long, and 1/4" thick. You'll be tempted to use them to file your nails. Why would Clif suddenly decide that humans can't take a granola bar that weighs more than .75 oz -- and package two of them together? Gosh, let's all think.Anyway, now you know. On the plus side, if you don't like these -- I'd give them a 5 out of 10 on taste -- just hold the box in your open palm, and a hefty breeze will take them away.
Awesome flavor, Awesome crunch. It almost melts in your mouth, could not ask for a better Granola bar.

saw this online as a deal. ordered some thinking I would receive 20 individually packed bars.  It was not the case.  You get two boxes and there are 5 individually wrapped bars inside.  they call it 20 because each wrapper has two thin bars inside. I fell for it. hope this helps someone not to make the same mistake I made.
This is not an accurate description for the product ordered.  I only received one box of ten bars.  The bars are great but since it is only one box it is not worth buying here.

Made the mistake of taking the picture at face value.  As other reviewers have stated, there are actually only 10 bars broken into two pieces.  The price is not $0.74/package, but actually $0.74/bite.
Product description says 2 boxes, only received one.  This is a huge ripoff, I paid $10 for one box of 5 bars yet they are counted as 10.  How do I go about getting my other box?
These are not original cliff bars, but the smaller lower quality Cliff crunch bars.  You can get these same bars in the same packaging at Walmart for 3 bucks for a box of 10.
They taste and look exactly like Nature Valley Bars. Also note the 10-count box is 5 packages of 2 thin bars. I would rather get the Nature Valley--they're cheaper and taste the same.
These are perfect for when you'd like to have that chocolate chip cookie and you know you shouldn't.  Its crunch, crispy with just the right amount of chocolate chips to satisfy your craving.

The Granola bars, with about a month left before being out of date, were stale, petrified and inedible.  I returned the product to the original seller.  Amazon charged double what the original merchant charged for the product.All in all, a very disappointing experience.  I have bought from Amazon many times in the past and was always pleased with the merchandise.  This was the first "FAIL" for me.

column9: Great taste, but not very filling
column10: I am a huge fan of Clif products, and consume them almost daily. My breakfast every single work day consists of a standard Clif Bar, and I also occasionally eat a Clif Builder's Bar after a strenuous workout. Happy with all previous Clif products, I purchased a couple boxes of these Clif Crunch Bars, in the Chocolate Chip flavor. Like other Clif products, the whole ingredients list consists of real, natural items; nothing on the list that you can't pronounce or identify.If this review were based on taste and taste alone, there is no doubt in my mind that these bars would deserve a full 5 stars. Given that the bars are relatively healthy, with a solid ingredients list, they taste wonderful; I wouldn't have them change a single thing. Unfortunately, the big downside to this product is the fact that they just aren't nearly as filling as other Clif products. Each pack contains two separate bars, and as far as satisfying hunger goes, I need to eat two complete packs of these Crunch Bars to get the same amount of satisfaction as a single normal Clif bar. Granted, these are lower in calories than the normal bar, but they just don't seem to cut it if I want a quick snack that will fill me up.Another product I have used that is about the same nutritional content as the Crunch Bar, but seems to satisfy my hunger better, are the standard Nature Valley Granola bars. I will keep buying Clif products, but these Clif Crunch Bars will likely not make it back onto my shopping list anytime soon.

column9: Overpriced! Not what you are expecting.
column10: My main beef with this product is with the labeling.The box is labeled very deceptively. This goes double when inspecting the packaging from the Web (as you are doing now). "10 bars" is prominently displayed on the box. Lo and behold, once you open the box, only five bars are present. Upon further inspection, you see that printed in mice-type on the box is "5 two count packages". The net weight of the entire box is 7.4 ounces. That's less than one cup of granola. That's when you realize you've been had.You can buy a mega-size box of Nature Valley granola bars from a warehouse club for less money than the "Pack of 2" you'll find here. I mention Nature Valley because in a blind taste test you won't be able to distinguish that brand from these Clif bars.Seriously, if they are selling them for this much on Amazon, I'd be shocked and chagrined to see what they go for at the camping stores which is their retailer of origin.I consider myself embarrassed to have been duped so badly on this one. Clif has seriously damaged their brand credibility. Live and learn.

These bars come two in a package (and two to a serving size!) and are absolutely delicious.  They are crunchy and rich. The peanut butter bars taste like they are made with actual peanut butter holding the grains together.  The white chocolate macadamia nut bars have little pieces of soy white chocolate in the bars and you can taste them when you bite in.  These bars can keep me full for a while and are a great snack.  Appropriate for a plant based diet.

I bought these not realizing that they were not the regular CLIF bars...I should have known because they are much too cheap the original ones, but I was pleasantly surprised with these... they come in packs of two, and they are like a regular granola bar as compared to the soft/chewy consistency of the original CLIF bars. I loved these though, and the white chocolate macadamia nut was so yummy! I would definitely buy these again! Great value. But very messy, so definitely not recommended for a breakfast while in the car! ha :)

Cliff Bar White Chocolate Macademia Nut Granola Bars are BY FAR the most delicious granola bars I have ever tasted.  I eat one (half a pack) right after a workout to help put some health sugar levels back in my body.  A couple grams of fiber, a couple grams of protein, a couple grams of fat = the PERFECT snack for health blood sugar levels for me.  Love them!
I love these bars.  They are lighter and crisper than the nature valley brand.  Being that they have protein as well they make it a better choice to stave off hunger.

I have been trying to eat better. And I have been going on photo walks. I find that I need something with me in case I get hungry. Fruit doesn't travel well. Granola bars do well in my bag. But chewy bars get too sticky. And most crunchy granola bars are so hard I am always worried I would lose a tooth or two. I saw these at Nutrition S'mart yesterday and picked them up. I tried one before I got home. They have a great crunch, not too hard, and a wonderful flavor. Now I want to try the other flavors but my local Nutrition S'mart only had 2.

OK, I've eaten a lot of granola bars that supposedly contain peanut butter but these are the first one that REALLY taste like peanut butter. Probably the finest compliment I can offer is that if I was going to make a crunchy peanut butter granola bar at home, I'm not sure I could make them better than these. Anyway, these are highly recommended if you want a delicious crunchy peanut butter granola bar that just happens to have all the nutrition we've come to expect from CLIF. Yum-O!

the best part was the white chocolate, but you can buy that anywhere for cheapthis crap crumbles into thousands of pieces when you take a bite, so you can't even anywhere with you. Gotta eat it over the kitchen sink as it is so messyavoid this at all costs. Buy the chewy counterpart instead
Why is the box of 10 $10 @ Amazon when I can buy this for $4 at the grocery store? Is there a pricing problem?
great snack, with a great price! I would recommend, I enjoy the cliff brand especially this flavor. It is neutral and not overwhelming.

These bars are awesome. The White Chocolate Macadamia is the only one I've tried, but it's goood. The only complaint is they break part too easily, but I can say, much better than Nature Valley. I hope these stay around for a while.
These bars are the perfect crunchiness.  I can eat both bars without my teeth hurting!  Great for breakfast or snack.

These taste great but they are small bars.  My biggest complaint is that I have to eat these while standing over a sink or trash to avoid making a mess.  I've gone through 6 or 7 boxes and not one package has had two completely intact bars.  Most of the time there are just lots of crumbles from the edges of the bars but occasionally you'll find a bar that was jostled around enough to be broken into three or more pieces.  Certainly, this is a combination of the composition of the granola bar and lack of completely protective packaging.  But be warned that you will have lots of crumbled Clif Crunch bars if you order this through Amazon.
Love, love, love these!  My husband first brought one of these home from the New York - Five Boro Tour, and I am hooked on them.

column9: a dark chocolate lovers' delight, a blueberry lover's disappointment
column10: "Cocoa" is the ingredient on the label of the chocolate peanut butter Clif crunch bars but I found these Clif Crunch snack bars less overly-sweet than many others.  They taste like they contain dark, as opposed to the easy-to-find milk, chocolate. I recommend them to dark chocolate lovers and ordered three more boxes, straight-away.On the other hand, the blueberry bars are a loser, in my opinion. There is only a faint blueberry flavor.  This blueberry-lover would just love one choc-full of dried blueberries, adding the appropriate blueberry flavor to these crunchy snack bars.
I really liked these bars. They are really good. Finished them in a week and would definitely order again. I wish I could find a coupon
I was expecting two packs of these like the description said, instead I only got one box.  It was a total rip off.

I came across these granola bars as part of the Subscribe & Save program.  Much to my dismay, the subscription service option was discontinued.  They are so good, however, I've continued to purchase them.  Even my children really like them and they usually only like granola bars if they are packed with so much sugar and covered in chocolate to the point you can't distinguish them from a candy bar.I like the Clif brand and what the company is trying to do, besides offering a more wholesome granola bar without compromising taste.The granola bars are certified organic by QAI and packaging is made from 100% recycled material.  Hey, every little bit helps when you're trying to reduce your carbon footprint.
I wasn't real confident that these were going to taste all that great, but my expectations were far exceeded! These bars are so very tasty! Easily the best crunchy bar I've ever had.

This crunch granola bar is on par with every other product from Clif.  It is, as the name would imply, very crunch and extremely delicious.  My favorite granola bar was Nature Valley, but this definitely took the cake.  Simply put, it's delicious.

I normally do not like "crunchy" bars because its a hit and miss proposition. Sometimes too hard, sometimes too soft (feel like Goldilocks). But the taste and texture gets a passing grade from me. Will buy more.
Love the peanut butter crunch bars.  Normally buy them at Walmart for 3.99 per box.  Walmart has been out so I looked here.  $15.75 is outrageous for 2 boxes.

I've tried a wide variety of granola bars and I have to say, these are some really great tasting bars. If you like peanut butter, you will love these. Each box comes with 5 packages of 2 bars a piece. These are a great snack for the middle of the day. I'm looking forward to trying out the other flavors. If you get it with S&S, the price is very low as well. Overall, this is a great granola bar at a great price!

I prefer these over comparable granola bars in both taste and texture, and the fact that Clif uses 'Organic' ingredients is an added bonus.  I am an avid hiker, and these have held up better than other brands on my hikes.

My daughter loves these bars.  The order came quickly.  No complaints whatsoever.  The only thing I would mention is that these bars are crumbly and do not "travel well" compared to the softer bars out there.  So I think we will have some softer bars for travel and these bars when travel is not an issue.  Hope that makes sense!

These snacks are perfect for the on the go exercise enthusiast.  They don't taste too sugary and are a great pick me up for when I need to replenish on the food front.  For the price I paid, I'm very satisfied.

I like Clif bars because they taste good but not great enough that you want to eat a whole lot of them. These crunch bars are no exception. I usually have clif bars in my school bag to stave off hunger during classes before succumbing to the call of a vending machine.The Chocolate Macadamia Nut flavor is a bit too sweet for my tastes which was a little surprising for a Clif bar (but it is chocolate). I like that each packet comes with two thin bars rather than one big granola bar - great for sharing or portioning.
Packaged well item tastes great can be messy when you attempt to eat that clif bar falls apart. However I want more of this product.

I like Clif products in general and this one is also pretty good.  It tastes good and it has better list of ingredients than the more processed ones from Nature's Valley, etc.  But the thing crumbles too much.  It doesn't hold together very well and from the moment you open the package, there's crumbs all over you.  Just be aware of it.  It's tasty and crunchy as they say on the package.
The bars taste good, but they are REALLY crunchy! It's almost impossible to eat them and not make a huge mess of crumbs--definitely not good for taking on the go to eat in the car!
There is a definite, crisp and crunchy texture to these bars. Some other bars have a slight chemical aftertaste. These are probably healthier then cereal.

My grandson, who is in special forces training in the Air Force requested these.  Needs a lot of protein for his training.  Asked me not to send cookies or junk food.  Wanted these instead.  Lots easier than cooking, packaging, and trips to the post office.He said his favorite is the Blueberry bars.

I love these things! Usually they go on sale on Amazon and I only buy them when they are about $6 - 7 for the pack of two. My favorite kind is the white chocolate macadamia nut. However, when I bought them I wasn't expecting them to be quite so messy. They are definitely crunchy, and you will get crumbs everywhere - so keep that in mind. Otherwise I love the things! I'm a college student so this is a good breakfast or snack on my walk to class.

I purchased 5 boxes of these. I really enjoy the taste and nutritional value of the bars. Great starter, mid day pick me up or evening snack (dip into milk). These are crunchy. Great price & excellent Amazon service!

The "healthiness" is great, as are most CLIF products.The price, even with subscribe and save is way too high.There is not much difference from just buying regular granola barsThere are only 5 packages in each box (with 2 smaller bars in each)I always wonder why they make such big boxes and only put a few items in the box....who only eats 5 granola bars?

column9: Taste just like Chocolate Chip Cookies!
column10: First off let me say that I've been a fan of Clif bars for a while now. So I saw these at my local grocery store and decided to give them a whirl.WOW! Just wow! These take exactly like crunchy chocolate chip cookies. They are absolutely delicious. I find myself craving these now instead of brownies or a candy bar. I was actually eating them in class one day and a few people tried them and now are also obsessed. Great product and completely yummy!

Great for on the go, I work in a job that I don't always got to eat lunch on time so grabbing a bar is a great way to eat. These are great, the only thing is that it comes in a 5 pack because 2 bars are in each pack. But it is still a great deal
Just as good as the other Clif bars, but dry and crunchy. Tasty, portable, and cheaper than the others. Perfect snack.
We love these granola bars. I didn't realize that they were crunchy when i ordered them and it was such a nice surprise. They have great flavor and I feel good about my family eating them.
This cliff bar is much more expensive than the nature valley products. But, it is not worth to be pricey.

This new product packs the perfect crunch into sweet bar. I love the bits of white chocolate. The only downside is that it crumbles incredibly easy so it's pretty messy to eat. But overall, it is a very satisfying bar!

column9: Decent granola bar, but the packaging is a bit misleading
column10: When I first opened the box I was surprised to find 5 packages of granola bars, each with 2 bars each, so a "10-pack" has 5 packages with 2 granola bars in each package (I never noticed it was normal to do that with granola bars), hence the serving size is 2 bars. The price for each packet is about the same as that of a normal clif bar, so I don't know if it's really worth it to me. You get about 60% more mass with a clif bar than with this for the same price.That being said, they taste decent and taste good broken into pieces with peanut butter and nutella.

These are so awesome. They have great crunch, without being really hard (like nature valley) and the little bits of chocolate throughout the bar are delightful. I would eat these for dessert instead of cake or brownies. Peanut butter is good too.
Figured I'd try these when Amazon lowered the price and glad I did!  My wife and I both enjoy these very tasty bars and it is a much healthier choice than a bag of chips!

These things are awesome!  I only ordered them because they were on a good sale on amazon, but now I'll gladly pay full price.They taste soo good!  No high fructose corn syrup, a big plus.  They do have "evaporated cane juice" as the sweetener.  I'm not familiar with it, but a quick google search shows it to be a healthier and better alternative to regular cane sugar.Great texture and crunch, and great flavor.  A perfect snack that is much much healthier than a lot of alternatives.I could not imagine a better granola bar.  Try these, you won't be disappointed!
My parents sent me some of these in care package while I was deployed and they are amazing.  So much better than nature vally bars.

column9: Pretty good break from other brand granola bars
column10: I got the white chocolate macadamia flavor of these.  They really aren't any different from any other granola bars.  The white chocolate flavor isn't as strong as it is in the regular Clif bars.  Overall, they're tasty and reasonably priced on Amazon.
Great crunch and taste.  Love the auto ship program with discount!  I can't find these in any stores in my area, was so happy to get them on Amazon.

I love these granola bars!  I can honestly say they are the best granola bars I've ever eaten.  They also have protein, and I love eating them just as a snack as well as if I'm on the go or post workout.  My only problem is they are hard to find in grocery stores...and I usually don't like to wait around to fill out a "please stock this item" form.

Love Cliff bars, but have only liked the Peanut Butter and Chocolate Chip Peanut Crunch flavors (maybe an occasional Blueberry).  The others are too sweet for my taste.  These are my new favorite.  Great taste combination.  Go Cliff Bars!
These are the best crunchy granola bars I've tasted. They are excellent alone or with a nice cup of coffee. Highly recommended!

Got these with a one-day shipping delay, but still very quickly with Amazon Prime.  The taste is quite good, perhaps a little on the sweet side - especially when you hit a pocket of white chocolate.  The big problem is the condition of the product when it arrives.  I opened my first 2-pack and the granola bars were crushed into nuggets and powder.  Strangely, the box wasn't in bad shape, just the bars.  A few days later, I opened the other box of granola bars, which was in better shape than the first one, and the first pack I tried again contained smashed fragments of granola bars.  These are no fun to eat, as you can't really open the pack and pour it into your mouth (I tried), and if you pick out the big chunks you get fragments and powder sticking to your fingers, and on your clothes (and in your beard).  I'll eat the rest, maybe out of a bowl with a spoon or something (with some fava beans and a nice chianti...), but I won't be ordering any more crunched Clif Crunch bars.
What looks like a great deal is actually a terrible one. This is ONE box of 5 packs of granola bars (packed like Nature Valley). So, instead of receiving 20 snacks, you get 5.

column9: Identical taste to Nature Valleys Granola bars
column10: I was hoping that the taste of these granola bars would different from Nature Valleys but it turns out they taste pretty much the same if not identical... maybe a little bit less sugary.Oh well, moving on... I just hate when companies deliberately trick consumers, the freaking box got 5 packs, just put that on the box.

These bars are tasty and delicious.  You get 20 bars for a decent price (depending if you do subscribe and save).  These bars are great for my little ones, they love them, and they are a good healthy alternative to candy or cookies.
The listing of the box describes as twice as many bars as there are servings.  Each foil pouch contains two very small bars, which together make one serving.  The 10 count is really a 5 count.
These granola bars are very similar to the Nature's Valley brand bars.  The Clif Crunch Bars are very messy.  They crumble.  The flavor is not as good as the flavors offered by Nature's Valley.
Item tasted plain and was crumbly. Did not taste at all like it is described. We were disappointed with product.

Just when you think you're eating healthier - you research to find out "Your NOT" with Clif Products. Theirs so much sugar, carbs & fats in these products that you might as well eat cookies or candy bars. They definitely taste better and you get the same sugar & calories.

Before making my boyfriend's birthday cake, I heavily researched which was the best store-bought cake mix. This came out perfect--it is still really moist after storing it in the fridge for a few days. You do have to add a stick of butter so it's not good for the health-conscious, but if you want a really moist, sweet cake in a basic yellow cake recipe, this is definitely it! Will definitely use it again!

The cake mix is good and has a long distant expiration date. I wish Amazon offered a variety pack, though. I've resorted to adding cocoa powder and other flavorings to the mix because we can only stand so much butter flavored cake.

column9: It's Yellow Cake Mix, what do you expect?  It's ok.
column10: Frankly, I expected more.  They sure make it sound good.  But it's just a yellow cake mix, after all.  If you love yellow cake mix, I'm sure you'll like it just fine.  I say, "blah, boring."

In years past I had to get in my car, drive to the super Wallmart, drag myself across the parking lot, get a electric cart, fend of the lady's (I always wear my 3 wolf and moon teeshirt), go to the cake mix isle, pick up the box, go pay $1.58 for it then travel all the way home.  NOW thanks to the Interwebs and Amazon I can just click buy now and get cake mix delivered to my house in 5-9 days for the low price of $24.61.  No more wasting valuable time away from my afternoon stories at the store like some looser, now ups delivers my cake mix to my door.  This is A.W.E.S.O.M.E!  Now if only I could find a way to get milk this way, maybe milk from a remote Italian region.
These are not your run-of-the-mill pig ears. They are REALLY big. They aren't greasy either. I was pleasantly surprised after receiving my order & am now ordering again. Our dogs LOVE them!!!

Box arrived as pictured.  So beautiful!  I was so impressed...until we opened each box.  Not as pictured!  In the ad, the boxes are over flowing with goodies...in reality, the snacks come in a hard plastic bag...not even as big as a single bag of animal crackers.  Even the popcorn boxes that are supposed to be the big treat boxes have a cheap single serving of popcorn in them.  Good thing I bought this on a lightening deal!  If I had paid full price, I would have been very upset!The best thing about this tower is that after the boxes are all empty, little kids can use them for stacking blocks!

I was very dissapointed in this item. It was much smaller than I expected. The picture makes it look like it contains big chocolate covered pretzels, but what you get is a bag of slightly crushed, tiny chocolate covered pretzels. There are mostly "fillers" in the boxes. I would say about 2/3 garbage fills each box. I could have made this same thing, better, for $10. This is not what I spent my money for. As this is supposed to be a gift for my in-laws, I decided to remove all of the garbage and move the food up, leaving the bottom box empty and got some gift cards to put at the bottom. Which I think is a cute idea, but I could have saved my money and just got the gift cards. I don't know how good the treats are, but they better be amazing considering the cost and the tiny amount you get. I swear I have seen this stuff in vending machines for 50 cents. I guess the only good thing about this gift is it is cute. The boxes are sturdy and it is just a cool setup. You decide if that is worth the price.

Absolutely the cheapest rip off I have ever purchased! There was so much packaging and so little product it was embarrassing to give. Due to the date it arrived I had no choice but to give it, but would NEVER recommend the purchase of it to anyone!

I originally purchased this as a gift, but ended up "ahem" trying it out for myself. The food in this tower was fantastic and the cherries were the best. This product was as good and fresh as compared to items offered by bigger brand name gift mail order companies. At the time I ordered free shipping was included, which made this an even better deal.This tower of sweets makes a wonderful gift for a single person, a couple or just for yourself.
Beautifully wrapped, great price and looks great too.  Because it's Kosher it's the perfect gift to give (in my case at Christmas) as you never know eating preferences of guests invited over.

Great service and wonderful snacks! My family recently relocated to another part of the country and it's the first Father's day in many years that I haven't spent with my now 84 year old father. I wasn't used to shipping presents for Father's Day so I got started late. This shipped right away and he received it prior to Father's Day despite my late start! He and my mother said it tasted great and the packaging was perfect for a gift for a man on Father's Day! Thanks again to Broadway Basketeers!
The people I sent this gift to just loved it!  The service was excellent!

column9: Tower of Treats is a Great Gift
column10: I ordered this gift for my daughter for her birthday. It was the perfect gift and she was able to share it with her roommates.

column9: Sympathy Gift Tower: product good, but they forgot gift card!
column10: When I bought this (11/1/10), this product was called Broadway Basketeers Sympathy Gift Tower of Sweets (Large). I see it's  now called "...Hanukkah Gift Tower...." In any case, we had a death in the family, so this seemed an appropriate gift. The recipient said it was exciting to open each individually wrapped box and they enjoyed the contents. Unfortunately, the gift message I wrote with my order wasn't anywhere in or on the product or package. So, during this stressful time, the recipient and their family had to make many phone calls to various family members to try to identify who had sent it. I felt terrible. I definitely didn't want to put any more stress on them.

column4: Eric Duff "Three guys walk into a bar, the fo...
column10: What you see in the picture is EXACTLY what you get. All the snacks are equivalent to what is in the picture, everything under them is packing peanuts and paper. Horrible disappointing.

This is a good product. The mouth feel is important to me. This one chews great then starts to get tough as most do. The cinnamon is very pleasant. First thing I noticed was that it comes in such small pieces. You will chew 2 of these at a time which factors into the cost.

El Pato Jalapeño Salsa is a great tasting, versatile tomato product.  The sauce can be used straight out of the can for chip-dipping salsa, or it could be used in a variety of recipes.  For example, it could make a great, spicy sauce for baked chicken.  I've used it in soups and also mixed it with sour cream and served it with tortilla chips.
Been using this product for years, never disappointed. Just hot enough and just tasty enough...the perfect addition to the perfect taco.El Pato Jalapeno Salsa - 7.75 oz.

I use it for a salsa base. Just add onions, peppers, tomatoes cilantro etc so yummy!I am always afraid our grocery will stop supplying it!Glad to see it here except the price is very high!It is like .69 at safeway.I'm hoping to find a good enchilada sauce recipe to use with it.

my first exposure to wasabi peas.pros: cheap, some really HOT peas (note - some)cons: inconsistant heat, inconsistant crunch.. some were hard as rocks, food colorings.not great, but not horrible either.
the product was great but the delivery was terrible.  Fed ex took my order and dropped it at a strangers house down the road from me and she didn't find me for a week after she got it.

This is a nice hot sauce that balances heat with flavor pretty well. Since purchasing this I realized that I simply don't favor the Jalapeno based sauces but I do recognize that it is still a really good sauce and I've been cooking with it quite a lot.

Warning about the points - even the bag says on the front these are 1 point each, when you calculate the points from the nutritional information, it comes out to more.Also, price is ridiculous - these are $1.98 a bag at WalMart
Wife is on Weight Watchers and these are a good deal when compared with the over the counter price. I have never eaten one so can't comment on that but it makes her happy. Enough said!!

column9: REAL Ginger makes this excellent Ginger Ale
column10: Hello.  I am reviewing this because I just tried this Ginger Ale for the first time.  I bought it because I have gluten intolerance, dairy intolerance, and have to limit certain grains.  So, I have all sorts of digestive issues.  Ginger Ale seems to really help, but if you buy Canada Dry or Seagram's, you're getting ginger flavor and high-fructose corn syrup.  Corn growers associations want you to know that the brain can't tell the difference between HFCS and sugar, but my colon can tell the difference.  So, I have been changing all items that I ingest into my mouth (toothpaste, mouthwash, food, drinks, etc) to ensure they're gluten free and not containing any definite triggers of problems.  I bought this based on the reviews and the ingredients, and I noticed an immediate result.  I could taste the ginger much better than regular Canada Dry.  Also, I tasted more ginger than carbonation which was very nice.  Within the first two sips I could feel it going down my esophagus and starting to help the digestion process.  I drank the whole can so fast because I fell in love with the flavor and the effect.This $24.00 is for 24 cans which is a decent price, especially if a Prime member; but, I can get a 6-pack for $3.99 at EarthFare which would make it about $17.50 for 4 6-packs (including tax here in TN), which is about $6.50 cheaper.  If you do not have local availability, I would recommend getting this.  And, if you have to order frequently, then I would recommend getting a Prime membership so you get the free 2-day shipping!

column9: First time trying an organic GingerAle
column10: First I need to qualify this review by saying this is the first organic Ginger Ale I've tried.I do enjoy natural sodas, specifically Rootbeers made with cane sugar, so the taste of REAL sugar is something I love.  I hate HFCS.This is an acquired taste. The first one I disliked.  After a couple, it's actually pretty good.  The ginger is strong.  The soda is very crisp, even when I initially disliked it, I enjoyed the crispness.My 4 y/o loves it, my 6 y/o does not.  My wife could take it or leave.This is probably my least informative review ever, sorry, I just don't know what else to say and with no other reviews, I feel it needs... something to help describe it.Will I buy again?  Maybe, I'm going to try some other varieties and brands first.  In any event, I'll enjoy the ones I have left.  Remember, this is my first go around at organic gingerale, so take it with a grain of sea salt ;)

Have tasted some good soda, but none as good as this. I was shocked at the taste of this. It's cane sugar, people! Its amazing! The taste of the ginger fully surrounds the smoothness of this soda. A must buy for anyone looking for an affordable soda with an excellent taste!
Great ginger ale! This is what ginger ale is supposed to taste like: a slight bite, a little sweet, a perfect sizzle.

I was really hoping that this had that "fresh" ginger bite. It tastes like lemon/lime soda with ginger powder added. Maybe I'm more accustomed to the strong taste of fresh ginger in food and drinks. I tried Q-Ginger, 8-Ounce Glass Bottles (Pack of 24) and loved it. However it was a bit pricey. Guess I'll keep looking.

I have always loved ginger ale and when I got pregnant- it was the only thing I wanted to drink for a while. I ordered this with the hopes that I could finally drink a ginger ale that Tastes like Ginger... it does. It helped with my morning sickness. I like that it is sweetened with cane sugar. I absolutely fell in love with this ginger ale and plan on it being a staple item in my pantry.

Really tastes like ginger, and like cane sugar. If you like the pungency of fresh ginger, as it tastes in home made ginger tea, you'll probably like this. For some, that ginger bite could be overwhelming. For me, it's spot on.

I keep ginger ale on hand for stomach upset and trust Blue Sky's quality over more commercial brands (like Canada Dry). It is a lot less expensive than Reed's ginger brew without sacrificing quality. This is a good value.

The flavor of this ginger ale isn't too strong or medicinal (something like baby asprin meets ginger beer)...rendering it perfect for making cocktails. The kids like to drink it straight too. Its also amazing in lemonade over ice on a hot day. Love that amazon delivers this. I'll be ordering more.

column9: Not Quite Reed's but Very Good
column10: A little pricey to buy online but good quality ginger ale.  Reed's ginder ale with 27 grams of ginger is still my favorite but hard to find in my city without having to pay more than $6 for a 6 pack.
If you like a ginger ale with a rich ginger flavor this is the drink for you.  Refreshing and delicious.
The Flavor is Worse than Flint Stones Vitamins and Similar to Fanta, but Worse Tasting. As I Drunk the last of the only can I tried, it Burned my Sinuses Every Drink.

I am no ginger ale connoisseur by any means. But I have tried several types. This brand is one of my least favorites. It has a good kick from the ginger which isn't too strong (which I like) but it has a pretty awful aftertaste in my opinion. I can't get over that aftertaste. I tried about 3 or 4 cans and had to toss the rest because I just couldn't take it.

I lived in the Los Angeles area for 20+ years and loved to get a dog from Pink's Hotdog Stand. I've tried a lot of dogs over the years, but could not find one with the snap that Hoffy Dogs have and once I saw them online, there was no stopping me. Great Dog.

Hoffy brand hot dogs "Hollywood Original" are all beef dogs, in a natural casing, with great flavor and "snap."  For over 75 years, these dogs have been the favorites of Los Angelenos and are sold at many of the best hot dog stands in the city.  Mild flavor, oversized, Hoffy's are sold in 12 oz packs of 5 dogs.

column9: A bit artificially sweet tasking, but filling, high fiber, and low carb
column10: I am a type II diabetic and had an unexpected elevation of my blood sugar levels after 10 years of excellent control.  My oral medication doses were increased, and I lowered my total calories and carbohydrate intake.  I eat cooked oatmeal every other day for breakfast, but sought an alternative to add some variety.  This granola is a bit artificially sweet for my taste, but I add unsweetened soy milk and some fresh berries and enjoy it as an occasional change from cooked cereal.  I also add a teaspoonfull in the blender to my Extend shake to give it some texture. It can also be sprinkled on diet puddings for some crunch.

I've been trying out a few treat items on my cats. We feed them twice a day but they always seem overly hungry, even though they are both at their proper weight. Go figure. In any case I bought a few items to treat them in between meals and one of them was Friskies Party Mix - Mixed Grill Crunch. Boy! These  things disappear in an instant! It's amazing! Evidently, it's an exceptionally good treat!Gary Peterson

I use Agave Organic Nectar in all of my recipes.  With a husband who is diabetic, this product does not spike his blood sugar.  When a recipe calls for one cup of sugar, I just substitue 2/3 cup of Agave Nectar.  Works great for a sweetner on fresh fruit such as strawberries as well.  Multiple uses...and no after taste as with some sugar substitutes.  I've recommended it to others and they use it in tea and give rave reviews.

Our family are vegan / vegitarians & we love this sweetner.  I am so happy to have found it here on Amazon.  SO THANKS "AMAZON" FOR OFFERING THE BEST PRICES & LOOKING OUT FOR THE CONSUMERS WALLETS, "LOVE YA"!
GREAT TASTING PRODUCT FOR COOKING OR JUST TO SIP ON A GREAT BROTH WHEN NOT FEELING WELL.  COMES INDIVIDUALLY BUBBLE WRAPPED.  VERY NICE.

column9: College Inn Beef Broth Easy Open Resealable, 32-Ounce Pack of 6
column10: Way to much salt. 970 mg in a cup. Won't buy again. If Amazon would post the  nutrition ingredients, I and other customers would not buy item's we can't use. Clearly a waste of money.

When I ordered this product, I was too lazy to convert "3-4 mm" to inches and consequently discovered the "Coarse Grinder Salt" was almost 1/4" (1/6" to be exact), way too coarse for my salt grinder.  Shortly after receiving my order from Amazon, I received a courtesy email from the Spice Lab to make sure I was happy with my order.  I replied that actually I was not happy, but the fault was mine because I didn't convert the metric dimensions to English units and consequently didn't realize how coarse the salt would be, which was too coarse for my salt mill.  Two days later I received a package of smaller crystals, no charge.  That's amazing customer service!

This product seems to have replaced a similar previous product (Natural Himalayan Crystal Salt). The previous prodcut was a deeper pink color and the texture was better than what I was finding elsewhere. This new product (Himalayan Organic Natural Unprocessed Cooking Salt) is much more like what the competitors are selling. I've enjoyed all my products from The Spice Lab, but was disappointed with the replacent for this product.

This pink salt has a very nice subtle flavor. I didn't know salt could vary in flavor until I tried this one. We bought the salt initially because (a) it's organic and (b) my daughter wanted pink salt! But the flavor is what really made the difference. I don't know much about salt, but I want to say that this has a "rounded" flavor meaning it isn't harsh or distinctive on food, rather it seems to become part of the food, going in and bringing back the flavor of the food in an enhanced way. Sounds silly, but I am learning good quality ingredients really make a difference.

Yes, I do use this product for salting some of my foods, but it also has another handy use. Because the grains of salt are much larger than normal, I use this salt to clean my cast iron grill and skillet. I pour one or two tablespoons of salt on the slightly warm grill or skillet, and rub the salt into the bottom and sides of the pans with a wadded up paper towel. The salt even quickly makes short work of cleaning the RIDGED bottom of my cast iron grill pan. Works perfectly. I usually keep two or three packages of this product on my spices shelf because I use it frequently both for salting food and cleaning the cast iron.

We were pleased with this salt. It's actually more salty than regular salt, even kosher salt or sea salt.  A little bit goes a long way!  I don't usually cook with it, but add it to things afterwards. I've been hand grinding it.

Not sure, but have been reading about Himalayan salt and apparently there is a high fluoride in this salt according to several reviews I've read, and that's not so good.  However, it looks very nice in my salt mill and tastes much better than Morton salt and I don't use it everyday.  Also, it's mined in Pakistan if that really matters.

placed the order on tuesday, received it on saturday with the cheapest shipping; super faster. the himalayan salt comes in a sealed ziploc bag that has a bottom that allows it to sit up vertically which is convenient for storage especially if you have way too many spices and sacks of beans and sugars and what not like me. in addition, it came with 3 samples (himalayan salt, lemon citron flake salt, and cyprus white flake salt) weighing quite a few grams each (sorry, doesn't say the weight and i don't have a scale with me at the moment).as far as product quality goes, i typically buy my himalayan salt from whole foods and aesthetically this salt look exactly like the salt i get from whole foods. i haven't tasted it yet, but i bet it tastes like salt. of course price wise this salt (the spice lab) is WAY cheaper than buying himalayan salt at whole foods (even including shipping).

This is a great salt; it has a wholesome flavor and, I noticed it doesn't make you thirsty or rise the blood pressure as regular salt does. That's the benefit of the natural balance of minerals in it. I would recommend this to friends and health conscious people.
This salt is so pink and taste like the ocean, I love it. Make sure to buy a grinder of some sort if you plan to use it on salads or sprinkle on cold dishes.

This is the first time I have used land mined salt.  I usually use salt from various sea sources.  After reading several reviews here on Amazon I decided to try this salt.  I was very pleasantly surprised the first time I tasted the salt. The flavor was fresh and subtle.  Not like the salt you usually buy in the grocery stores. Plus it has a lot of trace minerals your body needs.  I highly recommend this salt.

I love pink himalayan salt! It is loaded with minerals and taste great.  I don't have to use as much as the conventional table salt and I don't feel bad about using it because I know that it's also really good for my body.

column9: What I have been looking for....
column10: The product has far fewer pink crystals than shown in the picture, which is perfectly fine with me.  The salt is coarse, excellent for salt mills.  It tastes great and the size is what I wanted and haven't been able to find elsewhere.  The price and service is excellent, as well.

column9: the only salt I use--except herbamare and trocomare
column10: I have not purchased this from Amazon yet as still on what I purchased elsewhere BUT I noticed many people buying the one pound bag. Just to let you know: one kilo equals 2.2 lbs. Why would you buy the one pound bag on something that never goes bad when you can get more than double for just a few dollars more.Dr. Mercola's comments regarding Himalaya salt benefits are what started me using this initially a few years ago. You can easily see his comments at mercola.com.Himalaya salt has a very 'clean' taste--add at the end of cooking.
I bought Himalayan Organic Salt twice. Each time, quality was really good and service was fast and courteous (The Spice Lab's). I will buy it again.

I was very pleased with the Himalayan salt. It really does taste much better than ordinary salt and you can actually taste some of the other minerals in it. I would describe it like licking a salty rock, but in a good way. Very pleased and will be buying more.

I have never ordered sea salt before. i thought this was great. I was afraid it would have some additional flavor that I wouldnt like. Instead it was fresh tasting & natural. I like the pink color, but glad it doesnt come out pink.

column9: Very good salt for a very good price
column10: I'll certainly be a repeat customer. I had a tough time finding large salt crystals to refill a grinder, but this fit the bill nicely.Flavor is clean with slight minerality. The color is not a deep as some other himalayan pink I've seen, but it's a very good finishing salt, and a good conversation piece when put on the table in a clear grinder.Also, the seller included a coupon for a future purchase in the package, which was a nice bonus.
This salt has a slightly earthy taste. It is moderately coarse. I bought a ceramic grinder for when I would like to have it a little finer. I love this salt!

Great salt! Though now that I know how great it is I will have to buy a bigger bag next time. Mixed with some epsom salt and essential oils this makes a great bath salt. Ground up a bit finer it is wonderful for cooking. Will certainly buy again.

I had been told that Himalayan salt was much better for you.  After shopping around, I found the best deal was through Amazon.  It came in a heavy resealable bag and works great in my salt mill.  I would buy this again and recommend it to my friends.

I use this salt very liberally now especially after finding out that its table salt you really need to avoid.  Our bodies need salt to live and this is the purest kind out there.  I plan to make this salt a part of my regular diet.

I love this salt!!  The delivery was quick, the price was reasonable and the salt imparts a wonderful flavor to everything I eat!  And, it doesn't burn my tongue!  I will be using this salt for ever more!
I absolutely love this salt.  The flavor is awesome and at a great price.  No more box salt for me.

I discovered this salt about 2 years ago and have not looked back. I love it. The Spice Lab gives you a high quality product for a great price. It is hard to describe Himalayan salt - you get more salty goodness without using so much. It is delicious!
Great buy!  Fantastic taste and pleasing pink hue from the iron content.  I prefer a grinding salt, and this one is unprocessed for it's better for you.

column9: Slightly pink in color, but salt non-the-less.
column10: Can't tell it is any different than normal salt, except for a slight pink tinge. But if it has all the great minerals and stuff... all the better!

This salt is so tasty!  It tastes nothing like the iodized table salt.  This has a light, mild taste that greatly enhances meats, vegetables, etc.  It's pink/peach color also looks very pretty in my clear Cole/Mason grinder.  It grinds very finely with no issue.  In fact, this salt grinds so finely that it leaves a fine coating, almost like a powder, around the inside of the clear grinder.  If you're a neat freak, this might bug you a little and you might find yourself wiping out the top of the grinder.  Great salt and the bag lasts a long time.

Just like in the store for a fraction of the price. I purchased this to refill my expensive pink salt grinder. A million times better than table salt. I don't know if it tastes any different from regular table salt but I think there is something about the shape of the crystals that changes the way the salt hits your tongue. If you have a good grinder I highly recommend checking this stuff out.

This salt is great and way cheaper than any of the local spice shops. It does seem more difficult to grind than other himilayan salts I have tried, but doing a little at a time makes it well worth it. Would i buy it again?? YES
this is a fine example of mineral-rich himalayan salt. The packaging also keeps it fresh. It comes in a zip-seal pouch.
Fast service and item was exactly as described. Would purchase from this seller again. They even sent along more information on this salt and others as well as sent me some samples.
This is my kids favorite of the salts at the moment.  I like it too, and will keep it in my collection. Great deal also, and great company to do business with.

The bag was smaller than I expected, but that's probably just me being bad at estimating things.  The salt seems good, however, I was a little disappointed that the photo showed the salt to be much more vibrantly colored than they actually are.  I mean, they are pink, just not so bright pink as it shows.  The salt has a good flavor though.  I'd say it was worth the price.

I got this for work, as I am a cook. Everyone noticed that I have had a change in the flavors of my food. They said it was a good change. Personally I have enjoyed useing the salt in different foods. I do like it very much.

I use this Pink Himalayan course grain salt in salt grinders because it looks great, but also I make my own homemade Herbal Salt using Rosemary, Lemon Thyme and Pink Himalayan course grain salt...tastes great and look great in the grinders and shakers.  I've very satisfied.  I plan on making up some more Herbal Salts for Christmas gifts using this Pink Himalayan salt.  Very satisfied!
We grind our salt/pepper/spices fresh and this is out salt of choice.  It's milder than regular table salt, which allows for more precise control of how salty you want your foods.

The Spice Lab is a completely wonderful company!!!I received my order promptly. The salt is very high quality and a beautiful pink color.Due to my miscalculation, I ordered crystals that were too big for my grinder.I sent a note and asked if I could exchange it for smaller crystals.Customer service answered quickly and said "They were sending me a bag of smaller crystals" completely free.How wonderful of them!!!You don't see that very often these days. I commend Spice Lab for having such wonderful "customer service!" I am now a dedicated customer!!! Thank you Spice Lab for my quality salt!! I am going to make "Sole" and cook with it every day!!!

column9: SALT OF THE EARTH - Himalayan Style
column10: Silly me, I didn't even know there was such a thing as pink Himalayan salt.  A friend actually mentioned it to me as we were discussing moving into a vegetarian life style.  So now, it's like buying a red, Ford Mustang.  It's all you see on the road or, in this case, on the shelves of the stores.I'm actually glad I purchased this and have stopped using regular old white salt almost totally.  The salt does seem to have a milder taste but I don't find myself using any more of it than I did with the good old "when it rains it pours" variety.Since ordering this from Amazon, I've managed to find some here in my little town but it is way expensive.  When you purchase this you will also need a salt grinder unless you like throwing big chunks of salt at your food.  Worth getting the two together, however, especially if you purchase a grinder with a glass container as the salt really looks attractive in a pretty, transparent grinder.  And, of course, it tastes good, too.  About it's nutritional value I admit to knowing zip.  Does salt HAVE nutritional value?  In the meantime, I give this four stars.  If I find out more about the actual food value I'll update this review.

This jam is not a wild strawberry jam. It is a strawberry jam, maybe you can call it Wild Jam but wild straberries are different fruit.

I have been slowly working my way through the White Lion line of teas and this one is great!! I've tried their Cranberry Hibiscus, Moroccan Mint and now this. I love green teas and this one is amazing. I also love it chilled.

It was not as I had experienced at the restaurant which may because they combined it with something else without stating so. This is the best tasting green tea I have ever tried!!!I can not get enough of it! I have shared it will all the girls at the office and they now are in love with it as well. My wife had the Green Passion Tea at a Spa in Hawks Cay, FL Keys. She kept talking about it, so I ordered it. It is really good. We are now ordering the Raspberry and White Ambrosia tea.

I just ordered my thrid canister of that today.  Yum.  As a side note, I don't usually even like green tea.  Most of the stuff I've ever had tastes like a swamp.  This is delightful.  I hope you like it!

These are the best tasting crackers that I've tasted in years. They hold up in humid weather and are great for both parties and everyday soups and dips. They are also great for the special diet folks - no dairy, low sodium.

This matcha is amazing. There's a slight grassy vegetal flavor from the matcha, but it's really mostly amaretto without the alcohol burn and without all the sugar. Absolutely fabulous. If you like amaretto, you've got to try this!  All the deliciousness of amaretto without any of the negative effects from alcohol.  Think of all the ways you can use this!

column9: So so so so so so good!

This is the best! No more cold coffee and the bad taste in your mouth after. I love this stuff.

column9: Not as potent as military "Stay Alert", but good.

column9: Jolt Gum saves me on the job!
column10: I frequently drive long hours as part of my work and, thanks to Jolt, I don't have to worry about falling asleep at stop lights or hitting some lady with a stroller anymore. Whenever I start to feel drowsy at the wheel, I chew two or three pieces and it wakes me right up. I just keep it in the glove box. If you have a job that requires staying alert, you ought to try this.
