column10: I lover Liver Biscotti.  Well - not really love I suppose and it's not like I eat it myself! I used to sell this stuff over ten years ago and I had a rapidly growing online pet business.  I met the owner at a pet product show in Chicago and he was so enthusiastic about his product that I had to try some.  Now - my dog was my "product tester".  It was love at first bite! Our dog would sit, roll over, speak, beg - every trick he had in his bag of tricks just for a cube of Liver Biscotti!  I wasn't the largest retailer of the product, but I sold a lot and never had a complaint.  Even after I sold the business, I would purchase Liver Biscotti for our dog because he loved it so much!There are two sizes now.  The small bite size is most definately for small, even tiny, dogs.  The cubes are barely 3/16" on each side.  The original Liver Biscotti cubes are larger, about 3/8 in size and I would advise that they are more suitable for a dog over 8-10 lbs.  Biscotti, just like human biscotti, is dry and crunchy.  If you're looking for a moist treat, try something else. These are great trainign treats because you can keep them in a pouch on a belt and they won't stick together or mold.  However, if you leave them together too long with much movement, they may crumble somewhat.I believe the newer bags are a slight improvement over the original paper bags.  I didn't really ave a problem with the origina bag, but I suspect that the newer bag (since it has a "zip lock" will remain fresher longer.  Not every dog loves this stuff, but a lot of them do.  Try a bag and if it works for you, I've seen an option (here on Amazon) by some sellers to go on a monthly order basis.  I'm not sure that would work for me, but it might for some.  Good luck!

I didn't open this order for a couple of months ,,,I kept it with my other dog treats in a sealed tumbeware container. When I opened the bag not only where the treats really small (crumbs) but there were hundreds of small brown weasels in the bag I immediately through them out and checked out my other treats ...nothing else was attacked ....

I wish I had bought these from another provider, because now, looking back, I see that others posted the same thing I did. These treats were not at all what I expected. Biscotti, to me, brings to mind the kind a human would get in a grocery store. These are the tiniest bits of crumbs I have ever seen! I expected to be able to use these as training treats for my 58-lb English bulldog...he leaves crumbs bigger than this behind when he eats a biscuit! These are too small, also for my 20lb French bulldogs! The dogs seem to love them, but just be aware of the size of the individual pieces. I am posting a picture as well.

These treats are far smaller than I expected. They look almost like a crumb of food and though my dog seems to enjoy them I feel like I'm ripping her off giving her these tiny (over priced) treats she can hardly even chew. They're smaller than a cheerio. I would not buy again.

The original liver biscotti came in small blocks.  These are tiny pieces that almost seem like they might have been leftovers from when they were making the blocks (broken pieces, etc.).  They make a crumby mess everywhere and there is no teeth cleaning benefit from chewing them up.  The only benefit is that apparently have the same delicious taste.

column9: Outstanding dog training treat with minimum calories
column10: Dog loves them.  Small size make handling the treat best used for stationary training.
Our cats loved the liver treats. Packaging tore during shipping so had to patch the packet.

The new Reese's Minis are incredibly delicious.  I'm not a huge fan of the other Reese's products, but these hit the spot perfectly.  The great thing is you taste more chocolate in these than in other Reese's products.  They are the perfect size to drop in your mouth as a snack and the peanut butter is extremely soft.  The other great thing about this product is that you don't have to peel off a wrapper like you do with other Reese's products.I would recommend this treat to any peanut butter lover!!!
These things are so addicting.  I love putting four or five of these things in my mouth at once.Not good for the blood sugar but then again most things that taste as good as these things aren't.

column9: Perfection. The only Reese's I will ever eat.
column10: But seriously these are perfect. A perfect ratio of chocolate and peanut butter filling.A real bite sized candy.

More delicious than ever. Worth a try if the price is right. I will buy more when i catch them on sale sometime. They are too delicious. My order arrived fresh and undamaged. The minis are very smooth and silky but not gritty at all. You might like them too. They are not wrapped up in paper. I really think they are much better than the original product that comes in the bigger size. A better balance of rich chocolate with the peanut butter inside.

column9: DO NOT ORDER IN THE SUMMER
column10: Unfortunately, when this product arrived in this afternoon all the packages inside appeared to be full of liquid. After placing the entire box in the fridge and opening up one of the packages I found that the Reese's Minis had all melted into one big clump (so much for a bite sized snack). I was planning on giving these out at a meeting and now am stuck with a pack of 16 melted candies. I gave it an overall 2 because the candy itself is probably still good but Amazon should take into account that some of the candy that gets shipped during the summer COULD MELT. I am usually pleased with the overall packaging of Amazon products, but WILL NOT be ordering food from them anytime soon. I WOULD ADVISE ALL PERSONS INTERESTED IN THIS PRODUCT TO NOT ORDER IT DURING THE SUMMER, unless you want a giant melted down mess of a product. :(

column9: How to make a quick inexpensive paella at home
column10: I added the photo on this page. I'm from Miami originally and miss the paella we used to get cheap there, in the 70's. But who can afford to buy saffron, it's the most expensive spice in the world. And the few local restaurants here in Denver, that serve paella, get about $20 a plate for this dish! Then one day, I was searching around and found this product. 5 saffron packets. So we get 5 lbs of chicken thighs at Walmart, cheap, and add rice, a tablespoon of cumin, onion and garlic to taste, perhaps a beer of your preference, as part of the water for the rice, and some shrimp ( and/or other sea food of your choice ) about 20 minutes from the end of the cook cycle. Absolutely delicious!

Excellent seasoning, easy to use packets.  I have made a large batch of paella using the entire packet contents, as well as smaller batches using part of the contents of the packet.  Taste is always excellent and authentic.  Delicious results!  I plan to try some of the recipes that come with the seasoning.  It is better priced on Amazon than any other site on the web.
It's NOT cheap, but I like it.  It's easy to use.  Make sure you add a good amount of salt.

If you are an avid bread machine user I highly recommend getting this. We haven't eaten store bought bread at home for almost 2 years now. I was using active dry yeast in my bread machine and switched when I saw this at a local store. A 7 oz jar at Walmart is like $5.98. I keep it in my fridge after opening and it lasts forever. The bread turns out much better using this. I highly recmoned this product! I love it so much I wont even try Fleischmann's.

Bread machine yeast does make a difference in the out come of the texture of the bread. I have to make gluten free bread and it is really critical, this will help the flours have a lighter result. When ever baking gluten free bread it has a heavyness to it and I believe this product does help in the bread machine.

Yeast for bread machines is so expensive in the retail stores >$8 for a jar.  Amazon has the best value on the internet.  Yeast had a great expiry date too: 11/2010.  I'll use it all in easily in the next two years!
I get this yeast locally for only one fifth the price it's sold here, so you definitely will want to look locally for this. But it is the best yeast I've found!
one glassjar was brocken .so ionly have 2. there dit not wrapp the jars it was lose in the pckg.otherwise the yeast is good for breadbacking.

I had high hopes for this tea when I placed my order, however after a month it is still dissapointing. It seeems no matter what amount of time I brew this tea for, or vary the amount of tea I am using it is very bitter. Using sugar or honey does not help the situation. I have purchased Davidson's tea before, and have been very happy with the quality of tea. I think perhaps I got a bad batch. In the future I will only purchase tea that has been well reviewed by others.
I LOVE these! They are slightly sweet which is just what I crave. They are very filling so they make a perfect mid-day snack that doesn't contain lots of calories. I'm a big fan!

I really like Jasmine rice but locally it is usually cost prohibitive OR comes in huge quantities. This is a happy medium and delivered right to my door. It's a welcome change to the rice selections at the grocery store. For those the use rice as a gravy vehicle, this is too good for that, any old rice will do.

I was happily surprised how good the rice turned out: didn't stick and had a decent firmness.  We use Zojirushi rice maker, gold standard as far as I am concerned.  And the rice turne out perfectly with 1:1 rice to water ratio.  To get the clean, no sticky rice aspect,you do need to rinse the rice out three times with cold water!  A trick of my family.  No more heckling to the super market, as a solid rice eater, I am suitably impressed.
Nothing beats Jasmine rice! We use this in our rice cooker and its perfect everytime. We enjoy rice with about every meal, and this is one of our favorite.

This rice is the best rice I've ever had and its a shame I never tried anything other than American rice for so long. Perfect rice just like out of the best resturants every single time with my cheap rice cooker. I would rate this 5 stars but the rice sometimes comes with a bug problem... I've ordered dozens of bags in the past year from amazon and about 25% of the bags have tiny dead bugs in them.Apparently its quite common for bugs to be in rice, though I had never seen any until buying this brand. They are harmless though and float to the top as soon as you add water so you can scoop the 5-6 out and cook as you normally would. But if you dont want to do that be prepared to throw away a quarter of the bags you buy.

I've always been a rice man, but my wife has always preferred mashed potatoes.  I ordered this rice through Amazon and my wife became a rice fan as well.  Smells great when cooking and taste good with as little as butter and salt.

This rice is a great for your buck! Just got done eating a bowl of it! Rice is a great food for deployment, just a rice cooker and add water and rice.Rice isn't that sticky, but might have been how we cooked it up. Lots of people had it, and everyone enjoyed it. Can't really taste the jasmine if you're not looking for it. Add some soy sauce and you can't taste it at all. I'll buy more of this stuff soon.

Funny reviewing something so basic, but this jasmine rice is great! The bags are a good size, last quite a while. I use this rice in my cheapie rice cooker and it turns out perfect. I don't bother rinsing it beforehand because 1. I'm lazy and 2. always seem to end up wasting rice because it falls into the sink! Because I don't rinse it, it sticks a little but the best way to avoid that I've found is to let the rice sit in the cooker for a few minutes after the timer goes off. I think the steam from the pot loosens whatever is stuck to the bottom. :)Anyway yes - basic, but delicious rice. We recently ran out of it and had to resort to using that plain, long grain white rice from the store. Blegh. Much much much prefer this jasmine rice! Recommended! :)

The only rice I will use is the Jasmine rice.  It is very pungent and therefore tasty.  You can make sticky rice with it if you don't soak the starch off or if you do wash the starch off then you can make it not sticky, which is my preference.  This brand is as good as I've tried.

I wanted to get some rice.  Just plain rice.  Not parboiled, not "enriched", just rice.  Well, try walking into your local market and finding that.  Anything that was just plain rice was ridiculously expensive.  I like to support our local co-op, but I also can't afford to pay what they charge for organic rice - at least on a regular basis.My first choice for rice would usually be basmati or jasmine.  This rice is just what it says it is - fragrant, plain jasmine rice.  My wife and I love it, my kids love it, so that's all that matters.  We have a small rice cooker and it's a no-brainer.  Turns our perfect every time.
Love the fragrance of this product. These bath salts smell wonderful and easy to use. A great gift idea would be to repackage this in individual containers for friends as a spa gift. Great price too.
This rice cooks up very nicely and has great flavor and texture.  I would definitely continue purchasing it since it is good value for the price.
Arrived on time, with the package intact.  Absolutely no problems with buying this product and plan on purchasing more in the future.
smells good and tastes good ... wish there are bigger size available to purchase. overall very good products. my roommates loved it as well lol. will buy it again soon.

I enjoy this rice more than I thought I would I mean I thought I was just buying this rice because I ran out of my parboiled rice, I bought another and will continue, what a great tasting rice...you should try it.

column9: I am in love!  EXCITE ME!  YUMMMMM
column10: Wow, what a fantastic rice.  No need to go back to anything else.  As foodies who cook at home alot, but always in a hurry with three kids, this is just to simply wonderful. We prepare this rice using a basic rice steamer (1 cup rice to 2 cups water or stock -- No seasoning needed!)This rice is amazingly aromatic; sensual and heady.  The texture is soft, not mush or too sticky.  You will want to fluff it, nuzzle it and just sigh with pleasure.  It even keeps well in the frig and reheats nicely.  I never thought rice would excite me, but, I am in love.  This rice is so easy to prepare.  If you don't have a rice steamer yet, buy one. For something that seems so boring to add to a meal, all I can say is "Awesome!"

After reading scads of recipes that recommend trying Jasmine rice, I found it at our local grocery store but decided to check out Amazon before I made a purchase.  What a deal at Amazon!  My son prepares a wide variety of rice dishes on a regular basis, so I shared one of the two 5-pound bags of Jasmine rice with him.  I followed the directions on the bag and the rice was light, fluffy, and had a delicious flavor.  I store it in the original bag in a plastic storage bin.  It was packaged well and arrived two days after I placed my order.  Thanks again Amazon!
Very good product.  I made sushi with this rice, it was perfect. It cooks fast better than other white rice on market.
I cooked the rice today, and it is good as I expected. The minor problem is that the zipper on the bag is not of high-quality...
The delivery is quick. The rice grain is long and thin. It smalls really good even before you cook it. I love this rice!
Prepared in my rice maker. Smelled great. Tasted Great. Warmed up great from the refrigerator. Will definitely buy in the future..

column9: Great brand at a good price
column10: This is my favorite brand of jasmine rice and this is cheaper than in stores. Now I don't have to drive to the asian market and even get to save on the total price.

Great rice! I usually use rice cooker and make sticky rice. This is perfect for that. Plus it has nice smell and tastes fantastic. Gotta love Jasmine. This is great quality at a very reasonable price.

column9: Great teasting rice with some caveats.
column10: I was recovering from knee surgery and couldn't make it to the store to buy rice so I thought, why not Amazon? Well as other reviews say, make sure you rinse this rice properly. I wasn't used to rinsing my decent quality store rice so I was surprised to find the bottom of my pot burned after cooking this one. Lesson learned! Though this rice tastes very good I don't see myself purchasing it again. (Not until I can get the burn marks off my pot at least)

I love jasmine rice and usually buy it 25 pounds at a time at the local Asian market, but I thought I'd try this.Well, I really was surprised at this rice.  I have never seen such large rice grains puff up in my life.  They were like super-size rice grains!That being said, I think I prefer others... this reminded me too much of regular old long-grain rice.. But the best price in a pinch if you need it.

This Jasmine rice is good. So good they named it after that Aladdin character from the Disney film. Yes; it's fragrant and tasty. I have tried many different rice brands and types and Jasmine has become my favorite and the Lucky Elephant, sorry, the SUPER Luck Elephant brand is still the best tasting and most consistent (I've had other rice brands that taste different between bags). The only trick is to make sure you wash it very well as it does contain a lot of residue but that's very normal of all rice that you.

column9: THIS IS A RIP OFF!!! A bottle is less than $2/each!
column10: This is such a rip off!!!! You can get a case for $25 at Whole foods or a health food store. Reach out to your local grocer and request them to order it directly from the Vendor. Don't be foolish in paying this price!

I recently bought a 10 oz tub of these at the local market, and loved them so much that I am here to purchase the 5 lb bag!!  These are so sinfully decadant; a perfect harmony of sweet chocolate and semi-tart bing cherries.  They are good size pieces too! (about the size of a quarter

I ordered a 5 lb bag assuming they woul be very good due to the $50plus price.I will never order them again from this company.The chocolate was extremely thick so it appeared the cherries were large and plump but this was not the case.the cherries were very dried out and hard but what was worse was that I found splintered pieces of pit in a lot of the cherries and  I had to spit the fruit out.The ones to buy are from David and Thomas as they have soft,juicy delicious chocolate cherries that rate a 10 while these I would rate 3

The Spice Lag's Himalayan Salt Blocks are absolutely amazing, you can cook anything on these salt blocks! From steaks, to sea food, to vegetables, to hamburgers, to eggs it prepares everything fabulously...we even baked bread on ours. If you are serious about great food prepared in a healthy manner without the high costs of expensive restaurants you must have one or more of these blocks in your kitchen!

These are by far, the best chocolate chips. Ever.  Even if you are not vegan, these are still the best chocolate chips to use in baking and just to eat right out of the bag.  I owe my fat ass to these chocolate chips, along with the inability to have any sort of portion control when I have a bag in the house.  The store I go to tends to sell out of these frequently, apparently others need to maintain their enormous ass size too, that, and others probably appreciate these tasty little chips. So it would be great to be able to order these by case from Amazon.  Though if you try them you might not want to have them in bulk in your home.....

I bought this product on a whim when I was searching for something else. I am so glad I did! We love to sprinkle this on homemade pizza of just about any kind!  It adds a gourmet touch to any pizza, whether it's a specialty pizza made with mediterranean flavors, or even just a cheese pizza for the kids.  I look forward to seeing what other dishes I can make a little more delightful with a spoonful of sundried tomato sprinkles!

column9: No, it's not like wheat bread...
column10: ... but it is a 'safe' product for people who allergic to wheat, gluten,  yeast, and/or eggs. My child is one of them.You can't expect a product without wheat, gluten, yeast or eggs to be anything like a product that contains them. It would be like expecting a  chocolate cream pie to taste like a lemon meringue pie- it's not gonna happen.What this is is a healthy grain source and a means of holding your sandwich together.It actually makes surprisingly good toast... with butter and jam- great.

column9: A lifesaver for those on gluten-free, yeast-free diet and suffering from many food intolerances.
column10: There aren't many products that are gluten-free and also yeast-free especially in bread.  I have many food intolerances, so most other products add other ingredients which give me a bad reaction.  This isn't the greatest tasting product but when on a limited diet, I am thankful for it.  I always toast mine and add some Smart Balance spread and a slight amount of honey and I look forward to eating it every day.  I buy from six to twelve loaves at a time so I don't run out and place it in the freezor even though the company doesn't recommend it.  I'm happy to see that Amazon is now carrying this bread, so it can just be delivered to my home, and I no longer will have to go to a specialty store which is a distance from my home to buy this product.Ener-G Foods Yeast-Free Brown Rice Loaf, 19-Ounce Units (Pack of 6)

column9: I wish there was zero stars...
column10: This is one of the most horrible things I've ever attempted to eat.  It practically sucks the moisture out of your mouth, and the texture is like chewing sand without the crunch.  It has this awful tangy but bland flavor, and is barely swallowable.  I'm glad things like this are available to people who have many allergies and intolerances, but I feel so sorry for them having to eat it.  We only tried this bread during the elimination phase of an oligoantigenic diet, and even if I could never have bread again, I'd rather eat peanut butter and jelly plain, than put it on this disgusting stuff.  Horrid.  Absolutely horrid.

column9: Not the same as regular bread, but far better than nothing
column10: This is the only yeast-free and gluten-free bread I have found. It can't really be compared to regular bread, but that being said, it is not too bad when it is toasted. You have to turn the toaster up pretty high to get it to brown, but it makes decent toast and toasted sandwiches. I have come to actually like this bread after complaining about it initially. And I feel so much better from avoiding gluten that I know I will have no problem eating this bread from now on.I like the Brown Rice Loaf better than the White Rice. And there's a bonus, the bread is vacuum-sealed and can sit on the shelf for months (You'll need to refrigerate it after opening).If you are desperate for bread that has no yeast or gluten, I would recommend you try this. If you can have yeast, there are better breads out there (such as Pamela's Wheat-Free Bread Mix).

To make real bread, one needs yeast and gluten.  As a baker, I tried this bread on a whim.  It is completely different than the bread I bake or even the garbage that passes as bread in a grocery store.  However, if you cannot digest gluten or yeast, this bread is much better than any one could make at home.  If one toasts the bread (really toast it to a deep golden color) it is a great vehicle for other flavors and has a nice texture in a sandwich.  I cannot stress the importance of toasting enough.  Cold and alone, it is bland and dryer than dry, but it has real potential with a little heat, Vegenaise and fresh tomato and basil.

column9: Great wheat free/gluten free/yeast free choice
column10: This product is a godsend if you are on a wheat free/gluten free/yeast free diet.  Just like the directions say, you need to toast this to make it taste good.  Also, stick with it.  You will get used to the taste, and if you are on one of these restricted diets, it's well worth sticking to them to keep yourself healthy.  We are on the Amazon automatic delivery which is extremely convenient, and is by far the least expensive way to purchase this often hard to find product.
This bread tasted horrible.  No one in my family would touch it.  I ended up just throwing it all out.
I've tasted worse things but I would not buy this again. Dull flavor. Does not satisfy bread craving for the gluten free.

Can I just say, first, that if you haven't tried yeast-free bread yet (and you have gluten or wheat allergies/intolerance) you really should... about a week after eating this I felt SO much better physically (and I'm not "classically" allergic to yeast or anything).  So it's worth a try just for that.  As for the taste, I LOVE almost anything really toasted, so this bread is pretty good for that.  But, as with most gluten free breads (except for one brand that I can't remember the name of right now.. but it starts with a "U" I believe..), this bread is HORRIBLE untoasted.  So don't plan on eating it with a sandwhich or anything (untoasted) because you will, like, choke.  As long as you have a glass of something nearby, you will like this bread.  And so far, Amazon has been the cheapest way to buy it (in bulk, anyway), and health food stores sell it for like $6 a loaf (since it's yeast-free, it seems to be a little more).So Long story short... if you eat gluten-free, it's worth a shot...but if you're not used to gluten-free breads in general, don't start with this one)Hope this helped!

column9: I am so happy I found it!
column10: It is a good product! I am so happy I found the bread without gluten, wheat, corn, yest, milk and sugar in it - it is hard to find. It tastes good when toasted.

This is a bread that might take getting used to at first because, as a previous reviewer remarked, it's not the same as "regular" breads, but I've found it really has the best texture and taste when lightly toasted.  I don't recommend trying it without toasting it, as the consistency is doughy and the taste bland, but it does taste and feel much better after it's toasted lightly.  If you toast it to a dark level, it'll have that "burned" taste.  It's a good product for those on restricted diets because it allows you to enjoy a sandwich again!
This is a waste. If there were nothing better, I'd just never eat a bread product again.

This bread is a terrible tasting bread.  I needed a yeast free bread because of my allergic reaction to it.  But upon my reading it, I saw that it has leaven in it. I ate it without this prior knowledge and had an allergic reaction.  This is not yeast free because it has leaven. Yeast is leaven. On top of that it's extremely grainy and tastes terrible. How do people eat this? Kinnikinnick has a yeast free tapioca bread that tastes loads better for anyone who cares.

I ordered these for my older sister in California. She has severe arthritis and can't get out much. She and her husband both just adore these individual packets. Each one is fresh when opened,  not like the coffee one gets in a jar. They do not always drink coffee. Apparently, they do not get stale because someone with arthritis did not close the lid tight enough. Contrary to the bottle variety, the granules melt instantly without too much effort. The taste is fresh, easy to prepare so they are ecstatic about the thing. I order these for them as some items are cost prohibitive for their medicine ridden budget.
Love the convenience of just having one cup of decaf because I am the only one who drinks it in my house.  The packets stay fresh and the taste is very good for instant!!

Those of us who drink decaff will appreciate Nescafe Taster's Choice especially in the one serving packets for on the go people.  Not always easy to find in the grocery stores, it is found in sufficient quantities online with no hassle.Nice flavor, no bitterness.

Pretty good, tasty decaf to keep the morning routine while you're cutting on caffeine. The "singles" package comes in handy, but if you're using a larger mug, you'll need two pouches to make it stronger; otherwise, it tastes like tea.

I buy Taster's Choice Decaf and regular instant coffee in the "stick-style" packages for both convenience and flavor.  Brewing a pot of coffee in the morning is my routine, so these little packets are supplemental for me and very convenient at home or away.  The coffee flavor disputes the notion that instant can't be good, and the individual sticks are always fresh, unlike jars of instant that have an "off" taste once the jar's been opened.  Frequently, in mid-afternoon, I will use half a decaf packet with half a regular packet for a mild pick-up, rather than take a full caffeine jolt.  (Closing the open end of a stick by twisting it will preserve the freshness for use at a later date.)  Initially, I had purchased the Taster's Choice stick packages at local supermarkets, but it's not always in stock when I need it.  Also, buying in bulk at Amazon reduces the cost.

Having recently been switched to Decaf by my doctor, I was looking forward to trying these at work. I have previously purchased the Taster's Choice regular coffee in this form and found it to be quite good.  However, this decaf is slightly bitter and really does not taste good.  I drink decaf Kuerig at home, so I know that decaf can be good; this one simply is not.

Convenience is the major perk of Nescafe's Taster's Choice Decaffeinated Gourmet Instant Coffee packets. The taste is good but can't be compared to that of brewed coffee.  Other flavors in the packet line are: original, Vanilla, Colombian, and Hazelnut.My favorite of the bunch is Hazelnut.The small, individual packets are supposed to be mixed with 6 ounces of water. I prefer a larger cup of brew so I use two packages in a large cup or a packet and a half which is harder to judge.At work I fill a large mug with hot water, add one packet of Nescafe instant and one package of powdered hot chocolate mix. That way I get my coffee flavor with the addition of chocolate, sweetener , and milk. It's my Saturday morning regimen and a nice pick me up.Using these small instant coffee packets daily would be more expensive than spooning out instant from a jar. For occasional use and to add a little variety in one's coffee routine, the Taster's Choice packets are a good option.  Though the box and packets are  green, I wouldn't label this an environmentally green product because of the extra packaging.On the side of the package is a graphic  illustrating the roast intensity of the decaffeinated instant. The graphic indicates that this coffee is judged between light and medium.A cup of decaf only has 2 to 5 mg of caffeine.

i've often used instant coffee in a jar since no one else in the house drinks it and making a pot regardless of the size is a bit of a hassle. jar coffee loses its robust-ness after a while, it sort of 'stales'. being this coffee comes in little single serve sleeves it is always fresh. and the flavor was surprising and when it hits the hot water it smells brewed, mmm good. i first tried it when i picked up a pack of 6 at my local target for only $1. so then i thought i'd see if i can get a better deal on amazon for larger quantity. i don't care for super strong starbuck kind of coffee so i make mine using about 10-12oz of water verses the recommended 8oz. but if you like yours more full bodied i don't think this coffee will disappoint. ps. DO NOT buy Superior's brand of instant decaf, even tho i prefer weaker coffee i had to use 4 of their individual packets to get even a slightly mild flavor, it was much cheaper than tasters choice and as we learn over and over again 'you get what you paid for'...  so now i'm back ordering the good stuff

I received my pouch as part of a birthday gift basket from my parents.  Problem is my birthday isn't until November 29th.  I just so happen to be home when the Amazon delivery arrived and opened the box expecting it to be my own order ... only to find delicious Jelly Beans!  Early Birthday present win!  Anyhow, onto the review!!Jelly Belly Jelly Beans are easily my favorite snack food on the planet.  These little beans come in a wide variety of flavors, 49 for this 2-pound pouch.  Flavors such as: Green Apple, Mango, Raspberry, Red Apple, Plum, Kiwi, Peach, Coconut ... and Wild Flavors like: Buttered Popcorn, Bubble Gum, Dr. Pepper, French Vanilla, Toasted Marshmallow.  The pouch has a guide telling you what each jelly bean flavor is, and looks like.  Often included with gift box / sampler varieties of Jelly Belly is a small card that tells you how to make flavor combos to enhance your Jelly Bean experience.  A prime example wouldbe  Very Cherry.  By itself it is a very rich - cherry flavor.  However take 1 cherry + 1 Dr. Pepper and you now have  Cherry Dr. Pepper flavor.* POUCH DESIGN *The pouch itself is quite durable and does a decent job when put into a "standing" position, however I wouldn't trust it.  Once you start to devour the beans inside the package becomes less and less stable.  The great thing about this package design is that Jelly Belly saw this happening and included a resealable zipper inside the pouch.  This zipper seal is quite durable and passed my spill test; I sealed the pouch then turned it upside-down with all 2-lbs of beans in it over a bowl, then began to shake and try to break the seal.  No failure.* JELLY BEAN QUALITY *Now for the main event, the Jelly Belly's themselves.  The jelly belly's I got were excellent quality as I am used to with the Jelly Belly brand.  There is no comparison between a Jelly Belly bean and a generic jelly bean you find in the supermarket.  Jelly Belly beans are richly flavored, with each flavored bean having a distinct flavor to it.  This isn't just some sugary bean you pop into your mouth and enjoy a sweet treat.  Each tiny bean is packed with flavor, and by having 49 distinct flavors (plus mix n' match combos) the variety makes each portion of jelly beans a flavorful adventure.I will admit that not all the Jelly Bean flavors are my favorite.  I am not a fan of Cappuccino, crushed pineapple, or Strawberry Daiquiri plus I'm mixed on others... But that is what will happen when you have 49 unique flavors.  I will list all the flavors at the end of the review as well as nutritional information in the "Comment" section associated with this review.** OVERALL I would give this product 4 stars.  While the jelly beans are outstanding and still continue to be my favorite snack food of all time, it is an expensive product.  This was purchased on sale for about $11 or $5.50/lb (11/14/2011).  In a way that's a pretty decent price for Jelly Belly beans per pound, even when compared to some of the warehouse stores out there, but still very expensive if you compare it to a simple 24oz tin of generic jelly beans at the local supermarket for $2.99.  Despite Jelly Belly beans having a high  "per pound" cost, they are worth the asking price in my opinion(I wouldn't pay more than around $7.99/lb though).  The quality is exceptional and the variety of flavors make Jelly Belly beans truly a Gourmet Treat.

I purchased this, along with the gatorade bottle, for my brother as a gift and he loved it and used every last bit of powder. Loved the flavor, mixability. Great product.For me, personally, I wish they had powders in the reduced sugar/calorie.

The seller was great!  I had a problem during delivery, which resulted in the drink powder spilling out of the canisters....I wrote the seller, and within a week or two he replaced my order with no extra cost or hassle....mistakes happen, but I could not have been more satisfied with the way the situation was resolved....

We eat lentils about once a week as they are one of the more nutritious foods in existence. I have fewer 'rejects' than with other brands and they cook up quickly nice and tender without turning to mush. I sautee my veggies first: all small dice: a couple of serranos (since we eat spicy--this is optional), a large onion, a couple of carrots, lots of celery, a whole garlic fist, tomatoes (I often just use a can of organic diced tomatoes, sometimes fire-roasted), sometimes leeks (although i put those in later or they will disappear) with whole cumin seed, oregano, turmeric and curry powder (I use the Simply Organic brand which I like the best after much exploration). Seasonings can vary. Coarse grind black pepper. A little trocomare or herbamare depending if I make my own stock, use prepackaged or just water. Sometimes add leftover chicken or lamb. After the veggies are quite sauteed add the liquid and lentils and bring to slow simmer. Do not let them boil hard but they need to slow simmer to cook. Hmmmm. I may need to go make some now. Especially delicious the second and third days. I add fresh parsley just as serving or sometimes serve over fresh spinach to just slightly cook it. Pita or cornbread goes well. My family enjoys different types of cheese as topping.I am on my third order of these and have yet to find a stone.Update: When I really did just go make these I realized that those unused to using bulk products may not know you need to sort through any product like this. I just pour them into a container and then have another container to slowly pour them into as I sort through them. My new shipment are the BEST lentils I have EVER used in about fifty years anywhere. Only had about ten discards (any lentil that I would not want to eat and I am very picky--broken, dirty, etc.)Also, I just read the instructions on the package which do not make clear that you need to sort through and then rinse the lentils before using. Do not salt any bean-type product until the end or they will be tough.I don't use recipes so I realize that my seasoning amounts are unclear. The only thing you need to add right away to the saute is if you use cumin seed. You can always add more of everything else later. If you want it spicier you can also add something like cayenne, even after serving. I forgot to mention that I sautee all my veggies in a bit of coconut oil for health reasons (it is the only stable oil). You do not taste this later and I finish it at the end of cooking with some good olive oil.When I mentioned the fist of garlic: this must be minced. I use a meat cleaver to smash the cloves to peal more easily and then fine dice. Wait ten more minutes to allow the allicin to develop DONT WAIT LONGER. Allicin is the anticarcinogenic property of garlic and must be exposed to oxygen to develop, but it will start to diminish after about fourteen minutes.OK--there is my novel on cooking lentils! Hope this is useful to someone.

This is a great product to have in the pantry and will make tons of filling, nutritious meals. I was initially warry of buying so much of a product, but I like having such a healthy staple on hand. I find myself eating more of it, because its in the pantry. A great value both nutritionally and finacially.
I've ordered these lentils a number of times and they have become a staple at my house. The quality and taste is excellent. With the free shipping, they are also economical.

I had previously bought Pardina Lentils, Spanish Brown | 100% USA Grown | 5lbs | GMO Free (We Tell You What Field We Grew It In) and loved it. When I finished the bag, I decided to order these instead  because the Eden Green Lentils are organic. I can now safely say that both products are amazing, and now I know the difference between green and brown lentils!Brown lentils kept their shape much better, and were a bit meatier. The green lentils are a bit thinner, flatter, and they are far easier to burst during cooking. Personally I found the brown to have a much better flavor too, the green lentils have this odd no-name flavor that this is hard to get rid of, even when using crazy amounts of spices/bullions/whichever. Healthwise, the green lentils are easily the winner; they have more vitamins and are of course organic. This brand of green lentils is also exceptionally clean, I don't think I saw any dirt at all in the box!When I eventually reorder, I think I am going to go with the Spanish Brown lentils purely from a taste stance. The Eden Organic are nice, but not for me. 5 stars all the same!

These lentils are great and at a great price.  They are great to have on hand and make great leftovers.I sauté some onion, whole black peppers, carrots, and bay leaves. Then I rinse the lentils and add in a lot of water, bring to boil, then lower temp to low- medium. Let them cook about 45 to 60 minutes total until desired doneness. Sometimes I add pepperoni or ham. Ham is especially good.Anyways, these lentils are extremely good for you and make a filling meal.

Great item, has recipe on the box.  But have not tired it yet, made lentil curry came out great.  Even though the box says do not have to soak, the cooking time is cut in half if you soak it for a few hours before cooking.  Also in the process of sprouting, to use on salads.

I really love these lentils and will order them again!I normally buy lentils from the bulk section of Whole Foods, but I just gave up my car and am doing my best to minimize grocery trips.I found that these lentils cook better than the ones from Whole Foods and have a very nice consistency.I gave one start less because I suspect they might make me a bit gassy.  The box says you don't have to soak them, but the next time I make them I am going to soak them and see if that makes a difference.  I normally soak the Whole Foods lentils.

All the labeling says - green Lentils... but lentils inside the box are brown in color --- and I am not colorblind.I was after the green lentils because green lentils contain is more nutritious (more than 3-to-1) than brown and red lentils.

The price on Amazon is good.  If you have never tried it, it's probably better to get a small pack from local store and try it.  It actually takes long time to cook and the favor is just okay.  I need some time to get used to it. However, the nutrition fact makes me to stay with it.

Two cans plus an 8 ounce can of swanson chicken with Gold Fish on the side feeds my family of four without breaking the bank. This original flavor, without all the extra veggies, appeals to my 7 year old granddaughters tastes!Great on those rare cool Florida days. Simple and no fuss.
I'm not sure if this is more or less expensive than buying them in a store, but it sure is a lot more convenient.

Priced real well when I purchased. The only reason, I bought it was for the price. We all already know what the product taste like. Delicious.If you can catch it less than 40 bucks and you like Campbell's Chicken Noodle Soup, just press the purchase button.

I drink a LOT of coffee, and I use a lot of sugar in my coffee.  I switched from sugar to Truvia over a year ago.  Between that starting to play some recreational soccer once a week I've lost 40 lbs.I also stopped drinking soda and switched to the Sobe Lifewater 10 Cal and Vitamin Water ZERO.  This coincidentally also use either Purvia, or Truvia.  Both of these are just branded versions of the stevia extract.The taste of Truvia is very close to sugar.  There is a very very slight aftertaste.  The significant difference I have noticed is I don't have the lingering sweetness in my mouth that makes me want another, often unnecessary, cup of coffee or can of soda.

column9: Better for you than other sweetners
column10: Truvia is reported to be better for you than other no calorie sweetners.  I like that it has no after taste like the other no calorie sweetners.  The 300 count box lasts over 3 months and is considerably cheaper than the smaller boxes available in the grocery stores.

I was delighted when I found another sweetener that seemed to be based on stevia and not aspartame or chlorine (clorinated sugar, that is, as in Splenda). But after I used up my first box, which was not the most enjoyable experience (had a bad aftertaste), I decided to boycott the stuff.The mix of erythritol and rebiana goes through a patented process that is controlled by the same big companies that manage aspartame. Some of it starts out with stevia but the same could be said of Splenda and sugar; the whole ends up being truly artificial in substance. Just say 'no'. Look for a stevia sweetener that consists of stevia, not some big company's invention.The stuff I'm using now is absolutely wonderful. It's called SweetLeaf.

column9: Rated 3 stars for it being Natural
column10: I have been using Splenda for a while and now have switched to Truvia as it is natural.Pros: It is natural.Cons: More expensive than Splenda.  A single pack(unlike Splenda) is not enough to create a good taste to my coffee.  There is a sweet after affect that stays for a while. In other words, you feel the sweetness on your taste buds after swallowing the coffee in your mouth not so much while it is in your mouth.Conclusion: Please buy a few and taste them before buying a lot. MAy be you may like it may be you wont.  In my case I think I still have 280(more or less) packs to go. I have an Idea, join me for coffee guys:)

The only people who seem to like this are people who already have no problem and taste aversion to other artificial sweeteners. I bought this because I wanted to lay off the sugar, hoping since it was semi-"natural" it wouldn't taste as horrible as Splenda or anything else like that. Sadly this tastes like any other artificial sweetener. I can't describe it well but it reminds me of very bitter powdered sugar with a really bad aftertaste. It does not taste like regular sugar to me. I am really sensitive to the taste of artificial sweeteners and I can't even stomach diet pop. So if you're like me, don't buy this.

I have a really bad sweet tooth and love my  morning coffee sweet and light. For years I used sugar to sweeten and just could not use other sweeteners to replace it because of the nasty after taste. Then came Truvia. It is great tasting and I don't feel guilty using it, plus I can have several cups of coffee (also using sugar free creamer) for nearly zero calories instead of just one. Truvia is a little pricey, so buying in bulk from Amazon helps with that. Highly recommended.
This is the only sweetner I have tried that doesn't upset my stomach. I used to not be able to have hot tea in the morning because I'm suppose to limit my sugar and other sweetners upset my stomach.

column9: A perfect replacement for artificial sweeteners
column10: I was a true skeptic. We decided to try this product instead of using artificial sweeteners.  It was a real surprise when we found how good this product was, how it did not have any after-taste or artificial flavor. It sweetened like sugar without the calories and most of all, the product you use it in tasted like it was sweetened with sugar.  Also, you only need one packet as compared to two of the artifical sweeteners to get a perfect amount of sweetening. Highly recommend this as a "healthier" alternative to artifical sweeteners. As always, Amazon fulfilled its shipment and it arrived on time and it came to our house in perfect condition just as described.
This sweetner taste great.  I've been a long-term Splenda fan, but prefer the tase of Truvia now.

column9: As described, but not same taste as sugar
column10: Great to have 0 calories and all natural etc etc, but I've tried it with various teas, and especially my espresso's and it just doesn't taste the same. You still get the "sweetener"/artificial flavor. Nothing beats brown sugar I guess..

I've used this product for years and have even grown some at one time.  You use less than you would with regular sugar and there is no funny after taste.  I will continue to buy this product since it is a fabulous sugar substitute.

column9: Excellent product in large sized package
column10: Truvia tastes like sugar without the aftertaste.  I was happy to be able to find it in a large sized quantity.  It shipped quickly to me and I am totally satisfied with it.  It is not easily available elsewhere.

I don't generally care too much for the healthy alternatives, especially when it comes to coffee. However, after trying Truvia at a hotel, I am now hooked. I usually get it at the grocery store, but it is good to see that it is available on Amazon, and now that I have Prime, I might just be getting it online instead.This sweetener tastes really good, and in addition to coffee, I have had it with desserts and it tastes great. I think it even tastes better than sugar, and definitely tastes better than splenda.I cannot comment as to the health aspects related to artificial sweeteners, but I'm sure that there is plenty of information available on the Internet related to that.As a casual coffee drinker, I highly recommend Truvia! Though you may want to try a sample before buying the large bulk package.

column9: enough truvia to last a lifetime!
column10: ultra convenient and not so big like typical sam's club economy boxes where you have no room to fit it in your cupboards. buying in bulk is definitely the way to go and amazon had the best price by comparison to other online and local stores (yes I checked, as this stuff is generally NOT cheap, so I wanted the biggest bang for my buck).
After years of using Splenda, my parents wanted a change and tried Truvia at out friends place and they loved it! They changed to Truvia ever since!
We just switched from Spanda to Truvia after listening to many negative effects from spenda. We hope this product does not have any side effects as well. Test is good.
Love this product. Is not sweet like Splenda and would highly recommend it. I use it all the time in smoothies and other desserts.

This was my 1st attempt to get off artificial sweeteners. I liked it! It takes as much as sweet n'low for each cup of coffee/tea(3 packs)..I should say it takes a little getting used to, it is less sweet that sweet n low(since natural sweet is less sweet anyhow) but you get used to it quite fast! and there's no aftertaste or anything like it. If you looking for something natural & with zero calories then you should give it a taste.

column9: Better than stevia from health-food store brand, just as good as splenda.
column10: I tried stevia a long time ago, before it became "cool" and you could only get it at the health food store.  The after taste was too strong, so as much as I knew splenda was not good for me, I kept getting it because I did not want to sweeten things (mostly tea) with sugar and the after taste was just too much!  I decided to try truvia, figuring that maybe the after taste would be better, and I was right!  This is a great product.  I got it in a 9.8oz jar which is much more environmentally friendly as well.  I'll use up the splenda I have now, but I don't think I am going to be buying them again...
Arrived on time in good shape.  The best almonds on the market.  Much better than grocery store almonds and a better value.

column9: Like drinking straight from a coconut
column10: I love this coconut water!  I tried several other brands before trying this one; I like this one the best.  Because it has pulp, it is sweeter than the ones without.  This also means you have to chew the pulp since some of the pieces might be a bit uncomfortable to swallow.  This product does not have added sugar but it does have 10 grams of sugar per serving which is half of the can.  To me, it is just like the chilled coconuts I used to buy on the side of the road when I live in the carribean. (a coconut with a straw inserted in the top to get at the water inside)  A little taste of home!

column9: The best tea that Tao of Tea offers...
column10: Hands down, this is my favorite tea that Tao of Tea offers.  For those familiar with Pu-erh, it tastes very similar to Xia Guan 2004 100 gram toucha in my opinion.  I love that tea as well.  They both offer a sweet green taste with enough of a "bite" that you notice it.  I would recommend this tea highly to those looking for a really unique green tea experience.  As a side note, it is obviously much cheaper than buying a slightly aged pu-erh toucha.

column9: Tastes like an Orange Creme Pop. Without any dripping.
column10: Since I was a kid, I've been a fan of Stewarts Orange Creme Soda and the real Orange Creme Pops at your local grocer and ice cream truck.So when I saw this, I didn't think twice about buying it.If you're looking for one of the best flavors you can find in a candy gum, without added sugar, try Extra's Dessert Delights Orange Creme Pop flavor. Years ago, the only sugar free flavor was mint. These days, it seems anything is possible with the technology of artificial flavors and man made chemicals. Amazing flavor that brings back great memories of better days. The orange Creme pop flavor is highly recommended for anyone who enjoys the real thing. This is the kind of gum I eat the whole pack of in one mouthful. Delicious.

For a sugarfree gum, this stuff is really tasty. It has an intense flavor at first that softens into a more subtle orange cream taste. It lasts pretty long, but I've had gum that's lasted longer. It'll definitely make your breath smell good though.This is my favorite, and probably the most accurate, of all the extra dessert flavors. The mint chocolate chip doesn't taste much like mint or chocolate to me although it is refreshing, and the strawberry shortcake is so sweet it hurts my mouth. But they definitely got this one right on the money.
I love the dessert delights line, but this just tastes weird. It tastes orang-ey at first, but then a slightly minty flavor dominates with just a suggestion of orange left. I don't dig it.

I love this style of gum from extra, the flavors last a long time and it is quite tasty.  That being said, this flavor isn't my favorite, I prefer the strawberry shortcake or apple pie flavors, don't get me wrong this one is still good, just a personal preference.
Really delicious. My only complaint is that that taste could last a bit longer compared with the other flavors like the Key Lime and the Mint Chocolate Chip.

column9: GREAT SUBSTITUTE FOR REAL DESSERT WHEN DIETING!
column10: LOVE this stuff!  Super sweet & works as a "dessert substitute" when you are dieting.  Flavor doesnt last very long & gum gets super tough just as fast, so I go through the packs pretty quick.  But it takes away the cravings...for me, every little bit helps!

column9: just like a creamsicle. so good!
column10: One of the best tasting gums ever--seriously. If you like fruity/sweet gums (as opposed to minty) then try this one. It wards off a sweet tooth when you're feeling snacky. Also, the flavor seems to last a while. Definitely one of my favorite dessert gums!

column9: Orange you glad you ordered this?
column10: This might be one of my all time favorite gum flavors.  I have ordered this large pack several times.  Not only is the taste great, if you like a creme pop, but the gum chewing quality and lasting flavor is top notch as well.  Great stuff!

column9: Great tasting product, but very overpriced here.
column10: Great tasting product but very overpriced here.  Available for a little over half price at retailers like Smart N Final.  I believe it also contains aspartane as a sugar substitute... just fyi.  Please look it up and make your own decisions.RMH, MD

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column10: I got a pack of these today and I have to say, I'm pretty pleased with this flavor.I'll admit that it's been a long time since I've had a real orange creme pop (milk allergies), so all I have to go on is what I seem to remember them tasting like. For the most part, it resembles a mixture of an orange creme pop and orange Tang. There's more of an orange flavor here than a creamy flavor, with an aftertaste that just reminds me of orange Tang. Since I like Tang, this really isn't that bad.Since the key audience for this will be people on a diet, this will be a well received flavor.It still has a bit of a faint chemical taste to it and the flavor wears off rather quickly, but it's not bad for something to pop in your mouth when you're having a craving.
This is my New favorite gum. I bought it at Walmart last night and now i want to buy this 10 pack its so good. Taste just like cream popsicle.

How do I say delicious? Let me count the ways. I realize, of course; that this is not exactly an organic treat-this chewing gum, but it's not for the eating. As a diabetic, this is one of the few gums that I can chew without raising my blood sugar.As with all sugarless gums, if it has xylitol as an ingredient, keep it away from your pets. It is extremely bad for them.This does not, but this is for human consumption. Enjoy it-I do!

column9: The best mild curry on the market. Period.
column10: I have been using Ship brand for a long time. Once I tried it I have never used any other. I find the flavor mild in the sense that it allows the flavor of vegetables to come through...they are not washed out into a single, bland curry flavor. I use this is many stews and soups and I can trust that the quality is consistent. It has the perfect level of spice without going over the top.

column9: Curry powder is okay, but all the tins came all dented
column10: If you're going to buy curry powder in this quantity, and don't plan on opening an Indian restaurant, you can't let the powder be exposed to air or else by the time you get to use it, it's going to taste like sand.  Very disappointed to discover that every single one of the cans in this package was severely dented upon arrival.  Also, the curry powder is really not that great tasting.  I was expecting miracles, I guess.  Come to find out, there is no replacement for toasting your own whole spices and then running them through a spice grinder right before using them (and if there is, Ship Madras Curry Powder is not it).  Curry powder is not really that hard to make anyway.
Very good standard curry powder. It is one of the turmeric type curry powders. Provides good flavour woth a tomato and onion base for both meat and chicken
This brand of curry is awful. I bought it at the store and it has absolutely no flavor. Look for a different brand.

I thought that Ship Madras Curry was going to be a wonderful addition to my kitchen pantry as I use a LOT of curry. This curry tastes like it has become rancid and there is no way to get a refund. DO NOT BUY THIS!

in germany we have this and it's great but in america it just doesn't taste the same.The American Fanta, Coke and most of the carbonated beverage are made with corn syrup and glucose/fructose instead of cane sugar which makes the overall aftertaste very sticky.I can only hope one day amazon has the real German Fanta and mezzo mix at a reasonable price.

These are all natural, gluten free, low in fat and calories (130 calories and 3 grams of fat per serving) and they taste great.  Simply put I love everything about these chips.  The only problem with them is that they're definitely addicting and I want to eat them all the time.  I guess it's a good thing they're such a good deal here on Amazon (much cheaper than at my local grocery store).The texture is somewhat similar to a rice cake, except that it's much thinner so it has a better crunch to it.  They taste like salted popcorn minus the annoying hulls and un-popped kernels.

Open the bag, close you eyes, and smell--you'd swear it was popcorn from the movie theater. As a suffer of diverticulosis I cannot eat popcorn (the hulls are the problem). POPCORNERS came as if they were an answer to prayers. Now, I can once more enjoy the taste of popcorn--and they do taste like real popcorn!

We discovered these when my husband bought a bag of the Sea Salt flavor at a convenience store. I loved them so I came to Amazon to get a case. This Butter flavor was a few dollars less than the other flavors so I got it.The flavor is divine at first, but I can only eat about 5 chips before my mouth shrivels up from the overpowering saltiness. I did not experience that when eating the Sea Salt flavor.I will probably order PopCorners again, but DEFINITELY NOT the Butter variety. I will stick with the Sea Salt kind.

I love chips but don't love all the fat and calories they have.  These are a great alternative.  One serving (one ounce) has 120 calories and 3.5 grams of fat.  These taste great and have a nice satisfying crunch just like chips do but are much better for me.  My only complaint is that the butter flavor sometimes leaves a funny aftertaste in my mouth.  I've also tried the sea salt flavor and the white cheddar flavor.  Neither of those leave an aftertaste.  My favorite is the white cheddar flavor.

gee, delta gave me biscoff and now you give me popcorners! getting culture in the clouds. how could you go wrong with cheesy-jalapeno. c'mon now. The texture can be compared to how hand tossed and thin crust pizza are the same. Its a thinner rice cake meets a pita chip. Could have a stronger flavor but I'm just that kind of girl. 4 stars on the muchy rating scale. Feels like you get more in a bag than you would potato chips. Plus they "feel" healthier, which definitely helps when youre slinging back airline bloody marys. Came in a huge box of many but don't threaten me with a good time, They are being whittled down as we speak. Only shame is you can't buy a variety box. Ah well, *munch munch munch*

I've tried all the Popcorner flavors, and for a while I was completely addicted to the cheddar ones, but now the Sea Salt ones are my absolute favorites.They taste very similar to tortilla chips or baked corn chips- but with a slightly airy texture. And the salt is divine- I LOVE salty things, so the extra sprinkle of salt is much appreciated. These are light, airy, healthy snacks that pack the same punch as a treat that wouldn't be as kind to your body. They truly satisfy a craving for crispy and salty snacks without making you feel as if you liked a giant crystal of salt and scorched your mouth (the drawback to eating Fritos...)Here's a tip though- since the salt isn't baked into the chip or coated on with oils, it's best to REALLY shake the bag of Popcorners before eating- that way all the salt that had settled on the bottom of the bag get sprinkled back on the chips.Great everyday treat that satisfies and doesn't make you feel parched and guilty for indulging. My whole family loves them.

We had never seen these "chips" before and figured we would give them a try.  They are fantastic... a nice buttery flavor... great for a light snack.  They taste a bit like hull-less popcorn according to my daughter.  We will definitely buy them again.
These are some of the BEST chips I have ever eaten! Since they were popped and not fried, they have a fresh, non-greasy taste! I would recommend these to anyone watching their diet. FANTASTIC!!

I randomly got these on a Jet Blue flight (kettle flavour) and thought to myself whatever... When I bit into this chip I said "you've got to be kidding me"... as soon as I landed I hooped in a cab and went on good ol amazon.com and ordered a variety box. I absolutly love the cheesy jalapeno flavour, spicy but not over bearing... I serve it at my friendly "get-togethers" but everyone wants a bag to go. of course I tell them they better go on amaie and order their own... (now i hide the box in my bedroom ;)

column9: You really can't eat just one bag!
column10: This product has been waited for, I can personally say all my life. I love popcorn, but hate the things that usually come with it. It always gets stuck in the teeth or in the back of your throat. Not with Pop Corners, here you can eat and eat and never have anything get stuck or choke you. I love it, and I wish I could keep buying it. Sea Salt is my all time favorite and I try to get it as much as I possible can afford it. Buying by the case made it great, having as much as I want, when I want it, but it can get a bit expensive. But when the time is right I will be buying more to enjoy. If I could scream this out my window, I would scream for everyone to buy Pop corners. It's the greatest invention since the light bulb. Medora Snacks Popcorners Popped Corn Chips with Sea Salt, 5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)

I found these snacks on a jetblue flight and since then they have been my primary snacking chip. They are have pretty much healthy snacks for you because their is nothing bad in them. It is quite amazing and they are even gluten free for people that need good snacks like that.The most important part is they are delicious. I can't quite describe them, but they beat anything else out there. They also solved my old Doritos problem where the chips would slice the roof of my mouth......

If you like popcorn, you will like Pop Corners.  The sea salt is not overbearing.  They really are just like popcorn, but in a little triangle.  My two and a half year old loves them too!  They are a lot better than greasy chips!

I came across these on a dinnerless night while waiting in line at Marshall's. I think i had most the bag gone before i got to a cashier. Now i go to Marshall's specifically to buy these since i havent found them elsewhere. I buy 3 bags at a time and they are only $1.49/bag. I SIMPLY LOVE THESE in all flavors and prefer them to chips. Now that i can buy them by the case, the next line I will be standing in may just be to a rehab. Im addicted!

I tried these once and came to Amazon to order more because they don't sell them where I live.  They're a healthy alternative to chips, with great flavor!  I love that they only have 3 ingredients.  They're similar to rice cakes only thinner, and have achip-like crisp/crunch.  I was surprised to find the size of the bags, assuming they were small bags.  The 5 ounce bag is almost the size of regular chip bags, not individual bags.

column9: Better than movie or microwave popcorn!
column10: I was rather skeptical about the taste claims but I'm really impressed.  I have now placed 3 more orders.  I cannot eat regular popcorn because of the husks, this is better than the real deal, with no husk to worry about.  The butter flavored and sea salt are my favorites.

column9: The only problem is, after the first bite, you cannot stop.
column10: I'm never a fan of popcorn. Hate the chewiness, grease and the sugary flavors. But this bag of Popcorners is no typical popcorn. First of all, I purchased it on line, attracted by the packaging of course (one really eat with the eyes!), which jumps out of the usual bright pink or yellow colors you see when it comes to popcorns. Also thinking it might be just an alternation of "baked chips," already quite popular in the market. Even after I received it, I still thought "The wrapping's really lovely. But I'm just gonna try out a bite...".The only problem was, I couldn't stop after the first bite. Who knew something so simple, with only three ingredients for this flavor, could be this sensational? It's crispy yet thick in the texture. The size of each piece is not too big nor too small. The natural scent of corn is just delightful to the palate. Don't need to lick the fingers....I'm completely amazed and will be venturing into the other flavors. This is one snack food I'd be munching out. Ditch the bags of chips at lunch, try this!
I absolutely Love Popcorners, and the Caramel Flavored are out of this world.  My new favorite snack.  The vendor also made this purchase extra special!

This is just simply a great product-tasty and healthy-a winning combination! plus kosher!! Unfortunately it is so good that I really must limit myself and be cognizant of portion size. HURRAH! I really enjoy this snack!

Like quite a few other reviews, I discovered these on a JetBlue flight. I did try to find them when I landed too. But, it's really not so easy. I did find them when I got home though and have been eating them ever since. The Sea Salt are my favorite by far. I was lucky enough to get that flavor on the flight. If it had been one of the others, I may have never eaten them again. I've tried the Butter (way too salty) and Kettle (too sweet). So, I went back to Sea Salt and stayed there. My favorite thing about them is there are only 3 ingredients all of which you can pronounce.
I love the buttered Popocorners and will be ordering more.  Only wish they weren't as salty as they are.  I'll also be ordering other flavors, too.

I was surprised at how good these were, they are excellent! There are very tasty with real all natural butter flavor. It's like powdered butter, its very buttery. Better to eat this than fattening popcorn for a movie! And the price for the whole box can't be beat. Order them, you won't regret it!

column9: Taste great, but don't be fooled by "low calories"
column10: Popcorner chips taste great, but don't be fooled by the "low calorie" bit.  They are low in fat compared to regular potato chips, but the calories are fairly close.  For example, the calorie count for 1oz of Popcorners is about 120.  The calorie count for 1oz of Kettle Chips is 150.That being said, if you aren't thinking you're eating them for health reasons, they're great and tasty as a snack!  You can buy them at your local Costco too.

Do these taste exactly like hot buttery popcorn? No but it's really close. I love popcorn, popcorn regretfully does not return my feelings.Every time my housemate makes popcorn,which is frequently, the smell makes me nuts. Now I open up a bag of these yummy treats and I'm happy.Medora Snacks Popcorners Popped Corn Chips, Butter, 5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
This is a great snack with the perfect amount of salt. I don't feel guilty eating them because they are relatively healthy.

Regular popcorn makes me cough because of its dryness and its loose kernels. The Kettle Popcorners are a delicious alternative. I don't have a problem with eating the Popcorners, and they aren't as messy as regular popcorn.

column9: Popcorn lovers -- you really should try this
column10: I love popcorn but after trying these, I don't know if I should ever bother popping corn again.  The taste of these is wonderful and I really like the crunchiness of the chip.  Best of all, however, one can have them anytime by simply opening a bag.  While popcorn can be popped, stored and eaten later, good as it is, it is never quite as good as it is freshly-popped.  These taste great however, and I would rank them very close to freshly popped popcorn -- add convenience and crunch and they pull ahead in my eyes.Note that I am really basing my comparison on the Kettlecorn variety so I, perhaps, shouldn't be comparing it to plain popcorn, but I would rate this against regular kettlecorn similarly, and I suspect that the regular popcorn varieties would hold their own.The additional sugar in the Kettlecorn version weighs in at only 3g in a one-ounce serving so despite the great taste, it isn't exactly drenched in sugar.  If you love Kettlecorn or popcorn, you should give PopCorners a try.

column9: Very Tasty And Unavailable In Stores
column10: Awesome invention. I wish it was more available in stores. High quality product from start to finish. What else does this company produce?

column9: Great Snack if you Love Chips and Popcorn
column10: What a Great Snack because I love Chips and Popcorn and with these I get the best of both snacks.

My family loves Popcorners and the kettle variety has become our favorite movie snack. We think it tastes even better than actual kettle corn.  The serving sizes are fairly small so one bag doesn't go far.  At only 100 calories per serving it is a great, healthy snack. These have become a staple in our gluten free household.

Pop Corners are a good tasting snacking chip for those who are going for gultin free or those of us on the Lets Do Lunch diet. They taste as good there competitor (who we will leave unnamed) for abot half the price.

As a suffer of diverticulosis I cannot eat popcorn (the hulls are the problem). POPCORNERS came as if they were an answer to prayers. Now, I can once more enjoy the taste of popcorn--and they do taste like real popcorn!

I LOVE these!  They are addictively good and not that bad for you... just pure ingredients.  I am soooo happy I found these! I pray they never go away! Even my dogs love them and I don't feel bad giving them because they are pure ingredients of corn, oil and salt!  PERFECT!

column9: Great for a convenient cup of coffee!
column10: I have a small single cup coffee maker for those times when I need a quick cup of coffee but don't want a whole pot.  All right, that doesn't happen very often - I can usually handle a whole pot.  But when I want a quick cup, I don't want to be grinding beans, getting out a filter and going through all the same steps as making a whole pot.  These filter packs are the perfect solution at a great price!  The coffee is almost as good as Starbucks for a fraction of the price.
Great tasting coffee a good deal for your money, many different blends to choose from. Goes great with my 4 cup coffee maker when I'm on the road

column9: Mountain Blend Coffee 4 Cup Filter Pack
column10: Coffee is very weak,I have to use 3 packs to make 4 cups of coffee.

Very satisfied.  It was delivered earlier than expected.  I bought this so my elderly mother wouldn't have to mess with loose coffee grounds.  She loves the convenience and the taste.  I will be ordering more.
I like just dropping the filter pack (or two or three)in my coffee pot, filling the water chamber... tasty coffee- no mess.

This coffee is ok, but nothing great, at least in my opinion..  I will not throw it away, but neither will I order any more.  It has that sharp aftertaste that I don't care for.  It isn't as strong as I expected it to be, which could be one reason for my disappointment.  If you like mild coffee and just drink coffee for effect this is a decent and well priced product.  I enjoy coffee and drink it for taste as much as effect.  The packets are easy to open, which I appreciate.

Bought this coffee to take on vacation to use in the little 4-cup pots that are always in hotel rooms.  My husband, the coffee drinker, said it was very weak (even using two packs at one time). I threw away the rest. Save your money...buy something else.
This is my 2nd Order of Island Blend.  I had used another brand for years so it took a few days to get used to a new taste, but its just fine. The envelopes are easy to tear open and very convenient.

I was disappointed in the quality of this coffee.  It has a weird whang to it - a bitter taste.  My husband tried it and said the same thing.  I don't know if I got a bad batch or what, but I won't be using this coffee except for emergency backup (when I'm out of good coffee).
I got these because my son in Oklahoma can't get them there so I sent them to him.  Not much of a discount over single price.  Cases are supposed to save you money, aren't they?

As with the other Earth's Best products, Chunky Orchard Fruit is a quality and wholesome food for my baby.  According to the label, the ingredients are: Organic Apples, Water, Organic Apricots, Organic Pears, Organic Bananas, Organic Dehydrated Apples, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C).
These are just chunky enough to keep things interesting without being a choking hazard.  Definitely a great transition to 'real' fruit chunks!

I loved this food for my girls and they loved it too.  They didn't like the texture at first because they were not used to having chunks in their purees.  They quickly adjusted to a new texture and this food became a favorite.  I still give them this at 19 months when we travel.

I use jar foods when I am on the go or if I did not have time to leave the babysitter food. I made a majority of my twins food from scratch using the baby bullet, a chopper or just by mashing it. Now that my twins are 11months they have been eating table food. I was excited to see that Earth's best made Stage 3 foods.Unfortunately, this Particular Stage 3 option (Earth's Best Junior Baby Food Organic Chunky Orchard Fruit, 6-Ounce Jars) is not Stage 3 quality. It is very thin comparable to the Stage 2 food. It does have a few small tiny tiny pieces of fruit in it but nothing compared to the other stage 3 thicknesses. Seeing as my twins are used to have bigger thicker pieces of food they eat the food off the spoon so quickly.As with all Earth's best I love the quality of the food and my twins love the taste. However, I would not have purchased if I knew it would be so thin.

I love Earth's Best and I was a little weary of ordering it online. But, everything was great and just what I would expect from this brand. I do have to say that it was not as chunky as I thought it would be. My son is almost 10 months old (only has 2 bottom teeth) and he is somewhat picky about textures, so I mix it with oatmeal and he is a happy camper.

The 3rd stage has more texture than 2nd stage. In the beginning, my boy doesn't like 3rd stage that much as his variety 2nd stage Earth's best. But after a few weeks, he get used to the texture and love his 3rd stage food.
Great quality at a good price and pure yumminess!!! I ate them! It felt like eating a jar of healthy goodness.Thanks!

I have an 18 month old who only has 4 teeth. Needless to say, she still eats a lot of pureed foods. She can eat cereal, which she usually has for breakfast with fruit, however she's gotten bored with it. I got her some of these Earth's Best Oatmeals, which adds some variety to her breakfasts. She seems to like it a lot. I heat it up for 20 seconds in the microwave to make it warm oatmeal. I like the fact that this oatmeal has a lot of iron in it, which is necessary for a growing toddler!!

This is a good combo and our baby loves it, but he esp likes the chunky pasta. Stage 3 is supposed to be chunkier but we find that the pasta is the only part that is. Wish there were more veggies for him to chew.

We've had some trouble finding baby food that was thick and chunky enough for our little one. We've come across some that may as well have been soup. This is not that soup. This is a good thickness, and she seems to like the taste. No complaints at all!

I bought this for my baby (since she didn't have teeth at the time) thinking that it would be a good source of iron. Unfortunately, the ingredients did not mention that there are RAISINS in this product. The combination of apples, raisins and cinnamon is not a good idea at all. My baby actually started gagging when I put a spoonful in her mouth. When I tasted it myself, I felt like doing the same. This mixture is just too sweet because of the raisins. There is also a very strong flavor of cinnamon. I usually add some cinnamon to the food she eats so I know that she likes cinnamon if its in a normal quantity. I tried diluting the flavor in several ways, but it's no use. The cinnamon flavor was still too strong. I still have about 8 more jars to experiment with. I'm thinking I'll give it one more try by mixing apple puree with a little bit of this mixture and see if the baby will take it or not. Otherwise, it's all going in the trash. I hate wasting food but there doesn't seem to be another option.

At first my son loves it but when he tried other baby food he doesn't like this anymore . I think it's the sourness of the apricot that he's not fond of. Earths best should sell a variety so it is easier for us,moms, to feed our children. I was worried that we had to throw about six jars.
This product isn't too runny like a couple of the other Earth's Best #3 baby food.  Had good consistency and tastes very good.

My daughter loves this Spring Vegi Pasta.
