column9: Love the taste AND the concept!
column10: I discovered this coffee while on vacation; it is served at Two Cats Restaurant in Bar Harbor, Maine.  I really enjoyed the flavor and smoothness of that first cup with my breakfast. The second cup seemed even more flavorful, robust without an acidic aftertaste.  When I got home, I ordered some online.  I have it daily now: fresh ground, hot, and black.  Finally, a dark roasted coffee with a smooth flavor that satisfies. And I like the fact that it is a product that is not only organic but also gurantees the growers a fair price. Over the years I've paid quite a bit more for premium coffee beans.  I consider this coffee to be moderately priced, which makes it a tremendous value.

Great Decaffeinated whole been coffee. The smell, taste and quality is remarkable. I purchase Starbucks whole bean and other expensive top brands, too, but Really love Equal Exchange Organic Coffees just the same.
a couple of the last coffee orders were terible, another brand though,this one is really good. Not super strong, but full bodied, nicely roasted too.
it is hard to find a good whole bean decaf coffee - so this works for me - also good that it is a fair trade product.

I've been using this for years. I can't get a better cup of coffee than the one I make at home.  It's very difficult to find organic decaf in whole beans. I'd found a small organic mercantile near my house and purchased it there for a long time. Then I moved away and the only place I could find it was that store, but now it's an hour to drive there. I searched the closer stores and could not find it. Finally it occurred to me that Amazon has EVERYTHING and of course there it was. So much nice to order this and have it show up at my door. It's cheaper here too. Thanks Amazon !
Tasted literally like what I imagine licking the bottom of a dirty ashtray would taste like.  HORRIBLE taste.  Packaging was different from what is pictured as well.  Never again.
Equal Exchange coffee is has dark to light roast and is bought directly fromt he local farmer.  They have been in business for more than ten years.

These are the "dry" version of the ones available in the refrigerated deli section of most large supermarkets.  Those are the ones I want to comment on.I will never forget the first time I encountered Li'l Smokies.  I was out shopping for beer with a friend.  We were passing the case with hot dogs, lunch meat, and other prepared cold cuts.  He picked up a package of Li'l Smokies, tiny chubs in heavy shrink-wrap.  He held them out to me, and solemnly intoned, "Sir, your horse is very sick."Leopold Bloom "purveyor of fine wines and cheeses"
The chocolate did not taste like genuine hershey at all! It had a terrible aftertaste! I do not recommend this product!

I bought this at WalMart, and this was the only brand Cross that I saw.  Don't do bunnies.  So thanks to Hershey's for having some faith left.  By the way it was very hard to find, they were pushed to the back of the shelf and there were very few.

We have a deadly nut allergy in our house. We had to stop eating nuts AND seeds because seeds are always processed with nuts. This company is a nut-free place - all their products are safe for us. And all their products we've tried are fabulous.

column9: Out of date product from this shipper - don't buy from them
column10: I received the Starbucks coffee on March 27th, 2012.  The pull date is April 2012.  They are pawning off their old stock on the mail order public.  Don't promote this type of con job.  Starbucks gives coffee one year date from roasting date.  So this has been sitting for 12 months since roasting. I don't want anything if it is not at least 6-8 months into the future.Boycott this shipper and report them or all of us who rely on on-line purchasing are going to suffer for accepting this type of swindle.

Helmand, Afghanistan.  The Starbucks House Blend arrived in no time.  It's better than any of the other brands we've ordered, in freshness and taste. Problem is, it goes fast, when other folks find we're brewing the Starbucks House blend, they always seem to stop by with there empty cups.  Great for Morale.

Last year, I purchased a Keurig machine.  K-cups are extremely convenient and cleanup is so easy.  So many varieties of coffee to choose from and they are generally pretty good.  I've tried a number of K-cups since last year and reviewed a few here.  Fast forward to almost a year later.  My Keurig machine started to act up and I called customer service.  It started short cupping me and would automatically shut off.  It's hit or miss for when I brew a cup of coffee now.  Customer service had me try a number of things and finally decided to replace my Keurig machine.  I am waiting for the new one to arrive.  (I'm getting to the Starbucks review...wait for it.)  I decided to go buy a back of beans, as I had always done previous to purchasing a Keurig.  Also, I purchased a $14 Mr Coffee 5-cup drip coffeemaker.I ground up the beans, put it into my newly cleaned new coffeemaker, and made some Starbucks.  It smelled fantastic.  I remembered that smell.  Nothing like fresh brewed coffee smell.  I started to drink a cup.  It was good solid cup of Starbucks coffee(which is a bit strong anyway I think).  It got me thinking.  I decided to do a taste test of K-cup vs Starbucks.  I popped in the best K-cup I had around, a Timothy's Columbian.  I compared the two.  The Starbucks had depth to it.  Multidimensional compared to the K-cup, which I had thought was a great K-cup until now.  The K-cup had only one dimension of taste to it(some nuttiness) and did not fill out with the floral notes like the fresh ground.  The body of the Starbucks coffee was much fuller, too.  I was really amazed at the difference between the two.  I noticed that the Timothy's was smooth, only hit the front part of the tongue with taste, and did not linger long with a finish.  The Starbucks seemed to hit the entire tongue with taste and the finish lasted quite a bit longer.  In other words, with the Starbucks you know you have had a cup of coffee and it satisfied well.Where does this leave me?  I am seriously considering going back to whole beans and grinding them up daily now.  I love the convenience and clean-up of the Keurig but I have been missing out on taste.  There are many excellent beans to try. Here is a list of pros and cons of each...Whole Bean:PRO- Great taste, multidimensional.- Significantly lower cost compared to K-cup(cheapest I can get is 35 cents per cup.  fresh ground is nearly 13 cents)- Huge variety- Can get 100% Kona or Blue Mountain- Low cost coffeemaker can be used.- Coffeemaker has few parts to go wrong and is easy to clean- Small footprint on counter top for a coffeemaker.- Many styles and colors to choose from.- Fresh taste.CON- Takes more time.  (time to clean the coffeemaker, time to grind the beans, time to brew the coffee)- Not a lot of great 4-5 cup coffeemakers out there.- Not as easy to grind up beans for one cup of coffee. I found it takes a lot of tapping out of my small grinder for 2 tbls.K-Cup:PRO-  Fast coffeemaker.-  Extremely convenient when wanting to make just one cup of coffee.-  Huge variety of K-cups available.-  Extremely easy cleanup with just a damp paper towel.-  Coffee isn't stale tasting like already ground coffee you purchase in the store.  Once you open a can of regular ground  coffee, the first brew or two is fine but after that it turns stale very rapidly.  The freshness is due to the nitrogen  gas in each K-cup.  Each one will stay fairly fresh.-  Relatively quiet compared to the Mr Coffee 5-cup coffeemaker I purchased.  It still has some noise but not much.-  K-cup coffee isn't bad at all.-  My K-cup is available.  You can add your own fresh ground beans and make a cup in the Keurig.  That decreases some of  the convenience but many love it.  (101 reviewers out of 500 or so give this a 1 star rating...mostly saying it delivers  a weak cup of coffee.)CON-  Expensive coffeemaker.-  Track record of issues with short cupping and automatic shutoffs.-  Inability to fully empty the coffeemaker.  It concerns me that water is in it all the time and could lead to mold.-  Environmental issues with K-cups.  There's a lot of plastic waste with a K-cup.-  Not as fresh tasting as the fresh ground beans.-  Lacks that smell of fresh brewed coffee in the air.-  One dimensional flavor compared to whole bean fresh brewed.-  Takes up a lot of counter space.  It's a huge honkin' machine.-  Only comes in black unless you get the mini(which the no reservoir and has issues with temperature).-  Bold varieties often push coffee grounds back up into the 3 holes from the pump. Hit or miss with this one.  Bold varieties have about 30% more coffee in each K-Cup and are sometimes really packed.-  Only a few mediocre Kona blends are available in a K-cup.  They don't have 100% Kona or Blue Mountain.  Tully's  isn't too bad.Maybe I have a place for both coffeemakers.  Maybe I will take the Keurig to work and savor fresh beans at home.
The cookies are beautiful & delicious.  We needed them in time for an event & the folks at Beautiful Sweets made it happen.Will definitely order from them again.
My spice mix arrived and it was fresh, well packaged and within the promised time.  I give this vendor a high rating as the service could not have been better.

Ras el Hanout Organic Spice Blend, the Classic Moroccan Seasoning, "top of the shop", with all premium ingredients  Have used this spice mix many times, it gives a great authentic moroccan flavor. All organic, which is nice, and makes it very easy to do couscous or a  tagine without having to buy a lot of spices.

column9: Fun, easy to work with red fondant
column10: The red cherry fondant has the taste and texture of airheads candy; I like airheads candy. It was really easy to work with, soft and pliable without being sticky.  I've gotten Fondarific several times and have liked it each time.  The cherry flavor was fun.  Not something I'd use for an elegant wedding cake, but fun for a kid's birthday cake. [...]

It was my first fondant experience and I am not convinced... It was really hard to work with but since I felt that the tast was to artificial I wanted a thin layer which was impossible to achieve. So I ended up with a thick layer of fondant that cracked all over. But after a lot of trying I was able to make it look ok. Hope I have better luck next time... The worst off all for me is that is not red, it was a really sad pink! For that quality of color I should have mixed it myself in a white one.

column9: Great caraway seed and a great value at Amazon
column10: I love caraway seed.  It is one of my favorite savoury flavors and I use it a lot in making my homemade sauerkraut and in many of my raw food preparations, such as my flax crackers, sprouted bread, veggie side dishes and  garden salads.I prefer organic caraway and it's not always easy to find.  It usually means a trip to the bulk bins at the local health food stores and then I'm not always satisfied with the price or the quality.  It's most likely overpriced and the seed is old, stale or rancid.I have discovered that Frontier Organic Caraway Seed, Whole, 1.96-Ounce Container (Pack of 4) is not only a great organic caraway seed but a great value here at Amazon as well.  The 1.96-ounce jars are just about the perfect size for me.  I can use up a jar quickly and don't have to worry about the product's freshness.  The flavor is vibrant and I delight in it.If you enjoy fresh organic caraway seed as much as I do, you will enjoy this one.

column9: Bean soup as it should be
column10: I have never had such delicious bean soup. I wish I had known about Bob's Red Mill's bean soup seasoning years ago, I would have had many more delicious bean meals.The mixture is complex, balanced, and delightful but be aware that the red pepper grows very spicy as the soup ages. I use half-packets now instead of whole packets, but those who love spice will probably want the entire packet.I can imagine other uses for this spice: Texas-style chili (no beans, no tomatoes, only meat and the spice); cornbread; meatloaf; spicy potato soup; spicy corn spoonbread, fried spicy potato patties, breading for fish and chicken, in beef and pork mardinade, in biscuits and other small breads, and for the adventurous, even in chocolate cake!

I never expected this to be as great as it is! I was concerned that my bean soup would taste like chili, but it was delicious! The whole family loved it, and this is now a must have in my kitchen. Try this, you'll be glad you did!

This seasoning is the best! I make a quarter package of Bob's Red Mill Bean Soup and add 1 Tbsp of this seasoning, so needless to say one package of seasoning goes a long way. It is very low sodium, so if you like your soup on the spicy side you could easily add more.

This seasoning packet is great for people that dont do a lot of cooking as it makes Red Bob's Bean Soup extremely easy to make. I ordered this more out of curiosity as I already have some great recipes that go perfectly with Red Bob's 13 bean mix. With that being said, I am glad I did order it as it really is great and will be perfect for those days where I am feeling a bit lazy. There is nothing really fancy in here, just some basic ingredients thrown together is perfect quantity. You basically have Chili Powder, Black Pepper, Salt, Garlic, Onions, Basil, Celery Seed, Cumin Seed, Oregano and Savory. It really does make a mean bowl of 13 bean soup and again the seasoning mix makes the 13 bean mix accessible to everyone, even people that dont cook regularly.I have to comment on the price as its really out of whack, something that I am not used to seeing on Amazon. Basically the current price on Amazons site is basically double what one would normally pay for these packets. My advice to people would be to go to Red Bob's website and order it there. I actually just ordered a 12 pack from there last week and again it was basically 50% cheaper than the current price on Amazon. This is one case where Amazon is overcharging in a big way but I wont factor that into my review score. My review score reflects the product itself, not Amazon's pricing.Bottom line - Even if you have a good recipe for Red Bob's 13 bean mix, you should order a seasoning packet and give it a try. It basically gives you the ability to have the 13 bean mix, even on your lazy days. For those that haven't tried Red Bob's 13 bean mix or the seasoning packet, your missing out on one of the tastiest and healthiest packaged soups on the market.

We were really surprised and pleased at how good this coffee is.  We're no snobs, but considering we have a burr grinder and usually grind our own beans...that really says a lot about this stuff.  It is NOT bitter at all!  Like another reviewer said, we are not fans of dark roasts either.  We can't find this coffee anywhere here locally so we had to go on amazon subscribe and save.  That works!

Don't let the "light" fool you; it may be a lighter roast but still full flavored.Amazon sells this for less than my local market, and getting three cans delivered on a regular schedule keeps me from having one of those "Uh-oh, we're out of coffee" moments at home.
We love this coffee. It is full flavored like the Colombian coffees, but not bitter as the French Roast/Starbucks style coffees are.
loved the product it is almost as good as folgers and o hve used flogers for years would buy again

column9: Not bad!  Not great, but not bad!
column10: I've tried the spaghetti & meatballs (which is really darned good), the hawaiin nuggets (which I'd rather not have to try again), and the vegetarian steak...  The Vegetarian steak is definitely edible, to the point where I'd be ok with eating it again.The "steak" bits are quite tasty, have a good texture, and quite plentiful.  The biggest issue with the veggie steak is the texture of the vegetables: on the box, it shows all sorts of nice yummy crisp looking veggies...  whereas it turns out its really just a gelatneous goo.  It's pretty yucky looking, but it tastes decent.Definitely good for camping, or if you need to eat kosher on a business trip.

column9: when need to eat and short on time
column10: Let's face it. This is not home cooked or what you would get in a fancy restaurant. But when you're not home/short on time and want something fairly tasty/nutricious, this will fit the bill. You don't need refrigeration or a microwave and if you can add a salad and/or fruit, you've got yourself a nice meal. ENJOY!!
Like eating mushy, decomposing cow tongue.  There's really no other way to describe this.But the self-heating element is pretty cool, and works well...if you have something worthwhile to eat.

The other reviews are classic examples of how taste varies. This is the same sauce that is used at Popeye's restaurants in the little packets. I love it. My wife loves it. My friends love it. It's good. It's not that hot really if you like hot sauces but the flavor is excellent.
This hot sauce is delicious, it is hot and adds a good flavor not like Tabasco which tastes like vinegar yuck.
This sauce is great for making hot wings...the only thing I use.  I got this as a gift for a friend or else I just buy it in the store.

It is not my favorite hot sauce but I have been using and enjoying it for a long while. It is not extremely hot, but it does have some heat to it, just about right in my estimation. Flavor wise it is pretty good, if not perfect. But, I have used many, many bottles of it over the years.Good stuff.
#sogoodyoucanlickitNOTE: This is part of the #hashtag review program: delivering insights on the overall product experience, without the self-entitlement.

For well over a year, I have been using different types of hot sauce on different types of food.  Before I started doing this, I only ever remember using hot sauce on barbeque sandwiches.  Even though I have tried numerous types of hot sauce during this period, Original Louisiana Hot Sauce has set itself apart from the others as being a hot sauce that I find to be unappealing.  Awhile back, I had tried this hot sauce, but I could not remember what I had thought about it.  So recently, I decided to get another bottle of it in order to give it another try.  When I tried it, my impression was that it was strong and sharp, yet it did not have a pleasant taste.  Also, Original Louisiana Hot Sauce is hotter than the other hot sauces that I like, but I do not consider this to be a problem--it is not overpoweringly hot.  I am glad that I gave this hot sauce another shot, but it just is not my thing.

This is something you can pick up at wal-mart for 98 cents (I have, unfortunately). It's hotter than most generic hot sauces, but the taste is terrible. It smells like olives (somehow), and gets in the way of the flavor of the food you're putting it on.

If you used to use Soy Vey's Cha Cha Chinese Chicken Salad Dressing (which was delicious and addictive), don't think that this is what you're getting here. We ordered six bottles of it, because the dressing was no longer available at the store.  They sent us a new product which is basically their Sesame Dressing.  It tastes nothing like the Chinese Chicken Salad Dressing. It appears they are marketing their Sesame Dressing as their Chinese Chicken Salad Dressing.  I know its confusing, but the bottom line is this: if you want Cha Cha Chinese Chicken Salad Dressing DONT BUY THIS...its sesame oil with sesame seeds mixed in. Period.

It's tough to find red non-pareils, but I needed them for some ladybug cupcakes I was making. These were just perfect. I'm glad I ordered 2, though, because I used all of them to coat 24 cupcakes (so 1 container would coat 12 cupcakes).
Such delicious tea.  Make sure you have a tea ball to steep your tea, as it is loose.  Try it with a dash of half and half.

column9: Good for a low fat product
column10: IMHO, Heinz makes the best mayo period.  Second to none.  I tried the non fat for the heck of it.  Good for non fat dressings.  But, compared to the original, well.....There is no comparison.  Regular version is heaven.  But, this the best of the fat frees out there.

column9: Heinz Fat Free Mayonnaise Single Serve Packages
column10: Product was great!  Very tasty.  Will buy again.  Very convenient packaging.  Price was good, also.  Arrived in a timely fashion.

column9: Needs to steep longer than usual but excellent flavor
column10: This has been reviewed as weak tea, you need to let it steep longer than usual as compared to a lipton tea which is strong very quickly.  It is genuinely decaffeinated as I react to caffeine and have no ill effects.  So we are making our second purchase of this product.

column9: Not usual Harney quality, weak taste
column10: I was surprised that the product came in a recycled (or apparently) cardboard box of low quality. The individual packets of tea were also in flimsy wrapping (compared to the usual sturdy, flavor-holding metallic-lined material). I have been drinking Earl Grey for a while and have also tried several varieties of decaffinated black tea (in other flavors) from other makers. I know that I have had flavorful decaffinated black tea before. That being said, the bergamot in this decaffinated Earl Grey is exceptionally weak. I would not buy this product again and I would even hesitate to purchase Harney & Son's tea anywhere other than from the cafes attached to Barnes and Noble (where it is sold in quality tins).

This particular malt powder is wonderful.  If you like malted milk drinks, or just like the flavor of malt, this is for you.  Malt is mainly a blend of more complex sugars and doesn't generally cause blood-sugar spikes for diabetics.  While it tastes quite sweet, 1.5 tablespoons of this powder has only 15 calories and 3 gm of sugars.  This particular powder is super-fine and dissolves easily in even cold liquids.  Highly recommended.
Wonderful product, no doubt about it! But Amazon.com just increased the price by 63% at one fell swoop. I'll shop for it elsewhere, thank you. (Date of review: Feb. 18, 2011)

I was looking for a malted milk powder like the Horlick's that I remembered as a child.  The NOW brand tastes EXACTLY the same as I remember the Horlick's Malted Milk Tablets tasting.  This malted milk dissolves easily in a little cold milk with a bit of whisking.  I have enjoyed it in milk, malts and I'll admit, eating it dry right from the spoon, it tastes just the same as those yummy tablets!  I chose this malted milk on Amazon because it is considerably less expensive than Horlick's and I won't look any further!

I took a gamble by buying this. This is Malted Barley EXTRACT(sugar taken from malted barley grains.) They really should change the product name. That being said this is the cheapest and best tasting extract I've found so far.

column9: Pure Malt Deliciousness - No Flour, No Sugar, No Milk Additives
column10: If you want real malt taste without all the other additives, this is the stuff.  Barley malt has natural sugars which make it sweet without added sugar.  Good for diabetics. 90% barley malt and 10% maltodextrin.

This mix makes the best cobbler I have ever tasted. You can choose to use either canned or fresh peaches, or any fruit you choose. All you need is the mix, milk, butter, and fruit, everything else is in the bag. It is quick to put together and only takes 30 minutes to bake.You'll love the crispy edges and home cooked taste. As a special treat, serve it warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Everyone who loves fruit cobblers will love this mix.

I had been buying The Louisiana Fish Fry Cobbler Mix and thought it was heavently. THEN, I saw The Calhoun Bend Mill Peach Cobbler Mix ADVERTIZED as the mix that Georgia uses for its Peach Festival. Since Georgia is the Peach capital of the US (and perhaps the world), I figured this Calhoun Bend Mix was worth a try.And it was. It is just as simple to make as the other mix...just add butter and water. But, to my taste it is not quite as sweet as the Louisiana Mix and I like my Cobbler to be very sweet; hence, I prefer the Louisiana Mix.But between the two, I think, it will just come down to a matter of taste...do you like it extra sweet? Or do you like it "Very Sweet?" For the Extra Sweet, go Louisiana. For the Very Sweet, go Calhoun. Both are a snap to make and get you compliments every time. So, it is just your choice!

I bought this product recently (not through Amazon) and it is so incredible.  Everyone I have ever made this for has raved about it and I am shopping today on Amazon looking for it again.  It isn't in the stores nearby :(

column9: Hard to find cobbler mix is my family's favorite!
column10: I have been buying this mix locally for about 10 years, but they were always sporadically available. About 2 years ago the last store in town that was most reliable stopped carrying it altogether.  On occasion I've found the mixes in a country store here and there and I would buy all their stock. Lately I haven't reliably found it in any stores anywhere.Finally gave up on the stores in the area having this mix and checked online.  The company's website wants some ungodly amount with a ridiculous shipping price. Luckily it was available on Amazon for around $2 per bag of mix, which is about what we were paying in the stores locally.The family has made a variety of home-made cobblers and clafoutis, but we always preferred this one. We use canned fruit or fresh. If you follow the directions on the package you get a perfectly molten and crispy blend of fruit and cobbler. For fresh fruit you get great results by making a simple syrup to soak the produce in(and if you prepare it according to cooking orthodoxy it makes it that much better).The 12 pack is great, but we must have gotten the last one since they are currently not available. Will definitely be ordering more if they are restocked at a comparable price.

column9: THANK YOU! Now I can impress with my baking!
column10: This is literally a staple in my life now for desserts. I happened to pick this up by chance a few years ago to try something new and it was the EASIEST and tastiest dessert I've ever made! I don't just make Peach Cobbler, I make pear or strawberry rhubarb or anything I want because all you have to do is add any canned fruit! I think you also add butter and water. But this I can throw together before company comes over and it looks and tastes homemade! The recipe is simple and easy to follow and doesn't take much effort to make. If I could, I would rate this with 20 stars!

Calhoun Bend Mill - Peach Cobbler mix...I'm very disappointed in this mix - I used fresh peaches too........but 7 min. before it was suppose to be done it was already too brown & over done.....I really don't care for the taste also.

For the money, this is a great product. Just a bit of spice, but very well done. I would recommend this if you are looking for an alternative to the boring salsas offered in the grocery stores of the northeast.

column9: Delicious citrus-tangy, and packs just a little heat.
column10: Herdez's Salsa Verde tastes wonderful -- a perfect balance of fresh tangy-citrusy flavor with just a bit of fire from Serrano peppers. 'Medium' hot is a good description -- it warms up slowly, and gets just to the point of being noticeable but not uncomfortable. People who are heat-freaks will consider this salsa mild!!!Many salsa verdes sold in my local (New York, NY) markets are Amero-Mexican, with 'extra' ingredients that I do not want in my food. I decided to try Amazon's Herdez when I saw that the ingredients matched recipes in my Mexican cookbooks: tomatillos, onions, Serrano peppers, iodized salt and cilantro. Exactly what I wanted. There are seeds in it -- as there would be if you roasted and ground your own tomatillos and peppers. Herdez's salsa is imported from Mexico--it's the real thing. The cans are flip top -- one 7 oz. can is perfect to accompany two meals as a main dish sauce.My favorite use is southern fried chicken thighs (dusted with flour before frying in olive oil), rice and pozole (hominy). Not classically Mexican, but delicious. My other salsa verde favorite is chicken tamales. I add the salsa in the last few minutes to just heat it up, or heat it separately and pour over the food. I intend to cook something in the sauce to see if/how it changes with long cooking -- but I haven't done that yet. Enjoy!!
This coffee has great flavor..wish they made this flavor with a bolder coffee. I always make it on the smaller cup setting.

This is one of our favorite flavored coffees. The caramel flavor is nice and smooth, and not syrupy tasting like when the coffee shop just adds a syrup to regular coffee to give it a certain flavor. Coffee drinkers have very individual tastes, but for me and my wife this coffee is delicious.IMPORTANT: Carefully check the price before you order this coffee from any seller. A box of 24 cups should cost less than fourteen dollars exclusive of shipping, and further discounts are available if you order multiple boxes, including free shipping. Just "Google" the name of this coffee and you will find various sites, such as Keurig (where I buy mine), that have this coffee available.
A sample of this brand/flavor coffee came with my Bunn single serve that I recently purchased and this has been my favorite so far.  It's not too strong nor too light for me.  I'll be ordering more.

This was a trial for me on my quest to find a strong flavored coffee pod. This was definatly not the one. They were very similar to the Senseo breakfast blend only individually wrapped so unlike Senseos they would not loose the flavor after sitting for a few weeks. Price was right but very weak coffee.
Great tasting cheese.  Love the individual portion sizing.  Great value for the money.  A must for the micro wave.  Will order again.

I am a big fan of the Hormel Micro Cup soups.  This just isn't one of their best.After trying their "Compleats" Chicken with Rice (my favorite), I had high hopesfor this, but it fell short.  This is basically "carrot soup" with rice.  Lovetheir Chicken Noodle Micro Cup, but this just really doesn't cut it for me. Yourmileage may vary. I wanted chicken, not carrots.
Love this for a quick meal or snack. Could use a little more seasoning but can be added to taste.
Great taste and easy for a quick lunch. The grandchildren loved it, the eldest took it to school with her for lunch.

I ordered this hoping to get a sampler of the tea kcups available for my Keurig coffee maker. Here's what I got:8 Celestial Seasonings Sleepytime5 Celestial Seasonings Decaf Green4 Celestial Seasonings Mandarin Orange2 Celestial Seasonings India Spice Chai2 Celestial Seasonings Lemon Zinger.This is not a sampler, its the leftovers that someone couldn't sell! I was hoping to get a variety of brands and flavors, not this. Eight Sleepytimes? I don't even like Sleepytime! Not one plain black tea in the whole bag.  Oh, yes, they were tossed loose into a paper bag, and several had been bashed in a bit. Nothing serious, but it does suggest that no one actually picked out the selection; they just scooped them out of a bin without regard for the selection. If you're going to do that, you should be offering a 50% discount.
I was looking forward to trying the different varieties and ordered the 22 pack. Unfortunately it only contained 6 different types of teas.  I was disappointed in the purchase.

I understand that the description says "Due to availability some flavors may be substituted without prior notice" so I can't be too mad, but its a bit ridiculous when you buy a 22-pack tea "sampler" and you only get 7 differnt types of tea. I received 5 Green Tea, 5 Sleepytime Herbal Tea, 4 English Breakfast Black Tea...you get the picture. Definitely go with a different sampler.

I ordered this thinking I would get a variety of different teas. Here's what I got:1 Celestial Seasonsings India spice chai1 Bigelow Mint Medley1 Bigelow Pomegranate Green Tea2 Celestial Seasonsings Sleepytime herbal2 Celestial Seasonsings Lemon zinger3 Celestial Seasonsings English breakfast black4 Celestial Seasonsings Mandarin orange8 Celestial Seasonsings Green TeaREALLY! 8 green teas. I will not order this again, in fact I am returning for a refund. The teas were not packaged well, they were just tossed into a paper bag.

I was very unhappy with the selection. All 22 k cups were Celestial Seasonings. 7 of them were mandarin orange. 5 were sleepytime. 4 were lemon zinger. 1 india spice. 4 breakfast blend. 1 green tea. So really, I only got 6 flavors. The cups were covered in in what looks like burned tea leaves or dirt. If you want variety, go with a different sampler pack.

This salsa is pretty good.  I like the variety, but I want to have somthing that makes it seem like I'm at a great restaurant at home.The best I've tried is Border Town Salsa. […]That is real salsa that tastes like it comes from your favorite restaurant.Try some of that if you want something to impress your friends and family.
This salsa is yummy, but still not hot enough for my Dad...  still searching for that one!

I bought this for my dad for Christmas since he loves spicy foods and rarely finds anything that he actually considers spicy enough. He loves them, and they are definitely spicy enough, but not too much for him. I personally cannot handle spicy stuff too well, and one little drop of this sauce had me searching for some water, haha. Definitely recommend for someone who enjoys heat in their food.

column9: Can I Get This in Gallon Jugs?
column10: Put this product on subscribe and save.  If I'm willing to pay $45 a month for coffee, I am certainly willing to pay the same for this vinegar.This vinegar is incredible - I could drink the entire bottle while I'm sitting here.  It is thick and rich and sweet and tangy.  I can see how people would pour it on ice cream, make martinis with it, and dip strawberries into it.Knowing how good it is makes me want to try the 15 and 30 year old versions.  Life is too short to not experience the best.

column9: Not an English Breakfast but still good
column10: Although it isn't like any typical English breakfast tea from England it is still good. I was expecting a black tea but this is more like a light oolong and a little smokey.  It certainly isnt green as the description claims ( noticed that after I purchased). Also I weighed the packets and they are only 2.5 grams instead of the 3 grams as advertised. Also the tea is pure dust.

You're much better off scooping the loose leaf stuff at your local Wegman's or something. This stuff is OK, but it's just not that great. A couple of the sweeter flavors that came in mine were just gross to me. Also, maybe they've changed the product design, but the ones I received look nothing like the picture.

i don't know how people cook without white pepper. it's not popular enough to be stocked in large containers in most ordinary supermarkets, usually found in very small containers. at my local supermarket, it's about 55 dollars a pound, which makes this choice at amazon a great value.

I mix up my own dry rub for BBQ and smoker.  I liked the large amount for the price.  I was able to make up 5 batches of rub.  I like the mild flavor of the white pepper over the black pepper.  I will be ordering this again when I am ready to mix up another batch of rub.

Tempo makes great swedish meatballs. I have used them for years and you can add different sauces to your finished meatballs. They are so moist, everyone raves over them. Sometimes I find them at the stores and sometimes they are out, so with Amazon, I always have them when I need them.LC in PA
Makes the best-tasting meatballs....just like my Grandmother made!  So easy and foolproof.  They always make a hit when I serve them.....highly recommend them!

column9: received within 24 hours of placing order!
column10: ordered and recieved before 24 hours had past. will order again from this company. completely satisfied from beginning to end

Growing up New Years Day was at Grandmothers. The whole family was there and Grandmother did all the cooking. The main attraction was an extremely large pan of Swedish Meatballs (homemade of course..not mixes) and a large bowl of mashed potatoes. This mix is as close to her meatballs as you can get. Just add some creamy beef gravy and you have it all. It's excellent!!

I love this Sweedish Meatball mix and am so glad I found it on Amazon!! I used to live in a different state where it was sold in the grocery stores and ever since I moved to the Midwest, I haven't been able to find it anywhere. It's such a yummy, easy way to make a delicious homemade meal in under 30 minutes and they come out perfect EVERY time! As always, Amazon shipped it super-fast to my house and we've been enjoying them for dinner ever since. The package is the perfect size - 12 boxes. Enough to make the meal about once per month so 1 box of this product could last you an entire year!! Totally worth it. I thoroughly recommend it for the busy mom who still wants to put good food on the table.
