Over the years I have tried making iced tea out of dozens of different herbal teas and most just end up tasting like lightly-flavored water.  This Yogi Sweet Thai Delight tea is the first I've tried that I will make again.  As a matter of fact, I intend to have a jug of it in the refrigerator all summer!  The taste is amazingly sweet (but not in a sugary way) and a little nutty (actually "coconut-ty.")  I don't use sweeteners or milk in my tea as a rule, but even if I did I wouldn't want to add sugar to this tea, it's perfectly sweet as it is.Since there's no recipe for iced tea on the box, I just winged it and put 8 tea bags into a gallon of boiling water, then turned it down and let it steep covered for about twenty minutes.  You could probably also make it the way my Mom made tea in the summer, by putting the bags in a gallon jar, adding room temperature water, sealing it and setting it in the sunniest place in the yard for the day.However you make it, you really should try this tea iced.  I'm not a huge tea drinker normally, but I'm completely hooked on this one.
India Spice is a great tea if you like your herbal tea with a little kick.  It's strong, flavorful, and aromatic.  Also, the little fortunes are a nice little twist.

column9: THE BEST CHAI GREEN I HAVE TASTED
column10: I first had the opportunity of having this tea about 13 years ago.  The blend used for this tea is very smooth.  I have tried several other chai green tea brands, but none can compare to Yogi Tea.  I have allowed several friends, and co-workers to sample this tea, and all are hooked on it.  I have also tried the redbush chai, and black chai teas from Yogi Tea, all were very good but the taste of the chai green is superb by far.  Follow the directions, allowing the tea to steep, to get the full effect, you won't be disappointed.  I usually use white sugar only as a sweentener, but have also used Equal sweetener.  Thank you Yogi Tea for a wonderful tea.

The product information doesn't tell you that the tea includes processed sweetener (stevia), butterscotch flavoring, and some other processed ingredients.This is not the original recipe for Yogi Tea, though it implies that it is. Even on the Yogi Tea website, it doesn't mention the added artificial ingredients (I know that stevia is from a plant, but it's hightly processed for use as a sweetener).I love the old original yogi tea, but I would never buy this.

column9: This tea is a mixture of different spices
column10: Although this tea is flavorful and tastes fine, I should have read the description more carefully. I was looking for pure licorice root tea. This tea has other spices added to it and the orange peel flavor is dominant and licorice flavor is muted. I am giving it three stars because the name of the tea should include some of the other spices. Read the ingredients listed before you purchase. Here is the description, "Combined with a touch of cinnamon, orange peel and other carefully selected herbs and spices" If you like these other spices then you will be happy. Otherwise, you might opt for a pure licorice tea and the box will say, "Ingredients: Licorice Root". That was what I really wanted, although this tea tastes perfectly good.
Mild, but not boring! Enough sweetness for most, but I still add stevia. I have given several bags away and everybody raves about it!

Really do love the flavor of licorice, with this tea I can get that without the  sugar.  It is naturally sweet. The licorice flavor doesn't intensify with longer steeping time so if you want tht flavor to be more intense you have to use two bags.  My husband hates this tea though, he is Japanese and it reminds him of the herbal tonics they made him drink as a kid! More for me...!I also like the Yogi Throat Cure tea, similar flavor but has cherry bark.

I didn't expect this to be so spicy! It smells great but when you taste it, it's nasty! I sweetened it as much as I could but it just didn't help. This is a shame since I like so many other Yogi teas. I'll have to pawn off the rest to friends and family now :(

I love this tea. Spicy sweet,  If your first pick in the chocolate aisle is the one with the hottest chili nibs, this is your no-calorie alternative.However, we must talk about the price on Amazon.  I'm searching the site because I first encountered the tea while on vacation in New York City.  Fairway carries it for about half the price of listed here.

Over the years I have tried making iced tea out of dozens of different herbal teas and most just end up tasting like lightly-flavored water.  This Yogi Sweet Thai Delight tea is the first I've tried that I will make again.  As a matter of fact, I intend to have a jug of it in the refrigerator all summer!  The taste is amazingly sweet (but not in a sugary way) and a little nutty (actually "coconut-ty.")  I don't use sweeteners or milk in my tea as a rule, but even if I did I wouldn't want to add sugar to this tea, it's perfectly sweet as it is.Since there's no recipe for iced tea on the box, I just winged it and put 8 tea bags into a gallon of boiling water, then turned it down and let it steep covered for about twenty minutes.  You could probably also make it the way my Mom made tea in the summer, by putting the bags in a gallon jar, adding room temperature water, sealing it and setting it in the sunniest place in the yard for the day.However you make it, you really should try this tea iced.  I'm not a huge tea drinker normally, but I'm completely hooked on this one.
This tea has a nice light coconut flavor.  It's hard to find in the stores where I live so purchaing it at Amazon makes sense.

My husband puts Tabasco on everything eggs to pizza and absolutely loved this Mexican chili tea.  I took one sip and wanted to wash the spice off my tongue, but knew exactly why it appealed to him.  I'm sticking with Earl Grey.

column9: Great warming flavor on a dreary day
column10: My absolute favorite Yogi tea!  Pleasantly spicy, with a hint of rich chocolate.  I much prefer this to the Mayan Cocoa Spice & Sweet Thai flavors.  It's what I reach for when I get a craving for a cup of hot chocolate but don't want the calories.

My mom gave me licorice tea whenever I had a bad throat, and it really was soothing to my throat.  This works just as well!Now, if you really really dislike the flavor of licorice, you might want to stay away from this tea.  I don't typically like licorice (I can tolerate it), but this isn't too bad.  Sometimes I drink it just for the scent and flavor.

I got this as a free sample and I couldn't believe how delicious it is. It sounded so strange so I had to try it right away. It wasn't spicy but had many layers of flavor. I don't even think there are chilis in it!

I'm used to cheap tea (by the way, cheap tea isn't low quality), but this one's awful. It tastes like very spicy water.. water with Tabasco added, essentially. Although I did steep the tea bag for about four minutes, there was no depth to the flavor. I finished the cup, but I certainly wouldn't buy it.

When you read Mexican Sweet Chili, you think hot! Well this tea while being tangy and hot also delivers alot of unique flavors. A great wake-up or finish to a spicy meal.Clove, Cardamon, Cinnamon then black Pepper and Red Chili flavors, a unique cup of tea. Would be excellent Iced or with milk. I will reorder & reorder, this one a keeper.

So I bought this tea thinking it was the same as the Thai tea that is served at Thai Restaraunts but its not. This tea is very coconutty which theres nothing wrong with that but its not the same restaraunt type if thats what youre looking for. You should buy this tea if youre looking for a cinnamon/coconut exotic tea.

I love the Yogi brand of Chai tea...whether it's the Redbush or Green tea.  It has so much more flavor than other brands of Chai tea and I have tried a ton of varieties.  I like to make the tea strong and then add some soy milk to it to make it creamy.  It becomes a Chai Latte without all of the sugar you get from the Chai syrups used in coffee shops.  It's also good cold.

column9: lots of flavours in each sip
column10: A colleague at work just gave me one of these tea bags.I like herbal teas but this one was really unique.There were really nice lingering flavors on my tongue with every sip.First, a tangy orangey sensation followed by a suttle sweetness married with a spicy masala kick shortly after.The sweetness lingers around the back of the tongue afterwords.Nothing really Mexican about it, neither does it have any chilis. The spiciness comes from some common spices used in Masala tea.If this sounds like something you might like, I highly recommend that you try it.

I'm addicted to Yogi Teas and have vowed to try them all.  This Indian Spice tea is delicious. I've found that many of the Yogi teas are not as strong as I want them to be, so the tea bag stays in until I've drank all the tea. Not so with this tea, this tea has a VERY strong Cinnamon taste, which I find enjoyable. In truth, I may have left the bag in too long today, as the cinnamon flavor is burning a little.The directions on the box say to add milk (or milk substitute) and sweetener to the tea. They mean it. I tried to drink it plain, but couldn't, it just didn't taste right. However, I did add a popular flavored coffee creamer, and that worked beautifully.  This is a whole new drink now, doesn't feel like tea, it feels like a treat. Enjoy.
Not my taste. If you like it spicey, you'll probably like it. Me, I like my earl gray. I'm old fashioned like that.

Sweet, tart & tangy made with real pomegranate juice - fat free, gluten free snack. YUM! Ronald Reagan would have approved since they're made in the USA but you can buy them for less at the Jelly Belly website.

First of all, this is a 10% Kona BLEND, it is not 100% Kona coffee!Second, it is a 7 oz. bag, which is less than 1/2 pound.For the price, you would do better to go direct to the Lion Coffee site. So much for rarity.As for flavor, it's not much better than cafeteria coffee. I found it lacking in aroma and flavor.Granted, the lion is a great looking brand, and it makes a cool souvenir to bring back to friends but, like the Macadamia nuts, it tastes much better in the islands. Save your money and buy a keychain instead. If you're looking for a nice Kona blend, keep looking.
It arrived quickly & in good condition. It has good flavor. Nice product.

I purchased this kit mostly out of curiousity. I have been making wine for a couple years and have only purchased Wine Expert kits which have been ok. This is the first 6week kit of any kind I have done. It is in the secondary aging at the present time but, when I transfered it and tasted it I was suprised at how well it tasted and the amount of body it had. I will do a update once I bottle it but, at the present time I am considering purchasing the Amarone version of this kit. Update on 07/09/2010. this wine has been in the bottle for a while now and is 6 months old from the day I pitched the yeast. Opened an bottle and was very suprised at how good it tasted compared to 3 months. I will let it age for 6 more months now. This is a kit I would do again.Novemeber 13, 2010 update. This wine has aged quite well. I opened another bottle and am impressed with the wine. Doesn't have any kit taste like I get from some of the other brands of kits. This is my 12 wine kit and one of the best so far. I will buy this one again and let it age for a year before consuming any.
I was skeptical due to the price and being that I had a hard time finding this kit but the end result was very good!!

The wine is very good but the package was totally demolished when it arrived. The bag with the must survived OK but the corks etc were going all over the place. I had enough corks left over from previous kits so everything was OK. It's my opinion that the packaging for this 40 pound kit is not substantial enough to survive a UPS trip. Thanks for all the really good wine kits that I have recieved from AMAZON.Tommy

I had high hopes for this wine kit, but after fermenting, bottling and aging for several months, I'm left with 30 bottles of sour wine.  I think this may have been a sanitation issue on my part.  Had the wine not turned sour, I think it would have been pretty good (from a pre-fermentation taste).  I may try this one again in the future.  One thing that I did like about this kit was that it included labels and heat shrink / foil wrappers for the tops of the bottles.

I was shopping around for nutritional yeast, and based on the price and the reviews I found online, I decided to go with this brand.  It is definitely packed with nutrients and is a great source of many vitamins and minerals.  It's flavor is good, although this is the first nutritional yeast I've bought, so I can't compare it to other brands.  The smell upon first opening the jar seemed a bit strong, but it wasn't as bad after using it and opening/closing the jar a few times.I am mostly writing this review to let other potential customers know that this product is NOT VEGAN.  I guess everyone defines veganism a little differently, but this nutritional yeast contains whey from milk, so if you don't want to eat dairy, or can't for some health reason, you should be aware of that before you purchase it.  I will quote the ingredients list from another website:"Other Ingredients: Nutritional yeast, calcium carbonate, whey (from milk), magnesium carbonate, potassium phosphate monobasic, choline bitartrate, niacinamide, potassium chloride, d-calcium pantothenate, para aminobenzoic acid, bromelain, GTF chromium yeast, inositol, cyanocobalamin, ferrous sulfate, selenium yeast, papain, pyridoxine hydrochloride, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, sodium chloride, zinc sulfate, manganese sulfate, biotin, folic aicd, potassium iodide."This is the same as what is on my jars' labels.  You can get the entire nutritional facts and ingredients from the Twinlab website [...]  It's a nice product at a reasonable price in a large quantity.  In fact, it's going to take me a while to go through two pounds of it (how much yeast can a guy eat?).  When I finally do finish it, I won't be ordering again due to the dairy, but if that doesn't bother you, I would actually recommend this product as it seems to be a good deal.  I gave it four stars because the dairy thing was really my fault.  I should have done some more research of my own.Happy shopping.

I like that beef is the first ingredient in the recipe and there are none of those unrecognizable ingredients created in a science laboratory.The treats are a nice size and have just enough chew to satisfy. For Piper, our shih tzu with a few missing teeth, I break the treats into smaller pieces so she can manage them. On the package:Use within 3 weeks of opening.100% satisfaction guaranteedKeep this bag out of the reach of pets and children.

At first sniff the two girls turned up their noses at the new snack. To be fair, this happens with the introduction of most new snacks to this fussy and suspicious pair. By the third and fourth and subsequent offerings, the hesitation stopped. Though the girls genuinely like these treats now, there isn't the mad excitedness for them like they show for some others or for french fries.I like that the first ingredient of these snacks is  "real"beef ( not the undesirable artificial beef),and they are made with natural ingredients. The treats are small and chewy and are good for training, rewarding, and bribing. For most dogs the consistency is probably perfect, just enough chew to add interest. For Piper, our shih tzu with a few missing teeth, I break the treats in half so as not to tax the teeth she has left.Science Diet backs these treats with a 100% satisfaction guarantee.
My 9 year old daughter and the entire family Love it!  It really is very tasty and quick & easy to prepare.
This is a delicious coffee. A good bold, aromatic coffee.  I was extremely pleased with this purchase. I would purchase it again.
These are my mothers favorites and I have them sent to her often. She truly loves them. They are as we all remembered as kids. Any one loving black licorice will love these.

I cant find the mixes in the stores anymore and they are great. My parents used them 40 years ago and they are still around. I was relieved to see that Amazon had them and that they are still available.

My dog has always been finicky, and has had numerous digestive issues all his life. We've tried all the high end food products available. This past summer, he had HGE, and was in the hospital for 4 days. He was on Hill's prescription food and loved it! So we switched to Hill's Science Diet gourmet turkey when he was allowed, and he EATS! Is now very impatient for meal time and so much healthier. We will not feed him anything else. Highly recommend!
4 years ago after a near-fatal bout with pancreatitis, the vet recommended this product.  Our dog is happy, healthy and cannot wait for her daily can!

This stuff works!!  I was diagnosed almost 3 years ago with a form of Uterine cancer that is very rare and was told I had a 15% chance of survival.  The chemo stopped the tumor's growth (at the time 5 inches).  But it wasn't until I began drinking this tea that it began to SHRINK!  It is now at 1 and a quarter inch and so far has not regrown.  If you have cancer or know someone who does, I HIGHLY recommend this tea!  Get it!  It takes time to prepare, but is SO worth it.  A nice warm, woodsy flavor, not bitter.  You can drink it hot or cold.  I nuke mine and have from the beginning.  No concerns.  My oncologist was FLOORED by the results of this tea after she took me off chemo due to heart damage.Follow the directions on the bag and you'll be fine.  Put it in a dark container, though.  Light sensitive.  A friend of mine uses washed out milk cartons.  :)
TRUE! No other juices added and its delicious. I drink Acai pretty much every day - I tried the juices from others I can tell that, this is the "REAL DEAL".

column9: The freshest tasting ready to drink acai!
column10: This is my first time purchasing the Acai Roots Pure Juice from Amazon, but I have been drinking it for a few years now! It is with no doubt the best I have tasted straight from the bottle. It is fresh, lightly sweetened, and certified organic. The best part is that there are no other juices added. I love how it offers that exotic acai taste whether or not I choose to blend the juice with other ingredients. The additional nutrients to my diet are evident in the extra energy I have! I will definately continue to drink this delicious and healthy acai beverage!

I don't know what the bad review is talking about.... I am a big fan of Acai Roots and I just LOVE all of their products! I know what a good Acai juice tastes like and comparing theirs with the other brands, they definitely have the best taste and there is no other juice added like he said. They are the real thing!! I used to buy them at Costco and I'm happy I found it here at Amazon! BEST ACAI JUICE IN THE MARKET!!!

I will keep this review short and to the point. This is not 100% Juice. It is Acai puree, water, evaporated cane sugar, citric acid, xanthan gum; as listed in their ingredients section. It comes in a 32 OZ bottle. It contains about 26 ounces of fluid, as recorded by me using US standard ounce measurements. Although I think it tastes OK, I am very disappointed at the misrepresentations and will not buy it again.
This is quite good. I've taken to starting my mornings with a nice hot mug.

We went to a health spa in Vegas and they served us this chai.  It was so good that we searched on line for it.  You have to buy a big quantity but it is great.  We drink it after dinner sometimes as a desert.  my kids even love it.

I've searched high and low for a chai tea that comes close to the $4 Chai Lattes I purchase at Starbucks.  After many brands Mocafe beat all the rest.  I thought I was drinking Starbucks the first time I had this drink! You will not regret buying this product! Edited to add: I meant to rate it 5 stars but mistakingly chose 4 and now I can't change it.

column9: Money conscious chai lovers look here...
column10: I was spending 4bucks a day at starbucks, until I found this stuff as the local Home Goods store.  Since then, I am a new convert!  This stuff is divine!  So creamy and spicy!  I took off one star because you can get it cheaper at another store, if you have a Home Goods near you that is!

I almost didn't buy this lemonade due to the one poor review.  I'm so glad that I took the chance.  I really like it.  It is completely as advertised.  Not as good as when I make lemonade from scratch but I simply don't have time for that, which is why I was looking for an organic powder option.  It tastes great (very similar to Country Time) and completely hits the mark!

My family loves to drink lemonade, especially during the warm months, but I have always disliked how the lemonade mixes produced by the major brands contain artificial colors and sometimes preservatives.Fruit Blooms organic lemonade not only tastes great, but it also provides peace of mind that my family is consuming something a little better for them than the majority of other mixes.  I prefer to make our lemonade in a pitcher as opposed to individual glasses, and I have found that adding a little more water makes the lemonade less tart (we add 3 quarts of water to one pouch of lemonade mix).Add in the savings and convenience of Amazon's "Subscribe and Save" option, and Fruit Blooms Organic Lemonade gets a big thumbs-up in our household!

column9: Just what I was looking for
column10: I don't usually write reviews, but I'm happy to write one about this.  Finally, I've found a lemonade mix made with good old fashioned sugar and NO ARTIFICIAL COLORS!  I think it's a bit sweet for my taste so I like to squeeze a fresh lemon into the pitcher with a little extra water and it's perfect. I had a bunch of kids over yesterday and we went through 6 or 7 packages.  They loved it.  I'm ordering more now and will always have this on hand.

We don't use too many mixed drinks, but I had just bought Country Time for the first time in many many years. I saw all the chemicals listed in and didn't think we'd finish it. I was then looking for popcorn on Amazon and actually linked to this lemonade. After reading reviews I thought I'd give it a try. It turned out to be the best flavored drink mix I have ever had.I mix a 2 quart pitcher and then I slice up a lemon and squeeze the juice into as I mix it. We just had a BBQ this past weekend and I made a couple of pitchers of it and I was asked how I make my fresh squeezed lemonade. It doesn't have a chemical taste to it at all. I was really pleased with it. It mixed up quickly and you don't get that sludge at the bottom of the pitcher like some mixes.
Tastes as close to fresh lemonade as you'll probably get out of a mix... and it's organic. I only wish the packaging was not plastic and instead was made of something more bio-degradable.

I love the Fruit Blooms Organic Lemonade - it has a delicious, full, fruity taste and it's good for you.  You get about 8 servings per pouch (instead of the 10 it states on the pkg), but it's worth it.  Great stuff!  I also love the autoship feature which allows me to save money on my monthly order.
I purchased this as an alternative to artificial lemonade. This has a great flavor. Reminds me of the lemon drink they sell at our local fair in the summer. Fresh Lemon Taste!

column9: can't wait for my next shipment!
column10: this is a staple for dinner with the family.it doesn't dissolve as quickly as the chemically-ridden drinks you find in your usual grocery stores, but persistence pays.

The Lemonade flavor is excellent.  I like to make it a bit on the strong side, by putting over half of an entire package into a 64 oz "Super Big Gulp" sized container, instead of using the package to make 80 oz of the drink.  Add ice, and you have the best tasting Lemonade on planet earth, and enough of it to last the entire day.  The package could be made simpler to open, but since I started to put over one half of the entire package in a giant container, it does not matter to me any more.  Just cut the top off with your kitchen scissors.  I add a couple teaspoons of an algae/ veggie/ mineral product to the drink, and o-m-g it is the best tasting way I found to get my daily veggies and minerals.
Love it, love it, love it!  Each pack makes an entire pitcher of tart, clean, delicious lemonade.  The kids love it, the husband loves it, and I highly recommend it!

column9: taste better than country time and costs about the same per serving.
column10: This could have been a 5-star item if the package gave instructions to make a 2 quart pitcher! ( it takes 2/3 of a pouch) and the package gives you leftovers doing it this way.  the good news is that you get 12 pouches which makes it ever more portable than a big tube drink mix like koolaid.

I had this on subscription so I know I ordered the same stuff before. What I got the second time was exact same except all it said was All Natural (without certified organic) on it. There was one more ingredient Silicone Dioxide (non-caking agent according to the packaging). From what I have read Silicone Dioxide can happen naturally AND it can be made synthetically. Who knows which is which. This USED to be my favorite, now I am not sure anymore.
IT TAKES AWHILE TO MELT IN A BOTTLE OF COLD WATER. TWO MINUTES MAYBE.  BUT IT HAS A PUNCH TO IT.  AND YOU TASTE LEMON DROPS BEFORE IT COMPLETELY MELTS.  QUITE A TREAT.  WILL BUY AGAIN.

Out of all powdered lemonade drink mixes, this one tastes the closest to freshly squeezed. It's delicious! I love the 2 quart size pouches. The zipper closures are perfect. It is a very sweet product but it has a good amount of tartness to help balance it. I half expect to find pulp in my cup, it tastes that good!
So much better than Country Time mix in so many ways.  My family loves this lemonade.

This lemonade definitely tastes more like chemicals than real lemonade (a product like Simply Lemonade from the grocery store) does.  One reason might be that despite the organic name, there are unnecessary chemicals added simply to make it cloudy.  My other criticism of this product is that the size of it is awkward -- each pouch makes 1/2 gallon plus one glass, so you either always have a little bit left over, or you have to make it in a gallon pitcher that is almost half empty.

This product is a perfect example for the erroneous notion that the label of "all natural" or "organic" is of higher quality and therefore of good taste.  It seems to me that the makers have not really put much effort into this product.  Before purchasing I looked everywhere on-line  for the ingredients label and could not find it anywhere.  Here it is folks!: Sugar* (evaporated Cane Juice), Citric Acid (provides tartness), Natural Lemon Flavor, Natural Cloud (Maltrodextrin*, High Oleic Sunflower Oil*, Silicon Dioxide), Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C). Everything with the (*) are the organic ingredients. Not a very good list I may add.Sorry to say this, but who ever is giving this product any good review for taste must be either working for Fruit Blooms or has numb taste buds. To describe the taste:  after initially adding two level table spoons to 8fl oz. of water as suggested, the taste was rather flat.  After adding one more table spoon I couldn't help but be reminded of chewable vitamin C tablets which is far from how lemonade should taste.  Fruit Bloom...Get to work!!!

These are not your normal cashew. No salt, dry, white color and dried-up texture. Perhaps if you want to cook with them they might be alright, but most of mine were not even whole by the time they arrived.

Our family is so hooked on this scone mix...reminds us of living overseas in England...delicious!I would highly recommend this mix to anybody who wants an accompaniement with soup or just tea and coffee.
I had high expectations for this scone mix and was very disappointed with the product (it had rave reviews by other users). I followed the instructions and the scones were just so-so, very bland.

I was very pleased with my order of the Lake Grassmer Sea Salt. The product is terrific, very tasty. But what really impressed me was the wonderful way it was packed by the seller and the very very fast shipping. I would recommend this product and seller to everyone. I will be ordering from them again.

If you think that salt is merely salt, listen up! This salt gives a flavor to food that youwould have never imagined. Salt is a flavor enhancer, but this salt tastes like the RollsRoyce of them all. If you want to savor your cooking and kick it up a notch or two, I recommendsprinkling this salt on just about anything you can put in your mouth. BRAVO!
Delicious flavor enhancer. I will never go back to kosher salt again. It is very mild, without any "biting" aftertaste...a staple in my cabinet from now on.
These were great for a peace sign cake I had made for my cousin's bday party!  They were everything described and a great price.

column9: Great to drink and to season food.
column10: I bought my first box of these at an asian store....then I found them here and bought 6 boxes. Thank you for the product.  I grew up in South America and loved guava. I couldn't find it locally and I am very pleased withthis product!!

column9: Simply nothing better ... this makes the boil
column10: I have been using this product for may years. I like this particular version since it comes with 6 individual bags. I tossed them all in 40 quarts of water.  No mess, but plenty of flavor.

column9: Maxwell house coffee-good taste good price
column10: Yeah! It is great price for this good taste coffee. I enjoy it every morning!
What can I say, it's coffee? It's a lot less expensive to buy it here than at the store. I wish they sold gasoline this way.

This order was for 12 packs of Maxwell coffee.  For our area, it was a great price and packed very nicely for storage. No problems at all with the product or the delivery. I love Amazon and the way they deliver ASAP.  My husband also said this is great coffee.Maxwell House Master Blend Ground Coffee, 11.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)

I purchase this coffee regularly to donate to an urban soup kitchen in the fall and winter. No brand I've found comes close to the price, especially when there's a discount with $49 (or whatever) purchase. I can't speak to the taste, as I'm not a coffee drinker, but our homeless clients are full of praise since we added coffee to the day's menu. While the homeless and indigent have plenty to complain about in their lives, they have yet to complain about the coffee. Having the coffee in vacuum packs really helps the original freshly-opened flavor to be there when we get to the 12th pack.

I love these bags. I have both long and short handle ones from this seller. They are very well made. I will be ordering long handled ones next as I only have one long handled one now. I am so glad I ordered these as they are all cotton and you cannot see through the bottom of them like the ones the stores sell.There is a little hook on both sides of the bag for the rack in the grocery store. You do not have to turn the bag around and make sure you hook the right side because there is one on both sides. Very handy. The size is the same size as a paper bag, which is just right. I would not want to carry a large bag, but I am an older person and she does have large bags for those would would want to fill up a large one.They are not too heavy of canvas, and I think it is just right because you do not notice the bag weight when it is full. The handles are so convienent and comfortable to carry your groceries in.Now if I can remember every time to bring them in the store with me, I'll have it made :-)  I am still new with these bags. The other day I forgot and when I was checking out, I realized I was on a meat buying run, so maybe it was a good thing to forget the bags. I was thinking at the check out that the meat would leak in the bags.The seller is so easy to work with and shipped very fast too. All around these are well made bags of the right weight and functionality.

sturdy, nice large size. the short handle makes it easy to fill to the top with groceries. when they get dirty, i just throw them in the washer. i like that they are "no-frills". exactly what i was looking for in a reusable shopping bag.

I had been looking for well-constructed, canvas grocery bags made in the USA and I couldn't have asked for better!  I have used mine on several shopping trips.  They stay clean and each bag appears to hold at least double the same quantity that the old plastic grocery bags held.  This means less trips and overall less waste.  The convenient green handles make them easy to carry.I don't know for certain if the plastic grocery bags will go extinct, either by law or extra grocer's fees, but I believe this is a small way that I can help keep more plastic from getting into our environment.  Thanks for these terrific bags that help me do my part!

column9: Short handles!  (I mean this is a good thing)
column10: I've tried several different re-usable bags that I bought at local supermarkets but they all had the same problem - the handles were too long.  When I carried them by hand I had to lean my body to one side to prevent the bag from dragging on the ground and then the bag kept banging into my feet.  If I used the long handles over my shoulder; I could only fill it halfway or less.The Turtlecreek bags are the same size/shape as the large paper bags at the supermarket and they come with short handles.  I can carry two or more at a time (just like I did with plastic bags).  They hold a lot more than the disposable bags and they're a lot stronger.  When full, they fit nicely into the cart and my car - just like paper bags.When empty, they fold flat and don't take up much room in the car.  I keep a pair in the foot well of the front passenger seat and haven't forgotten them yet since Seattle banned plastic bags a few weeks back.  They've also come in handy for other occasions.  It turns out that always having bags in the car is a smart idea.  I'm very happy with these bags.

I thought I gave review on canvas bags awhile ago--but-must not been posted. I have had bags for a long while now---I use them for everything while out in my vehicle whileshopping etc. they open easy--are very strong-I recommend them--try bags -you will beglad--I keep mine in my car--they have come in handy so many times when I didn't realize they would. They will last a long--long time---------------------

Every 5lb bag of whole beans I've bought off of amazon has been tasty and worthy of 5 stars (even outside of subjective preference, they are GOOD coffees, if maybe roasted too dark or too light for my tastes, etc). This product defied that standard. The beans were dry and dusty. Many of them were broken into smaller pieces already, and the coffee brewed is distinctively "bad." I suspect that my 5lb bag may have been old stock, but it was a huge dissapointment. I soldiered through the last cup today and felt compelled to prevent others from making the same mistake I did. Go with something else.

column9: Makes One Good Cup Of Coffee
column10: I didn't think that this Copper Moon Panama Bouquete Coffee would be all that great because of the low price, but low and behold it fooled me good.  This is an excellet whole bean coffee, real nice roast that delivers a great mellow taste.  Good coffee all around, sure will recomend to other coffee lover's out there.  Thank you Amazon.com for another excellent product at a super low price.

Panama Boquete has been a favorite varietal of mine for a few years. On review of the Copper Moon label, it turns out this bag is actually a blend--and specifics of varietals included are not disclosed. At least one third of beans are broken or misshapen, Grinds up pale, dusty and dry. No character, even with French Press preparation. I will not buy again. Try Coffee Bean Direct Panama Boquete, Whole Bean Coffee, 5-Pound Bag for a few more dollars. If the Boquete is too much dough, try their Poor Man's Blend. I have bought both several times. Superior beans, carefully sorted for uniformity, and nicely-roasted.
fast shipping -nothing better than a fresh coffee beans now i can finally enjoy a good cup of coffee thanks guys (not that burnt french roast crap)

Never did business with (or heard of) Cooper Moon before this order.  I was mousing around Amazon and found a very good deal (sale/mark down) on a 5 lb lot of freshly roasted coffee beans (Panama Boquete) -- which is why I was motivated to take a chance on an unknown (to me) company.  Since they advertise and sell product on Amazon, it wasn't the same (again, to my way of thinking) as going on eBay and buying product from an unknown vendor (I do that too, but that's another story). Plus free shipping. I no longer order coffee from anybody that charges me the full rate for shipping! It has to be a low flat rate or free shipping!  My wife and I are hearty coffee drinkers (it is our beverage of choice) and although I buy at least 5 lbs at a time we probably order 10-20 times per year (according to my shipping history with various vendors).  If you multiply that by $10.00 up to $15.00 (UPS) depending on the size of the shipment, the coin you save can surely buy either something else, or more coffee!Anyway, I ordered, and 6 days later beans were delivered by UPS.  Everything was in great shape. The bags had proper ventilation (small gas vent near upper middle of coffee bag).  Since Amazon shipped it, the coffee bags were well packed with box filler adding extra padding to the beans.  When I opened up the bags the smell of fresh roast coffee was wonderful.  Store bought cans or bags smell okay when you open them for the first time, but freshly roasted coffee perfumes the entire kitchen with an aroma of spice, berries and the smoke characteristics of the roaster that did the cooking and the varietal (type) of coffee bean purchased. In this case the PB beans had a city roast and they had a light citrus tang that really lends to the flavor of the coffee.Of course the proof of good coffee is in the tasting.  I made a pot. Poured a cup. (slurp!).  Great stuff. Panama Boquete is a hearty coffee with complex flavors (berries, earth, a little chocolate and citrus) and a deep, smooth finish.I have nothing critical to say.  I got a great deal with free shipping; beans arrived in the alloted window of time and were freshly roasted.  Copper Moon and Amazon get a top score.

column9: nice but not my favorite cuppa
column10: It is excellent coffee.  The roast is mild.  I prefer something a bit heavier.  If a dark roast isn't your usual preference, I'm sure you enjoy this one.  It is a quality bean with a lot going for it.

column9: Not a Panama Boquete. A blend.
column10: I've tried numerous varietal coffees including other Panama Boquetes sold here at Amazon. When I order a coffee that is listed or described as a varietal, that is what I expect. Though it is not (yet) mentioned in the title or description for this coffee, potential buyers should be aware that this coffee from Copper Moon is not a Panama Boquete varietal but is instead a blend of of some undisclosed portion of Panama Boquete beans with other undisclosed varieties of coffee beans.The distinction between a varietal and a blend is not a small one. There is nothing wrong with a blended coffee per se, but it should be disclosed. This coffee should be listed as a Panama Boquete blend, and not as "Panama Boquete Coffee." If you're looking to try a true Panama Boquete, look to some of the other whole bean listings here at Amazon. Don't judge the potential of a Panama Boquete based on a blend. Try the real deal so you have a  baseline on which to judge the blend.What's in the bag? Five pounds of unevenly roasted beans of various origins, sizes and qualities in what is overall a very light roast. There is some portion of Panama Boquete which is recognizable due to the characteristically small, distinctive beans of this varietal, but based on the condition of the beans, I would be hard pressed to describe even that portion of this blend as first quality. The unknown varieties which fill out the remaining 60 to 80 percent of this five pound bag are not of consistent size or roast and appear to be of generally average quality.  In comparison to other whole beans coffees I have purchased at Amazon, there is what seems like a high proportion of broken beans, at least in the five pound bag I received.Due to the fact that the product I received is not the product I expected, I don't know that I can fairly rate this coffee or the results in the cup, so consider my three stars to be neutral.
It was very drinkable. Not as strong as we usually like but a good flavor.

I was buying java trading company whole beans, and after they raised the price 10 dollars I found copper moon whole beans, the coffee is great, and for 27 dollars for a 5 pound bag, makes for a terrific deal.

These are great crackers.  I have had plenty of GF crackers.  Some are good but many still have a grainy texture and are very crumbly.  The texture of these are great--indistinguishable from regular flour based crackers.  There were no broken crackers in the package either.  And the taste was great!Just try these, I bet you love them.

These are available at my local grocery store, but I came to Amazon to see if I could find a better price :)  (Thanks Amazon for all the GF choices!!)  Anyway,  these are great.  They're cheesy without having the fake cheese taste of cheesy poof type snacks.  It is a more subtle baked in cheese flavor.  There is another listing for these w/ more reviews if you want to check it outSchar Crackers Cheese Bites Gluten Free, 4-Ounces (Pack of 3)

I remember "Basket Cheese" from my younger days in an Italian family.  I wanted to make an old family recipe that called for this cheese.  I ordered it and we all loved it so much, that it was gone before using in recipe.  It is sooo good!

column9: Girlfriend loved it, missing some items though
column10: EDIT: Just realized some of the items promised are missing... Disappointing.Gave this gift to my girlfriend, she loved it. Quite a sour pomegranate molasses (they vary), but i like that as its much easier to sweeten a dish than to try and get a sickly sweet taste out. Recommended.

The cracker meal I previously purchased locally has been discontinued, so I ordered Gilda.  The quality was good, just not what was expected.  Cracker meal I always used wasn't fine, it was more like panko, only not quite so coarse.  Gilda has the consistency of flour.Regretably, I don't recall the brand name I like and will keep searching.

I didn't know there was a difference between brands of gelatin.  I had gotten this brand through the Radiant Life company ([...]), and it had a pleasant, gummy smell when mixed in hot water. column9: A Great Product Ruined by Misguided Marketing
column10: I have used this formerly terrifc product for over 10 years.  It was the only canned chicken sold in North America that contained no food additives.  It was just chicken, water, and sea salt.As of this month( March 2011) new labelling and contents  have appeared.  The label now proclaims "Better Flavor".The product now contains 50% more sodium - at a time when many manufacturers are either cutting back on salt content or introducing "reduced sodium" vesions of their tradtional products.Worse yet, the "Better Flavor" is achieved by adding "rice starch", "vegetable starch" ( a call to the company revealed that this is potato starch) and "chicken broth" - which contains, among other listed ingredients, "natural flavor" (derived from corn - an increasingly common food allergen ).This product is now useless to me as I am highly sensitive to corn products.  While the label still claims the product is gluten free, which was pretty much guaranteed before, since it had only chicken water and sea salt in it, this claim is now somewhat suspect in as much as with the introduction of each new additive, there is the possiblitly of cross contamination in the prodution of the various grain based starches and "flavors"The company needs to re-think this change.  What made them unique and a mainstay for people on specialized diets, was their plain and simple good food.  Now they are little differnt from every other canned meat that is adulterated with unecessary and unwanted food additives.They can kiss goodbye all their former customers who are allergic to or sensitive to corn, processed starches, who are on the Atkins or no grain diets, who have arthritis which is exacerbated by potatoes, and who avoid processed food additives in general.The company also needs to be more up front in their new labelling and say "potato starch" rather than "vegetable starch" AND in bold print say "Contains Corn" to warn customers who are allergic to corn products that they probably should now avoid the product.Hopefully this "Better Flavor" change will be about as successful as New Coke" and we will see Valley Fresh "Classic" chicken in a year so.

column9: Super tasty, if a bit slow to cook
column10: I bought a bag of this stuff just for kicks. I like Cream of Rice and usually make it with a little butter and salt. I had no idea what Teff would taste like, but it is fantastic, it really is! Kind of like a nutty Cream of Rice but with a very nice consistency. I am definitely a converted Teff eater!I followed the directions on the bag: boil 2 cups of lightly salted water, then add 1/2 cup of Teff. It says to cover and let it simmer for 15-20 minutes or until all the water is absorbed. The first time I made it, the Teff was all over the inside of the pot and cover. So it needs to be on a very low simmer. I find that it works best to cook it like they say but stir it around 2-3 times during the first 15 minutes.UPDATE: By the way, if you cook it the entire time with the cover on like the directions say, the water won't evaporate. I remove the cover about half-way through. I set the kitchen timer for 5 minute intervals and simmer the Teff, then come back and stir it. After 10 minutes, I leave the cover off, otherwise the water won't evaporate and it will be too watery.If you don't use a low simmer, it will stick to the sides of the pot so you have to stir it to make sure it doesn't stick to the bottom.It takes around 17-18 minutes, it has the consistency of a bit loose Cream of Rice or oatmeal in terms of how much water stays in. I turn off the heat and keep stirring until it stops bubbling, then put it in a bowl.Note: The portion size above and on the instructions yields a huge bowl of the stuff, definitely two big servings. Cut the ingredients in half for one serving. Also, don't over-salt it, it seems to carry the salt taste pretty well.I mix about a 1/4 teaspoon of butter and a bit more salt to taste and it is really delicious, it really is. Definitely recommended. Although it is a bit expensive. But it's good! In fact, I'd say it's probably the best hot breakfast cereal I ever ate -- except I eat it all the time, for a snack!It gets 5 stars as a food, but I dropped a star because it is a bit fussy to cook. Char-Siu, also known as Chinese barbecue, is really a Cantonese delicacy.  Most non-Cantonese Chinese rarely consume it and certainly do not cook it.  Char-Siu is ever slightly crunchy outside and is moist and tender inside.  The sauce is sweet and tangy with a touch of saltiness to it.  It is different from the American Southern barbecue which is slow smoked for hours, nor it is like the Coastal barbecue which is grilled on direct flames for minutes.  It sits in between.  The cook time is about 1-2 hours.  The cooking temperature also sit in between the Southern and Coastal barbecue.  You can eat it by itself.  You can eat it as part of a meal.  Of course, it is THE essential ingredient of the infamous Char-Siu Bao (Chinese BBQ pork buns).  When you eat a real good Char Siu, you just want to run home and kiss your mom.I am born and raised in Hong Kong.  I have tasted countless authentic Char-Siu for decades.  I know how to make my own Char-Siu sauce from scratch, but it takes time.  I still encourage people to at least make their sauce once, just to appreciate the ingredients.  There is no absolute recipe for Char-Siu sauce, but it must contains sugar, vinegar, honey, salt and soy paste.  Some people make their Char-Siu sauce from Hosin sauce since they share many ingredients.This Lee Kum Kee Char Siu Sauce is authentic -- not because I say so, but because its existence proves its authenticity.  Lee Kum Kee is a very famous Hong Kong brand which dedicates in making sauces.  Its trademark staple product is the  Lee Kum Kee Premium Oyster Sauce, 18-Ounce Bottle (Pack of 2).  Actually, that is an understatement.  Oyster sauce, in fact, is invented by Lee Kam Sheung, who then founded the company: Lee Kum Kee.  (Oyster sauce is another product mostly enjoyed by Cantonese Chinese).  This company made its sauces to satisfy Hong Kong residents who do not have time to make their own sauces.  These Lee Kum Kee sauces would have never survived if they are not authentic and accepted by the Hong Kong residents.I uploaded two pictures of my Char-Siu made with this sauce as customer images.  By no mean, my Char-Siu is perfected.  However, I hope to show that one can achieve good Char-Siu by using this sauce as the main ingredient.I have used this Char-Siu sauce for more than 15 years, and have also tried other brands in between.  I encourage others to try other brands as well.  Lee Kum Kee Char-Siu sauce is not the only good one out there, but it is definitely one of the best.

column9: MAKES YOU LOOK LIKE A GENIUS
column10: I MADE GRILLED ASIAN STYLE WINGS WITH THIS STUFF FOR MY GIRLFRIEND AND HER CRONIES. THEY WERE AMAZED AT HOW GOOD THEY CAME OUT, AND IT MADE ME LOOK LIKE I KNEW WHAT I WAS DOING. LITTLE DID THEY KNOW HOW SIMPLE THEY ACTUALLY WERE TO MAKE. LET ME SHARE MY SECERET WITH YOU.BURN WINGS ON BOTH SIDES, AND THEN COOK WITH THE TOP DOWN FOR AN ADDITIONAL FIFTEEN MINUTES ON INDIRECT HEAT. POUR THE CHAR SIU SAUCE INTO A LARGE BOWL, AND DUMP THE WINGS IN A COUPLE AT A TIME AND TOSS TO REALLY DRENCH THEM. THEN, PUT THEM BACK ON THE GRILL FOR ANOTHER TEN MINUTES ON INDIRECT HEAT WITH THE TOP DOWN TO HEAT UP THE SAUCE.TO PLATE: SIMPLY PUT A PILE OF WINGS ON A SERVING DISH AND GARNISH WITH SESAME SEEDS AND FRESH SCALLIONS. IF YOU MAKE THIS FOR A GROUP IT'LL KNOCK THEIR SOCKS OFF, GUARANTEED. LEE KUM KEE MAKES IT EEE-ZZZ.

It tastes like what I imagine cleaning products to taste like.  The "sweetener," which they added way too much of, actually leaves a noticeably bitter aftertaste.  I would much rather drink just lemon water with no sugar added, as a healthy and palatable alternative.  Horrible, just horrible...

...that the year is 1700. You've just come in from a hard days work in the field and you want to quench your thirst with some delectable lemonade. But alas, you are a poor farmer, and cannot afford lemons from the lemon tree. Instead, you collect the urine from the goats that inhabit your farm, pour it into a cup fashioned from cow dung, and drink it.This product is essentially the same thing.

I just got this drink at the retail store I work at. This drink doesn't even deserve 1 star. I can honestly say this is the worst thing I have ever tasted in my entire life. It was so bad, I kept it to let my friends taste and share my worst drink experience ever. After tasting this, I immediately went online to see all of the hilariously bad reviews. I love the Honest Teas and the lightly sweetened 1/2 Tea 1/2 lemonade so I picked up some zero calorie Honest Ade Classic Lemonade.  It tastes like lemon-scented soap smells.  It is so over-sweet I gagged on my first sip.  Do not make the same mistake I did.  Just go with the regular lower calorie versions of this brand's offerings.  Skip the stevia-sweetened disgusting zero calorie versions.  I can't get the taste out of my mouth an hour later.  So nasty.

After seeing this lemonade recommended in a health magazine I decided to see if it was as good as they said it was. After reading other's opinion I decided if it was that bad I'd have to try it for myself.I'm a fan of stevia. I drink stevia sweetened beverages all day long so I know what it is supposed to taste like. To me it is almost as good as sugar. The stevia used in this drink seems fine and didn't have an awful bitter taste. You can get various types of stevia and this one seems perfectly sweet.I think the problem with this "lemonade" is that it also has lime juice in it. That is what I'm tasting and it seems a little strong. In fact the aroma of lime seems to be what first hits your nose as you are about to take a drink. That seems to be a little confusing since you think you are drinking lemonade not limeade.The aroma aside, the lemon flavor is actually not bad but is very mild. Think more of a lemon water than a lemonade. If you drink this while holding your nose closed it tastes much better. If I was Honest Ade I'd take out the lime juice. I'd also like to know what "natural flavor" is. Is that a lemon or lime zest flavor? Maybe they could take that out too.A lemonade should taste pure like a summer day. I feel that in making this they are trying too hard to be different. Please Honest Ade - make this just with lemon juice. I make my own lemonade all the time with just straight lemon juice and a packet of stevia and it tastes better than this. I'm giving this a three because it is not as bad as I expected. I just don't like the aroma and the acidic aftertaste.~The Rebecca Review

I hate this so much i would rather drink a gallon of elk urine than this horrid stuff. If i were stuck in the desert with no water and only Honest Ade I would rather die than ever consume it again. Honest Ade should be called Honestly AIDS because that is what i feel like i have tasted after drinking it.
Don't waste your money on lemonade that tastes like waste water. That's a bit of an exaggeration. But this does not taste like lemonade, it doesn't taste like anything you'd want to drink.

I like its taste and sweetness. My body doesn't tolerate artificial sweeteners and I can't drink any light sodas. I'm not a big fun of stevia - I have tried a few stevia products to replace the sugar in baking and they all have this awful aftertaste. But Honest Ade has no aftertaste. I buy it at Stop& Shop for $1 /bottle -sale price.But I wouldn't pay regular price :$1.50 - it's to much.

column9: Plastic bottle flavoring + too much stevia = An honestly awful drink
column10: This is not a good beverage.  For a diet lemonade, it has a rather extensive list of ingredients that do not produce a flavor you want to remember.  This beverage is sweetened with stevia.  I don't mind stevia but there is such a thing as too much.  This beverage has entirely too much of it.  All I could taste when I drank this was the stevia, lemon, and plastic bottle.  I'm serious about the last one.  On the side of the bottle, the manufacturer boasts that PETE plastic is non-leaching.  This beverage, however, has a distinctly plastic taste.  Again, this is not a case of my needing to get used to the stevia.  Like I said, I don't mind stevia in moderation.  This company needs to go back to the drawing board.  If you are seeking a diet beverage that is not sweetened with aspartame and actually tastes fairly good, I recommend Acai Lemonade Sugar Free Drink Sticks 1.7 oz sticks 12 Sticks, which can be purchased at health food stores, iherb.com and Amazon.Ingredients:  Purified water, organic lemon juice concentrate, organic lemon extract, organic lime juice concentrate, citric acid, organic stevia extract, organic natural flavor, ascorbic acid, mixed carotene.This product contains 3% juice.This product is gluten-free.

column9: Like cilantro -- you either love it or hate it?
column10: I recently found this at a local market and was hoping to find it less expensive at amazon (my local market is cheaper). From the other reviews I can only assume that there is something in this drink that either pleases the palate -- or doesn't -- with very little in between preferences. I'm in the camp that thinks this drink is wonderful -- refreshing and not overly sweet.

This "lemonade" is worse than the champagne drink called a French 75 I had at Pat O's in the French Quarter that tasted like meat marinade and although I had spent 7 bucks, I poured it out. It tastes worse than that Icee I drank in grade school that unbeknownst to me had a cockroach in the bottom of it. The experience was worse than the time when I was a kid and my dad went to the store to go get apple cider, but he was drunk so he accidentally got apple cider vinegar and I took a big swig and threw up.I don't know if its the stevia sweetener, which I had never had before, or they got a terrible batch of lemons, or what the problem might have been, but this is by far the worst bottled "refreshment" that I have ever had. Never again.

OK, here's the thing about this lemonade:  we are so used to consuming overly sweet, high calorie food & beverages that when you take your first sip of this lemonade, you might not like it.  My first reaction, admittedly, was, "Ew!" due to the tart taste and the absence of sweetness.  It was definitely not your Country Time brand.  Then I took another sip, and another, and now I find that I'm hooked on this stuff.  It's very light-tasting, not sweet, and it's a bit tart.  I love it.  To give you another example, it's like being a regular Coke drinker and then drinking Diet Coke for the first time.  At first, the taste seems off.  But after awhile, the regular version seems sickeningly sweet.  If you like regular versions of soda and lemonade, then you might not like Honest Ade at first; but keep in mind why you like the reg. version (overly sweet taste)-you might just want to change your habits.

I try not to right a negative review, but drinking this has got to be the worst experience I ever had with any drink. I took one sip of it and it had me gagging. I had to get a bottle of minute maid lemonade just to wash the taste away, and even after that, my mouth was still completely dry and still had the horrid aftertaste. I would not give this to my worst enemy.

I bought a bottle at the company cafeteria and couldn't take more than two sips.  I like stevia.  I like other Honest Ade drinks.  That said, I have no idea how this junk made it to market.  I've literally never tasted a beverage so bad; I thought I had gotten a bottle that had been improperly stored.  I went online to see what other people thought and I'm not alone, this is just a plain awful tasting drink.  No lemon taste and some horrible strange aftertaste that doesn't taste like any stevia I've ever tried.  The full bottle is sitting on my desk, but I won't force myself to try any more of it to give better details of just how bad this stuff is.  Avoid like the plague.

Alright, I made the mistake of buying a few of these without realizing they were "zero calorie".Let me tell you that the sweetener used (setiva?) makes this drink taste AWFUL! Upon first gulp, there is little flavor. Then a terrible wave of the taste of battery acid overwhelms your mouth. Then a "fake" sweet aftertaste looms making you want to wash it away with more. Bad idea.This certainly doesn't taste like lemonade and I wouldn't drink it if someone gave it to me for free at this point. Please don't buy ANY Honest Zero beverages, stick with the regular variety which are pretty good.

Honest Ade's zero calorie lemonade is the worst tasting thing I've ever had.  It tastes like someone squirted a little lemon juice in some gasoline, and bottled it.  It's not sour... it's not sweet... it's just disgusting.  I tried to continue drinking it, but I was afraid my face would permanently be stuck in the awful cringe I continued making.

I don't write reviews often, but when something is this bad I am inspired to share my experience.There is a hint of lemon in there, somewhere, but it mostly tastes like un-sweet, burnt honey (not that I've ever had such a thing, but I imagine it would taste something like this drink).  I guess, maybe, bad Mezcal tastes worse (which I usually describe as tasting like cheap Tequila that has been left sitting for about a year in a rusty barrel stuffed with the remnants of old, dirty tires).By the way, one star is the lowest rating, apparently (otherwise I would have given it 0).
Read my title and if that doesn't get the point across... then think of the worst thing you've tasted in your life. Multiply that by four.

As one reviewer here said, this is THE worst drink I have EVER had in my life, and I'm OLD!!!!!!!!!!The aftertaste? Unlike any I have ever had in my life, and I thought diet sodas could not be topped in disgustingness.Well, Honest Ade (spent all your money on marketing and none on taste testing?), you did it.You have the honor, albeit a dubious one, of having the single most disgusting drink on the entire planet.I kid you not.

Let me say a couple things first. 1. 99% of the drinks I have (not including water) are diet/low calorie ones. 2. I love Honest Ade. Now that I got that off my chest. What the hell Honest Ade?! Try the cranberry lemonade. It's tangy, slightly sweet and all around delicious.

The first problem: There's only 3% juice! Unless you're dumping artificial flavors in there, 3% lemon juice isn't lemonade, it's lemon water. But I'd rather have lemon water than deal with...The second problem: Stevia has no place in lemonade. Maybe in tea, where its molasses-like earthy flavor would blend well, it might work. But the stevia clashes horribly with what little lemon flavor comes through, resulting in a thoroughly unsatisfying beverage.
The first one I tried I thought the product was "taste free". The second one I thought "this isn't too bad"! Now, I can't leave it alone. Only concern is if I can buy it at a decent price. Love it.

I'm so glad that I only bought one bottle!  What was this company thinking?  Didn't anyone taste this stuff before bottling it?  Oh my gosh...I took a big gulp (expecting something delicious and refreshing) and just about spit it out!  This form of stevia is so bitter :-(  Don't waste your money!
This lemonade is absolutely disgusting, I thought something was wrong with it but after reading these other review, obviously not. I took two sips and threw it away.

I wonder how awful the test batch versions of this drink were before they decided to go with this finished product.  Easily the worst drink I have ever purchased.  And I like Honest Tea! I encouraged my gf to buy this, not knowing it would be vomit inducing.  Honest Tea RECALL THIS IMMEDIATELY BEFORE YOU LOSE CUSTOMERS! Wow... I can't believe I paid for something that tastes this bad.  I wish I had read the reviews before I purchased.  Just amazingly bad.  I mean A-M-A-Z-I-N-G-L-Y BAD!!!!  How anyone could decide it was a good idea to sell this is beyond me...

Unfortunately I was sorely disappointed. It tasted awful, with some kind of plastic or chemical flavor that I can't even begin to describe. My husband just about lost his lunch when he tasted it. We thought maybe it was just a bad bottle, but after reading all of the horrible reviews, I'm thinking they need to hire some new taste testers. I can honestly say this is the worst lemonade I have ever had. The after taste is just as terrible as the taste that first hits your taste buds. I gave this drink a shot and it is a bust! It almost tastes like it was made with bad lemons or something but it may be the Stevia that is used. Regardless, it is God awful.

This tastes nothing like lemonade.  It is awful.  It is inedible.  It doesn't even deserve one star.  I poured it down the drain.  The reviewers who said we're just not used to it are correct.  I'm not used to drinking sewer sludge, either, but that doesn't mean I need to become accustomed to it.  I drink nothing but diet drinks and I can think of a half dozen, some organic, that taste a million times better than this foul swill.

This was pretty bad.  Not completely terrible, I managed to chug the whole thing down, but still not very good.  I would not get this drink again, although I may try some of the other drinks from the brand since they are supposed to be pretty good.  Maybe something with a stronger taste than light lemon would be better.My biggest complaint with this drink would be the taste.  I honestly think it tasted like lemon sawdust.  And I'm not sure why it tasted that way.  I don't think it was the stevia, as I've drank things with stevia in it before without this effect, so I'm not sure what to blame.  It had just a little bit of sweetness to go along with the sawdust but there wasn't a very strong taste of anything.  The lemon taste was very faint, and as said before, it was mostly covered by the sawdust taste.The ingredients in this product are good, which kept it from getting one star.  Most everything is organic, and stevia is the sweetener.  A pretty healthy drink in all.  It also had zero calories and zero fat, so its a good diet drink if it was more palatable.  And at 16.9 fl oz, it lasts for a couple of hours (at least for me anyway) when drinking.  The Honest brand also boasts that its gluten free, no GMO's, is recycled, and they plant a tree, so lots of good things going on with the company in general.Not too great, I don't recommend it to anyone.  Try another of the brand if you want to try any.Review by M. Reynard 2012

Some reviewers state that people don't like it because it doesn't taste sweet enough, so I can only conclude we have a different reaction to the stevia in this lemonade.  It was bad enough, after just a few sips I came online to leave a review.

This is the best and most delicious 0-cal drink out there!!! I think that the people who don't like it just have no tastebuds. I cannot understand why anyone would find it anything other than heavenly. I only wish they were $1, or the ten-for-ten deal. They are more expensive than 0-cal vitamin water, but they are also yummier, and healthier.

This product is very hit or miss for people. It DOES NOT really taste anything like the heavily sugared "tradtional" lemonades out there, and the stevia can leave a aftertaste for most people that they find unappealing.  That being said I enjoy it myself very much, but i use it primarly to make a half and half lemonade/ice tea with unsweetened ice tea. Makes a very refreshing drink on hot summer days that way with no sugar added.

I will definitely order this product again.  These are large high quality pigs ears.  My dogs love them.  They are not greasy or messy.  They are full size pigs ears not pieces. Also, great service.

This is the 1st time I purchased from this company and I am somewhat disappointed in the size of the ears. About 2/3s the size of ears I had bought elsewhere. The ears were neatly packaged 25 per zipped plastic bag. They were nice clean ears and have caused no problems. We have 2 Giant Schnauzers and their after dinner treat is 1/2 a pig's ear each. column9: A dark, bold roast that is a welcome start to the day
column10: Noted as a "West Coast Favorite" this dark roast conjures up a scent of pine needles for me as it brews, a subliminal association perhaps tied more to the blend's name than the actual aromatics, which are pleasantly thick, sweet and strong enough to lift me from a groggy morning.I am still partial to Green Mountain Coffee Nantucket Blend, a recent purchase that knocked my socks off. Still, I would place Lake & Lodge a mere notch (star) beneath the Nantucket Blend. The Green Mountain website offers a fantastic description for Lake & Lodge: "This particular blend is very versatile, yet elegant. It makes a great espresso, partners well with cream, and is delicious iced. The flavors of this rich, darker roast blend reflect hearty West Coast style roasts. Dark roasted Indonesian coffees offer bountiful sweetness and syrupy notes. A touch of East African beans adds an element of berry-hued brightness to the blend's bold flavor foundations."I read that the blend's name has a peculiar history, first called "Tapestry Blend Dark" the blend was originally developed for a New York City shop called "The Coffee Station."Lake & Lodge is a better name, a blend that invokes ski resorts and campsites and sleepy mornings when a dark, bold roast is a welcome start to the day.Rating: Four stars.BTW: Here's my other recent K-cup coffee reviews for Amazon:5 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Nantucket Blend5 stars: Coffee People Donut Shop Medium Roast5 stars: Van Houtte Chocolate Raspberry Truffle4 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Vermont Country Blend4 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Wild Mountain Blueberry4 stars: Tully's Coffee Kona Blend4 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Dark Magic3 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Breakfast Blend3 stars: Green Mountain Coffee Fair Trade Gingerbread

We picked up a box at their store in Waterbury, VT and it is one of my favorite K cups. The price was right, $16 for a pack of 24. It is great on a cold morning, perfectly balanced, not bitter, light and crisp!

I bought 48 Green Mountain Lake and Lodge K-Cups and they arrived on 9/24 with a 'best by" date of 10/7.  Nowhere did Amazon state they were close-dated.  I like coffee but cannot drink 48 cups in 12 days.  I think Amazon should insure the products they sell are fresh or clearly state this is a clearance item.

I like Lake and Lodge however, some of the cups I brew have less than others on the same water setting, in fact a few were substantially less than others, not sure if there is perhaps different amounts of coffee in some of the k-cups?
ITs OK. the k cup isn't consistent in strength.  I like a strong cup of coffee and this choice is uneven.
My Grandma loves these and it was perfect to just order and have them shipped her way! Came as described.
If you enjoy their Kenyan AA but find it a bit bitter and not as smooth as you'd like, then you will love this!It's smooth and full bodied yet bold and strong.  I highly recommend it!

As a professional dog trainer who works 12 - 14 hour days, 7 days a week.......I am a coffee drinker! My clients purchased a sign which says "Dog Trainer Powered by Coffee". At home I use an antique vacuum pot to brew my freshly ground beans. At work I use a Keurig machine so that the coffee doesn't sit on a burner while I give classes. I enjoy a good tasting and strong cup of coffee. I have tried MANY k-cups. None have the flavor and aroma of this wonderful coffee, Lake and Lodge. I have finally found my "go-to" k-cup!

Hide them from the company, hide them from the room mates or family members! You will not get more than one cup if you share this set of 48! I am not kidding. These are so good and so hard to find that they simply vanish from the k-cup carousel. You will see people sitting on your couch holding mugs and they will all claim innocence !  A truly fine blend of coffee.
This coffee is great if you love a medium to darker roast; it is rich and great tasting.  No after taste.
I stumbled across this in an ad or something, and it's become my favorite.  It's quite a bit darker than a breakfast blend, but not too dark or too strong.  Like, I said, it's my new favorite

column9: One of the best K-Cups out there
column10: This was one of the first K-Cups I tried and I keep going back to it. Plenty of flavor without bitterness. I little smoother taste than the Caribou blend which has a "woodier" flavor. Highly recommended.
This is my favorite K-cup, just bold enough and really great on a cold, rainy day.  Nice, smooth, hearty taste.
I love my kcups coffee. This is an excellent product.The company I purchased from made the transaction fast and easy. I definitely recommend this product for purchase.

column9: This is the only food I feed my cat
column10: My cat needs weight control, and he actually likes this formula.  Right now it's very hard to find in my area, so he has been eating other food and gaining weight.  I don't expect him to LOSE weight with this formula, but just at least maintain, which is what it's designed to do.

This is good cat food. To the reviewer who complained that their cats didn't lose weight with this food and are still vomiting - don't give the food itself a poor rating. Find out what your cat is allergic to and don't feed it as much! If you are free-feeding, your cat will gain weight because it can eat whenever it wants. Also, as cats age, they gain weight easier just like people do. It's not the food's fault.

I ordered this item because I wanted a cat food that would help my cats lose weight. So far half of this enormous bag is gone & the only thing Ive seen is my cats vomit more, like they did when I had fed them other brands, such as Purina. I guess my only other option to help my cats shed pounds is to take them to a vet:(

column9: So good, I stopped making home-made..
column10: People used to rave over my home made salsa.  The only way to make it is by roasting the tomatoes.  So I was dismayed when I found the Arriba Salsa because it was as good as mine and cost less than the ingredients for a small batch.Now I just pour the Arriba in a bowl and heat it up and everyone still raves.Yes, it is that good.

Unlike the common variety of salsa's, Arriba's Fire roasted taste is rich and full bodied flavor. This is better than any restaurant salsa I have ever had (Born and raised in Texas). As with all finer foods, if you are trying to make a large dish, you can stick with the common variety jar of tomatoes in water, if however you wish to garnish with exceptional flavor, or use as a dipping salsa, Arriba is a must have. Being a active duty military, I have had this salsa shipped to me in the Middles East, and Europe, it is truley worth the effort with every bite.

I bought a jar of this salsa last week because I heard a lot of raves about it. I really like this salsas taste and had it with chips and later with tortillas with cheese. I don't like extremely hot salsa and this one is pretty mild for being medium. I am wondering if anyone has tried the hot version and how they like it. I would give this salsa a 5 if it were a tad hotter. I found it at the local store for around $4.50 a jar. You can't go wrong with this Roasted Red Salsa. Check it out the next time you buy salsa.

Arriba Fire Roasted Mexican Salsa is outstanding.  It has a peppery, smoky, roasted tomato flavor and is excellent for dipping chips, cooking, or as a toping.  It does not have a lot of chucky tomatoes or peppers in it, which I prefer, but has a nice, even consistency.  It is an excellent salsa - in fact it's one of the best I've tried.  I prefer the hot variety, as I love spiciness, but they are all good.

Since all the of the problems with pet foods and treats coming from China being tainted with various nasty things I have been on the hunt for pet treats made (and sourced) in the US, and Dogswell brand is one of the ones I've found. I didn't really notice that they were marked "happy hips", but really unless you have a toy sized breed the amount of glu/chon is too low to make much difference (the reason for only 4 stars). my dogs were a bit confused at first because they are quite chewy, but they do seem to really enjoy them, and I like giving them to my boxer when I crate her; it takes her a few minutes to completely consume it, and it seems to keep her occupied for the 10 or 15 minutes I leave her in there. I am lucky that my local pet shop has the entire line of Dogswell products, and I very much look forward to trying more of their products :)

This is the best gum, ever.  I have very bad dry mouth and this gum tastes wonderful and keeps its flavor for a long time.  Unfortunately, the flavor has been discontinued.  I have been lucky so far to be able to buy it, but I worry that one day it won't be available at all.
The gum was out of date but i didn't notice it until my family had already chewed 2 packs But I was able to return even without the two packs

column9: Smaller size but still a good price
column10: Capers in brine cannot compare.  Brine turns the buds to mush.  These are crisp high quality capers in salt at a good price from Agostino Recca. You can find them in twenty-four oz elsewhere on Amazon. So I could have given that one five stars on best buy basis.I gave it four stars considering only a few in brine get three stars. Most get one star as weak and adulterated by things other than salt in the brine. So most pure salt brine still get only two stars. Not worth the low quality since these are available.This is my everyday old reliable. Do not cook them. Rinse out the salt if you do not need it, and use them after cooking is over, even in a caper sauce. They need only warm to blossom. They respond well to mortar and pestle.I saved five stars for the ones from Pantalleria which go with caviar, or best quality tuna or veal.

Kids think they are fun and easy to drink too.  The Pina Colada flavor is amazing.  If I could just squeeze some rum into the package..... :)

They are all 80 proof, smooth, and lack a flavor so perfect for mixed drinks. I had never heard of this brand but a liquor distributor said that it was equal to the better known brands.

For me the sauce reminds me of childhood because she uses some cloves in the sauce that reminds me of a sauce I ate as a child. But for anyone who wants a tasty, locally sourced meal but doesn't have the time to cook, this is the sauce for you. My only problem is that it does not stay on my shelf for very long!

Sometimes you do not get that many cookies in a bag but that's okay, just go eat another bag of cookies. :) They taste great and have mostly if not 100% natural ingredients. I have made many orders for these cookies and plan on making more orders for them in the future. Highly recommended if you are looking for a delicious, individually packaged, chocolate chip cookie snack.

As good as Nutter Butters, Girl Scout cookies and the rest, but without all the unneccessary ingredients. My only complaint is that they should sell them in larger boxes, ha. You won't be disappointed!!!
A great choice for packing lunches or a quick snack on the go.  No trans fats or high fructose corn syrup either which is a tremendous plus in a packaged food.  Will definitely buy again.
great for on the go snack, as i am a diabetic, this is just the thing, also great lunch snack for my son, great value for the money, but buy plenty as they go fast!

These are even better than Girl Scout cookies and most likely healthier.  If you are into weight watchers.  You may eat two of these absolutely delicious cookies for 3 points.  These are so satisfying.  After eating, two quickly put the box away, because you will want more.
