I had the same issue as the 1 star reviewer in the similar product:http://www.amazon.com/Mangia-Carmelina-Italian-Tomatoes-28-Ounce/dp/B000R8YIFI/ref=pd_sim_gro_6I feel a bit mislead for the same reason.  Let's face it:  anyone who thinks they are going to get real San Marzano certified tomatoes at this price is dreaming a bit, but at least change the picture to represent exactly what is being sold.That being said, the tomatoes are Italian organic and are good for still a decent price for organic tomatoes.  I bought these for making tomato sauce for Italian Pizza and for pasta and they are actually very good for this.4 stars for the quality, 2 stars for the mis-representation

I always hate to write a bad review, but here goes.I don't know how these tomatoes taste.  I haven't tried them.  I just opened the carefully wrapped box and EVERY - EVERY single can is dented - there are 24 cans.  One can is so severely dented that it won't even stand up.None of the tops are bulging, so I will open them up as needed and will see.  But, I can say this: I'm cancelling my subscribe and save for these tomatoes.  Very disappointed - they could be the best tasting tomatoes but they will never taste good to me based on the cans.Quality control really was taking a break when packing these cans.  Shameful.

column9: $14.99? This stuff is only $3 at Hannaford.
column10: Is this $14.99 for a single jar of peanut butter? Maybe $8 if it was organic.Price discrepancy aside, Teddie Brand PB is by far my favorite.

I have been using Alber's Yellow Corn Meal for about 40 years.  I have their recipe for cornbread memorized as it is the best, most pure cornbread I have ever eaten. After moving to the south and not being able to find it I began going through a withdrawal.  I tried all different kinds of "corn meal", which, being in the south usually meant more of a "corn FLOUR"!  I was eating cakie, heavy cornbread and couldn't stand it.  It was in desperation that I checked Amazon and found that I could order my very favorite!  Now I have to admit that 4-40 oz boxes is a bit much for 2 old people but I put 2 boxes in the freezer and gave one to my daughter who declared that it made the best cornbread she had ever had also.  (She had forgotten the cornbread of her youth!)  So, if you are looking for the best, most pure and authentic cornbread ever, stop messing around the cheap copies and get the real thing - Albers!
THIS STUFF IS GOOD!  SOME OF THIS ON A CRACKER OR THINLY SLICED BREAD TOPPED WITH SHAVED PARM IS SO YUMMY, YOU'LL LOVE IT.

Plum Organics is a really good product, and this flavor is no exception.  My 8-month old loves, loves, loves the Spinach, Peas & Pear combo...more so than any other brand out there.  She is keen on savory foods and I guess this qualifies because she can't get enough of it!  It is still sweet, but not overwhelming so, and you can really smell the spinach in it, which I think is a good thing.As far as the integrity of the product is concerned, I also give it a 5 star.  After researching "where" the product is made, it has become apparent to me in talking both with Plum Baby Organics and the distributor, Oregon Tilth, that most of the main ingredients are made in the U.S. and not in China.  The bulk of their ingredients come from Emeryville, CA.  The exception would be fruit such as bananas, mangoes and other tropical fruit come from Mexico.  So, until proven otherwise, I will continue purchasing their products gladly and quite satisfied.  I was also quite pleased that I actually spoke with representatives from both companies in a timely manner.  I will gladly support small businesses such as Plum, especially knowing that they are endeavoring to provide a quality product for our children.

After the arsenic scare with baby formula, I looked into the source for all of my baby food.  Plum Organics never responded to my email asking for information on where the product is made.  I finally found it under a link regarding the makers of the packaging.  Not sure many organic baby food purchasers would be thrilled to know that this is made at the Hosokawa Yoko plant in CHINA.  [...]

This is my go to choice for premade baby food. I love the packaging, making it easy to throw in the diaper bag and pull out whenever needed. I like the ingredients a lot more than similar products. It is just the pureed vegetables and some lemon juice to keep it from spoiling. My kids love it and it is always a treat when we are out and I can grab one. It took them a little while to figure out how to suck it out and I normally have to push up the last of it for the one year olds. Great product, would recommend it.

column9: Easy way to get Fruit and Veggies
column10: My daughter loves this. It's a simple snack on the go that is both tasty and good for her. It's an easy way to get fruit and veggies in her diet. I highly recommend.
My 17 month old loves these. So convenient and - I think - healthy! Favorites so far are the Spinach, Peas and Pear and the Blueberry, Pear, and Purple Carrot.

As a grandmother of 3 little ones, I'm delighted with this product.  The one who's currently enjoying this loves holding onto and feeding himself out of the pouch and usually gets his veggies this way.  He was annoyed when we tried to feed him with a spoon as, at the age of one today (!) he's trying to be his own man.  I love this product for it's organic, non-GMO nutrition, as well as the ease with which it feeds him.  I only wish these would have been around when my own children were babies!

column9: Hard to believe this one gets 5 stars, right?  My daughter loves this!
column10: My daughter started out not really digging food.  She warmed up to pears right away and was really particular about what else she liked.  Mostly fruit (mango, pineapple, pear, blueberry) she would eat and peas on their own, forget it!  I was a bit reluctant to try this flavor out seeing as my daughter absolutely refused to eat peas after trying them once.  To my surprise she loved it!  Loved it so much she ate nearly the entire packet in one sitting (unheard of for her).  This is now a regular staple in our rotation and she simply can't get enough.  As a Mom, I'm delighted she is so into veggies, I am happy to spend any amount of money on these little suckers as long as she's happy eating them.Convenient pouches last for days in the fridge once opened.  Easy to take anywhere with us, including traveling.  The spoon attachments are really handy for these, but my little one enjoys eating straight from the bag. Slurp slurp slurp!Messy with the green, so be sure to use a bib.  Otherwise, hands down one of my favorite baby foods on the market.

column9: Our daughter loves this flavor in this brand + it's healthy!
column10: We have tried various organic food pouches. Our daughter loves this particular flavor in this brand. We couldn't be happier because it is also a very healthy mix of greens. We have been using it for her since she was 6 mo. old. She is now 20-months old and still loves it. When she is in a good mood, she will have more than on at one time. It's also easy to carry around, she holds it and eats it straight up!, so we always keep a stock of these at home.

We feed all of our large dogs Fromm, and they love it. We tried several brands with them, but Fromm is the only one they seem to enjoy eating. It's a high protein, no grain, no filler food. Of course, these things do make it cost more, but it's worth it to feed our pets food that is actually beneficial to them. I've done tons and tons of research on dog food, with all of the recalls happening I want to be sure that whatever I'm feeding them is safe and healthy. It's the least I can do for them. Fromm hasn't had any recalls in the 5 years I've been feeding it, and my dogs have had zero problems while eating it. It's definitely worth the price to me to have happy, healthy pets. If Fromm is out of your price range, please do research, and find the best food within your budget... your dog will thank you immensely!!!!

This is the food my dogs get exclusively. My little one (got him first) has been on it since soon after I got him because I discovered the truth about dog foods after I got him. I research everything like crazy..almost to a point where I drive myself nuts. I keep coming back to this brand of dog food. I first discovered it at a small local pet store (that does not sell pets of course; (I try not to go to those)). The store recommended we try Fromm because they have been selling it for a long time and think it is a really good food and company. So I gave it a shot (of course I had to research it more on my own). But both of my dogs do very well on it. They are small dogs (13lb and 5lb) so the kibble size is good with all the flavors. They have no problems eating any of the adult dog flavors. I do switch up the flavors for them though because they get sick of the same flavor all the time but I would too. They are healthy and spoiled rotten. In my opinion, it is the best kibble you can buy. They don't care for the canned versions though, so I get a different brand when they get a canned 'treat'. But thankfully, my boys are healthy and happy on this food. I wouldn't want it any other way. Dog foods scare me because I am putting a lot of trust into a company that has the potential to harm my boys who mean the world to me. If I had the time and money, I would make their food myself. But I hope Fromm doesn't change anything. They use quality ingredients and I've never recalled an issue with the food.By the way, I have tried other brands here and there because I am sometimes so indecisive because of my crazy researching and wanting 'the best' but I always come back to Fromm and this last time, I told myself that's it; were sticking with it; Fromm that is). So I'm glad I can get it online because I moved and don't have any pet store that carries decent food like this within an hours driving time. I refuse to get anything else now. So thanks Amazon ;)
One of my two dogs really likes this food.  The other one isn't interested.  The shape of the kibble is very interesting and unique, it is a three dimensional pyramid.
we have used this food for 5 years and our dog is healthy with no allergies.  The breeder recommended Fromms and we would recommend it also.

I think these are fabulous, especially compared to so many other mochi products I've tried over the years.  These have a very nice, gentle sweetness that is balanced; a tender but not mooshy or soggy bite, and the fillings also have nice flavors and textures.  The overall result is a little snack that is satisfying and appealing.

Taste is individual so you either like it or you don't. This mochi is sweet but not too sweet, I like it. I enrolled to Amazon's automatic delivery on this product, so that says a lot. Shipping is free & quick and the product is always fresh, kudos to Amazon. I'm yours for life.

column9: They all taste like the peanut mochi
column10: I got this figuring it was a great price for three different types of mochi.  The problem is that the peanut mochi is so strong it actually overpowered/changed the flavors of the red bean and sesame mochi so they all taste like peanuts. It was still good but I knocked off a few stars since I was expecting three different flavors for what I paid.
Great value for 4 boxes (15 pieces of 3 flavors in each box, 15.8 oz per box) of soft, flavorful mochi. Subscribe and save makes it even a better value so thanks Amazon.com!!!

column9: Tasty but peanut wasn't very good.
column10: The dough isn't as thick as I'd like but that might be personal preference. Some of the red bean ones had a chunky filling as well.

column9: Good for such a big pack!
column10: It's pretty good with such a giganic pack. The red bean flavor is pretty good. Like it the most!These packages I tried tasted using less sugar than the regular one. I don't know if it's good for all, but I like it less sugar.

Yes, I've been using Utah red (pink, really) salt for that long, beginning when Walnut Acres carried it.  It's a good addition to your salt repertoire, enhances many many flavors.  I couldn't cook without it!

I bought this product for my partner who is a professional chef. We love this product-never ceases to amaze that so many flavors can be brought forward with the many varieties of salt on the market today. Utah Jurassic salt is a 'sweet' salt and your culinary uses are only limited by your imagination. I recommend this product and hope you enjoy the adventure.

I have chronic high blood pressure and my naturopathic dr recommended this salt to help my sleepy thyroid and overall health.  Because it has iodine it helps my thyroid.  Because the salt is natural with no added anti-caking ingredients it will not have ill effects on my body or BP.  This is the best tasting salt i've ever had!  Somewhat sweet.
Rich and smooth olive oil without the bitter after-taste common in other brands.  This oil is so good one can take a spoonful for a pleasant and mouth cleansing experience.

It seems to help with their digestion and they really love it. I have also purchased Wysong Allergen for catd and dogs for my dogs' allergy problems and the cats love that too. Their coats and skin has never been better.
Wow! These are amazing. I admit, I was a little worried about how they would get to my house unmelted, but they were packed in dry ice so they were still good. Definitely a product worth ordering.

The description says "no sugar added" but the ingredients are listed as follows:  Ingredients:Whole milk, cream, nonfat milk solids, SUGAR, guar gum, carrageenan, chocolate syrup (HIGH FRUCTOSE CORN SYRUP, water, cocoa processed with alkali, xanthan gum, SUGER, salt), vanilla, strawberry juice, natural and artificial flavors. (Pasteurized/Homogenized).Maybe they mean no sugar added after it is made!
My Dad enjoys spreading this on his toast in the mornings. It doesn't take much and this jar will last him about six months.
Salty, malty and tasty. Not for sissies. A little goes a long way and is a tasteful departure from jam or marmalade. About a jar-a-year should do for a party of two.

column9: The classic English yeast extract spread
column10: I ordered some of this basically just to try it. I found that yes indeed, it is really salty and very strong flavored. You don't need much of this stuff to add some real flavor to whatever it is you are putting it on. I found that compared to other similar products, this one has more of a beer flavor. I ended up using a lot of my jar to make Marmite pasta which was really different and good enough to make a couple times afterwards. Unfortunately the pasta uses up a lot of a small jar quickly, and given the expense it makes for some pricey pasta. But I'd recommend it if you want to try something pretty alien to American taste buds. All I can think is it reminds me of beer, soy sauce, and salt, but not exactly. I guess you will just have to try it. If you have sensitive taste buds this might be too much for you. Try a little on saltines with some cheese, or smear it on buttered toast like the English serve it. I just deduct a star because it should be cheaper IMO.
For those of us growing up with Marmite - we either loved it or hated it - For us lovers, no pantry should be without it!
Definitely an acquired taste.  Good but I will be using it very sparingly and have managed to find some recipes that sound like they'll be good.

I love this product! I was starting to spend a small fortune on smaller jars of it, so I was delighted when I saw a GALLON size of it! Product shipped in a timely fashion and arrived in good condition, so that's good. However, when it arrived at my post office, one side of the box was wide open, the 8 pounds in the package had busted through the tape on one side. The box was too large for the product with only a few air pillows thrown in for padding. Other than that, I'm very happy with my purchase!

Ingredients: Chili, Salt, garlic, distilled vinegar, potassium sorbate, sodium bisulfite and xanthan gum. The 1st 4 ingredients have preserving properties; why the addition of potassium sorbate and sodium bisulfite is not clear to me - unless they want a 10 year shelf life. Sodium bisulfite also adds saltiness. This sauce has a great taste if you can tolerate the abundance of salt.
really wonderful bread.so good it seems a misnomer to call it bread.maybe cake would be better?

I bought a Bauli Traditional Il Panettone 500 gram (1.1 pound) Italian Christmas Cake recently at Costco.  Although the cake was satisfactory ( not nearly as good as my Nonna's) the biggest hassle was unsticking the cake from the baking paper that it is shipped in from Italy.  The whole cake had to be scraped loose with a spoon and it crumbled and broke much of the outer layer.  Besides the mess, I was left with a pile of Panettone crumbs in a dish.  Next Christmas, I'll make my own.

I sent three of these items to relatives, all Italian, for Christmas.  All three reported that the panettone was dry and without much flavor.  I personally have not tasted this product; just reporting what I heard.  On the other hand, the delivery by the vendor was better than I expected, given the holiday rush.

As a diabetic, I look for a few special treats to help me when I need something sweet and one more sliced apple is just not gonna work. These little licorice bites, red and black, do the trick. They give a good chew, have a nice flavor and best of all, no weird, chemical-y aftertaste.

I recently purchased both the red and black licorice bites. The product was a little on the hard side but worse than that it had very little cherry or licorice flavor.  To turn this into a pretty good product I poured a teaspoon of anise and 3 T of Splenda over the black, shook it up to coat all the pieces and then micro waved the bag for 30 seconds.  A few days later the product tasted better and was softer. I deem my change a success.  For the cherry bites, I did the same only with cherry extract (no anise) and also had very good results.  I have a recipie for sugar free licorice if you want it email me.
I bought these for my husband. It's almost impossible to find sugarless black licorice in stores, & he's thrilled with these! Fast shipping, highly recommend.

I ordered the sugar free black licorice bites shown in the photo but I received plain black licorice pieces.  I was really hoping to get the colored pieces.  I reordered them to try again and did not received the correct ones again.  I am very disappointed in this purchase, however, the purchase was delivered very quickly.

By far one of my favorite flavors of Tic Tacs! They don't sell these in stores anymore (at least not any stores that are near me) so I was pretty excited to find a whole box of 12 at such a reasonable price.
The Melon Mango is unique and delightful. Shipment was fast and well packaged. It makes for a great gift as well.

I don't know if it is really a mango and melon flavor, but it is a really good fresh, fruity flavor without being too sweet. And it's not at all sour. Actually it's my favorite (much better than mint or ORANGE). And, it's usually hard to find this flavor in the stores. But, of course, it only makes sense to try one out first if you're not sure.

column9: senseo is the best taste of all the coffees available
column10: my wife and i find senseo always consistent in flavor and taste.. we have traveled all over the world and we feel the best is in a cup of senseo dark roast coffee...long may senseo be available

column9: Senseo Dark Roast Coffee pack of 6
column10: Having been a Senseo coffee drinker for many years, I obviously love the taste!  Since it has been increasingly difficult to find this item in stores, I am so thrilled that I could order it online and have it deliverd to my door.  I'm a happy camper!

I purchase this product for my mom. She is a elderly, handicap  lady .  I enjoy the fact that she can get the six bags at a time. She new that she wouldn't run out since she was getting it every 2 months. She doesn't always get out to purchase the coffee. The store in her town doesn't always carry it and when they do it is usually $2-$3 dollars more than what we pay on line , plus it just comes to the house. She doesn't get out that often. She is really disappointed that you are discontinuing the product. Please bring it back as soon as possible. Thank you.

I love the Senseo Coffee, dark roast especially.  My son introduced this coffee to me years ago and I have worn out two Senseo coffee pots.  When I had lung cancer, I heard that coffee was a good thing.  And I have my pot going almost all the time, loving the dark roast flavor the best.  I carried it with me when I flew to Texas and when the water holder was damaged, my daughter in Texas bought me a new Senseo pot.  When the handle on the top was broken, my son bought me another pot and for Christmas we bought a Senseo pot for another son who loves the French Vanilla. We love ordering from Amazon, as we cannot find the product locally.
Love! Love! Love! This coffee is the best! I love getting it right to my house! It is the only coffee I can drink... Absolutely wonderful!

My first experience with Senseo style coffee was shortly after the manufacturing of the machine. I purcahed one. The coffee was excellent...much better than other machines, very close to the experience of getting a European (Italian) style coffee...froth and all. I have since purchased 3 Senseo coffee makers and everyone is blown away by the quality of the coffee produced. The dark roast is my favorite of the entire selection, followed by the decaf!  Try it, you may like it or even learn to love it!

Seems grocery stores stopped selling Senseo pods. Their loss! Senseo pods are great! There are different flavors, and buying them through Amazon is a great deal. I have saved on the cost when comparing to the grocery stores. The automatic shipping is reliable.

This product is not the best for flavor, but the earlier price per cup was reasonable, at about $0.28. Now, however, the price seems to have escalated to more than $0.33 per cup, and for that I will abandon ordering prefilled pods & just resort to using my ecopods and coffeeduck. Amazon, you have disappointed by not keeping prices within reason.

column9: Very pleasant taste and nice foam on top of every cup
column10: Senseo Dark Roast Coffee, 18-Count Pods (Pack of 6)Very tastefull coffee easy to make one cup at a time. If you like a hot cup of coffee with a lot of foam then you will love this one.
The coffee good for a quick cup in the morning.Easy to fix,and clean up after.enjoy a cup in the morning.

I actually love both systems but I find the Senseo coffee to be easier on my stomach without a loss of flavor. The Senseo pods are much easier to composite given there is no plastic in the container, just paper. However, the fact that there is somewhat less of a mess with the Keurig pod, consumers are more apt to go with this convenience than with the recycling aspect. Alas, we can not find Senseo in our supermarkets anymore.

I like the rich flavor of this dark roast single cup brew, and because it is often discounted, it is a good value. I chose the pod-type brewing because I do not like to put little plastic cups in the landfills with every cup I drink; just ground coffee and a little filter paper which biodegrade.
My husband has tested many a coffee maker and this is the best.  Likes his coffee dark and very flavorful.  Much better than any other inexpensive coffee maker on the market today.
Best tasting coffee you can buy and sometimes hard to find in the local stores. Price is very competitive and we don't have to search anymore. Delivery to our front door makes it a no brainer.
When I just want one cup of coffee instead of brewing or going for pressed,  this is a great cup of coffee.

bought the senseo one cup coffee maker and this coffee about 6 months ago. The coffee maker is quiet and the foamy top to this great tasting and strong cup of brew is fabulous. i just keep ordering more. had melitta but it was much more expensive, coffee maker kept breaking down... senseo is much better.
We have been buying Senseo Dark Roast every since we bought the Senseo Coffee maker from Amazon.  We heat up some milk in the microwave and and fill our cups with Dark roast and it is very delicious!
I don't drink coffee. But my wife, who is accustomed to drinking Peet's French Roast, tells me this product is very good.

I have had considerable trouble finding coffee pods in supermarkets for my Black and Decker Home Cafe, so was very pleased to find I can easily order them from Amazon.  My coffee maker is no longer being manufactured and seems to have been replaced by very expensive one-cup-at-a-time coffee machines.  I prefer the convenience and taste of coffee from my machine so will continue to order pods on line.

I am very pleased with this product. My local stores no longer carry Senseo, so this is my second purchase through Amazon.  I now order it on auto delivery and love how quickly it arrives.  I also find that it taste quite fresher then when I bought them at the store.
I still think Senseo coffee is as close to Starbucks as I can get. I might even like it better! Kona is strong yet gentle and does not upset my stomach with too much acid.

column9: I actually subscribe to a coffee
column10: This coffee is delicious, the Kona blend is a favorite senseo blend in our house, people come over just to have a cup with us.  It even made my wife who doesn't really like coffee start requesting a cup!

This coffee is very good....a bit strong it isgreat if you have the Hamilton beach stay or gopersonal cup coffee maker....the other senseopods I have to use two of them but the sumatra blendI only need one....this is my coffee for mystay and go machine.....if you dont like thiscoffee send me your pods...have a great day

I have tried quite a few different Senseo coffee pods So far, Kona is my fsavorite. Goes down easy, smooth and on the mild side. There are stronger blends. I prefer Kona over the others. I use the single cup and one pod.

I love the sumatra, but since this product just keeps getting more and more expensive everywhere, the best price I found was on Amazon. And it was a really good price at that.  They shipped the first box of 6 packs and UPS broke the box, and put 4 packs in a UPS box and shipped that to me...3 of which were broken open inside THAT box.  I took a picture of how they tried to sneakily (is that a word?) ship only 4 packs to me.  It was sooo obvious.  I called Amazon and they reshipped a new box of 6packs immediately.  GREAT customer service!

This coffee is yummy. It is my favorite of all the pods.  The Senseo coffee system provides a truly European experience.  The Sumatra blend is strong and flavorful without being overpowering and it fills my cup with a perfect layer of froth. LOVE

After travelling in Europe and using a Senseo coffee machine and Senseo Espresso Coffee, we came home & found we missed it terribly.  Not available in Canada, I was pleased to find I could order it in the U.S.  That was 3 years ago, and we've been using and loving it ever since.  It is the only coffee I drink now, it's economical, there's no wasted coffee and it makes the best latte's going.
This is delicious coffee, and extremely quick and convenient to prepare.  In less than a minute, you have a brew that's fresh, aromatic, and rich in flavor.

I buy Senseo Coffee Pods for my brother.  He can no longer buy it at any local store and it his favorite.  I order it for him and it is at his door in a couple of days. It cost the same as he was paying when he purchased it locally.  It is easy to order from Amazon, I just go to my account and the record is there so I just push reorder and all of the information is there.  Nothing to be typed in. We are always pleased with this service.Thanks,ET

I received a single cup coffee maker for Christmas.then I went to buy the pods and found that the store was limited in thier choices.Then I found them on amazon,and at a  good price. Makes a good cup of coffee.

I don't know what I expected.  Coffee pod systems all seem to be geared to someone who prefers weaker coffee than me.  I can reduce the water, but then I get a smaller cup of coffee and it starts being less cost effective.  Plus, the Senseo coffees (both medium and dark roast) are bitter.  These aren't horrible, just mediocre, and they do have caffeine in them and are quick and convenient, so 3 stars.
I usually enjoy my coffee but the package was split and coffee grounds were in every cup of coffee making my mornings unhappy

column9: Do you want really good coffee at home?
column10: I have been using the Senseo Coffee maker for quite a few years now.  We have the "K" cup machine at my office and the Senseo makes much better coffee.  The Espresso pods are the best yet, and I have tried most of the other varieties.  We almost never go out to S**B** any more for a special cup of coffee.
I don't have an espresso machine, and these pods are the next-best thing. Love 'em!
Amazon price is cheaper than the grocery store.  I do auto ship, so it's even cheaper and I never run out of coffee.  The coffee is good and so much easier than making a whole pot for one person.: )

We love our Senseo coffee maker.  Had one for about 5 years now.  Unfortunately local stores have discontinued stocking the coffee pods.  So glad to see that Amazon.com carries it.  Will be ordering more of the Medium Roast and the Colombian.

I like full flavored coffee and the espresso coffee pods, brewed as regular coffee are just the ticket.  I especially like Senseo coffee pods because they are paper filtered real ground coffee.  Don't like single servers with plastic cups, plus Senseo pods are much less expensive.
Taste great for espresso from a pod. Beats dragging out my big expensive machine and clean it up is much easier. Works if you are in a hurry.

Althouh I love Senseo coffees for the most part, I didn't care for this one at all.  It has a smokey, burnt flavor to me that tastes like coffee that's been sitting out for hours.  Plus I had the same problems others mentioned with torn pods that contaminated the rest of the bag and what a mess that was!  I won't be buying this kind again.
I'm not an aficionado so I can't give this coffee the review it deserves, but I will say that as a 27 year old daily drinker, this blend+tasty creamer = a good morning.

BJ's Brewhouse started serving Douwe Egberts coffee a few years ago.  I loved it so much, I went online looking for a way to purchase it for home.  It turns out, Douwe Egberts partnered with Phillips to create the Senseo coffee pod system for the sole purpose of marketing their coffee to the United States.  This is the most remarkable coffee I've ever been able to make at home.  It's restaurant quality, and Amazon has the best deal on the pods.  Especially now that they offer the subscription program.

I ordered this case of pods based on all the positive reviews, which are usually right on (thanks everybody!), but I thought this coffee tasted horrible, and was especially disappointed because I love Starbucks Sumatra and it didn't have any of the distinctive Sumatra taste.  This is Sumatra BLEND.  I didn't notice the "blend" part but regardless it tastes like Sumatra blended with the cheapest office coffee ever.  So bad I gave it away.  Sorry I can't be more specific about the flavor except to say it tastes like cheap coffee...
We've been happy w/ our Senseo machine for a while now but this Espresso coffee sealed the deal. Excellent coffee.
I ws very disapointed in the strength and taste of this blend.  It was far too weak and bitter tasting. I recomment you buy Sumatra Blend far more flavor then Columbia and a four star rating.

I've tried most of the Senseo pods... if you like a really rich, bold flavor and aroma, Sumatra is far and away the best! In fact, you can make a much better version of French Vanilla by flavoring this blend yourself than by buying the French Vanilla flavor, which really lacks much vanilla flavor at all.And this is the ONLY one in which I can make 6oz per pod and still end up with decent coffee. (Still better to stick to 4oz/pod IMHO.)

[asin]Senseo Douwe Egberts Medium Roast Coffee Pods, 18-Count 4.41-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6) I like saving money on this deliciously rich, full bodied coffee for my Grindmaster coffee machine. It's great to be able to make just one cup at a time, or more, with the pods, and the taste in consistently yummy! I've told my friends and they love the taste too!

While I like the taste of the blend I received this time, I would be happier if Senseo offered a generic bean, such as Columbian Supremo instead of an unidentifiable blend. By offering a blend, Senseo can change the mix to reflect their current costs for the various Columbian beans. The next time I purchase this, if I do, it could have an entirely differant taste.

I love Sumatra coffee and was delighted to find it in the Senseo Pods.  It is a little lighter than the Sumatra I used to brew but still is low acid.There are less pods in these pkgs than in the dark roast.  16 as opposed to 18.I love my Senseo but hate to clean it.

This is the best Senseo that i've tried, and I've tried almost all of them.  If you like the strong taste and aroma that a French press gives you, then this is the pod for you.  Strong coffee flavor that reminds me of some of the best coffee's I've had the pleasure of trying while living in Europe.

I have been a very very loyal Senseo drinker since my first machine over 7 years ago.  I purchased the new Supreme model in Oct '11 when my old one was wearing out and then Consumer Reports rated the new model the top one for pod machines.  I would have purchased it from Amazon but the Senseo website was selling them for half price!  Too good to be true it turned out....as they stopped selling the machine several months later and on April 1st the pods were no longer available in retail stores.  So I kept purchasing pods thru Amazon.  Until May....when I saw that they no longer in stock.  And no longer in stock anywhere online....including the Senseo Store on their own website.  Well I just called Senseo today, June 7th, 2012, to complain and they said they they "should" have coffee pods back in stock mid-June.....and they said Amazon "should" have pods the 1st week of July.  That wasn't good enough for me.  They sell (and then stop selling) a coffee maker and then claim they cannot supply the coffee pods due to operations problems and changes with their manufacturing.  I love my Senseo brewer a lot but it is too much of a struggle to get the pods....or wait for them....and I am not convinced that this won't be the case again the future.  So the people at Senseo (Sara Lee, Inc actually) helped me make a decision.....that I will be disposing of my 8 month old Senseo brewer next week when my current pod supply runs out and I will be replacing it with a new K-Cup machine.

From all the original Senseo Coffee Pods, I like this variety best.I follow the rules and prepare it using the Senseo HD7003 Espresso Pod Holder - that means it will be a smaller cup (not really as little as an Italian Espresso shot), but you can always use your regular Pod Holder, if that is too strong for you.The prepared coffee has a nice Crema and great taste. In the morning I heat some milk in the microwave and whip it using an Aerolatte Frother to make a very quick Cappuccino - the way I like it :)

Apparently, Senseo has decided to abandoned the US market. It is nearly impossible to find Senseo at any of the traditional retailers, including Amazon, Walmart, or Target. Walmart is carrying Melitta brand pods that work in the Senseo, but the quality is not as good.It is interesting to note Amazon continues to list the Senseo brand in email blast, but the items are always out of stock. I wrote Senseo customer service about the issue, but they failed to respond.I'm going back to Costco brand ground coffee and the old reliable Mr. Coffee or Bunn for the morning jolt. I refuse to buy into another expensive pod or k-cup single serve system that changes as often as Gillette changes razor blade models.

Had some of this on back order - four boxes of six bags each.  Yesterday they were $26.04 a box.  Look at today!!!After being out of production,  I suppose we should be happy to have availability at all,  eh?

column9: Good coffee, but let's not pretend it's Kona coffee
column10: This is one of the better tasting Senseo pods out there, but it is not Kona coffee.  It contains only 10% Kona coffee, the other 90% is something else.  If you want Kona coffee, go buy Kona coffee.  This Kona "blend" won't taste anything like it.Names aside, as I stated this is one of the better tasting Senseo pods.  Four stars are based on rating Senseo coffee.  It would get less stars if I was just rating "coffee".

Senseo pods are very convenient and reasonably priced--I only wish the brew was a little more "tasty".  Since I don't like dark-roast beans/coffee, I ordered the "medium roast".  Much to my surprise, it is TOO mild for me!  This is particularly so since a pod really is only intended to make an 8 oz. cup of coffee.  My coffee maker allows me to use up to 12 oz. of water and then it's really way too mild/weak.The Senseo pods are ordered by the case, so it's going to take me a long time before I can try a stronger brew.  My recommendation is to be sure and try all the flavor options before ordering a full case of pods.

Based on the reviews, I ordered a 6 pack of these.  BAD IDEA.We have tried a number of different varieties of pods,  these are by far the worst.This stuff is so bad no one here will drink it.You might want to buy one bag and try it before ordering a 6 pack.
Not as strong as the regular dark coffee.  Disappointing after having Sumatra at Starbucks. Wouldn't get it again.  It just didn't taste like the real deal.

The Kona blend pods are okay, but a bit weak and lacking in "bite" like the coffees I prefer. My favorite of the pods was the Espresso Blend, which is no longer available in the US.I've tried using the "coffee duck" as a substitute for the Senseo pods... and it works okay with a good, finely ground coffee, but it's much less convenient than just tossing a pod into the coffee maker.  And the "duck" doesn't produce the trademark foam on the coffee surface.  Melitta Dark roast is another alternative for those who like a bit more coffee taste, but the Melitta is not as good as the Senseo Espresso Blend was (when it was still available).My understanding is that in the very near future, the existing US supply of Senseo pods will be exhausted and users will either need to find a replacement or move on to a different type of coffee maker... maybe a Kuerig machine or, when it's available, the new Starbucks Verisimo machine.  I believe the latter is slated to be on the market in time for the 2012 Christmas holidays.I hate to see the Senseo machines go... and I believe the pods and the machines are still being sold in Europe... but due to some corporate mergers and non-compete agreements, we are about to see the Senseo line come to an end in the US.  (If my facts are wrong on this, please, post something to let me know!)

Senseo, I used to LOVE you, but then your products went dark for nearly 8 months, whats a gal to do without coffee?....now I have a Keurig, and Im happy again. Why do you come back to haunt me Senseo, and where did you go all that time???? Could I trust you again? I think not....
Cup for cup the senseo Dark Roast is one of the best coffees on the market for the price.  An excellent "day to day" coffee with consistent good taste.
Can't find these in stores anymore so I was happy to get them at Amazon.com.  My small single cup coffeemaker requires these pods.
Very good coffee for the Senseo but it cost too much. I drink a lot of cups of coffee a day and can't afford it anymore!
18 pods and great tasting. Was hoping senseo would come back  and amazon did it , now we need pods for under 30 cents
This coffee is just delicious.....smooth and yet very RICH...  Makes me feel like I am in Hawaii.......Just look forward to mornings with these pods in my Senseo machine!!!!
First experience with Senseo, I ordered the dark roast because I want coffee to taste like coffee!  Much weaker than the medium roast...wish I had my "pricey" dollars back!  Mediocre product!

Because there was a period last spring when I couldn't get the Senseo pods anywhere, I was thrilled to find some at Tesco (large grocery chain in England).  I bought a large quantity to bring home with me and the best news is they make a mug size pod (you only use one instead of two).  The other nice thing about the European product is they use nicer paper for the pods...it has a silky quality.  Any chance of getting the mug size here?  I prefer this product to Keurig etc as it is much more environment friendly, not to mention cheaper.....although the price has really gone up since it disappeared from the supermarket shelf.
I threw these away after making 3 cups - one cup with 1 pod, then one with 2 them 3 (as the others were way too weak). They all tasted TERRIBLE. I wish I could return them. Yuk.
I love this coffee.  Reminds me of the time I was in Holland.  Can't get it at my local grocery store.
These coffee pods are easy to use for a single cup - and have a good flavor. My elderly mother loves the convenience of the use and clean-up.
Easy to use, that's what I like first thing (5:00a.m.) in the morning!Good coffee flavor, that's most important.  Just what you want, especially in that first cup in the moring.
Best source for these coffee pods and best price.Coffee made by this method is never wasted.  It is always the same, no guesswork.My friends love having coffee at my house!
Great tasting coffee. Not too strong, not too weak. One pod sufficient for a morning mug. Cheaper by the subscription.

We've had the Senseo coffee maker for a few years now and really enjoy the coffee.  I like the dark roast (purchased) and my wife enjoys the decaf.  It seems other competitors are gaining ground in the local stores and the Senseo coffee pods are less and less easy to find.  Or, if you find them they are priced higher than usual.  We're really glad we located this product and vendor online through Amazon.  Hopefully, our Senseo coffee machine will continue to last and the pods will continue to be made available.  The only "complaint" we've ever had is that the decaf flavors are very limited.  Otherwise, love the coffee!
Can't find these anywhere else. This is my fave coffee so I'm very happy I can get them here. Tried others, just aren't the same.
I use my pods at work and even people who don't drink coffee comment how good it smells as it brews up!

senseo was the first to come up with the single serve coffee machine.I bought it and along with it came the coffee pods.After trying my first machine and the senseo coffee pods I have continued to use the senseo pods and have enjoyed every cup.I hope you will continue to carry these pods because I cannot purchase them any more through any of the food stores.Thank you amazon,Doreen
I have purchased this product many times over. Although the cost has risen,I find it is still a good brand of coffee.

column9: they're back and as good as before!
column10: After a long absence, Senseo dark roast coffee pods are again available.  I had heard they are made by another company,not Sara Lee, so I wasn't sure they would taste the same. I ordered them again from Amazon.com (I was previously on their subscription plan, in which they would automatically send me a 6 pack every month, but then Amazon cancelled it--lack of supply from Sara Lee).Good news, the coffee is the same, delicious!  However, in the many months of absence of the Senseo pods (did they think I was going to stop drinking coffee and wait?  Lol, NO!), I found another brand that is comparable, just as good, but just about the same price:  Baronet dark roast makes pods that are also excellent coffee.  So if Senseo again stops production, I have another brand to fall back on. Bottom line, Senseo coffee is back, it's still delicious, but I don't trust them to stay in production, so I have Baronet as my back up plan.

The Senseo coffe pods work with are Black&Decker Home Cafe single cup maker. We Love both of them!!! The pods are getting hard to find in stores and are costly. So, when we need more Senseo coffe pods, I order a 6 pack of them thru Amazon ... I also make sure it's a "prime" purchase for free shipping.
this is a great tasting coffee, have been ordering through subscription until I was told it was out of stock. I then tried Melitta coffee pods and found it cheaper and almost same great flavor.
Nice dark roast. When it's in your mouth it has very rich, earthy, and herbal flavors.. leaves a great taste in your mouth. It is bold, but is well balanced and is a favorite in my home.
Good tasting coffee that works with my Senseo Coffee Maker.  I'm glad this product is back, it was on backorder for several months.

I am not a coffee drinker but my husband is.  The sensa dark roast has made him an exremely happy person.  He finds it a blend that he truly loves and the fact that he can make one good cup at a time is great.  I have never seen him this happy with any other coffee brewed at home. It got to the point that I couldn't find this coffee locally and am thankful I found it on Amazon.

I purchased the coffee maker not knowing how good this coffee was. I purchased my coffee from Amazon.  It was a great deal and I got it so fast.  This coffee is the best I've had & I have friends who agree.
I loved this coffee,and I will buy it again.. soon.... I will try other brands of this coffee.. I might even try the tea that they have..

column9: My Favorite Senseo Coffee Pod....Sumatra Blend!
column10: This is the one I continue to buy time after time after time....! It's just that good, smooth and delicious and I never get tired of it!  The only problem I have ever had concerning this coffee, is that it sometimes is out of stock........even on Amazon! Then I run out and have to wait!! Just like it is now....out of stock!  So waiting I am..........guess everyone else likes it too!!

Senseo Coffee is the most enjoyable cup of coffee I have ever had.My favorite time of morning...Is having a cup of Senseo Medium Roast Coffee.The flavor is a blend of the best tasting coffee I have ever tasted. The aroma of  coffee brewing is an absolute pleasure to wake up to.

This is the best coffee!! Amazon is great and had the best deal. I was able to have a schedule of delivery and didn't have to worry about running out.  Very very upset that we can no longer purchase this on Amazon!!! Very disappointed. I still love Amazon though...
We like the Senseo Medium Roast Coffee pods but unfortunately they are no longer offered as part of the subscribe and save program.  I was purchasing them for the office.
Best coffee I've ever had. Also the easiest to make.It is getting harder to find in stores.I'm glad to see someone is inteligent enought to still carry it.

column9: I Enjoy My Morning Cup Now
column10: I've never been much of a coffee drinker because I could never seem to brew a good cup.  This has changed how I drink coffee now. I thoroughly enjoy my morning cup(or 2) now since I purchased my one cup coffee maker and discovered Senseo Medium Roast Coffee pods. I don't like strong coffee and the Medium Roast is just the way I like it.

I read the reviews and based on them I purchased these pods.  I know I like my coffee strong, not as strong as some, but really?  These pods are kind of weak.  It says espresso but it doesn't taste like it to me.  Yes, you get a little creama, but not much, and not every time.  I won't be purchasing these again.
These pods offer a quick and conveinent good cup of coffee when you don't have time to brew a full pot. Amazon provides a good and the best value I have found do far.

I have tried many different Senseo coffees, and I like the Columbian coffee the best. The taste is smooth and has lots of flavor. Senseo is a great way to enjoy good tasting coffee without paying the high price of the Kuerig coffee maker and the "cups" coffee.

I have not been happy with my order. I love this Senseo coffee but cannot find the Sumatra flavour in the stores.My first order was disappointing.Apart from two of the bags, every bag had one pod with a tear in it making it unusable. The other two bags... one had no torn pods and the other had two torn pods.So I am averaging one unusable pod per bag which bumps up the cost of the coffee. I find this unacceptable but will see how the second order pans out as I have already received it.If I have the same problem I will cancel future orders and buy my coffee elsewhere.

Finally we have found a Senseo Coffee pod that is close to what we could get in Europe.  We got hooked on Senseo while living overseas and had a large variety of different pod manufacturers to choose from.  Here in the United States, the majority of the selection tasted like water down coffee (YUCK).  This variety was the only one I could tolerate for my morning coffee fix.. Now if it can only get back in stock!
Love this blend.  I combine the breakfast blend with a flavored Pod and enjoy my morning java.  Sad to be told this is no longer on the Subscribe & Save program
These are so perfect for my cappucino machine. No fuss or mess involved. I love all the different flavors. Good coffee, too!

Fabulous coffee.  Kona is my favorite of the Senseo choices but even the medium and dark roast are good.  The decalf coffe is surpringly tasty!  Sure a whole lot less than the Starbucks down the street!!!

If you like a rich dark coffee, Sesseo Sumatra Blend is really great without being bitter.  While the pods are expensive compared to ground coffee in a coffee maker, we believe that this is equivalent to coffee you would buy at Starbucks and you have it at home.  We also like Senseo Dark Roast, but actually we did not like and do not buy any of the other coffee offerings from Senseo.

column9: Smooth, Rich Blend, simply the best!
column10: Our Senseo coffee machine was given to us as a house warming gift, and we have loved from the first time we used it!  The dark roast coffee pods seem to taste so much better than any other brand or flavor I have ever made from home.  The dark roast blend is simply the best. It is smooth, rich, and brews so quickly in our new machine, it's fantastic.  I suggest using stevia powder as a natural (and chemical free!) sweetener with this blend, 30 Grams (1.06 Oz) Stevia 95% Steviosides Bulk Powder.  I don't even use cream anymore, no kidding!

column9: Finally, a great cup of coffee
column10: I have tried them all...all the brands on Amazon, that is. Some have been less than thrilling and some pretty good. The Senseo Espresso Coffee Pods are the best I have found. You can make a great cup of coffee...I wouldn't really call it espresso with the convenience of a pod. I read a tip somewhere on Amazon about wetting both sides of the pod and it was the best tip I got in 2008. The resulting coffee is rich and full flavored, without bitterness. I think I will stick with Senseo Espresso. I did not use the special espresso pod, just the usual one pod holder, and it worked fine.

We were among the first owners of a free Senseo coffeemaker way back like 10 or more years ago. We have a white machine in our laundryroom & then bought my husband a black one for work.  Soooooooo I guess you could say we looooooove this coffee/method of making it, & medium roast is the best. I recently saw Douwe Egberts non-pod coffee @ a local gourmet shop & it was like $9 something for 12oz! Good to know one can get the coffee to use in a regular drip pot as well, however, @ that price, I guess we will just continue to have this as "treat coffee" via our machine.All this being said, I would like to say that @ both Target & Walmart here in Buffalo, NY area stores, I can get the pods for $4.24 each. However, when Target in particular, wants to rotate stock, they mark it down to the wonderful price of $4!!!!! Needless to say, I buy them out, go to another store & do the same. That's almost $4 less for 6 bags than Amazon sells it for!!!! I encourage all of you Senseoholics to do the same & check out the above mentioned stores. I wish Amazon would stop reminding me it's so cheap, when they don't mark it down to Target's level.

column9: Can't find Senseo coffee, here's the story
column10: Years ago Philips and Douwe Egberts were partners in the development of the machine and coffee pods.  The copyright on the pod system was ruled invalid and a decision was made to offer the pods via on line vendors only; no more brick and mortar stores.  Philips then sold their share of the coffee business to Douwe Egberts and are moving pod production to Brazil.  This is causing the delay, especially with the Dark Roast.  According to Senseo the coffee should be by June or July at the latest.  Or so they say.  I am surprised that they have not made this info more available.  Seems like many will simply move on to another coffee machine.  Meanwhile try using a regular coffee filter and espresso grind your own coffee.  I've tried Starbucks coffee and not bad.  Less creama, but good flavor.  Google 'make your own coffee pods' to see the methods used to trim the filter and pack the coffee.  It's easy, but not so easy as dropping two pods and pushing the start button.
These pods are excellent. They are great hot or cold. I did not purchase the special pod holder; I believe the regular single pod is just fine.

column9: Wonderful Coffee - absolutely delicious - love the frothy flavor
column10: Senseo Dark Roast is a wonderfully flavored coffee designed for use in the Senseo machine - unfortunately this machine is almost never sold in brick and mortar stores anymore and Amazon is about the last place you can buy one.  In fact, we bought a backup when we realized this was occurring so we would always have access.  AND we THOUGHT surely Amazon would continue to at least sell the coffee since it's so difficult to find in local stores - but about two weeks ago Amazon's Subscribe and Save service notified us Dark Roast would no longer be available and recommended another brand of Dark Roast - which was awful.  Senseo Dark Roast coffee is incredible - best coffee we've ever drank and I'm 62 years old and have been drinking coffee for nearly 50 years - honestly, if I have to purchase it from European suppliers, I guess I will because there is no other real substitute for this wonderfully delicious coffee.  I've even written to Senseo on their web site and they don't respond - so something is happening here, not sure what.  But if you can find this Dark Roast, buy it - because you will not be disappointed.  It is THE best pod coffee out there.Why would Amazon stop selling this coffee? Dark Roast has a very loyal following and comments on every blog or review site are almost all favorable - PLEASE - BRING IT BACK!  If enough of us indicate an interest, perhaps Amazon will reconsider - after all, the continue to sell the other flavors (for now?) but not Dark Roast - which is hands down the best.UPDATE SEPTEMBER 2012:  Senseo Dark Roast is BACK! YEAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!  Finally, after I had to switch to alternative pods, Senseo finally got their act together and started production at their new facility - I don't know all the details, but basically they shut down their production of this particular line (perhaps others) and sold the product line to another retailer - so we had a down period of several months when it was all but impossible to find this product on line (and it will never, I'm told, be in the brick and mortars again) - WHY!!!!!!!!!!!!!  This is THE best coffee out there, bar none.To add insult to injury, while we were anxiously waiting for our first shipment of Senseo Dark Roast in months our Senseo Supreme coffee maker broke down (probably due to using alternative pods that don't fit!)  So our shipment arrived and no coffee maker (we love the froth on top, so their new machine by Hamilton Beach I think it is, does not produce "froth" so not a viable option) - anyway, we reached out to Senseo Customer Service - we are many years out of warranty and Philips no longer makes the Senseo Supreme machine - OH NO!  Now what.  CS rep says there is nothing they can do to help.  So I clicked on the Corporate Relations link on their site and shot off an email to the big cheese.  GUESS WHAT?  A nice lady (Dolores) wrote me back and said she would get me a refurbished machine, no problem.  We thought great - and waited, and waited - and waited - almost a month and no machine came - so I wrote her back and ask for tracking - she checked and the order was still in the system; seems she forgot to click the submit button to the fulfillment center so it was just sitting there in limbo.  She corrected this and apologized, machine came a few days later.  Just like a new machine, could not tell that it was in any way refurbished - even included a bag of dark roast!! (stale, out of date by 9 months, but was still drinkable, just a little more bold than normal.)Senseo came through for us - they know they have very loyal customers and appreciate them - and while the disruption in supply was annoying, we are just thankful we can still buy this product on Amazon - although the price did go up by $13 a case (or $2 a bag) and there is no more Subscribe and Save capability (please Amazon, restore this savings and if possible, please lower the price back to a more competitive level with other pods - under or about $4/bag!?!?)

I enjoy my senseo so much more now that I have these pods.  I had worked as a barista for 8 years and was having a hard time adjusting to life without free lattes.  I certainly won't say that Senseo espresso by itself is in the same league as freshly ground, coffee shop espresso, but having the freedom to easily and cheaply make my favorite coffee drinks at home has been a Godsend.  I usually mix two shot of Senseo espresso with a spoonful of Xylitol, a spoonful of Black and Green brand unsweetened cocoa powder, and a splash of half and half for a sugar-free mocha that tastes almost as good as one from coffee shop, but for about a quarter of the price.  Try it!
I use one 'Espresso' on top of one 'Dark Roast' for a great cup of coffee.

First time I tried Sumatra in a large order from Amazon and I was not disappointed. I read the reviews before selection and was encouraged to try this blend. When I grind Sumatra beans for a drip coffee maker it is stronger. This Pod-style Sumatra blend is not too strong and should please most coffee drinkers. Very satisfactory - will probably stick with this selection for future purchases. The quick and easy brewing using Senseo is so great for people on the run - or too sleepy to grind and brew. Tastes great from first sip to bottom of cup!

I've been a Senseo fan for three years, and I subscribed to delivery through Amazon.  Over the past year or so I've felt the flavor fading, and with the ONE THIRD PRICE INCREASE over the last year I'm rethinking my devotion.  I just cancelled my subscription.  We'll see how I feel when the coffee runs out.  Back to the french press?
I love my Senseo coffee! The pods are made of a mesh that will decompose. I love that the only thing I have to was is my coffee cup. (No pot, filter, etc.)

column9: I hope they don't sell out to Melita completely
column10: I'm going to try this, hoping it is the same good coffee we've been buying for years - ever since the Senseo machine came out. We used to buy these pods at Walmart but now they sell something that says Senseo on it and Dark Roast etc. but It's a "Melita" brand and it's awful. Really awful. Some people on here say the Keurig is better but don't believe it. Plus, compare the price of using all of those Keurig "pods."There is another single serving coffee maker (Hamilton Beach) where you put your own coffee into a strainer receptical and it makes an 8-10 ounce cup of coffee that is as good as any drip coffee but you don't have to heat water, use paper filters, etc. We have one of those too.We also have a Pavoni Espresso machine ~$1,000. But it's a lot of work. Our favorite is still the Senseo with the original Dark Roast Coffee pods. If they stop selling these, our two senseo machines will go to the Goodwill store.One additional comment: After writing this review, I was going to order a box of six packages of Senseo Dark Roast Coffee as I have before. The price was $29 and some cents but with shipping it ws over $35 so I didn't order. Amazon says orders over $25 ship free but apparently not unless it's very small or you are a Premium member. So it might mean we will give up our Senseo because we can't buy it locally anymore. I refuse to pay 25-50 cents for a cup of coffee at home (as with Senseo+shipping or Keurig or other "pod" systems) when I can make a great cup with my own premium beans from Costco for about 2 cents with my Hamilton Beach single cup system. And this simple system makes hot water for tea or coffee with your own ground coffee in about 3 minutes and it cost about $60. I don't know why people buy these Keurig or other systems (Nestles has had this pod system in Europe for 20 years or more). Have you ever figured out what you're paying for each cup?

I purchased these coffee pods for my one-cup coffee makers.  My clients love the coffee.  It's not too light and not too strong.  Just perfect.  After I open the packet, I keep them in the freezer until I use the pods.  They keep perfectly fresh and aromatic.

column9: Good coffee, but do watch out for differing batches
column10: OK so most people seem to like this coffee; it's got a strong rating (4 1/2 at the moment), but there are still those that say they don't. It will always be subjective; many people detest Starbucks coffee, but millions more like it. Some like it bold, some like it weak, some like it mild, some like it bitter, some like it sweet; no way to please everyone.This coffee is on the mild side, meaning it has flavor but its not overpowering, and is moreso on the sweeter side, meaning it's not bitter like diner-house coffee. The great thing about this flavor is that it blends excellent for those that like to flavor their coffee; because it is not bitter but still has a noticeable coffee flavor, it compliments most flavored creamers. I've had many many different types of coffees with many different types of creamers, and it can be a real balancing act to find the right blends. The senseo medium roast so far has been the best "starting point", meaning nobody I've personally made coffee for has said anything but complimentary things about it. Some still like a more bold or bitter coffee, but so far nobody has said poor things about this coffee. I use a single pod in approx. 6oz of coffee in a cheap Hamilton Beach drip machine with filtered water, and it turns out great.One other thing, sometimes batches taste 'slightly' different from one-another; it's a product from a plant when all is said and done, and while controls are put into place to regulate the taste, sometimes batches are slightly more bold or bitter than another, it happens with all manufacturers (including Folgers and other large manufacturers, which I've personally tasted radical variations). I've ordered this 6-pack around 6 times so far, and only one batch was slightly odd tasting (had a much more noticeable/bitter flavor to it), other than that it has been very consistent. I left the bag slightly open on that batch, in essence making it "go flat" so it wasn't so bitter. While these packets are sealed, make sure you store them in a sealed container after opening to preserve the flavor.One other thing to watch out for: increasing costs. This pack is still a great deal on Amazon, but I am worried since they have made the decision to pull from retail outlets that it will increase in cost on Amazon as well. I still love this coffee, but if it goes up to $40 for a 6-pack of this, I may be rethinking the coffee I purchase. Keep it low in cost and at the same level of flavor and we'll all be happy.

Have been using Senseo for over 4 years and enjoy its flexibility (the coffee machine) and its flavor (the pods).  Now that the grocery stores seem to be dropping the product line, ordering through Amazon is fast and, again, flexible with each order.
After trying most all the dark roasts and also others, this tastes most like brewed coffee. It is strong and only requires one pod for up to an 8 oz. cup.  i will keep ordering this.
I have been using Senseo for several years, the coffee is the best ever. Thank you for coming up with such a great coffee.
