I love this tea, I also have purchased the decaf and I love both, like I said with the decaf, it's the perfect blend of spice and sweetness!  If you haven't tried it, it's a must try!

column9: Naturally sweet, no calories, warm, spicy, delicious
column10: This tea is naturally sweet with a similarity to Good Earth tea but so much better.If you enjoy cinnamon tea, you will never find one better than this!

column4: L. B. Carter "The Original Emerald City Playa"
column10: Love it! Love it! Love it!  Reminds me of home (I used to be a Seattlite!)  Wonderful aroma, delicious flavor...what more could you ask for?  Only being at the market itself would be better!  Cheers!
this tea is wonderful.  I bought it for myself, then bought 4 more pkgs. for Christmas gifts.
The teabags are convenient and I use them at work, but the loose tea is much better.  Both the teabags amd the loose tea are great for anyone who loves cinnamon!
This tea is a favorite of my family and it is a "miracle of the age" that I can get it so easily here in the Northeast through Amazon.

I wouldn't call this a true, delicately subtle floral Earl Grey. The tea, no matter how long or which style it is brewed in, is overly tannic, like a cheap supermarket brand of black tea. It is lovely to smell, disappointing to drink - very little citrus tones (as in, none I could detect) with just the slightest tang of bergamot oil. Extremely disappointing. A good buy if you do not enjoy earl grey but love the smell.

Reading the other reviews, I wonder whether I got a stale box! My tea tasted bland and even dusty. I couldn't taste the slightest bergamot. It was like something you would drink when you're camping in the boonies and it's raining and you have no other way to heat up. Like something out of one of those giant yellow Igloo dispensers you see at tailgate parties on foggy November mornings. I would rather drink hot water. After I tried this, I dumped out my mug and threw the box and its 15 remaining organic tannin packets into the compost! Ashes to ashes.

column9: By Far The Tastiest Earl Gray Tea I Have Tasted
column10: I found this product featured on www.organicgrocerydeals.com and the members there spoke highly of this brand of organic tea.When my package arrived I could smell the yummy Earl Grey scent waft out of the box as soon as I opened the standard Amazon packaging. I immediatly put on my copper tea kettle to boil water so I could taste this heavently scented tea.I made my cup of tea with a bit of honey and a splash of organic milk and sat down to drink. I was very happy with the flavor of this tea and will purchase this brand again when I run out. I normally drink Bigelow tea purchased in the grocery store but as of this writting I have not seen an organic Earl Grey tea in my local grocery stores.Choice Organic Earl Grey Tea + Honey + Organic Milk + Toasted English Mufffin with butter and marmalade = the best breakfast in the world!

It feels like I've tried every Earl Grey tea on the market.  Choice Earl Grey is at the very top of the list.  The Earl Grey flavor is bold, yet not overpowering and is delicious with a little cream and sugar.  Yummy!!
I have been drinking Earl Grey tea for 10+ yrs now and find the Choice tea to be the best. It is strong and flavorful but not bitter (no need to add sugar).
This is the best Earl Grey around and we've tried many plus it's organic! Full flavor black tea with more than a hint of bergamont.
This is a great black tea. I drink lots of teas and taste wise can really tell the difference between many qualities of tea. This is a good one!
Did not like this tea. It smelled so strong right out of the box that I never brewed it. Won't buy it again.

column9: Extremely tasty but very hard to find.
column10: We picked up 3 bottles of this about a month ago at a Winco grocery store in Northern California for $2.00 per bottle.  It is a delicious edition of Heinz Ketchup.  It is rich and tangy, with a not too sweet flavor.  I would recommend this on any hamburger, we had it with sweet potato fries and it was so good.  We even used less of this than we usually do with regular ketchup.  We have actively been looking for this ketchup at all stores we go to and we haven't been able to find it again.  I did read in a magazine that Wal-Mart will be carrying it for a limited time for the same price point that we bought it at.  I also heard a Heinz executive mention it as an upcoming new product, so hopefully it will become more available before it goes away forever.
Save yourself some money and mix ketchup and balsamic yourself!!  Does not even have a balsamic taste. I feel hipped because I was so excited to try this ketchup

I am a frequent traveler and always looking for handy snacks that will fit in small spaces in my laptop bag or purse. I love these cocoa-roasted almonds! They are delicious, with just a hint of cocoa and sweetness, and they are always fresh. Almonds are a great snack, they help keep my hunger under control during those long meetings and training sessions. The only complaint I have is the little bit of cocoa dust that makes the snack a bit messy, although this is a minor annoyance.

This is a little bit of portion control heaven.  These cocoa roast almonds are really a delicious treat in many ways with crunch and a solid deep chocolate and almond taste with just the right amount of sweetness.  The 100-calorie packs take the guesswork out of portioning, and especially if you're watching portions and calories, being able to take a bag and eat the whole thing without guilt can be very satisfying. This is a yummy little snack.

Who knew you could buy the coca roasted almonds in 100 calorie packs! We had purchased these in a large container previously from a big-box store. It was good to find them in 100 calorie packs. This particular product isn't even available in our town; probably not in our part of the world! It was great to find all the 100 calorie products available at Amazon.

I bought some of these at a store.  I love both almonds and dark chocolate.  These are great.  Chocolate is dark and subtle, not overwhelming.  They are a great pick me up without indulging in a lot of empty calories.  Both ingredients are supposed to be healthy. Wish they were organic.

I really thought I was going to love these. My sister loves them and recommended them. So, I bought two packs-(at buy one get one free) and dug in. I was sorely disappointed b/c it tasted really off to me. I flipped the box over and read the ingredients and realized it was the artificial sweeteners. The flavor of the artificial sweeteners was so overpowering to me that I gave the rest of them away.
I can't believe someone finally made a delicious snack I can enjoy and feel good about.  Wonderful combo of almonds and chocolate without excessive calories.  Perfect in the 100 calorie packs!

Who would have guessed that this combination would work, taste so good and satisfying?The concept is so simple. We have been eating all kinds of chocolate impregnated with almonds. Why not the other way around.The size of the packed is not only good for calorie counters but also from a snack stand points its self. Being in individual packages, helps keep and ration it through the workweek.I did try sucking on them and that just does not work as it is the combination that fives the sweetness and fullness to the snack.
These are delicious and amazon's price is great! The batch I got has an expires in July 2013, which I think is very reasonable.
I bought these at wal-mart and loved them. Found this great subscribe and save price but don't understand why all the other flavor varieties are sooooooo expensive here. No really, why?

The Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, 100 Calorie Pack,are a delicious snack and in the 100 calorie pack you are not over doing it..They really help me with portion control and I feel satisfied when I enjoy them!!!  Give them a try!

These almonds taste really good and more important have helped me curb my chocolate cravings.  Love the 100 calorie packs because they help with portion control and there are enough nuts to stave off hunger for 1-2 hours!!

I grabbed these on impulse at the supermarket and fell in love with them. The 100 calorie packs are great to keep in your purse or desk at work for that afternoon slump. You get a fair portion of nuts too! My coworkers tried them and love them too, now we all bring them in. 3 of us in the office are on weight watchers, and the 100 calorie packs are 2 points each, which makes them great for a snack since they have all the good fats we need and keep us on track (otherwise the 3 of us on weight watchers would end up in line at the vending machine looking for something with chocolaty goodness). Highly recommended.

column9: Didn't taste like cocoa to me
column10: If you were to eat these without looking at them, I don't think I would ever guess that cocoa on the nuts.  Some reviews mention sweet, but the bags I tried had zero sweetness, zero cocoa flavor, a strange aftertaste, and I wonder if they were bad.

column9: Near expiration date, and extremely dry
column10: Based on all the five star reviews, I had high hopes for this snack.  But I received a product with an expiration date of Sep 11 (it is June 11 as of this review), and have to say the almonds are just so dry that I really don't like them.I wasn't expecting a luxuriously rich chocolate velvety experience or anything from a 100 calorie snack, but these were pretty bad.  I'm cancelling my subscribe & save, and will enjoy other better tasting 100 calorie snacks.

I have used these many times.  They are a wonderful product.  All you do is push the spikes in the dirt around your plants and it fertilizes and releases insecticide that the plant draws up into it's tissues.  Any bugs, like aphids, that want to chew on your plants are history.  No spraying or mixing and you don't have to worry about applying on a windy day, or trying to get it on the under side of leaves.  I LOVE it.

I bought this product becuase i had a infestation of what I called "gnats", in my plant at work. It is a vine plant, im not really sure the name of it. Anyway, I had lots of little flying bugs that multiplied over the last few months, and after getting a nice warning from my boss, i thought i would get something to save my plant. I threw one of these fertilizer/bug killer sticks into the soil, and within a week or so i am yet to see one. Pretty amazing actually, as I didn't think it would actually work. If the bugs look like gnats, and fly around this product will kill em!You also get 10 of them in the package, which will last quite some time

Because of cold weather, I have to bring my tropical hibiscus plants indoors during winter. Every year, they would get aphids and generally be a big mess. Until I discovered these Bayer pesticide/fertilizer spikes. No more aphids. The plant leaves stay green and healthy-looking. And a bonus -- right now, one of my plants has more than 20 flower buds. It's beautiful.
This product works exactly as advertised.  It takes a few days for the systemic action to get going and begin to be noticeable on the bugs, so don't panic if you don't see results overight.
I really like this product. I grow orchids and scale is a problem. This product breaks the cycle and no more bugs. I highly recommend this product.

I have these oober annoying bugs infesting my plant (a Dragon Tree) that can only be described as "look like gnats" and many people said this product worked for them for the same problem. It is labeled for a very specific bug and did NOT work for whatever it is I have. I'm sure it works for those bugs on the package but not for tiny black flying things. Just so you know.

I have fought mealie bugs on my adenium and hoya for years. One application and wow...no more mealies.My Adenium look the best they ever have! My troubled Hoya is putting out new sprouts. The best thingabout this systemic is 'no mess'. The liquids and granuals always worried me.Just came here to purchase some more.
This systemic insecticide and fertilizer has kept our indoor bouganvilleas free of mealybugs, which have heretofore been an annual midwinter problem problem.

i have 26 african violets, i was losing alot of leaves due to thrips and a few had cyclemen mites. i used these 2in1 fert/pesticide spikes in all of them, and now (3 wks later) i no longer lose any leaves and my violets are now healthy and growing strong. i've tried everything on the market to rid my violets of the pests but nothing worked until now. these spikes are great! but you have to wait for them to work, so don't give up on them, just when i thought they were not working, i saw a big improvement so give them time. i gave them 4 stars because you have to wait for results.

I purchased 2 of these to kill off some white fly I have on 3 hibiscus trees that are now inside my house for the winter.  Four weeks have gone by and no progress.  I even added one more to each pot than what was suggested on the product directions.  There's still plenty of white flies - and I'm extremely disappointed.  Would not recommend.
If you grown ivy indoors or out...this is a must have.  You never have to was off spider mites again!

column9: be warned- you need multiple spikes per plant
column10: I have a rather large container garden outside on my lanai (anywhere from 75-100 pots and planters depending on what I've got growing). Pests *can* be a problem, especially mealybugs. I usually treat with either tons of power misting from the hose (takes care of almost all pests- do it several days in a row and it usually eliminates the problem altogether) or Safer spray products, because I try to be mindful of environmental factors. Plus we live right on a bay and we've got three cats who roam the lanai and a bunch of tiny lizards and frogs that live *in* and among the plants.However, every so often the pests get out of control (mealybugs.... ARGH) and the eco-friendly options don't do anything, and instead of tossing ten plants, I have to get something stronger. I like these Bayer spikes because I can control the application. I like that they are buried in the soil and treat from the inside out. I also can control how much water I give the plant after the spike has been buried, so that there's no runoff. It's a VERY controlled pest control solution.However, unless you are growing plants in pots the size of teacups, you will need multiple spikes per plant. I can usually treat about 2-3 plants per pack, which isn't really a great bargain. However, if you have an infestation on a prized plant, this might be a good option instead of dousing the plant with liquid chemicals or pouring in gradules on the surface of the soil, which will likely be run off when you water.So be aware you won't get much use from one pack, and there are much safer options, but if you are looking for a controlled way to kill pests from the INSIDE and not be applying toxic chemicals to the surface of the plant and soil and area surrounding, this is a great option.
I have little flies all over my plants.  I used the whole package on 3 plants and the flies are now worse then ever.  This stuff just does not work.

I would not recommend this product.  It takes a long time to dissolve into the soil, and even then I don't think it does so evenly at all, not enough so to be effective.  I dont like the fact that it has fertilizer in it also, as this will complicate any feeding regimen you're giving your plant already, and will persist in the soil for a while.  Long and short of it is these don't really work.  I would recommend [...]details as a solution over these.  I had soil gnats like a m** f** and if anyone has had the same, they know its not fun, pleasant, or anything similar.  After applying the one linked and watering well, there were one or two stray gnats within two days, and none within a week.

I originally bought this for a lemon tree that was being over run with ants and aphids.  I discovered that the product is not designed for fruit or vegetables that people eat.  I think the manufacturer could have done a better job with the labeling, as I learned this only after contacting Bayer.  I did use two packages on a large hibiscus bush that had the same problem, and the spikes seem to have eliminated the infestation. If the labeling was better and more specific regarding safety for humans, definitely 5 stars.
Works really well for indoor plants.  I used to have fungus gnats and they don't exist anymore.  It is a great product.

column9: early results suggest this is going to work!!
column10: after a couple of weeks the infected plant seems to be recovering.  Too early for a definite answer .

Bayer Plant spikes have solved my problem with white flies on my hibiscus plants. I have quite a few plants which I bring in for the winter and in the past--ugh pests everywhere and nothing seemed to help. I just use as directed. The fertilizer is good too.

column9: Best solution for "scales" on Sago palms
column10: We have a sago palm. In Florida these palms are getting killed by an insect called scales. These spikes we believe saved the palm.

This stuff worked to kill mealy bugs on my hibiscus and some spider mites I have on another plant. I could use a much larger size for all my plant that I have to bring in for the winter to protect them from the dreaded gnats that they get in the winter inside.

I am always skeptical about the claims of most products.  However, I noticed very little insect action after I inserted the Bayer tablets as instructed. The bites on the leaves all but disappeared. I cannot attest for the growth as much but the insect/bug claim works.
Easy to use.  Had no problems with this product. I used it on potted plants. I will purchase this again.

column9: Fertilizer works but wont control white flies!
column10: I bought several of these fertilizer/pesticide stakes and was mildly disappointed in the product. Our garden has been over run by white flies lately and after reading these could kill them I bought 3 packages and followed the directions in placing the stakes in my pots. The product comes with a bunch of stakes and an applicator to place the stakes in your soil. Simple enough so I added 4 stakes to each pot. After a few days the plants looked greener from the fertilizer but the white flies were still out of hand.After a week the flies were still there in great numbers so I applied another 2 stakes to each pot. Fast forward 3 weeks and the flies were still out of control.  As a fertilizer they work well but in my experience the have no effect on white flies which is unfortunate because it says right on the labelling that it kills them...For the price I think you are better off looking at other options.

column9: Effective but may need repeated application
column10: I had some insects in the soil that were eventually killed, but it took replacing the spikes a few times to get rid of all of them. If you catch the insects sooner than I did, they might work in a single application. Keep in mind that the process is slow, unlike a spray, since the insecticide has to spread through the soil and the plant to work.If your household has children, you might want to be careful with keeping these out of reach, as the spikes resemble large tablets, and they can be dispensed easily by pressing them through the foil backing.
This product works wonder.  After a week or two of inserting thestakes into the ground by the hedges, we started to noticea film of dead whiteflies on the top of our pool.
Does a great job. Takes care of the insects and black spot. Easy to use. Would buy again. Works as adverised.

column9: Really Great Tasting Green Curry! Highly Recommended!
column10: We love Thai food and was thrilled to find Maesri Thai Green Curry. This curry is great tasting, authentically flavored, and fairly hot. We like that it comes in a paste as it easy use in our cooking.Highly recommended! You might also want to try Maesri Thai red curry - 4 oz x 2 cans.

The variety pack containing 24 bars were a good buy. The candy were a true mixture of almond joys and mounds, including being regular size and most of all they were fresh. The candy came packed inside a tightly sealed bag and boxed securely.Again, a good purchase!

column9: Black Tiger, works 60% of the time, all the time
column10: I knew this was going to be strong going into it. I mean its named Black Tiger. It delivers. I had to purchase another weaker set of K-cups to drink after my initial blast. Its strong, but not that nasty burnt flavor that you can sometimes get.

column9: Perfect Combination of Smooth and Dark
column10: I'm really glad I gave this flavor a try. Like other Coffee People blends, Black Tiger is spicy and a full of flavor. It is a bit darker than the Donut House blend - which I guess you'd expect - but it is also, ironically, a lot smoother as you drink it. I've really begun to enjoy Coffee People's products because they're really tasty without being overwhelming like, say, Starbucks.
My husband loves this coffee. He had been searching for something very bold, and this does the job! I love that I can use it to make iced coffee, and it still has a great taste- not watered down!

My husband loves strong coffee so he loves Black Tiger. I was able to order it when it was subscribe and save so its very convenient. I wish Amazon would have other options for automatic shipments though. With this product you can estimate when you will need more very easily. The only other subscribe and save kcups available are made with "instant coffee" and they are horrible :(

Black Tiger is by far the best coffee I have ever tasted(for Keurig machines). We have a keurig machine at work and Black Tiger is the only flavor I will drink now that we ordered it by chance when an older flavor was no longer being made. Black Tiger actually tastes like coffee should. I had, up until I tasted this, thought that the keurig was unable of brewing a decent cup of coffee but thanks to Black Tiger now I have something to look forward to when I want a cup of coffee at work.

Do not read on if you never liked the taste of Starbucks coffee as it used to be.I did, but stopped drinking it after they changed the recipe.Therefore, THANK GOODNESS for Black Tiger.  It has a deep, rich, bold coffee taste that is the best.  We've tried Green Mountain Black Magic, and that's good, but this is better.  Bottoms up!I get it on a subscription from Amazon, which makes it real easy, too.

I enjoy this coffee very much.  I typically drink one or two cups a day as i work from my home office.  It has a rich and pleasant flavor, but is not bitter or offensive in any way.  It strikes the perfect balance for me.  Its dissapointing that amazon no longer offers subscribe and save on this product for new orders, but it is still economical in the 50 pack.  This company is owned by green mountain, hopefully they keep this brand going strong!  My wife prefers the less strong, but equally smooth, donut shop which serves as my backup when i am out.
finally a good cup of coffee from the k-cup,it bold but not bitter . the amazon price is good and coffee people product is great

I love this coffee and the fast that it's on subscribe and save. What I hate is the "frustration free" packaging. More often than not I receive crushed, open K cups and coffee ground are all in the bottom of the box. The last time I received it, I got my crushed K cups and the crushed original box folded up all inside another box. When you notify Amazon that 1/5th of your product was ruined they don't offer to make it right, either. It's almost better to order directly from Keurig. Amazon isn't that much cheap and Keurig offers automatic shipments, also.

column9: Coffee People's Black Tiger K-cup wins my personal taste test.
column10: This is my favorite K-Cup coffee and I can get is at Amazon! I love my Kuerig, but many K-cup products don't seem to have any depth. Black Tiger is bold without being bitter or harsh. Hats off to the Coffee People.

I was accustomed to some of the lesser "dark" or "bold" K-cup flavors and the first time i tried this I actually didn't like it, but powered through it because it was part of my breakfast.  Once I got past the initial shock of how unique the flavor is though, I have grown to like it.  don't get this if you don't like very strong or bold coffee unless you want to put half your cup full of cream/milk.  If you're a little adventurous, I recommend.

I have no problems with the delivery of the coffee, nor the price.  It is cheaper to buy 50 k-cups than to buy the 80 count thru Green Mountain.  However, the coffee just is not that good.  It lacks a cripness in its taste.
I have been trying different types for a while now and think I am going to finally stick with one.  It is a strong coffee but it is not bitter.  Just a rich and smooth cup of dark coffee....perfect!
Very popular in our family.  A tasty, bold coffee experience.  If you love a similar experience, I recommend that you order Black Tiger.

column9: Coffee good but not great--- k-cup quality awful
column10: Opinions on coffee, like those on most food or drink are subjective. On coffee quality only, I would give this product 4 stars... like I said, "good, but not great".On the other hand, the quality of the K-Cups is a very objective item. I purchased my first (and last) box of the "Coffee People" cups after Amazon discontinued the "Subscribe and Save" on the Timothy's Parisian Nights K-Cups, in April of 2011.I provided Amazon with direct feedback that this product is substandard, and also noticed that many of the poor reviews of this product were from customers complaining of leaky or otherwise badly constructed k-cups. Some of these reviews were from over 1 year ago. (Shame on me for not catching this  prior to choosing this product.)....My advice, don't buy this brand... the bad cups will end up costing you more than what it would cost to buy KCups at your local grocer.

When Amazon recommended this in place of the coffee subscription we wanted to order, we were suspicious.  However, the coffee is very tasty, with a full, rich flavor.  Moreover, after three boxes, we haven't had an mis-assembled or leaking K-cups, like we had been getting with our other brand.K
This is my breakfast coffee of choice.  Satifying, deep rich flavor gets the day started with a little oomph.  Two cups and I am ready to face the working world.

column9: Starbucks Lover that hates coffee prep hassle Purchased From Amazon
column10: I have sampled most of the K- Cups.  During that process my husband and myself almost went back to a French Press.  Obviously using a single serve machine is the easiest way to brew and enjoy coffee.  After reading the reviews, we tried Black Tiger and knew we had found the right flavor for us.  It has a bold robust flavor without the bitterness.  It is comparable to Starbucks "Pike".  Everyone that uses a single serve brewer knows that it is the most expensive way to enjoy coffee.  Combine the ease with the perfect smoothness of Bold Tiger and you cannot go wrong.

column9: It's alright, but a bit overroasted
column10: I bought black tiger, jet fuel, and wake-up call.  Wake-up call was the best of the three.  Black tiger is an attempt at making a dark roasted bold flavor coffee.  I felt like the acid finish was too much, and the coffee was over roasted tasting.  Jet fuel is very similar with less acid finish, wake up call is again similiar and I would give it 3.5 stars if I could.We are relative novices when it comes to K-Cups, Prior to receiving the Keurigg we used a percolator and it still makes the best coffee in my opinion.  As a refernce point, we enjoyed Starbucks Komodo Dragon, and Cafe Verona.  We also enjoyed Dunkin Donuts coffee on the less expensive end.
I purchased this coffee for my husband, he likes a bold cup of coffee.Excellant choice great taste.

This coffee is tasty but I am a dark coffee lover and it wasn't strong enough for me. So if your looking for something medium to light with good flavor this is your coffee, if not I would try something else.

We have tried several different kinds of K-cups, including Jet Fuel and Wake Up Call.  Black Tiger is by far the best if you're looking for a rich, smooth and bold brew.  Jet Fuel and Wake Up Call are great but they have a slight bitterness to them, unlike Black Tiger.  Give it a try, it's yummy!  I only wish Amazon would put it back on Subscribe and Save...
This is nice strong cup of coffee, it is similar to dark magic execept it had a bitter beginning but finishes smooth.

column4: ROBERT A. SANTA MARIA "human book worm"
column10: I gave this gift out to friends and they liked it very much.The Keurig system is one of the best "fast" coffee makers and these Coffee People pods are the best value for the money!I highly recommend Coffee People products as I have tried several of their pods and have yet to be disappointed.

We have tried many kcups for our keurig.  We like black tiger, kona , jet fuel and french roast.  All dark extra bold coffee except Kona which is just extra bold.  Black tiger has little after taste and a rich flavor for a great Price.
I've had a keurig Coffee Maker for 3 years . I've tried many different types and brands of coffee and keep coming back to Coffee People's Black Tiger. Great tasting coffee. I love it !!!!

I was looking to replace my depleted store of Coffee People Jet Fuel, but it was back ordered.  One of the reviewers suggested that Black Tiger was a similar cup of coffee, so I bit.  Black Tiger has a rich and powerful flavor that lingers and seems to have more substance in the mouth than most others.  It also holds up very well when brewed at the 10 ounce setting.  I love this coffee but wouldn't recommend it or serve it to someone who prefers a daintier experience.
Coffee people black tiger coffee is yet again another great blend of coffee for the Keurig machine.  I put this on my subscribe and save list.

I love this coffee -- I haven't been able to find a K-cup that tasted strong enough for me until now.Unfortunately, the two recent price hikes (totaling about a 40% increase in three months) have made this too expensive for what it is, so I'm only giving the product three stars.I'm back to grinding my own coffee for now; it's strong enough, but more hassle.
If you like a stronger coffee, this is it.  Tried Jet Fuel, Emeril, Kona (bold) and we're sticking with this one.  On auto delivery for Black Tiger.

I love Starbucks coffee, especially their strong ones. I wish they would make it for this machine. I have found the Black Tiger the closest to what I like. Slightly bitter taste stll not the same as Starbucks but the best K cup that comes close.

First, you have to like real, bold coffee (which I do) to like this coffee. If you like this coffee, also try Jet Fuel, Organic, and Wake Up Call. Each of these is similar but have slightly different tastes. I like to buy them in boxes of 50 using automatic delivery (can't beat the price that way).The coffee tastes great. I would classify it as bold/extra bold. I gave it 5 stars, and I continue to buy it along with the others that I mentioned.
Its ok.  I use it to make iced latte drinks, but I would not be able to drink it as a cup of regular hot coffee.  Black Tiger has a bitter aftertaste, so I like Jet Fuel better.

column9: Put a Tiger in your Tank
column10: If you like dark roast coffees this is for you.  Nothing goes better in the AM then Black Tiger.

I am so glad I paid more attention to the positive reviews for this than to the negative ones.  I wasn't sure what to expect when I first started brewing it because it is SO black, but it turned out incredible.  It is so rich, it feels creamy on the palate.  No bitterness at all, only fullness.  I do have to say that when I first started trying several different coffees, I wasn't giving each brew it's rightful place.  By this, I mean I was making the mistake of adding the same cream and sugar for each kind and you can not do that!  If you drink it black, which I don't, then this wouldn't matter but if you add cream and sugar the amount you add for each kind of coffee will be different.  Every coffee has a certain amount or lack of sweetness on it's own and if you add the same sugar to it, you will ruin that brew.  I start each cup with just about 1/2 tsp. and then work up to another pinch if I need it according the the taste of that coffee.  This one needed very little sugar and a little more cream than for some kinds.  It is different with each cup.  Once I figured this out, they are all unique in their own right.  I imagine as time goes on there will be one I don't like and can't "adjust to suit my taste", but I haven't found it yet!  Loving my Keurig and the deal on these K-cups!

I tried this because of a review I read. I wanted to try something different. The first time I tried the coffee I wasnt sure that I even liked it. A little sharp but full bodied. Well after the 3rd or 4th cup that changed, it has become my favorite coffee. I dont know why I didnt like it to begin with, but now I actually think about having another cup and I am usually a 1 cup person - most of the time I get the second cup. I highly recommend this coffee. My wife drinks the Donut Shop and I have the Black Tiger. Not bitter, just full flavored and smooth, I add cream and sugar to mine.

column9: Not jet fuel but very strong
column10: Big fab of coffee people. Love jet fuel and donut shop. Decide to try a new blend. Black tiger is just atad bit too acidic for me. It's strong as sh-t, don't get me wrong , but I am intimidated to drink it in the am. Big coffee!

I've tried many different brands, flavors and strengths of K-Cups in my search for a perfect cup of coffee.  Coffee People Black Tiger is the right balance of strength, low acidity and nutty flavor that I was looking for.  We receive our coffee on an Amazon subscription basis and have been very happy with this coffee.  I also really like the frustration-free packaging, which amounts to 50 loose K-Cups in a box.
For those who like a nice bold cup of coffee, Black Tiger is the way to go. It's mello and smooth but still strong enough so that you know you're drinking coffee. I love this coffee.
I find this coffee to be the strongest and that is what I need to wake up in the am.

column9: My favorite of the Coffee People
column10: This is my favorite of all the Coffee People coffees. It is strong but doesn't taste burnt.  It holds up very well with the largest cup size.  My wife, who generally prefers the flavored coffees, has decided this is her favorite as well.Not much to say about the "frustration-free packaging".  The size of the box is small enough to throw in a cabinet, but obviously won't be convenient on the counter.  Having the keurig rack next to coffee maker makes this a no brainer. Keurig 5071 K-Cup Carousel Tower
I love my coffee bold and black and this one has become my new favorite! A terrifically rich, bold taste that's sure to get you going in the morning. I love it! A great price, too.
Received a box of the Tiger K-cup and shared with my co-workers.  We all really like it.  Has a great flavor and the K-cups are very decorative.

This coffee has become my morning go to cup. It's nearly perfect! Bold but not overpowering with an excellent taste! With subscribe and save, it's also a good bargain! In general, I like all of the Coffee People k=cups (Wake Up Call, Donut Shop, Kona) that I've tried, but this is the best! I didn't give it a five because I've never had a "perfect" cup of coffee, although I imagine that this is pretty darn close!

I've had a keurig coffee maker for over 2 years now and have probably tried over 30 ro 40 different types of coffee.  Some are better than other butso far I've never had one that I didn't enjoy.  I like bold coffee and my advise is to try as many different coffees that you can from any maker

I have tried all the kcups and i guess you could call me a coffee snob!!! When i drink a cup of coffee, i want it to have a punch..after years of trying all brands, i finally found a grrrrrrrrrrrrrreat cup of coffee...BLACK TIGER!!! It is strong, but not bitter. Its taking years...but i finally found it..You must try BLACK TIGER.
I don't like most of the Keurig pods because they aren't full bodied or strong enough for me.  Black Tiger allow me to enjoy K-cup convenience and tolerate the coffee it produces
My wife loves this bold flavor and we can get a good 1.5 cup of coffee from a single K-cup.
Very good coffee. This is #2 after Jet Fuel. Have it on my scheduled monthly delivery. This is a great deal and wonderful service from Amazon.
I have been a fan of Seattle's Best 6th Avenue Bistro and found Black Tiger to have similar characteristics in a Keurig pod.  Great flavor, bold, yet smooth.  Good wake up coffee.

My go to coffee has been Jet Fuel for a while now but I like a change.  I tried Black Tiger and I have found my new favorite.  I like strong, dark coffees and Black Tiger is as smooth as I have had.  For a puurrrrfect cup, Black Tiger is it!  Heh

I love the K-cup Black Tiger. Much better than Newman's or any of the others.  Next time, I will try the jet fuel but have no regrets for the Black Tiger. Really like the box opening.  Featherman

It is coffee with rich earthy flavors and mild acid finish in excellent balance. A little early morning time alone with a cup of fresh brewed black tiger K-cup is what makes the start of the day a real treat for me. Sweet! I found Black Tiger in the display or coffees at my car dealer while I was waiting for my car and tried a cup. It was fantastic; just the right blend of acidity and richness in a coffee with a good punch. I came home and ordered some for myself and, while I keep trying different K-Cups, I keep going back to the Tiger.

NOTE: This is a review of this coffee in the K-cup format, not of Amazon's packaging.  However, I have never had trouble with the Frustration-free packaging; I simply cannot comment in this case.Reviewer's preferences: Strong, medium-dark roast coffees, mid-to-heavily sweetened with whole milk (4:1 ratio or a little heavier toward the coffee side).  I occasionally add a hint of vanilla syrup and cream or half-and-half if a coffee is overly bitter.I picked up this coffee in a large sampler box of Coffee People "Extra Bold" K-cups, which I have just finished off.  The collection contained the following blends/coffees: Wake-up Call, Jet Fuel, Black Tiger, and Organic.  I have had each coffee multiple times.  From the four, I give the Organic blend the top spot with a slight edge over Black Tiger (we're talking 9.1/10 over 9.0/10 here).  Both the Black Tiger and Organic were strong and bold in flavor but not too bitter, while the Wake-up Call tended to be a little more harsh on the palate.  The Jet Fuel blend was appropriately named, as it almost always required a little vanilla and more milk or even heavy cream to make it palatable.Qualities of Coffee People Black Tiger blend:Strong, medium-to-heavy dark coffee flavor (think bold Columbian or Italian roast strength) with a rich aroma and barely-there nutty note.  Bitterness on the mild end, a little above most medium roast coffees, but still pleasant.  Mild-to-medium acidity (mellow), with no sourness of note and a slightly nutty or even earthy flavor.  Flavor envelops the entire mouth, but rarely overwhelms the palate.  Substantial body, but not heavy or syrupy.  Takes to sweeteners and milk/cream well without disappearing or losing nuance.  Very good bold coffee, with a distinguishable flavor profile but still primarily made up of the familiar flavors unique to coffee.

column9: Ok, but not the best I've tasted
column10: Black Tiger makes a good cup of coffee, but not great.  It's got a bit of a bite and could be a little smoother.  I really enjoy a rich, robust coffee and was hoping for that according to the name--just a bit disappointed.  I have found Timothy's Rainforest Extra Bold Espresso K-Cup a much more satisfying cup.  The 50 pack in the simple brown box, though, is a great idea--there's enough waste with the K-cups that the simpler the outer packaging, the better.
Very bold flavor, without being bitter.  Perfect for morning or after dinner.  The bulk packaging works for me, and the price is the lowest regular price I've been able to find.

Raised in TX but very near S. LA, I love a really strong cup of coffee.  Coffee People win out over all other brands.  The others have some great coffees but overall, Coffee People don't make a really bad K-Cup.  I have no idea what they do differently but they don't have all that sour aftertaste or acidity.  I hate that and for me, it's prevalent in most of Grn Mtn coffees.  My fav of all the Coffee People is a difficult choice but I do love Black Tiger and Jet Fuel.  I keep both all the time.  They are similar but Jet Fuel has a bit of smokey end note and Black Tiger is a bit smoother with no smokey taste.  Love Coffee People.

I like bold coffee, which this was promoted as a bold, dark brew. I've had better but this isn't bad. It has a dark roast flavor that really attacks the palette, leaving a slightly bitter aftertaste, which I don't really care for. I'm glad I tried it and I have enjoyed it as my morning brew but I probably wouldn't order another box. I have also experienced some of the kcups leaking during the brewing, spreading dark, hot coffee with the grounds all over and down the front of the brewer leaving an absolute mess. It's bad enough for this to happen once in awhile, but this has happened three times and I'm not even half-way through the box (BTW, Amazon's frustration-free packaging is really great!). I see what is happening is that the foil on the top of the cup breaks loose allowing the coffee to be forced out over the top. Now, I must look over each KCup very carefully before I use it. Maybe I just got a bad batch but I can't wait for it to be gone.UPDATE. I separated out the cups that look like they might explode. Of the 28 kcups left, 17 (over half) looked like they would fail. I was right on all but 4 of them! With this batch of 50 kcups, nearly half of them failed during the brewing process. This is by far the worst batch of KCups I have ever used. I will definitely, never, ever, buy these again.

Therefore, I chose not to run this risk and wasted half of this box.  Normally, on my regular shipments I have never had this happen and I am always completely satisfied.

This is the 6th box of the Black Tiger K cups that we've received and while the coffee is still fabulous, the seals on this box of K cups were defective.  Atleast 10 of the box of 50 were unusable, as without a tight seal, the water and ground will overflow the k cup to spill all over your counter.  The cost of these skyrocket when fully 20% of the order is defective.This has only happened with one box so far and I am hoping it is a one-time occurence.

I have long been a fan of Black Tiger coffee - K-cups; however, upon receipt of this particular item, I found many "bloated" k-cups with the seal pulling away from the edge of the cup. I gave a couple of them a try, only to find overflowing coffee and what little went into my cup had coffee grounds in it. I'm not sure if the "frustration-free" packaging was the cause or this batch was just mishandled - another order I had was packaged normally - 25 cups per box, and those K-cups were normal.

Having tried several of the K-Cup coffees available I keep coming back to Black Tiger. I like my coffee black, bold and strong, with a rich full flavor. This really delivers better than the others. It is smoother and richer than Jet Fuel, coming as close, so far as I've been able to get to, a quad Americano at Starbucks. Oh, and packaged in the Amazon packaging at .42 per Kup its a pretty good deal with less cardboard to dispose of.

I really like this coffee, I put it on auto ship! I use to be a Folgers drinker, coffee maker, coffee filters, measuring etc..Keurig is GREAT! I have ordered most of my k-cups from Amazon, so far I have liked everyone. I think this black tiger may be the favorite so far. It has a strong flavor which I love. I set my cup size to the biggest cup, add one mini moo and two sweet-n-lows. I love it.
I added Black Tiger to my selection at home and it's become a favorite!  I'll be ordering more!

I had never tried Black Tiger coffee before purchasing this, which struck me as a little odd while I was waiting for it.  I mean really, who buys a 50 pack of coffee they have no idea if they like?  But fortunately, it turned out very well.  This is some of the best coffee I have had in K-cups, and will definitely be something I will purchase again in the future.  The frustration free packaging was great, too.  I love that I didn't have to fool with the flimsy cardboard packaging that K-cups usually come in.

Although the coffee itself was very good - great, even - EVERY cup I brewed had a tremendous amount of coffee grounds! I don't have this problem with any other brand of coffee I use in my Keurig. I'm cancelling my subscription. What a shame! Like I said, the flavor was great, but not enough so to deal with a mouth full of grounds with every cup.
For me this is a good strong cup (9.25 ounce) that is smooth and NOT bitter like a French roast. Another contender for my first cup in the morning is Jet Fuel.
I love a bold coffee, and Black Tiger definitely delivers. It's one that I intend to keep in my private stock from now on.
A wonderful full body taste. Great price on 50 poack.A must for the coffee lover.

column9: just what I was looking for...
column10: I got the Keurig coffeemaker for Christmas.  Was skeptical that it could brew a cup of coffee strong enough for my taste.  After trying all the k-cup samples that came with the maker I decided that the extra bold k-cups were strong, but not quite what I was looking for.  Started reading reviews and decided on Black Tiger.  Found what I was looking for.  Great taste, not bitter, strong enough for me (the largest size brew is not strong enough, but the next size down is perfect).  Highly recommend this k-cup.

column9: Excellent dark flavor with a smooth, silky feel.
column10: If you love the rich taste of a good cup of espresso or french brew and the smooth, silky feel they leave behind on your tongue, this is the K-cup for you. While it doesn't have the full-blown flavor of espresso, this is a nice dark, rich coffee that really comes across as freshly ground and brewed. I love my Keurig  for and the convenience it provides, and I've tried quite a few different K-cups, including Coffee People's Jet Fuel (good, but not as good as this) and Newman's Extra Bold (no way nearly as good as this), and this is the first one that has made me want to go back and brew another cup and another. It's really that good.

I have ordered Black Tiger many times, but this last shipment was horrible!  Something definitely changed with this batch, besides the cup color.  This batch had a harsh chemical taste and was very bitter. It was undrinkable. I thought maybe it was just one k-cup, but after a few the same, I returned the product and cancelled my subscription.  This was my favorite type with Donut Shop a second. Now Donut Shop will be my everyday K-Cup.  Hope they don't mess with that one too.

I bought this based on the other favorable reviews.  I find it is just about right for flavor and strength.  While not being the strongest coffee I have ever tried with my Keurig brewer, it makes a decent cup of coffee.  I also tried Tree Hugger and find it is a bit stronger and you can even run it through almost a second time to get another small serving or a warm up out of it.  So, if you are looking for a bit stronger coffee try the Tree Hugger.  Santa's Buzz is also a good choice.  I will most likely buy the Black Tiger again at some point but I like to try different ones for variety.

column9: Great for those who love strong coffee
column10: I love extra bold, dark roasted coffee, and Black Tiger is one of my favorites. Nice, deep flavor with just a tiny bite to it. I'm also a fan of the new "frustration free" packaging...never did like the regular K-cup boxes with their perforated openings. The new packaging is just a plain old box, which I think is much easier to store and use.

I bought this because it was on sale.  I had never had it and thought that if I didn't like it I would take it to work.  They will drink anything!  I love this coffee.  It is strong but not bitter.  At times I will double pump it and it still retains a strong taste the second time.  This has become my favorite coffee.

Buy it with the subscription, you'll save a few bucks, and you can stop any time.As others said, a bit bitter, but I like it. I often get two cups right away from a k-cup. Makes a large coffee  with good strength.

I agree that Black Tiger and Jet Fuel are strong and perhaps (to some people)bitter.  If you prefer light or medium blends, these are not for you.  But if you like strong coffee, these are the best on the market.

I read the reviews about this being a *really* strong cup of coffee and bought it for that exact reason.  Maybe I got a box of wonky pods, but it wasn't nearly as strong as I was hoping for.  I'll stick with the Wake-Up Call or the Jet Fuel - I think both have a darker and more intense flavor.The frustration-free packaging is great...I'm so glad this is being offered now.  Every month I'd gripe to my husband about the ridiculousness of two separate boxes of coffee pods wrapped in plastic, padded with more plastic and then placed inside another gigantic box.  Thumbs up to the much simpler and greener packaging of just one little box.
50 cups for 50$ = a buck a cupthe 24 count box is <18 buckson the Keurig site as a club member about 15 buck for 24this is a ripoff!

Purchased this coffee after reading many reviews about being bold, etc.  I also Purchased "Jet Fuel" also by coffee people.  Bottom line - Black tiger does not live up to its name.  It has a "mainstream" flavor similar to the big brands you find in a grocery store.  No comparison to high quality coffee.  If you have a choice between this and Jet Fuel go for Jet Fuel.  Bold and pleasant without the astringent bite of black Tiger.
This is really strong and really delicious coffee.  I usually dont like strong coffee but this is great and really gets me going in the morning.  I would purchase this again.

I have been purchasing this product for years, along with some of the other Coffee People extra bold flavors, such as Jet Fuel and the Organic option. For me, they are the best K Cups around for bold and deep flavor; also, the 50 count packaging is convenient. However, as the demand and popularity have been increasing, so has the price.  It, and others are no longer available for subscription as well. Therefore, I have been looking into substitutions. I still purchase 50 count Jet Fuel since the it is still available for around $30.00.
Good coffee. Tastes good and is consistent.  It's nice that it's in bulk. I wish I could get a variety pack like this, though.
Pretty good coffee. Best I think for keurig. Not as rich as I would like, but two pods on smallest pour is decent.

Black Tiger has a very nice, full flavor without pronounced acidity. Newman's Own medium kinda, sorta approaches this but with that edgy bite (as sold at warehouse stores, $$ cheaper). I drink the Black Tiger at a cup or two a day, and the cheaper Newman's otherwise.HOWEVER!!! My latest shipment came in with only 32 K-Cups in the box NOT 50! Made this an even more expensive purchase. Grunt. I must say that Amazon was really, REALLY great on another subscription purchase that was messed up in shipment. So I "complained" on packaging feedback - hopefully that works.(In all my years shopping Amazon, this is only the second foul-up. I love Prime and subscriptions. Yay for Amazon!)

column9: Strong rich flavors in dark roast
column10: First off this coffee has got a great logo on the cap.  How can anybody resist a cup of Black Tiger???  Seriously though, this makes a great cup.  Very dark and rich without being too bitter.  Makes for an excellent large mug of morning coffee.  We've got this one on our re-order list and pick it up every month or so.Well worth it for those who enjoy a strong cup.
pleasant bold tasting, a nice change...would purchase again someday as I change coffees frequently...great packaging and value...enjoy your mornings with a cup of Black Tiger....
This is a really strong wonderful coffee, not bitter in any way. It's the only one we drink now. Great product.

column9: Strong and rich! Without a bitter aftertaste
column10: I LOVE strong coffee but most strong blends have a bitter aftertaste. This is an excellent cup. Not for the faint of heart ;)
Coffee People Black Tiger K-Cup is a really good coffee. Bold but a bitter bold. After trying a k-cup bold sampler Black Tiger is the 1st 50 pack I ordered.
Good product reasonable fast shipping dependable will buy again its nice to get a box full since they are vac packet they last along time and remain fresh

I love the Keurig machine. Green Mountain Coffee sells most of the K-cups, especially in stores but there is not usually good strong coffee. I love Black Tiger and Jet Fuel. On 60 Minutes, the billionaire owner of GMC said they make no money on the machine itself, that they in effect give it away. What!? At its price I hardly call it a gift. He makes money on the K-cups so I'm happy to buy NON-GMC coffee.

This coffee is okay but it's not my favorite. I ordered it because others left reviews saying that there wasn't a bitter taste but I find that there is a slight bitter taste and I really like smooth coffee so I may be more of a critic when it comes to coffee.
This Tiger coffee was new taste for us but has turned out to be one of our favorites. Coffee was priced right, shipped fast and we will use this vendor again.
Ok coffee. Nothing special. Too smooth and un-interesting for me. I really love the Lake and Lodge, newman's extra bold, dark magic, and kona extra bold, in case you were needing a reference point.

column9: I'm hooked, been hooked, it's what I drink.
column10: I started drinking this about 20 years ago on trips to Portland, but then Coffee People sold off all of the corner stores to the Big Guy except the ones in the airport. So now whenever I visit family and friends, I pick up a few pounds of beans for them. Amazon keeps me happy with the Black Tiger K-Cups.
Love that tiger!  Perfect for opening your eyes in the morning or giving you that EYE OF THE TIGER on extra tough days.  Highly recommend this to anyone who likes their coffee bold and dark!

Black Tiger coffee ROCKS!!!  The name says it all.  Strong, dark and fierce!!  Anyone that truly appreciates an extra bold/super dark roast in the morning, this one is for you!!!!  This one's got all that you could desire in a "k-cup" o'coffee and never leaves a bitter after taste.  LOVE IT!!  STRONGLY RECOMMEND!!
If you like strong, dark coffee, with a bold aroma you'll love Black Tiger.  This and Emeril's Big Easy Bold are two of my favorite dark coffees.
Love Coffee People and this is great coffee. I keep ordering more because it is sooo good. Nice roast and smooth enough to drink every day.

Black Tiger was my third Coffee People flavor after trying Donut Shop and Jet Fuel. Donut Shop is a bit weak for me and Jet Fuel was too strong, so I hoped this would be the perfect strength. The strength is right on, but this flavor has an overly bitter taste that really turns me off. It is drinkable, but I think I'll be going back to Donut Shop (which is super smooth) for my next order.

This easily moves to my top 3 favorite k-cups, along with the Puck Sumatran and Puck Columbian. This is a very fresh tasting, wonderfully smokey dark roast. For those who may not know, even though a dark roast has a stronger flavor, it has less caffeine than regular roasts as the beans are roasted longer. The aftertaste is smooth, earthy, and smokey, no bitterness at all. I'd say its the best aftertaste of any k-cup so far. Highly recommend!

I found these cups to have a smooth, surprisingly powerful taste.  They make a great addition to the other dark, bold roasts I tend to favor, but seem to be a little less bitter than some.  Overall, very enjoyable coffee.

We have a ton of different k-cups at work and Black Tiger continues to be my favorite. It's strong but is smoother than jet fuel or wake up call. I have gotten tired of the coffee house flavor and much prefer this.

The coffee is as strong as advertised and reviewed however the grind seems to be too fine.  The commuter mug setting produces a 1/2 cup of coffee and the pod is full of water.  When used with other coffees and teas the Keurig produces the expected volumes so it's not my machine.

Coffee was priced perfectly as well as being delicious. Order came in time and I even counted all of my k-cups out and was given the exact amount. I was very happy with this bold, fresh coffee as well as the arrival of my shipment.

column9: Great coffee, but got a mixed box
column10: Black Tiger K-cup is my daily coffee. I love it.  I also like the minimized packaging.  However my latest order(box of 50)contained half Black Tiger and half Coffee People Donut Shop. Not what I ordered.  I was tempted to return the shipment, but that would have left me without my Black Tiger.  So, I'll give the Donut Shop a try, and come back and add a review.  If a mixed shipment is sent in future I'll not only return it, but seriously consider ending Amazon as my go to source for K-cups.

column9: Coffee that will Wake Up Your Senses!
column10: If you like your coffee dark, rich, and with a kick then you will like Black Tiger K-Cups.  We can't say enough about how good this coffee is.  Thanks Coffee People for producing a coffee with such great flavor and thank you Amazon for making this coffee available in the Brewers Pack of 50 K-Cups.

I just love my Keurig but supplying the coffee was getting pretty expensive. Based on other reviews I took a chance and bought the Black Tiger k-cups for a terrific price.They were better than good. In fact, I will be buying them again and have recommended them to friends and family. A rich, bold coffee but not too strong nor bitter. Excellent!
Love the bold taste to make a bigger cup from the machine taste like coffee I am used to.  Other normal coffee i have bought tastes weak.  Not this one.  I love Jet Fuel too.
I really enjoy this coffee! It is strong and yet is not bitter. I look forward to my morning and my little "pick me up"  that I get from Black Tiger.
Black Tiger K cups are just the right strength, robust and earthy. They deliver the burst of coffee that I need in the morning.

Everyone in our office loves this coffee. We're all very visual, so the bright color of the package draws us in as well -- a sad reason (initially) to buy coffee, but indeed, Black Tiger is delicious.

I was looking for some good mints with a cheap price when I found these. About 2c per tic tac (24 packs x 37 per pack = 888 pieces / $18 = 0.02027c), it is cheaper than the Big Packs and virtually every other mint product. On the package, it said to be sold by Oct 2011, its late January 2011. (I read in another review that amazon had sold a box of tic tacs beyond the expiration date.) In the package, there are two cases, each which hold 12 5/8 oz of tic tacs, so you can keep it well organized. I tried one, and mint was powerful. Within maybe 5-10 seconds, my breath was already smelling like freshmint. In short, a solid product with a cheap price. Anyone looking for cheap strong mints should look no further than this one. This should be at the top of anyone-looking-for-mints's to buy list.

column9: Dehydrated Sweet Green and Red Bell Pepper
column10: An excellent product that is in a convenient size. The provider shipped on a timely basis and the product arrived safely.The product is great in soups, stews, in prepared meat dishes such as Meat Loaf and in sauces such as spaghetti sauce. Fresh and aromatic.

I like to keep these on hand for when I'm making soup.  They are good & so much easier than dicing green peppers.  Just toss them in.  Also much better shelf life than fresh.  And they last much better than frozen, no freezer burn.
This makes a good addition to your earthquake or desaster stocks, It is easy to use and will keep for a long time.

I used to be able to find dried bell peppers fairly easily but in the last year or two they've been impossible.  I found this website and these are as good as any I've ever had. I don't use bell pepper very frequently and often it is on the spur of the moment. This solves my problem without my having to go to the store. I only use dried bell pepper in things that I am cooking. I have no idea how they'd be if you were trying to use them in a salad or something where they weren't cooked.

I have not tried this product yet so I could not give 5 stars, but the shipping was fast and it looks like a nice package of Peppers. I like the idea of the smaller pkg's and not the big #10 cans , it's easier to take camping!
The smell and taste of this extract reminds me of tootsie rolls. It wasn't the dark chocolate flavor that I was expecting.

We have stopped buying Kellogg's Frosted Flakes because the corn in this product is an EPA registered pesticide. It is Bt GMO corn which is patented by a chemical company that genetically engineered it in a lab and turned it into an EPA registered pesticide. When corn worms bite into this corn, their stomaches explode. There are concerns about the effect these GMOs have on human health and no long term studies have been done. Kellogg's Frosted Flakes are not the same product I ate when I was growing up. I won't feed my family EPA registered genetically modified corn, or any other GMOs. The sugar they are using is from GMO sugar beet. My family loves the Nature's Path version of frosted flakes. Tastes much better and no GMO risks or pesticides.

The only complaint I have is that you should have not taped the boxes together because when I pulled the tape off it was stuck to the boxes,  it pulled the paper off the box, and I was not happy about that.

I use this for breading fish or chicken.  Add some spices to the mix, coat the meat with milk or a beaten egg, roll in corn muffin mix and then fry - awesome! Great option for those looking for low carb- not easy to find these days!

These are more like eggy bread than corn bread, in both taste and texture. There is none of the gritty texture of cornbread, and not really any of the taste either. The product was edible but not worth the price paid, in my opinion. I am curious about the other posters use as breading, but not willing to shell out the cash to try it.
For me the taste seemed excellent. Even better was how incredibly fast and convenient it is to make a cup!

Got this when I got my Kuerig coffee machine since it was cold out at the time and thought it would be perfect for a quick cup of hot chocolate. Basically it was meh ... thin flavor. Not sure what else to say. Ended up tossing the rest of the box.

This is one of the highest quality dog foods available. Full of nutrients. My 2 1/2 year old lab retriever has done very well on it. His coat is great, he is the ideal weight (labs tend to get chunky if you're not careful), and his stools are solid. Yes, Innova is expensive, but quality food should decrease all the potential health problems (and that's where it gets really expensive) down the road.

column9: One of the best dry foods out there!
column10: We put our German Shepherd on Innova when she was a puppy.  She has always flourished and her coat was gorgeous.  Our vet has always highly recommended this or the Buffalo Blue or anything that doesn't have "meal" in the top three ingredients.  She was started on Wolf Cub by her breeder and we put her on Innova as soon as we got her home.Our only complaint is the rate at which the price skyrocketed on the Innova.  We were forced to switch brands when it was costing upwards of $70 a bag for the food and after five years.  It was well below that until they went to the larger chain stores.  We currently have her on Chicken Soup but would love to be able to put her back on the Innova.  I'm always still looking for deals on it where ever I can.Any dog not only switching brands but going from a natural dog food to one more processed, or the other way around, is going to get diarrhea.I can't recommend Innova enough for anyone looking for a great food with not a lot of fillers and premium ingredients.

column9: Bang for you buck best deal in the better dog foods
column10: Our Golden Retriever used Innova Large Breed puppy food for a year.  We switched to this over a course of a few weeks without any issues.She is healthy with a nice coat being on this for 3 months.  She maintains her weight well on Innova and seems to be full whenever she gobbles down the bowl.  I agree with the reviewer who stated this is the least expensive of the best dog foods in pricing other higher end foods.We buy locally for $60 a bag and it seems to last awhile since its a higher quality nutrient dense food (I can update an exact time in the future).  You can spend less on a bag of food with fillers...and you probably will go through it quicker.It is worth the extra $$ in a healthier pet/member of our family.

column9: Least expensive of the very best dog foods
column10: Our Standard Poodle loves this; I am delighted that I followed our trainer's recommendation.  BTW, when switching from one food to another, don't forget to do it gradually--ideally over at least a week to ten days.  If you ignore this caution, diarrhea could result.
Unfortunately, when I switched my dogs over to this food they had diarrhea for over a month.  Once I change from this food their stool went back to normal.

Thanks Amazon! And thanks to Organic Valley for a LOW FAT shelf stable milk that tastes great! I always have these handy packs around, and this is the only brand I know of with a low fat option. I started using Parmalat in Europe, but when the company filed for bankruptcy in '04 it became almost impossible to find in the USA....and no one filled the need for UHT milk. Who stepped up to the plate? The Organic milk companies! This size is just enough for a day's worth of coffee drinkers.
It tastes good and rich. This is my first aseptic milk purchase. The only thing is when I received my package, it's about 3 months from the expiration date.

column9: Most appreciated item in my pantry!
column10: These single serve aseptic cartons of milk, which need no refrigeration, are just incredibly convenient to have on hand. Many trips to the store have been avoided -- saving a lot of gas and time -- when I only needed a cup or two of milk.A plus is that the milk is delicious, organic, and comes in lowfat 1%. Instant milk, though handy to use in recipes, never seems to mix up into a pleasantly drinkable beverage.My idea of coffee is 8 oz. of hot milk to 2 oz. of strong coffee, so I've used these out of my pantry multiple times at 6 a.m. when I really didn't want to go to the store just to get milk for my wake-up coffee.Perhaps you never run out of milk like I do, but if you do, and find yourself needing just enough for cereal, or a recipe, or for your coffee or tea, these are great to have tucked away and available. A terrific time saver!

Great portability (small carton + no refrigeration needed!), price, and convenience (delivery sort of brings back the old milkman days) combined with the health benefits and the key fact that our 5 year old daughter loves it makes this a win-win on all fronts.

Order and delivery are quick.  Price is good considering it cost about the same at my neighborhood grocery store and this is delivered to my door step.  I always waste milk so having single-serve portions that has a long shelf-life is great for me.

Last week I decided to try something new with this milk instead of just drink it from the glass. Well,have you ever tried this stuff over cereal?  AWESOME! I can't say enough good things about how it changes the dry, bland, and sometimes boring taste of plain cereal.  Without a doubt, the greatest find of '09.  I'll be sure to come back if I find any other uses for this product.

I like shelf stable milk in my kitchen since I don't drink milk and I don't cook with it enough to buy even a half gallon at a time.  I loved the fact that when I received this in March, the expiration date was Sept 10, 2012.  Very nice to have shelf time - as one expects with the product.  Well, I just ordered this again (August 23, 2012) and the expiration date is in October 2012! I would not have bought the product with such a short expiration date if I was in the store and picked it up off the shelf myself.  I will not be buying this product again for this reason.Taste-wise:  I like it. When I lived/traveled overseas there were some shelf stable milks I did not like, but this one is a keeper. If only they could be consistent with expiration dates - come on at least give me 3 months of shelf life!

If you are looking for these little boxes of milk, definitely go with Organic Valley over Horizon.  They actually adhere to and go a bit beyond organic standards!  Your best choice is obviously to support a small local organic dairy whose cows are well cared for and grass fed, but they don't offer these little boxes for occasional needed convenience for that better diet choice when you are out.  If you are buying organic, you are a mindful consumer to some varying degree so do yourself a favor and check out the findings on the Cornucopia Institute website (sorry for no link...google and you'll get there) on organic dairy findings, then do everyone a favor and speak your mind at stores and restaurants that carry Horizon products as well as lousy store brands of organic dairy.  They are making billions off the organic consumers and you are not getting what you think you are paying for.

My preschooler daughter doesn't like something too sweet such like chocolate milk or strawberry milk. She likes this original milk very much.  Organic Valley Organic 1% Lowfat Single Serve Milk, 8-Ounce Aseptic Cartons (Pack of 24)

I really didn't think there was a BIG difference between the way milk tastes, but after having this one, there really is!  It's really good - it doesn't taste like it is lowfat either. It's a little pricey, but I give it 5 stars because it has helped me out when I ran out of milk for my little one, it is easy to take to amusement parks, and it also gives me peace of mind knowing that I will have some milk around in case of an emergency (earthquakes especially, here in Southern Cali!)The price does fluctuate, so I check it frequently. The best deal was when it was $1.04 for one.

GREAT,WONDERFUL, BEST TASTING MILK I HAVE EVER HAD.....I DON'T OFTEN WRITE REVIEWS BUT THIS MILK DESERVES TO BE SPOKEN OF..... TO HAVE SUCH A GOOD TASTING AND HEALTHY DRINK THAT DOES NOT HAVE TO BE REFRIGERATED IS A REAL PLUS. ORGANIC, GOOD TASTING, HEALTHY, DOESN'T NEED REFRIGERATION, WHAT MORE IS NEEDED? AND OH, YES, IT IS PRICED RIGHT AND CAN BE PURCHASED SAFELY THROUGH AMAZON.

column9: I love the convenience, but the taste could be better
column10: I really love being able to pack organic milk in my kids' lunches without having to fill reused plastic juice bottles like I used to do. When I read about the health risks from phthalates that leach out of plastic, I looked for an alternative and found these prepackaged milks. The only thing my kids and I don't like is the slightly odd taste of the milk, it doesn't seem as fresh and creamy as when we buy it in the grocery store in larger refrigerated containers. I guess there's some kind of sterilization process or something in the packaging that affects the taste. I wish Organic Valley could improve that. Still, we will keep buying this milk for now.

This milk is just great, and very convenient.  I ordered it after receiving an email from Amazon that it was onsale.  I'm glad i did, and will purchase it again.  Taste great and perfect to keep on hand, both in the cupboard and cold.
Send teens off to school with Organic Valley boxed milk every school day! Great product, great value!
Love organic milk, it taste so much better and love the single serving too. Now I can take it anyware.
Tasty.  Convenient for school lunches.  Nutritious.  Though I found a comparable product now available sold by the case at my local grocery store.

I frequently order this milk by the case.  It's very convenient to always have milk on hand. The product has an excellent taste.  I highly recommend that you simply place the entire case in the refrigerator and take a cold pack out when you want it.

Love that this milk is organic and that it does not need to be refrigerated.  We keep some on hand at all times for we forget to buy milk so we can make it until the next day.  Also nice to take to restaurants where they don't serve milk for the kids or for school when you want to make sure they are drinking organic.  Do wish they had other choices other than just 1%, but oh well.  It's a bit expensive for milk, but the price is for convenience.  One thing that I really do like is that Organic Valley still has the larger opening at the top of the milk, because most often we pour this into a spill-proof cup of some sort for the little one.  Horizon milk has changed their packaging so that the hole is just big enough for the attached straw, so if you buy that brand you have to squeeze it into the cup, which doesn't always go as planned!

We needed some milk on hand for our two year old that we could take with us anywhere and did not have to be kept cold at all times like regular milk.  Additionally, this is plain milk; not chocolate or vanilla, etc or otherwise flavoured milk.  He likes it cold or room temp.Great product.

column9: Love it, thank heavens for Organic Valley
column10: We love this milk!  Perfect for lunchboxes!  I love the convenience, the fact its organic AND unflavored, unsweetened, etc.  My daughter loves it, too.  We had been drinking the Horizon milk which was difficult to find unflavored (chocolate, strawberry, vanilla).  Finally we found "plain" (or whatever they call it) and only later realized it's sweetened!  Organic cane sugar, sure, but who needs to sweeten milk!!?  Glad we noticed that and glad we found this.  My daughter was delighted with the switch -- declaring "this tastes like milk!"

it's milk.  no big deal.  my only gripe is that the adhesive used to affix the straws to the carton suck and the straws fall off (which means i have to tape it to the carton so my daughter won't lose it during lunch time).  not a huge problem...but an inconvenience.
This is a fabulous invention. My friend in the Air Force turned me on to this. But why did Amazon remove the "Have one to sell? Sell your here" button for this.

I love all of Organic Valley's products. This is white milk.  Not sure what I can say about it other than it's really good.  Even their lowfat milks have a richness about them that makes them seem closer to whole milk.  There is also more flavor there.  Can't explain it. column9: Great milk - cheaper than the store!
column10: I have tried over and over to buy these at my local natural grocer, but they are almost always out of stock!  This tells you how popular the Organic Valley milk is, because it's not cheap at that particular store.  They almost always have chocolate, vanilla, and strawberry flavored milk available and then a big empty spot where the plain milk should be.Not only is it less expensive to purchase these through Amazon, but getting a whole case at once means I don't have to worry about my stash of milk for a while.I eat a lot of oatmeal during the week, usually while I am at work. Great taste, and healthier than most other organic milks in aseptic cartons. Especially great that they last so long for us college kids. Recommended.
great flavor I believe because of what's not in this product.  wonderful for kids' lunches

column9: The milk tastes GREAT, but "Use by July 30, 2011" ????
column10: That's 4 months from now.THAT does not make me happy. I bought this in case our milk is contaminated by Japan's Nuclear meltdown (happening in 1 reactor as I type, BTW) and was hoping to have at least 8-12 months to sit on the shelf. That's not the case. This is "Best Used by July 30, 2011" and that date puts it right in the middle of the possible milk contamination in the states. I guess we'll just use this up by July and not drink ANY milk until we know FOR A FACT it's not contaminated (radiation concentrates in milk because of the cow's grazing habits...if you have young children, start planning ahead...please). By July, Organic Valley's milk could be contaminated too! That's why I ordered it NOW thinking I would have 6-12 months until I would need to buy milk and by then we might be safe.I just tried the milk and it's very good! It tastes great! I really wish we had a way to know the expiration dates of items we purchase though.MY suggestion: IF you can find this locally, look at the "Use by" date before you buy it. I'm going to check out our local health food store and see if they carry this and hope they have a longer "use by" date. Or, we'll just go without milk. We have no young kids in the house anymore so I'm not concerned for their health and lack of calcium and vitamin D. If you have babies or young children, you really do need to start doing something about this NOW. All milk products could be in danger in the states....from what I have read. You can do your own research, if you wish, but I believe the people who have told me this WILL BE a concern in the future.You could even stock up on dry powdered milk. That's better than nothing...in an emergency.

I have been a fan of Nature Valley granola bars for years. They come in many varieties. My favorites lately have been the Pecan Crunch and Peanut Butter bars. So, I was pleased to learn that Amazon now offers the bars in their many different types.Certainly, Oats and Honey are a classic combination. Oats go way back. Samuel Johnson included a definition of oats in his 1755 Dictionary of the English Language. I have adapted liberally from his definition for my title. Actually, Samuel Johnson said: "Oats: A grain, which in England is generally given to horses, but in Scotland appears to support the people." Little did he know that two and a half centuries later, England's colonial offspring would enthusiastically endorse oats as a food for people.Earlier this month, I spent a week skiing in Colorado at Vail, The ticket counters were equipped with baskets of the Oats and Honey bars provided free of charge. It was a nice gesture considering the almost $100 daily ticket price. The granola bars pack nearly 100 calories for a single bar, and obviously double that for a two-bar pack.I took the Oats bars with me skiing, but I also depend on them for hiking. An extra 200 calories is what you may need to give you enough energy to get up the last 200 feet to a mountain summit. The taste is good. They do not melt. If you get tired of the Oats, there is always a choice: Pecan, Almond, or Peanut Butter, to provide variety.
