Add more veggies to your diet, cut down on processed foods, and meats.Truly this IS a verifiable super food that will make a difference in your life.Here are two great recipes for you:Oatmeal1/3 cup intant oatmeal1/4 cup chopped walnuts1/4 cup to 1/3 cup raisinsCook itThen add 4tbsp hemp seed heartsMilk or rice milk to preferenceDo not cook the hemp seed hearts.Do not add sugar. Use unsweetened dried fruit such as raisins for sweetness or add some chopped apple bits before cooking.If you are accustomed to using suguat your taste will adjust after a while.Green smoothie1/2 to 2/4 apple for sweetness1 cup or so fresh baby spinach1/2 - 3/4 banana - I freeze peeled bananas so that it provides a cooler drink but unfrozen is good too.1/2 avacado1 cup rice milk1-3Tbsp Hemp seed hearts. Start with 1 and work your way up to test your preference.If you are unaccustomed to green smoothies give this one a try. It tastes better than most other recipes and the nutrition is undeniable. If you want sweeter try adding more apple up to a whole. 3/4 to a whole apple and 3/4 to a whole or fresh frozen banana and an extra 1/2 cup added to the recipe will make more than enough for two.Also note that your body needs magnesium and phosphorus to properly assimilate calcium. Hemp seed hearts are an excelent source of these nutrients and many others including protien.
This was recommended by my neice and it has been great. I feel more energy and less tired during the day. I highly recommend this product.

My healthy-eating foodie friend recommended this product to me, however, after reading the reviews about excessive hulls mixed in with the hemp hearts, I wasn't sure if I wanted to buy it. I've had a lot of dental work done, and am sensitive to unexpectedly biting down on hard bits, not to mention getting fibrous food painfully stuck in my teeth. My friend assured me that she hasn't had any problems with the hulls, so I went ahead and bought a tub. I've been putting them in and on everything, and I haven't noticed a single hull! I put them in smoothies, on salads, in baked goods, on oatmeal, in granola; super tasty. I will buy this again, it's a good deal.

I bought these hemp nuts because I wanted a good deal... I'm glad I did! Whatever problems they had in the past have been resolved with these new batches. The quality is excellent... great taste, few husks, and awesome deal! You can open the tub and leave it in the refrigerator... it will be good until the freshest before date.

I've ordered Manitoba Hemp Hearts 5#s several times and each time I've been very pleased with the quality of the product.  I have not experienced any "hulls" as some have complained of and I use it every day.  This is a very healthy and tasty product that I'll always eat.  It's a great "emergency" food as well and can sustain human life as it is really a perfect food.  I love the taste.  I highly recommend this product.
My wife and I am most happy with our purchase of hemp seed hearts. They taste wonderful and are so nutritious! We are both losing weight and plan on using this product for a long time.

This is the best deal for hemp hearts I have found. I love the freshness of the hemp. The only issue that can arise is fridge space. It is a big tub and to keep them fresh they must be refrigerated. My local sprouts was the old place to get them, but it is costs more. I enjoy them on my yogurt the most and by the spoonful. Great in cereal, smoothies, oatmeal fruit and salads. The texture it's soft with the occasional shell, but it's expected. Actually, if you have seen hemp seeds with shell on it's amazing how clean they get them out.Do your body a favor and get these yummy power house seeds.

Does what it says on the bottle. I tried hemp hearts / hemp seeds etc before purchasing this product and am very glad I found the large tub. It goes on everything - yoghurt, salad, smoothies and just in a snack pack mix with berries and nuts... its filling and healthy and has a super light and slightly nutty flavour. It is just YUM!

I tried the Nutiva hemp seeds and i was really impressed.  I wanted to try value so i went with the 5 pound Manitoba.  I was really disappointed in the hulls.  I am afraid to bite down on then because of the hard hulls or whatever that is included in the container.  Don't want to try thIs product again.  Amazon ordering process was very easy and delivery time was great.  Manitoba should really check the hulls.
I added hemp seeds to my daily diet a few years ago, and plan to never stop eating them.  I believe they are an important addition to a healthy eating plan.

Yummy Hemp Protein!  This stuff is actually very good. I was surprised how much I like this.  I put a couple of tablespoons in my oatmeal every morning.  Sometimes I just eat it out of the jar.  I really should put it in the fridge, but it'll probably be gone soon, so I doubt that it will spoil.

Originally tried this product after finding it at a local market.  It was in a smaller package, costing almost twice as much per ounce.  There's something about the combination of chewiness and nutty flavor that I almost crave when I'm eating it.  Don't worry, I haven't eaten more than 1/2 cup at one serving and probably had no more than 2 of those servings in one day, so not over-addicted, but also wouldn't be too bad if were. . . ?  I find it tasty and nutritious eaten raw, great for a snack or part of a meal.

I like this product, it is very economical and hemp seeds are very healthy.I use it on my fruit salad in the morning, sprinkle in some home made fruit jam and put the hemp seeds on the top.It keeps you from getting hyngry too soon.

Absolutely love these hemp hearts! I've been eating these by the bowlfull with a bit of milk and blueberries. A much more tasty and healthful breakfast cereal than my usual oatmeal, i'm planning on getting the auto delivery so i'll never run out... check out the health benefits of these tasty little seeds and you'll wonder what took you so long to find them!

Three tablespoons of Hemp Hearts daily gets my day off to a blazing start.  Those days I do not take it (for whatever reason) my flames burn low.  Don't take it late in the day unless you want to be wired for sleeplessness.  It is also packed with nutrients that your body seems to crave.I started using hemp hearts on the advice of my son.  It worked so well for me, I recommended it to many of my friends and it really took off from there.A great product.

Had hedged for a long time to but hemp hearts. Amazon's price helped to push me to buy and I'm glad I did. The omega boost is great and the taste is slightly nutty and sweet. I add this to my Greek yogurt and oatmeal. A spoonful of hemp hearts is a tasty little treat.

By that I don't mean it was grown by free range hens, or plucked from the lush fertile soil of virgin Canadian tundra.  What I mean is that you had better chew slowly lest you find your dental work impinging upon bits of sand and grit directly from Canada.My tub tasted somewhat more fully than the "Nutiva Organic Shelled Hempseed" 5 lb. bag.  But the Nutiva lacked the sand and grits.  All told it's a toss up between the two.  I'll probably go with Nutiva next time, despite the higher price, as so not to put my teeth and dental work in jeopardy.

Received my second order the other day in excellent condition.  I love this hemp, we have it everyday in our breakfast smoothie which we have around 7:30 am, many days I am not hungry again until 2 pm or later.  I also eat a spoonfull of it if I get hungry in the evening.
Great quality - yes an occasional bit of shell but always a small piece that you can chew, nothing hard on your teeth.

I've been using this product for several weeks now and find it to be very good.  It helps curb my appetite, yet I have plenty of energy to make it through the day with moderate food intake.  I am noticing slow weight loss on this regimen, but am very happy with my energy level and increased feeling of well being.As usual, service from Amazon was quick and accurate.

I'm very happy I switched.  I love the container and of course the Hemp Seeds.  I mix them with my protein shake in the mornings and I feel satisfied until lunch.  Very healthy and perfect way to add tasty fiber to my low carb diet.
just like the reviews stated full of hulls, but the price is right, worth going through and picking them out

Protip: Keep it in the freezer in ziploc bags with the air squeezed out. I kept most of it in a jar in the fridge, but the air in the jar was apparently still spoiling it slightly. I find it tastes much fresher and makes me feel much better when it's protected from air and heat.I've had frequent severe headaches for years, and since I've used this method starting last week(Nov 5), I've noticed a great reduction of intensity of pain, which reduces the effective dose of pain pills. Also my stomach doesn't hurt after taking pain pills, which I directly attribute to these hemp seeds.Protip 2: If I take these in the evening, I won't get any sleep. Maybe it's just me, but It definitely gives me almost too much energy.I just eat it straight with a spoon about a quarter-cup to a half-cup per day. I haven't tried any other brands.
Healthy, fresh and very tasty. This product can be sprinkled on fruit, cereal or used in baking. Gluten free. High fiber.

Very pleased with the quality of this product compared to what we were getting at Rainbow and Whole Foods in the SF Bay Area.The price is what sets it apart for me. It's about 30% cheaper to purchase it at Amazon on subscription as opposed to buying it at the store.

I bought the 5lb tub of this product after trying in vain to find smaller quantities available locally.  After ordering, I found some at Sprouts but more expensive than this.  With the free shipping, this is a good deal.Mine is kept in the freezer with a small quantity decanted to the fridge as needed.  I put them on oatmeal, on salads and in soups.  I have not experienced magical weight loss but the product does taste good and helps with 'regularity'.Recently, I had to stop eating gluten so it helps to add this to a salad to make it a filling meal, instead of having bread or pasta with the salad.
blah blah blahwhat can i say that you don't already know?i  can't comment, on the nutrition, benefits, quality, etc.try it as an extra for your health. just don't expect miracles
I use the hemp seeds in my breakfast drink.  They are grown in a green manner.  The price is really good for the 5 lb tub.  I'm really glad to buy this product.

Can't beat it.  The only thing I have noticed with the higher priced products is that the higher priced ones are dryer.  Of course, while that might be a good thing, it might mean that these are more natural (i.e. no drying agent)....I can't tell which it is.
love the product and have told all my friends.  Did notice since then, the price went up.

Before buying this mass quantity, I tried hulled hemp from several different brands. For the price, quality and nutritional value, you really can't beat this purchase.  As others have stated, you want to pull a portion out to keep in the fridge, which you can use ongoing, and store the rest in your freezer.  For those interested in aesthetics, the label is a lot nicer than the one pictured, and the tub is a tall rounded black plastic package that's about a foot tall and half a foot wide (make room in your freezer before you crack it open).

Hemp hearts have become a regular part of my diet.. and this is the most economical way to buy them. Same quality at half the price.. can't argue with that. The shipping was free and I got it in 4 days. And the resealable tub is easy.. I leave it in the freezer and just take out what I need each day.

I treat myself from time to time to British food.  I have lived in America for 23 years, and crave Cadbury chocolate.  The Cadbury you find in the supermarkets is made by Hershey, and has a waxy taste to it.Cadbury Chocolate Fingers were one of my favorites, when I was growing up, and I found the Mini Fingers here on amazon.com.  I opened the tub, and then the inner packaging, to see these baby chocolate fingers.  I put one in my mouth, and sucked the chocolate off.  The chocolate tasted great, and then I had the biscuit crunch.Well, I couldn't stop at 1 so I ate several.  I have to say that they didn't taste as good as I remembered, but that happens over the years.I do prefer Cadbury Digestives, or McVitie's Digestives over the Cadbury Mini Fingers, but will willingly eat them at any time.
Gits Kulfi mix is a lot easier for me than making kulfi from scratch. I pour the mix in muffin tins and create disks that I knock later after freezing. The taste is absolutely addictive.

This coffee is wonderful but you have to love chocolate because it has a very strong chocolate flavor.  I loved it and after brewing my Sunday morning pot my house smelled absolutely wonderful.  Delivery was very fast and as always well packaged.  I can't wait to try the other flavors.I'd recommend this coffee to anyone who loves flavored coffee and especially loves chocolate.

I admit I'm weird because while I eat little chocolate I really enjoy this coffee. BiblioGal is correct that the chocolate flavor is intense, but I don't feel it overwhelms the coffee. Rather, while the balance is weighted to the chocolate, the coffee flavor stills comes through. I, too recommend this coffee to anyone who enjoys flavored coffees, but in particular to all those chocoholics out there. Enjoy!

Unfortunately, I didn't find this coffee at all flavorful. I couldn't detect the rich chocolate flavor it is supposed to have. It tastes a bit like weak butter toffee to me. The coffee itself didn't have a robust flavor either, and I used plenty of it. Perhaps I'm still comparing all chocolate flavored coffees with that of the discontinued Millstone Chocolate Velvet Decaf, which was intensely flavored along with a good full-flavored coffee. The Chocolate Thunder just didn't come close. My search continues ...
I have tried already several flavors, caffeinated and decaff, and so far I have jet to find a flavor I did not like.  I am sure to go and try more.

column9: These are NOT in fact Salmiak Rocks.
column10: So, what I received were not in fact Salmiak Rocks, but Chocolate Rockies. The incredibly unfortunate thing about this is that these two products look incredibly similar and you cannot tell one from another until you eat them. As such I had already opened everything before I realized the error so I couldn't return them. The chocolate rockies weren't terrible, but they were not NEARLY as good as the salmiak rocks and moreover they weren't what I ordered. When you expect salty black licorice flavor and instead you get "chocolate" (I use the term loosely because the filling was akin to a tootsie roll) wrapped in black licorice, it's rather disappointing.I don't know how you can go about ensuring that you get the right thing here, which is a shame because the price is great and if it was in fact salmiak rocks, those are a delicious soft salty black licorice with a sweet molasses taste to it.If you do order this product, good luck.

Being a Dutchman raised in North America there was nothing like the black salty licorice my relatives would bring me as a kid, but Salmiak Rocks, didn't discover them well into my adult life.  Boy oh boy, these are incredible!  I'm making up for the many years I didn't know about these.  Taste sensation, I'm thinking of moving to Holland near the factory that makes them!

column9: Not as strong as I hoped for,
column10: These were not bad, but I was expecting and hoping for the really strong Salmiak rockies.  I"m becoming a regular at buying the licorice through Amazon.  I wish they would offer sample-sized portions so you could try the product before spending a small fortune on a poor facsimile.

I purchased a small baggie of these Salmiak Rocks at a Finn Specialty store.  The small bag containing maybe 15 pieces sold for $3.00.  I was thrilled to find such a great bargain at Amazon.  All my Finn friends who grew up eating this candy stated it is authentic and delishious.  No one I shared the candy with was disapointed.  I love it.  Can't beat the price.

I have eaten Dutch licorice since the age of 3 when I lived there.  When we came back to the US I could only find the roll of zoute drop, now I can get 6.6 pounds of this wonderful licorice every month with free shipping.  It is a wonderful licorice flavor with the combinatition of sweet yet salty at the same time.I have given it to friends who have never had real licorice, and they love it! Usually they just spit it out, but not this one.5 star good!
I love the Salmiak Rocks, but most Americans will not enjoy unless you have been to Northern Europe and have come to appreciate salty liquorice

Senna tea is truly magical in the way it temporarily replaces your internal organs with bees.I guess I must not be worthy enough in the constipation department to truly reap the benefits of Senna, and so the gods of this truly magical herb treated me instead to merciless abdominal pain and rear-ended agony.Does it make you poop? Yes, you will poop everything that is inside you, including your innards.
It's great, drink it at bedtime and you will go to the bathroom in the morning.

This product is supposedly the best brand you can get for Senna Tea.  I can see why.  It helped me go when I thought nothing would.  You do not need Enemas when there is Senna Tea.  Thank god man..  This stuff works.  It took about 15 hours for me, which was quite shocking.  It let everything out.  Yeah baby.... Oh yeah, and it tastes good too.

great tea, let's face it, indgestion and regularity can be a real problem for some of us. I've tried a few cleansing tea, this tea is great to gently clean you out. When you start taking the tea, let it seep only a 2-3 min the first few days, I like the caffein free before bed and in the morning..well you know.

This stuff is awesome, it really does work. Iv only done it once so far becuase its hard to find a day where im not going anyway and i can just stay home. but i look forward to using it agian. good detox!
This product was delivered to me fast. Everything that was supposed to be there, was there. I am a happy customer.:]
Senna leaf tea lives up to its claims but prefer tea bags to be in separate envelopes.

Great stuff, especially when you have chronically stuffy sinuses, as I do, and this gives me quick, temporary relief. I discovered Airwaves gum when I lived in the UK (I'm American) and I bring some back every time I've been over there. My favorite flavors are the menthol eucalyptus (blue pack) and the green mint (green pack). Very pleased to find it available on Amazon!

I was 14 the first time I tried Airwaves gum, and absolutely love it!  Almost can't live without it.  I have a dry mouth a lot, and chewing gum, especially really strong, low in sugar, gum is helpful.  It might be a "learn to love" kind of thing, but I honestly can't figure out why Wrigley's still doesn't distribute this gum in the U.S..  I saw a package of Cardamom/mint flavor (not Airwaves) in the store recently, so plain old Eucalyptus shouldn't be a stretch for most of us.  In any case - I'll keep on ordering large packages of it!

column9: A cough drop in gum form
column10: If you like menthol cough drops, then this gum might be for you. Generally not available for sale in the US, I first encountered this gum in Taiwan. The menthol is in the candy coating so at first bite you will get that wonderful sinus-clearing effect, but it is not as long-lasting as when taken in lozenge form. This gum serves to freshen the breath as well - if you are going for that medicinal scent. Slather on some Ben-Gay for the full effect and make the girls go wild!
Got this gum in Germany and Kuwait and wished the US would sell it in our stores, but I will continue to purchase online if I have to, to get it.

I ordered this for my husband thinking it might help keep his sinuses clear because of the menthol.  It is a little surprising - it is like chewing a menthol cough drop, but tastes good and does a similar job but more fun.  I am sure I will have to order more when this batch is gone.
Great flavor - long lasting. Clears the sinuses!! I have shared it with others who want to know where I got it. They are converts!
This is a very goood product and i would purchase it again. I would also pass this info on to friends so that they could order it as well.

I first discovered this gum in Germany. I bought it because of the name: "Airwaves." At the time, I was working at a radio station and thought it would make a fun gift for co-workers. But I absolutely LOVED how strong it was -- menthol and euclayptus? wow! what a good combination. Then, I'd buy it anytime I went over there, or have a friend in Germany bring in on visits. I am SO happy that it's available in America now!
This gum is good, tastes a bit like a cough drop but clears your nasal passages up well. If you like strong gum this ones for you.
These are delicious and just the right size.  I have IC and they don't irritate my bladder at all.

This is the best chamomile tea I have ever had. I am so glad I found this tea, it is fresh like just picked blossoms, the flavor is rich & mellow, so many chamomile teas have little or no flavor. The packaging is exceptional!! I have bought loose tea many times, but I really do not like messing with the clean up. This is real loose chamomile in a tea bag unlike any I have ever seen. Chamomile is my daughter's favorite tea & I bought 6 boxes to give her as a xmas present. I only gave her 3, I just had to keep 3 for myself. I will definitely buy again.

column9: Not the Two Leaves and a Bud I remember
column10: I ordered this because I once bought great teabags called Two Leaves and a Bud that came in a triangular shaped teabag and were very good.These are not that. I am not sure if the manufacturer has downgraded their quality or what but here are problems with these that I didn't have when I originally bought from this company a year ago:The teabags are packed together more tightly now and are squished into small plastic packages, you are supposed to expand the teabag into it's original 3D shape afterwards, this doesn't work as well as the original packaging.But the bigger problem is that the bit of paper on the end of the teabag string (does this have a name?) is glued, actually STUCK, in each individual package to the teabag portion. Try as you might to detach it so you can put only the bag and not the paper into your tea, it will rip the bag, and then tea leaves will leak out! I should call it tea dust becuase tea leaves are what they used tohave, but squished into thier new package they are just and expensive version of any other organic camomile tea, they are no longer the cool unique ones that had really quality tea in them.I am a pretty picky person about my tea, but I am very dissapointed overall as this is not what I remember or expected about the quality of this tea.

I always loved chamomile tea as a child, but recently it has never tasted the same, until I tried this brand one day and discovered that it keep the chamomile flower buds I think that is what really makes the difference. Normal powdered chamomile in a sack just isn't the same. I think this brand is excellent. It is very expensive though.To the guy who posted the bad review why don't  you post where you found this cheaper one you claim is just as good, because I have not been able to find any alternatives that are this quality for less.  This tea is at least a strong as other brands here on amazon I have tried, including the orgranic ones. It's true is is not very very strong, but the flavor is really good.

There are bugs in the tea bags. Now, these aren't the 'organic' bugs you find in your garden when you plant veggies. These are the bugs that dig into expired produce. There are about 4-5 bugs in each bag. If you want some protein boost while relaxing before you go to bed, this is the product to buy. Also, the tea bags aren't made from organdy. It's some sort of plastic/polyester. I burnt a bag and it melted, turned black, and glued onto itself. Horrible, unethical company.

There is a reason that most tea companies don't do pure organic chamomile - it is darn difficult: Great lemon-y flavor only comes from certain origins at certain times of year. And ORGANIC is even tougher - sure, it is easy to keep bugs away with chemicals but with no pesticides?! Hi, I am Richard from two leaves and a bud. We are a small company that works very very hard to provide the finest quality teas and herbal infusions. And consumers love our chamomile! As always, we stand 100% behind the quality. If this is not the best pure chamomile tea bag you have ever tasted, email us and we will refund the cost of your purchase. We are real humans who care.

I've been drinking Two Leaves and a Bud ever since a friend gave me a box to try a couple months back. I haven't bothered with other teas after that. I have it on a daily basis.The reviews regarding the "snails" that were in the packaging are from a while ago. No photos were provided, so it's hard to say how truthful they are or rather if their assumptions were correct (are you sure it was snails?) And even if that was the case, I'm sure by this point the matter has been resolved. I can't imagine Two Leaves and a Bud disregarding such a quality control mistep. I'm drinking a cup of their chamomile tea as I write this review. There's nothing wrong with it. The familiar taste is there. Get your kettle ready!

column9: One of the best Chamomile tea I have known in the world.
column10: I have tried almost all kinds of Chamomile tea bags on the market, This is one of the best I have ever tried so far. I am a repeat buyer of this and I recommend for everyone near me. Very good tea to solve insomnia if you experience one.

column9: Very weak... and a hint of plastic?
column10: The sachets come individually wrapped in plastic baggies.  For a large cup (say ~16 oz), you'd need 3-4 sachets to brew a tea that wasn't obviously weak.  I tried it well before the box's expiration date, so that wasn't the problem.  As the tea soaked in the water, it seemed to develop a faint taste of plastic.  Not sure where that's coming from.  Could be the baggie it was in or the sachet, which is made out of some kind of plastic fabric.

I purchased a quart carton of chamomile tea at a street fair about 2 years ago.  I started using it a few months ago and it was excellent, in spite of its age.  It had a great calming effect on me and I went to sleep about 20 minutes after drinking it.  Thinking it was "cheap" (after all, I bought it at a street fair), I ordered Two Leaves and a Bud brand from Amazon and it was awful!  I had to use 3-4 tea bags in a single cup  to achieve any degree of strength or taste or desired result.  In my opinion, the packaging is gorgeous; the product leaves a lot to be desired.

column9: Mild tasting, great quality whole leaves
column10: Excellent quality of individual whole leaves.For some reason I get jittery from green tea but I love the taste, so a decaf version was just perfect.Mild tasting and given the high quality of the leaves, you are able to just drop a little at the bottom of the mug and fill with hot water and you will be able to drink without fussing with additional accessories.A pound of tea is A LOT of tea, so I'm sure this will last a while.It came in a resealable bag but it wasn't the best quality and broke on the second opening, so I had to find alternative storage for it.
it was bit fishy when i drink it as a hot tea.but it was a lot better when i made it into ice green tea

column9: Just not good -- a strange rancid flavor
column10: I think that the Tabasco folks tried sincerely to make this a good sauce: the basic idea was to mix a high-quality Worcestershire with Tabasco.  It should have worked, but I just think they misunderstood the things that make the classic Worcestershire so appealing.  Maybe they just opted for smoked anchovies or something, but this sauce has an unpleasant smoky, almost bacon-y undertone to it.  I've tried it again and again, hoping I'd get used to the difference, but in the end I had to chuck it in the trash.  From a man who has ordered and enjoyed multiple gallon jugs of Tabasco Regular and Habanero Sauces: this one is just not a winner.

This stuff is just not good.I will give the Tabasco company credit, but realistically, you just cant throw Tabascosauce into every condiment known to man and expect it to work, and this does not work.Worcestershire Sauce, particularly the real stuff, has a specific place in the foodie world,and the only time you find these two in the same general area is in a Bloody Mary, but youalso find horseradish and and a half dozen other ingredients that mask the horrible combinationof the two. In fact, Bloodies are probably the only thing you could use this stuff for, Idon't know cause I tossed it the first week I had it.Tabasco Soy Sauce, Tabasco Mayonnaise, Tabasco Pickles... these are real winners. But thisstuff... they should just abandon this experiment and forget they ever tried to take it tomarket.

Yep, Unfortunately I have one of those "picky eaters" you often hear about but might not have the pleasure of knowing.  Well, to be fair, she is only really picky when it comes to eating veggies.  I think that she was the only baby that did not eat "trees" and even now (at almost 3 years old) shuns pretty much all green veggies across the board.  Enter HAPPYBABY to the rescue!  I could not believe my eyes the first time I tried one of these out on her ... she gobbled it down and was reaching for more!!  It makes me feel so good to know that she is getting her green veggies at snack time every day (you can't beat the portability of these things ... so nice to be able to pop one in her snack pack for school), and because about 95% of the food we eat is organic, I love it that this product fits in with our organic lifestyle.  The mango and pear combo sweetens up the spinach quite nicely ... my girl has no idea she is eating something that is actually healthy for her.  Her teacher always comments about how healthy her snack is and how she finishes it so quickly ... makes mama proud!

This is my baby's favorite food, and they are always out of it at the store. I want to purchase from Amazon, but you are not saying how many pouches come in the 19.99 box.  I need that information before ordering.

The recipies that Pamala's Company sent us after we called them called for a set of recipes. They do NOT include recipes within the 25 lb. bag. You will have to go to their website and download their instructions for many variations for their various mixes. The brownie recipes always call for a 16 oz. package, and since we had a 25 lb. package we were puzzled about what to do until we hit upon the idea of measuring the mix into a scale. 16 oz. ended up to measure about three cups.I personally love chocolate and enjoy our brownie mix. Going wheat free is a difficult world in which to shop, and the whole family enjoyed these brownies.
This is waaaay better than Hershey's bar of chocolate.  I like milk chocolate best, and this one is absolutely great!!!
This is really good chocolate.  While this is called a milk chocolate, it is 48% dark chocolate.  That's a good mix: strong chocolate taste without the bitterness of dark chocolate.

column9: Ethically traded, shade grown, and great flavor
column10: Every so often, I get my dad and I each a chocolate bar so I can get his opinion and write a review of the chocolate based on both of our tastes.I'm picky about chocolate and want quality. He appreciates quality, but he's a quantity eater.This is the perfect compromise bar between our tastes and budgets.First, the snap.It has the soft muted snap of milk chocolate, as long it's kept cool, it doesn't just bend like some milk chocolate bars and it's not as hard as a Hershey's bar. It's more like Nestle consistency.My dad, who used to really appreciate a good dark chocolate prefers milk chocolate now. Sometimes a 48% bar can be too bitter for his tastes. Not this one, the flavor is a good pure chocolate,very smooth, it's just a touch on the sweet side which he likes. He doesn't have any idea it uses beet sugar, so that didn't affect the flavor at all for him.The vanilla sets off and rounds off the edges of the chocolate flavor. The balance of cocoa butter and milk with the touch of lecithin creates a bar that melts well in your mouth. It's very smooth.To him, it tastes a lot more like Nestle's milk chocolate than Hershey's and he really likes the flavor.It's nearly guilt free except for the calories, and quite reasonably priced.

Great tasting chocolate. I like their company vibe, too. Although, I wish they used all organic ingredients. "All Natural" is not organic.On a side note, the 48% is perfect. I tried their 88% and oh my gosh, I did not know that chocolate could taste that bitter. I tried Newman's Own 34% and thought it was pretty bad - could barely taste the chocolate.
Southern Fruit Sensation - Loose Leaf Black and Green Tea -2 oz has a mild flavor.  Enjoyable tea for any occasion.

These crackers are not for everyone. The rest of my family refers to them as my "dog biscuits." I love them. For me they have great texture and crunch, while adding important fiber to my diet. The fiber has multiple benefits, including the fact that I feel full long after including a few fiber rich crackers with a tasty topping in my meal. I suggest that one search the internet to check pricing before ordering here, though.

I bought the 2.2 lb bag for a quoted price of 6.83.  I thought the shipping was free, but turns out the shipping was $7.70.  The shipping was more than the food.  I would have never purchased the food had I known the shipping was not free.  I contacted the distributor and they said they could do nothing.  Beware and don't get ripped off like I was.

So, somehow Diamond captured the perfect flavor of french toast without all the calories. Such a great flavor, after tasting only a few for the first time I immediately orderd three more. These don't even have that "Almond" aftertaste, it finishes very nice with a hint of a butter maple flavor...wow.Now: To Diamond please rename to "Buttery French Toast", as this would be much better fitting.

The flavor of these nuts is similar to cinnamon toast cereal, yet they are filling and healthy, containing little sugar and almost no salt. I would deduct a star for being priced too high both here and in the supermarket, but Blue Diamond deserves credit for their restraint in using quality ingredients and in not producing a sugar encrusted candy. Now if they would only go against the trend of charging a huge markup for minimal extra processing cost...The other reviewer seems to think these contain lactose. The ingredients:ALMONDS, EVAPORATED CANE JUICE, BROWN SUGAR, CORN MALTODEXTRIN, CINNAMON, NATURAL FLAVORS AND SALT. PEANUT FREE. MAY CONTAIN OTHER TREE NUTS. Unless OTHER TREE NUTS comes from cows, I don't think this is true.

I ordered these nuts off a whim because of the flavor. I just got into eating more nuts because I don't get enough Omega 3's. Everybody that I shared these with loved them! I went through 2 containers in a week (because of sharing). This will be a staple in my house from now on!!!
These have more net carbs than the Emerald Cocoa Roast almonds (6g vs 3g), but if you're not worried about that, these are absolutely delicious! If you like flavored nuts, you've got to try these.

I discovered these nuts by accident. They were on clearance ay my local CVS for $1. I wish I had bought them all!The cinnamon and brown sugar flavor is perfect together with the roasted almond flavor. It is not candy coated like other cinnamon almonds (making it a much healthier treat). Everyone that I have shared them with think that they arephenomenal! I highly recommend this product. It is one of the most tasty and healthy snacks you can find. I only wish Amazon would put them on their subscribe and save program.

At the time of purchase, the production description stated:Blue Diamond Natural Cinnamon Brown Sugar Oven Roasted Almonds 8 ozby Blue DiamondBe the first to review this item  Like (0)List Price: $32.55Price: $6.82 ($0.12 / oz)You Save: $25.73 (79%)Product DescriptionBlue Diamond Almonds Oven Roasted Cinnamon Brown Sugar - 6 PackBoth the list price and description suggests that it is a 6 Pack.I ordered 2 and received 2 "1 packs".This is a single 8 oz container.

I got these at my local Publix. They're the best tasting almonds of the bunch. The butter toffee tastes natural and the almonds are of good quality. They also make dark chocolate covered almonds. They taste like Cocoa Puffs but are still pretty good if you're looking for a cocoa kick instead.

At first, I thought these tasted a little artificial. After a few handfuls I realized I like them, regardless.I am a big fan of this company's products, and have even gone so far as to speak with one of their growers about the integrated pest management systems they employ (using the smallest amount of pesticides possible).  I will keep buying all their other flavors. The Bold line, especially the Habanero, is also excellent, as are the dark chocolate variety.

These almonds are nothing short of incredible- they are so delicious! If you are trying to follow a low-carb lifestyle (for dietary reasons or weight loss) and need a 'sweet fix' after meals, then this is a wonderful option - only 6 g. Net carbs! And the taste is so yummy! They are just sweet enough! I'm so glad that amazon sells them in bulk, because I could easily go through one container in a week!

If you want a truly healthy, filling snack, you must give these a try, as well as their sisters, the Vanilla Bean Almonds. They are both just lightly sweetened, and fragrant with either the cinnamon or the vanilla, depending on which you choose. The container is marvelous; there is a half flip top which is easy to do with one hand (like in the car). And they're not roasted in more oil, so the almonds are "meaty" and sweet. And almonds are SOOO good for you. I'd recommend that you try them, and then get an Amazon subscribe and save if you can. It's well worth it! And all natural. LOVELY!

column9: Not the same as the canned version
column10: I expected that these canisters of Blue Diamond "Roasted Almonds - Honey" would be the same product as the little cans of Blue Diamond "Honey Roasted Almonds" ( Blue Diamond Almonds Honey Roast, 6-Ounce Tins (Pack of 12) ) but they're surprisingly not the same, and have a very "off" taste.  What a disappointment!  Blue Diamond has apparently seen fit to add much more maltodextrin and "other natural flavors", which I suspect cause the odd taste, thus ruining a fabulous product.I've been having a hard time finding the small cans of Blue Diamond "Honey Roasted Almonds" at the supermarkets, despite all the other flavors being carried.  It's as if Blue Diamond just, for some reason, *wants* this product to fail.  First they make it hard to get the canned version, then they completely change the taste of a great product and package it in a canister, using a name that is so similar that it contains all the same words, but without a hint that it's not the same product.I'd contact Blue Diamond and complain, but I already know that they never respond to customers despite having a contact link on their website.  In the past, I wrote to them when they test-marketed and then removed some wonderful silvered almonds (not "slivered" but silvered, as in almonds with a very light sugary coating);  when I wrote to ask, instead of appreciating my interest as a customer, they simply ignored me.So I'm offering this review as a warning to anyone else who might make the same mistake, and think that these almonds will be like the similarly-named canned "Honey Roasted Almonds" from the same company.  The ones in the can are great;  these are just plain awful, and I'll be throwing out 2.9 canisters of 3 purchased.

column9: Nice salt on a very dry nut.
column10: OK, I like a little richness. These nuts have a flavorful salt taste, but are almost too dry to get down your throat.

I love these almonds. They are my favorite to date and I would definitely buy again. The taste is crunchy, they are well toasted and the salt that has been added is just perfect. Not too little, not too much. Best I have ever eaten!!

This is basically candy masquerading as a "healthy" snack. They taste good - because they have three different kinds of sugar in them! Blue Diamond  wants you to think that eating sugar is a healthy snack - c'mon!I purchased these thinking they were sweetened with stevia. Yeah, there's a miniscule amount of stevia (very last ingredient) - but sugars are the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th ingredient listed. These have corn maltodextrin - the worst thing there is on the glycemic index (can you say fat formation?). Now I'm stuck with 3 containers of this sugar snack.
These are the best tasting almonds. I buy them in bulk to share at work. Any time someone finds cheaper almonds, they always come back to these because they can't be beat.

I love these almonds!!  They taste just like a snickerdoodle cookie, but make for a much healthier snack!  One of my favorites of the Blue Diamond Oven Roasted varieties.  Buying them in a 6-pack is more cost-effective for me, especially now that I can't find them in my grocery store. I wish they came in the large resealable bag like some of the other flavors, but for now I'll stick with the 6 container pack.

I wouldn't call these almonds sweet, but they do have just the right hint of sweet flavor that the almond is elevated and feels like a treat.  The taste and texture of almonds doesn't particularly appeal to me, but they're such a healthy snack that I'm glad to find this delicious option.  Also, the small container is the perfect size to have on your desk or keep in the car, or use as stocking stuffers like I plan to do for a couple of my healthy eating conscious friends!

column9: You are only getting one container!
column10: I purchased 2 other types of Blue Diamond almonds on the same day, and they were both around $11 for a pack of 3. T his one was only ONE 8 oz. container, and I assumed it was at least 2-3 containers since the cost was over $8.
Nice sweet treat with some nutritional value. These are fantastic! The only thing is I can find them in more local store at a lower cost.

I LOVE the Blue Diamond Butter Toffee and The Chocolate.  This is my first try with the Cinnamon and they are fabulous!  I eat and live low carb and eat a lot of nuts...the flavored Blue Diamond Almonds are hard to find, so I am happy to find them on Amazon.  Even better to have them delivered to my door FAST & FREE!  Thanks Amazon and Blue Diamond!

I love salted and smoked almonds. I had never even heard of Butter Toffee almonds before.  But, wow, I'm glad I tried them.  They are just sweet enough to satisfy my sweet tooth without overwhelming you with a sugar taste.Another reviewer was right, they taste a lot like french toast.  I'm definately buying these again.

column9: boy these are some tasty nuts !!
column10: Ive had some tasty nuts before but these are exceptionaly good. try them ! im very happy with this product

column9: Should almost be labelled a "BOLD" flavor
column10: Butter Toffee is not a flavor I thought I would like - for some reason the name makes me think of an icky flavor. However, I became hooked at first bite. This flavor is much sweeter than the Honey Roasted. It certainly becomes my top "dessert almonds" when in need of that sweet replacement.Absolutely great for those on a low-carb or Keto diet - only 6 Net Carbs per serving. The bold, sweet flavor keeps you satisfied after only a small amount.Highly recommended!
These almonds are my favorite almonds.  Wal-Mart used to carry them, but now I have to order online.  They are the perfect balance of cinnamon and sugar without being overpoweringly sweet.

column9: If You Like Almonds and You Like Cinnamon You will like these
column10: The Almonds are very very fresh tasting.  The cinnamon adds an extra bonus of goodness to the almonds with a great flavor.  We keep them in the fridge.  We also mix them with all the other nuts we have making our own nut mixture.  Excellent snack with protein.Just ordered some more of them.

I love these for a snack. I get a nice taste of chocolate and mint (in addition to the almond, of course), but it isn't super sweet. I hope Blue Diamond keeps coming out with more flavors. The Butter Toffee is great too.

column9: A heathly snack we all love
column10: Great taste.  The Blue Diamond flavors are way better than the Emerald flavors.  Great between meals snack that we all eat.  Also grab to put in baggies for lunches.

After trying every kind of almond out there over the years, I will take these flavorful Blue Diamond almonds any day.  They are fresh, salted just right and not greasy/oily.  I try to eat a handful a day, usually as a mid-afternoon snack for optimum health benefits. The handy container is easy to use and even indicates portion size.  Unfortunately, this type of almonds is getting more and more difficult to find in my local stores, so I was happy to be able to order a 6-pack from Amazon to have in my pantry.

These are our absolute favorite almonds and love that there isn't any fake sugars in them.  I'll take more calories with real sweeteners any day over sucralose in the other brands. And this flavor is DELICIOUS.  YUM!

I ordered these lovely almonds a few weeks ago, as I often find myself jonesing for junk food, and I thought that if I had something that was good for me around, I would be less likely to grab something terrible.  These nuts are packed with nutrition, and they taste amazing.  They have just enough flavor to make me want more, but the fact that they are high in fat makes it difficult to eat too many in one sitting; I'm satiated with two handfuls.  I go through one little container every week or so.  They are perfect for anyone concerned with nutrition or trying to put on or keep muscle- they pack 6 grams of protein in 1 oz.  I will definitely be re-purchasing these nuts. I wasn't so keen on the idea of the canisters, as I don't like producing so much waste, but I have purchased nuts (peanuts etc) in the past in bulk, and they did go bad before I finished eating them.These nuts have kept me out of the icecream, chocolate chips, and other naughty sweet things that have little nutritional content.  These nuts taste like they should be bad for you, but they are more similar to vitamins than junk food; read the back for the nutritional content: 35% Vitamin E, 15% Phosphorus, 20% Magnesium, 35% Manganese....the list goes on...:)Update: I ordered my second shipment of these.  I love these and I eat a handful of these almonds after my morning banana yogurt shake and with my vitamins :)

One ounce contain approximately 20% of the RDA for an adult recommended dietary allowance (RDA)Recommended Dietary Allowance (RDA) the amounts of selected nutrients considered adequate to meet the known nutrient needs of healthy people. The RDA is based on scientific knowledge and has been presented by a committee of the Food and Nutrition Board (FNB) of the National Academy of Sciences (NAS). The Canadian equivalent is the Recommended Nutrient Intakes. RDA is generally accepted throughout the world as a valid source of information. At least 40 different nations have as well as organizations have published standards similar to the RDA.Magnesium is the fourth most abundant mineral in the body and is essential to good health. Approximately 50% of total body magnesium is found in bone. The other half is found predominantly inside cells of body tissues and organs. Only 1% of magnesium is found in blood, but the body works very hard to keep blood levels of magnesium constant.Magnesium is needed for more than 300 biochemical reactions in the body. It helps maintain normal muscle and nerve function, keeps heart rhythm steady, supports a healthy immune system, and keeps bones strong. Magnesium also helps regulate blood sugar levels, promotes normal blood pressure, and is known to be involved in energy metabolism and protein synthesis. There is an increased interest in the role of magnesium in preventing and managing disorders such as hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes. Dietary magnesium is absorbed in the small intestines. Are you taking enough magnesium in the diet? The recommended daily allowance is 300mgs/day for men, 350mgs for women. Magnesium is extremely safe by mouth - too much simply causes diarrhea. Try increasing the amount of magnesium you take by mouth until it causes diarrhea, then reduce the dose slightly so it does not. these are a good thing for you and sometimes hard to find in a larger container at the store, so these make it much easier and there a good price here.

These are incredible!  Eating these makes me not want to eat candy.  I love these!  The price isn't that great though.  I think Blue Diamond should save money by packaging them in something cheaper than plastic.  I did notice it on Amazon in a box, but the price looks odd - over $50?  Too bad Amazon doesn't stock this, so no Free Shipping.

The almonds tastes all right. Since it is too dry, the salt can hardly stay on surface. Therefore, it is not salty enough. On the whole, it is a healthy snack. I hope this type of almonds can have subscription service and discount.

column9: Butter Toffee almonds are sooo good, but hi-carb
column10: I've tried several of the Blue Diamond jar almonds and the Butter Toffee almonds are the best.  They would probably be my favorite almond, but they're high-carb. I guess the trick is to only eat a few at a time....  We can all do that, right?  :-)I agree with the other reviewer who said that the Blue Diamond almonds in the cans are better than the ones in the jars -- my favorite are the Vinegar & Salt -- but the Butter Toffee almonds are the exception.

column9: Satisfies My Sweet Tooth in A Healthy Way!
column10: It seems impossible that there is a healthy snack that tastes like cinnamon brown sugar but they've managed to do it.  I love these and I always have my cabinet stocked.  This quenches my sweet tooth without gulit.  I highly recommend it.
Do buy the almonds.  Great for snacks and travel.  The contanier has a close top which is great for storage.
Great flavor.  I snack on these when I need a boost of energy.  They help satisfy cravings between meals.

I must say, these almonds have made me a lover of nuts!!!  I have always been a cashew girl and never cared that much for almonds. Well, being on a low carb diet made cashews a no no.  Almonds roasted only with sea salt are soooo good. Blue Diamond makes the best tasting and these are hard to find in stores.  I love the 1 lb bag of these, but can't seem to find them. Buying these in bulk was the best deal out there and I will have to purchase again.  Thanks, Blue Diamond for a superior nut!
This almond product is wonderful!  I am so excited to have healthy options that curb my sweet tooth.  It has on 5 sugars for an ounce of almonds.Wahoo!
These almonds taste good, not as well flavored as the cinnamon or vanilla flavored but a decent change of pace.  A little plain though.
I love these almonds!  Wish they sold them somewhere locally so I didn't have to buy them in bulk over the internet.
If you are an almond fan like me and like sweets as well this is a great treat.  And healthy as well.

These almonds are fantastic!  I can't find them locally, so I'm glad Amazon sells them (comes to under [...] bucks a bottle).  The only thing better?  Blue Diamond Natural Oven Roasted Almonds Vanilla Bean, 8-Ounce Jars (Pack of 6)
Compared to what I pay at the normal grocery store for almonds, these are priced great, and taste fresh and crunchy. The sea salt taste is perfect, and the containers are conviently sized.

This is an excellent product.  I tried a handful that a friend had and I was hooked!  It has good flavor without being too salty.  You can also chop them and add to salads or in green beans.  My kids enjoy them also, good alternative to junk snacks!

I love sea salt and I love almonds.  This snack is so good, I had to keep reminding myself that this is a healthy snack.  Unbelievable.Almonds have a lot of health benefits.  One benefit, in addition to all the others, is heart-health.This snack is perfect for anytime you want a snack, but don't need anything unhealthy.
Love these - very flavorful and wholesome.  I'm hooked!  Unlike the heavily oiled/salted/roasted almonds found in most grocery stores, these actually taste like real food.

Diamond AlmondsAlmonds are a good source of magnesium. One ounce contain approximately 20% of the RDA for an adult recommended dietary allowance (RDA)Recommended Dietary Allowance (RDA) the amounts of selected nutrients considered adequate to meet the known nutrient needs of healthy people. The RDA is based on scientific knowledge and has been presented by a committee of the Food and Nutrition Board (FNB) of the National Academy of Sciences (NAS). The Canadian equivalent is the Recommended Nutrient Intakes. RDA is generally accepted throughout the world as a valid source of information. At least 40 different nations have as well as organizations have published standards similar to the RDA.Magnesium is the fourth most abundant mineral in the body and is essential to good health. Approximately 50% of total body magnesium is found in bone. The other half is found predominantly inside cells of body tissues and organs. Only 1% of magnesium is found in blood, but the body works very hard to keep blood levels of magnesium constant.Magnesium is needed for more than 300 biochemical reactions in the body. It helps maintain normal muscle and nerve function, keeps heart rhythm steady, supports a healthy immune system, and keeps bones strong. Magnesium also helps regulate blood sugar levels, promotes normal blood pressure, and is known to be involved in energy metabolism and protein synthesis. There is an increased interest in the role of magnesium in preventing and managing disorders such as hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes. Dietary magnesium is absorbed in the small intestines. Are you taking enough magnesium in the diet? The recommended daily allowance is 300mgs/day for men, 350mgs for women. Magnesium is extremely safe by mouth - too much simply causes diarrhea. Try increasing the amount of magnesium you take by mouth until it causes diarrhea, then reduce the dose slightly so it does not. This is called taking magnesium to bowel tolerance (just like using vitamin C to bowel tolerance.Almonds are a good source of Fiber.One ounce contains approximately 12% of the RDA for an adult.So, in summary, Almonds are a very healthy snack, so what's left to say?Two things:1st be cautious about "bowel tolerance" or "happy bowels" if you prefer.2nd Taste. column9: Light, Crisp and Good--Just a Little Too Sweet
column10: I'm not a sweets eater, preferring starchy salty things for snacks, but I crave a little something sweet every now and then. The little 100-calorie packs of other sweets are a good choice for me, because they are just small, low-calorie packs of sweet things to eat. Here recently, I've gone to eating gluten-free and all-natural, so I don't really eat this type of food any more. I preface my review with that, so everyone is clear that this isn't my normal type of food when I am judging a rating on it, and my rating might be affected by the fact I usually don't eat processed foods. My daughter bought two boxes of these the other day--and cinnamon and brown sugar are two flavors I really love for the limited sweets I do eat--so she let me have one.They are very sweet. For me, they are too sweet... way too sweet. But for someone who likes sweets, I would imagine they are just the perfect amount of sweetness. What I really liked about them was the crispy, flakiness. They have this nice softish outer shell of pastry, but this nice, crisp, brittleness that makes them crunchy too. In flavor, they are like a thin, crispy pop tart. It's like all the good stuff of a pop tart without all the 'excess' pastry that pop tarts have that I don't like. I love the crispness.My BFF tried the chocolate ones and said it was very good and didn't have any powder 'fake' chocolate taste that some chocolate products have. She liked the crispiness of it too.So if you're a sweets eater, these small little pop-tart-like treats are probably going to be the perfect little snack item and if you can bring yourself to eat only one package of them (there are two small 'sticks' or 'bars' in each interior package), then it's only 100-calories and might fit in well with a low-calorie and/or low-fat diet plans too. They are not, however, good for low-carbing or Paleo or all-natural diets. For older kids and teenagers, they are probably a great slightly healthier substitution for pop tarts too.

column9: Read the ingredients list BEFORE you buy this...
column10: Well, I wanted to get these for our cats. I am always looking for things without a lotof grain in them, since we have one cat who gets hot spots if he eats corn or wheat products.As you can imagine, that limits things a lot.I thought this was interesting, because it had rabbit in it. Now, the listing here offers VERY littleinformation, being really vague about the ingredients, etc etc. I wasn't sure if they actually hadrabbit in them, or was another reference. So, did some research and wanted to share the list.Here's what is in these "healthy" treats:Rabbit, Rice Flour, Barley Flour, Whole Ground Potato, Maple Syrup, Chicken Meal, Natural Flavor, Tapioca Starch, Glycerine, Cane Molasses, Brewer's Yeast, Canola Oil, Salt, Phosphoric Acid, Sorbic Acid, Citric Acid, Mixed Tocopherols, Rosemary Extract.CALORIE CONTENT (calculated):This treat contains 2,800 kcal/kg or1 kcal/piece ME (metabolized energy)on an as fed basis (calculated).You know, I just don't see cats needing maple syrup or cane molasses. It has to be bad for their teeth.There's also a LOT of starch/carbohydrates in these treats, and cats don't really need a lot of carbsin their diet either - they are MEAT eaters. For something that touts itself as uber healthy, these don'tseem to meet the mark. I'm not sure if they call themselves "healthier" because there isn't any corn mealin them, or what yardstick they really used.Decide for yourselves, but be very cautious. We changed our minds about lettingthe cats have them after reading the ingredients.

I debated between these dried beans and the BPA-free canned variety from the same company  Eden Organic Garbanzo Beans, No Salt Added, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12).  Both were highly reviewed, but with a little calculation I saw that one box of the dried variety would yield the equivalent of 5 cans of cooked beans (about 7-1/2 cups), which made the price per serving of the dried about 40% of the price of the canned. Dried beans are not hard to cook, and 60% savings seemed worth the effort.So I ordered a case of dried beans along with a case of sesame seeds  Bob's Red Mill White Sesame Seeds, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4) to try my hand at making homemade hummus.  Both arrived fairly quickly (ordered August 30, arrived September 3; it seems that amazon's shipping just isn't as quick as it used to be), and I got started right away making the hummus.I noticed that the beans were really clean, so little rinsing was necessary.  I also saw that there were no malformed or defective beans.  I followed the perfectly simple "quick soak" and cooking instructions on the box, rinsing the beans between steps.  After first soaking for 90 minutes, the beans cooked beautifully in a little under 90 minutes more and were so soft that I was able to mash them in my Kitchenaid mixer; no food processor necessary!  We used the hummus recipe on the back of Bob's Sesame Seeds bag, minus half of the garlic, and it's definitely in the same league as any storebought I've ever tried.The disappointing part is that midway through the cooking process I noticed a little disclaimer near the bottom of the box in small, non-bold font: "Packed on equipment that handles wheat."  My family eats gluten free due to our child's Celiac Disease, and the risk of cross contamination in this naturally gluten free product, offered by a company that produces many fabulous g free items, was a surprise to me.  I had ordered a case, for crying out loud, and neither amazon nor Eden Organic made any statement on their websites regarding the possibility of cross contamination.  (Mind you, the canned variety is advertised as gluten free.  Apparently it isn't packaged on the same production line.)  Because only one of our family members has a medical reason to eat g free, the rest of us were able to eat (and really enjoy) the hummus, but I was pretty disappointed that the snack I'd planned for us all was off-limits to our celiac child.Bottom line for this product: great quality bean that I intend to use.  However, I won't purchase it again due to risk of gluten contamination.  (Amazon & Eden Organic, please post the disclaimer on your websites in the product descriptions for those of us gluten free customers that need to know this information!)

I love most Bob's Red Mill products and have been buying from them for 10+ years.  However, this is my least favorite of their products.  This stuff is easy to cook with, it's true, but it tastes like rubber, smells bad when it's cooking, and has no flavor until you add your own spices.  I have no idea why I used to cook with this stuff so often other than that I didn't know much about cooking in HS and it looked "high protein" on the label.  I recently read The Whole Soy Story by Kaayla Daniel (Amazon has it), and was amazed to learn that processed soy products like TSP are processed at high temperatures, denaturing the proteins and leaving in loads with antinutrients that damage the thyroid among many other health problems they cause.  Although TSP appears to be almost all protein (like meat or tofu), in reality, you don't absorb much of the protein, anyway.  While I am glad Bob's is using organic soybeans to make their TSP (thereby leaving out the pesticides and genetically engineered ingredients), the fact that it's "organic" doesn't make it a healthy or even a safe product.  The dangerous antinutrients in soy are not a chemical additive or pesticide, they are in intrinsic part of the beans themselves, the plant's natural way of deterring pests.  Traditional foods made from soy and eaten over the past 400+ years were slow cooked and fermented, destroying the antinutrients and leaving the protein, vitamins, and minerals intact.  TSP is the total opposite of whole, healthy, fermented soy products like tempeh or miso soup, as it is not fermented and leaves in all the antinutrients.  As a longtime vegan on a gluten-free diet because of food allergies, I'll continue to buy other Bob's products (they have an amazing gluten-free line), but I am saddened they are still making highly-processed, extremely unhealthy items like TSP.
