I had to double check the ingredient list on the bag for garlic...yep, it's in there....like eating a whole clove! The garlic stayed with me thru the next day. I waited a few days to kill off the last 1/3.  I didn't enjoy the last 1/3 as I knew what I was in for with the garlic.The Bacon Seeds are good, not great.  That one bag was enough to satisfy my curiosity. I can't see committing to a 12-pack. It would be nice if BIGS had a variety pack.  The liquor store didn't have their other flavors, so I'll try them like I did this, one bag at a time as I come across them.

column9: Very tasty, but yes, they are salty and I will buy them again.
column10: I love bacon (rare to find someone who doesn't) and so when I saw these at a convenience store, I had to try them.I find them to be just a bit salty, but the bacon taste is there, just rather subtle initially. Takes a minute for it to really come through.I will buy these again, no question.
I have long wanted bacon flavored sun flower seeds. The bacon salt gives merges well with the oils of the seeds. I am very happy indeed!

column9: Bet on it being the best
column10: Of all the companies that do sunflower seeds, BiGS is the best by a long shot!The seeds are nice and big, the flavor is tastier and the seasoning is layed on! This item is a necessity for those who stopped smoking, that's the best benefit of all that I've received from this product. ENjoy!
These are the BEST sunflower seeds. I have had the pickle, Ranch and bacon. All great! Seeds are huge, flavoring is done better then I've ever tasted and there are virtually no bad seeds.
I love these Sizzlin' Bacon sunflower seeds!  The coating tastes great, lots of flavor, and the seeds are a good size. I went through a pack of 12 in a couple weeks. Will definitely buy more.

Local convenience stores carried these long enough to get me hooked then quit carrying them.  I went to Amazon and found them in stock and cheaper.  The free shipping got to me within 3 days.Good taste, larger size...does have stems and trash, but I can eat around that.
I love these sunflower seeds. I found them up when I was out of town and loved them so much, I had to order more online. These are a pretty good price and so tasty! These are by far my favorite!
As a bacon-lover, I was intrigued by the sound of these seeds so I bought a box. I'm glad I did! These are great tasting seeds!! I would highly recommend them.

If your mouth is sensitive too much salt from sunflower seeds in the shell, then stay away from these. Shells at times seem like they are encrusted with salt/flavoring and can end up in clumps of 2 to 5 seeds. Also too much debris,stems etc.  for the bag size. I can have a lot more Spitz brand seeds before my mouth says no more salt.

bacon sunflower seeds... sounds great, right? well i thought so too... but they put a little too much baconsalt on them, crazy right? but the paprika or whatever it is overpowers everything else & because of that i can only eat 3-4 seeds at atime.. big disappointment.

column9: BIGS Bacon Salt Sizzlin' Bacon Sunflower Seeds
column10: I love bacon however, BIGS Bacon Salt Sizzlin' Bacon Sunflower Seeds, taste nothing like bacon. If anything, they taste more like sucking on a beef boullion cube. I shared the BIGS Bacon Salt Sizzlin' Bacon Sunflower Seeds with other people and they agreed the BIGS Bacon Salt Sizzlin' Bacon Sunflower Seeds doesn't even come close to the taste of bacon. In my opinion BIGS has a good line of flavored sunflower seeds, but failed in the bacon flavor department.

I buy sunflower seeds by the case on Amazon, but only after trying them first to make sure I like a given flavor.Yesterday I picked up single bags of various flavors and brands of seeds, including BIGS Sizzlin' Bacon. Out of the three taste testers (myself included), we all agreed they taste like they took regular sunflower seeds and roasted them with ramen noodle seasoning (I'd say somewhere between beef and oriental, so not too bad). While they do not taste horrible, they are still too salty and taste nothing like the front says they should. They don't even have a smokey flavor to them, just the saltiness of ramen.If you like ramen noodle seasoning, you'll enjoy these. If you want your bacon seeds to taste like bacon, look elsewhere.

column9: Far too salty (also beware if you have a milk allergy)
column10: Let it be known that I love sunflower seeds.  And I like bacon.  So it seemed like this concept would have worked out well for sunflower seeds.  Unfortunately, I was wrong.These seeds are WAAAAYYY too salty.  I put a handful in my mouth and could barely swallow them because of how much salt there was.  The bag has a picture of bacon salt on it, but it seems as though there is too much salt and not enough bacon.Also, just like with the Bigs Dill Pickle sunflower seeds, there are a lot of non-seed particles in the bag.  I found myself spitting out stems, empty shells, and other plant parts far more often than I would have liked.  I was very disappointed by these seeds and would recommend the pickle-flavored ones anyday.Also, be advised that milk is listed as an ingredient for these seeds.  If you have a milk allergy or lactose intolerance, you should probably stay away from these.  But given how salty they are, you might find them inedible anyway.  I actually had to throw my bag away because they were just too salty to eat.
no bacon just garlic if you like garlic you well like it i NOW HAVE A whole box of seed to throw in trash bacon and garlic are not the SAME don't waste your money like we did

You can't go wrong here.  Nature's Variety is one of the top brands in terms of quality and I've researched this extensively.  If you choose the subscribe and save option the price cannot be beat anywhere.  The beef and lamb formula is the favorite of the Instinct flavors amongst my three dogs.  While not a cheap food, you get what you pay for.  I've been feeding Nature's Variety and admittedly a few other high quality brands for years.  First off, the amount to feed listed on the bag, at least for my adult dogs (10, 6 and 5 years old) is much lower than recommended.  My dogs generally get 3/4 cup twice a day, with the 10 year old getting a bit less.  A nice perk is very, very small stool production (gross I know) but if you have multiple dogs it's nice to have small "packages" to pick up in the yard.  (If you fed supermarket brands you'd be scooping all day- I know as I have a pet related business.) Kibble size will work for any size dog- big or small.  Perhaps most importantly, I truly believe your dogs will be healthier and live longer on Instinct foods.  My 10.5 year old Merlin is just starting to show signs of aging.  I adopted him as a scroungry rescue at age 3, so he didn't have the best start in life.  It's amazing what a great diet can do for a dog.  Definitely a food worth purchasing, and Amazon makes it easy.

It's difficult to review a food when each dogs tastes may vary.  This food is a high quality, grain free food.  The kibble is small (slightly smaller than ToTW).  I moved my dog onto it after she spontaneously decided that she didn't like ToTW Pacific Stream anymore.  Reviews on dogfoodanalysis.com and dogfoodadvisor.com both list the food as a high quality food.  I have seen comments on using asorbic acid as a preservative that can lead to bloating if you pre-wet the food.  If that's the case, well, just don't pre-wet it.  My dog is loving this food and has been on it for several months.  Her coat and breath are both good.  I also add salmon oil and royal jelly to her food, so I don't know if it's the food or not.  She also has Antler chews in the house.  Either way, I'm just happy that the fussy eater is eating.  The subscribe and save option offers about $10 per bag off of the regular price, plus I'm a prime member so I don't pay shipping.  They offer the different flavors in small bags if you're interested in trying it out before investing in the biggers bags.

My dog love it! They were having loose stools and stomach issues. Since switching my 5 dogs to Nature's Variety Instinct dog food all their issues have been resolved. They also seem more energetic and active even my 10-year old Golden Retriever. This is great food and I will be purchasing 2 large bags per month.

My Rat Terrier seems to love this food.  Usually, he eats a portion of what is in his bowl and stops.  Since I've started him on this Instinct he eats all of it in one go.  He has allergy problems and they seem to be less of a problem also.  The fact that the food is grain-free has to help with the allergies, and without the grain the food has more nutrition.  I've been very pleased with this food.  It arrived well packaged and in excellent condition.
How dog has had problems with food and her skin having black spots. This food got rid of that problem.Also amazon is by far the cheapest way (if subscribe and save) to buy this food.

column9: Great Stuff for Dogs with Allergies
column10: I own two dogs and three cats and I feed them exclusively Instinct for their species.  After reviewing many products and trying raw (too hard) I've settled on Instinct for my pets as to one of the best foods to buy.

column9: Happy dog, happy tummy, happy human.
column10: My nine year-old labracollie has a very sensitive tummy and is allergic to a lot of foods.  I started my labracollie on Instinct Grain-Free Duck/Turkey about two months ago, when I ran out of her usual dog food (which was working out "okay") and had to give her our wiener dog's food.  I immediately noticed how pungent this dog food was.  It smelled very concentrated but I ensured myself it was not bad by checking the kibble and expiration date.  The smell may shock some people, but after that initial surprise, I noticed how eager my dog looked when she got a whiff of this food.  I think some dogs like stinky-smelling food.  She started eating it right away, and the very next day I was happy to see that she passed a normal stool!  It was even great that she was not scratching like she a maddog.After she did well on the Duck/Turkey, I bought the Beef/Lamb.  She was fine on this one too.  I try to give her a variety of options to keep her interested in her meals so I was glad that I found at least two choicesIt's only been two months so I can't comment on how she does long-term.  I will probably update this review if I find notice anything that I feel could be shared.  My dog is about 52 pounds and I go through the 13-pound bag in about two weeks.  The results, so far, definitely validate the additional cost; and I feel this brand is decently priced compared to other grain-free dog foods out there.  So far she has tried the Turkey/Duck and Beef/Lamb and she liked both of them, and is still passing normal stool.  Unfortunately she's allergic to chicken so I can't give her the Chicken mix and she has never particularly cared for fish so I am debating if I should bother with the Salmon Meal.  My next bag will probably be the Instinct Grain-Free Limited Ingredients, just to give it a try.So to recap...Pros:1. Good for dogs with sensitive tummies and food allergies2. Kibbles are small.3. Reasonable price.Cons:1. Smells strong.

column9: Not the same kibble that I buy from the local pet store.
column10: Looks like this kibble (although sold as the same product) is different from the kibble that I buy locally. It looks like there are fillers in it. Very disappointed and pray that it doesn't set off my dogs bad allergies, because they do not accept returns (which my local store does!) I will be buying locally from now on!

column9: Instinct Grain-Free Beef Meal and Lamb Meal
column10: I mixed it slowly into my dog's daily rations, but she got diarrhea anyway. It just doesn't agree with her so back to EVO. This food smelled rancid just a week or so after I opened it.

I have a little jelly belly dispenser at my desk that gets a lot of use...This order came right in time for it to be replenished! It's hard to find sour jelly bellies in stores so this is a great find ...thank you!

I generally order Lucaffe Classic by itself but jumped at the chance to have a little variety.  All Lucaffe products are very good (I have tried many of them).  If I could pick the varieties, I would have used Classic, Ospite and Mr. Exclusive.  The price of the box plus free super saver shipping makes these pods cheaper than the others and I like Lucaffe quality.
I've tried several combo packs with many different pods in them. This one is by far the best! It has an excellent aroma, taste and crema. Now I just purchase this brand.

Espresso pods are a no-fuss, no-muss way to go. I use the MyPressi espresso maker, which I love, and pods make clean-up a snap. The Lucaffe mixed case includes two SKUs. I kind of wish there's been more, but both are so tasty I can't complain. They also arrived loose in a box, which was surprising for me, but not a particular problem. Five stars because both my "complaints" are trivial and are irrelevant to the quality of the product.

After looking all over my area for butter beans, I finally turned to the internet.  And guess whose name turned up: Amazon.  Since the weather turned a bit cooler yesterday, I decided to fix the beans for dinner last night.  Success!  They taste exactly like the ones my mom made when I was growing up - thanks!

column9: Simply, my quest for perfect Chai has ended
column10: I started drinking Chai tea in 2000, having given up coffee. I needed something to replace my coffee,without the ferocious caffeine attack that begins shortly afterwards.  In my search for the best chai tea, I have triedTazo[very good},Celestial seasonings[okay]Stash[good] Big Train[a mix, sweet}Yogi{okay-good} Revolution Bombay Chai[very good]Alto eco ceylon Chai{very Good} Kashmiri Chai[very Good}Tetley{surprisingly good} looose Chai from Stash[good} Fresh Direct[very good] Tazo{very Good] and local tea sellers. NUMI TEA GOLDEN CHAI IS THE BEST I HAVE TASTED. Not too spicey,it hold the tea flavor both with milk and soy milk,plain and with sugar[and splenda] It is spicey not biting, strong not overpowering. Simply excellent! And organic to boot!

I ordered this tea in search of a good chai in a tea bag. (My favorite is Harney & Sons "Indian Spice" but it is a loose tea, pretty expensive, they make tea bags, too, but they are even more expensive.) So I was on a mission to find a really good chai, with less mess.  The spice in this chai is great, tastes very good, but it is lacking tea flavor and body, if I put too much milk in it, it over powers the tea altogether.  It just seems watery to me, maybe I'll try 2 tea bags per cup.  I really relied on the reviews above and the worst part is I bought the 6-pack and now I have all this tea I really don't care for.

My opinion is that it's a very weak chai.  Hardly spicy!  Everyone has different tastes.  I prefer to make my own so that it has some heat to it.  Contrary to what another reviewer said, it doesn't take hours or cost a lot more.  It cost about the same as one box to buy all of the spices.  It takes just a couple of minutes to make yourself.

While Numi's Ruby Chai has an overtone of mixed ginger and cloves, their Golden Chai makes the notes of cardamom and cinnamon more obvious. The two teas are surprisingly different, despite the fact that they both share a certain warmth and coziness. The assam tea that serves as a base for the Golden is a mellow, mild black, giving the tea its golden color and light flavor. You end up with a mellow, subtle, warm, complex blend that holds your tastebuds' attention while it warms, relaxes and refreshes you.

I love chai (unsweetened) & usually sprinkly the spices in a standard black tea. However, I've tried other chai formulations so I can get the chai flavor quickly. I tried the Numi Golden Chai for the first time a couple months ago at a small coffee shop near the Indiana University campus & liked it so much that I asked if they sold boxes of the tea bags. I quickly finished the bag of tea in a couple weeks, but live two hours away & wouldn't make a trip to IU to buy the tea. The next best thing was to search for it on the Internet. I found several places, but ordered the multiple boxes from Amazon because the price with free shipping made the overall cost less than other vendors. The tea is the same delicious blend that I can now enjoy for a few more months before I have to re-order my new favorite tea bag formulation!

I had to give up on coffee because it bothered my stomach and spent sometime in the world of teas before coming across Chai. Chai tea is now my favorite drink. What is great about Numi is that it does not contain black pepper in the spice mix and does not have a bitter after taste.
Delicious spicy black tea.  You can sweeten and add milk if you like it that way.  Better than the chai found in some famous coffee places!

column9: one of the best Chai Tea
column10: I ever had. I use to make my own Chai tea and it took hours and was expensive. I happen to try this just because I was short on time and I was happy I did. The flavor is very much like homemade and for the price it is perfect. If you like Chai tea I highly recommed you try this. You will not be disappointed.

Numi is my favorite brand of tea;  I discovered it at a health food store-I find the Chai flavor to be delicious and better than other brands; its  a great pick-me-up in the afternoon.  Also, there is nothing obscure about the ingredients- i am having trouble finding other brands which don't have "natural flavorings, may contain soy" ingredient which provides the essence of their tea.  Also, the art on the boxes is very pretty.  All-in-all an excellent product.

column9: Can't give it more than 1 star.
column10: I wanted to like this coffee as I appreciate the fair trade and organic policies of the company. However, I had my doubts from the moment I broke the seal on the can and there was no coffee smell whatsoever! There is hardly even an aroma when it brews! The taste is just bland with a slight bitterness, neither of which you want in a cup of coffee.Perhaps their whole bean might have been better, I don't know. I decided I'd try this for those mornings when you wake up and just don't want to take out the grinder and go through that process. Okay, I learned my lesson - it was a mistake!
I would not purchase this coffee again. Although drinkable- it needs a lot of creamer to drown out the bitterness.

My husband and I have been addicted to this coffee since we first started buying it directly from the company several years ago. We love the smell, the caffeine kick and the taste. Sadly, I don't care about fair trade or organic much, but I love this coffee. We introduced it to my brother who is equally picky about coffee and he is addicted to it now. Whenever we eat out for breakfast or have coffee somewhere else, we wish we were at home drinking our coffee. Our friends all love coming over for it as well.

column9: Best Tasting Artichoke Tea I have come across
column10: Saw an episode on Artichoke Tea on Cholesterole. It has actually helped, but the teas I have tried did not taste very good until I came across this one. It has a apple berry flavor which is great, now it is easy to finish my cup. Even drink more than one a day now because it taste pretty good.
This is my first time trying Artichoke Tea and the taste is a acquired taste. My experience with this brand of tea was good.

I enjoy this Tea very much. If you like your tea a little sweet add a 1/2 teaspoon honey, sugar or whatever you use. There isn't any of the bitterness I'd heard about as long as it doesn't steep for too long, 3 - 4 minutes. All in all a nice flavor

My wife is a hard case. No matter what she tries it either takes longer than most people to work, or it doesn't work at all.This tea seems to work for her, although not as well, I'm sure as it would on other people. She's lost a few pounds using this tea. So if you're normal, you'll most likely lose more.

This tea and the brand has been the top quality I was searching for. The tea is delicious and very fresh. I will go so far as to say it is the most delicious tea I have tasted! I was impressed how quickly the tea was shipped.
This TADIN ARTICHOKE TEA is great. My husband has a cup everyday. It arrived in perfect condition. It arrived sooner thanI expected. Thanks so much for the healthy option.
I bought this as a gift for my boyfriend who collects Pez dispensers, and he appreciated it.

This tea is amazing. I love it. I didn't think I'd like it, especially the chocolate/mate notes, because I hate coffee and I've found that tea with chocolate tends to have a coffee taste to me and I don't like it. But this is awesome! It's beat out my usual morning Earl Grey and I'd certainly drink a lot more of it if it was easier to find. Amazon appears to be out of it. Two other sites I tried ordering from were out and the store I originally bought it from said it wasn't part of their regular inventory and wasn't something they were planning to stock again. I think Tazo hates me. This is the second tea of theirs I've fallen in love with and can't seem to get my hands on.

column9: delighful, surprisingly original and great tasting tea!!
column10: I have been long-time fan of the Earl Grey Tea...  I love drinking tea, and have tried endless variety over the years...  and I always come back to Earl Grey...  there is such a simple, yet powerful magic in the taste of black tea with the citrus flavor of bergamot...(and of course, not all the brands deliver the same standard of excellence, there are some Earl Grey brands, that taste as bland as any generic black tea...)All right, that being said, discovering this Tazo Focus was quite a delightful surprise.  I just randomly bought it in a store, that I could not later remember, and when I was ready to buy another box, I was not able to find it in any of the stores I usually shop at - that's why I turn to Amazon.  As usually, I was not disappointed, and I found it here (except I had to buy six-pack, now that's quite a supply of tea!! :).Anyway, the combination of orange essence and cocoa peel is surprisingly tasteful and delectable, and in a lot of ways reminds me of really good Earl Grey in it's uniqueness.  I do not regret having to buy the whole six pack, as I have already gone through one of the boxes in less than two weeks.Bottom line - love the taste, and would recommend it wholeheartedly to anyone who likes delicious and unique tasting tea!!

column9: Love this Tea, Hard to Find
column10: I'm generally pleased with all of the Tazo products. Their packaging keeps the teas from going "stale" which is a problem I've had with other specialty teas. This blend is very pleasing and not quite as strong as "Awake" which is also a favorite of mine and not quite as bluntly fruity as some other black and fruit mixes. Much more interesting than Earl Grey although I love that too. I found this one first at Target and when they stopped putting it on the shelf I started the web search. I was so worried it was going to be discontinued I bought a 6 box case. I hope they do not discontinue it as it is really part of my routine now.
Helps wake up in the morning and offers a good alternative to coffee.  Gives a nice deep aroma and has a very pleasant taste.

Delicious and full of enough caffeine to be a viable coffee alternative. I looked at lots of physical stores and couldn't find it. Just here on amazon. It's kinda expensive here though. But worth it. A great tea!
I purchased this product online because I could not find it anywhere in stores (had previously purchased at Target). The product came quickly and was exactly as described.

I also discovered this at a giant-sized Target (the smaller Targets don't usually carry this, and the giant Target runs out) - and fell in love with this! This is a dark tea with smooth RICH QUALITY cocoa and orange undertones. I prefer stronger tea - so I steep two bags in 12oz of water, then add a couple of ounces of milk. (I recently developed itchy rashes to Splenda, so am bummed that I can't drink this as sweet, anymore!) The "darkness" - and the "caffeine" level - is moderate-to-moderately high, compared to other teas. It was virtually impossible to find this at local stores, so I ordered 15 boxes online (I think it was via an Amazon seller offering free shipping - and came out to a little more than $3 per box. At first, I thought I was going to have to give boxes away, but I loved this so much that I'm down to the last box! I go through weeks of craving this stuff! (When I'm not drinking this in the early morning, I might drink TAZO "Awake" with a Mighty Leaf "Vanilla Bean" +/- a Mighty Leaf "Chocolate Mint Truffle" . . . or a Lady Grey or an Earl Grey . . . just to give you an idea of what tastes I lean toward. I love the flavor of rich coffee - with a little cream - more, but my stomach and skin often can't handle the acid and caffeine, so I am always looking for a rich full-bodied interesting tea that can fill the bill! :)

Finally two great tasting teas. I picked up these two teas on a whim at Target. The flavor of the TAZO FOCUS was so different and I think it is the cocoa petals. I reviewed the TAZO tea site and did not even find them there. I sure hope they do not discontinue them. They contain Mate' which I have been meaning to try but the flavor of Mate' by itself is not great.

I love this tea. I live in Atlanta and I can't find this tea at the grocer or at Starbucks. I am a huge black tea drinker and this is the best flavor I have ever put in my mouth. My husband, who is a coffee drinker, loves this tea too. A must have for tea connoiseurs.
I absolutely LOVE this tea!!!! I wish it was more readily available! The flavors a so wonderful together. It is a great sub for coffee! :-)

Tazo's Focus tea is a blend of black tea, lemon balm, chicory, cocoa peels, roasted yerba mate, rose petals, citrus essence oil, rosemary and natural flavors. To me it mostly tastes like a mild lemony tea. It tastes pretty good with a few tablespoons of powdered milk (so it doesn't dilute the taste like milk would) and a packet of stevia. What I've noticed with this tea is how it makes the world shimmer. It is as if you are more aware of beauty when you have had a cup of this tea. I've read negative and positive things about yerba mate. So I think it is best to drink this tea occasionally and not to drink it instead of your normal tea or coffee. It is good if you want to focus on reading a good book but this tea can also make you a bit jittery from the caffeine. I also noticed that this was a good appetite suppressant. When I drank this a few hours before dinner I ate way less than normal. I was only eating a salad but made it much smaller than a dinner salad and even skipped adding the chicken. This tea also contains theobromine which is found in chocolate. Since some articles online state that yerba mate causes cancer and others say it cures cancer it is probably best to do your own research before deciding if you want to drink this tea.~The Rebecca Review

column9: makes the best prickly pear margarita

column9: Cute little gift set, but not for the serious lover of HOT stuff
column10: I picked up one of these little "spicy 12-packs" last year from a hot sauce shop in Gatlinburg, Tennessee. I've long been a fan of the Dave's range of sauces and was very taken with the little miniature sampler bottles and the chance to try out so many of their sauces for a relatively good price. The bottles live on my desk at work and I've been merrily sampling my way through them for a while now.This is a great little set that will ensure you always have something slightly different to try depending on your mood, but for the serious lover of outrageously hot sauces like myself, there is nothing new to discover here. That's not a bad thing - these sauces are all as flavorful and complex as you'd expect from this company, and with such a wide range of flavors there's something to match just about any meal. If you're already familiar with some of the hotter sauces in the Dave's range, though, what you won't find here is anything new in the way of sauces that will give you that endorphin rush that comes from a sky-high Scoville rating. By far the hottest of the bunch here is Temporary Insanity (a "mere" Insane on the Dave's Insanity scale), and I already had a bottle of that lurking in the fridge.I'm not knocking this set at all, though - it's something that will be appreciated by anyone who likes things slightly on the hot side looking to sample a few and find a new favorite. If you're like me and find yourself going out to eat and wishing the place stocked some decent hot sauce, these little bottles are the perfect size to stash in your bag before you go. I polished off my mini-bottle of Rowdy Red Chile within a few days and refilled the bottle with Dave's Ghost Pepper sauce. That bottle now lives in my purse and comes with me everywhere I go, so never again will I have to endure a breakfast that fails to blow my head off in the expected fashion!I'd love to see a similar set featuring ALL the really hot sauces in the range - that would be something I'd pick up in a second.

column9: Truly Disappointing. Product Changed. Not for the better!
column10: We have been buying Caribou Blend K-cups for a couple of years. It is a fine medium blend that we, and everyone that we have served it to, loves. We have written to Caribou and have been waiting for a response, but nothing yet (I will update if I hear anything). You will not get the same thing and this coffee is truly terrible!Deserves 0 Stars...Update - a note from Caribou Corporate:Thank you for taking the time to contact us.We certainly apologize for any confusion. Recently the packaging for Caribou Blend K Cups did change. Previously the regular blend had an orange band and the decaf had a green band. The new labels the regular is a green band and the decaf is an orange band.The coffee itself has not changed, simply the label. There are two factors that might be involved in the change you taste. The change in taste is affected by the time that has lapsed between roasting the coffee beans and brewing them...freshness. Also, coffee is an agricultural crop that varies with weather and other environmental factors. Our Roastmasters put in a lot of time and attention to provide a consistency when roasting the coffee beans.We do apologize for any confusion and please let us know if there is anything else we can do for you.Sincerely,LindaCaribou Coffee Customer RelationsThe coffee is Dramatically different, but they will not admit to the change. Oh, well. Goodbye Caribou Coffee.

(Yes, you can just cook it in the water that it's been soaking in!)  I added a little sea salt to the mixture and gave it a good stir.Made 2 very delicious servings.

Amaranth tastes bad.  Like intense corn taste, too intense.  I threw away the product I didn't cook.  I think I'll end up throwing away the rest of what I cooked.  I mixed 1/4 amaranth to 3/4 rice, and prepared it like rice.

I have an unreasonable love of these little cubes.  They're easy to fix, completely portable (as in, you can take them camping with ease), versatile (I use them to flavor meat dishes, rice dishes, and pasta dishes, for example) and best of all, the mushroom flavor is just right.  Not too subtle, not too strong.  And it's not just some generic cheap white button mushroom flavor, either, but a rich, meaty mushroom flavor I associate with the more exotic fungi.  It might seem odd to rave on about some stupid seasoning cubes, but as a hard-core mushroom lover, this is one of my all-time favorite products in the kitchen, and an indispensible backpack item for cool-weather outings.

As a vegetarian, it's sometimes hard to build complex flavors in soup.  Meat is very flavorful.  But these little cubes solve the problem for me.  The flavor is rich and authentic, and the intensity of flavor is just right - not salty, not to weak, not too strong.  I use these in barley soup, asian soup, "meat" loaf, "meat" balls, anything that needs a rich flavor.  They make a great and easy home-made ramen noodle bowl, as well.  These are better than any vegetable boullion I have found in any brand.  I wish they weren't so hard to find!One thing to note is that these do list MSG in the ingredients.  If you're sensitive to MSG, these are not for you.

If you have never tried these Telma cubes in mushroom you are really missing out.  I use them when making a pot of soup.  Doesn't really matter what kind.  You just have to know that you do not add salt until the soup is done otherwise it probably would be too salty.  It just takes your soup to another dimension.  Everyone that I tell about these cubes loves them.  You can also use in other things but just must be careful about salt.

It's hard to get my hands on these little buggers living overseas with the military.

I really like these Tender Bits, fried in just a little butter.  They are quick and easy as my vegetarian replacement when I'm cooking chicken or pork for the rest of my family.  Good with gravy, poultry seasoning or any of your other favorite seasonings too.

Tender Bits are a variety of seitan/wheat meat and replace chicken breast in many recipes.  They are best prepared sliced and sauteed until crispy with olive oil and garlic, and spiced according to taste.  Prepared in this manner, they make an excellent topping for rice or pasta dishes, and are especially good when finished with barbeque sauce.  What's great about Tender Bits is that they can be kept on hand in the cupboard instead of the freezer, where many a package of seitan has met its untimely end.

I am not a vegatarian.  I tried these based on the reviews. I wanted something that was low in fat/carbs/other bad stuff.  I need to lose weight and I love other soy products.  So, gave it a try.  This has become my favorite Loma Linda product.  I add them to everything where I need meat or more substance.  I use in stews, pizza toppings if sliced thin, chili, spaghetti, even small tidbits in a salad.  They take on the flavor of the sauce they are in, but better than tofu because the texture is firmer. If texture is hard to get over you might not like them, but if that isn't an issue, this is a great product with so many ways to use it.  Great chicken substitute if you are in a rush.  Microwaves well.  I love them.

after reading al the reviews, i tried this product and do not like the consistency. I found that if i cook it in the microwave for a few minutes before using in recipes it is slightly more palatable. this is not my favorite chicken substitute - prefer the fri chik over this product.

I make these and non-vegetarians beg for more.  I'm forbidden from bringing anything else to potlucks.I first ate these in a stir fry and they were terrible.Then, after re-reading the reviews, I drained them, patted them dry, and dredged them in a flour/paprika mixture and fried them til dark golden.  They're amazing dipped in BBQ sauce, honey mustard, a hot sauce/butter mixture, general tso's sauce - you name it.  DELICIOUS!  My friend's love them and none of them are vegetarians.  Even my extremely picky vegetarian husband will eat them.

This stuff tastes really good.  It browns well.  I put it in stirfry a lot.  When my family cooks something, when they're putting the chicken in the vegetables, I'm putting the tender bits in the vegetables.  It can also be breaded and fried or marinated and grilled.  Sometimes I just eat it straight from the can.  Great for vegetarians.

I had very low expectations and resisted ordering these for a while, given that there was no way to test them out through Amazon short of ordering a case, and none of my local supermarkets carried them.  Finally, I caved into curiosity, and was it ever worth the wait.  These are just incredibly delicious.  I find myself eating them straight from the can, but they're much better when fried up with a little sriracha and soy sauce.  The five-star reviews are no accident.Don't expect a perfect chicken replica, like you can get in some vegetarian restaurants.  These have the consistency and flavor of a chicken dumpling, although they're pretty versatile.  Cannot recommend highly enough.

I love love love these. I wouldn't ever consider them a chicken substitute, they are unique. I had a roommate once who was a Seventh Day Adventist and she introduced me to them and I got hooked. When I moved from Fla, I had to search high and low to get them. Now my health food store orders them for me.I don't know if anyone else eats them this way, but I just stir fry them in water on the stove and dip them in ketchup. My mouth waters thinking about them. My 12 yr old loves them too.

I just chop them in the food processor with some celery, add some Nayonaise and pepper, serve on a roll or bagel, and it's great! The only problem is that they are so good I keep eating them right out of the can while I'm making lunch!

These make a great addition to stir fry. I've also just dipped them into sauces after frying them (breaded or not). Can't beat the nutritional value or the taste with any other canned chicken substitute I've found.
I ate this stuff before going vegetarian a few years ago,and I eat it a bunch now. Low fat,packed with protein,super versatile in cooking and tastes great. Highly recommended!

Oh my gosh, I followed some suggestions and dipped in flour and cooked in Olive Oil and seasoned with salt, pepper and garlic powder. I then put ketchup on my plate and was so amazed at how good these are. I will keep my order flowing and hope to never run out. This is the best meat replacement I have ever tried.
My husband loves these. I'll bread them and bake in the oven, he loves to dip them in homemade ranch dressing or homemade tarter sauce.
This product is excellent - I dipped it in a little beaten egg and rolled in bread crumbs and lightly fried in olive oil -- they are a wonderful vegetarian meat substitute.

I was going to call my review, "I Love These," but someone had already done that! I eat them from the can when I'm cooking with them. I cut them up for stir frys and soups, and I slice them for sandwiches. They're good instead of chicken in a sandwich, but they are small and can fall out. How about a tortilla with avocado spread on it and some lettuce, wrapped around some Tender Bits, whole or sliced? Add pepper and/or onion! Although I am a strict vegetarian, I have a sensitive digestive system, and I turn to Tender Bits when my system is irritated. I have been eating these by the case for years and am glad to find them on Amazon!Update: After being diagnosed with a small breast cancer, I learned that soy protein concentrate, a main ingredient in Tender Bits, is a controversial ingredient. To put it simply, foods with this ingredient are "processed food" and should be eaten in the amounts one would eat any processed meat or other food. Vegetarians should be careful about eating too much processed vegetarian foods. Soy has an important relationship to estrogen, which means that vegetarian women and especially those who have had estrogen-positive breast cancer should learn more about it.I have not had any Tender Bits in many months, but I keep a can on hand for special occasions!

column9: Why such a dramatic price increase?
column10: I order these quite allot and they last me for a few months.  My last order was March 4, 2010.  I purchased "Loma Linda Tender Bits, 19-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)" for $46.80 & "Worthington Diced Chik, Fat Free, 13-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)" for $52.43 Sold by: Amazon.com, LLC.Now Amazon wants $62.95 for the "Loma Linda Tender Bits, 19-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12) and $63.57 for the "Worthington Diced Chik, Fat Free, 13-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)".  Why such a dramatic price increase?  Especially in this economy?

column9: So good, in so many ways :)
column10: The beautiful thing about Tender bits, is that they are so flexible.  They are great battered and fried, bread crumb coated, chopped up and put in a sauce, soup, stew, etc.  They have a very mild taste, so they go with anything.  They seem to be an excellent sub in any recipe that calls for Chicken, BUT they are not like chicken. Don't buy them thinking "Hey this will be just like chicken".  It's not.  They are their own entity, and a super yummy one at that.

This chicken substitute is flavorful, browns well, and can be dressed up any way you like. I often brown them in olive oil with a little garlic and onion powder and some coriander and then toss them in a salad. But  you can do anything with these and they taste great.
Very nice product for the strict vegetarian.  It does need to be seasoned though, maybe a little garlic and salt and lemon pepper.  very tasty.

column9: OK, but not as good as other Loma LInda products
column10: I would rate this product as just OK, but not as good as other Loma LInda products. I love the Salisbury Steak and the Big Franks, but this one is a big disappointing. It has no chicken flavor, but is useful as a protein substitute and tastes very bland and OK. I would also like the same amount in a case, but in smaller cans.

column9: Great Tasting Vegan Stuff! I applaud Loma Linda to come out with Vegan and Vegetarian alternatives.
column10: Great Tasting Vegan Stuff! I applaud Loma Linda to come out with Vegan and Vegetarian alternatives.In this world of meat eating people, thank you for giving the world a choice to be free of killing animals.
I looked all over in every health food store for this product..found them on Amazon & paid way less that I would at the store, plus free shipping!  Very Happy

Very nice product.My kids loves it.It has very nice texture. Being vegeterian i like this product very much. But I wish it has less sodium.After saute itbecome very salty. Other vise this is the best vegeterian alternate. Thanks.
I love Loma Linda Foods and I have been eeating all my life. This is a quality product. I wish I could order by the can as a case lasts a very long time, I would like variety in my order.
A great substitution for chicken or scallops in stirfry.  Look forward to using more Loma Linda products.DomSun City, AZ

I'm new to Veg lifestyle and dishes, but had to give thes a try and was very pleased with the ease of preparation and with the taste.  Though probably not exact, to me, they tasted very similar to chicken tenders.  I coated six in flour and fried as suggested, then I dipped them in ketchup which is probably cheating, but they were very tasty.  I would love to experiement with them and add spices and such to give them an extra zing, but they are very tasty and filling as is.  Amazon delivered very quickly.  They seem a little pricey at a little less than $4 a can, but I guess they go far, with six cooked, being 1/4 or 1/3 of a can.  I highly receommend them.

column4: Donna's Reviews "I Love Shopping on Amazon!"
column10: Shaped like Mushroom Caps and similar consistency.......Loma Linda Tender Bits, 19-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)....I paid $70.45  for 12 of these I also bought several of the other products from this brand....They are Heavy ALL were shipped in On large box...SEVERAL cans have HUGE dents in them...

As a lifelong vegetarian I have consumed many "fake meats" over the years. The Tender Bits are among my family's favorites. While they have a pretty decent flavor by themselves, I often rinse, drain, slice and use in stir fries, soups, pasta salads, etc.This stuff is relatively healthy too, as far as being low fat and high protein. If you want to negate all that healthy stuff, try rinsing the Bits, rolling them in bread crumbs, then deep frying at 350 for about 4 minutes. Delicious! We Even my carnivorous guests enjoy it!

Is there some reason, still, even today, when we know better, that canned food, even Vegan canned food, is so salty we could use it to repel snails and slugs?If you want to make these palatable, soak in clear water for a few hours before preparing - after soaking they don't taste half bad.

Just like I remember my grandma used to make for me as a special treat. Batter in cornmeal and light sautee. Great on the go meal with some fresh fruit. It even tastes great served unheated. The only way to make this better is to use organic soybeans.
Good flavor but strange texture. Some people compare this to meat, I wouldn't. Tender Bits are in a category of their own. Buy one at the store, not the whole case.

column9: Uh whoops I used the wrong review for the last item.
column10: If you want to see my review for tender bits you will need to go to the Loma Linda Vegie Burger.  Now I'm reviewing the vegie burger and it's great too.  Use just like any ground meat.

These things are great!  I fry them, use them in salads, eat them from the can, and bake them with pizza or barbeque sauce with melted cheese or cheese substitute.  I've even cut them up and put them on pizzas instead of meat.  I've ate them all my life and was thrilled when I saw them on Amazon.  I can't afford them very often but when I do I go wild over them.  Thanks for having them AMAZON!

I love these, they are tasty and easy to incorporate into your favorite non-chicken recipe!  I like the texture and the flavor is good too.  I wish they were easier to find.  I have only been able to find them at Amazon.  I would love for Worthington/Loma Linda to bring back their TUNO.  That is my absolute favorite food in the world and they discontinued it.
Recieved my order quickly, unfortunately, Loma Linda Linketts were shipped instead of the Tender Bits. I was so in the mood, these are so wonderful fried w/ a little crisp around the edges.

If you've ever eaten real meat, or you are currently a meat eater trying to go veggie, this is not the product for you.Putting aside that this stuff doesn't taste like chicken (forgivable because it isn't chicken); it does taste like a cross between cardboard box and dog food.  It's a sort of brownish color, a terrible texture (like when you cook chicken and there's a bit of cooked blood--imagine someone sculpting a patty out of that).I coated and fried mine.  It was so awful that none of us could eat it and we ended up going out for dinner.

column9: A gluten-free, highly nutritious addition to cooked cereal & baked goods.
column10: Among the basics I keep in my pantry is this sprouted organic golden flax seed powder. Shelf-stable, it allows the home baker to make a gluten-free version of the Cornell triple-rich baking formula by substituting sprouted flaxseed powder for the wheat germ. (Unfamiliar with the Cornell triple-rich formula? It's simple: In the bottom of a one cup measure, put 1 T soya flour, 1 T dry milk solids, and 1 tsp wheat germ. Fill the rest of the cup with sifted unbleached enriched flour.) You can, of course, add it in addition to the wheat germ.I routinely add 1 scoop (2T) of this product to each 1-1/2 to 2 cups of dry whole grains when I make cooked cereal.While I rarely use commercial mixes for baked goods & pancakes, when I do, I add up to 1 T of this product per cup of mix.IMHO, the product has a pleasant, light aroma. No one at our table has ever found it offensive, either in cooked cereal or in baked goods. Vegans and vegetarians will like the fact that this product is a good source of omega-3 fatty acids.
If you like sprouted flaxseed this product is outstanding.  It does not need any refrigeration and is sweet in taste and is delicious on your cereal.

column9: It tastes as bad as it smells
column10: I was really excited about this product b/c I put organic milled flax in my kids oatmeal and eggs everyday and was excited about a sproated flax at such a great price, you can barely notice milled flax but this has this really strong odor and taste, even a teaspoon in my kids oatmeal and they wouldn't touch it. Bummer! I gave it 2 stats for the concept.

I'm so glad I found this - plus with the subscribe & save it's a huge deal for what I love to have post-workout. I sometimes throw it in a salad too!Great to mix with a ton of spinach, a banana or mango, avocado, & some hemp milk/coconut milk/water. Never agave as agave is evil (it's a myth that it's a healthy alternative to sugar but that's another topic!).Anyway, if you can find a deal on the Protein 70 by this company, JUMP ON!! There's so much sweetened protein product out there, this is a great relief & extremely healthy. Enjoy!!

I love this product by Manitoba Harvest. I used it instead of whey in my blender drinks. It's great with a banana, ice, bit of soy milk, 2 tablespoons of the powder and agave...you can switch it up by adding cocoa or peanut butter to it too. With both of those add-ins, the hemp isn't really noticeable by taste (only with the color of the drink)...but after a while making it like that, I'm pretty used to the taste and can have it without the add in ingredients too.It's a great source of protein for people who don't want whey or, like me, don't want to overuse soy as a protein source.They have organic available in this product, but the regular one is made with out pesticides and isn't GMO...I have yet to try it in other things like sprinkled on salads (it has a gritty/nutty taste) or baked in anything...

I consume Hemp Protein on a daily basis and it's so convenient not having to worry about running out and ordering more with your subscription service and the savings are great with it. This is quality protein at it's best I think !

This protein powder is fantastic!  It contains alot of protein, no sugar, fiber, and the wonderful omega's that our bodies need plus lyciene and lots of other beneficial nutrients.  It makes into a great smoothie, but I like it blended with plain almond milk.  The flavor of the product is very pleasant.
I really like that it only has one ingredient. It is easily digestible and taste great with mango, chia, unsweetened vanilla almond milk and hemp hearts.
Hemp is the only protein smoothie i will make and drink. Nothing else on the market does what this does for the body.
Great quality, no issue with taste though I mix it with a bit of organic cocoa and one tbsp of honey.
I would not order this product again. It tastes awful-no matter what I mixed it with you can'r get rid of thefishy taste. Now I have two containers I wasted my money on.

I purchased this product for Martin Jr., my 12month old grandson. Well. it turns out, that due to the portabililty and easy clean up. my daughter is able to place these great treats on his stroller tray and he is as happy as can be. he especially likes the sweet potato puffs.
What Can I say about these puffs, my baby loves to eat theme so a happy baby is a happy mommy. i recommend Gerber Puffs!

Was browsing around as what to purchase for my 7month old kid in terms of snacks, and my friend recommended these puffs. I was hesistant since my kid doesn't have teeth yet, but she loves them. They chew with their gums and she doesn't choke on it. You just have to monitor them at all times.
My daughter is on the High School swim team, she has a bar a couple of hours before the meet, they give her the added energy to perform her best.

Skip making brownies, walk right by the chocolate cake, taste one of these for a healthy and delicious (ok, somewhat ecstatic) experience of chocolate flavor. The "Dutched" Cocoa and Chocolate Chips gives this a deep rich chocolate flavor while the roasted soybeans give a little crunch, like almonds. These bars are naturally sweetened with cane juice and that enhances the flavor significantly. Fig paste almost makes these romantic. A touch of sea salt brings out the flavors perfectly and this is an excellent choice for indulging while maintaining health. Clif bars are still the best health bars on the planet! The Carrot Cake and Apple Cranberry are also favorites.~The Rebecca Review

I have tried to stay off of sugar and white refined things for years but giving up the occasional sweet delights was hard.  This amazing "smart sugar" has changed my life and brought better health and freedom.  Not only have I been able to stabilize my blood sugar which is critical for my weight control and all disease for that matter as Jorge Crews so succinctly presented in his best seller, The Belly Fat Cure, but I have found that substituting Sweet Matters xylitol crystals for sugar in all recipes has completely stopped newly developing joint pain.  Since xylitol, unlike sugar, does not stimulate my pancreas to release insulin and is alkalizing in my system instead of acid producing like sugar,it has been a huge factor in keeping the inflammatory process at bay in my body. Oh yes, this smart sugar is huge in Europe and been the healthy alternative for years. Not only is it not bad for me but it has many health giving benefits. Got to love it!!!

I have been a big fan of xylitol crystals for quite a while but now my children are having to deal with the sugar issue with their own kids. With so much refined sugar in foods today, what a great healthy alternative to use in baked good and any time you need sugar to sweeten what we are putting into little bodies. There is no difference in the taste of a great pumpkin pie - I actually got rave reviews for the best pumpkin pie ever this Thanksgiving. I highly recommend switching to Sweet Matters for the health of the whole family.

Sweet Matters pure xylitol crystals is like gold to me! I started reading and learning about xylitol several years ago....I have been looking for a healthy all natural sugar substitute I could use the same as regular sugar for years. I finally found it in "Sweet Matters" pure xylitol crystals. I use it for baking, coffee, tea, and anything else you would use sugar. It dissolves beautifully and makes all my cakes and baked goods taste incredible!...and I know I'm making healthy sweets for my family. I Love this product and will always use in place of refined sugar. Anyone looking to change their health habits and eat healthy start with xylitol. People use and eat way too much refined sugar products. Xylitol tastes just like sugar but doesn't have the risks eating refined sugar does to our bodies. .
My vegan honey and I love this stuff!  The review that said it has no flavor is way off base.  Perfect amount of flavor.  I'm buying more right after finishing this review!!

column9: I love surprises! (when they're this good)
column10: I love perpetual kid! When I open the box the first thing I see is this four-eyed, green, duck-billed platypus, lobster alien finger puppet thing with staring back at me with a packing peanut in its mouth and the first thing I think to myself is "I love whoever took the time to put this in here".Now for the part of me that is logical and not amused so easily: the package arrived incredibly quickly! It told me it would arrive around the 19th (the package tracker still says it's only been shipped, so they even pulled one past amazon), and here it is, in my hands on the 13th.I would have been satisfied with half of the quality demonstrated by perpetual kid, I guess that just goes to show how low standards are at some places.
Bacon pop was way overpriced and didn't taste very good. You are way better off buying Bacon Salt and sprinkling it on your favorite popcorn.

column9: I would have  kiss a pig for more flavor
column10: Yes i said that, i bought this as a treat for me  i thinking  hey i love bacon and cheese why not?ofcourse i knew it was not going to be perfect or dripping with grease but it tasted like eating an air fresher with the smell of bacon but no taste.Are you kidding me they must have tested this on people with no taste buds!
I bought a bag of this and a bag of the plain bacon flavor. I prefer the bacon cheddar! I didn't know what to expect but I really like it! And of course... will be buying again!

THIS POPCORN HAS NO TASTE. WHEN I MADE THE FIRST BAG AND TASTED IT, I THOUGHT COOKED THE WRONG POPCORN. IT IS PLAIN WHITHOUT ANY BACON OR CHEDAR TASTE. I BOUGHT IT DUE TOFAVARABLE REVIEWS. THEY MUST HAVE RECEIVED A FRESHER BACH TAHN I DID. VERY DISAPPOINTED.

column9: Not what it seems: this is a fake bully stick
column10: Beware: This is just man-made doggy junkfood.  I always try to give my dog natural minimally-processed chews and treats, she goes through a lot of bully sticks, pig ears, & himalayan chews. When I bought this, the label didn't say what it was made of & I thought it was a bully stick or other bit of dried anatomy like a large tendon. Nice that it's odor-free but the texture seemed unusual, it's sort chewy like a heavy dried dough, not tough & durable like a normal bully stick. My 20lb bicha-poo ate the WHOLE 12" stick in about half an hour. After looking it up online I discovered that this is not a natural meat product at all but a man-made "fake" bully stick. Ingredients: Potato starch, meat by product, corn starch, sorbitol, liver, cellulose, water, egg, lecithin, calcium stearate, titanium dioxide, caramel color, sorbic acid. I won't be buying a Chew-A-Bull again: Full of weird ingredients, not natural, and it does not last.

column9: Not as good as real bully sticks
column10: Quick summary:* Dog devours these things in 15 mins - no joke, they claim to be tougher than bully sticks, but they aren't even close. Not sure what they are made of, but it's pulpy inside and the dog can get through it quickly.* Dog seems to get the brown color off of the outside - it ends up looking like it's painted on, so only the white stick remains. Not sure what's up with that, but not natural.* Dog simply doesn't like them as much as regular bully sticksI have a Beagle that eats everything under the sun, but she is kind of picky when it comes to bully sticks. She likes stinky ones, and these did fit that bill, but the reason I purchased these was to try to give her something to chew on for a longer period of time, and since they say "One tough chew" on them I figured they would last for a while, but they didn't.I have to say we're going back to regular bully sticks.

I thought this was another strange creation - cheese and fish in the same cat food can.  So, I only bought 2 initially, just as a trial because, quite frankly, I thought it sounded a bit gross.  Not so!  Again, Garfield strikes again and this disappeared faster than the sardines version!  I now buy this on a regular basis and the Persian king couldn't be happier (unless, of course, he had it attached to him via an IV).  Great product, doesn't reek of odor upon opening, but a bit pricey here. Check out your local store first. Highly recommend!

I have to offset the one star, long winded review.  Anyone who has bought cat food in a store know what Tasty Treasures is.  My cats certainly know what it is!  We have been waiting for Amazon to carry it so I don't have to make the trek to carry it home.  This food is favored over all by my two youngest who lap down every last bite.  Even my dry food eater will have a couple of bites.So, while I've been waiting for Amazon to carry this product...and yes, call it cat food and not treats, please ignore people wanting to call their Congressmen!  What rot!  Do a little homework and feed your picky eaters this...they'll love it.

My brother always dries persimmons for me but couldn't this year.I bought these in hopes that they would be the same.They are great! Just like the ones I got from my brother!I especially appreciate that there are no chemicals in them,as I am allergic to the sulpur dioxide that is usually indried fruit products.Couldn't be happier!

Don't look or taste much like the fresh persimmons (since those are mostly water, and these are dried...), but are very tasty in their own right. I thought it was a weird concept at first, but got religion after the first taste.

column9: Chewy, a little sweet, and a lot addictive!
column10: These are one of my family's favorite snacks. The littles like them just as much as the grown ups. I don't care for fresh persimmons (too watery, what's the point?), but these are great. At first taste I agree they seem a bit plasticy, but then as you start munching away you realize there's a huge depth of flavor and texture and you must.have.more. Love these things!

I'm a recent convert to Bahlsen cookies, and these little wafers are a standout among a product line that's hard not to love.  The crisp. toasty, slightly nuttly wafers surround a very light, not-too-sweet creme layer; the combination is an incredible, multi-dimensional treat that would pair nicely with coffee or milk.  The only thing I would think that would make this product better is a resealable package, but the wafers aren't going to last long once opened anyway.  The package size is good in the sense that it's enough to share with one or two other people, but if you eat the whole thing yourself it's not an utter disaster ;)

These crackers are a great way to get whole wheat into your diet & into children's.  They are low in fat & sugar, and they taste great.  I haven't met a child yet who doesn't like them.  The ingredients are good as well.

1.  I love  Amazon's grocery/makeup/cleaning products subscription service.  It is only beta now, but I truly hope they will continue it.2.  This cookie is amazingly delicious.  I like sweets that aren't too sweet, with just the right hint of sugar.  These are cookies just like that.  Like Creme Brulee -- barely sweetened, but if it is done right, the sweetness makes it the best food in the world.  I'm not saying these cookies are Creme Brulee, but maybe they approach the creme brulee of cookies.
The Bahlsen Delobas are my favorite so far. Call them biscuits or call them cookies they are just plain good. Light and pastry like with a nice burst of sweetness from the red current jam. Try Them!

I had these cookies in Germany, but I had a hard time finding them in the US.  I was amused to discover I could order them from Amazon.  They seem to be most closely related to pecan sandies, but they're a little richer and a little moister.  I wish it were possible to order a single box instead of 12, but I already knew I liked them, so ordering 12 wasn't really a problem.  A bigger problem is trying not to eat them all immediately.
Great texture and balance of sweet to butter is just about right. Adults and kids both love them. Recommended

column9: These cookies are $2.19 in my SuperMarket
column10: We were buying Bahlsen cookies at $1.70-$2.19 at lockal supermarket until I found that they are $1.41/box here at Amazon!

If you love the heavenly combination of chocolate and orange, then thisis a cookie to try.  Gotta have your coffee and treat everyday like moi.Well this plays well with coffee. Yum gonna have some right now....
The title says it all! These butter biscuits are DIVINE! Everyone loves them--my parents, my students, my colleagues, and, of course, me! You will love them, too!

These cookies are fabulous. Flaky, not too sweet, fluffy not gooey layers. Small but not too small. Suggested serving size of 6 is good. Lots of things these days have completely unrealistic serving sizes. I know they have sat fat but I really don't care. I have been unable to find anything like them. They remind me of REAL bakery cookies.

These are every bit as good as the other two reviewers stated. Awesome butter cookies!!! There's a lot of butter taste in these cookies and they're not overly sweet. Just right! I'll be buying again when the 12 pack runs out. Amazon please make sure you keep these in stock on a continuing basis!

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column10: These Bahlsen Butter Leaves are the best cookies! Not too sweet, not greasy, soooo "just right!" Order extra! They go fast!
I love this chocolate covered cookies. The chocolate is pure and tasty. Not too sweet.

These cookies didn't disappoint.  They are delicious and go really well with a cup of tea or coffee.  They have just the right amount of sweetness...not cloying.  (I think American desserts usually go overboard on sugar).  I highly recommend them.
Love these tea biscuits. The price was great for a box of 12. I hope you continue to carry.

i tried bahlsen chocolates in europe, but you can't find them very often in the states. these are unlike any usa chocolates i've eaten, the wafer is wrapped over itself 4-5 times. you can't beat the crunch these make, delicious.

Many of Bahlsen's cookies are too sweet and floury for my taste, but these light flaky cookies don't taste stale and are not too rich but are nice and do not taste like sugared cardboard.  I don't crave these but when you eat them, you realize that these are better than the average boxed cookies and unexpectedly delicate and fresh tasting given the supermarket price.

The title says it.  Some of the cookies arrived with the chocolate melted.  Others were stuck together or had the wafer separated and stuck to the chocolate top of the cookie below.  It appears that the box was a little overheated and banged around somewhere along the way here.  It was 65F here when the package was delivered.

Having grown up on these cookies I was pleased to see that they now come in the more healthful whole wheat version.  Same great taste...light on the sugar...even my husband who hates sweets will eat these with his ice cream.

Rich, dark chocolate thinly covering a tart orange marmalade-like substance on a soft sponge cookie. It melts in your mouth and leaves you wanting more. Chocolate and orange are an addictive combination.  There are other brands out there of these sponge cookies, but the Bahlsen brand is by far tops in the quality of the ingredients used.

Have always enjoyed Balsen products. Found  the nuss-dessert cookies while on vacation at Sanibel Island Florida. We were really excited to find them on Amazon, we had searched through out the Chicago area since last April.They are the best. Taste like fresh hazelnuts and are great with either coffee or tea. (or later with wine).So good that I bought a case, but they are reserved for special moments(like now).

This is without a doubt the most incredibly addictive packaged cookie in the world. The dark chocolate dipping at one end is a great contrast to the rolled wafer of the cookie itself. Why did I ever buy a whole case! Bless Amazon for carrying the Bahlsen line of fabulous cookies because it is not available in Montana.

If you are looking for a sweet, try this cookie.  It is extra lightand has a nice crunch to it.  I buy these cookies by the carton.They last for one month between my husband and I.  He likes cookieswith his morning coffee.  We are both satisfied with these cookies.Would buy them again and again.Mary
These are soo good with a nice cup of coffee. They are light, buttery and very flavorful with the finely chopped nuts.
better than grahm crakers and they do not spike your blood sugar (at least not mine.)

Once you try this piece of chocolate you will fall in love with it. Probably one of the best nonbar chocolates produced in Switzerland and Europe as a whole. And I think it is rather cheap for the quality you get.
We've ordered for them every month and only once the package inside the seal had a small hole and wasn't as fresh.

The first time had these cookies was when I visited NYC.  One box of these cost me around $7, so when I found these on amazon.com for about $1.40 per box, I was so exstatic!  I could eat an entire box without feeling full of sugar or guilt.  Perfect with tea as I am not a coffee fan.  There are several reviews that I have read that were complaining about the number of boxes they received (12)- it says right in the product title how many boxes come in the order!  Do people really not read anymore then turn around and have the gall to give a bad review just because out of pure stupidity they failed to read what they were actually ordering?  I am appaled by some people's idiocy until I remind myself that I live in the United States.  Besides, why would anyone complain at $1.40 per box?  I HIGHLY recommend these to anyone, I would give 10 stars if I could.  Oh, and be glad they come in shipments of 12 boxes, they will be gone before you know it!  Thank you, Amazon!

My husband and I have been buying these cookies locally for years because we love them so much; they are far better than the milk chocolate version (but then, we love DARK chocolate!). In the past couple of years, our local grocer has stopped carrying them, we would request them, they would get them for a few months, and then they would stop carrying them again. I am so glad to see that I can get them via amazon.com! These are wonderful cookies with warm milk, cold milk, or a little Scotch . . . mmmmmmm!
This product was delivered on time and included more than I thought I was going to get - a full 16 packages. I first purchased these in England and have loved them ever sense.

column9: I love these cookies. Found them in Sherman .Texas need them in Centennial.Co. Albertsons had them in Sherman.  Sssooo good!!
column10: Will always buy these if I can find them. Hate to have to buy from Germany. Need a grocery store.
I was not very happy when i recieved my order. All the cookies were melted. Very good product. Word of advise. Don't buy any products in the summer time that will melt.
I grew up eating these cookies.  Got a case for a great price.  Will be looking for them again this fall.

Leibniz cookies are truly my favorite, beyond what I make, I am a passionate cook. The whole wheat version of these are particularly superb with a subtly greater flavor than the original and a lovely, slightly more crumbly and grainy texture. It has been a wonderful discovery. Bon appetit.

column9: Great cookies--don't buy in the summer
column10: These are positively the most delicious cookies ever--smooth milk chocolate covering meringue biscuits.  However, when we received them--albeit in the Texas summer--they were fused together in the packaging. They are now not only less attractive, but also hard to eat.  So I would not recommend ordering these in the summer with the way they are packaged by Amazon.
It tastes perfect. I like it.You would "feel" the butter in the cookies.
Great cookies.  Not overly sweet as most American cookies can be, with a hint of citrus.  Could not ask for more.  There is only 12 or so cookies in the box, but a decadent treat.

column9: YUM- like a perfect Rice Crispy
column10: If Rice Crispy bars were made with good chocolate, and didn't taste like wax, they might taste like this.  Wow- What a yummy treat.  These are coated with a LOT of chocolate, and for me are more like a candy than a cookie (and I don't have a problem with that!)  I would not have wanted to order them in the summer, because I feel sure they would have melted.  The chocolate taste is wonderful, and I love the crunchiness.  The Sell By date is not until 9/2010 a full 8 months from today (1/21/2010), so I'm pleased with their freshness.  I don't think they will last very long in our house, but still, it's nice they are fresh.  These are packed very well, so they should not arrive crumbled or damaged in any way.  My cookies are perfect.  If you like crunchy chocolate treats this is for you!  Delicious!

column9: Great- and good Sell By date
column10: I'll start with something really important to me- the sell by date.  I bought these cookies in January of 2010, and they are good until 9-2010, which is important to me, since I hate eating rancid food, so I just throw it out.  I've always loved these cookies, and my market sells them for much more than the subscribe price, so I'm happy to subscribe and save.  I love currants, and it's hard to find things flavored with them.  I have to admit, the currant taste is not strong, but they are delicious anyway, and I love the puff pastry.  Further, I'm allergic to GMO corn starch (genetically modified corn starch)- and just try to find cookies in US stores without corn starch (and 95% of all corn is modified in the US, and does not have to be labeled so).  So these are a real treat for me- since they are a cookie I can actually eat.The cookies are flaky, as puff pastry always is, and slightly sweet.  As other people have said, this is not a terribly sweet cookie, but it is quite sweet enough.  I enjoy mine with tea, and I also take them in my lunch.  If you take them in your lunch, put them in a little box- because they ARE delicate, and you might end up with delicious crumbs if you don't protect them.  I know this because I squashed them once.

This very crispy sugar wafer is perfect with ice cream, or with coffee or tea.  It's got a lovely burnt marshmallow flavor.  I really like these- they seem to harmonize with anything.  I'm allergic to GMo cornstarch, so it is hard for me to find cookies I can eat.  This one is lovely, and it's safe for me to eat.

These have a delicate, nutty, warm, faintly sweet wheat flavor, and a pleasing texture.  Satisfying without guilt, they're truly addictive.  I prefer them to digestives (much less Graham crackers), and even Leibniz's standard butter biscuits don't come close.  The whole wheat is especially good with green and pouchong teas - though predictably satisfying paired with a cup of Assam or English Breakfast. Also great with cocoa or milk, cheese or apples.... a slather of peanut butter..... !They're one of the few biscuits I'd definitely offer to children.
these cookies are a perfect treat....very light and crunchy wafer sweetened by  the right amount of chocolate....great price and fast service

If you've had these cookies already - no one needs to sell them to you. I would just recommend that you keep them in the freezer. That way they're sort of hidden from you (and others) but for some reason freezing them brings out the taste and consistency of the chocolate. Try it!

column9: Bahlsen Dark Chocolate Cookies -  A Treat
column10: I don't know what Bahlsen was thinking over the last several months, but I looked high and low for these cookies in supermarkets and specialty stores...none were to be found. Then, after checking with Amazon (and its tracking mechanisms), Voila! I ordered a whole case and that should satisfy our deep appreciation of these cookies... a perfect blend of high quality dark chocolate and a crisp, thin "chocolate vehicle"--i.e., cookie.

These are great!  And they can get to be habit forming if you are not careful.  I bought the whole case, because you save overall  versus going to the supermarket.  Very rich dark chocolate, crisp cookie.  Worth every penny.  Oreo, eat your heart out!

These cookies are just wonderful!!! The chocolate is deep, dark, rich and melts very nicely in your mouth.  I would say that it is a bittersweet chocolate and very finely made. These cookies give the chocolate lover a satisfying chocolate experience. Do not hesitate to buy them!

These appear to be, on first glance, similar to Nutter Butters.  On taste, however, they are lighter, more delicate, and infused with hazelnut.  There is more air in the cookie, so when you dip it in coffee, it becomes saturated rather quickly and the cookie folds into your mouth, with the sweet center taking center stage.  Nuff said.

I am very happy with Amazon service including the speedy shipment. I am also very happy the product Amazon is carrying. This product is only available in selected specialty stores in the area. And tend to be expensive. Sometime they only carry small selection in store. You have to wait long time for a special order. Amazon is making the product available with a wide selection of variaty and affortable. Thanks.

A light and crisp flaky cookie surrounding a brightly flavorful nugget of jam. The only problem - I can eat a whole box without stopping to breathe! And buying them by the case makes them very affordable. My next order is already in...

I first had these cookies at our Oktoberfest where they were giving out samples.  I loved them and could not find them at World Market so I went to the internet and found them available at Amazon. They are very light and flaky.
When we couldn't find these in our local grocery store anymore, we were very glad to find them available through Amazon. these are light and delicious and a true treat!

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: Rich, but delicate,  hazelnut (filbert) cookies that everyone likes !
column10: Buy more than one box - these disappear fast! Bahlsen Biscuits are elegant, impressive, and delight everyone. I keep some on hand for unexpected guests and these "Hazelnut Biscuits" have never disappointed anyone! (Betcha YOU could eat a whole box yourself!)

column9: Oh, so very very very VERY good
column10: I LOVE these cookies.  Most cookies are too sweet for me -- not these.  However, since they follow the  European trend of using  natural ingredients, they are full of saturated fat from butter and cream.WHO CARES?They are the best cookies, for me, in the world, comparable only to"Feullitees Doree," which can be bought on in France.

I bought these cookies for myself and as a gift for my dad for his birthday. Unfortunately, 2 out of 4 of the boxes I gave my dad as a gift had mostly broken cookies, and were stale tasting. Not a great gift idea, and not really packaged or handled well. I have bought the delice cookies in the past and had no problems other than a random broken cookie in a box. I have not opened all of the boxes yet of course, but will hope to find a couple that are not all broken up to give to my dad.

I really like these cookies.  They are made with pastry dough - lots of thin, flaky, crispy layers with a very light coating of honey (or something like honey).  The jelly center rounds the cookie out with a delicious bite of sweetness. It's a robust burst of flavor that makes you want to smile. I am rapidly getting addicted to these fine flavorful confections -- bet you can't eat just one!

I am an adventurous person who likes new things and when Amazon began selling the Bahlsen line I tried a number of their products and found them to be enjoyable and tasty, but the Hannover Wafer Cookies are, to my palate, rather bland and tasteless. The texture is pleasing, though a little grainy tasting and the creme filling has little flavor. They're very high in saturated fat, and  devoid of flavor..Think I'll stick with the Bahlsen Delobas'.

Bahlsen Butter Cookies,4.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)Very Disappointed with your service and deceptive listing of the product ingredients. i am allergic eggs and as per your listing, there is NO mention of eggs and when i received the product, on the box the cookies one of the ingredient is EGG.Also i emailed not send me any cookie with EGGS

column9: Hazelnut (Filberts) in a fragile crescent shaped tea cookie.
column10: Delicate ground hazelnut cookies for a Ladies tea, NOT for children or most men! Appreciated only by sophisticated palates, because they are neither cloyingly sweet or fatty. Set these aside for unexpected guests you'd like to impress.

Amazon sends you TWELVE boxes of these fabulous cookies and each box disappears FAST - in fact, DO NOT sit down with the whole box nearby or you will munch thru all of them without stopping! They are delicately sweet, crunchy, and buttery - without being at all greasy. You've been warned!

We used to have a Greek restaurant in our area that made Gyros.  It has since closed.  I was very excited to see that I could order the ingredients to make Gyros myself.  The meat & cucumber sauce were absolutely delicious.  I will order these products from this company again.
You have to try this sauce,i have brought similar sauces in fine gourmet stores but they don't compare.It's great....
