Great product. Good company. Only one problem. Containers are not marked with a experation date.

been everywhere buying gyros and this sauce is by far the best ive had. i would recommened buying 1 at a time though i ordered 2 of them and they stacked them on top of eachother so the bottom lid broke off and made a huge mess so i only had like a little more than 1 lb. of sauce after the clean up! but the flavor is unbeatable!
Very good.  Had  a good taste and consistency.  Was fresh and a good buy

At first I thought that ordering Gyro sauce over the internet was kind of wierd, but it turned out the be pretty good. It came when they said it would, and it came cold with ice packs. The taste was a little more on the pickled side, but i used it with pizza when i ran out of ranch dressing.

The shipment arrived warm.  The 3 small ice packs (not dry ice) melted completely over the three days of shipping.  What's worse is you don't get your money back or the product replaced.  Evidently standard shipping negates any food guarantee-don't do business with this company.

The parcel arrived earlier than promised, perfectly chilled and packaged. above average size and quite a few were collosal. Not a sigle bad one. Blump and sweet. Far exceeded my best expectations. Highly recommended to oysters enthusiasts. Enjoy. Fathy Sedky,Los Angeles, California

Perfectly packed with a years worth of gel ice, every oyster was fresh like we had spent the 59 dollars to drive to the ocean...  Metallic, flinty, a bit salty, just a hint of earth on the finish.  These are at least 1/2 to 1/3 the cost of ANYONE else on the web. I only hope they can continue at that price!  Great job, Amazon and oyster guys.

I had a little issue that didn't have to do with quality but with Fed Ex delivery which Charleston Seafood resolved to my 100% satisfaction.  This is a quality organization that provides a quality product and quality service!

I have ordered these oysters twice now. Very fresh and delicious but a little on the small side. But a very good value with the shipping included when you live in Wisconsin and can't get fresh seafood of any kind here. We received approx. 100 oysters in each shipment.

These were a part of my first venture at shucking and cooking oysters. I had the opportunity to share with my 9 year old grandson and he picked up on the shucking fast. It was a great experience! The oysters were great and there were plenty of them. Now I can enjoy Uncle Bubba's chargrilled oysters and save the 6 hour drive to Savannah. (The recipe is on his website and Food Network's website.)I'm ready to order my second shipment. The only questions I have is how do I properly store them when they get here and how long will they last, if properly stored?

column9: Love / Hate Feelings  - EDIT: Now more love than hate
column10: EDITED to reflect new order; original order from 2011 was 3/5 stars, this new order gets 5/5.---------------------------New review:I re-ordered these oysters a couple months ago. I'd give that new experience more than the perfection, 5/5 if I could.There were some issues with that newer box that came to me. I reached out to Charleston Seafood about it; the issue was more than resolved to my satisfaction. Oysters were delicious, packed securely, and it was a great time to eat!---------------------------Original review:On a 5 star scale, I figure:1 = terrible2 = not good3 = neutral4 = great5 = amazingIf I could, I'd rate my overall experience a 3.5 / 5, but, decided to default down to 3 and not up to 4. Here's why:POSITIVES first. Ordered on a Thursday, and received Friday, the next day, even though I paid for two day shipping and not overnight. Package was labeled 'Saturday Delivery,' but UPS must have been ahead of schedule. It was great for me to receive one day early but I can't credit that to seller.Oysters were packed very securely in a foam cooler, with a nice, handwritten 'thank you' written on the invoice, with instructions on how to handle / store / prepare miscellaneous shellfish included.Most importantly, most oysters were of a fairly substantial size, ALL oysters were still good and were very fresh and tasty.NEGATIVES second. Oysters were sold by weight and not count. I received 56 pieces; at the current sale price, this comes to $1.16 per oyster, which is about 16 cents more per piece than I would pay if I would buy just one Grade A oyster at my local fish monger, who sells oysters for 99 cents each.  Unfortunately, these oysters are B, C, or even D grade oysters; they are NOT of the visual quality you would receive in a restaurant and are probably a good bit 'uglier' than you would buy at your local fish market. Most are either: barnacle encrusted; have deformed shells; have grown into broken shells of other oysters (a franken-oyster of sorts, which weighs a substantial amount but is still only one edible oyster); etc . . . Further, my package contained a decent number of mismatched broken shells; that is, broken halves that did not have their other broken half in the same box. Lastly, the oysters arrive filthy, much more so than you would find at your local fish market or grocery store.OVERALL IMPRESSIONS. The oysters were delicious, and packaged securely. They were fresh, which is really important. However, they are grade B or below oysters; these sell for MUCH LESS than restaurant quality oysters do (I've seen B grade sell for $20 or less for similar sized bushels). It really perturbs me that I had to pay by weight and a decent amount of weight was taken by broken shells, a decent number of franken-oysters which comprised of maybe 4 full shell halves but only 1 edible oyster, and silt / filth / mud. However, I do realize a substantial amount of my purchase price went to the 2 day shipping cost. I get that. Ultimately, ordering oysters in this manner is a novelty, much like ordering lobsters by mail from Maine and spending much more than retail. But, here, the premium for getting them delivered to your door is not too high; chances are you won't be able to purchase B grade oysters near you, so you won't be able to take advantage of their much lower price point.For the cost, I will probably purchase these again; it was enjoyable to receive and prepare these oysters, and all were fresh, which is of the utmost importance.

The oysters arrived very fast and in good condition.  They do arrive dirty but a quick scrub gets them ready.  As a big fan of oysters I was looking forward to trying a different variety then the ones we get in the west.  I found them tasty and well worth the purchase.  Sizes shipped were consistent and no disappointment.  Will purchase again.

column9: Just like when I was a kid
column10: Oysters came quickly (to Kansas) and very well packed. I ate several raw and did notice a little more silt than I would like but overall not bad. There were upwards of 50 nice size oysters with only 2 dead ones when we cooked them 2 days later. Free super saving shipping was unbeatable. Next time I'm ready to relive my childhood of living in florida and having oysters cooked over an open flame, this is my place!

I was recently in Charleston and loved the oysters so decided to order via Amazon. These are not the same type that I had so didn't know what to expect especially with the little info you get via the product description but am very happy!Got order in less than 2 days very well packed with tons of ice packs. Took me longer to open the carton than it did to shuck an oyster and enjoy it. I rec'd 75 huge osters! 1 doa. Some were as big as my hand! You do need to do alot of cleaning. These are fresh out of the ocean as is. Do what I did and buy a good scrubber and a shucking kit. I ate the 1st 2 raw as I had never eaten they raw before and they were very good. I then steamed some and overall very good though of course not as good as going to Charleston and eating them just harvested.You just can't beat the free shipping and when I went to the same seafood website they wanted $125 just for the shipping.So expect a foam cooler filled with yummy oysters and enjoy! I wish the seller would provide more pics, a much better description and some instructions. I would if I were the seller. These are not shucked as stated in the description. They are live intact and well worth it. TY

This is an exceptional value. The oysters were ordered as an X-mass gift for my father. They arrived on time and in good condition (ice packs frozen). The oysters were not clumped together and were clean.  Yes, there was some silt, but that is to be expected. Those expecting perfectly clean oysters should go to an oyster bar. I asked my father to rate the oysters and he said they were "great".

Due to the oil spill, we were unable to locate fresh oysters locally.  The oysters were a good value.  They arrived in a very timley manner.  When they say bulk, raw oysters....they mean it!  Although I feel they could have been picked a little better.  It appeared as if they just shoveled them out of the sand and shipped them.  They were definately worth it though.  A few were dead, but that is expected.  The live ones were delicious! and recieved extra, I'm sure to account for the ones to die in transit.  Will definately order again.

column9: Fresh Oysters magically appear in the middle of the farm belt!
column10: 20lbs showed up, packed in styrafoam cooler with plenty of gel/ice packs as promised.Only 1 dud iA the lot, and he may just have been unmotivated... (very good percentage !)Flavor was good, both raw and fried (with cornmeal in a shallow pan).Amazon Prime Shipping made it quite a good deal!Next time I think I need about twice as many..

I bought these for my brother last year and he LOVED them and asked for them again this Christmas.  They arrived today and there were no single oysters in the entire box.  There was a big clump that were all grown together and were impossible to try and open most were empty, but some have an oyster on either the one grown to the bottom or to the side - they were impossible to open.  I am beyond disappointed and am humiliated at the gift given my brother.  Last year's batch was wonderful - this year - beyond awful.Definitely won't order and make the mistake again.  Seriously, how do you send people oysters to someone when they are not singularly in the box?  I am so disappointed.  If he hadn't spent hours getting out the few he did, I would have told him to send them back.  So awful!!!!!!!

I purchased this item based on a customer review indicating they received approx. 100 oysters. My 20 pound box contained 56 oysters. At $59.00 and free shipping, 100 oysters is a great deal. At 56 pieces, regardless of size, my per piece cost went out the window and suddenly, this is not a good deal. Suggest you buy oysters on a "count" rather than weight basis. I now realize this is the only time I bought oysters this way. I've bought gulf oysters at 100 count per box and 150 count per box. Locally, I buy Pacific oysters at $.67 per piece. These are from Washington state and Vancouver, B.C.. That is a per piece, retail price. Select and bag yourself at a local fish market. Also, the shipment contained no "Harvest Tag". I believe this is a federal requirement. In the event you become ill, the source of the oysters can be traced. Won't buy again.

column9: Awesome for a midwestern family who loves oysters!!!!
column10: I normally don't write reviews, but we were SO happy with this product and service!  After reading some of the other reviews, I was nervous about what we were going to receive.  However, we were VERY happy with the size and quantity of the oysters and they were extremely delicious!!!  We received 85 oysters and I think only one was "iffy" on whether it was dead or not.  Living in the midwest, we don't have a lot of options for "fresh" oysters, so the price and quick service were perfect for us!!!  Even the cleaning and shucking was kind of fun since it's not something we get to do very often!  We will definitely be ordering again!!!  My only advice is that the company does not ship over the weekend, so I ordered on a Friday night and did not receive until the following Wednesday.  Not a big deal, but not something that I realized until after I ordered!

These oysters come covered with mud and sand and barnacles but they tasted like I scooped them out of the sea myself.  My husband and I ate 18 each on the night they arrived and two days later I fried up the remainder with some Panko bread crumbs.  They were unbelievably delicious both ways. They are not the pretty little ones you get at restaurants.  They are butt ugly but fresh and tender as can be.  My friends can't believe I buy oysters on Amazon.  Wonderful.

They arrived before expected, which was not an inconvenience luckily as I was home to receive the product!I read and re-read all the reviews on here about the oysters and decided to take a chance. I am glad I did!They arrived wonderfully packed with ice packs, of course you have to eat them the same day as soon as possible. I never intended these oysters to be eaten raw half shell. I tried one, and it was not up to par freshness wise (DUH) and they were always intended for the grill. As I was hosing them down in the backyard on my patio with a garden hose and attachment, I thought once again of the complaints people had that they are full of silt.Well, nothing worth doing is ever easy. So I lovingly sprayed each one, giving them a once over, and it gave me the chance to pick out ones that were open and toss the meat into my vegetable garden as fertilizer. Out of the stack, only 4 or 5 were bad overall (from sniff test) If you work for your food, it tastes better. Regardless, the oysters did not arrive any more clumped than at a restaurant, nor were they absolutely covered in silt the way they are just as they are fished out of the Charleston bay. If you are expecting them to be grocery store clean, you by all means pay grocery store price. Some of them had gorgeous shells and the barnacles were shaved off. Thank you so much!Now the sad part, I did find that the oysters lacked any kind of noisette. I didn't overcook them on the roaster, even when I had the two raw, it failed to excite me the way blue point or kumamoto does. They were also cleaned to the point that all saltiness in the brine were non-existent. I had to toss some fleur de sel over each one to bring back some sort of saltiness.There was a point where I was shucking the roasted oysters and was smelling some really ripe ones. I thought there would be a really nasty oyster in there that I had missed, giving out this foul garbage pail odor. It turned out, in fact, to be my 23 month old son, walking past me with a stinky diaper. I had to laugh!!!So as a recap, I would buy from them again when I have another oyster roast, I wouldn't get these for eating raw, I love the prompt delivery, and the product arrived in excellent condition!!!

column9: Can't be more fresher than this.
column10: Oysters arrived very quickly. They needed some cleaning with a brush but that just shows that they were just harvested. They were large and plump, and had a fresh, great, mild taste. Ron, the owner, corrected a slight problem that wasn't his fault. He is a great person do deal with and I would highly recommend buying anything from Charleston Seafood!

I had way too many too small pieces that I ended up not eating. I don't think they are ready and should have been left alone until they grew up. I have been looking for decent Oyster for some time now, beating the Sunday branch at one of the Casino near by and this one wasn't good enough. It's better than up scale seafood restaurant near by but wasn't worth it. Nice packaging though. Maybe I just had bad luck but I don't intend to find out...

These were the dirtiest, filthiest, silt-ridden oysters I have ever bought in my life. Even after scrubbing, it was almost impossible to open the oysters without getting silt inside. So many of the oysters were stuck together, and they were so barnacle encrusted it made shucking VERY difficult. I spoke to the owner Ron before ordering, and since he had been so nice on the phone, I called him to tell him of my experience and he offered to make amends when I told him that I wanted to buy some shucked oysters. But instead of $20 with free shipping, Amazon's price is now $25 plus $22 shipping. Wow!Buy oysters at your local fish market or supermarket where you can pick out your own. I would never buy from this vendor again.
Renaissance Man's review was spot on. They were filthy, stuck together, my 84 year old aunt couldn't break them upapart.

These Oysters arrived the next day as promised. But they were incredibly nasty with dirt and the smelled like rotten fish. I had to throw the whole box out (I pity the garbage man having to smell that!)

I was on Sanibel Island, Florida and I tried this for the first time in my life this past summer.  It just made my mouth explode in flavor...it is the best drink I have ever had in my life, hands down.  I don't even like cherry flavored anything, but with the black cherry flavor mixed with the lemonade, I couldn't get enough.  The price here on amazon is a little high, but I can not find a store around my house (illinois) that carries it.

column9: Ranch Corn Nuts Are Better Than Freakin' Ninjas
column10: These Ranch Corn Nuts are so good it's incredible. I can never find the ranch flavor at any stores, and when I do, they cost more than the price I got on Amazon. They're absolutely addicting, and are great for parties, as a snack, and taste great with beer. They are not very high in calories, and are better for you than most other snacks. This is the official snack food of Ninja's, and should be consumed with caution.
it is very hard to find corn nuts in any store. these are excellent and would recommend them highly. i will buy these again

I've always been a huge fan of Cornnuts, so when I saw them at amazon, I couldn't help myself! It's a great deal, you get 36 packages for around 20 bucks - I usually pay a dollar for one pack at my local grocery store.  And its a great way to satisfy your munchie needs!  That being said, I think that ranch is the BEST flavor they've got out, followed by the chile con limon one.
They came super fast :) My hubby had to have them, I mean come on they better be good if he is buying Corn Nuts in bulk... hahahaha cracks me up.

The Ranch flavored Cornnuts are the best flavor offered!  Everyone in our house, as well as other friends, agree that these are a winner.  The Ranch taste is right on mark and he perfect balance of seasonings and saltiness.

They are very crunchy and very good!!  We first bought a package at a convenience store while we were traveling.  We could not find them at the grocery store, so we ordered them from amazon.  Great for packing in luch boxes!!

I love this stuff! It's filling and simply delicious! Yes, the raisins are a little hard, but I think it's because it's free of preservatives. Doesn't bother me a all. As another reviewer said, I could live off this cereal.

This granola is the only one I have consistently liked for years now, it is simply better than any other granola I have ever tried! I am glad I can get it on Amazon since it's a lot cheaper here than at the grocery store. I never had a problem with it being stale at all, in fact the best before date is always several months away on all the shipments I've received. Give this a try, you'll love it!

column9: Perfert granola for those who don't like cinnamon
column10: I am a big fan of granola but had a hard time finding a granola cereal without cinnamon in it.  (Nothing against cinnamon -- it's just not my favorite thing.)  This granola cereal is absolutely fantastic -- it's not too sweet and it has plenty of raisins and almonds in it.  I eat it with milk or sometimes just plain right out of the box.  I've purchased it many, many times over the past several years and have never had problems with the cereal being stale.  I urge all granola lovers to give this cereal a try; you won't be sorry!

I practically live on this cereal.  Oat bran is really healthy for your heart.  Almonds and raisins bring up the taste just right for me.  I eat it as cereal and also on top of sliced bananas and yogurt. For me, at least, this is the best cereal I've found.  I buy it by the case.

I ordered 2 12-box cartons of this cereal because my family loves it and all the boxes in BOTH cartons were stale. We were extremely disappointed. Would not recommend ordering it from Amazon. Go to the grocery store and buy a box at a time to ensure freshness!

column9: Not granola in any way, shape, or form
column10: I found this by searching granola cereals and it looked interesting. However, it is mostly fluff, can't hardly see the almonds, and what raisens there are are hard and stale even though the box claims they are coated in glycerin. Won't buy from this company ever again.
Does a good job on our dogs.  Smell isn't half bad and it makes their fur very soft.  Also does a lot to prevent dander.  Using this with Allerpet-D (or similar) works wonders to fight pet allergies.

My dog recently has had a dry, itch, flaky back.  After reading about several shampoos, I decided to try Fresh n Clean Medi-Cleen.  I used it for the first time, following the directions given.  I was surprised to see how well it worked.  All the flakes were gone (when I shampooed him with regular dog shampoo, the flakes remained).  The shampoo has a fresh smell, not some flowery scent that would seem most unnatural for a dog.  His fur is nice and soft.  I'm pleased with my choice, and I'll be using for as long as my dog needs it.

column9: fresh n clean medi-cleen medicated shampoo
column10: My order arrived exchanged, I asked with a picture of Sharpei and what arrived was with the photo of a Pit Bull, who arrived this is not indicated for skin irritation.

column9: A very good alternative to Cholula
column10: This is a great Mexican hot sauce. It's very cheap at Walmart. It tastes similar to  Cholula hot sauce, which is much more expensive. It does not taste like Frank's Red Hot. I dunno what's up with that reviewer's taste buds. It has a slight chipolte pepper taste and is darker red compared to Cholula.Overall: highly recommended.

This is a much cheaper substitute for Frank's Hot Sauce. The tastes are very close. Tabasco is mostly heat to me. I like being able to put sauce on Mexican or Cajun food for the flavor. With Tabasco I find a sprinkle gives the heat but there is too little to really flavor the dish. Valentina is great added to enchilada sauce. I like the vinegar addition to tomato sauce and cumin.

For quite some time, I have been using different types of hot sauce on different types of food.  Before I started doing this, I only ever remember using hot sauce on barbeque sandwiches.  Even though I have tried numerous types of hot sauce during this period, Valentina Salsa Picante Mexican Hot Sauce has set itself apart from the others.  It has a good flavor and is neither too hot nor too mild.  This is a product that I can recommend.

I copied this from a post I wrote on my blog a while back. I only changed the price to XX.This has become my preferred hot sauce. I had never heard of the brand before but saw it on the shelf at WalMart maybe a year ago and bought a small bottle to try. I really like it so it is now what I use mostly as hot sauce, several times a day usually. It comes in regular and extra hot. I have tried both and prefer the extra hot, although it is not that hot. It is about right for me. I go through a bottle or 2 a month.Ingredients: Water, Chili Peppers, Vinegar, Salt, Spices, 0.1% sodium benzoate as a preservative.As an added bonus, the 1 liter bottles are <$XX. Made in Mexico. it comes in a smaller bottle as well, but I get the 1 liter size. I have one at work and one at home.

This is just so delicious. We consider food just a vehicle for this sauce. Not too spicy, has a nice flavor and the large bottle is huge! I bought a jar for my husband for Hanukkah (yes, there will be Valentina flavored latkes this year). We cannot find it where we live and are grateful it is on Amazon. The shipping was super fast and the bottle was wrapped very well to prevent breaking. Thank you.
this in the only way i can get this salsa in japan. thank you very much for providing this product.
A coworker from El Paso turned me on to this.  His whole family eats this and I can definitely understand why now.  It's great if you like hot sauce and not as expensive as some others I also like.
The product is great, I used to get it at Wal-Mart...but they quit selling it.  Shipping and handling is twice as much as the product - that kind of annoys me, but I ordered anyway.

column9: Too much vinegar in this variety. The "extra hot" version (look for a black background on the label) is much better
column10: Warning: there is a significant differences between the regular Valentina reviewed here (a yellow background on the label) and the "extra hot" version (black background on the label).The regular variety of Valentina hot sauce is heavily laden with vinegar. Yet, if you like a lot of vinegar in your hot sauce, you might really like this one. It tastes very much like Frank's hot sauce or even the original Tabasco hot sauce (once diluted). Unless you like a heavy dose of vinegar, this variety is Not Recommended. But keep in mind that a lot of vinegar is what many Americans are used to and may actually prefer.The "extra hot" version is much better balanced in my view.  The vinegar is in the background and while this variety is a tiny bit hotter - it is far from being "extra hot".To tell the two versions apart - keep in mind that the regular variety has a light yellow background on the label while the so-called "extra hot" version has a black background on the label. In very small type, on the "extra hot" variety, you will see the words "extra hot" but that is easy to miss. Use the label background to tell the two versions apart.Make no mistake, the two versions of this sauce are worlds apart. The regular version has a heavy vinegar taste and the hotter version, which is not much hotter, is far better balanced in my view. See my review of the "extra hot" variety for more comments.

This is a great tasteing product that is a lot cheaper at COSTCO and you get 8 cans of the same size. It's sad the food stores don't have this item in the stores. The regular pineapple you find in the stores isn't sweet like DOLE TROPICAL GOLD.

column9: Awesome product....not worth the shipping cost
column10: $32 for shipping.....seriously???!! No thank you I'll just get it from my local health food store

Some people thing those who like this BBQ sauce must be the devil...I'm not the devil, not even a devil, but I sure love this Cattlemen's Kansas City Classic BBQ sauce.  If you like BBQ sauce with some tang and a great flavor, then this BBQ sauce is a winner for all those devil-may-care people.

I lived in Kansas City and this NOT Kansas City BBQ. There is no hickory taste and the spice is too hot. The devil might like this but I certainly don't.To top it off the seller refuses to refund my money. Don't buy from this seller!

I enjoy the Breadshop Granolas because they are not too sweet nor hard. They remind me of muesli, but are not as complicated (separate fruit flavors) and the oats are less "raw" tasting. The dehydrated fruits quickly re-hydrate in milk and taste like what they are - real fruit!

column9: Healthiest granola and not too sweet!
column10: This is the best granola I've been able to find on the market.Other granolas are too sweet, too oily, too dry, or mixed with fillers such as rice or corn flakes.  Yuck!The Breadshop granola includes no added sugar or molasses, and is flavored with fruit juice, raspberries, and soy milk powder.Very highly recommended for someone who wants light and healthy granola.

I use to buy this at health food stores and some supermarkets at a higher cost of course. This granola has an excellent and tangy flavor, is filling, and as I said has no sugar of any kind. It's sweet enough as it is with just the dried raspberries. Umm good and tasty indeed!

column9: The only granola with no refined sugar!
column10: This is a wonderful product!  Great tasting and without refined sugar.  Just the perfect sweetness!

Breadshop's Raspberry 'n Cream Granola is the best breakfast treat going. Not only is it a healthy food, but it's a delicious way to start the day. We  travel quite a bit, and I can't always find a store that stocks it. That's what led me to Amazon.com; not only do they have it, but the service is great and I save money, too.  Breadshop's has a full line of similar granolas, no matter what your taste. Mine happens to be the Raspberry 'n Cream. But there's more Breadshop's Granola to try. Check out their selection. (save me some Raspberry 'n Cream).

Breadshop cereal tastes good and is healthy.  I've eaten it for years.  Downfall is that it's way too expensive.I don't understand the expense.  Terrible to have to pay nearly five dollars for one 13 oz box.

I absolutely love this granola! It is both delicious and healthy. With 33 grams of Whole Grains, 4 grams of fiber, and 5 grams of protein in each 1/2 cup serving, it packs a nutritional powerhouse with a fantastic flavor! I like it best after a workout with a 1/2 cup of milk and banana chopped up in it. I can't wait to try the other flavors. I'm sure they will be equally as delicious!

column9: Great All Natural Option For Those Watching Sugars
column10: Breadshop's Granola is super-tasty and all natural. It is sweetened with Chicory which is great for us, as we avoid refined sugars and artificial ingredients. It is a staple on our Subscribe and Save because it is peerless!
This granola is the best ever! It tastes delicious and is a healthy choice for breakfast or snack time.

I love the flavor of all the Breadshops granolas, not just this one.They go great in yogurt.They do, however, tend to get very clumpy and I have to pound thebox on the edge of the table to break up the "rocks" before eating.I've had this happen with three different flavors now.

column9: Excellent Variety - All Good Coffees - Price Steep at $.83/cup
column10: Here's what you get.  Four each of:Green Mountain Breakfast BlendGreen Mountain Colombian Fair Trade SelectGreen Mountain Sumatran ReserveNewman's Special BlendDonut House CoffeeTully's House BlendTully's Italian RoastTully's French RoastCaribou Coffee Caribou BlendAll excellent coffees (both bold and medium) so this is a good combination for company coming or to try out new blends.  The price is high but it always is higher for variety packs.  You can get some of the blends (Donut House, Newman's, Caribou) for $.50 a k-cup at Sam's Club in boxes of 50.

This is another item that I buy in bulk.  The price for the 3 lb. 7 ounce tub is a bit high, as it works out as close to $10 a pound.  It is listed on the container as having 216 pieces, which is close to 15 cents per piece.  It always pays to shop around.  Amazon lists a variety of prices for different weights.  It does not seem as sticky as some other forms of taffy, which might be a plus for some people.

These are my favorite type of Jelly Bellies. I had been eyeing this product for some time. After a few glasses of wine, I decided that this was a must buy because its price per pound was much lower than a single pound of this flavor. The price is still pretty high, but it is about the same price as buying 5 single pounds. I have been snacking on these for a few months. They are still around, and I still love them.The product arrived in a cardboard box with the jelly beans directly in the box. No plastic bag or anything, just the shipping box filled with jelly beans. I am not a huge germaphobe, but would have preferred a better container than the shipping box. This was the only reason why I docked it a star.

This product -eg the 35 lb bag- just DOUBLED in price, from 35 to 63$ for a 35lbs bag. Strangely the price for the 17 lb bag has remained unchanged..Delivery was prompt (prime), but on opening the bag the rancid smell was overwhelming. Granted it is still summer, but this bag must have been in a warehouse storage for some time.Aside from the rancid smell, it looked as advertised, small kibble without coloring, ingredients said to be all from the US.However, there is no justification to grossly overcharge for it.I will not reorder for that reason. And because the heavy rancidity of this product.http://www.amazon.com/Hi-Tek-Naturals-Chicken-Formula-35-Pound/dp/B004TMGRLG/ref=sr_1_2?s=pet-supplies&ie=UTF8&qid=1348333106&sr=1-2&keywords=hi+tek+dog+food

I am so glad Amazon had our brand! After our distributor went out of business, I couldn't find Hi-Tek anywhere! We switched our two Cattle dog mixes to Hi-Tek from Blue Buffalo after it made our 9-year-old gassy. This food is all natural and made in America (even the packaging is made in the USA) and I can get a huge bag of Hi-Tek for $20 less than other natural brands in the pet store with Amazon's free shipping. When I forgot to order more food and had to get another natural brand at the pet store, my dog turned her nose up at it and waited until we got the Hi-Tek in the mail (the next day) to eat!I don't know what I would've done without Hi-Tek! Natural food on a budget.

This is one of the few dog foods that agrees with my puppies, and it has great high quality ingredients and value! I am a college kid who worries about her pets health, and this is a premium dog food at a great price.

I have purchased this product several times and is now the only dog food I use. I needed a dog food that was grain free as my breed does not tolerate corn and other grains. I end up feeding both my dogs a smaller quantity and so the food goes a lot further.

column9: DOUBLED IN PRICE WITHIN A MONTH!!!
column10: I bought this dog food a month ago for 31$ it is now priced at 64$! What kind of company jacks up the price like that? I can buy much more high quality dog food for much less then this, plus better ingredients! Noone is going to pay that much for this dog food!

My 4 stars is for the original price!!! I bought a 35# bag of Hi-Tek Naturals Lamb Meal for Less Active and Large Breeds in 10/6/12 for $36.80. Only a week later it is OVER DOUBLE this price ($76.34 on 10/11/12)?? It is a good dog food, but for $36! It is not worth over 75 dollars! I hope they get such a decrease in revenue that they revert to their original price.As for this food itself, I do like Hi-Tek brand and have tried multiple foods. My dog likes all of them fine, and her stools are smaller, less frequent, less smelly. The fat content of this Less active formulation is 12% as opposed to the normal 16% ( Hi-tek chicken meal with sweet potato is my comparison, $47.38 for 30# on 10/6/12, $45.99 for 30# 7/7/2012). However, the protein is decreased from the normal food - this one is 21% and normal food is 32%. I believe this is a reflection in the decrease of the quality of ingredients. The first five ingredients in the Less active formulation are: Lamb meal, pearled barley, white rice, brown rice, whole milo (another grain) followed by pork meal and some vitamins. Seems to me, a smart person would just buy the regular food and add some rice! The first five ingredients of the regular formulation are: Chicken meal, sweet potato, peas, pork meal, egg followed by duck meal, salmon meal, and a bunch of fruits and vitamins.Bottom line: love Hi-tek, kinda upset about the price changes, this food is not worth a penny over the original formulation even though you get 5# more. In this food they just cut protein sources and fruits and added more "filler" like rice.

This brand of food works great for all three of my dogs, ages 11, 9 and 2 yrs.  Since feeding I've noticed a decrease in the number of stools in the yard and they are all maintaining a good weight throughout the year.

I highly recommend Hi-Tek Naturals!  Originally, I thought that my foster Great Dane was a picky eater, then started feeding him this food.  Now he leaps around like a puppy when the kibble hits the dish.You can't beat the price for the quality of food.  On top of that, free shipping?  Awesome!
My Saint has a sensitive stomach and this food is great.  No intestinal problems and solid.  Both of my dogs seem to really like it and the price is right on Amazon!

column9: Tastes good, but not like Banana Chocolate Chip
column10: Having made some banana bread last week, I was expecting this bar to have a similar taste, with a bit of chocolate added.  Wrong!  The box says this includes 1/2 serving of veggies based on the pumpkin it contains, and I would say that there may be more pumpkin taste than banana. The 1/2 serving of fruit comes from apples and bananas, and the apple content seems to exceed the banana as well, since the first ingredient is apple puree.So what DOES it taste like?  I'd say it is a dense, spicey bar with a bit of gingerbread taste going on.  The chocolate is barely detectable.  Once I get over the fact that the name does not fit, the bar is flavorful enough.  Plan to drink something with it, as it feels a bit dry.

column4: Mark P. Sadler "Reviewed by Mark P Sadler"
column10: I opened the package as soon as I got home wanting to eat a little something to give me an energy boost so I wouldn't bonk as I headed for the swimming pool right after work. The box had been sitting in 100 degree heat in my mail box for several hours and they where all moist and warm, almost like being fresh from the oven. They where delicious so you might want to try them in the microwave .. would go great with a glass of cold milk, and only 130 calories. Definetly going with me to work for mid afternoon snacks.

As a regular consumer of Kashi Go Lean Cereal, I thought I would try this banana Chocolate Chip Bar.  Very gross flavors, and as one reviewer said, tastes like burnt bananas with no extra flavoring. Definately not worth the calories. I'll pass on this, hopefully they can come up with something with some better flavors.

I got one in the mail today as a sample. I was worried it would have an artificial taste but it was soooo good. Tastes like banana bread with chocolate chips. It's not fair they got me craving them and you can't buy them yet lol. I will definitely be buying these especially being they are only 3 points on weight watchers.

I received a sample of this Kashi Chocolate Chip Chewey Snack Bar in the mail today and just finished eating it...It was absolutely delicious, it didn't have the fake banana taste that I fear and all of the flavors complemented each other perfectly. The bar made for a perfect desert, satisfying my sweet tooth...can't wait for them to be available!

for about the worst-tasting product i have even tried in the last 10 years... how this bar even made it into production is beyond me... there was a burnt, stale taste comparable to overcooked ginger bread...two stars off for a nasty, mealy, and flat tastethe caloric/ingredient info is printed in pale white on a yellow panel on the side; if you wear glasses, good luck trying to read the listing off the shelfanother star off for a poor, rookie package design (and yes, review weenies, package design is part of a review)i had to pull out a magnifying glass to read the ingredients; interesting to know that this product contains many if not more of the same polysyllabic chemical ingredients found in consumer and pet foods from the 'Big Boys,' such as Proctor and God, Con Agra, Kellog's, etc. There is 9 grams of sugar and 3 grams of protein in each 140-calorie 1.4-oz baranother star off for this 47-ingredient concoction that should have never made it out of taste-tastingwant to punish your child for bad behavior? get a box and serve a bar - this product is *that* bad - although i'm not really that religious, i think wasting food is a sin - and i threw this box out in the trash

I buy so many different snack bars for my family and never know which one will taste the best, not be so small you need to eat 2, and have the most healthy ingredients without a bunch of processed junk we try to avoid.  I may have just found it!  These bars are big enough, very tasty and filling and are healthy! I plan on trying every flavor.  I can feel good about offering these to my family and knowing they aren't just eating a glorified candy bar.**UPDATE** I now have tried all the flavors of these bars - and now these are the only bars I buy, my kids think they are a little dry - but I love them.  Would recommend for anyone who wants a healthier alternative to the "bars" out there on the market.
Well, though some others don't like...I happen to love them.  Apparently I am not the only one, since every store in my area keeps selling out of them the day they re-stock.  Delicious!

column9: If you like chocolate & bananas, this is for you!
column10: I love chocolate. Everyday as a kid my mom call and ask what candy bar I wanted that  day. She would pick it up at the snack shop at work before heading home. My day was not complete without chocolate. Of course, as a kid I played sports, ran around, and had a super high metabolism. Now as an adult i sit at a desk all day and occasionally make it to the gym. But i still love chocolate and in my quest for a healthy eating life style these bars fit in great. I think they taste very good. And they are 3 points plus if you are doing weight watchers.

I haven't done a review in a while, but after seeing multiple 1/5 star reviews I felt compelled to give my objective opinion. First of all, I'll provide some background. I am a large proponent of "all-natural" foods based upon real ingredients, rather than ones sourced directly from a chemical lab. If you are accustomed to eating other natural/healthy snack bars such as Nature's Path, Pure Bar, LaraBar, etc. you will appreciate Kashi's flavor profile. It is not overly sweet. It is also not a glorified candy bar disguised as a healthy snack; there are only 9 grams of sugar per serving. Instead, one is treated to an accurate description of a soft yet chewy bar that has a satisfying baked oat crunch. In addition, flavor notes of real banana are present with an occasional chocolate chip folded in for good measure. Buy a pack from your supermarket on sale, it's a cheap and satisfying snack with coffee or tea. I recently paid $2.99 for a box on sale at Publix (Winter Park, FL).-Joe

column9: worst tasting bar i've ever ingested...
column10: I've tried almost all of kashi brand granola bars and cereal bars so I was excited to give this one a try. It has the most sugar out of all the kashi bars so i thought it must be delicious...WRONG. I couldn't even eat half of this bar...so disgusting. Going to throw the rest of them away or something.

Blehhhhhhh. I am 100% all for natural and organic food, and I've had some GREAT all natural snack bars, but this is gross. It's really thick and dense, gross flavor of banana, reminds me of really old burnt banana bread only less flavorful and without cinnamon or sugar or anything good. Even the chocolate chips don't save this bar.

column9: Banana Chocolate Chip Bars that taste like Fig Newtons
column10: If you are a person who is used to eating healthy products, and especially Kashi products, you may very much enjoy this snack bar. But if you are looking for a snack bar that tastes like banana and chocolate chips, the name of this variety of snack bar, you may be (like me) quite disappointed.I have had Kashi cereals and energy bars and the past and have enjoyed them (some more than others), so I was shocked when I opened my first "Banana Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bar" to find that it had zero banana flavor and not much chocolate flavor either. There ARE chips in it that look like they might be chocolate chips, but even when I plucked one out and ate it by itself, I could just BARELY identify it as tasting chocolate-like (i.e., it tasted like carob or some other fake chocolate, even though "semi sweet chocolate" is indeed in the ingredient list)...and certainly, among the sweet taste of a base that tastes like Fig Newtons, the chips have little chance of standing out.I admire Kashi as a company, but I was truly disappointed and angry to have something marketed as banana chocolate chip that tasted like neither. One part of the marketing that IS correct is that it IS chewy. It has a soft chewy texture and there are some crunchy bits in there that I can't identify. Looking at the ingredient list, it could be oats or another of the "Kashi seven whole grains."The description for this product included the words "Yummy banana bread taste with dark chocolate chips, just like homemade." Uh...NOT! I found the sweetness cloying, likely a result of using evaporated cane sugar, fruit purees (apple and banana), and dried pumpkin as sweeteners vs. sugar. The weirdest thing to me is that it tastes so much like Fig Newtons but has no figs in it (which makes me now want to read the ingredient list for Fig Newtons). For the record, I love Fig Newtons...but not all the time...and not when billed as chocolate.Basic Nutrition Facts PER 40g bar:Calories  140Total Fat  3gSat Fat  0.5g (no trans fat)Cholesterol 0Sodium  125mgTotal Carb  25g (not for you low carbers!)Fiber  4gSugars  9gProtein  3gIncludes small amounts of Vitamin A and the minerals Iron and Calcium. The list of ingredients is about 2 inches long on the side of the box.The box includes 5 1.4 ounce bars and claims that these bars provide 1/2 serving of fruit and 1/2 serving of veggie.  I was only able to eat 1 1/2 bars in order to write this review. I will be giving the rest of the box to a friend. They don't contain enough protein to be effective as a protein bar and are definitely not satisfying enough TO ME to be used as a sweet snack.Not recommended unless you:1. Are already accustomed to the cloying sweetness/aftertaste of evaporated cane sugar or are already eating very healthy;2. Are looking for a healthy snack bar and don't mind the taste;3. Are looking for a snack bar for your kids that is better for them than a candy bar or a high fat snack bar; or4. Don't mind that the product doesn't taste like bananas or chocolate.

Take a big whiff of a dog food bag and smell that gross stench of nasty dog food...keep that in mind because when you chew into this bar you get 2-3 chews of banana and then all of a sudden this WAVE of dog food overcomes and I gagged and had to spit it out...that was so disgusting. Me and my husband love healthy foods, and I'm all about organic and healthy foods...but this....this wasn't food...this was something that should be given as dog treats to your pups. EW.

My first bite was just so-so. At first, I thought it had a slightly burnt flavor, but I was wrong. I finished the whole bar and thought about it. I had time to be thinking deeply about snack bars, since my sons were at baseball practice and I was sitting in some bleachers. Baseball practice is a great time to contemplate anything, like, say, world peace or the evil of fractions. I went with snack bars. I'm deep like that.These are not awe-inspiring, as snack bars go. They aren't bad though. I might buy them again. But, I really think I could whip up some banana bread and it would taste better and cost less. But, in a hurry, they're good.

column9: Put it in your disaster kit
column10: Without a doubt, no one in our home liked this product.  As another reviewer stated, it taste like burnt banannas. The product crumbles easily because it is very dry. I suspect there may have been an issue in the manufacturing process that led to the burnt taste and dry texture.If I was really hungry, I would probably eat it- hence the title of this review.

As its name indicates, these bars are not crunchy, but more cake like. The banana flavor overrides the chocolate, though not entirely, and is reminiscent of banana bread. What I found most interesting is that they contain 1/2 serving each of fruit and vegetable, a plus for any portable packaged snack, as is the fiber content. Great for snackers looking for something less sweet that the traditional granola based bar.

Something billed as banana chocolate chip seems like it would have to be pretty awesome, a sweet flavor explosion, something so good it just has to be bad for you, right? Ah, not so much. While I have little doubt this snack bar is a healthier treat than, say, a Payday candy bar or a chocolate brownie, it's also not as tasty. So if you want to feel like you're doing something good for yourself and don't mind a cookie type product that tastes a little closer to cardboard, have at it, kiddo. Kashi is right up your low carb, low-sugar, low-flavor alley. However, if you're sweet tooth is jonesing, I say give in and have some chocolate or, heck, even a banana off the tree. You'll be much more satisfied and you won't feel like you compromised.

I didn't like this. I couldn't finish the entire bar and gave the rest to my husband who will for sure be getting these in his lunch until they're gone. He thought they were okay. They have a strange flavor I can't place. They're dry but it feels as though they added something to make it seem like they aren't. The banana and chocolate flavors aren't as noticeable as I thought they should be. I won't be buying these and I wouldn't recommend them.

column9: Okay, but nothing to write home about... A little heavy.
column10: So, this stuff's advertised as "soft & chewy" and made out to be health food, of a sort.Granted it's probably better than a fig newton, since it's made with whole grain flour (oats, hard red wheat, rye, brown rice, triticale, barley, buckwheat, sesame seeds) and various kinds of grain & such. So, there's probably SOME nutritional value. But, on the other hand, it seems to be packed with sugar (apple puree concentrate, evaporated cane juice invert syrup, Banana puree, brown rice syrup, evaporated cane juice). But not enough to make up for the fact that it's also pretty "heavy," despite fulfilling the "soft" & "chewy" claim. Being honest, I didn't really taste much banana, either (which seems weird considering they use banana puree).I wanted to like these, but they felt more like eating a heavy protein bar, despit there not being especially much protein. The chocolate chips were nice. But, for some reason the little crunchies seemed kind of out of place.So, yeah, far from terrible. Not as heavy as a lot of protein-type bars out there. But not as "soft & chewy" as a fig newton or something similar, though possibly slightly healthier on account of the whole grain flour & such? So, it's a mixed bad. I guess I'd say there wasn't anything that dazzled me or set it apart from other such bars.

As others have pointed out, this tastes of BURNT bananas. Those who don't think so must have LOTS of dead taste buds or have a funky-taste fetish (it takes all-kinds to make a world).The bottom of the bars coloring looks suspiciously over-cooked, as well.Many people have come to the same conclusions on Amazon and other sites regarding the flavor of these things.I know, I know. Taste is subjective. As someone who enjoys bananas AND chocolate, this bars are an ultra-bummer....tastes like they've burned the bananas and up-chucked in the chocolate. :-L

I got these to put in my 4-year-old's lunches and for an after dinner snack. She took one bite and instantly wanted to spit it out. I tried to make her eat more of it until I finally took a bite and almost gagged. It's very dry, hard to swallow, and bitter. I would not recommend getting these, especially for children.

I was really hoping these would be like J&J Snack Foods' Banana Chocolate chunk BeneFit bars (which are only available to school food service and not retail), but they are not. They are tasty though, with a slightly burnt taste, which I figure has something to do with the dried pumpkin in the ingredient list. They are soft, with a little crunch.

Kashi's Banana Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bar is intended for the health conscious and those who prefer more natural ingredients in their snacks. The bar has great banana and chocolate flavors; however it has the texture of a dry fig newton without the gooey center. The product describes itself as having a banana bread taste. Though Kashi's bar is a fine attempt to replicate banana bread, I would always select real banana bread over this product. It's not that it doesn't do what it's intended to do, but it's hard to get past the bar's dryness and underwhelming texture. Give it a try, but as for me, I'll be walking past Kashi's Snack Bar the next time I see it in the grocery aisle.

Kashi is a brand under the Kellogg umbrella. It has a wide variety of products, though it seems to focus primarily on breakfast foods. This snack bar is actually quite tasty, tasting rather like some sort of banana-nut bread. The bars weigh in at a nice 140 calories (25 from fat), which is nice and close to 100 calories - the target for my afternoon snacks.What can I say? I like the taste of these bars, and I like the fact that they have a 1/2 serving of fruit and a 1/2 serving of veggie. I think that they make a pretty darn good snack, and I look forward to trying some other flavors!

Normally Kashi does a pretty good job with their granola bars. One that is particularly good is the Trail Mix Chewy granola bars. I have had several people try it and now love them too. But the Chocolate Chip/Banana bars were chewy, but really bland. They tasted like semi-flavored cardboard. Don't waste your money on these. Kashi--this needs a re-do.

Kashi's products are usually pretty good. However, when it comes to snack bars, these are mediocre at best.The good -- the bars aren't cloyingly sweet. They do taste like natural banana, but have a slight bitterness (some other reviewers have commented on a 'burnt' flavor).The bad -- the nutritional value isn't notable, and these aren't exactly 'health' bars. The chocolate chips, rumored by the packaging to be contained therein, are unidentifiable and not taste-able in the product. The texture is unremarkable, a bit too dry.In all, I wouldn't purchase these again. They're simply not worth the calories -- their taste and nutritional values aren't what's needed for regular purchase and enjoyment.

We enjoy Kashi cereals...  No complaints about any of the varieties that we have tried.  But these new Kellogg's Kashi Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bars are not very tasty.  Not very banana-y.  Not very chewy.  And the so called chocolate chips are not recognizable as, well, chocolate chips.  The bars are rather dry in consistency.  This product is not going to get me excited enough to get me to buy them.

this is a delicious bar!it is a perfect snack for mid-day. i particularly enjoy the chocolaty nuggets that you get in each bite. this plays off the moist, fruity boy of the bar itself. the raw oat accents provide extra texture and flavor as well.my only regret was running out of them!

column9: A great breakfast bar or snack when you need energy
column10: Now I might be a little biased, as Banana Bread was my mother's favorite snack item to make herself, but this bar reminds me of the bread she made. Some of the bars were a little on the dry side, but overall I like these. They are good for when you don't have time to make breakfast or for when you need a energy boost between meals. The Banana bread is the dominate flavor in all the bars I ate, the chocolate chips were there but not very noticeable. Personally, I would like to see more chocolate chips in my "Chocolate chip chewy snack bar". They had a consistent taste from the first to the last bar, the dry aspect didn't seem tied to how long they were on my shelf, more likely due to to how they are made. The last few did not get hard like some snack bar do, so they might be a good choice for a survival/emergency pack.Overall, a very nice snack bar, could use more chocolate chips, but very nice Banana bread flavor.

The first bar I had, I decidedly didn't like it.  To me, they didn't taste of banana or chocolate, but definitely sweet, dry, cake-like.  By the end of the box (there are 5 bars per box) they had grown on me a bit.  They are sort of like a sweet slice of banana bread, with oats on top and chocolate mixed in (although I still don't really taste the chocolate).  They are soft and chewy bars, although I found them a little dry, hence crumbly.  They are pretty low-cal (only 3g fat per bar) and boast "1/2 serving of fruit, 1/2 serving of veggie" on the front of the box.  I think you would need to be a Kashi fan to really appreciate these.  To me, they were average, hence 3-stars.

I find Kashi products to usually be hit or miss. Overall, this is a hit. Neither the chocolate or banana taste overwhelms the other and the texture is fine. This is for people who enjoy Kashi products, if you never had anything by them I would start somewhere else.

When I first tried one of these snack bars, it reminded me of other high fiber bars I've eaten over the years. The chocolate flavor is light but does add a nice combination with the banana. My wife took them to work for colleagues to sample. They ate the whole box in one setting and everyone really liked them. The most common reaction including my own is that they are a little dry, but otherwise pretty good.

I still have some and cant wait till they are all gone. Theres too much sugar in them for the meal plan i am on. The taste isnt bad but its not the best. I will say be sure to have something to drink around when eating these. They are dry as all get out. Overall just okay. Tthe banana comes through the chocolate not too much. This review will be short and sweet. There isnt a lot i can go into detail over these bars about

column9: I wasn't impressed, but my child liked these bars
column10: Nutritionally, I thought these bars were fine. 140 calories, 3 grams fat, 4 grams fiber, 9 grams sugar.  The ingredients were recognizable and include apple puree, banana puree and dried pumpkin.  Unfortunately, the taste is not very appealing.  The chocolate is barely discernable and the taste of the rest of the bar is lackluster.  It may be because although the bars use decent ingredients, there are a lot of them and it must be highly processed.  Despite my lack of enthusiasm, my 4-year-old liked these bars just fine.  So 2 stars from mom and 4 stars from the kid make for a 3 star rating.

column9: Not too bad for health bars
column10: I refuse to compare this product to something like a fruit and cereal bar.  It is a health food bar and, lets face it, most of those are horrible.  I will agree that the banana and chocolate flavors don't really come out and there is a hint of a burned flavor, but all in all, I found them to be okay.  Compared to other health food bars, they were pretty good.  I actually really liked the texture.  They were filling, fairly low calorie, and pretty healthy.  I went through the whole box in a few days and didn't share any with my kids, so that is saying something!

I love bananas and chocolate together, so this seemed like a can't miss. I like to have snack bars in the morning with my coffee, so I opened my first bar with a hot cuppa joe. The bar looked as it does on the package upon opening, however after taking my first bite I was first struck by the dryness of the bar. Really too dry, and I chose to dip future bars in my coffee. But I continued on with this bar without dipping in order to properly review. I found there was a slight burned taste to the banana, but I didn't find it that objectionable. I guess I'm one of those weird people who likes a little burn taste to food from time to time. The chocolate was fine, nothing memorable, could have used a little more. I will say it kept me feeling full until lunchtime, and it improved considerably once I dipped it to add some moisture. I probably wouldn't buy them though, and I usually like Kashi products.

I unfortunately don't have a food critic's particular vocabulary or understanding of the dimensions on which to evaluate food.  However you articulate it, this product isn't so good.  Its bland, dry and boring.  I'm sure its particularly healthy, but I won't be buying it again.

column9: Not too sweet & nice consistency...but not for people with a sweet tooth
column10: I brought my Vine sample box of "Kellogg's Kashi Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bar, Banana, Kellogg's Kashi Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bar" in to work...had my first one at break time, hoping to try out the rest over the following 2 days. But, it was not to be, because colleagues snapped up my remaining few bars. The consensus was: not overly sweet, with a nice soft (but not unmanageably crumbly) texture and consistency.So, just based on our small sample, I have to say that these are worth a try. Ingredients-wise, there does seem to be a lot of sugar, even though they are not that sweet...so diabetics might need to be careful. And they seem a bit pricey for what they are. So, we decided that a 3-star rating was fair.

column4: T. Lee "God has died lots of times, but someo...
column10: These bars have a nice consitency and taste, good and chewy, and pretty healthy.  But they kind of need a glass of milk to go with, as they're a bit on the dry side.  I think this holds them back as an on-the-go bar.  Now as a breakroom treat at work, or a little at-home snack, where something to wash it down is available, I think this'll do fine.

Whenever I try a 'healthfood' product I assume that the health claims are for the most part true - at least I assume that the snack is going to be better for me than a candy bar. Unfortunately alot of nutrition bars taste like cardboard and drive me back into chocolate purgatory. In this particular taste, I found this Kashi product tasty, crunchy, chewy, and filling. It passed my test - and i did not feel like sneaking a piece of chocolate to supplement my snack. When I went back to try another bar later, I found that the gremlins (my children) had discovered my stash. When this happens sometimes I find half-eaten bars lying in the folds of the recliner - not this time. The bars were consumed totally, wghich tells me that these snacks passed the kid test. They're not interested in health - they go for taste! Congratulations KASHI! Another winner!

I try to eat healthy and severely limit any snacking.  The Kashi Chocolate Chip Banana bar is excellent.  The taste is similar to a banana bread, though not as sweet of course.  The texture is great even though it's high in fiber.  I highly recommend this product.
Tasted ok, but had a bit of a burnt wheat flavor which I myself didn't like. Maybe it was just my particular package but I'm not willing to try another batch.Thank you very much.

This was a grat tasting treat.  The bars are flavorful and have a good banana-chocolatey taste.  I took the bars to work and had them as either my mid-morning or mid afternoon snack.  They were satisfying without being heavy.  The texture of the bar was pleasing.  Kashi has good products that balance nutrition and taste.  This product fits that description without doubt.

I really wanted to like this product but it just isn't that tasty to me.  I was hoping for more banana flavor.  The texture is kind of odd also.  It has a moist texture tho.  We love Kashi products and I've tried and love many, many things from them.  This one is a miss for me.
Banana and chocolate are two of my fave flavors. Too bad, this turned out a bit too sweet for me. Also, it really needed more crunchy texture. The bread-y consistency just wasn't my thing.

column9: A little crumbly, but very tasty
column10: I love the combination of chocolate and banana, and these bars are both chocolaty and banana-y. I do like my bananas ripe, which may come across as "burned" to some, but the banana taste is perfect for me here, and the chocolate chips add just a touch of chocolate without making the bars too sweet. Kids love them too. I just wish they held together better - eat them outside or over a napkin.

Straight out of the box, these are tasty. But...you know what's even better? Leave one in your lunchbox, in the car, on a sunny day.  Then, when it's all warm and moist, scarf it down like it's Grandma's Chocolate Chipper Banana Bread. True story. These are triple yummy when warmed up a bit. Everyone in the house--from the kid to the picky husband--loves them now.

I decided to review this product because I need more fiber in my diet.  Other Kashi bars are almost as tasty as candy bars, and I like both bananas and chocolate.  This snack bar has a pleasant soft consistency, like a soft cookie.  But I was unable to detect either a banana flavor or a chocolate flavor.  All in all, I found this snack bar uninteresting, but useful as a means of increasing fiber in my diet.

When I first opened up one of these Kashi Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bars my initial thought was that they looked like yummy banana bread bars. Unfortunately, they do not taste like banana bread. They are dense, heavy and mostly lack flavor. You get an occasional faint banana flavor & the chocolate chips are almost non-existent. They taste like bad health food bars. While I don't hate the taste, I don't like it either.Nutritional facts:Each bar is supposed to have 1/2 serving of fruit, 1/2 serving of veggies, 7 whole grains and 4gm of fiber. They claim to be naturally sweetened, but pack 9gm of sugar per bar. 140 calories, 3gm of fat, 125mg of sodium, 25gm of carbs, 3gm of protein.Given the nutritional content and lack of taste, I recommend just eating an apple for a snack. It will be healthier, cheaper and better tasting. Skip this one!

The Kellogg's Kashi Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bar Banana is a healthy alternative to junk food snacking. Aside from the its great taste and being all natural, it is healthy, giving you the half serving of fruit and half serving of vegetables in a convenient snack bar form. The 3g of fat, no cholesterol, 140 calories per bar and 4g of dietary fiber makes this an ideal grab snack for those trying to lose weight and eat on the healthier side. The only drawback I could see was the 9g of sugar per bar. Maybe Kashi can lower this to around 2 or 3 g's of sugar and you absolutely have a healthier, all-around snack. I have been a regular user of Kashi products and the Kellogg's Kashi Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bar, Banana is good but not great. With 9g's of sugar per bar, moderation in consumption is still advised.

column9: The first bad Kashi - this bar is not appealing!
column10: Like other reviewers I actually like Kashi products. Generally I find them flavorful within the allowance I make for healthier food. That means I don't expect a Snickers bar - but I do expect a good flavor. These had a taste that was bland but with a slightly bad aftertaste. The texture is fine and was not a problem. I didn't taste much of anything in it other than banana - but that flavor didn't even taste that good. No chocolate that I could determine. They are not the worst bar I've ever had but they are not something I would ever buy. I didn't hate them. If they were the last food and I was shopping for a hurricane or something I'd have to pick them up so I would not starve.Look it's 2012 - not 1990. Back in 1990 all my health food tasted, well, gross. But there wasn't much available so I dealt with it. Now in 2012 healthy food does not have to taste bland, unappealing, and cardboard like. Take a pass!

column9: mixed results from the kids, just OK, won't buy again
column10: Well, I've got two 5 year olds, and these bars claim to be kid friendly.  I like the nutritional info in terms of having fiber and being low in sugar (we try to not to get stuff with more than 9 grams of sugar per serving).  They are very soft which is nice, many granola bars are too hard for little ones to eat.  The banana flavor in these is natural tasting, not fake or chemical, but it has a weird taste, like over cooked baked goods or something.  I did not taste any chocolate AT ALL in these.  Now, I gave one to the less picky eater, she said she liked and gobbled it up.  Gave one to the picky eater, said she liked it then half way through didn't want to finish it.  On next offering, NEITHER girl wanted one and said they did not like them.  On next offering they both acted like they were getting some sort of special treat and the both gobbled it down.  Also of note, both girls flicked off the oats that are on the surface of the bars and did not like those.  So, it is hard to say.  I guess I can simply say that these were just okay and that I would not buy them again.  I'll stick with Annie's chocolate chippers.

column9: Good Bar With a Few Kinks
column10: I found the Kellogg's Kashi Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bar, Banana to be tasty and filling in exactly the way you'd expect from a Kashi breakfast bar, but I agree with some of the other reviewers that some of the choices made when developing this item could use a re-think. While the overall flavor is good, the bar does have an odd flavor that does resemble "burnt". The chips of dried banana mixed in the bar taste ok, but add a brittle "crunch" texture that has a mouth feel less like a nut and more like a foreign object. These are ok, but not at good as I have come to expect from Kashi.

Not my favorite mix of flavors. The banana tastes strange, bars are very bready & seems kind of oily, and tastes like over-cooked bananas.I ate half a bar and had to stop. I thought it might have been just one bad or not-sealed bar, so tossed that one & opened another, but it was the same.I like a lot of Kashi's products, but this isn't one of them.

column9: One of my few disappointments with a Kashi product
column10: I was eager to try this product. I love banana flavored anything and add chocolate chips and you've got a winner. So I was terribly disappointed at how bland, heavy and dry this bars tasted.There was no sweetness or banana taste and very few chocolate chips.They also left a very heavy feeling in my stomach after I ate them. I tried three bars on three separate occasions and each time I felt like I couldn't move afterwards, as if I ate a huge meal.This wouldn't discourage me from trying any other Kashi products because all of them except this one have always been a quality product. (Their Dark Chocolate Coconut Bars by contrast are delicious and flavorful)I would just take a pass on these.

If I could have given this 0 stars I would have!!! Never in my life have I reviewed anything! But I needed to warn people! Do not buy these! I actually thought to myself who in the world taste tested these!!! Yuck!Yuck!Yuck!

column9: Those In Need Of (Or Are Simply Fans Of) Low Glycemic Index Snacks Are In Luck Here
column10: I have heard a lot about Kashi food products over the years, principally from my eco-hip, health-nut acquaintances who simply can't get enough of the outfit's stuff.  I have always looked askance at Kashi, given that I am not one of this yoga-pants wearing, Whole Foods shopping demographic (in truth, Kashi goods can be found in just about any supermarket).  But I digress.As for the product itself, while being very flavorful (indeed, it's almost like snacking on a real banana), the product is not very sweet.  Texture-wise, it came across as kind of grainy and flaky.  The combination of texture and composition, when ingested with a suitable liquid (coffee is my preferred beverage) is actually quite filling.  However, I like my snack bars sweet and diabetic-coma inducing, and this, quite frankly, didn't cut it.  And oh yes, it needs more chocolate!That said, I gave a few to a couple of friends, one of whom is diabetic, and both raved about them. Neither of them were originally big fans of Kashi products, so that is a plus.  Additionally, both actually liked the lack of (simple) sugars, and loved the combination of oats, grains and fiber.  In its defense, the Kashi snack bar would make for a great fuel source either during a strenuous workout or after, especially in combination with a protein-dense food source such as soy milk or a non-fat latte.  Indeed, I found the best results when nibbling on it with a de-caf, non-fat latte after a solid aerobic workout (you get your carbs, protein, fiber and fluid all at once).  I also had one with my normal cup of Joe, and it was quite filling.Sometime later, on a lark, I believe I may go to the supermarket and buy a couple of boxes to use as post work-out fuel.  While not the sweetest thing around (and very stingy on the chocolate!), it is quite an improvement over those candy bars masquerading as "healthy snack bars".  For those of you that want the sweet snack bar, I say take a pass on this product.  However, for those of you that want a flavorful snack bar that won't send your blood sugar into the stratosphere, this just might be the ticket.

The Kashi Banana Chocolate Chip Bars sound perfect. Each bar has a half serving of fruit and veggies. Each contain 4g of fiber and are soft and natural. At only 140 calories, they won't ruin your diet and can make a perfect snack or breakfast supplement. So, the question is, do they taste good?They taste GOOD. Not great, but they are tasty and easy to eat. The oats on top give the banana bread a crunch, and chocolate chips give it a sweetness. I great, natural bar you can have for a snack or supplement your breakfast.

column9: I'd rather gnaw on my wool hiking socks
column10: These would be okay on a hike when I am famished enough to eat my backpack.  But on the sofa, these bars do not satisfy;  they are far more savory (and not in a delectable way) than sweet, and necessitate a tall drink of anything.  The pumpkin flavor prevails over the banana, followed closely by the taste of the boiled apple juice.  I crumbled apart an entire bar just to count the molecular-sized chocolate chips (3).  While I do like Kashi cereal, I'll be disposing of - rather than digesting - the remainder of the box.  I would much rather go to the trouble of baking my own banana/pumpkin/whole wheat bread with proper adult-sized chocolate chips.  The reason I am giving these 2 stars instead of 1 is that I do like the hint of barley and the (too few) crunchy oats on the top.

I think these are over baked cookies that tasted like burnt cookies. It has more pumpkin and banana than chocolate. The texture is soft and chewy, but has no crunchiness. It is nutritious but not a great snack in terms of the flavor or taste.1. Cascadian Farm Organic Chewy Granola Bar, Chocolate Chip, 6-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)

The Kashi Banana Chocolate Chip bars are great for the health nut who's crazy about the banana and chocolate combination. Great flavor, low in calories (compared to a regular granola bar) and fits well with the Kashi line. These tasted great and were soft instead of crunchy. Just plain old yummy goodness!

I usually love kashi stuff, but these were inedible.  The taste is just deplorable. I couldn't even finish two bites.  It tastes nothing like chocolate and banana, which I love together. These are just really icky.

column9: A Few Things I Love And A Few I Just Might Learn To!
column10: These Kashi Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bars by Kellogg's contain two of my favorite things; chocolate chips and bananas along with a few healthy items like whole grains sprinkled on top and veggie from pumpkin (I love pumpkin). To make it even better they have the texture and an overall taste reminiscent of the American classic fig newton. My only recommendation would be a few more chocolate chips would be appreciated. A great treat item in my estimation!

column9: Tasty, but Kashi might want to add "Dry" to the product description
column10: Let me preface this review with the statement that I am a big fan of Kashi products, particularly its Autumn Wheat, Island Vanilla and Cinnamon Harvest cereals and its TLC Fruit and Grain Bar, Dark Chocolate Coconut.  Kashi's chocolate chip/banana snack bar, however, didn't resonate with me like the aforementioned products.  It lacked any sort of tasty greatness, coming across as an average experience for the palette.  The bar lacked moistness and was very dense in consistency.  I choked down half of my first bar and determined that I would be unlikely to finish it without a drink of water.  My second experience was much better because I dipped it in yogurt before each bite.  Good product, but it fell short (for me) in several areas.  I'll stick with the Dark Chocolate Coconut (Kashi TLC Fruit & Grain Bar, Dark Chocolate Coconut, Layered Granola Bars 6 - 1.1 oz  Bars, (Pack of 6)) for now.

column9: Taste a bit unusual but promises 1/2 serving of fruit and 1/2 serving of veggies
column10: The Kashi banana chocolate chip bars come in a box that contains five individually wrapped bars. Each bar has 140 calories with 3g of fat (0.5g saturated, 0g trans), 0mg cholesterol, 125mg sodium, 25g carbs (4g fiber, 9g sugars), 3g protein, 8% Vitamin A, 4% Iron, and 2% Calcium.The box promises that each bar is half a serving of fruit because of the apples and bananas included, and half a serving of veggies because of the pumpkin included (dried pumpkin with rice flour).The bar is on the soft side, with the chocolate bits providing some light crunchy resistance.The taste it is a bit off. I don't know if it is the combination of banana and pumpkin or the way it was prepared and baked. The chocolate chips are decidedly losing the taste battle to the banana+pumpkin combo. I can sort of feel a little bit of a pumpkin-ish after taste, similar to when eating pumpkin pastries or pumpkin pie.They deserve credit for at least trying to come up with healthy snacks, but the taste needs to be improved!

column9: Tasty But Could Be More Nutritious
column10: I really like the taste of these bars.  They are soft and flavorful with bits of crunch in them, and not overly sweet.  I didn't get the burnt taste than some people experienced, but the banana does taste like very ripe bananas.  Those who are fond of only relatively green bananas may not be thrilled with the taste of these.Although I like the flavor, there were a couple of drawbacks.  The bar, at 140 calories, has only 3 grams of protein, less than I expected.  The sugar content is 9 grams, which I don't find too bad.  The bars weren't as filling as I expected.It is, for me anyway, next to impossible to read the ingredients as printed on the outside of the box.  The print is white on a yellow background, and there is just not enough contrast to make it readable.  The nutritional information on the box is a bit more readable, but still not easy.On the inside, the nutritional information is easy to read but the tiny print of the list ingredients still makes reading that difficult.  Manufacturers, please make your information easy to read.  When you do not, I assume you are trying to hide something.While I enjoyed these bars, I probably won't go out of my way to get more in the future.

I had high hopes for these snack bars, but it's difficult to get excited about them.  The flavor is okay, the calorie count and nutrition are okay.  But that's about it.  The biggest problem I have with them is the consistency.  Each bar is chewy but dry.  It's almost as if they took a decent loaf of banana bread and compressed it into a small bar.  Sorry guys, but I appreciate a little better snack experience.

I wasn't expecting too much from this newton-like cereal bar, and I can say that it was edible but nothing special. The texture was somewhat dry and a little crumbly, not moist like I thought it would be.
