It was also a little dark and had a faint burnt taste, not sure if they're all like that or if mine was an anomaly.I didn't taste much banana in this bar at all, and the chocolate chips were small, though they added a nice textural contrast. It isn't very sweet and is relatively low in sodium and fat, which is good for your body, but unfortunately doesn't add to the taste.At only 140 calories per bar with 3gm of fat, this makes for a decent and fairly healthy snack bar, but frankly a regular piece of fruit would probably be more satisfying, and there are a number of other energy bars out there that have more taste. If they could punch up the banana and chocolate flavor, and make it a little more moist, then I think they'd be getting somewhere.

Honestly, Kashi is not one of my favorite brands, but I am constantly on the lookout for 100 calorie snacks (or lunch bars) to tide me over to dinner, especially since I now have to lose weight for health reasons.  Actually, these bars are 140 calories, and they are pretty good.  They are moderately moist, the banana taste is not overpowering or artificial, and there is just a hint of chocolate.  They are not overly sweet either; the first ingredient listed is apple puree concentrate.  The rest of the ingredient list is long, but amazingly, 99 percent of the ingredients are recognizable and pronounceable.  What I did not like is that when biting into the bar, it tended to crumble (not good at the computer); I solved this by just cutting up the bar into pieces.  The other thing is that for a snack, I personally would not pay more than 75 cents apiece for these.

column4: David L. Poremba "the past in review"
column10: I took a bite of my first bar and felt that it was dry and somewhat overcooked(?) I realize that this is suppposed to be a healthy bar but it proved to be heavy eating and definately not without a whole glass of milk.Very disappointing.

I was worried about them tasting like burnt bananas like other reviewers but we didn't have a problem.  My two daughters are pretty picky about flavors and consistencies but they both enjoyed the Banana Chocolate Chip chewy bar. They have a nice banana flavor without the fake taste that I hate so much.  There are little pieces of oatmeal on top and inside there is something that gives a tiny crunch, makes me think of rice krispies.  I compared them to the other chewy bars we have on hand (Kashi TLC, Cascadian Farm, and Kellogg's) and they have very similar nutritional values.  The only thing, all my other boxes have six bars and the Banana Chocolate Chip came with only five.  Something to think about when comparing prices is the quantity of bars in the box.

They are a strong banana taste and it can be over powering since its like a fig newton without the center so its dry. They are good, but I love banana, but my 15yr old keeps grabbing around them in the pantry so I dont think they appeal to him.

column9: Not exactly the taste I expected - but not bad either.
column10: I sort of taste a banana flavor but not at all like banana bread or anything close.  I don't taste the chocolate chips at all - they might have just as well left those out for as much impact as they have.  After reading there is Pumpkin in it I almost can detect it but I think if I had not read that was in it I would not have been able to put my finger on it.If you gave me this bar - without the wrapping there is no way I would have been able to tell you the main flavor was supposed to be banana or chocolate chip.  There is a sweetness but it's so hard to define.  You can taste the oats and grains and that gives it a nice texture.  I would have said the main flavor was supposed to be oats I think.Over all the texture is very soft and moist with the oats and the chocolate chips giving a little bit of roughness to the soft texture.The taste is sweet, an undefinable mix of flavors... the banana I guess sticks out most but it's not at all like banana bread in the traditional sense.  It is tasty I think, and my 1.5 year old loves them but my 8 year old does not like them so well.  My husband say he thought they were just "ok" but nothing special so I guess everyone in our house has a different opinion.But the ingredients are certainly better than most other bars and that is something to consider when choosing one product over another.

I like the banana taste and the soft, chewy texture of these bars.This is a perfect product for me to keep in my car, so that the next time I'm on a long drive (as I was the other day from Fort Lauderdale to Leesburg, Florida) I won't be forced to stop at a service area and pay $3.20 for a high fat, high calorie ice cream cone. (I could have opted for a small bag of beef jerky, but it cost more than $7.00!)These cookie bars are well sealed -- I think they would have been fine after sitting in a hot car for a week and I could have eaten TWO of them and come away with less calories, less fat and a whole lot less guilt.I like that they have fiber (4g), protein (3g) only 140 calories per bar and 3 grams of total fat. They also have a little vitamin A, iron and calcium.Kashi soft-baked bars are a practical solution to my personal dilemma of what to eat "on the road," and I've also been enjoying them for breakfast every morning. I really like this product!

I have to say, I've never met a Kashi product that I didn't like. And this bar is no different - great flavor, great texture, good for you! My only complaint is that it's a bit stingy on the chocolate. But then again, what COULDN'T use more chocolate??

column9: Crack crinkle drop: sweet tasty treat
column10: Be prepared to sweep the floor if  you eat these inside, without a plate.Do you see the oats sprinkled on top? Well, they drop on the floor as you pull the bar out of the crinkling wrapper.Why "crack" because you could eat a whole box in one sitting! Tasty, tasty, maybe too tasty.Something in the bar is crunchy too, maybe that is a defect, like something that went crystaline during a hot day of shipment.  The primary taste and the aftertaste is of banana. They do have a hint of chocolate.A strange number in the box: 5.  Why not 6 or 10?  Maybe it is because of the too yummy taste.Here is the nutritional information:140 Calories25 from Fat3g fat (.5 saturated, .5 poly, 1.5 mono)125mg Sodium25g Carbs4g Fiber (17%)9g Sugar3g Protein8% Vitamin A2% Calcium4% IronSo, if you eat the whole box, it is only 700 Calories, 15g of fat and 625mg of Sodium.I liked them, but probably won't get them again as they are too much of an indulgence for me, I will have eaten 5 in just 24 hours.

column9: Once U cultivate a taste for it...not so bad!
column10: I realize that Kashi stuff is made more for health food approach using grains, fruit and veggies, so when I got this banana chocolate chip I wasn't expecting it to be super sweet (which it isn't). It's a nice sized bar with small dark chocolate chips throughout.  It kinda tastes like Raisin Bran in bar form.  It's filling and even though I didn't find the banana flavor that strong like I was hoping.  Overall, if your looking for a healthy snack this would certainly do at 140 calories for the whole bar.  Having 3 grams of fat and 125mg of Sodium with -0- cholesterol.  It carries 17% (4g) of your daily intake for Fiber.  It also has 7 whole grains. The label claims that its a 1/2 serving of fruit from the apples and bananas and 1/2 serving of veggies from the pumpkin.If your looking for a healthy snack this would work.  They come in other flavors (Ripe Strawberry, Blackberry Graham and Cherry Vanilla)

column9: Better than I could make at home
column10: I like these bars as a snack because they're only about 140 calories and they taste like homemade banana bread, with the yummy addition of tiny dark chocolate chips. They're probably better than any banana bar I would attempt to bake at home. The only thing that keeps me from rating them any higher is the texture, which seems to be the downfall of the Kashi products I've tasted before. It's a little dry.

OK, I like bananas and I like chocolate chips, but I wasn't too sure about putting them together. In a word, it's DELICIOUS!! They're dark, soft, cake-like bars with a bit of crunch from pieces of banana chips, and I find them irresistible.  Very highly recommended.

Nicely balanced flavors--I didn't find the banana overwhelming.  Definitely a "healthier" tasting snack, which isn't a bad thing to me since I try to keep my snacks on the less-junky side of things.  If your diet is rich in whole grains, and you're used to the heartier flavor of them, I think you'll like these.In the meantime, I'm getting more.

I'm sure these snack bars are much better for you than many sugary snacks.  Each bar provides 1/2 serving of fruit and 1/2 serving of vegetables (from pumpkin), 4 grams of fiber, and 7 whole grains, with only 3 grams of fat and 140 calories.  That would be great, but I didn't find the flavor to be that great.  They look appealing and the texture is good and they are soft and chewy, but there's something about the flavor I don't care for.  I taste pumpkin more than banana or chocolate, and the aftertaste is a little bitter and reminds me of other protein bars that I don't care for.  But taste is subjective and others may love the flavor.  It's certainly nice to have the option of eating a sweet snack that is a little more nutritious than, say, cookies.
Good tasting high fiber banana bread breakfast bar. Ok but a little bland. I was hoping for sweeter. Fiber one has more sweetness and more fiber.

I love Kashi products and was looking forward to trying out this snack bar. However, unlike the other Kashi products I've tried (cereals and other bars), this snack bar isn't very good.When you open up the package and smell the bar, it smells a bit burnt - like burnt chocolate with a very light banana smell to it. Taste-wise, while there's a slightly sweet taste, there's a bitter aftertaste. There's very little to no banana taste to the bar. It is chewy, but it's dry - you'll need something to drink with it. And while there are chocolate chips in the bar, you really can't taste them.Overall, I'd say pass on these bars.

column9: Very tasty, just a bit dry
column10: I recently had the opportunity to review the Kashi Banana Chocolate Chip Soft n Chewy Bars.  I am a longtime fan of the Kashi brand, it is a brand I trust to provide healthy, delicious foods.  I had a feeling that this bar would live up to my high standards, otherwise Kashi would not be making it.  That feeling proved to be completely accurate.The first thing I took notice of was the nutritional info.  Each bar contains 4 grams of fiber, 7 whole grains, 1/2 serving of fruit, 1/2 serving of vegetables, only 3 grams of fat, 3 grams of protein, and only 140 calories.  In terms of a snack, this is pretty good.  While still a processed snack, this is a lot healthier than some on the market.As I opened the package, I was struck by how the bar itself really looked exactly like the picture on the box.  That is so rarely the case.  Same dark brown color, same oats on top.  It looked pretty delicious.As I tore a bite off of the bar, I noticed it was not as moist as I would have liked.  It is still a soft, chewy, texture, just a bit dry.  The flavor was actually really good.  It was not overly sweet, in any artificial way, and I thought the banana flavor was just right.  It did not have an artificial banana flavor, the flavor was subtle, mellow, but still detectable.  The same can be said for the chocolate, there are not too many chips, just enough to give the bar the perfect blend of tastes.All in all, I was really pleased with the bar, as was my husband.  We are big fans of the chocolate banana combination, and this bar is a healthy way to satisfy a sweet tooth.  My only complaint is that it is indeed a little dry, so it would be best paired with a glass of water, or even a cup of coffee.  All in all, I think I can safely say I plan on buying more of these in the future.

My friend and I, both of whom buy Kashi products and enjoy them, opened my package for review together -- with anticipation of a treat.What we got was bars that were overcooked to the point of turning black.  (Was your quality control on vacation, Kashi???)  In what I could force myself to try, there was one tiny chocolate chip almost too tiny to notice -- and he got none.  The bars were dry and unpleasant.  They tasted strongly of pumpkin, NOT banana or chocolate.  There were large chips of peanut leading me to think they should have contained peanut in the title.  When I told my friend that I could barely give this product two stars, he said he wouldn't even give it one.If this is Kashi's "new" approach to food, I think it will cost them customers.  The poor quality control alone will make me wonder whether the products I already use will continue to be up to snuff.  Both of us deplore wasting food, but even the garbage can seemed reluctant to accept these bars!

column9: Not exactly banana bread, but close
column10: This little snack bar seems designed to be banana bread in a wrapper, and it's not perfect, but it's definitely very good.  The most important aspect of a snack bar, for me, is taste, and this is a tasty snack.  The banana and chocolate ingredients have strong flavors, and the overall sweetness is satisfying without being overwhelming.  I also like the little crunch from the oats sprinkled along one side of the bar.  I don't love the texture - it's very dense, especially compared to good banana bread or similar bars from other companies - but it's certainly not bad.  I would buy more of these bars for my morning commutes.

column9: Not bad snack, taste a bit bitter.
column10: This bar is more like cookies, but truly is not as bad according to ingredients (main: fruit, veggie-pumpkin, oats, barley). Sugar 9 g, protein 3g, fat 3 g, total carbs 25g.It does taste a little bit bitter, but I think because it was baked and flavors are natural. Usually in very tasty banana products (except for real bananas;) artificial flavors are present. Some chocolate chips in it sweeten up the bar.I don't mind the taste (I prefer less sweet snacks overall) but I am not fond of the texture. It makes good snack for my toddler though, he loves them and can easily bite and eat it.

Reviewing the taste of a snack food is iffy at best. I like it, but then again, I rather like burnt banana bread.That said, I take issue with this being a "health food." The Kashi brand would lead one to believe that it is, and the back of the box reads, ". . .just like homemade!" I'd love to list the ingredients here, but I can not read the print on the box. It is tiny and printed in white on a yellow background. I had to go to the Kashi website to find a readable list.It's not all "bad." Kashi's signature "seven whole grains and sesame" are in these bars. Canola oil? Well, some say that's not good for you. I don't know, but I do know that it's doubtful that the very long list of ingredients would not be in any "yummy banana bread. . .just like homemade!"The back of the box boasts that each bar contains 1/2 a daily serving of fruit, and 1/2 a daily serving of "veggie" (from pumpkin). These bars taste like cookies to me. I like them, but if one wants a cookie, there's plenty of cookies out there, and if one wants a healthy snack, an apple and a few pieces of broccoli would serve you far better than one of these. We fool ourselves when we eat products like this. They are not "health food," even with the assurance that "you can snack with satisfaction and feel good about it!" from Kashi (on the side of the box). An honest cookie, one that contains flour, butter, and sugar, is just as good or bad for a person as these.

column9: Good Flavor But Texture is Off
column10: I like this - the smell is wonderful (important in bars like this - so often they smell "off"). It smells very clearly of banana, I like the touch of chocolate. But I do not like the texture. It's a soft sort of chewy (not hard chewy, not mealy - can't think of the word) texture. I don't like it. But other than that I like it.

It's yummy. In fact, the Kashi Banana Chocolate Chip far is so yummy that my husband who is definitely not a fan of nutritious health bars has been getting into my stash. When first considering whether to get them or not, I made a pretty quick decision based on the descriptive words on the box: ½ service of fruit from apples and bananas, ½ serving of veggie from pumpkin, 7 whole grains, 4g of fiber, and dark chocolate chips. What's not to like about that combination of flavors?When I opened the wrapper, I was surprised and pleased to see that it was a bar of substance, not little and thin like some bars. And the taste and texture...sweet but not too sweet, chewy but not overly chewy, and soft but with some "bite"to it. Plus, the bar has just the right amount of crunchiness to add another gustatory sensation.My only complaint is that there are only five instead of six bars in the box.

column9: Edible, but not exactly your mama's banana bread
column10: According to marketing claims, Kellogg's Kashi Chocolate Chip Chewy Snack Bar, Banana, 7-Ounce (Pack of 4) has "Yummy banana bread taste with dark chocolate chips--just like homemade." The bars also have "a touch of natural sweetness," and "soft-baked, natural goodness you can see and taste."My taste-testing suggests that Kelloggs may be going a bit far in making comparisons to your mama's (or your own) banana bread.When you first bite into one of these bars, you feel its softness. It's not as soft as a slice of banana bread or a Fig Newton, but it is softer and probably less chewy than a typical oatmeal raisin cookie. Chewing it, you note some odd, crunchy, rice-crispy-ish bits, along with small chunks of chocolate and paper-like rolled oats. Tasting it, the banana flavor is sharp, almost artificial-seeming, but it does not overpower the chocolate, pumpkin, or other, less identifiable flavors. What's most memorable about the taste, though, is the bitterness. I don't know if the bitterness is "natural" or otherwise, but it is a lot more prominent than sweetness.In other words, taste is NOT the best selling point for these bars. Likewise, high carb content (25g), and low protein content (3g) are not going to win the bars many points. On the plus side, they are made with whole grains, they have a moderately high fiber content (4g), they have little fat (3g total, 1.5g monounsaturated), they have a low calorie count (140), and they feature "natural goodness" (note that the packaging does not make an "all-natural" claim). The bottom line, though, is that they're edible but not much fun to eat. Not recommended.

This snack bar tastes like banana bread, which isn't necessarily a bad thing, unless you were expecting it to taste like chocolate as the flavor name implies. It's a little on the dry side and crumbles easily, so it's messy. It's not that filling. I would rate the taste as "okay." I wouldn't turn down an offer of one of these snack bars if I were hungry and really needed something, but I wouldn't go out of my way to have one.

column9: Eat with a bottle of water at your side
column10: I was very disappointed in these Banana Chocolate Chip snack bars. I didn't find that there was much taste in them. I couldn't taste much of either the banana or chocolate chip. In fact, they sort of taste slightly of cardboard. And when I ate a bar, I had a really hard time swallowing it. It seemed like it wouldn't break down in my mouth and ended up getting caught in my throat. I had to drink quite a bit of water to make it go down. Not a pleasant experience, to say the least. Then, as others have pointed out, the print on the box is extremely hard to read. When I tried to read the nutrition facts, I got an instant headache while trying to make the words out.A disappointing product overall and I wouldn't recommend it.

"Soft and chewy?"  Absolutely. But, unfortunately, also bland and wholly without any "notes" of enticing flavor. Reminds me of C-rations from the Korean "War" era. KASHI is, in my estimation, a big winner with GoLean cereals. Not even a mediocrity here. :(

column9: A good snack, but not a great one
column10: I generally like Kashi stuff, and love banana bread- so I thought I would give this a try.  The Banana Chocolate Chip bars are not strongly favored of banana (its pretty subtle) nor are there many chocolate chips (which helps keep the calories to a reasonable 140 per bar, with only 3 grams of total fat).The package is correct in that they are "soft and chewy" but they are also a bit dry.  I had mine with coffee, which seemed to complement each other.  Without something to drink, you will find these a bit too dry I think.Ingredient Check:  the reason the banana flavor is so subtle is that the first ingredient listed is "apple puree concentrate".  The second is seven grain flour (which gives it the dryer texture and slightly nutty taste).  Then pumpkin.  Then "evaporated cane juice invert syrup" aka sugar.  Then vegetable glycerin.  Finally banana puree makes an appearance.  So first in name, but clearly not in the ingredients.On the plus side, 1/2 serving of fruit and of veggies per bar each doesn't hurt.  And the 4 grams of Fiber per bar is 17% of the total daily value, which is outstanding.On the negative side, these aren't organic ("all natural" doesn't really mean anything), and do appear to have quite a few potential allergens.  Those sensitive to the following should take notice: wheat, milk, soy, egg, PEANUT and ALMOND and may contain other tree nuts (emphasis added- you wouldn't expect this from the general product description and nut allergies are not to be messed with).In summary, while I liked these as a snack with coffee (especially at the Amazon price) the banana flavor was pretty subtle, chocolate chips rather spare and the texture was a bit dry.  But the calorie, fat and fiber profiles were quite good for a snack.  As a healthy snack I liked them, but did not love them.

And that's about all I can really say about it.  The texture's a kind of grainy and chalky, the aroma was ok and I didn't taste much in the way of bananas.  Chocolate chips are hard enough to chip a tooth if you're not careful.  And that gold-lettering on a white background makes the nutritional info harder to read than it should be.  You can give these ones a pass.

If I was basing this review on just the first bite, you'd see a lower rating from me.  My first impression was that this is really dry.  But as I finished the rest of the bar I could appreciate the sweetness and the small bits of crunch - most likely the chocolate chips - and it didn't seem nearly as dry.  Although for something called Banana Chocolate Chip, you really don't get the taste of either.The ½ serving of fruit comes from apples and bananas.  Most of the sweetness seems to be from the apples.  The ½ serving of veggies comes from pumpkin.  That is probably the most dominant taste - although it's somewhat similar to ginger.  Not bad tasting, but not great either.7 whole grains, 4 grams of fiber and naturally sweetened.  Not a bad choice for a somewhat healthier afternoon bar snack that gives you a full feeling.I really have to take umbrage with the packaging, especially the Nutrition Facts.  White type on a gold background is incredibly difficult to read.  I have trouble reading the long list of ingredients, even with my glasses on.  The fact that the ingredients list is so long might take away from the healthy aspect of the product.The price of $18.20 for 4 boxes with 5 per box makes each bar .91, so the price isn't bad.  I'll definitely be finishing the box.  Not sure yet about a future purchase.  Maybe after I get out a magnifying glass and read all of the ingredients.

This snack bar is soft and slightly chewy. It does taste like banana bread and the chips (crunchy banana and soft chocolate) provide a nice textural contrast. It is also surprisingly filling.My only complaint is that one of the sweeteners has a rather "sharp" sensation. I don't know any other way to describe it other than rather than blending in it makes itself known in the after taste. This will not keep me from buying more, because if you're having a sugar craving, this is a helpful option that will satisfy the urge without breaking the calorie bank.

column9: I won't be putting these on my shopping list
column10: These are awful. They do not taste like bananas, nor do they have any chocolate flavor. I would describe the taste as being primarily "health food energy bar" with undertones of fruit puree and a burned bittersweet aftertaste. The texture is soft, dense, and slightly dry, with little bits of something crunchy scattered through it.I have had other Kashi products that I liked, particularly the oatmeal dark chocolate cookies, but I would never purchase these nor would I recommend them to anyone.

column9: Tasty snack bars - chewy with some crunch
column10: Although the reviews are all over the place, I really like these snack bars because they are quite tasty, being both chewy with a little bit of crunch.

This bar is similar to banana bread. It is sweater than regular bread but not as much as cake. It is firmer than cake and regular banana bread, and would be soft enough to eat without teeth, except for a few small pieces of crunchy something that is in it.It must not have much banana in it because the banana flavor is weak, and the chocolate chips are virtually nonexistent. Nevertheless, it is a really good healthy snake bar.

column9: Chewy: yes. Sweet: Yes. Granola-y: not really. Like banana bread: YES and YUM!
column10: Of the bars I've tried, this is amongst my favorites. It satisfies a need for a sweet snack, it's soft and chewy, and it has a lovely flavor - sort of like banana bread. I highly recommend this bar!

column9: Yuck but does have merits too
column10: If you've tried the natural energy bars,you might be familiar with the flavor and textures you'll experience with this bar.If you aren't...expect a dense, soft but dry texture.  There's the off flavor of something designated as "health food" that is commercially produced.  Banana flavor?  I didn't detect any.  Same with the chocolate.  I did, however, notice the pumpkin flavor.  Besides the dense, dry texture, there is both crunchy and chocolate chips that do add some badly needed relief for your mouth.  It's pretty bland, which might be why it is considered "kid friendly."  It does have an overall sweet taste but it isn't overwhelmingly sweet.As for the package...they chose yellow and white for the predominate colors.  I have poor eyesight up close, and was completely incapable of reading the labeling due to the lack of color contrast, even with my glasses.  Standing in a grocery store aisle, that's enough alone to get me to give up on trying a new product.  The nutritional information was actually printed in white on the yellow side of the package, and was totally illegible even in the larger letters to me.  I could not read ingredients or the nutritional information at all.For pure snacking pleasure, this is a loser.  If you want something that isn't chock full of refined sugars to stick in your backpack for a hike...this might be the ticket.  Just make sure your canteen isn't empty because you will need water to wash this down.  It does have the advantages of extended shelf life and single unit packaging that makes it portable.  For snacking without a ride in a backpack, I'd stick to a healthy homemade bar.I'm not likely to buy this for snacking at home.  Despite its less-than-wonderful flavor, I might actually buy it for a portable snack when I know I will need complex carbohydrates because it isn't ridiculously full of preservatives, sugar and fat.  I suspect, between the heavy texture and the water you'd need to wash it down with, it is a snack that would keep hunger at bay for a while.
I was very pleased with my St Mary's banana chips. It was so delicous. I would definitely recommend the store and I plan to order again real soon.
THE BANANA CHIPS ARE UM UM GOOD!!! I LOVE POTATO CHIPS, BUT..THESE ARE MUCH MUCH BETTER AND GREAT TASTING!!!
$8.00 for one small bag of banana chips is ridiculous.I thought it would have been a couple of bags at least so was very disappointed.
I purchased this item as I attempt to follow a dietary schedule. The product suggests banana chips, THIS PRODUCT TASTE LIKE POTATO CHIPS AND I WILL NEVER PURCHASE THEM AGAIN.

The Starkist Chunk Light Tuna packed in *oil* has a superior, fresh flavor, not greasy, with just the right amount of salt.  The texture is firm and, unlike canned tuna, there is actually tuna in this pouch.  A 7-oz pouch of tuna has more tuna than two 6-ounce cans (which are about half water or oil).  I highly recommend you try this.

This tuna is (without any close competition) The Best I've ever eaten. I used to love albacore packed in spring water, but now that tastes absolutely tasteless & dry compared to this one. So, even though this one is chunk light, it's not heavy tasting at all. I can't stand regular canned chunk light, since it tastes way too strong. And this one is also not greasy tasting at all. I've also tried the water pack pouches, but they're harder & drier in texture & not nearly as soft & delicious as the oil pack. I used to be able to find both large & small oil packs in my local supermarket, but now they sell only the small ones. So, I was thrilled to find the large ones here on Amazon. I will buy it . . . forever. Many thanks!!
This is definitely the best packaged tuna product on the market.  The flavor is superior.  Actually, this is the only packaged tuna I enjoy at all.

column9: You won't go back to canned!
column10: The Starkist Tuna in oil in the pouch is far superior to canned tune!  No fussy, messy draining.  No metal taste from being in can too long.  Lovely cuts of tuna and, though I've been buying exclusively in the pouch now for years, virtually never a bone to be found!! (Literally I've only found one little bone ever.)Great eaten as is, or mixed in tuna salad, tuna melt, etc. You have to try it!

The pouch tuna with sunflower oil is superior to any the canned or pouch (retort)tuna in water products.  It almost tastes like fresh tuna.  Amazon.com has one of the lowest prices on this product I have seen....very tasty and cheap too!

column9: Missing Pouch and awful customer service
column10: The product is great. The tuna has great taste and is delicious.it took 22 days to get my order and surprise surprise the box only had 11 puches (instead of the 12).I called  Customer Service and after 20 min of explanantion tey told me to go online and return the box to get another one. because this item is considered "food" it's not returnable.Bottom line the product is great but in this case the Amazon service was pretty low,

Maltesers usually little bit "saggy" and chewy in here, (wherever I'm buying)but these, .... amazing. Extremely fresh, and so tasty, and soooo different!!!(shipping slow, and pricey, but the quality and the taste amazing, like I never taste something like this)

column9: 1/2 of the shelf life was gone upon arrival!
column10: I haven't tried the product yet, but regardless of that experience, I think it's pure BS that when I checked the date code, I found out that the product I was shipped was half-way through it's shelf life!  Give me a break!  So in my view, I paid full price but received half the value expected, since I had intended this for my earthquake food supply.  Not a huge deal, since I'll use it, but I had intended to keep it for 12 months before use.  I suspect that the expiration date is just a suggestion, and that the product will last much longer, but why not ship products that are fresh to begin with?

column9: Best cereal ever made in history of time
column10: title says it all. I am a fiend for this cereal. I just bought it and i can't wait to get it. I love it so much. If it was between this cereal box falling off of a cliff on one side and my significant other on the other side....well you know which one I would choose. If i was an alien i would invade this planet only to eat this cereal.

I have been trying to find this cereal for years and i found it.  Its just as good as i remember it. I poured a bowl and it was like using a time machine it felt like i was 10 again! Thank You for bring me back to a good time!

My daughter loves this cereal.  Everytime I would go into the store to purchase this it wasn't in the store.  All stores don't carry this cereal and my daughter just had to have it.  Amazon made my life easier.  Thank you.  She loves her cereal and she is happy.

Waffle Crisp has been my favorite cereal since I was 12 or so the first time I tasted it. Now I'm 24 and I still totally live it. I can't find it sold anywhere in my area, which frustrates me, so I have purchased it here on Amazon to be delivered to my house every three months, which is already not enough. It was my first purchase from amazon and I'm not a internet buyer, so if that tells you anything...
Here is a list that was compiled by U.S. Government Scientists of the 6 most addicting substances known to man.6. Caffeine5. Alcohol4. Crack Cocaine3. Heroin2. Nicotine1. Waffle Crisp!
Its a shame that this cereal is so hard to get. Its my daughters favorite and whenever we see it available on Amazon we get it for her. Keep in in inventory and we will keep buying it!!

column9: Best cereal ever!  Thank you, Amazon!
column10: I'm not sure how many grocery stores carry Waffle Crisp anymore - all I know is that I can't find any stores in Los Angeles that do.  I used to be able to go to my local Ralphs and find it amongst the inferior cereals.  But over the past year, it started disappearing.  I was worried that Post had discontinued it.Fortunately, Amazon came to the rescue!  I can now enjoy the greatest cereal ever invented anytime I choose.  For those of you who have never had Waffle Crisp, you are missing out.  Think of the most delicious waffle swimming in maple syrup and butter...and imagine it in a bowl.  That is exactly what it is like eating Waffle Crisp.  I brought a box to my office and now everyone is addicted.Sure, it isn't healthy.  But that's not why you're eating Waffle Crisp or any other sweetened cereal.  You are eating it for the unparalleled delicious taste experience.  Try Waffle Crisp - you will not regret it.

I don't know about other areas, but in New York, I cannot find this cereal on the shelves. It was taken off a couple of years ago where I live. At subscribe and save price, I pay $4.04 per box. Normally, I wouldn't pay that amount for cereal in the grocery store. However, my thirteen year old absolutely loves it. Good quality packaging for cereal. The subscription came boxed quite well. No dented boxes, none broken open. Prompt shipping as well. This is my third order of this, I continue to buy it every three or four months. It is quite sugary. In between orders we usually get wheaties to recover from the sugar overdose. It tastes A LOT better than the Eggo waffle cereal. Very glad that Amazon carries this and hope they continue to do so.
I love this cereal and I cannot find it in the stores anymore! Thanks for having it Amazon!
This cereal is not available in my area anymore; I definitely felt it was worth it to order a few boxes.  Sure, the nutritional value is pretty terrible, but it just tastes so good.

My mom used to buy me this cereal every time she went to the grocery store, then one day she came home without them!! I was pissed and she swore to me that they just didn't have them anymore, oh the sadness! But now I'm happy again I've found my crisp. I get them delivered every month twice a month. A sad addiction Idk how to kick lol

column9: I love this cereal but it's hard to swallow
column10: I love the syrupy taste and I just love this, in general. If you like really sweet cereals and sugary cereals then I'd buy this. It does taste like waffles in the same sense that a toaster strudel tastes like an actual strudel or the way Cookie Crisp tastes like cookies. Cereal lovers will understand.I'm an adult, though. I wouldn't want my kid to eat this every day because of the sugar content but a box a week would be reasonable, I think, between a couple of kids.The reason I knock off a star is because the cereal is so hard. Literally, the little waffles are hard and it can make the roof of your mouth sore from eating it. Let it sit in the milk a little bit before you gobble it up or you'll hurt your mouth. It really happened lol.

column9: Its Waffle Crisp! Need I say more?
column10: I love everything about Waffle Crisp! Except that you can't readily find it in stores all the time like cheerios or rice krispies. The only thing I don't like is that Amazon keeps flexing the price on this. When I bought it here, the price was at an all time low. Should have gotten more than just the package of four boxes...

I have been searching for years for this product. everytime i am in a grocery store and in the cereal i search for this product. this was my favorite cereal when i was kid and now as an adult it still my favorite and now even my son loves it and cant get enough of it.

Waffle Crisp is my grandsons favorite cereal and it's not soldin Austin anymore -- or I can't find it.He's been looking and looking and found it on Amazon and askedme to order it....Really, he could eat a box of Waffle Crispeach day!
its this and french toast crunch at the top! ITS LIkE JESUS WOULD eat this cereal! just please try it and youll get so fat from it

column9: Ok it REALLY is the best Cereal ever Made.
column10: Cereal god George Post (ok thats a totally made-up name) broke the mold when he created this cereal. This cereal is good enough to eat right out of the box...no milk, just grab and go. Each little waffle packs a consistency that gives it that right amount of crisp with every bite. And the taste..........its like waffles that have been soaking in maple syrup overnight. It has that satisfying taste after each bowl...not like ("ughhh i'm eating ceresl to stay healthy" but...." omg this is so good....I must stop. But it also is not like lucky charms or frosted Mini Wheats and inundated in sugar for no reason. The cereal was formulated with Purpose, not mindless sugar. And its good for you! Fortified with 10 essential Vitamins and minerals- lots of calcium and its MULTIGRAIN!!

This cereal hasn't been sold in stores for years because I haven't seen it anywhere anymore and figured it would be gone forever. Not until recently did it occur to me that, hmm..it might be sold online if they still make it. Well it was! I found it on amazon and bought it for 16.37, a great price for 4 boxes, because if I was to buy it now individually in stores, it would be well over 4 dollars, probably closer to 5.29 or something. Point is, I bought it and was immediately brought back to my childhood days when my dad would buy this for my brother and I. I loooooooove this cereal, it is by far the best and well worth the money. Can't beat the price, can't beat the taste. Tastes just as I remembered years ago. Definitely a great buy for the cereal lovers in a family. Even people who swear they don't like cereal like this kind. Definite recommend! This is my childhood in a box!

The Tastest Cereal in the wooorld.. i use to eat these all the time when i was younger, im only 23, but im soo glad they are on Amazon.. Now i hope u guys get those Oreo O's Cereals Back!! Thanks Amazon for Suppling these Exclusive Cereal were u cant find in stores anywhere in the US!!

Loved this cereal as a kid, and still do to this day! Its incredibly hard to find nowadays where I live. Delivery came 2 days early, product was undamaged, and product was fresh. Highly recommend this classic breakfast cereal!!! 5/5

This might be the best cereal I've ever had! It tastes exactly like it did 15 years ago and I cant wait for a 2nd bowl. Buttery, walfley, syrupy goodness.. If you've never had it, try it!  You'll love it.
They need to bring this product back to the store to purchase.  I nned to be able to go to the store instead of buying online and waiting for the product to show up at the door.
We love this cereal, has the best flavor like no other cereal, I keep buying it for my son and my brother, they love it, I treat them to it cause I love them. Thank you amazon and The Candy Company.

This waffle crisp is freakin' delicious and every bit as good as I remember! Arrived super-fresh and well worth the wait on shipping. The price is pretty reasonable for everlasting happiness in my opinion.
Was gift for grandson, and he was quite surprised and pleased. Would order again sometime I am sure.  This cereal is not available in our area.  It is his all time favorite.

My newly college graduate has searched for Waffle Crisp for the past couple of years and couldn't find it. Every town or State he visited he would make a grocery store run. I found this on Amazon, fast delivery, I left in the the big box it came in just to make him wonder. Its really hard to surprise him these days......but I did! He was thrilled that I had found his favorite cereal.

It's a flash from the past!  My son loves it so much, so we found it online through Amazon.  Only thing is, we used to purchase this item for about $16.00 for four boxes and now it's $26.00 for four!  Not going to be able to continue with this 'cereal addiction.'
Thank you for being efficient and fast. The product was delivered in a rapid manner and good condition. Thank you for being so business like.

In my quest to find new and exciting cereals for my morning wakeup, I stumbled across a mega-box of Waffle Crisp at the grocery store yesterday and just had to snatch it up.  I love waffles (who doesn't) and so I just had to try this.  What starts off rather delicious turns to mush very quickly, so if you tend to take your time eating your breakfast (which is the case with me since I work from home and eat while I work) then this can turn off-putting rather quickly.  The maple flavor (which is the best part of the waffle experience) is subtle enough to not be overly sweet, but it is also subtle enough to be mistaken for something else entirely.  In fact, this tasted a lot like Cookie Crisp at first, which is not what I was wanting.  My milk was rather delicious in the end, so there is always that.  I can't say that I'm all that impressed really.  I wanted to be, and I expected to be, but at the end of the day (or should I say `morning') I'm left with some mushy mini-sponges swimming in lightly flavored maple milk.

Bought the post waffle crisp in a 4-pack because they no longer have it in any stores in my area. I only bought it for my son for a Christmas present. Would not purchase on regular basis for it is too expensive per ounce. It is one of the kids favorite cereals.
I used to love this cereal years ago but it seems ten times sweeter now that I'm an adult. I must be getting old because I can't handle the amount of sugar in it.

column9: Yuck! Buy Wonka Runts, Not These..
column10: Don't be fooled by the name, these are NOT the real "Willy Wonka Runts"And they are horrible tasting and not worth it.We threw all the bags we had out as the kids didn't even like them. Such a waste.

The assortment being sold here is not what is pictured.  This is a pack of 12, 4.5-ounce bags of the Runts assortment with the pineapple and mango.  You don't get the cherry, lime, or blue raspberry.  Amazon needs to update their photos, because when the assortment changed this drastically, it created a completely different (and much worse) candy.  It's sad that Runts felt they had to destroy the product that made them popular. I've read a comment stating that the new assortments are better than not having Runts at all.  I disagree.  I'd rather have nothing than have this new assortment, if I have to pay for it.If you're looking for the old assortment that sold so well for decades, don't buy these!  If you find that old assortment with the lime and cherry somewhere, let me know.  I'll go to great lengths to get more of those, but I wouldn't pay anything for the new assortments.
I enjoyed these very much.  The ones with ginger and garlic were delicious and were great in soup.

delicious and not too high on sodium....These help me eat more salads, which are necessary on my summer diet! Fresh, crispy, tasty, just the right salty crunch to add a savory touch to my salads. I love them!
Excellent tea! Smooth with a hit of rose infusion, this tea calms and soothes.  Great to drink before going to bed since it's caffeine free.

I purchased this tea because I was searching for a replacement to the Pompadour Rosehip and Hibiscus tea which is becoming increasingly hard to find, not to mention far more expensive.  I found this tea to be a little milder, but overall an acceptable replacement.  If you like stronger tea, I would suggest using two bags per cup since there is not as much tea per bag as other brands.  I still gave the product five stars because the taste is wonderful and tea strength is really a personal preference.

column9: MY FIRST 'PINK' TEA AND SOOOO DELICIOUS.
column10: I HAVE NEVER HAD A CUP OF COFFEE.  SO 'TEA IS ME' OVER THE MANY YEARS!  WHEN I WAS ABOUT TO ORDER MY FAVORITE FROM AMAZON, THIS POPPED UP, SO I READ THE DESCRIPTION AND RISKED ORDERING.  WHAT A BLESSING AND SURPRISE.  MY FRIENDS NOW ASK FOR THIS 'PINK' TEA WHEN THEY VISIT... SO ENJOYABLE.  DO CONSIDER TRYING IT.

column4: FOREVER student of Life:D "Always learning co...
column10: In AM I have Decaf Tea Celestial Seasonings White Tea, Decaf, 20-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)Then this one So far so goodThen near bed time I have Celestial Seasonings Chamomile Herb Tea, 40-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)I Don't use honey sugar or creamEnjoy!

My two year old absolutely LOVES the Gerber Spinach Pasta Pick-Ups. But they are only $1.39 each at Walmart and even lower at Publix for $1.25 each. So why is it that Amazon has a 12 pack for $35 (making it $2.91 each)? I'm very disappointed in the price, but this product is great. I wish Amazon would lower the price so we can buy in bulk at a discount.

column9: Love it! Price way to expensive.
column10: My son LOVES these. They are perfect for small fingers. Another great thing is that these ravioli are not in a messy sauce. The price here is over double the price it should be.

Describing this as airline food would be an insult to airline food. Mushy, flavorless. You would be much better to make your own, or find an adult ravioli with flavor and kid-friendly ingredients. Now, I am reluctant to try any of the Gerber Graduates.

I was initially caught off guard and put off by the strong cinnamon flavor, but after the first bar, I have to say that I like the taste. I was hoping for something a little more chewy, but this is basically high grain content, low fat, and tasty, so I guess I'll take them. For the carb counters, one serving = one bar, 1.5g fat, and 19g carbs, but a lot of those come from oats, and oats have a very low glycemic index.

These are a great snack in between meals or on the go.  They are low in calories, high in whole grains, and taste good.  My only complaint is I haven't seen a big variety pack so some people might get sick of the flavor buying 48 of the same type.  Personally I haven't but I usually rotate my morning snack between this or a piece of fruit.

column9: Very tasty but fall apart too easy.
column10: My girls loved the taste of these Oatmeal Rasin Chewy bars.  They are great for a small snack for school.  The only problem is that they fall apart way to easy.  As soon as you unwrap more than an inch it all crumbles.  My 2 year old made way to many messes with it this way for me to get them again.  But I still gave them a 4 star rating for the flavor.

Here's the situation: Two fussy dogs, a shih tzu and a Bolognese, who don't like change. They like crunchy, but not too hard. They like their food and snacks in small pieces. Enter Zuke's Mini Bakes, chicken 'n cherryz. The girls have had and like Zukes turkey 'n taters treats, but how would this new one go over?No need to worry. Both girls love this snack and devour them with gusto. I like the natural ingredients and the lack of wheat, unpronounceable additives,and byproducts. As an added bonus I notice that POTATOES are ingredient number five.Greenies should note that the box is made of recyclable cardboard and with wind energy. We'll be recycling the box again!The inner bag of these American made snacks is not resealable, but it's no problem to store them in an airtight container to retain freshness. Zukes offers a great line of snacks in many shapes and flavors.

I purchased these treats for my dogs after they experienced excessive weight gain from dog biscuit alternatives. This product has a much lower crude fat ratio than other biscuits, such as milk bones.What I like about the product:It's a nice size for dogs. About ¾ of an inch long, it's a nice reward without giving too much of a treat. The treats have a line in the middle for those who want to break the treat in half. Additionally, with a higher quality product, you do not have grease residue left on your fingers from handling the treats.What I don't like:When you try to break the treats in half, a lot of times it crumbles in your hands and you lose a portion of the treat.  Also, my picky Springer isn't sure about the taste. He'll start eating the treat and spit it out. My Beagle devours them, so it may not be a concern for every consumer. This is the main reason I rated the treat at 4, it may not be something appetizing to discriminating eaters. A good alternative I have found is Charlee Bear treats.Bottom line, they're a healthy alternative for those who need to control weight or just want to reward your dogs with a healthier alternative. I have found the price versus the amount of treats in the box to be one of the best values of healthy dog treats.
The Cafe Altura Columbian dark whole bean coffee is absolutely delicious. It's the best whole bean coffee I have tasted. It has great aroma & a full body taste.

column9: Superb Coffee...and a clarification on the Decaf issue....
column10: To allay any questions about whether this is decaf or not. It is indeed CAFFEINATED. The bag does have the "swiss water process decaf" words on the side but the bigger issue for me was that the bag I received was the ubiquitous decaf dark green color...not black/brown as shown on Amazon.com. Combined with the wording on the side...I too was curious.  Here are excerpts from my email exchange with Cafe Altura's customer service...From: Cindy Hernandez [mailto:cindy@cafealtura.com]Subject: Re: Coffee Bean Caffeine Question...Sent: Wednesday, September 03, 2008 10:06 AMMark,Be glad to know that it  is not, I repeat not decaf. To begin with, we do not have Columbian Decaf. So be assured. What is written on the side of the bags are just the different roasts we carry, and our decaf processing method, that's it. Maybe you can post a comment on the Amazon site, to let people know this......Cindy...and the followup email to my suggestion to either remove the writing or change the color of the bag...From: Cindy Hernandez [mailto:cindy@cafealtura.com]Sent: Wednesday, September 03, 2008 11:01 AMMark,Thanks for your input,and your support,  we are in the process of changing the bags at this time.CHMy synopsis: Superb coffee.  Great company. Responsive customer service.
Superb flavor. Organic product from small growers. Dark, oily beans. Lovers of dark roast coffee will appreciate this coffee.

column9: It's the only coffee I'll drink.
column10: There's really nothing more to say that the others haven't already said. The beans are dark, oily, fragrant. I fell in love with these the second I unsealed the bag. Yes, fell in love. I use a plain ol' Krups blade grinder and brew in a Melitta cone with near boiling water. The resulting brew is smooth, rich, full (all those buzz words you see on coffee bags, but actually true in this case).Further, these beans do something none other have; keep. I've had these same beans for months in an air-tight and light-proof container, the way I keep all my beans. But unlike most beans which eventually dry out and lose flavor, these are still pretty oily and retain nearly all of the flavor it had to begin with.As for these being decaf, I don't doubt L.Gregory had decaf beans, but I get a pretty nice buzz when I drink a cup. There have been days when I've lost sleep because I couldn't resist that end-of-the-day mud. I can't verify whether what (s)he says is true because I've long since discarded the bag. Maybe there's a pyschological component. I feel invigorated because it's so full-flavored. Kind of like I feel after a shot of espresso even though per ounce, espresso contains less caffeine than regular coffee. In any case, I love this stuff and recommend it to anyone who's serious about coffee.I'm completely sold on these beans. From now on, for my money, there's nothing like Cafe Altura. I can't wait to try the other flavors. At under $10/lb, how can you afford not to try it at least once?

column9: Best coffee ever, yeah it's good!
column10: I drink coffee every day and am a self proclaimed coffee expert.  I drink a lot, usually an entire 12 cup pot each and every day. So in the last 10 years I estimate this to be about 43,800 cups of coffee, and this is the best coffee i have ever brewed.  I've been ordering the Colombian Dark from amazon for about 8 months now and do not plan to purchase any other coffee anytime soon.

I am a coffee snob, so I am very picky about my coffee.  This coffee is so amazing.  The beans are beautiful! They are dark and shiny.  The smell is wonderful too.  This coffee is a must for all of you coffee lovers out there!

column9: Didn't taste like a dark roast
column10: I was very disappointed.  This coffee did not taste like a dark roast.  It was not full bodied.If you are looking for a wonderful dark roast, try "Sumatra" - I get it at Sam's Club--although it may be available elsewhere.

Very good dark roast.  It's not over-roasted/burnt tasting & the flavor is somewhat complex; cocoa, good acidity, bit of syrup, bit of citrus, hint of smokiness.  The beans are oily, dark brown. I found 1 quaker (underdeveloped coffee beans that make coffee taste awful - they stick out because they do not roast/darken properly).  That's a good test of coffee beans:  empty the bag on a cookie sheet & see how many quakers you find.  A few is "acceptable" but more than 10 is pretty bad in my opinion.  This is a good cup of Columbian coffee which is getting hard to find these days.I use the "pour over" method to brew coffee every day because at this time, there is only one non-commercial drip coffeemaker that gets water to the ideal brewing temperature of 192F to 204 F.  I use cold, filtered water, a Melitta filter, manual drip coffee filter & brew directly into my stainless carafe.  I heat the water to boiling, let it cool for 30 seconds,  pour a few tablespoons over the grounds to saturate & plump up the beans, & then flood the grounds with the rest of the water.  There is some crema, the beautiful reddish brown foam that develops on top of the beans, & it smells & tastes good; a really nice morning cup.I brew directly in to this carafe using this coffee cone (pour over method):RSVP Manual Drip Coffee Filter Cone for Carafes or ThermosI use this grinder:Bodum Bistro Electric Burr Coffee Grinder, BlackI use this water kettle to heat the water:Oster 5965 1-1/2-Liter Electric Water Kettle, Stainless SteelI use these coffee filters:Melitta 40Ct #6 Wht Cone Filter 626402 Coffee Filters

I have been drinking the Cafe Altura French Roast for a long time-the price is great and the beans are top quality--no quakers--the little shrivelled ones that Cook's Illustrated showed cause that truck stop coffee taste. The French Roast does seem to make a huge mess when I grind it--lots of static, and the Columbian Dark Roast doesn't. Best of all, though, is that the flavor of the Columbian Dark Roast is just as rich and low acid, without any "burned" taste. It has a rich complexity missing from other dark roasts. Yum yum!
I use this coffee in my french press.  The coffee is very bold and dark and the beans are nice and oily.  Makes a very good cup of coffee.

Compared to other Altura beans (Sumatra is my favorite), Colombian are just mildly flavorful.  Makes good coffee, just not the best.  Amazon delivery of Altura coffee is very fast compared to other brands I have tried from them.

column9: Cafe' Altura Colombian Dark, was Bland!
column10: This reminded me of a bland "Breakfast Blend"! No distinct taste/body at all!If you are looking for a full flavored rich coffee that has a bold/smooth taste!?-Try  their Peruvian Dark, Ruta Cubita organic Cuban (Costco.com online- for non-members too!), or Ethical Beans organic Espresso (best Espresso I've had outside of Brazil, and I drip grind/brew it!)!~~~~~~~~~~~~~This is the Best drip coffee Maker I've ever had!For a GREAT cup of coffee without having to Hassle with a messy Espresso/French Press machine!Melitta 46893 12-Cup Coffee MakerI use a Med/fine grind (6), with my KitchenAid burr grinder (shop around, for a better price!)-KitchenAid Pro Line Burr Coffee Grinder - Onyx Black
We've finished our second 2 lb. bag of this coffee and it's great.  I make the coffee for my honey and he always notices and comments on the great flavor of this coffee.

Had to find a good tasting whole bean coffee since Folgers went up in price.  I tried several brands.  None could even come close till I found this one.  It has a bold taste, but is not bitter.  I love the smell while it is brewing.  It is well worth it for the price.

This is my second bag of Colombian Whole Bean Organic Coffee by Cafe Altura.I tried others like their Sumatra and Peruvian but have come back to this.It's strictly a matter of individual taste, and their Colombian TASTES great.Until I feel adventurous again, this is the coffee I'll be sticking with.Want to add a belated word here about the integrity of Cafe Altura.Had a minor issue with packaging a couple of bags ago. Instead of hassling me over it they courteously made things right.That goes a long way with me. It's also another reason why I am a return customer.TIP: if you've never tried grinding your own beans (Highly Recommended!) and/or are looking for a good little grinder, take a peek at my Five Star write-up of the "KRUPS 203-42 Electric Spice and Coffee Grinder with Stainless Steel blades" (June 7, 2012).Been using it every day for months and it's still performing like new.
Incredibly good coffee especially when comapred to grocery stores and the like. Add the fact there are many options and scheduled deliveries with a price that cannot be beat and it's a "no brainer"

I am a long time Starbucks standard roast guy.  I have really enjoyed the it's dark richness.  A few months ago I tasted The Coffee Beans's similar roast and have like it as least as much- I was surprised.  Then at the recommendation of a friend I tried this Cafe Altura Colombian dark roast and was blown away.  2 pounds later I am a convert.  I didn't even care that it was organically grown (that's great though)but this coffee is fabulous.  It's rich, dark oily goodness is addictive.I am a dark coffee drinker and have never brewed a better cup of coffee.This is the stuff: Cafe Altura Organic Coffee, Colombian Dark, Whole Bean, 32-Ounce Bag

Although the price is higher than what I normally would pay for coffee I feel it is well worth it. Very bold taste. Now everytime I drink any other coffee I feel as though it has no flavor compared to this coffee
It's right up there with Kona coffee.  It's pricey so won't be drinking it all the time, but will buy again.
Good tasting coffee, no bitter taste, just rich and full bodied.  Can't imagine going back to grocery store quality coffee.  Also appreciate that it is shade grown and organic.

I was expecting this coffee to have a bit more flavor.  I usually drink starbucks and I do like to try different beans, but I don't think I'll get this one again.  It wasn't bad, but still I felt it was missing flavor for a dark roast.

Although I am not a fan of dark roast coffee (I actually purchased this thinking it was organic regular roast) I think that fans of dark roast would love this.  Very clean for a dark roast & oh so Colombian, my favorite!
Not bad coffee for the price but for less money you can get a good Sumatra from the same supplier.
Great beans here! Super nice earthy smooth flavor. Organic, fair-traded. Open the bag and sniff. AHHHH!!!! I looks forward to my morning cups! Excellent stuff!
If you like Dark bean coffee, I would think this is excellent. I'm more of a medium bean person.
Great tasting coffee for a Colombian Dark Roast. It has a strong, but mellow taste and is a excellent value if you order on Amazon's auto ship program.

column9: A good cup of coffe is the best way to start a day!
column10: I like a good fresh cup of coffee every morning. I grind my beans and then make a pot of 14 cups. Last me all the way to lunch. This coffee is great.

column9: Cafe' Altura Colombian Dark ---  Wow; it's got some strength
column10: This is a great coffee if you like the taste of a dark robust brew. I like it myself, but my wife says it's a touch on the strong side. I've cut back on the amount of coffee I use for our brew cycle. The taste is satisfying and is not bitter at all.  If you like a dark Colombian, give it a try.

column9: Excellent Coffee and it is not decaf
column10: Very nice although it lacks the slightly bitter spark of their French Roast. You can see my review of their French Roast which settles the "is it decaf?" question. It is not, despite the description on the side of the bag.

I prefer a lighter roast but the coffee was OK otherwise. This is a dark roast Columbian and I can't quibble with the quality, only that the taste seemed more "burnt" to me. If that's what you like, then this is the coffee for you. I decided to switch to another brand that offers medium roast.

They taste good and have very few calories.  Good for a sweet fix without committing to large piece of candy.  Wrappers are bright and shiny - look great in a bowl or glass jar.  Perfect for events.  However, I prefer the chips candy that is more like a gummy product.  These are more like hard candy.

column9: What you get is not what's pictured..
column10: I've ordered this sauce before, (Mild J1 bulgogi korean bbq sauce.. (Comes in a black label). The sauce sent is in a large, tall, red label and tastes disgusting.

column9: Almost fail proof and great tasting
column10: I've been using this starter for about two months and I've been very successful baking wonderful sourdough bread.  We recently returned from a trip to the Yukon and Alaska and got hooked on the baking of sourdough after touring the gold rush areas.  I've tried other starters and this is absolutely the best and you can use a variety of recipes from various bread making books and other sources.  I've never had it fail to rise properly or give a great flavor and texture.  If you like baking sour dough bread and other things such as biscuits or making pancakes, this should be in your kitchen.  I have three one cup containers stored in my freezer for safe keeping in case I lose the batch I'm currently using.The instructions are simple and easy to follow when it comes to getting the starter going.  Care and feeding is relative easy but with all sour dough starters, you must plan ahead when you want to bake bread.  Buy this starter and you will not be disappointed.

Can't believe I found this sooo cheap on Amazon. 3 large containers with enough Majoram to probably last me more than a lifetime. I'm just keeping one, gave 2 to friends and both said the taste, after using on fish and in in some stews, was just as good as those little bottles bought in a local grocery for $$. I can only agree and am very happy to have made this purchase. I've been buying quite a few spices and herbs on Amazon lately and am very satisfied with every one of them.

column9: Very Convenient to Have it Shipped to us
column10: The convenience of having this product arrive by mail is great.  Plus the price per unit is better than at most stores (at least when I purchased it).

My wife bought a variety of munchies for our son who is going through teething. These items are not a main part of his diet, but rather occasional snacks that he might chew on. One item was Gerber Graduates Fruit and Cereal bars. She first bought the strawberry and banana variety. These bars somewhat resemble a fig bar or other fruit bar where the fruit is on the inside and a coating of cereal on the outside. I found them to be dry and bland tasting. Our boy ate the bars, but somewhat reluctantly. I suspect we got a box that was somewhat stale from residing on the shelf too long.Our next box was of the Apple and Cinnamon variety. He seemed to like these somewhat better, but they still are not one of his favorite chewy items. In any case, he seemed to enjoy biting and chewing on them but acts as if he could really use a drink to go along with them. That does not surprise me as they are rather dry and granular, as if sawdust might be a hidden ingredient. However, we give him a bar from time to time and get a kick out of him eating it bite by bite. It's worth a try at this stage of his development.Gary Peterson

Save your money!!!  Individually these boxes sell for $3.49.  For six individual boxes, you would pay around $21.  This case of 6 boxes is $46!!!  Why pay more than double for a product that costs so much less?  This is completely absurd.

column9: Gerber food is bad for growing brains- read the ingredients!!
column10: Check out the ingredients in this product! Aside from being mostly sugar, it has Partially Hydrogenated Soybean Oil(which is trans fats)and ingredients that contain msg.I never buy Gerber.

column9: Lightning Lemonade has NO CAFFEINE!!!  and it rocks!
column10: So, not a frequent reviewer but after using this stuff for so long, I felt I should give some feedback.  This stuff will not make you a raging animal in the gym.  I know of no pre-workout supplement that will that does not also contain caffeine.  So, wtf is one supposed to do if you work out late?  Ever done that with a caffeinated supplement and laid in bed staring at the ceiling, with a totally drop-dead tired body but alert brain?  sucks doesnt it?  This is the only supplement I keep coming back to for that reason.  It gives you some energy and definitely increases stamina.  It also has kre-alkalyn creatine which is awesome because you need very little and none of it turns into creatinine.  It doesnt mess with my stomach one bit and it tastes great.  This sucker is a no-brainer for a caffeine free workout booster.  I've been using it for years and will likely continue to do so.  Enjoy  : )

I must say I cannot agree with the other reviewer in that I thought the grape flavor tasted great, kinda like a slightly bitter, yet refreshing grape kool-aid. Everyone is different though and/or perhaps he got a bad batch, not sure, but I liked it....also I thought FAST TWITCH(GO GRAPE) had better taste, texture and performance than NO-XPLODE!!!! So forget  the coffee and dump the pills, this stuff works WAY better than any pre-workout stimulant I have ever tried.

column9: WHEW, try and slow me down!!!
column10: I am doing P90X and I really didnt want to buy their recovery drink. I have heard some pretty bad things about it from taste to just not working. So I tried fast twitch because I love the muscle milk.Let me say that this stuff gets you going. I wake up at 530 to start working out and after I chug some fast twitch I am ready to go. Saw a noticeable difference in the amount of energy and reps I can do.Although I think it makes my heart race a little bit, maybe my body will start getting used to it, I'll keep you updated.The Grape tastes great IMO...

Great product. Grape flavor has 200mg caffeine per scoop, which can be excessive if you hit the gym after work and plan on sleeping within few hours. For morning/afternoon workouts, shouldn't be an issue. I took 1/2 scoop with 25 oz water upon entering gym.  I also felt like drinking more water in the gym while drinking this stuff, which is good (and necessary, per instructions). It started kicking in about 20 min into workout. Pretty fast. I didn't want to leave gym today. I felt strong between sets. Effective.Cons: Sweetened with sucralose instead of a natural sweetener, like Stevia. So what if people complain about stevia's strong taste..do you drink this on a night out w/your buddies? No, it's just a pre-workout chug-and-start-training drink!Suggestions: Introduce stevia in place of sucralose. Otherwise, excellent!

column9: Fantastic product. Not exactly what I ordered, but five stars for Amazon.com fixing it
column10: I ordered the power punch to replace the Go Grape flavor I'm growing rather tired of. It arrived on time, but it was Tropical Punch flavor (had a different label too) and had a noticable 149 mg Caffeine on that label. Not the 200mg advertised and also like all other containers I've purchased. Who knows why cytosport would do something like this. However, they aren't required to be consistent so I hope it's just a one off occurance.Why this review gets 5 stars. Amazon.com customer service immediately processed a replacement to send me the correct item. No arguing fine points of 51 mg of missing caffeine, just an immediate replacement. It's great to know fantastic customer service still exists!

column9: Lets get a little honesty in the house
column10: I think the cheap price has effected honest ratings here. Nothing special about Fast Twitch, in fact this formula is pretty old. Alot of improvements been made to pre workout products over the last 6-7 years and this Fast Twitch is exactly the same today as it was back then. Even back then it wasn't the best pre workout on the market or even close to it. This formula is dated and Arginine has been proven ineffective in fairly recent studies. Glycocyamine has been removed from most pre workouts due to health risk that it provides, but of course Fast Twitch still contains it. L-Citrulline, Citrulline Malate are solid ingredients in this product, but it's going to be dosed fairly low considering the Arginine is the first ingredient in this part of the blend. This has a pretty good Electrolyte blend in it, I will give it that. Not enough to justify using it as your go to pre workout powder. This has some funky type of creatine in it Kre-Alkalyn, which has proven to be a bunch of hype and mumbo jumbo. Stick to CreaPure monohydrate if you want a good source of creatine. Fast Twitch is a little higher in carbs than I like for a pre workout as well. That would just be filler Maltodextrin.All in all it's not a total waste, it's not to bad for the low price on here. If you're really poor and must have something pre workout this would be a decent option. To make it worth the while you'd be best off ordering two at a time to get the free shipping saver, only thing about it I liked the product better when it was $16, it went up $2 since last week. So if you order two you will have around $37 wrapped up into it. You'd be much better off order Superpump Max by Gaspari nutrition for $28 with free shipping saver. A much much better formula. I will leave the best for the last, the fruit punch fast twitch taste bad, it doesn't taste like fruit punch, more like medicine or chemicals. Hope you're a trooper because you will have to be a solider to drink this stuff. The grape fast twitch on the other hand isn't half bad, but that's not on sale :( makes wonder doesn't it? Get some Superpump Max fruit punch and don't look back.....And honest review with no hyped included.....

I used to take this product before lifting and sprint swim races. It seemed to really give me a boost during weight training and also for swim races. I stopped using it for races because I didn't want to have to depend on a supplement to swim fast (and I've done great times without using it). I also felt slightly more nauseous after races when I used it, but not a whole lot more than I did when I didn't use anything.I was also drug tested by Drug Free Sport after a 50m sprint race (I took a full serving right before) after the US open swim meet in 2008 and was negative for all banned substances so apparently its Ok to use for competition (was worried that something in it might be a banned substance even though the listed ingredients/amounts passed).This stuff does have a lot of caffeine in (its a stimulant supplement). When I took it during evening swim finals I did stay up pretty late when trying to fall asleep.Also, this stuff tastes really good (power punch and go grape). Its kind of funny because you can smell when somebody on the team has this in their water bottle for practice and they almost always have a great practice.

I have been using this product for the past 5 months and it has been nothing short of a God send.  The energy it provides me during and even after my workouts has been very noticeable.  I have been able to lift heavy weights for longer periods of time and am now in the best shape of my life. It also doesnt have any post-use crashing effects.  I look better now at 42 than when I was 22.  Highly recommended for anyone who engages in high intensity training looking for an extra boost that wont leave you dragging afterward.

column9: Highly recommend Fast Twitch w/ no added stimulants
column10: Have been using this product for approx. six months now. I can definitely tell a difference in energy, strength, and appearance since using. I'm super sensitive to stimulants, so this is a real bonus to my diet/workout. Highly recommended for those looking for that extra push in the gym without unpleasant side effects.

I have been using the Power Punch flavor for about three months.  I drink 3/4ths of it during the drive to the gym and it really gives me the energy and endurance to get a great workout.  On days I workout without it, I really notice the difference.

This is a great product and is the best tasting out of all your flavors.  I have also tried the power punch flavor and switched back to the grape.  It is also good because you only have to take it on the days that you work out on and its easy on the stomach.

column9: Nice, effective product, but the taste is horrible..
column10: Don't get me wrong, Fast Twitch is a great product.  However, I was replenishing my supply, and tried the grape flavor..Oh man, it was crazy horrible.  I'm usually fine with tastes, too.  I eventually tossed what was left and switched to pink lemonade. Totally pleased.
this is the best of it's kind! delivers the perfect energy boost without the side efffects of other brands, and doesn't leave you shaky or pumped up afterwards.

column9: Does exactly what I needed it to do
column10: I was having trouble finishing the P90X workouts after 6 months of doing them. Just running out of energy. This drink gives me the juice to finish, and break about 80% of my personal bests in the process. Gear results. I deducted 1 star for the taste. On ice it's ok, but I wouldn't say it's great tasting.

column9: Great tasting energy in a scoop of powder
column10: I have tried several pre-workout products on the market with questionable results to the efficacy of the product. Once I took my first scoop of Fast-twitch I noticed that in the gym my energy levels remained strong but not overly hyped up as you would expect from drinking coffee.My only warning is that this product contains caffeine which will keep you up if you take it for late night or evening workouts. I need to go online and check for a caffeine free version.

I use this mostly for mountain biking, running, mostly endurance sports.  I'm not a gym rat.  Was struggling getting my endurance up lately, I was getting tired quick into my rides.  Was always getting an electrolyte imbalance halfway thru my ride/run. Tried different diets, supplements, sodium crap, etc... Then I decided to give this a try.WOW! Whatever problems I had before they are officially gone.  It almost feels like cheating with this stuff.  I went from mid pack riding mtn bikes to front of the pack with friends asking 'what are you on?' Just follow directions... for some reason this stuff works great when your running on an empty stomach then 30min later your on fire.  It seems to last forever too, 15miles later I'm still climbing hills/mountains that I couldn't even climb before on fresh legs.  I can't figure out whats in this stuff... I know it has caffeine which I've taken many times before but this stuff is heaven sent.  I am in no way affiliated with this product just someone who is pointing out the obvious... this stuff works!

My main issue with this product is that i received the old formula with the old label. I wanted to try fast twitch because it was apparently caffeine free. That may be the case with the new formula but not the one i received. I have used it two times now and the product is a good pre workout supplement offering a good pump and good energy boost, however, it is not my favorite. Besides the caffeine that wasn't supposed to be in it, my second issue is the taste. It's a very potent pre workout compared to a Superpump Max by Gaspari that tastes more like a juice. Fast twitch is just very strong. I'm not totally sure if i did not mix it into enough water. Bottom line is that for the price it is worth it to try it out because you may see better results.

I recently ordered this product and can say that I am extremely pleased with the results. The taste is good, albeit strong; I recommend taking it with a generous portion of water. The creatine in it makes it easy to get your daily requirement and perhaps the most note-able ingredient in this is the endo-thermogens. I noticed that the rate at which I sweated had increased significantly and I was very hungry after my workout (I'm pretty sure that that is a good thing). As for the energy, I am sure that a caffeine product would give me more energy, but I would rather not become dependent upon stimulants such as that. With that in mind, I can say that I have more energy when working out to do more reps. I have seen significant strength gains in the three weeks I have spent using this product; my squat has gone up more than 50 pounds, deadlift about 20, bench about 10, and Preacher Curls an amazing 20 pounds!! Finally, I have noticed better pumps since starting it. Overall, I can say that I would definitely buy this product another time, and for the price you get quite a good amount of it. My only complaint is that on the second day during which I used it, I experienced some minor digestive problems; although it caused me little discomfort.

Been using it about 2 weeks now and this drink is great on my strength training days. Way more energy, doing more reps. Feels real good. I even used it on my HIIT days and still got great results. gave it a four cause its not the best taste in the world but i will stll buy it.

column9: All the energy without any of the stomach aches!
column10: I've used NO XPlod and other drink mixes like that in the past and always ended up having an upset stomach when it started to kick in.
