Sure they all work great, but I couldn't stand how it made me feel. I decided to give Fast Twitch a try and I haven't stopped using it since. I get no upset stomach and I still get great workouts.

the product does provide faster muscle 'time readiness' for that next set and increased weight, and does it best when the instructions are followed, meaning take on an empty stomach and start about 30 minutes before you actually beging to exercise.

Maybe I am bias to Cytosprt but I like this product. I like all cytosports products. I have tried other workout products like Dark Rage, Dark matter and Hemo Rage, those products really hurt my stomache for just about an hour after consumption. So bad, it felt like someone had their heel on my sternum while I was on the ground twisting it. This product is great.I like the results and the consumption of FAST TWITCH. I will re-order

Ok, maybe I'm a little bias here. But I love fast twitch :) This product was shipped fast, and I love the grape flavor. I use a little more than a scoop but I like in the powder form or the pre bottled form. I use it for weight loss and it does what it says~!~!~
This stuff wears off way to quickly.  Not nearly as affective as the companies previous line of NOS booster drink.  I would recommend looking else where.

column9: Great help to get in the gym and leave the excuses at home!
column10: The most important part is to take this on an empty stomach.  I had to get in the gym earlier because of having to take it on an empty stomach but I am happy with the results.  The taste is something you have to get used to.  It starts tasting better after few uses.  I have a hot water system in my house so I pour it on the powder and let it dissolve and then I pour really cold water and the taste is actually not that bad.  This stuff will not make you a sexual Tyrannosaurus or make you go over 9000.  I just gives you the energy and focus to go to the gym without excuses and get it done and get it done right.  Make sure to get a protein shake after workout so you can repair and be ready for the next day and keep the results coming.

column9: Works Great, Too much Caffeine for me.
column10: This is a great pre workout drink.  I had some issues using other products such as N.O. Explode with upset stomachs which resulted in unproductive workouts.  This stuff works and is made by the makers of muscle milk.  Does not taste great but it is drinkable.  The only problem I had was with the 200 mg of caffeine present in every scoop.  I liked this but they now have a new item out called Muscle N.O.  I bought it at Costco.  It is the same company.  It only has 100 mg of caffeine and has no creatine in it like the Fast Twitch does.  Another option is the Fast Twitch lemonade flavor which has no caffeine.Overall, good product.
I've been drinking this stuff everyday before i go to the gym and it gives me the boost i need to be awesome.
Excellent creatine product for those sensitive to caffeine, the flavor is just about right. Not too sweet or bitter.

column9: Works great, longer workouts no jitters!
column10: I have used this for a while now and I can feel it if I don't use it now. The lemon has no caffeine which I like so I don't get jittery like with Gaspari Super Pump 250...cannot sleep with that stuff. I am able to spend hours with decent consistent energy all the time. I lift more with it all the time and recovery seems a bit better and get more reps in and it really reduces the burn. No side effects I can see. I take it 40 minutes before and that seems to work best on an empty stomach. Takes a while to mix in and taste is fair...I don't drink it for that reason!

This worked for me.  It gave me noticable pump and endurance for my workouts.  I had to get used to the taste... it just doesn't taste natural nor good.It's always interesting when you buy these supplements because you never know if it'll work for you as advertised.  I've tried a few different varieties of supplements and none of them really worked like they were promised.  I don't put too much faith in these products but I do think if used correctly, a lot of them could give you an edge.  I believe Fast Twitch is one of those products.  It did work for me... nothing miraculous but it helped me to workout a little harder so no complaints here.  I guess it's up to you to decide if what you pay for this is worth that.

I don't know if I feel any different before, during, or after my workouts when using this stuff, but I do know I enjoy drinking this more than anything else. It tastes great and mixes with no chunks or leftover grains at the bottom. Even if it is just a mental thing, I feel really motivated when that shaker cup and cytosport come out of the cabinet. My only complaint is that it makes my mouth salivate hardcore. Almost as soon as I take a sip I feel like I have to spit. For my current regiment of indoor cardio, this is really inconvenient. I've basically worked around it by using half a scoop. But yeah, if I don't, lotsa spit.
it's not the best ive used, but for the price it does work good. you get what you pay for with any supplements.. cheaper isn't better

Great energy and fantastic pumps are a direct result of Fast Twitch for me. From the makers of Muscle Milk, Fast Twitch combines caffeine and creatine for an intense workout with an unbelievable flavor (grape especially).Warning: Do not take Fast Twitch if you don't workout! You will not be able to sleep!

column9: Too much sweet, not enough cherry.
column10: I bought this for my husband because he wanted to make Italian sodas, or at least mock Italian sodas, with it.  Unfortunately, the stuff just tastes like red sugar water.  I'm sure hummingbirds would love it, but it's not exactly what we had in mind.  If it had a bit more (a lot more, really) cherry flavor, then it'd be fine - obviously it's supposed to be sweet!
Great Item and service. Will order from this vendor again. Future customers should highly consider this item and vendor. Thanks!

This is a great product when used for what it was intended. It is not made to use as fresh sour cream on potatoes and the like. It is intended for baking or recipes like dips. It does not mix well straight into water, you add it with the powdered or dry part of your recipe and add the water with your other wet ingredients. I love powdered products and sour cream powder is a real convenience when you are out and need it.

column9: Sour cream powder and Chedder cheese powder
column10: I have made purchases from Berry Farms twice now and both times they have dilivered before the due date, usualy within a day or two.  The products are as advertised, and are real good for putting up for desaster storage.  The chedder cheese powder is the same thing as Kraft uses in it's macaroni and cheese.  The only draw back was there where no mixing directions for the chedder powder, but 1/4 cup of powder, 1/4 cup of butter (1/2 stick), and 1/4 cup milk makes a creamy sauce.  Just remember equal ammounts of powder, milk, and butter.  They still get 5 stars for prompt delivery.  I haven't had a customer service contact yet, so I can't grade them on that.  There web sight has a whole bunch of dried goods, and I have also ordered dried bell peppers and tomato powder from them.  Their packages are very well sealed and are packed for rough shipments.  I recomend this company highly.
This is so convenient to have in the house when you are a baker.  It is much easier than using fresh sour cream.  You just use the powder and water and your cake recipe is done.
While not as good as fresh, this product serves a great service, because it's on hand. I was throwing out half used cartons of sour cream because not used in time. I like it.

column9: Fresh sour cream and the exact amount needed
column10: I love using sour cream and I have been buying the cartons, and I freeze them, then when I thaw, the consistency is not the same nor the taste, I am so happy that I can now make fresh, with no waste and just the amount I need for my recipe
This is definately not for putting on potatoes, etc.  It is, however, great to have in your pantry for when you need sour cream in a cooked recipe.  It has a good shelf life and is easily prepared.

ALTHOUGH I RECEIVED MY SHIPMENT IN A TIMELY MANNER, I WAS VERY DISAPPOINTED WITH THE PRODUCT.  IT TASTES LIKE INSTANT NON-FAT DRY MILK AND NOTHING LIKE SOUR CREAM.  IT MAY BE OK TO USE IN COOKING, BUT NOT ON BAKED POTATOES.  ALSO, IT DOES NOT COME WITH DIRECTIONS.  IF I COULD, I WOULD GIVE IT MINUS 5 STARS, THAT'S HOW DISAPPOINTED I AM.  THE COMPANY MAY BE GOOD AND THEIR OTHER PRODUCTS MAY BE GOOD, BUT NOT THE SOUR CREAM POWDER.

Due to getting a comment which pointed out that I had failed to change the rating, I have now done so. Thank you to the one who brought this goof to my attention. The original 5-star rating was for the speed in shipping. If I could give this product a minus rating, I would, because it really is awful; a true waste of money. I would not even use this in a baked product where other flavors might come into play.

I purchased Simply Organic Carrot Cake Mix, Certified Organic, Fair Trade Certified(tm), 11.60 Ounce Boxes  (Pack of 3) mix at my local grocer for $4.99/box less $1 off coupon I got from the Simply Organic website.  It had an expiration date of over one year out on it.  It is fair trade certified as well as USDA organic.  The mix makes either two 8" or 9" round cakes or one 11" x 7" cake.  The directions call for 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup water, and 1 cup grated carrots.  It offers an alternate vegan recipe option by substituting 1/4 cup applesauce for the 2 eggs with no change in cooking times or temperature. There is also a bonus recipe on the box for pumpkin cake that adds 3/4 cup pumpkin filling to the other ingredients.  It also suggests that you can make a spice cake by omitting the carrots and adding 2 tablespoons of additional water.  It suggests topping the cake with either cream cheese frosting or dusting with powdered sugar.  I thought the flavor and texture were wonderful but that the cake was a little thin.  I made a delicious icing out of goat milk butter, goat milk cream cheese, vanilla, and confectioner's sugar.  I think next time, I would try making a one layer cake with the batter.  I would purchase again. Another good choice if you want already made gluten-free carrot muffins is Kinnikinnick frozen and you can add icing/frosting if you want.

I have purchased this carrot cake many times for family and friends and it always gets rave reviews.  The main word that always comes up to desribe this cake is AWESOME CAKE.  The only thing is you need to buy 2 boxes to make a 2 layer cake, but other than that it will be best carrot cake you have ever eaten.

column9: THE PREFECT CAKE...PLUS IT IS GLUTEN-FREE
column10: THIS IS THE PREFECT CAKE AND IT IS GLUTEN FREE!MOIST WITH NO GRAINY TEXTURE. FAMILY CAN NOT TELL IT IS GLUTEN FREE.A BIG PLUS IS THIS MIX IS LOWER IN FAT. YOU ADD EGG, WATER, CARROTS... NOT ADDING OIL OR BUTTER IS A PLUS FOR US.BOX OFFERS RECIPES A RECIPE FOR A VAGAN APPLE CAKE & PUMPKIN CAKE TOO .

No, seriously, this carrot cake (or the pumpkin cake variation, which I've also tried) is so good that I bought 10 boxes straight from the Simply Organic website, plus some of their other mixes.  I use the vegan recipe.  Amazing that I can enjoy a gluten-free, dairy-free, egg-free cake as much or more than I used to enjoy the allergen-full versions.  My normal-eating family all agree that this is quite possibly the best cake ever.

I am eating the cake as I write this review...it is really that good!I followed the instructions for the pumpkin cake recipe on the side of the box. I added half a 15oz can of pumpkin, but I also added about 1/3 cup of grated carrots and 4 diced dates (whatever was in the fridge). Once the cake cooled a bit, I smothered it with cream cheese frosting.For a gluten free carrot cake, it is bringing me to tears (of joy). For those in the room who are not gluten free, they are in disbelief! The cake is rich, moist (I think the pumpkin really added that moist factor), and perfectly spiced.I am thinking of trying these in cupcakes next time so we don't finish the whole cake in one sitting...

This Carrot Cake mix is absolutely delicious!  Do not let the "gluten free" title detract you. . .my husband has been eating gluten-free for about 10 years now and I rarely enjoy "his" food. . .I make an exception with this cake mix.  Everyone in the family eats them.  Making cupcakes with it is even better!  Don't let the price get in your way either. . .we don't have an organic food store in our town so after I drive 100 miles it's still just under $5/box.  Could you really make a carrot cake from scratch for that?  I vote for powdered sugar or a rich cream cheese icing to top it off.  There's also a vegan variation if you want to please one of your vegan friends.

This cake mix takes minutes to put together, add shredded carrot and raisins and the cake turns out amazingly well. Guests always rave about it and assume it's homeade! I've also made it as a simple spice cake, adding only the eggs and water and then sprinkling brown sugar on top. Delicious and so easy!
One 8-9 inch single layer cake per box.  This is a perfect cake.  Does not taste like some of the other gluten-free mixes out there.  Worth the money.

This mix is amazingly good! I was making a carrot cake for my mom's Bday and decided to make another one for my daughter and myself since we are both wheat intolerant. Bob's Red Mill, for some reason, upsets my daughter's stomach.I thought this might have a good enough taste, but expected it to be dry as you only add eggs, water, and carrots - but it was so moist! The taste was much better than i thought it would be! I added a bit more cinnamon, nutmeg and 1/2 a cup of chopped walnuts. I baked it in an 8x8 pan.  It is suppose to be baked 40-50 minutes. I set the timer at 40 to check and I am glad I did! It was done!!  My husband was very impressed (he got to eat the from scratch carrot cake with gluten) - but for a change we didn't feel left out. You could easily eat this without any frosting - it is that tasty (reminded me of the spice cake my mom use to make for my dad)This one will be ordered again - for sure!

This mix makes the best cake I've ever tasted in my life!  It is PHENOMENAL!  Nobody would ever guess it is GF, that is the last thing on anyone's mind when eating this cake.  I like to make a homemade icing to go with it (butter, powdered sugar, vanilla extract, and milk) - YUUMMM!  My husband and I have had it at least 4 times already, and he asks for it constantly (he is GF, I'm soy free).  I'm usually back and forth between the health food store, but finally I put my foot down and we're ordering online in bulk!  :D

This is the best cake mix for making a gluten free dessert. My family loves the taste. We've made it with carrots and with pumpkin, as cakes and as cupcakes, with homemade cream cheese frosting and with butter frosting. All delicious, always!

The #1 ingredient in this mix is sugar. The mix looks like sugar and spices, without flour. It does have flour though - brown rice flour, I believe. I mixed it with juliened carrots (already juliened from the salad section of the produce isle), chopped walnuts and some shredded coconut. Baked in a bundt pan for the recommended time. Did not rise very much. But, was delicious. Very dense and moist. Ate it warm with ice cream. Even my teenager liked it
Fat free items are hard to find.  This not only gives you solutions to create fat free dessert but lends itself to other variations, like pumpkin cake,mmmm, both are yummy.

column4: Sara Free-Bird "Try and you will know"
column10: I have purchased this carrot cake many times for family and friends and it always gets rave reviews. The main word that always comes up to desribe this cake is AWESOME CAKE. The only thing is you need to buy 2 boxes to make a 2 layer cake, but other than that it will be best carrot cake you have ever eaten.

column9: It's good, not the greatest, but it's decent.
column10: This is not the best carrot cake I've had.  But it's okay, a little too sweet for my taste, and I'm not shy of using sugar in my cooking.  I used the eggs and made the recipe.  Refrigerated it, and then ate it the next day, and I was pleasantly surprised...it has sort of a chewy taste which I LIKE!  I'll buy this again...son likes it, but this is not the best carrot cake I've had.  It's decent though, organic and gluten free, so I shouldn't complain.

I bought this cake mix in hopes of making a great carrot cake.  The other reviewers loved it, but I was disappointed.  The texture comes out odd and somewhat gummy, and the overall taste is a bit off.  It's fine to satisfy a sweet tooth, but nothing to write home about (unless it's in a review).

Made this for my daughters first birthday "smash" cake. It was heavy like a brick. I'm still giving it 4 stars because it still did taste good but you can't really smash bread that efficiently, lol. It didn't rise very well for me and I tried it using eggs and using applesauce. I don't think I will buy again for cake purposes, I like my cake light and fluffy, unfortunately maybe only the "bad for you" cakes are able to achieve this. I will add that I'm not an out of this world kind of baker but the boxed regular cake I made everyone else turned out how I would expect.
This cake mix is outstanding in its flavor and wide range of uses. i have made cakes, cookies, breads and more with it. It works great every time and people love the flavor.

The purchase price was fairly good on sale, but I was very disappointed with how tiny the cake was when cooked. I followed the directions exactly, and the cake only rose a scant 1" in the MIDDLE of the cake. I have been baking gluten free for a couple years, and even as a novice, I can get a cake to rise higher than that! I would not purchase again unless the purchase price was cut drastically so I could purchase several boxes and combine them to make a normal size cake.

This carrot cake is DELICIOUS, and very, very easy.  The directions say to use an 8" or 9" pan.  I used a 9" pan, and the cake only came out 3/4" high. Keep this in mind and consider using an 8" pan and/or making two or three layers.  (I ended up doing two 9" layers.)  Also, the directions don't call for any nuts or raisins.  My guests commented that the cake was as delicious as anything they'd ever had from a bakery, but when I asked if it could use nuts, they said, "oh, yes! Or raisins."  That said, I'm not sure how either of those would chage the baking time, so if you're going to do that, you better know more about baking than me.  Also, I, personally, can't stand nuts in baked goods - but that has no relevance to you or this review. :-)  Order, bake and enjoy!

This product is light, not too sweet and very satisfying.  Just what it says it is and shows on the box.  There is no sacrifice of delectable quality in the pursuit of a gluten free product at all.  Needs no frosting at all! Guests told me how wonderful the cake was even when they didn't know it was good for everybody, including us gluten free folk.

column9: Cella's Chocolate Covered Cherries in a word YUM!
column10: Cella's hands down makes the best Chocolate covered Cherries.  We usually buy them seasonally in the local stores but have a hard time finding the dark chocolate as those seem to sell out quicker than the milk chocolate.That said, recently I bought high priced CCC (chocolate covered cherries)from Helen Grace Chocolates.  I was desperate for some and no Cella's in the local stores.  What a disappointment!  Any CCC lover knows that the liquid center makes up for 98% of the taste and the Helen Grace were lacking this.  There was a scant (and I mean very scant) liquid center so all you really tasted was the chocolate, very overpowering!  At 18.50 per pound it was a ripoff!  From now on I am staying with Cella's.  You won't be disappointed at all, they know how to make a cordial center!

column9: One of the best brands of chocolate covered cherries!
column10: I absolutely love these chocolate covered cherries. I have seen reviews on other sites, comparing the different brands, and I see a lot of hate on these for no fondant in the center. That is really why these are so good! I like cherries with both the fondant (key: if it's good), but also the liquid centers. I had these for the first time as a child after usually getting just Queen Anne cherries, and I still love these. Zachary, the brand Walmart and a lot of other places carry, are just gross..the chocolate is grainy and cheap tasting. It is getting increasingly hard for me to find Cella's in stores. I usually only find them in a local drug store or discount mart by chance, but I'm so happy to find them here. Also, dark chocolate cherries are so much better in my opinion, but Cella's is the only brand that I actually like the milk chocolate too! Its a wonderful, crisp, creamy chocolate. Yum! Can't wait to get these and eat them! I've been getting by on Queen Anne (which are equally as good in their own right, meaning fondant centers)so I can't wait to finally get a box of Cella's!

Ohhhhh.... Is this what Heaven is like? Without a doubt, these are the best chocolate candies in the universe! The combination of chocolate, cherry and liquid center is to die for. I've tried other brands, and always come back to Cella's. If you are in search of candy perfection, Cella's is the brand to buy! They are positively addictive.
These were delivered quickly and are delicious.  Highly recommend this for anyone with a weakness for chocolate covered cherries.  Yum!

Golly, writing this review is making me drool!  Years ago, you could only buy these in Ohio at Christmastime.  However, some wise soul figured it would make good marketing sense to make them available year round for us addicts and well, voila! No more buying tons of these boxes at Christmas and storing them in the freezer all year!  Golly these things are awesome!  I've been eating them for 40 years and still can't get enough of them. In my husband's family, they were always the first gift of Christmas, delivered from Santa.  These things are in so many family traditions, that they HAVE to be doing something right. Highly, highly recommend!

column9: Steel cut oats are the way to go, for the sake of texture.
column10: While you may not be astounded by the difference in flavor from standard rolled oats (the standard these days on the shelves I see), the difference in texture is quite nice. column10: I spend all day working in the Texas summer sun. For years I've had issues with hydration, I could drink 2 gallons of water a day, but was having trouble replenishing electrolytes. column9: Love the smell and taste and price
column10: I have been buying the gold label virgin coconut oil from Tropical Traditions for years.  I usually buy 1 gallon bucket at a time.  I transfer some to wide mouth mason jar from the plastic bucket.  I try to avoid plastic, but buying it in quart glass jars cost 2x more.  I was out and getting ready to order another bucket.  I am glad I decided to read some reviews on other coconut oils on amazon.  Based on reviews for this oil (single jar, but I bought 12 pack) I decided to try it.  I love Dr. Bronner's soaps, so why not buy this oil.  I know prices change on amazon.  I bought this set for $104, I calculated the cost to compare it to tropical traditions (1 gallon bucket on sale for $75+7.37 shipping snail mail=$82.37) and this one 14 oz x12= 1.3125 gallon which boils down to $72.24 per gallon).  So it turned out to be cheaper AND in convenient glass jars, so I don't have to transfer the oil from bucket to jar.  Another plus:  it smells better than Tropical Traditions.  I know TT can vary in taste and smell from batch to batch, and mine might have been older since I was on my last 1/2 quart.  I just loved the fresh smell of Dr.B's coconut oil, taste matched the wonderful coconutty aroma.  It might help with taste and smell retention by having it in separate jars that don't get open until use (not like the bucket that I open once or twice a month to refill my more convenient container).  Another thing I love about this oil is that it comes in standard jars that have an opening to fit canning lids.  I can my own produce and my town doesn't recycle glass.  I can reuse these jars myself or give to friends who can their produce.  Local beekeepers also welcome them to put their honey:  they can use standard canning lids.  The only bad thing I have to say about this oil is not on the product itself but the company that sold it to me (poor packaging or maybe poor delivery on UPS part).  Some people think it doesn't belong in the review of the product, some think customer service is part of it, so I'm including it as well.  The jars weren't packed well and 4 lids got crushed and oil leaked.  Glass wasn't broken (luckily).  Company has a very good customer service and offered me a choice:  refund or replacement of the damaged jars.  I'm happy and give this product 5 stars.

column9: The Best Mexican Picante Hands Down
column10: This hot sauce is so tasty with Mexican food / Tex Mex that for me personally, nothing even touches it. This isn't a hot sauce that I would use for Buffalo Wings or home fries. I always thought it did, and it is very yummy, but not like this stuff on Tex mex or Mexican chow. I live in Upstate New York and travel a lot for business. I buy this stuff on the west coast for $1.29 a bottle at the grocery store, bubble wrap it and bring it home in my luggage. I think about this hot sauce some times. It's amazing. column9: Hot but not too hot - a nicely blended hot sauce. Purchase this "extra hot " variety. The regular version is Not Recommended
column10: Lets face it - the Mexicans love hot food and generally know how to make a fine hot sauce. While the label (in small print) says "extra hot" there are many other sauces which are far hotter.  Think in terms of needing 5 or 6 drops for a bloody mary rather than spoonfuls when using this sauce. It is far from being "extra hot". I'd call it medium hot.Important: There is a significant difference between this "extra hot" variety of Valentina hot sauce and their regular variety. The easiest way to tell the two apart is the regular version has a light yellow background on the label and this one - the so called "extra hot" has a black background on the label. To my taste, the "extra hot" is far superior.Ingredients (as copied from the label): water, chili peppers, vinegar, salt ...Which chili peppers Valentina used is unknown, yet the company has certainly created a nice blend. You can easily detect some sweetness in this sauce and that has to be due to a nice blend of the chiles. There are no added sugars!Normally I don't like any vinegar in a hot sauce, yet I don't mind it all in this particular version of Valentina. The difference may be this sauce uses actual vinegar while most others use acetic acid (a chemical component of vinegar) and the chili peppers dominate in this particular variety of Valentina. I want to emphasize that this is ONLY true for this particular blend.The bottom line is this is a nicely blended hot sauce worthy of your consideration. My four star rating means this is a very good hot sauce but, depending on your palette, you might find a few that are better.Warning: there is a significant differences between the regular Valentina and the "extra hot" (black label) variety that I'm reviewing here. In the regular version a heavy taste of vinegar is painfully evident while the "extra hot" variety is much better balanced, ie, the vinegar is in the background. So it is quite important that you choose the extra hot version - the one with a black background on the label.This is a near perfect hot sauce for a bloody mary and most other foods.BTW: Watch out for sellers that price the sauce low but charge very high shipping charges on a per bottle basis

As a result, the hot sauce adds flavor instead of taking away.In fact, it may taste too good. The heat has a way of sneaking up on you. column9: A nice blend. Medium heat - not too much vinegar and a smart buy in the 32 oz size
column10: I really like this sauce. It is a great blend! While there is nothing truly remarkable about it - more importantly - it has no obvious flaws.  It simply has a nicely balanced flavor and that alone is quite rare in hot sauces!!!! This sauce could or should be a staple in any kitchen.  I'm glad to have a bottle in my pantry.I would rate this sauce somewhere between mild and medium hot. You'll need more than a couple of drops but not much more than that to generate some heat in any dish. Compared to Tabasco's original you'll need about twice the number of drops.Ingredients (as copied from the label): Water, Red Peppers, Salt, Spices, Garlic, Acetic Acid (a component of vinegar), etc ......Note the relatively low level of vinegar within the sauce. That is a good thing. The type of red pepper is unknown but there is a natural sweetness to this sauce which I find quite pleasant. That sweetness balances nicely against the heat. View this sauce as a superior alternative to a very common benchmark - the original Tabasco hot sauce.Minor flaws: There is a bit too much salt in this sauce but that only becomes evident when used in an already heavily salted dish. For example: This is not the best choice for a Bloody Mary due to the heavily salted nature of most vegetable/tomato juices.Since this sauce is available in 5 oz, 10 oz and 32 oz sizes - you'd be wise to pick up the 32oz size given the fact that it often costs little more than the smaller sizes.This is a fine basic hot sauce with a natural sweetness to it. This sauce is worthy of being a staple in any kitchen. It is better than most. What it lacks is that rare sense of freshness and, as noted, there is also a bit too much salt.

column9: Great Flavor with a lot of heat

This Scotch was a mystery to me; I always thought that Johnnie Walker only came in colors. Turns out, they have this little quiet Scotch called Swing.Swing is a soft, delicate, smooth Scotch. There is a lot of honey flavor along with an incredible smoothness. This Scotch is very easy to drink. There is no smoky flavor at all.So where does it fit in the color scheme of things, someplace close to Gold. The price point is slightly more expensive than Gold. Where Red, Black, Double Black, and Green make a wonderful smoky progression, culminating with Blue, Swing stands almost alone. Its cousin is Gold, but Swing is much more refined and maybe a little bit sweeter.I love this Scotch, and I am a died in the wool smoke fan - Green is one of my favorite every day drinking Scotch. I really dislike Gold, it is too thick and the edges are too sharp and unfinished. Swing hits a very happy medium with those edges smoothed off. There are no really sharp flavors in this Scotch, just a lovely sweet honey flavor.From the Johnnie Walker website, Swing was supposed to be made for sailing ships, to take to the new worlds and sell. The shape of the bottle was supposed to keep it upright in a ship. Frankly, I'm not a big fan of the bottle. The maritime story is nice, but I much prefer Johnnie Walker's square bottle. The sad thing, this looks like a Crown Royal or Pinch bottle, and frankly was the reason I'd never bought it before. Don't judge a book by its cover; the contents are far better than Crown Royal or Pinch.If you like smooth Scotch, this is a winner.The picture for this product makes the bottle look like it has hideous black lines on it. The bottle is really beautiful - clear glass with the amber Scotch inside. There are no black vercrose veins on the bottle.

I bought this dog food because the bag showed pictured of veggies and chunks of meat, and with a name like "Beneful" I thought I was purchasing a nutritious brand of dog food. My dogs did eat this food, but after reading the ingredients I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my dogs. The first three ingredients are Ground yellow corn, chicken by-product meal, and corn gluten meal. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a corn filler. One thing my vet told me a while back that I never forgot: "When you eat corn, what comes out of the other end? The same thing happens with dogs." Basically, dogs cannot digest corn, it is just a filler and causes them to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more, and retain less nutrients. The only meat in Beneful at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful dog food. I can't believe the pictures of veggies and full chunks of meat on the bag can be allowed to be on the packaging of such a disgusting product; it is very misleading and should be considered false advertising.I recommend to stay far away from Beneful, and most Purina products. When purchasing a dog (or cat) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for,  I usually buy my pets all natural, organic foods such as Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness.

Expected this all-natural sourdough rye bread mix from Germany to be much better.  The packaging is attactive, with instructions that are easy to follow for bread machines and conventional ovens.  You get a bag of the flour, a packet of yeast, and two packets of liquid sourdough starter.  I used my Zojirushi bread machine on the whole wheat setting, which usually works great.  Trial number 1: Made exactly according to package directions, the bread came out like an undercooked doughy rock.  While it did rise during the process, the last rise was minimal.  Usually a 1 1/2 pound loaf bakes 7-8" high in my machine.  This one was barely 4" high, half of what is should be.  The taste was bitter and the herb flavors, including caraway, coriander, and fennel, were unpleasant.  Trial number 2:  I added an egg and an extra packet of yeast, plus 2 tsp of sugar, in an effort to help the bread rise more.  I also baked it for 10 minutes longer in the regular oven after the bread machine finished so it wouldn't be so doughy.  The result was no better than the first. The loaf was very heavy, bitter and taste, not good at all, inedible. Trial number 3:  This time I combined the package of Seitenbacher with half of a standard white bread recipe that works well in my machine (basic white bread: 1 5/8 cup unbleached white flour, 1/2 cup plus 1 T water, 1 T dry milk powder, 2 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1 packet of yeast).  I hoped that the combination of a lighter white bread with this dark heavy rye would help.  Well the resulting loaf did rise more, but only to about 7-8".  This is essentially 1 1/2 time the usual recipe, so it should have risen to the top of the pan, 10-11" or more.  It's still very heavy, and the additional sugar did nothing to overpower the strong bitter flavor of this bread.  It did taste a little better with a lot of butter on it, but not enough to really enjoy it.  I had to convince myself I liked it, but I didn't.Perhaps this style of bread is supposed to have a bitter flavor, but it's really unique in a negative way, and unlike any rustic sourdough rye I've ever had.  I'll be feeding my three experimental loaves to the birds.  I do wonder if the Seitenbacher German Farmers Bread without seeds would taste better or not, but it might also has the same herbs.

She always chows down on Purina, though, and I also don't have any problems with extreme litter box smells, as I did when experimenting with one other brand. Yikes!

Let me start off by saying that I have fed all 5 of my cats this food since they were very young.  It is only recently that my most fragile one developed urinary troubles.  I have done a lot of research on diet since then, and have discovered that there are much better foods out there for cats.  I originally choose this food becuase the ingredients seemed a bit better than other brands at the grocery store and the price was very affordable.  So if that's your goal, this is a pretty decent food choice.  However, in my research I discovered that cats should not be eating grains.  Also, chicken, or meat should be in the first couple ingredients if not the first ingredient.  That being said, it seemed to work fine with the other four cats, I don't why the 5th cat was more sensitive to it, though he did eat it for about 6 months until he developed his problem.  Moral of the story, if you need food, it serves it's purpose.  Though because I am now a bit more health aware, I will no longer be feeding this food to any of my future kittens.  If you do decided to feed this or any other dry food, I would recommend also feeding canned food once or twice a day to add moisture to the diet.  On another note, the subscribe and save is very handy.  Not only is it a bit cheaper, but it saves you the trouble of having to go to the store and buy it.  I wish they had subscribe and save for more items.

column9: High quality product I rely upon..thank you, Purina!
column10: I must agree with the first reviewer, as I've never once seen any feline of any age show anything less than enthusiasm for Purina Kitten Chow. I purchase at least one on these seven pound bags per month, although my youngest are now approaching one year of age. Many people (myself included) avoid commercial cat foods, but I've had some truly great results with Kitten Chow over the years.I don't think of Kitten Chow as "for kittens only". No doubt there are people who will disagree, but I've observed the benefits of feeding to older cats or kittens who are either malnourished, recuperating from a surgical procedure or are outdoor, feral cats who refuse to allow humans to touch them. This is what I bought and fed a young female cat who arrived on my front porch last winter, cold, starving and frightened..and, as I realized about a month later, when she'd gained weight and bone mass, very pregnant. Initially, I hadn't expected this cat to survive, but she thrived.Then I feared that if she succeeded in giving birth to a litter, her kittens might be weak and have a less than optimal chance for growing to adulthood. Wrong again! She got through the birth like a champion and each of her four kittens are healthy and happy (all, including the Mom cat have been spayed or neutered). Her diet and then theirs, until they were weaned: Purina Kitten Chow, a Cat Mother's Milk supplement and chicken or turkey (human) baby food. The Kitten Chow remains as part of their regular diet.The feral outdoor cats benefit from the extra nutrients and fat content. I often wonder how these poor critters survive sub-freezing temperatures and have built a few small shelters to keep them out of the wind, rain and snow that I've no evidence they use (back to the shelter drawing board for me!), but Purina Kitten Chow is food they adore and eat and I'm convinced it has helped these cats survive (and one I was able to humanely trap and have neutered and vaccinated before releasing him back outdoors ~ his definite preference ~ survived the surgery and the winter cold, an attack by another feral and territorial cat and now appears quite healthy).I could be a snob about this as so many people seem to be: if a product is commercial, it isn't trustworthy or truly good..but I've seen a lot of recalls of very expensive high-end guaranteed organic kitten and cat foods and Purina Kitten Chow did not seem to make it to the recall list. When I believe a feline needs even more nutrition than this food provides (a RARE occurrence), I typically resort to DIY recipes where there is no issue with Quality Assurance.Honestly, this food is not only a favorite with cats of all ages, but I believe it is also a lifesaver. It's great that Amazon has made this product available, as it saves me a 50+ mile trip into town and a lot of running around miles of a "Super store" to be able to receive it via USPS at regular intervals. Now that these kittens are *technically* cats, it might seem less than optimal to feed them Kitten Chow. Still, I continue to incorporate it into their diet. The only reason I could imagine NOT to make this food available to your kitten or cat is if they appeared to be overweight..and mine (who live entirely indoors) aren't. They're in terrific shape! They all have exquisitely beautiful and healthy coats, lovely clear eyes & zero GI problems. They prefer the Kitten Chow to Purina's "All Ages" Original Formula and if you feel any concerns you can always mix a percentage of both together as an extra incentive ~ and those of you for whom price is no object: it's good to keep a bag around when your cat refuses to eat the high end Prescription Diet.Again, this is the food of choice IMO for feeding feral outdoor cats..particularly when you cannot afford to buy the really high end food that isn't necessarily any better (and is potentially far worse). In case you're concerned about longetivity: I've had a cat who lived to be nearly twenty years old who was entirely a Purina Kitten and Cat Chow cat who was healthy right to the end of his considerably long (indoor/outdoor..before I had the wisdom to learn that keeping one's cats indoors 24/7 was the kindest, safest way to go) life.
My cats just love this kitten food. It doesn't upset their bellies and has all of the nutrition they need for a good price.
My 3 month old kitten wouldn't eat it.  Now I'm left with 2.75 bags full of worthless kitten food.  Do not recommend this product, and advise you to spend a little more for quality.

This is the best food to my knowledge you can get for your growing kittens. It's best to feed it to them until they are one year old. Because, they are still growing until that age. The tin is a little difficult to open but I was pleasantly surprised by how much dipping spice was in there!  The tins were packaged well for shipping and it all arrived as promised (it took about a week).  Also, there was a previous review questioning the expiration date...all of mine had a sticker with the date stamped on the bottom of the can.

column9: So wonderful in olive oil with a nice crusty bread!
column10: Of all the Dean Jacobs Dipping seasoning, I like this one the best.  Such rich flavors that just make your bread sing!  The addition of the Parmesan cheese adds a bit of saltiness to the other wonderful herbs.  Bread with olive oil and this seasoning and a nice Caesar Salad is all you need for a wonderful dinner!

The blend of flavor is fantastic for this olive oil seasoning for bread dipping.  I also add this to pita bread with a bit of olive oil and put in the toaster over for a great treat and also mix with olive oil, parsley flakes and a bit of S&P and toss this with boiled potatoes for a great side dish.The only downside is that it's a bit pricey but so flavorful that a little goes a long way. They do not ship to Puerto Rico so I did have to ship it to a friend who then sent it to me thus adding additional costs.
I love dipping oils/spices and this is one of my favorites. It has a little bit of a salty taste (because of the cheese) but I like that in my dipping spices. The flavor is full and not heavy.

column9: Love it and can't find it!
column10: This spread is so tasty, a great breakfast spread or alternative treat to a candybar! So much better tasting that Nutella! I used to be able to buy it at Walmart and Target, neither carry it any longer...I'll be stocking up through Amazon.
Pros: Tastes good, non-toxic, colorfulCons: Made me fat, can't cut a tomato, ineffective against burglars.I will give it 5 stars, because stars are cool so there should always be as many as possible.

Our family and friends are hooked on this candy. It's been described as a cross between gum and starbursts. The flavors are great. The only thing to contend with is the substitution of flavors  without warning. Lemon is hard to find and to have it advertised as available was deceptive. Our pack was missing orange and lemon and were substituted with grape and melon. Two of our other favorite flavors. Disappointed but not worth returning the lot. I will, however, not purchase from this seller as we can get the other flavors locally for cheaper.

This is what Starbursts wish they were! And I love that I can order a multi pack rather than 10 packs of just one flavor. BUT a word of warning that you may get different flavors from the ones pictured above! We love every flavor so that's not a big deal for some, but others that have their hearts set on a certain flavor combination should stay away. Ours had Grape and Melon rather than Orange and Lemon.

If you have a "sweet spot" for sweets and/or less than an iron will-then DON'T buy these.  That's right, put the mouse down and walk away now!  Why, you may ask?  Because these tasty morsels are the equivalent of fruity, chewy, delicious crack. (Imagine Starburst without the artificial colors and flavors and a greater variety of flavors.) They are so wonderfully addictive that the package should contain a warning like-"MAY BE DETRIMENTAL TO DIETING AND LETHAL TO DIABETICS".Now, chocolate has always been my "drug" of choice.  At least until I tried these tasty tidbits!  Now if I was stranded on a desert island and given a choice between a lifetime supply of chocolate or a lifetime supply of Hi-chew assorted fruit chews, the fruit chews would win hands down.Gee, do you think these count as a serving of fruit?  Who am I fooling, I'm going to eat them anyway!
All the flavors are pretty good except for the Melon one.  If you have a membership you can get this assorted pack for about 7 bucks at Costco.

Hi-Chew, hands down has to be one of the best candies that you may ever try. It's a real shame that it isn't marketed aggressively here in the States. Personally I think that they could become a major player in the market here since the only real competition is Starbursts which lets face it, has no flavor that really comples you.Anyway, I originally got introduced to Morinaga Hi-Chew at my local World Market, when I was looking for a quick candy fix to go along with my Ramune soda and discovered these little guys. But at almost 2 dollars for these and 4 for the bags, I was severely limited I purchasing because let's face it 2+ for some candy is a bit steep. So I was thrilled to find it on Amazon at a competitive rate. All in all, if you haven't tried this product then your missing out on something great.
I did not enjoy all the flavours, but overall it is a good product. They do replicate the fruit well with regards to taste in candy form.  Was not a big fan of the melon flavour.

We love this candy! We love the texture, it's like edible gum.  We love the different flavors.. my favorite is grape, 2nd favorite is melon (canteloupe); my husband's favorite is mango; my daughter loves all of them.  Flavors we got were the ones in description: 2 packs each of Strawberry, grape, Green Apple, melon, and Mango.  If you have a favorite you can order packs of 10 or 20 of only one flavor here on amazon, price depends on the flavor I think..At our local Asian/international market, there are only a few Hi-chew flavors, and sometimes they don't even have them at all.  They did have banana which I didn't like so much.  Plus I guess they were old cuz they were super hard!So I'm happy with this amazon purchase and would repurchase this. This pack costs $11, comes out to $1.10 each.. even if the price fluctuated it's still worth it for me to order amazon... takes us an hour to get to the Asian store and half hour to get to World Market.. gas plus tax.. then they might not have any!

I love Hi-Chews, it's like a higher version of starburst. This combo pack comes with 2 each, 5 different flavors. Mango, Strawberry, Grape, Apple, & Melon. These are the flavors put in order of best tasting to worst. The melon is absolutely disgusting. After trying it, I traded the unopened one in at my local convenience store for the strawberry flavor. HAHA. And, the apple has a chemical taste to it. I like to eat them by cutting the strawberry, mango, and grape pieces into thirds, and reconnecting them for a trifecta of the three best flavors, tastes AAAH-Mazing. The Mango tastes amazing, so does the strawberry, both mouth watering. and the grape is very, very good as well. the other two, Not so much, but I don't have to deal with them anymore. :)

The name is literal: these are very chewy and quite sticky. However, they are very tasty and have a nice fruity flavor. Absolutely delicious and this pack is large enough to last for a long time!One star down is for price difference. I've seen this at Costco for as low as $4.

I've been a fan of the "Hi-Chew" candies for quite some time and was glad to find this variety pack on Amazon.com! I especially like the chewy consistency (chewier than a Starburst, sort of a more dense consistency and that's a good thing) and the burst of flavor in each one. My favorites are the strawberry and green apple, though the mango is also good. The melon flavor is a little strange, my roommate described it as eating perfume, and I think that makes more sense than anything else. Overall, a yummy candy treat!
I love Hi-chews,they taste so good! but please, eliminate the hydrogenated oils!I mean, i know this isn't the healthiest of products, but hydrogenated-oils are abysmal.
Tastes great, and it's cheaper than buying it in the stores.  For some reason, it is the "official" candy of yoyo'ers and my son always takes some to yoyo championships.

I love these. Out of all the candy I ordered from Amazon, this was the best. It was genuinely what I ordered. Absolutely love the strawberry and green apple. I would order from them again; they sent me exactly what I ordered, which is more than I can say about candy I ordered from two separate sellers.
i love how hi-chew is not super sugary sweet, like starburst. green apple is my fave flavor; some of the others taste kind of waxy to me.

column9: HiChew: The love child of Gummy Bears and Starbursts.
column10: Mmmm... a cross between Starburst fruit chews and Gummy Bears.  These are great!  They're available in my neighborhood in Korean grocery stores, but for those of you who don't happen to have access, these are a unique candy treat.

column9: I bet you can't eat just one!
column10: These soft fruit chews are so good and so juicy, I basically inhaled a whole pack! I'm ashamed to say!The flavors are bold!Grape, strawberry and apple are my personal favorites.These are really good...you have been warned!
I had these in Korea a few years back and finally thought to order some from Amazon. I was not disappointed. Whether in Asia or not, this candy is still the best!
I don't really eat these as much as the wife but they are good. The wife thinks they are the best thing since cotton candy. Too bad they don't seem to sell these anywhere on the East Coast.
these things are the best, i live in hoboken nj and just about every corner grocer sells them..usually the asian owned ones......they are so tasty!

HI-CHEW is my personal all time favorite candy.  It's all about the texture.  It's almost like a cross between a starburst and a gummy bear.  Soft and chewy, but not like stick to your teeth chewy.  And the flavors are awesome.  They taste more like real fruit flavors instead of being over the top sweet with and imitation fruit flavor.  I've loved this candy ever since a friend went to Japan and brought some back.  And I would buy it every time I got lucky and stumbled upon it in a random liquor store or japan town.  I'm just so glad I can find it on amazon now and buy it in bulk whenever I want!  :)

column9: Love them, but there is something different....
column10: When I found out that these were the American version of my favorite Chinese candy, I was ecstatic to buy them and try them out. With a nice assorted pack, this box has all the flavors that I was looking for, but I would have to say in decreasing order my favorite would go: Strawberry>Green Apple>Mango>Grape>Melon. However all of them are great. For some reason, when I have the Chinese version, they always seem to taste better, however, this just might be in my head and I could be crazy. Nonetheless, these are by far my favorite candy. I always tell my friends when they asks me about them that they are a "healthy starburst" which at 210 calories a pack they are. With real fruit and a taste so real, I would recommend these candies to anyone who wants a little sugar without all the calories and sugar of Starburst! You wont be let down.I hope this helps:)Note: Here is the Chinese Version : Morinaga - Japanese Hi-Chew Strawberry Candy -- Choice of 1 Pack or 12 PacksBut they seem a little expensive

When looking at the picture and the caption saying "10 Pack," i thought that they were going to give ten packets of whatever was shown in the image (so a total of 50 small packs over all).However, it only came with 1 large package, or 10 small packs over all. That comes out to about $1.50 per pack. If you visit any Asian market, Hi Chew costs at most $1.Not only am I overpaying for candy, but I'm overpaying while buying in bulk which should NEVER happen.
Check this out! original, organic, sooo tasty . . .get some of this yummy bean for your A.M.  Love their teas too!

This was the first time I tried these smoked pork loin ribs and I must say..........they were scrumptious! They were about 1/2 bone to 1/2 meat but truly succulent.  Quick and easy to prepare in my convection oven.  I will be buying these again when Omaha Steaks has it's next 50% off sale.
Ribs were very tasty and tender and I will definitely buy them again.  Just had to put them in aluminum foil with a little water and heat so easy to fix.
Excellent quality whole fenugreek.  Well packaged and shipped quickly. Would definately order other products from this seller.

I love this coffee, I am very picky about my coffee, but this one is just perfect, it is sweet and just good.  I would have given a 5 for taste, but I'm also reviewing the cost which I think is horrible, there are so many other kinds you can get so much cheaper, don't know why it costs this amount but I'm stuck cause I do love the coffee!

In my opinion, none of these flavored coffees actually taste like the names they are given.  This one is no exception. All I can say is that it doesn't taste like regular coffee.  Give it a try and see what you think.

At first I thought this might taste funny - blueberry coffee is not a flavor you think of much.  But I've had raspberry flavoring in coffee and liked it, so I thought I'd give this a try.  Well worth it!  Really nice berry aftertaste, smooth and not bitter.  If you like strong coffee - this is not for you, but if you are looking for flavor and something different - try it, you'll like it.

I love that green mountain has made blueberry K cups;  I have always loved brewing the coffee in my pot and I am very satisfied that I can make it in a single serving use. the smell is great. I do wish the taste was a bit stronger, but it's perfect with a teaspoon of sugar. The price was excellent too! I am very glad it has dropped and made it more affordable. It's cheaper here than in the store. Will definatly order again
Love this coffee BUT I wish the flavor was just a tad bit more.It's a definite keeper in my supply, it does have a good taste with no bitterness it just needs a bit more blueberry flavor.
This is are most favorite coffee!!! Can't find it in any store!! This is a good price and beyond fast shipping!!! Thanks!!!
I tried this flavor of coffee pods as a change of pace but I don't love it.  It's ok, but not my favorite.

I love the light blueberry flavor of this coffee.  It doesn't overpower, but instead gives the coffee just the right note of fruit.  MMMMM...Blueberry coffee and a good book are just the right way to start off a lazy Saturday.
This coffee is turning into one of my favorites. Unlike other "flavored" coffee this one has a natural taste and an amazing aroma.

I do like flavored coffee but have a hard time finding ones that have flavor and aroma too.  This is only the second one I have found that does have both.  I only gave it 4 stars because I always think there might be a better one coming up.  I have given it to people who don't even like blueberry and they loved this coffee.

I came across this coffee while looking for Coconut and Pumpkin Spice Kcups, thought to myself oh yuck.. read all the positive reviews and decided to give it a try, its one of my favorites now, although the price on Amazon is stupid now at $26 a box :( I would certainly give this coffee a try.

column9: Excuse me, would you like a blueberry muffin with your coffee?
column10: Tastes like Blueberry muffin and coffee without the muffin. My opinion is that its better than Green Mountain Coffee Golden French Toast, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers, but not as good as Green Mountain Coffee Caramel Vanilla Cream, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers. It's all a matter of opinion, and all of these Green Mountain flavored coffees are mild with artificial flavors. It boils down to, would you rather have a blueberry muffin or french toast drenched with maple syrup with your coffee? Try 'em all, and pick your favorite is my suggestion. Also, check out the other flavors to see which is lower priced and take turns.
Love this coffee. Was not sure I would like it but I got hooked. Wish it was made more available and in stores as well.

Partial to blueberry anyways, but this coffee fills the house with a wonderful smell and makes you want to drink more! I highly recommend this flavored coffee :-)Top it off with french vanilla creamer for a special treat!

column9: Good with blueberry muffins or scones
column10: This has a natural flavor to it, not artificial at all, and some of the K-cups do have a serious artificial note (as does almost every flavored coffee seller). This tastes great when it's accompanying any hot blueberry breakfast- pancakes or waffles with blueberries would be nice served with this coffee, too. It's definitely a milder coffee, but it still tastes like coffee. I drink it w/ a couple teaspoons of raw sugar & a couple teaspoons of Coffeemate, and enjoy it even served alone. Not my everyday coffee, but since I love blueberry muffins, it's one I like to keep on hand. If you like flavored coffee, coffee in general & blueberries, I think you'd enjoy this.
I like blueberry iced coffee from Dunkin Donuts so I figured I'd give this a try since Green Mountain is one of my favorite coffee makers in general.  It was great!
I order this product all of the time as it smells like bluberry muffins baking in the morning and tastes delicious..

I am a huge fan of blueberry coffee and I can never find it anywhere!  So when I came accross the k cups on Amazon I was thrilled!  It did not let me down either!  This coffee is delicious!  Fyi this coffee is a little better when you make iced coffee because it has that Sweet flavor, but I drink it both ways! :)

I originally tried Wild Mountain Blueberry in a sample package and was immediately hooked. I was so happy to find I could purchase and entire box of this smooth tasting, great smelling coffee. It's my entire families favorite flavor right now!

This is by far one of my favorite coffees ever. The aroma of the blueberry is heavenly and the taste. . .well, a perfect medieum brew coffee with just a touch/hint of a blueberry muffin. Hard to explain as the coffee is not sweet. . .just light and delightful. Wonderful way to start the day.
I thought Blueberry coffee sounded horrible...but curiosity got me to try it and WOW!!! WOW!!! WOW!!!! I love it! It is my new favorite!!!
this is the second time that I've ordered this coffee it is very tasty.  I will keep buying it.

I was doubtful about blueberry coffee but since this flavor had such great reviews on Keurig.com, I thought I'd give it a try.  As so many other people have said, I'm glad I did!  I was afraid it would be too strong but it's a perfect blend of coffee with a blueberry aftertaste!  I have started to enjoy many of the flavored K-cups but usually in the afternoon since I like plain strong coffee in the morning- but this one goes perfectly with my yogurt and fruit!  Enjoy!

I have three family members who love this coffee because it has a great blueberry flavor without tasting syrupy, and a nice hearty coffee taste. This is one of their favorite K-cup coffees.Shop for price. A box of 24 cups should cost less than fourteen dollars.

I first had this coffee in Maine in a regular coffee maker.  How wonderful it was on a crisp Maine morning!!  Just the right amount of flavor and the smell is amazing.  Top it off with Italian Sweet creamer or vanilla creamer--winner combo!  I was so happy when I found the flavor in k cups!!  My husband and I now anticipate Sept 1 like Christmas because that's when we break out the blueberry!  Love, love, love it!!
I had bought these previously and was glad to find them again on Amazon.  Not too blueberry but just enough of a hint and true to flavor.
This is my husband's favorite flavor!  I didn't even want to try it (it just didn't sound good) - but it really is delicious!

Just FYI - This is a light roast coffee and has a pleasant taste to it. It is perfect for a relaxing morning as it does not caffeinate your bloodstream into overdrive but just keeps you mellow and for the afternoon cup of coffee this blend would serve well also.There is a subtle hint of blueberry flavoring - not too overwhelming. If you have it straight up you will enjoy it without any bitter taste. You do find the flavors of the coffee to be there. But then again every one has different taste buds and what I found to be enjoyable, you may find to be a unfavorable taste; but I don't think so. I know you will enjoy this light roasted coffee as it will bring a relative calmness over your soul.If you add a bit of cream (my choice is french vanilla cream), it will prove as a more satisfying taste. Overall a nice cup of coffee.

column9: Smells pretty good, tastes...not so good.
column10: I figured that blueberry would be a nice change from the "normal" flavored coffees...well, it MIGHT be, but not from the k-cup I used.The smell was fine. While brewing, I thought how good it smelled, and that it might just be a nice addition to the collection of k-cups I've currently got. I took a sip, though, and found the taste to seriously be lacking. IIt had flavor, but the flavor, to me, was very artificial. Like my experience with the gingerbread flavor, this one reminded me of an air freshener or potpourri.I won't buy another box of this one...
THe Wild Blueberry is my favorite flavored coffee.  It is a nice bold coffee with a great taste and aroma/

I haven't had my Keurig for long and thought this coffee sounded wonderful! It smells fantastic when it's brewing as many have mentioned. This box came the evening before I was to take off on a long car trip. Early in the morning before my departure I brewed a cup of this and took off. A few miles from the house I took my first sip and about threw the mug out the window. The aftertaste is not pleasant, it's syrupy and awful. You need a chaser to drink this coffee. Be prepared or just don't buy it in the first place! There are so many good kinds of coffee for the Keurig don't waste time on this one.
Was very disappointed in this coffee.  I would compare this coffee to a coffee one would find in a motel room.
This isn't the light aroma or tinge of blueberry, this is like pure hot blueberry juice. I think there was a mild coffee undertone somewhere...

Terrible! Overwhelming fake, gross blueberry flavor. My wife bought a box of this for me to take to the shared Keurig machine in my office. Of the 18 cups, only 4 were tasted. None of those cups was finished. No one will use the remaining cups, even when desperate for coffee. Avoid.

some of the cups were opened ...the box was crashed ...most of them were dented ..it was not the way i excepted to get them shipped...the box was a mess .. when i opened the box the coffee went all over the place

Blueberry coffee...sounds weird, right?This is the best darn coffee out there.  One try and you are hooked!It tastes like coffee in your mouth with a blueberry muffin aftertaste.  The flavor is not strong, just a hint of bluberry!The smell when it is brewing is delightful!I encourage all people with a Keurig to try it once.  I am the pickiest eater I know and I love it!!!
The coffee itself is great, but how can Amazon be charging $20.05 for a 24 count box when MSRP is $13.95 and you can find it at specialty shops for around $11.00?

I am absolutely shocked that I love this coffee. I do like some flavored coffees but I also like Extra Bold strong coffee, black. And I wouldn't even call myself a huge blueberry fan. I only tried the blueberry because it was in a sampler box I bought. But the smell as it was brewing was amazing. Still I was skeptical as I took the first sip. I mean, really? Blueberry coffee? But it is delicious! Will definitely be getting more!

Unlike some flavored k-cup coffee blends, Green Mountain's Wild Mountain Blueberry gets it just right! This blend is smooth and surprisingly "authentic" tasting.  Blueberry and coffee flavors don't immediately come to mind as the most compatible combo, but believe me, they we born to blend!  I highly recommend this coffee and it is definitely one of my all time favorite coffee flavors. However, since it is a milder brew, I wouldn't recommend it being brewed in the largest size.  Enjoy!

I recently treated myself to a keurig single serve machine Keurig B-70 B70 Platinum Single-Cup Home Brewing System and was anxious to experiment with different coffees.  I am not a fan of strong coffee so I use the travel mug size to make this blueberry coffee.  This green mountain blueberry coffee is THE best coffee ever for someone who loves the treat of a light flavored coffee and the aroma is to die for.  I am not a coffee purist and do not claim to be an expert; however I do know the difference between a good and bad cup of Joe and this gets my vote for great flavored coffee.  Please try to buy fair trade coffee - take a few minutes to read up on the subject, it is worth it!

I logged in to write a review for this coffee and was shocked to see how positive the reviews were, I guess my taste is not in line with the norm. I got this coffee in a sample pack and it is the only flavor that has yet to be completely used. I made one cup and it smells fantastic, it was very strange to have a fruity smell come from a cup of coffee but it really smelled great, so much so that even after I decided I didn't like it I left it on my desk for a while just for the aroma. First I tried it black, thinking it may be sweet already but it is not and it was a weird sensation to taste blueberry with the normal bitterness of coffee. Then I added sweetener which made it better, the sweetness aligned with the taste and smell of blueberry. Ultimately I just didn't like it and didn't even finish the cup. I don't think fruit flavored coffee is for me.

column9: You won't believe how much you like it
column10: I got some of these cups in a sampler pack and was like, "Meh, I can use them for company."  I never have liked blueberry flavored anything (except donuts because my God I'm only human), and am not that big into fruit-flavored coffee.  So these cups sat around my house for a while.  But wow - when I finally gave these a chance, I was hooked.  The aroma is absolutely heavenly.  And the flavor is the perfect hint of blueberry, it doesn't clash with the coffee like you think it would.  Because "on paper", who would put blueberry flavor and coffee flavor together?  It is not supposed to work but magically it does.There's something that happens psychologically too - you feel like you've eaten a blueberry donut after you've drank the coffee.  It's satisfying like you've really indulged for breakfast but without the calories of a muffin or pastry.  (I drink it with Equal and plain or vanilla creamer.)I served it to my parents over Christmas - real "black coffee only" folks - and they raved over it and for the first time ever asked for a second cup.  I've been disappointed in some Green Mountain flavors, but not this one.

Wild Mountain Blueberry is a wonderful tasting coffee...I didn't want to try it when it was first offered to me. I don't like fruitty coffee......this item is definitely not. It's delicious coffee with a mild hint of blueberry. The arouma is pleasant and the coffee is "real" for coffee drinkers like me. I defintely recommend it and especially to those who don't normally like fruit flavored coffees.

This Blueberry coffee is AWESOME and Tastes Great in the beginning; but husband and I found that after having it so much, you begin to feel like you're just trying to get rid of it after a while. I think if we laid off of drinking it so much in the beginning, we might appreciate it more after all this time. hehe. If you haven't tried it, I do highly recommend that you do try it; just don't "overserve" yourself and get tired of it, like we did. We're going to back off and then drink some more in a few months. hehe. With that said.... the Only flavor that we have never gotten tired of is the Green Mountain Island Coconut!!! We have had the coconut just as long as the blueberry and had even more of it than the blueberry; but THAT COCONUT is the best one, by far, and I can't see us ever getting tired of it! SUPER HIGHLY RECOMMEND THE ISLAND COCONUT!!!

column9: Oh My Gosh,  My Favorite Coffee Flavor is Blueberry
column10: I only bought this flavored coffee based on the glowing reviews I read, but I was skeptical...very skeptical. Blueberry and coffee..that is just weird!  I'm not a coffee "expert", but I know what I do and don't like. Was I surprised!  This I like!  A milder blend of coffee with no bitter aftertaste.  For me, there was just a hint of bluberry.  Such a perfect flavor to blend with coffee!  Aroma as it is brewing is very pleasant.  The only downside?  Well, instead of just one cup, I want two!
The flavor of the Wild Blueberry K-cups is refreshing and a nice change for coffee. I order this one regularly also.  If you like the flavor of blueberry, give this one a try. You'll get hooked.

This is my new favorite K-Cup. For anyone who has had the Blueberry coffee at Quick Check (convenience store), this tastes just like it. It is slightly bitter and slightly strong with a lot of blueberry flavor. The flavor does resemble that of a blueberry muffin more than of an actual blueberry. I would also reccomend trying it with vanilla creamer.

column9: Enjoyed even though Im not a big fan of blueberry!
column10: Blueberry is not my favorite thing but this cup of coffee was a nice experience.  Almost like a Blueberry muffin.  I rated it 5 stars just because I was surprised by how much I enjoyed it even though Im not a big fan of blueberry usually.

Thought this sounded weird at first, but gave it a shot.  SO glad I did.This is easily my favorite flavored coffee.  The coffee is a good medium roast, and the blueberry isn't too sweet or over powering.I don't normally put sugar in my coffee, but have found that putting just a dash or 2 in this coffee really brings out the blueberry flavor.You must try this coffee!

I purchased these K cups in a sample pack from Kurig and was suprised at how good they are.  They are a very light roast and have a blue berry aroma but not a blueberry taste.  If you like a very mild coffee with a light roast then you will like this.
Great flavor. One of my top 3 favorites. I will note that it is a rather weak blend. If you brew using the travel mug 12oz setting like I do, it tends to be rather weak. Other than that I love it.

I love my Keurig mostly because I love flavored coffee and my husband doesn't.  I am always looking for new flavors and came across this flavor and with so many positive reviews, how could I go wrong?  You can't!  It smells wonderful while brewing and taste just as good!  My only complaint is that I was disappointed that I didn't have blueberry muffins when it was done, so were my kids!

column9: Smells one way, tastes another, but thankfully both are pretty good!
column10: My boyfriend really wanted to try this blend as he has always enjoyed blueberry flavored coffees in the past.  We picked up one of the sample packs of this blend from keurig's website to give it a try.  I was skeptical about how a berry flavored coffee would translate when being brewed in the Keurig.  Fortunately, though, the end result is very good, although not at all like either of us expected.From the moment this coffee begins brewing, the blueberry scent is unmistakeable.  Very nice, but that had me worried that this coffee would have some sort of artificial sweetness to it.  Thankfully, however, that isn't the case.  While the scent may overpower you with the fragrance of fresh blueberries, the taste is a whole different thing altogether.  The taste of this coffee is incredibly woodsy with a bit of a hint of cinnamon (very subtle in the latter).  It's quite pleasing although totally unexpected.All in all my boyfriend even prefers this to the coffee shop blends, which speaks volumes in my book.  I think it's great and I'm sure we'll restock it when our current supply of pods runs out.
This is my new favorite K-cup!  Smells and tastes delicious without being too sweet or overpowering.  Amazing with sweet cream creamer.  Yum!
The Wild Mountain Blueberry coffee is delicious!  The coffee isn't bitter and has just the right amount of blueberry flavor without being overwhelming.  Gets my vote!  Try it!
the green mountain wild mountain blueberry coffe is the best k-cup coffe outthere. I did not think I was going to like it and I was right, I do n't like it, I love it. you must give it a try.

Tried this coffee shortly after getting my Keurig brewer.  Mainly because I hoped it would taste just like blueberries.  While of course it didn't  taste totally of blueberries, I was definitely not disappointed!  First cup I brewed, my kitchen smelled so good!!  Couldn't wait to taste it!I am one who normally likes "a little coffee with my creamer".  Not with this coffee.  The blueberry taste is not overpowering but I find that I don't need to use as much creamer as with other coffees.Bottom line,if you like the taste of blueberry in your coffee, you'll love it.  And have never totally disliked any Green Mountain coffee.  To me it's a a good coffee at a reasonable price.  And blueberry is THE BEST!!

I just got a sample of this coffee from BzzAgent and was excited to try this flavor. If I can describe it, it tastes like the smell of Dunkin Donuts lol..Dunkin Donuts always has a blueberry smell to me. This is my new favorite flavored coffee! I usually brew Barista Prima brand because their coffee is very bold and flavorful, but this Green Mountain flavor is just as tasty!
Just ordered my 2nd batch of this. The blueberry smell is incredible while brewing but the taste is very subtle. Very nice blend!

I understand this is a light roast, but it honestly tastes like water. There was barely a hint of coffee flavor. It did smell pretty nice though. Sweet and fruity. I've got a bunch of cups to use up, so now I brew it and stir in some instant coffee.

Wild Mountain Blueberry can't be beaten when it comes to flavored coffee.  I have been drinking it every day for almost 2 years. I must not be alone in my taste as I find it very difficult to purchase locally.
Smelled great brewing, but the taste is just too bitter.  I've tried it several times just to give it the benefit of doubt, but NO BUENO.  I won't purchase this flavor again.
Since I discovered Blueberry Coffee I'm hooked.It's the best Coffee I have ever tasted.I would give it a 5 star.
This is one of my favorite Green Mountain flavors. It has a strong hint of blueberry, without being over-powering or too sweet.

column4: Kimberly J. Karas "a New England mom"
column10: I just got a Mr Coffee Keurig type coffee machine.  My first cup, the Green Mountain wild blueberry.  I would say it's not for those who like strong strong coffee.  Tried it black just to see... eh, not so great.  Put in a splash of 2% milk and it tastes like I'm having a blueberry muffin with my coffee.  Am I in love with it, no.  Caramel and Pumpkin are my fave flavors but I do like this a lot and good to have to mix things up.  That's the point of a single serve machine, right?  For those who are bigger blueberry fans you might give it five stars.UPDATE: After about half the box I got bored of it.  As I am trying different flavors I don't think I will reorder this one.

I understand a few people don't care for the taste but personally I love it. The aroma is very nice at 6 o'clock in the morning. I prefer to try different things and don't to attached to anything other then my wife and cats(and maybe my golf clubs). So live on the edge and give it a try. I think you'll like it.

column9: Green Mountain's Wild Mountain Blueberry Coffee
column10: I was first hooked on Timothy's German Chocolate Cake. I received the Blueberry as a sampler.  I absolutely LOVE, LOVE THIS COFFEE!  It taste so good. It's not sweet, overpowering, just a great blend that makes you think you've just ate a fresh muffin. I really don't care to eat blueberries, but this is truly one great coffee!  I love Bold coffee, I.e., French Roast, Sumatran, Kenya. This coffee has the perfect blend.  I usually drink mine with French Vanilla Creamer.  My husband takes his black and doesn't drink flavored coffee, he did try it and was pleasantly surprised. If you like flavored coffee, give this a try, you will not be disappointed!
I love this coffee. The flavor is great and the best part I do not have to leave my house to buy it.

I'm a huge fan of flavored coffees and this one does not disappoint. Light roast that smells heavenly as it brews - just like a blueberry muffin baking - and has a great blueberry flavor that pairs perfectly with sweetener and creamer. This one is definitely a light roast but my sister (who drinks only the dark roast flavors usually) swears by it too. I have this one on constant rotation on my carousel.

column9: Green Mountain Wild Mountain Blueberry,for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
column10: Green Mountain Wild Mountain Blueberry,for Keurig K-Cup Brewers is an excellent medium brewed coffee.  I enjoy the "Wild Mountain Blueberry" flavor that compliments a blueberry bagel or fruit with breakfast.  Unlike some flavored coffees that claim to have flavor...I have found that "Green Mountain" pulls of the balance of richness, aroma, good taste and flavor.

Tastes GREAT! But this is way too light. If you can see through your coffee, drink something else. I love this flavor but they might as well call it exlax. You need to be by a bathroom after consuming this coffee. It will destroy you. Naturally sweet. Use less than normal sweetener when you brew this.

column9: Love the taste, love the smell
column10: The first thing that hits you when you brew this is the smell that closely resembles a blueberry muffin, with a ton of blueberries in it.
