I am a cream user, so that sort of the dilutes the flavor a bit, it still tastes (and smells) quite good.  You can definitely make out the blueberry flavor still.  It tastes great, and has become my go-to flavor over doughnut shop and Puck's Breakfast in Bed.  This is a light roast coffee, so if you like a strong coffee flavor, you should look elsewhere.

This product sounded great. I love flavored coffees! But, this is just too weak for my taste. The blueberry overpowers any coffee taste, except to leave behind a horrid aftertaste of not quite coffee. I wish it had been a more robust roast to really hold the flavor together.

The best thing about this coffee is the sweet smell, just like a blueberry muffin. The taste is good, not as sweet as I was expecting but it was good nonetheless. Its a nice treat when you're craving something sweet but it won't replace my morning Donut Shop coffee :)

The first time I had this coffee, I swear I wanted to eat my coffee cup.  Just like a luscious blueberry muffin, especially if you add a bit of cream and sweetener.  It's not a strong coffee, so you may need to use one of the smaller size cups, but it's absolutely lovely.

column9: Greatest Coffee I've tasted from Amazon.com
column10: This is without a doubt the best coffee I've tasted.  My wife raves about it, and won't purchase any other brand or flavor.  I guess I'm committed to order and reorder.

Blueberry coffee sounds wierd but it is the best flavored coffee. It is a light brew as most flavored coffee is. Very smooth not at all bitter. Add a splash of vanilla coffee creamer and you have a special treat.
Unique blueberry flavor, but this is a VERY lightly roasted coffee.  You may want to pass if you enjoy a stronger cup of coffee.
the product arrived in two days!! the coffee is delicious. :) I was looking for flavored K-cups and had only tried Island coconout which is delicious as well.

column9: Good Coffee w/ a subtle Blueberry Taste
column10: This is a good tasting flavored coffee. The blueberry taste could be a little stronger and the roast could be a little stronger as well, but the light roast does make for a good morning coffee to wake you up and the blueberry flavor makes this a good breakfast coffee as well. This will certainly make my list of regular coffee flavors.
Good buy! I love this flavor in k-cups. It's like having a blueberry muffin in the morning. Would recommend this to coffee drinkers.

column9: Not as much blueberry as I expected, but still a good cup of coffee
column10: This really just tastes like regular coffee, but has a blueberry smell in my opinion.  Still a good cup of coffee nonetheless.

column9: The taste was a nice surprise!
column10: The Green Mountain Blueberry blend was a nice surprise for my husband and I.  He asked me to order a bold coffee. I picked out the blueberry as well to give us some variety. This ended up being his favorite. Mellow and flavorful, this is an excellent blend and we will continue to buy it throughout the season.

I'm an avid tea drinker found coffee to have a bitter after taste. Tried Green Mountain Wild Blueberry and got hooked. No bitter after taste, perfect hit of blueberry. Shared it with my tea drinking friends. Love it!
This flavor is so unique and complex. Highly recommend everyone tries it out, especially if you add cream and sugar to your coffee like me. Product shipped quickly and arrived in less than 48 hours.
Love, Love, Love it! This taste like a blueberry candy, if you like blueberry you will love this k-cup.  It is a sweet brew, and great with alittle cream.

I'm not a huge flavored coffee fan, but for some reason this one piqued my interest and I had to try it.As others have mentioned, it smells incredible while brewing - very fresh and strongly blueberry scented, which honestly is a tiny bit offputting at first.  But from the first sip it isn't nearly as strongly flavored, and the scent settles down quickly. I will say that the first cup carried a slight artificial flavor, but I don't notice it now that I'm used to the flavor.I'm left thinking perhaps coffee - with it's natural berry/fruit flavor - is the perfect foil to blueberry, something I never thought I'd say.  It just has this deep, complex fruitiness that "goes" much better than I'd have imagined.For the moment, anyway, this has replaced my normal breakfast blend as my go-to cup.  Another thing I *never* thought I'd say... I might have to see if this comes in decaf (ugh, decaf?) because I am drinking entirely too much!
You will not be disappointed with this coffee. I personally am not a coffee drinker but I got this for my wife. She said it is like drinking a blueberry strudel dessert and is her favorite all time.

Fun change of pace, especially nice for an afternoon cup. Smells wonderful and soft, subtle blueberry flavor. Definately would recommend to friends who enjoy flavored coffees and want something other than your standard vanilla, hazelnut etc.
This coffee is like eating a blueberry muffin and drinking coffee at the same time. It smells (and tastes) SO GOOD. I can usually get two cups of coffee from one k-cup.
The taste is wonderful. Its not for those who like very bold coffee tho. If you enjoy blue blueberry. Pick up a pack and enjoy.
Both my daughter and I enjoyed this flavor. We added a splash of cream and it was perfect! We will  totally purchase again.

My husband and I went to Maine years ago where I discovered this blueberry coffee. Every little shop sold it brewed by the cup. I loved it! Of course I bought the beans and brewed it at home! But its been a few yrs now and then I got a Keurig and saw these kcups! It tastes just as wonderful! As it cools it is even more flavorful so I decided to brew a cup,cool it for later and drink it on ice! Oh yea!! It makes a great blueberry iced coffee! This will be a regular hot or cold.
I love the smell of the coffee as it is brewing because of the blueberry flavor. The product arrived quickly and as described on the website.

I love this flavor, truly tastes like blueberries.  I use french vanilla creamer and sweeten with sugar, though, and it ends up like a blueberry/coffee milkshake, good hot or cold.  You need to love blueberries and you will love this coffee.

Wild Mountain Blueberry by Green Mountain has a nice subtle blueberry taste - it's not bitter and the k-cups of course are very convenient for work.  A little French Vanilla flavored creamer goes well with this coffee.

column9: Pure pleasure, the ultimate warm cozy treat
column10: Especially good in the morning with cream and a touch of sugar.  The flavor lingers on the palate very pleasantly. I have a long drive to work and take a cup of this with me to liven up the drive. So, there I am with my audio-book and coffee actually making the best of my drive.  You really need to try this coffee.
Love this coffee and couldn't find it where I live.  Ordered on line On February 22, and here it is February 24, and I already have it.  Thank you so much.  Hope to do business again.

Smelled wonderful as I was brewing it. Sadly, it smells more blueberry than it really tastes-however! I do have a bit of a cold, so I may not be tasting in it fully. I just added creamer and it was splendid. Would totally order again. Really awesome with fresh scones.

If you love coffee, and blueberries, this is the coffee for you!Full blueberry taste that does not overpower the coffee flavor.  Great for after dinner in a quiet relaxing space with a book!  Curl up and enjoy!

column9: Excellent flavored coffee here - nice accents
column10: Just had my first cup today and it was great.  A very unique blend here with a subtle but relevant blueberry tinge that really works as good as I hoped it would.  I bought this blend based on the great reviews I read here and am glad I did.  It's not an everyday coffee for me, but it is a fine addition to my stable of k-cup varieties.

column9: If you don't like flavored coffees, pass on this
column10: Ordinarily I don't like flavored coffees, with the exception of an iced latte with caramel.  I like plain coffee.After reading reviews I decided to try this anyway.  I didn't like it.  However, my husband thinks it's great, so it wasn't a total waste.I'd say if you're like me and don't want any weird flavors in your coffee, you won't like it.

column4: JetRocket11 "You cannot sedate all the things...
column9: Best K-Cup Coffee that I have tried
column10: Out of all the various k-cup coffee's that I have tried this one is by far the best. I got a few of these in a sampler box.I did not think much of it when I first put it in to brew but then once it started the smell was amazing. The blueberry aroma is great.The taste is not too strong which is what I like and it feels like you are drinking coffee and eating a blueberry muffin at the same time. I highly recommend this flavor.

This coffee has a great smell while brewing and the flavor lasts long after you are done drinking it.  It's my 2nd favorite coffee now.  This isn't a strong coffee at all, but it's not weak either.  It's pretty much perfect.-Adam

Great coffee; we love Green Mountain.  My fiance loves blueberry coffee, but it's hard to get around the holidays and his birthday, so I was happy to find it!  (And it makes our kitchen smell awesome when it's brewed!)

The Wild Mountain Blueberry k-cup was just okay. It smelled great while brewing, but the taste was kind of flat. I paired with a sweet creamer, but didn't help any. Maybe if I can get a complimentary creamer, it will be better.
This coffee is amazing it tastes like blueberries and it has just the right amount of flavor. I think it goes best with vanilla cream  or regular. I will definately order more.
I was very hesitant to try this as the idea of blueberry coffee just doesn't really sound that good, but I was amazingly surprised at the flavor!  It is now one of my family's favorite coffees!
Had this coffee while ccamping in New Mexico last year..finally got some for myself... Great medium roast flavor with a background and aftertaste of blueberries..I will be ordering more..

I thought it would be strange to put a berry flavor in coffee, and it turns out they didn't.  Like most flavors, its all in the fragrance, no difference in taste.It's a bit weaker than most of the other flavors, but still good.

column9: Blueberry flavored coffee?  Weird sounding, but one of the best K-Cup flavors I've found...
column10: I must admit, like many others, that this sounds a little weird.  However, after trying this coffee months ago, it is one of the few K-Cup coffees that I will pay the premium price for.  Of course it brews like any other K-Cup, but the added aroma from the blueberries that it adds to the room is incredible.  In fact, they should make an air freshener out of this, but that's another category.The coffee has a good balance to it, and the added blueberry flavor is not just right.  I use a vanilla creamer and sweetener with my coffee, which may enhance the flavor, so I can't attenst to what this would be like if you drink your coffee black.  I also tend to make two 8 ounce cups from one K-Cup, brewing both into a small pot, and then dividing the coffee into separate cups, which makes for a good strength from this coffee.  I like a medium roast normally, and this holds up to that.Although you're not going to get a full serving of fruit with this coffee, you will wake up a little faster when you smell this coffee in the mornings.  I like many flavored coffees, but find a few that I don't like, but this is one that seems to appeal to most when they smell the blueberries.  My recommendation, give it a try...

I have been wanting to try this flavor since I first got my Keurig coffee machine.I wasn't disappointed.  It smells like blueberries and you can really taste the blueberries in the coffee.  It's a very natural good flavor, not sweet or artificial at all.  Thanks Amazon for carrying this brand of Green Mountain Wild Mountain Blueberry coffee!Angie
This is by far one of my favorite k-cup flavors!!  It smells great as it's brewing and it tastes just as great!  It is a mild brew so gentle on the cream! :)
this is one of my favorite flavors for the Keurig. If you like Blueberry, this coffee has a a hint of blueberry flavor. Great price and it shipped and arrived very quickly.

I have been wanting to try this for a while but have put it off thinking that it might have an artificial taste or that the blueberry is just a little weird with coffee.  But WOW was I wrong.This coffee is absolutely delicious!!  I love it with a splash of vanilla coffee-mate in it.  It has a sweetness to it, with a hint of blueberry with a really perfect blend of coffee that isn't too strong or too weak.  It's just right!  Kind of reminds me of a blueberry muffin or blueberry waffle or something - but without it having an over powerful blueberry taste.With the fall weather it has been an excellent morning choice, along with the perfectly pumpkin Timothy's World Coffee Perfectly Pumpkin, K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) which also very tasty!  Love the fall/winter weather to experiment with these flavors!  Go ahead and try it, you might be pleasantly surprised like I was!

I'm a big fan of Green Mountain coffee, and the blueberry flavor has been one of my favorites for a while. These K-cups have the same great taste that I know and love from the fresh ground version.The blueberry flavor is in no way dominating. It gives on a great sweet aroma and has an excellent coffee flavor with a hint of blueberry aftertaste. If you're unsure about the flavor, I would suggest trying it at a coffee shop or cafe before buying the entire K-cup pack, but if you're up for trying something different (or you know you love the flavor), this is a great buy.
You have to try this flavor. It will become on of your top five. Trust me. Don't get sample pack, get a box!
I came to drinking coffee rather late in life so I prefer the flavored coffees over the "real" thing. This is probably my favorite one so far--smells and tastes great.
this is such a great flavor even iced it taste great hard to find these in the grocery store but defanately a good buy..
WE just bought a Keurig coffee maker for work.  I do not like strong or bitter coffee.  This product fits the bill.

Echoing several other reviewers here - we were so skeptical about trying Wild Mountain Blueberry coffee and now that we've run out, both my husband and I miss it.  It was such a pleasant surprise, as we generally don't drink that much flavored coffee. As the coffee is brewing, it gives off a strong blueberry scent, and the taste of the coffee doesn't disappoint. My husband usually takes a bold roast in the morning for his first cup of coffee. He liked having a cup of blueberry as his second cup, kind of like "dessert." I had a couple cups a week. I agree with another reviewer who said its possible to have too much of a good thing. For that reason, I will wait a little while before getting our next box but not too long.
Heard raves about this flavor and while nice, I would not purchase it again.Barely detect any wild mountain blueberry flavor...there is something but not distinct enough for me to label it blueberry.

I recently purchased Wild Mountain Blueberry K cups for my Keurig coffeemaker,  and I just love it.  All of the coffee K cups that I have purchased have been wonderful, but I think that at this time, the blueberry is my favorite.Peggy Manning
Just so yummy. And I love that it is available year-round. Being a flavored-coffee lover, I love how many different flavors you can get through Green Mountain.

I'm a K-cup fanatic, and (much to my shock and surprise) this is by far my favorite variety!  It tastes like having coffee with a blueberry scone.  It's a light to medium brew, without an aftertaste.  Give it a whirl - I think you'll like it too!

column9: Good... Too much fat to keep around all the time, for me...
column10: I just want to add some info.Each pack contains about 7 pieces. (Get real - I eat all 7 at a time lol...)3 pieces contain 160 calories and 10g of fat, 7g of which are saturated fat.Top ingredient is maltitol syrup, and sucralose is also used in it (Splenda). No aspartame (NutraSweet) listed.

Mounds and Almond Joy lovers everywhere... HERE is the answer to your Sugar Free needs.  Diabetics will love this and as always Russell Stover puts out an excellent product in taste and texture!  This came packed in original Russel Stover CASE box.

Contains maltitol, which may cause very bad gas in some people.  I bought some the other day because it said it was sweetened with splenda, and I just assumed it wouldn't contain maltitol.  Stupid me. I suppose it's okay if you don't exhibit the "laxative effect" otherwise steer clear of this one, or consume in light quantities.

column9: Incrediblely Great food with great results.
column10: I order this food to try as it was grain free and I liked the ingredients listed on the site with the reviews. I opened the bag and the smell was incredible. It almost made me hungry lol. The dog loves it and is doing well on it.  I start doing more research on the food and was very impressed. The owners of this food make sure ethoxyquin, BHA and BHT (which are knowing to cause cancer) are NOT used at all in the food. They make sure that the slaughter and processing plants do not use them either. That is great and it show that they care as well.  I have communicated with the Petcurean and have been very impressed with them as well. I am really happy with this food. It has very good ingredients. he company is great. I highly recommended this good and I have tired several different grain free dog foods.  Plus my dog loves it.  Thank you amazon. i would have never found it without amazon.

I'm not usually one to write reviews, but I am so happy with this food that I felt it was necessary! I was nearly at my wits end before I purchased this. When we adopted our Basset Hound, Lucy, a few months ago we started feeding her Innova from the get go. She had loose stools, but we figured it was just because it was a different food than what she ate at the rescue. We fed her pumpkin with the food, and she did great, but she also would not eat from then on without the pumpkin. We weened her off of the pumpkin, and as soon as we did she had loose stools/diarrhea again. Kept trying for a few weeks. It never let up, and she still had no real interest in eating the food at all. She would not eat for a day until she was starving. We nearly took her to the costly vet to see if she had some sort of digestive issue.We did some further research, and discovered that Innova was bought by P&G, and that there were many people that had been feeding for 10 years and suddenly started having loose stools so we decided it might just be the food. We immediately switched her to Petcurean Now!, and immediately her stool turned normal even though we did not phase it in. Lucy *loves* the taste of this food. We put it down, and she eats every last morsel without having to coax her. She is excited for meal time finally!I am so very content with this purchase. It is worth the slightly higher price tag if you want a happy, healthy dog.

column9: My shelties love this dog food
column10: Now Grain Free Turkey and Duck Formula dog food is great.  My shelties love it and I love that it has no junk in the formula.  It is healthy for my pets.  I receive my orders in a timely fashion and usually sooner than expected.  Amazon is great in getting the orders out.

My dog is prone to allergies requiring treatment with steroids and antihistamines at least twice a year.  Since beginning this food his allergies have all but gone away.  I switched him directly to this food without gradually introducing it with no problems.  The food produces well formed compact stools which is a plus if he has an accident in the house.  Not that much more expensive than other "high quality" dog foods that contain grains and meal.

this product was recommended by the breeder...our scottie loves it and looks forward to his meal...would definitely recommend this product to those with new puppies, even tho it is a little expensive, it does have all the nutrients required for good health...

I have decided that I want to provide the best quality food to my animals.  My dog loves this food, and hasn't had any digestive problems since moving to it.  Also does wonders for her coat.  Love this product.

column9: Moved out of state and couldn't find a retailer for this dog food.
column10: Our Bichon has a very sensitive stomach, so this is the only dog food we buy for her.  When we moved to another state, we had difficulty finding a retailer that carried this particular brand of dog food.  Ordering from Amazon.com makes it easy, and it is delivered to our door within a few days.

column9: Product is great but the seller stinks
column10: The food deserves 5 stars, but the seller (1800PetMeds) deserves zero stars, if that could be assigned. My dog has allergies, but does well on this brand of non-grain dog food. I thought it would be smart to order through Amazon, since it is difficult to find in stores, but that was a mistake. It has been 14 days since I ordered, and the product has not yet arrive. Nine days after the order, it had not even shipped. And while it was shipped via Fedex, the Fedex tracking says the order will take about 6 to 7 days to deliver. The seller must have asked for special slow delivery... Never again will I buy from this seller.

I purchased Now! Senior/Light last week in an effort to get one of my Bichon girl's very high triglycerides down.IT's been a week feeding this food and her triglycerides are back to normal!  Also, a bonus is she likes it plain with nothing mixed in, and stool is firm and nearly no smell!Thanks for a great product!

column9: One of the few dry kibble with NO Meal byproducts!!
column10: I have searched really hard for dry kibble with out meal byproducts. Dogs eat bones, but not ground to a sandy material!

Like many pet owners, our 7-month-old Lhasa pup suddenly is getting picky, picky about her food.  The Now Dry Puppy Food is the eighth brand (wet and dry) I have tried and I am holding my breath because she actually ate a helping of it and why I gave it a 4 star rating.  It is also wonderful to be able to buy it in smaller quantities than 6, 10 or 15 pound bags only to find out she will not eat it and we donate bag after bag of dog food to our neighbors. I don't believe she is allergic to any of the brands but I think she is holding out for a human food menu.  I have high hopes for the Now Puppy Formula and will update this review when there is a change-positive or negative.Update:  Once again I thought our picky eater pup was going to turn her nose up at NOW on the third day but when I laid some kibble on the floor, she gobbled it up.  She likes wet food and pieces of meat in her bowl and dry food on the floor.  This is our third Lhasa and this adorable pup provides us with so many first experiences. The hunt for the perfect food for our picky eater is over.  I feed her Redbarn Premium Variety Pack Food Rolls cut up in treat-size pieces for all day treats and lay NOW dry food and extra supplement cubes (all combined to equal her daily allowance) on the floor in her exercise pen for her to eat at her leisure until just after her last meal of the day and what is left is taken away and all food and treats are suspended until breakfast the next morning.

I used to get the product when I visited Spain and I was so happy to find it here in the states.  It has just the right amount of heat and sweet.  It is great on everything.The shipper was outstanding.  Quick delivery and the product was packaged extremely well.  No chance of breakage.The Brava Sauce is a little expensive, but if you like it as much as I do, it just doesn't matter.

column9: Great Product, But Not In Stores Anymore.  Too Pricey Online.
column10: I had been using this Pepper Season-All (under the McCormick label, UPC 052100071336, 5.75 oz.) for many, many years, mostly as my secret ingredient for marinades.  Not anymore.About 2 and a half years ago, McCormick sold its Season-All line to Morton, the Pepper Season-All having a UPC of 024600017558, for the 5.75 oz. plastic jar.  As I was on my last jar, but hadn't seen the McCormick product in any stores for sometime, I contacted McCormick and they told me Season-All was now under the Morton label. I looked in every grocery I stopped at between Seattle and Spokane and could not find this product anywhere.  I asked manager after manager if they were going to get any in, but they checked and said no.  I had that UPC memorized, much to their surprise.  Go figure.Then, one day at a Wal-Mart, I found it in their spice section and bought the 3 jars they had left.  I believe I paid $2.38 per jar.  That was the first and ONLY time I have seen it in a store ANYWHERE.  When I asked a manager at the same Wal-Mart when they were getting another shipment in, he said he didn't know, as it was out of his control.  I asked if I could request they special order it, but he said no.  So much for that.It was available on the Morton website (and still is), and even though a 2-pack is reasonable at $7.58, shipping costs are ridiculous.  They want $10.44 for FedEx Home delivery (6-10 business days) and $23.12 for FedEx 2nd Day delivery, which shows as arriving in 3 -7 business days.  Crazy!Now on Amazon, there a re a few ordering options, but this one takes the cake.  $16.99 for 1 5.75.oz. jar, but free Prime Shipping, which I have.  Or, even worse, a 6-pack for $89.99 (Free Prime Shipping) or $79.99 ($19.99 Shipping).  The latter 2 are actually cheaper overall than the one for $16.99, but you get the picture.What the heck are these guys smoking?So, I contnue my search for anothe alternative.  Today, I found something that just might work.  McCormick's new Perfect Pinch.  It has Roasted Garlic and Red Bell Peppers, no MSG and looks like it could be pretty good.  I'll use it in a marinade this weekend.Bottom Line:  If you find any Pepper Season-All in a store, buy it and try it, you won't be dissappointed!

column9: Where Can I Buy This at a Reasonable Price???
column10: I use to buy this product all the time at Rainbow Foods/Wal-Mart for less than $5.00 a bottle.  Now I cannot find it anywhere.  Maybe McCormick sold it so they could sell more of their inferior product.

Black Licorice Scottie Dogs are GREAT!  I grew up thinking that licorice was "awful" and "disgusting" until the day I tried the wonderful black licorice Scottie Dogs.  I could not believe that I liked licorice; I mean I REALLY LIKE IT.  I went to the candy store and bought a little of every kind of licorice available.  When I would travel, I would do the same thing.  I tried anise product to compare the difference in flavor.  I found that most licorice has molasses which is absolutely NOT for me.  I continue to judge some licorice as "awful" and "disgusting"; I always came back to these wonderful black dogs.  There is something really refreshing, like spearmint is to me, about these licorice dogs.  I say, "Don't give up on licorice until you have tried these black dogs."

My children sent me a box of scotties for Christmas and they tookme back eighty years to the time we could get real good licorice.The scotties were the best licorice I have had since then so I hadto have more! C Leef Sr.
Gluten free as promised and good to eat.  I buy the 5 pound bags because they are a bargain compared to other gluten free licorice brands.

column9: Good choice for black licorice fans
column10: You can't go wrong with these if you're a fan of black licorice. They have a mild licorice flavor and I was surprised by how many people I shared them with were so entertained and amused by their simple doggie shapes.

column9: Great taste for diehard licorice fans
column10: I've always liked all kinds of licorice, especially black licorice. I like the taste; while it's hard to describe taste, i'd say has a somewhat more pronounced "licorice" taste than other licorice I've tried.They are somewhat addicting, and friends I've shared these with ooh and ahh over the cute doggie shape.
the scottie dogs are very good licorice. i'm glad to have purchased them.they are hard to find.they where at a resonable price.i would buy them again.

My husband has always loved black licorice, but so many brands have artificial flavors. I discovered the Scottie Dogs at TJ Maxx and would buy every bag I could find, but suddenly they stopped carrying them. I was glad to find them through Amazon as we had checked at every candy store. Not only is this a true licorice, it is also soft and not sticky. One time a piece of sticky licorice pulled off a cap. Additionally, the flavor lasts longer than others. My husband sings and depends on Scotties to soothe his throat before a performance.

I purchased my Scottie Dog Licorice mainly because they sold it in a 5-lb bag and I could share them with friends for the holidays. I thought that since I got such a large quantity in one bag the flavor would be dulled down somewhat. Oh how wrong I was! These little dogs were so fresh I couldn't stop eating them! The flavor of the Anise in this licorice is so good, it's almost addicting! I will not buy from any company for my little scottie dogs but this one. They have QUALITY candy and fresh like it was just made! What a treat! I confess...I only gave 2 little sandwich bags away...and if one weren't my mother it would have been only one...and I endulged the rest...They were almost too good! I love them! If you are in doubt of who to make your purchase from...seek no more! Right here is where you need to buy from!
I ordered this for a gift . Recipiant tells me it was very fresh tasting. Very satisfied with my purchase.Thank You ,Bob

I purchased the scottie licorice dogs for my sister-in-law, who loved them when she was a child.  I surprised her with a five pound bag so she could enjoy for a long time. She mentions them everyday.  They taste just as she remembers.  Thank you so much for your superior service.
Better than Jelly Belly. I love 'Good" licorice! And the place we bought these locally went out of business so to find them online was wonderful!

My 3 cats, including my youngest who doesn't like seafood (but loves to play in water!), LOVE these. I can't go to the cabinet without all 3 of them following me, meowing for these treats!And they're healthy because they're mostly air. So, my guys get this treat just about every evening. Buy them - Your cat(s) will love them, too. BTW, these were reviewed/tested by either Cat Fancy or Catnip magazine (where I first heard about them), and they got 5 stars because all of the test cats loved them.

This is the only type of treat my cat will eat!  I was so happy to find a large size because you can usually only buy the tiny containers in pet stores.  The 1 oz. is a better bargain.  My cat prefers this over Kitty Caviar, and it smells a lot fresher.  This is high quality healthy treat for any cat.

column9: Always ships quickly and arrives in "purr"fect condition
column10: Cats go crazy for this product - and it's all natural and good for them.

column9: Surprised that my cats don't like these
column10: When I buy a 5 star item from Amazon, it is always a good product. In this case, the product may be just fine quality wise, but for some reason my cats hate these flakes. Of the two cats, when presented with the flakes - one gave me a "are you stupid" look and the other one gave me a "why did you do this to me" look. Both of the cats like all other cat treats and are not picky eaters. Don't know why they don't like these, both of them go nuts for seafood. Given that all the other reviews are very positive, perhaps I got a bad batch of flakes and it is just an aberration, but both cats are very much "Do Not Want!" on these flakes.

column9: A little messy, but well worth it.
column10: The flakes are dry so don't worry about the messy part, it vacums up easily if your cat doesn't get it all up. This treat will get them to run to you when you open the container. It's amazing. I was skeptical, but my cat just loves it. It is fine to sprinkle on top of dry or wet food or just serve it up by itself (but I would use a bowl). My cat is 12 and being older and sort of set in her routine and diet I was a little concerned that this treat would be a waste of money but I was proven wrong. She just eats it up. I give it to her as a treat once a day, in a bowl, lol, and she is quite happy with that arrangement.

My cat loves this more than catnip. These are shaved and dried pieces of Bonito Tuna. Some of the pieces look like bacon. I like to keep mine in the fridge so when I treat my cat I can tell her it came "fresh from the sea".
My cat is crazy for them - no fillers, no additives - a healthy treat she loves.
My aging cat loves this treat even better than Kat Kaviar. It is quite fishy smelling, which she loves.
Bought these as a gift; the person reported that their cats really liked them. This tub is cheaper than the mini containers at the pet store.

I bought this on a lark, not expecting a big response from my cats. They absolutely love it!I thought they might not like the dry, tissue-thin texture, but they seem to enjoy licking it up. They beg for more, and I suspect it is spoiling them from wanting to eat their super-healthy crunchies that I serve after their super-fine meat course (yes, I know, I know..) I recommend this treat, and now think that the price is fair.
This product drives my cats crazy! The only negative thing I can say is that it is pretty smelly but seriously, my cats went insane for it.

column9: My picky cats LOVE these treats!
column10: I cannot say how happy I am that my 2 picky cats now have a healthy treat to enjoy. They just love these! I have tried many high end cat treats to no avail, so I was pleased when these passed the picky cat test. Cat-Man-Doo is really difficult to find in stores, so Amazon is a great place to buy them...very affordable.

My cats love these bonito flakes. They do smell fishy but it is not a lingering smell. They are a healthy treat that my cats love. I wish I could find them at a store so I didn't have to order them online all the time!

column9: A big hit with my kittens
column10: I searched Amazon for a natural treat for my kittens, without the additives in most of the more common cat treats, and I came across Cat-Man-Doo.  I was pleased that they both love the bonito flakes.  I had them spayed recently, and this was a great treat for them while they recovered, encumbered by those pitiful cone collars.I don't like seafood myself, and I typically find the odor very unpleasant.  Many reviewers commented on the pungent odor of these flakes, but it was not bad at all for me.I noticed the product description does not include the nutritional information, so I'll add it here:76% min. crude protein3% min. crude fat1% max. crude fiber12% max. moisture (I guess that's a fancy way of saying "water").35% min. taurine

column9: Good stuff but way too expensive!
column10: The product itself deserves 5 stars as all 3 of my cats go crazy and sometimes even fight for it. However, Cat-Man-Doo or "Bonito Flakes" as the Japanese call them are used in actual cooking and if you look it up under this name on Amazon, there are sellers who are selling it for a fraction of the price listed here. You can also find this at your local Korean/Japanese grocer in big bags that last months.

This is by far my cat's favorite treat.  He even know where they are in the cabinet and opens the door and pulls the container out.  I give him a few flakes a day, so the container lasts more than a month and at least I know it's fish and not anything processed and not high in calories.  Highly recommend this for any cat.  Only downside is there is a strong fish odor but it doesn't linger.

column9: Cat loves the taste but not the flakes
column10: My cat really really likes these, it's the first treat I've found that he'll eat! He isn't too thrilled about the flakes though. All in all a good treat :D

column9: 4 stars only because you can buy this MUCH cheaper from an asian grocer
column10: These are great.My cat is totally in love with them.  She just waits patiently for them.  They are very healthy!  Also her fur has become so soft that she feels like velvet, like a soft bunny!  so much so that everyone that pets her is amazed.  This stuff is great, very healthy, very good for her.  I'd much rather give her this then some "wiskas" or something treat of questionable health benefits :x at least this is natural.  :)and as I said in the title, the only reason this doesn't get 5 stars is because its sort of a rip off... if you go to a asian grocer and get Bonito Flakes (or Katsuboshi) you will pay much less, and its probably fresher and better quality, as it is intended for human consumption then.  :x

I got the cat man-doo for my pet and even before I could get it in her bowl she was taking her paw and trying to take it out herself to eat it.  The smell of the stuff must of been sooo good that she didn't want to wait for me to put it in her bowl.  She ate the whole container in a week.  Best stuff I ever purchased so far.
My cat loves these bonita flakes.  Product shipped promptly and was in great condition on arrival.

column4: Barbara Lundeen "there can't be enough books"
column9: My finicky kittens LOVE this product!!
column10: All I have to do is say "Bonito" and both my 10 month old kittens are beside themselves with excitement - apparently this treat is to them like double fudge peanut butter ice cream is to me.  I heartily recommend this product.  It's a little pricey but goes a looooong way and is totally worth it watching the kits eagerly chomp it down.  One of my kittens will not have anything to do with any other kind of treat (she's pretty food fussy too) so it's nice to find something she likes so well.

This product is amazing for several reasons:1) Our 5 indoor cats LOVE this stuff - cannot keep enough of it in the house.2) Product stays in the large ribbons therefore, each cat can have a nicecrunchy piece for a nightly snack. There isn't a lot of shaving residueleft in the bottom when the cannister is empty. I feel like I get mymoney's worth of quality product.3) It's healthy - you know what's going into your cat's body.  Everread the ingredients on a bag of manufacturered cat treats? Garbage. Switchto Bonito flakes and you'll keep unhealthy unnatural chemicals out of your cat's body.

column9: It will make your cat purr
column10: Our cat can be finicky, even with treats.  The first time she tasted this, she didn't seem that excited and even left some on the plate. Ever since however, she meows as soon as she sees the container, and it's the only treat she will actually sit up for or try to grab from our hands. Her only complaint is that it can be diffiult for her to gobble down the shavings.  She wishes it came in chunk form. Definitely 4 paws up!

column9: Makes my cats wish they had opposable thumbs
column10: I have 2 cats.  One is of the garbage disposal variety. She will eat anything. Even inedible things that she later spits out. They other is finicky. Extremely so. In the years they have been getting treats, this is the only one that gets an equal reaction from both. They *love* the Bonito flakes. I don't feed them to them daily, but they are the occasional treat.I have them in a high cabinet, as I know they would get to them on their own if they could. This is exactly what I think a treat should be, heathy, light and something special.

column9: Has replaced Kitty Kaviar as the favorite cat treat in my household
column10: The two cats who eat treats loved Kitty Kaviar, but sometimes I noticed they sneezed a lot afterward.  The larger Bonita (tuna) flakes are easier for them to pick up and eat without getting them up their noses and they seem to prefer the bigger size, too.Rebecca Kyle, October 2008
The product was easy to order, inexpensive, and arrived before the due date.  My cats just love these tuna flakes!!!
All four of our cats love these flakes.  We like that they are natural and healthy.
The cats loved this!  It stays fresh in the container and is light enough to not spoil their regular feedings nor gain weight as I only need to give them a small bit to make them very happy!

MY cats Love this treat.  It is low in fat/high in protein so my Maine Coon, Mowgli who is already 17 pounds, does not gain any extra weight and can still have as much as he wants!!!! I also have a kitten rescue and cattery and it is a wonderful treat to use in socializing those timid kittens.  None of them can resist it.  I cannot keep enough of this great snack in the house!!!!!!!

No other cat treats have been more effective at turning my 3 sweet, fussy little adopted kitties into crazed, psycho banshees!  As soon as I open the top of the container of Cat-Man-Doo Bonito Flakes I can hear the stampede coming from every corner of the house.  These lightweight flakes are delicate and almost float in the air, but the fishy smell can rock your socks and with a cats sensitive nose, they waste no time trampling over each other to get to the goodies.  All I can say is it's every man for himself! But use caution and don't overload your kitty with too much protein - just a few flakes a day is all I allow, no matter how long they sit there glaring at me with their most threatening stink-eyes...I know they love me.

This is a great product and my cat goes crazy for it, but I just bought a 4 oz. bag of Bonito flakes at a local Asian store for $3.78. It's the same exact thing, but just much cheaper. If possible, but this stuff at an Asian supermarket.

We've stopped calling this Bonito and now refer to it as 'cat crack'. Our cats are crazy about it! One of them will go to the cabinet and cry and paw for more. We don't ever let them out of the house as we live in a remote area where they run the risk of becoming part of the food chain so when they get past us at times we no longer have to chase them to bring them back. All we have to do is say "bonito" and they'll run right back inside for it. So easy it almost makes us feel guilty.

I found this treat on one of my trips and discovered the availability thru Amazon!  Ordering is easy and the treat comes within 2 days.  I'm happy, my cat is happy and I know where to buy more!  Don't stop this awesome treat, this is priceless.KD
Cats seem to love these, including ours.  Just sprinkle a few flakes on the ground and watch them come running!WARNING: Opening the container will release a very pungent fishy odor into the room.

column9: Odds are your cat will LOVE these!!!
column10: I only feed my cat treats that are 100% protein and we like to switch it up a bit.When I first brought this treat home, my cat went insane!!! She looooooves these, and will meow when she sees the container (this is the only treat she will do this for!).

Happy to say I've finally found the one treat that my cat loves.He's a bit picky, usually takes a sniff and walks away from everything--food that's been out 5 min too long, check; not the right flavor, check; wrong temperature, check; not the right shape or texture, check; I can go on and on. Oh and did I mention that he's too good for wellness. Okay, fine he's really picky. Just a cat servant in denial here...Anyways, I guess I'm just as excited and happy as he is. For the very first time I've heard him purr at the sight/smell of a treat. This is definitely going to be my leverage-treat/i'm-the-boss-too-treat.

column9: My cat goes bonkers for these
column10: My cat absolutely LOVES these fish flakes. I am just about to make my second order as I just ran out, and I am sure there will be a third and fourth order, etc,  in the future as well. One thing to be aware of is that because these treats are so light and airy, they tend to end up on cat as well as in them. After feeding a couple to my cat, I often end up finding scraps in the fur around his face. This is probably less of a problem for less fuzzy cats. My cat is part Maine Coon, as is extremely fuzzy.

My cat loves these treats! He goes nuts for the. They are a very good alternative to the treats with a ton of ingredients and calories. These are a MUST try! Also, if you are in Washington state, go to your local Mud Bay Granary and they have samples of these for you to try!

I received Cat-Man-Doo as a gift several years ago.  Scottie, my cat, absolutely adors them and will do anything for a little nibble.  None of my friends that have cats have heard of it.  None of the local pet stores carry it and I've even checked several surrounding communities.  Now that Scottie has tried Cat-Man-Doo treats, he won't eat any others.

i had no idea what bonito flakes were, but something about the listing made me think they might be worth a try.  my cat is really glad i did, he loves them.  i give them alone as a treat, or along with his dinner.  either way, he leaves his dish empty.  my talkative maine coon gets quite vocal about these treats.i have since read up a bit, they are flakes of dried tuna.  very good for the cat, a healthy treat.  from now on, i will make sure to have these on hand at all times.  of course, he does have to share a bit with the dogs. . .

Wrong size container was sent and the company emailed me to state that Amazon only receives 1 ounce containers to be sent out.Don't know where the error occurred but was pleased to hear from the vendor to attempt to correct the problem.Hopefully the cause of the error will be tracked down and others will not run ito the same issue.  Cat-Man-Doo Extra Large Bonito Flakes, 1-Ounce Container

Wonderfully efficient vendor and from my cat's reaction, a wonderfully delicious treat.  My cat knows the time of day she gets her fishflakes treat, and sits in the kitchen by her feeding area and waits patiently.  (Not always too patiently, she gives a pathetic little meow and I hurry to apportion her beloved treat!!!)

My cats absolutely love this stuff...they can't get enough. It's an excellent source of protein. It's great as a snack or to mix in with food that your cat is picky about. I had to give my cat a certain canned food from the vet that he hated. Once I mixed a few flakes in and sprinkled some on top, he ate it without a problem. I never had a cat that didn't beg for this. It's worth the money!

My 13-yr old grouch stuck up her nose to these when I first sprinkled them onto her kibble.  First time she'd had anything fishy in her life.  Then after a week or so, they began disappearing.  Now I get scolded if they aren't there every evening.  It's fun to give her something she enjoys so much.

This is the best kitty treat I have ever bought.  Just the sound of the lid being taken off will bring them out of a deep sleep.  Yes, it is stinky the older it gets, (I keep the big bag in the fridge) but my kittens are hooked. I like the idea of giving treats that don't have fillers and contribute to obesity.  This is the answer to that.

Bought these for my kitty for a little treat.  Opened the container, approximately the size of a large jar of mayo, and got a major whiff of fish smell.  Kitty was unimpressed.  Offered some to my pup and she loved them!  Large, light, transparent flakes of dried fish.  It looks like giant flakes of fish food.  Super stinky but my dog loves it.

Not only are these healthy and tasty for cats, they're fun too!  Dangle bits over their heads and watch them grab onto them!  Since they're so light, they stick with static, always amusing to watch them chase them around and get them stuck to their fur.  Or in my big boy's case, on the end of his nose.  Even my picky little girl likes these treats and they're both begging at the cupboard door for more.  I've found this cat treat at a variety of stores in a very large range of prices, but after seeing how crazy my cats go over these (I think they might be laced with catnip!) I'll happily spend the extra just to keep them in their fishy goodness.

These make great and healthy treats for cats. All three of our cats go nuts over these flakes. You can buy bonito flakes for less as human food (they are used to make stock for soups like miso), but in my experience the human-food flakes are small and crushed up. The cats seem to enjoy the bigger flakes that come in the Cat-Man-Doo more than smaller flakes. The bottom of the Cat-Man-Doo container is never as exciting to them as the top. The container itself keeps the flakes sealed and fresh. There isn't any fishy smell until you actually open the container and give some to your kitties.It takes some cats a few times to figure out these are for eating, perhaps because of the flake texture. If your cat doesn't take to them right away, you can try putting some on or in their food or playing with one of the flakes so they pounce. Once tasted, the confused kitty gets that these are food and wants more.

column9: Our cats come racing at the pop of the lid...
column10: We rescued a momma cat and her kitten.  It took the kitten a full week before she decided we were trustworthy.  Momma is still distrustful and keeps a safe distance.  She's also a finicky eater.  However, these snacks are bringing her around. When they hear the lid pop off the container, both cats come running!  Momma will even get on my lap to eat the snack, which is amazing for her.  I pet her when I feed her, conditioning her to my touch.  Baby cat just goes crazy at the sound and meows loudly, climbing all over me, until she gets her share.  I am definitely keeping these in stock!  They're good for a nice light snack and happy cats.
I got this for my sis's cats.  They really loved these flakes.  YEAH!!!
They are advertised as extra large but I really didn't see much difference from the standard sized flakes. Cats LOVE them nonetheless.Will purchase again

These flakes are a healthy, natural treat for my cats, BOTH of which absolutely love them!  They are indifferent to the usual "cat treats" from either the grocery store or pet store, but come running when I just pop the top on the flakes.  I accidentally dropped one onto my knee and had 2 cats their in a heartbeat!  Fun!

column9: Cat loves it BUT your cat can get TOO much protein and kidney was shutting down!!  Had to go to vet, get blood labs, give subq!!
column10: I just want to share that My cat loves the bonito flakes,  BUT my cat nearly got kidney failure due to so much protein.  Nothing on the bag suggests an amount daily for a typical cat, age, etc.  Make sure you don't overdose them, and put it somewhere it can't be overdosed on it....  I'd say just about a teaspoon or tablespoon once or twice a day.It is a nice treat, but don't overdo it.Cat threw up bile twice, so....I went to vet, got subcutaneous fluid, blood labs, subcutaneous fluid, etc.  !!!So don't OVER DO it![...]Phone 425 861 941015600 NE 8th Street, Suite B-1, PMB 322, Bellevue, WA 98008.That's what I wanted folks to know.  by "Backyardgarden"

These were recommended by a friend in the US as she knew our cat was poorly and thought this would renew her interest in food.  Sadly she died the very day they arrived.  I have passed them on to my daughter for her cats who have yet to try them.The only negative comment I have is that there was an additional postal charge of £8+ made by Royal Mail which made this a really expensive item to purchase.
My cat will not touch it.  He gives me a "are you kidding me" look.  On the bright side, my dog likes them.
Unfortunately, my cats didn't get it.  They would not even try these.  BUT I volunteer at an animal shelter and the cats there ate them up instantly and they sniffed and looked around for more.

We call this " kitty cat crack" at our house, that's how much they love it. All 4 come running when they hear the container open. We always buy more than one because it goes so fast. The only downside is the smell- it smells just like fish food, stinky.Also, be prepared to vacuum if they leave little crumbs- it gets everywhere.  The smell and messiness are worth it for their reaction and the enjoyment they get from eating these flakes.
Our cat loves these treats, and this is a good sized package that lasts.  Your cat will go crazy over these tuna flakes.

My 2 kitties, Chivaughan and Cory, LOVE this special treat. I don't give it to them very often so the large container lasts a long time. They usually get it when they've endured something traumatic like getting the claws clipped or a brushy or going to the vet. I am really happy with this product from Amazon. I once bought this same item from another source and the smell was soooo strong I could hardly stand to give it to my babies. Although the smell is pungent from Amazon's it's not unbearable and I'm more likely to treat my sweethearts more often. I'm sure your kitties will love it too.

It's hard for me to review these as I have two cats.  One is crazy for them, one won't touch them.  I didn't realize they were actual shavings, paper thin shavings of the fish.  It's like feeding curly paper to my cats.  Not easy to do.  But as I stated before, one of my cats really likes it so I put a little in a bowl and let him worry about how to eat it.  The price is good for cat treats and the container is big.  I'm glad we tried it but I probably won't repurchase it.  I'll stick with the freeze dried salmon...both cats are crazy for it.

column9: Made CRF kitty violently ill.  IBD kitty likes them, though.
column10: I bought these because they were recommended as a way to get finicky seniors and sick cats to eat.  My sick cat had to be coaxed to eat them, and they made her vomit almost immediately.  My other cat, who has IBD, likes them fine but doesn't love them, and they do not cause any ill effects in him.  I split the difference and gave them three stars for what the cats think, and I added a star, because these aren't processed and full of questionable ingredients.  I wouldn't feed them to a cat who has CRF (although they are all different, and what doesn't work for mine may work for yours), but I would recommend them over kibble treats (except Greenies - we love Feline Greenies, Beef, 3 oz. Package).

My one cat loves these bonito shavings. She makes lots of different noises and vocalizations to let me know she likes them whenever I reach for them.  My other cat also enjoys them, but not as much as the other cat.These are good because they're natural and just shavings off of dried bonito fish.  Probably a lot healthier than most generic cat treats (also more $ of course).If you really love your cat and don't mind shelling out the premium price, go for it.
I've been buying this for my cats for a long time.  It is always fresh (peeee-u!) A nice natural treat.
My cat will meow at me (more like a howl), demanding that I give him a pinch of his favorite snack food.  I give him just a pinch at a time.  One ounce will last me about a month.

Unfortunately my cat would not eat it.  I don't think there is anything I can say after that, other than I'm very disappointed and now I have a tub of this stuff which I don't know what to do with.  My cat isn't picky about which food she eats and loves turkey and tuna from our plates so I'm surprised this didn't work for her.  But I liked the packaging.

I have a cat who struggles with some sickness, thus not wanting to eat. When I add this stuff to her food, she wolfs it down. Ah joy! I just received my second order of it and recommend it to others as a treat for their cat, or to entice them to eat.
My cats absolutely go crazy for this stuff, and with 4 cats, a container surprisingly lasts a really long time.
Both of my cats are Cat-Man-Doo bonito flakes lovers. It's their dessert andsometimes their snack! Thanks Amazon for stocking these items.

column9: My cat likes it, no surprise there
column10: My cat did a double take after eating this for the first time. He went a little nuts trying to figure out how to get more.This stuff is expensive by the weight, but there's tons of flakes in the package. For the first week, I would only give my cat a few flakes, but it would take me forever to get through the whole container, so I started just pouring out a bunch into a bowl for him. It's pungent stuff, but that's how he likes it.

column9: Picky cat liked these after second try
column10: Our cat isn't one for treats, but I ordered these after reading other reviews.  Our cat wouldn't really try them the first time we gave them to her, but after trying a second time she loved them.  Now, every time we get the container out she comes running.  Funny thing, the dog even likes them.This is a pretty large container, perfect for a house with multiple cats.

Our cat just loves this product.  It was great on a treat on top of her regular food.  It is always hard to find in our pet store.  So good ole Amazon comes to the aid.  The price is great and the shipping super.  Saves also on gas.

The one ounce size was advertised, but I received the .5 ounce size. There was a white sticker on the container with the words "one ounce"typed on it, but the container had 1/2 ounce printed on it! If my cats didn't love this product so much, I would have given it one star. I will not not be ordering this product through Amazon again because of the incorrect size shipped to me.  The seller was Gulf Coast Pet Supplies and the price was $7.13
This is the best lemonaid available today. It is just tart enough so you can taste the lemon, but not so tart as to make it undrinkable. It is mildly sweet and is just a great product!

column9: This pickle is a must-have for our Holiday meals
column10: In our house, the relish tray gets a lot of attention. Traditionally, we've had what are called candied dills. This is that same pickle, taken to a better level of flavor. When it came time to make turkey sandwiches, this pickle was what was used in them. The whole family loved them.

These pickles are my favorite. I grew up eating them on applebutter sandwiches with roast beef. (Sounds gross, but it's delicious!) They are a must whenever I cook a beef roast. Would definitely recommend to anyone!

column9: the very best there is!!!!!! sweet dill strips
column10: My parents and I injoyed these pickles so much. They are crisp,dill and yet snappy sweet. Just like the old times.This quality just is not matched in any other pickle. Worth more than twice the price. Just have to have for all the holiday's.  Ray

column9: Wow!  So glad Amazon carries this!
column10: This product is so good I obsess over it.  it's a shock when you find your jar is empty and your store no longer carries it.  Thank you Amazon for carrying it !  The stuff is a bit expensive, but nearly addictive for folks who love garlic and hot stuff. I'm ovo-lacto-vegetarian and eat a lot of soups with beans,  also pasta and various grain and rice dishes.  I  eat this in and on almost everything.  Just a bit livens up soup, makes any pasta sauce better, even makes something a bit bland like plain hummus or tofu "egg salad " really jazzy.  Try it, you'll be amazed what a "hottie" it is.
Sooooo glad amazon sells this I moved to another state and could not find it. Try it with grilled chicken or shrimp its quick easy and taste great
I love to cook with this sauce, it's excellent to dressing and increase the flavor of almost every dish.
If you like hot peppers in Olive Oil instead of vinegar, these are outstanding. Never mind that it's labeled pasta sauce, they are great for anything, hors d'oeuvres, pizza, sandwiches etc.
Very spicy, but oh so good!!!  I swear I have lost weight by eating this with whole wheat pasta.  Must be the  hot peppers and garlic!!!  Love it!

column9: Updated: 2nd Order was awful, I'ma so sad, it make me cry
column10: Below is the original review, which was a stellar 5 star. However, after I ran through my first 6 pack and all the jars were great, I ordered another 6pack. So far the first 3 jars have tasted awful. Flavor is awful, bitter, no garlic taste, it's like the peppers were rotten or something. Just really not edible. I can no longer recommend this. I would steer away from it due to the inconsistancy. Guess I'm gonna have to ordering more expensive Italian brands or go to Italy afterall.--------------------Old Review-----------------------------------------This is exactly the same as the stuff I remember having in Italy, which figures because it is from Italy. It may be a tad on the expensive side but it is worth every penny. I purchase by the 6-pack which lasts me a few months. I love the flavor. The peppers will give any sauce the signature Italian heat that you can't get with Asian or Mexican peppers. It's hot but not too hot, and it's full of flavor.I use it in my pasta sauces or just as a bruscetta. It goes great with a little marinara and shrimp. I also once fried up some pine nuts in a pan with olive oil and then added this to it, and bam! great spicy pasta dish. I bet it goes great with pesto to make a spicy pesto... hmmm I'm gonna have to try that next.

This is the most spectacular condiment. I am a foodie. Not an extreme gourmand, but I can be picky. While I'm not a health nut, I do try to keep abreast of what foods are the most nutritious for me to take it. I like spicy food & I am a huge believer in extra-virgin olive oil & garlic, for health reasons. My mother & I both eat EVOO & garlic daily (and have been doing so for twenty years), and unlike the rest of our family (who ALL have heart disease of some form), we have consistently great cholesterol levels & our hearts are in spectacular shape. Now, on to the joyful part of reviewing this great sauce/condiment!This only has four ingredients, all "good for you". I use & eat it on everything savory that I can- garlic bread, pizza, spaghetti, chicken Parmesan, even Chinese food! It's extremely versatile. For example, tonight, I mixed a couple of heaping tablespoons w/ 5 oz. of Italian tuna in extra-virgin olive oil, served over spaghettini. It was simple, but superb. It adds just the right amount of moisture to a dish, as well as heat, if one is using it as a sauce (you must like spicy food to do that!) That said, it is not overwhelmingly hot, like habanero peppers. A tip- I add a heaping TBSP. of this to my spaghetti sauce (I love Raos Marinara) at the beginning of cooking. I always let my spaghetti sauce simmer for an hour on low heat, after the meat is cooked & the sauce comes to a gentle boil. The heat of this mellows out a bit in that hour of cooking, but the flavor it imparts is pronounced & delicious.This is perfect for those on a low-carb, higher-fat diet. (I'm not following such a diet, but I know what it's requirements are). Even if you eat a 1/4 cup (which is a big serving), it still only has 2g of carbs, 135mg of sodium, zero cholesterol & no trans fats! It is high in Vitamin A & VERY high in Vitamin C. It really adds pizazz to even the most bland of foods, and I couldn't live without it. It is also very fresh when I buy it, and it lasts a long time, based on the expiration date.

I discovered DeLallo Imported Garlic, Oil and Hot Pepper Sauce in the early 2000s and loved it, using 2-3 jars/week.  My sons both loved it as well. But about a year to year and a half ago, the flavor changed, drastically and for the the worse.  All three of us noticed it. It began to taste bitter.  You will never convince us that the company did not change the recipe.  Don't know exactly what happened, but it is a shame.  Now we never buy the product.
Honestly, this stuff is so good it's like crack!  I could use it with every meal - on eggs, any meats, in sauces and soups.  It's expensive, but worth every penny.

column9: a little smokier than most kimchee but still tasty
column10: I bought this and slathered it on wilted salted napa cabbage, with scallions, ginger, and a litle chili paste added in. It wasn't as good as Korean store-bought Kimchee but it was better than big grocery store chain versions.

column9: Fine if you've never had their full size Homestyle Popcorn
column10: This package is misleading in that you expect it to be the same product as PopSecret's normal Homestyle popcorn but in a smaller package. This is not the case - it is a lighter formula with not nearly as much flavor. I know many of the 100 calorie packs are not the same as their full calorie counterparts, but they are normally labeled as such (ex Oreo baked Wafer snacks). Overall it is disappointing.

First off let me say, this popcorn is an absolute addiction for my husband and I. We each eat a snack-size bag nearly every night.  It is by far the best and most consistent popcorn out there (and we've tried them all). It has the perfect amount of butter and needs only a small amount of popcorn salt (always important to use the salt made specifically for popcorn as its finer and sticks to the popcorn).  For those who have commented that it either burns or does not "pop up" enough of the kernels, I suggest they experiment with the power setting and timing to find the perfect environment for the most effective popping. We have a GE Spacemaker XL microwave with 1100 watts. We pop at full power for 1 min 25 sec to 1 min 30 secs (not one second longer).  It is honestly the best snack there is and a snack bag is plenty big for one person.  Though, if you are a popcorn lover like we are... you would no doubt eat more than one bag if you can get away with it :)If you haven't tried it, pick up a box in the store.  If you love it (and I predict you will)... sign up for the subscribe and save here.  Amazon often runs out for a while so I stock up when they have it!  Happy snacking!

First off, I love the full size Homestyle Pop Secret, but most of the time the amount was too much for me. I thought this product would be perfect, what a disappointment. It doesn't pop worth a darn and what does pop doesn't taste like the popcorn in the full sized bags. I just now popped myself some for a snack and that experience made me decide that I should cancel my subscribe and save for this product and write this review. The first bag wasn't popping like it should and I left it in a bit too long. It's now on my back porch as I hate the smell of burnt popcorn. The second bag was different. I was really careful in listening and watching the bag so it wouldn't burn. When the popping slowed down and it sounded like it was finished I took it out. Only about half the kernels popped. I wouldn't recommend this product at all.

I thought this would cut down on waste. Put a bag in my microwave and followed the instructions exactly. It didn't pop all the corn and severely burned that which did pop. I changed the power setting. Less than half the popcorn popped and ended up tasting bland and awful.

column9: Great for late night snack with low calories!
column10: My wife goes through bags of this like no other. They're great for a healthier snack and for anyone on a diet. As for the other reviewer, our microwave is only 2 years old and we have never had a problem cooking it, and if we did, we'd probably try a lower power to cook it :) If you want a tasty snack that will take time to eat, then this is a great choice!

I love Pop-Secret's Homestyle popcorn, and thought that a snack size would be perfect for one person.  Well, I bought a bulk purchase of the snack size, thinking it would last me a while.  It will probably last for years....it burns in my new microwave! Very little is popped. It probably works fine in an old, slow microwave oven, but seems to be misformulated for the newer ovens. Sad, sad, sad....
But I coulnd't get it delivered for Xmas - I was penalized because I didn't proscratinate.

At least 1/3 of the content of the container in which the blocks of feta were shipped was excessively salty brine liquid.The cheese is a far cry from tangy feta cheese, a crude salty mass without distinct taste other than salt. No actual flavor comes through. Does not even impart flavor when added to robust food or salads.Disappointing, no repeats.

While studying herbs I ran across an eyewash recipe that required red raspberry leaf as one of the ingredients.  I ended up buying the one pound bag because the pricing was so much better than the smaller quantities.  One pound of red raspberry leaf is a lot of herb--at the time, I never thought I'd be able to use it all.  I did some research and found that this herb, when drunk as a tea, is good for a plethora uses.  Nausea, diarrhea, fevers, flu, hemorrhoids (yes, drinking tea helps hemorrhoids!) diabetes, and virtually any problems involving a woman's reproductive system just to name a few. I serve this tea to all of my guests and recommend it to virtually everyone.  The cut and sifted is kind of fuzzy looking, but it works very nicely when brewed.  It has a very light and mild flavor that requires little or no sweetener added.  I just ordered my second one pound bag. Try it--it's wonderful!

Women! Listen up! This tea is for you!This tea has so many good properties, it is simply amazing! You get lots of health benefits from drinking it daily: it is said to help with nausea, ease labor and delivery, and post- partum recovery. It is also helpful for regulating menstrual periods and controlling diarrhea. And as if that were not enough, it also acts as an astringent on irritated skin by tightening the top layers of skin or mucous membranes, it reduces secretions, relieves irritation, and improves tissue firmness. As a mouth wash, you can use it to soothe mouth and throat irritations.It does not have much flavor, but you can pair it with mint leaves and it will tate very nice. The color of this tea is amazing, considering that the leaves are just green! It yields a nice, golden hue!
I have never bought tea this way but love the economical benefit!  Large bag of pure leaf tea.  I have a diffuser so it works for me.  May never go back to buying regular tea bags.

I got this to make tea while I was pregnant. It tastes good (if you like earthy flavors) and is just a fraction of what you would pay to buy tea bags at a grocery store or co-op. I take off a star because it comes all mashed together in a huge clump; it is a bit of work to break it apart.
So...wow! This is a lot of tea. I bought this tea after reading about the many health benefits. It arrived in a sealed-foil bag. I will be drinking raspberry leaf tea for months before I run out.

I'm a big iced tea fan.  I could drink it in lieu of water.  The big downside however is going to the bathroom all day.  (Between being 9 mos. pregnant and tea being a diuretic, I can't say which is more to blame though.)  I started drinking this stuff b/c of all the purported benefits of red raspberry leaf in pregnancy and toning the uterus.  I drank it throughout my first pregnancy as well.I was very happy that I was able to find this organic loose leaf tea online.  I actually doubled the strength of it and would make it in batches.  About 1/2 cup of loose tea leaves per 4 cups of boiling water which I poured into my French press.  If you don't have a French press or tea infuser pot, then you can just pour the hot water and loose tea into any mug or tempered container and allow the leaves to seep.  I let the tea seep until the water cooled down, then I poured the tea through another strainer into a large jug.  Eventually I collected a gallon of it and added splenda and sugar and then put into the fridge to cool.  It is better than the gallons and gallons of Arizona green tea that I go through; and much cheaper than Starbucks or Dunkin Donuts iced teas which are also my vices.  (I learned that the secret to Starbucks' iced tea is to double the concentration and use plenty of sweetener; hence it's so good.)The other tea that my doula recommended, dandelion root, is a whole 'nother ballgame, though.  That stuff tastes awful.  But I would highly recommended the raspberry leaf tea for both its taste and medicinal benefits.If you found this review helpful, please let me know!

column9: Very good option for this teaPrompt shipping and well packed but
column10: Very good product  a little bit on the brown side compare to the picture .. And like the other reviewer has some stems but all in all good quality and generous portion......  The tea is very good. For female health.  I use a French pressor comes out really nice

column9: Worth of the money!  it taste very fresh, and not affect my sleeping :)
column10: my OB strongly suggest me drink red raspberry leaf tea(not tea bag) at least 2 weeks before the due date because he said this tea can help easy labor.I found this product on amazon, thanks for all those positive reviews and I finally ordered it.  I begin to drink it on my 37 weeks pregnancy.So far, I feel very good about this tea: 1) First of all, although the dry leaf looks not pretty, the tea color looks very pretty after it brew,  and smell very fresh, and taste very well; 2) Secondly, this tea does not affect my sleeping,  usaully other herbal tea or coffee can cause me lose sleep at night , but this product not,  Im so happy to have it, I drink 3-4 cups of this tea everyday now and can still sleep very well.I really hope this tea can help to easy labor as my OB said,  if yes, I will update here again to you guys :) wish me good luck!!btw, 16 oz of this product is a big amount, i did not expect so much in the package ,  i mean the price is very reasonable and it worth of the money! Thank you so much!!
The tea seems to be good quality, although I am no expert, and the quantity will last me a long time.
I'm not a huge tea connoisseur, however this tea appears to be everything it promised. Tastes pretty good for an herbal tea as well.

Tea was good! Love that it's organic! Def get way more for your money with this as opposed to store bought. Used this to prepare to give birth. It def helped my uterus tone and bring on more Braxton Hicks... But my labor was still 20 hours. Maybe it would have been longer without the use of the tea?

When I saw 16 ounces, I didn't expect quite that large a bag, but I'm definitely not complaining! I've used Red Raspberry Leaf Tea before, and I absolutely adore it. It tasted exactly as I remembered and has really helped some of my health issues. My package arrived about 3 days before I expected it, which was a huge plus. I am more than happy with the results and the cost was very affordable, especially considering how much some of my local health food stores mark up their tea. Well worth it! I would recommend this product and company to anyone interested in giving it a try.

I am so glad I ran across this tea on Amazon --  This is a large bag of tea  -- I love loose teas and I drink hot or cold  -- I have mixed with other teas  --  I have  heard that is good for women -  This is a great bargain  too!  I have a hard time finding dried herbs where I live --  I am glad I found this on Amazon  :)

column9: As great as the brand name one.
column10: Used this tea during pregnancy and to save a few bucks. It works just as good as the brand name one.

this product is wonderful! tastes great. i make it in a tea pot and pour it on ice and add some KAL stevia to sweeten it! I read that it is good for all women ailments. I am not 100% sure it has done that for me because i started using it in my 2nd trimester but i did drink it almost every other day at most and i had an easy labor and i was induced too. I read that it helps to tone and strengthen the uterus before, during, and after pregnancy and i believe it did the job.
The leaves are chopped to tiny pieces. Otherwise I would have enjoyed it much more.I had to buy a tea leaf separator/container to avoid the trouble of drinking those small pieces.

column9: Not enough relief for severe cramps
column10: I decided to try the red raspberry leaf tea because my Dr said I should not take ibuprofen until my stomach healed. I get really wicked cramps and need to take four ibuprofen every 4-5 hours for the first two days. I started drinking the tea a day before period as someone suggested online. I used 3 heaping tablespoons of tea for 32 oz of water. I let the tea steep with a plate over it. I drank two cups every hour. I upped it to four cups an hour to see if this would further help me. It did not. This takes the edge off the cramps so I can bear it but I am not comfortable. I am dreading the next few days of cramps without ibuprofen because this does not help me enough. If you are one of those lucky ladies who can take two ibuprofen every six hours for cramps this will probably work for you. If you get severe cramps I doubt it will help. If the natural thing helps as good or better than the drug then I am all for it. THis is not the case with this tea. By the way I also tried the ALvita brand tea some ladies said worked better. It did no better in relieving the cramps than this bulk product. I am disappointed it is not helping me more than it is.

These are NOT a long lasting chew! It took my standard poodle all of five minutes to completely finish a ChurpiChew where as it took her days to finish a Himalayan Dog Chew.I do NOT recommend buying this brand as it just doesn't last along as other brands do!I paid almost 10 bucks for a five minute chew.

I paid a good price for the ChurpiChews because they were advertised as being hard (they were) and long lasting (they weren't). The product packaging says the ChurpiChew is a unique "long lasting treat" handmade in the Himalayan highlands.  My two dogs finished theirs in about 45 seconds longer than it would take them to eat a milkbone biscuit.  Translated: less than 60 seconds.  I will concede that their packaging also says "Dogs Absolutely Love Them" which mine did. I hope my two Labs savored each chomp because that's the last $16 I'll ever spend on this product.

I have a 1-year old female Rhodesian Ridgeback who's about 60lbs. She's not particularly interested in the elk antlers so I was hoping the Churpi might keep her occupied for at least a few hours.  She finished the medium in about 25 minutes.. She's not an aggressive chewer -- she does like to rip up  fabric toys -- but she isn't destroying Kong toys and the like. Regardless, this is definitely not a long lasting chew treat.
This bone is not long lasting.  My golden retriever ate the bone in less than five minutes.  My lab went through the bone in about one minute.

I bought the large size Churpi Chews at my locally owned pet store.  It seemed hard enough (almost like plastic) and I was looking for something that did not have the chemical bleach smell of raw hides.  I was concerned that my dog ingests the raw hides and hence all the nasty chemicals that go along with it.  I was pleased to see that the ingredients are natural "yak and cow milk, salt, and lime juice", but I am a bit skeptical as it is white on the inside and has a nice bbq beef smelling covering on the outside that has to add some other ingredients to it.  It is made in the Himalyan Highlands, so although it is natural, I'm not sure how the guidelines differ if they had been made in the U.S.A.  I'm not sure there are many protections for dogs (as opposed to humans) to begin with.  It also comes with one of those silica packets in the inside of the package which tells me that at least there is something that is being preserved (vs. adding chemical preservatives).In a nutshell, my dog love, love, loves it.  However, I noticed that within a couple of minutes she was already making good headway working her way through the Churpi Chew.  She is not a huge dog, about 17lbs, but loves to chew, chew, chew!
