column10: This brand is tops.  I have never found it in the stores in the U.S. and always brought it back from Italy so I decided to search the web and was delighted to find it on Amazon.  The tagliatelle is excellent and cooks in under 2 minutes, like fresh pasta. I have no interest in this or any other pasta company - I just hope that this brand becomes popular enough to be an easy to find product!
I ordered two boxes, one of them the expiration date is only three weeks away.  I am returning this box.

During a long night of searching the Amazon web site I came across this coffee deal for a price of $14.00 with Subscribe & Save.Since it was about $10.00 less for the same amount of coffee beans that I had purchased from Amazon in the last few months, I thought I'd give it a try.I have bought Hawaiian Kona whole bean coffee, Lavazza Super Crema Espresso whole bean coffee, and Starbucks Colombian whole bean coffee in my quest to find a good, reasonable priced coffee bean. But, even at the lower price that I paid, this ranks right up with the best of the more expensive coffees.It is smooth, full bodied, with no "after bite" in the back of the throat. It is not a dark Italian coffee, as some might use for espresso, but is what I would call a full flavored, and rich, breakfast blend, I prefer it to two other brands that I over paid twice to three times as much for.I did sign up for the Subscribe & Save simply because of the lower price, but now I'll use that account to continually receive this coffee once a month.

Eight O'clock French Roast has been my #1 favorite store brand, so I decided to try the new Italian. I thought it might have the flavor & body of espresso, but it missed the mark. It makes a good cup of coffee, but French Roast has a fuller, richer flavor for the same price.
Ok this isn't the BEST coffee i have ever had, but it is pretty good, especially for being as reasonably priced as it is. A burr grinder + french press + these beans = good cup of joe.

Eight O'Clock Dark Italian Roast is better than the French Roast. The beans are a bit darker, a bit more oily, with the coffee having a bit more flavor. Perhaps that's because the four bags I received were perfectly vacuum sealed. The French Roast bags were not.This coffee is a big step above Folgers and other supermarket coffee. But if you like Starbucks or Peets you'll be disappointed. It's nowhere close to the full rich bold flavor and smell of these two (and some other local coffeehouses where they roast their own beans).

column9: Not espresso, but a good, dark cup of coffee
column10: I love dark, rich coffee. When I was in Italy, I brought back as much as customs would allow. I've always wished someone in America would make a good coffee like that, but most seem to either leave it too light, too weak, or burnt. This isn't going to make an Italian espresso, but the coffee is dark and robust. I don't know if it's the roasting process or the packaging, but there isn't a lot of oil left in these beans, and that would go a long way toward making this a better coffee.

column9: surprisingly good and a great value
column10: While this isn't quite as good as one of the bolder varieties of Peet's or Starbucks, it's reasonably close, and can be had for about half the price if you catch it on sale. I have tried most of Eight O'Clocks, and for me this is easily the best, much better than the French Roast. It also seems to deliver a bit more caffeine kick- which for me is a plus. If you're tired of paying for Starbucks, give this a try and see if it doesn't satisfy your fixation while thickening your wallet!

Okay, so I'm a bit picky about my coffee beans. If you are reading reviews about whole bean coffee you probably are too. We don't just buy what's on sale at the grocery store. We put true consideration into a coffee purchase in that endless quest for the perfect cup of coffee. Well, your quest won't stop here with this Dark Italian Eight O'Clock. The beans themselves weren't all that impressive, not dry but not nearly oily enough. The color was too varied, some light colored beans, some dark. The texture was not firm, very hollow and too brittle. The aroma was nice but a bit weak. I ground it extra fine and still used more than usual to get enough flavor. Overall the flavor is good. Bold, and rich and dark but just not quite bold and rich and dark enough. Usually Italian blends include some robusta beans, this one does not. Which is nice. It is good coffee, just not great coffee.

column9: Price uncertain, coffee very good, subscription convenient
column10: While I love Eight O'Clock coffee, and this one is good too, and I love, love! the ability to subscribe for coffee delivery, I am decidedly medium on the price disparity, and the subscription set up, here.I saw this on the product description page, "Price: $18.03  $15.33 (after 15% discount)" (I ordered 2/24/11) yet was charged $26.73 for this. I'm not sure why. I'd also love to be able to change the type of coffee I receive each month if possible... but I'm not sure if I can do that without canceling and resubscribing.Overall, this coffee is delicious. I enjoy all types of Eight O'Clock coffee though, so I may be biased.

column9: Easy to get through your service...thanks...always like the coffee.
column10: This is my husband's favorite coffee but we can no longer buy it in our hometown.  I was always buying it when we went out of town and had to purchase a large amount.Now I purchase only through your service.  It's quick and easy and receipt is very fast even with standard shipping.  Thanks so much for the service.  Amazon.com is the way to shop.

column4: But I'm feeling much better now...
column9: Really beats donut shop coffee, and it's cheap at that.
column10: I could pretty much write the same about all of the Eight O'clock coffees I've tried.  They taste good and are reasonably priced.  This doesn't taste as darkly roasted as their French Roast, but it's so close it's hard to say.  One thing to look at, the bags are 11.5 ounce, not 12.  (And 12oz is not a pound) so the per ounce price creeps up.

If you like excellent strong coffee this is for you!  I only buy the whole bean and grind it fresh every morning.  It's very hard to find the whole bean in most super markets so I'm especially happy that Amazon carries it on line.  It's fresh ground, fresh brewed, strong black coffee for me!

If you like the taste of coffee as the Italians make it, this might be the closest thing to espresso you will find without using an espresso coffee maker. Using a burr grinder, grind it as finely ground as your grinder will make it. Try filling the coffee container as full as you can and add water to the six cup mark. Sit back and enjoy.
This coffee tastes as good or better than most coffees costing twice as much.  This coffee is actually  so strong that you need only 3/4 of the usually amount to make a great cup of java.

column9: High quality coffee beans for a great price.
column10: Eight O'Clock Dark Italian Roast is a wonderfully dark, oily bean that rivals much more expensive brands like Starbucks and even Peet's coffee.  If you like a rich, dark coffee, this is the one for you.

Eight O'Clock Italian Roast may not be the the single best coffee you can buy it is really good. I used to purchase this regularly from local grocery stores but all of them stopped carrying this roast. I'm glad I found it on Amazon.
I like this coffee, especially for the price, but all of the bags arrived not vacuum with sealed the last two orders so I've canceled.

I'm a big fan of dark roasted coffees, but have been having a difficult time finding any here in southeast PA.  Trader Joe's is nowhere to be found (not enough ageing hippies and young hipsters, I guess...).  I stumbled on to this coffee at the local market last year.  As I recall, it was about $8.00 for a bag smaller that the one Amazon sells!  I checked here for "Subscribe & Save", and lo and behold (!) - four 11.5 ounce bags for under $20.00!!Their other roasts are good, too.  I've had the Eight O'Clock Coffee, French Roast Whole Bean, 36-Ounce Bag, but I find I prefer the Italian - darker, bolder, better.  Smooth, deep flavor, no bitterness.

column9: Rich brew of Eight O'clock coffee, Italian roast
column10: I look forward to my coffee each morning after I have ground the fragrant Eight O'Clock Italian roast to perfection.  Eight O'Clock Coffee, Dark Italian Roast Ground, 11.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)

Great tasting coffee at a very reasonable price. It used to be vacuum packed for freshness. Lately, the packages are no longer vacuum packed. Is it because of cost saving, or vacuum leakage? It would be perfect if they could blend in a more aromatic coffee, such as Kenya coffee.  Although it is labelled as Dark Italian Roast, it tastes more like a medium roast, which suites me just fine.
I have tried dozens of italian roasts from expensive to cheap...this is definately the best value/flavor combination.Grind it to very fine.Try it!

column9: Subscribe and save : Eight O'clock Coffee
column10: I love Eight O'Clock Dark Roast Coffee and have had a Subscribe and Save subscription for a year. This month's shipment was a big disappointment because the coffee in the first 2 bags was flavored and undrinkable. I could not find a place to directly communicate with the seller. All other shipments have been very good.

column9: Great coffee!  If you like a strong flavorful coffee this one's for you.
column10: I have been drinking this coffee since it was introduced a few years ago. Its taste is very flavorful and hardy. Never bitter. I buy the coffee beans and grind them.  Only one store carried it and it sold so quickly one had to be there practically at delivery time.  Since i moved a few months ago i found that it is not available anywhere, not even wal-mart(wasn't carried in wal-mart where i did live either.) Anyhow, Amazon ships to me monthly at a lower price and no shipping costs.  great service. arrives quickly.

Everyone's taste buds are a little different.  I find that the fast-and-dark roast like the French roast (and all Starbucks Coffees) taste like a cat peed into them.  The overheated oils and scorched beans taste like overheated oils and scorched beans.  Italian roast beans are loaded into a cool roaster and brought up to the required temperature for a full rich dark roast.  I use a french press, add a little half-n-half to the cup and top with freshly whisked (to soft peak) unsweetened heavy cream.It is certainly easier than roasting a blend of cracked raw beans in a cast iron frying pan; which is what I used to do to get a similar flavor profile.Also, it is to be made quite strong, like the coffees you would get in Germany--so it is not "cheap" coffee to make.When you make espresso with a machine, the water is actually under pressure and above the boiling temperature of 212 degrees (Fahrenheit)and using three tablespoons of ground coffee to make 4ozs of espresso.  Good Espresso tastes exactly as it smells because of the temperature and pressure of the extraction process.  (I have had a lot of bad espresso.)

My friend works at a specialty coffee store.  He several times gave me a bag of different premium brews.  There was an Italian roasted Columbian that was my favorite.  He knew I could not afford to buy these brews but valued my opinion.  Until about 15 years ago I just made Bokar very strong then began mating Bokar which has a slight fruity taste with Dark Roast which 8 oclock replace with Dark Italian which nearly tasted as good as my freind's Italian roasted Columbian when maded by itself.  But for the morning I prefer the 50 50.
This is great coffee for cappucino-making.  Has an almost chocolatey taste.  Also not too oily so does not gum up my grinder.  Love it!

column9: Delicious dark coffee for unbeatable price
column10: I like rich, dark, bold coffee.  After giving up my K-cup machine to go back to a traditional brewer, I was looking for a dark roast that could match my bold k-cups. I drink a lot of coffee, so I wanted to find something more reasonably priced than the "name" brands.  I saw a posting on another site for a deal on this coffee and figured I'd check out the reviews. Most were good, and the price was pretty fantastic so I decided to give it a try. Wow! I am so impressed.  Smooth, delicious, bold flavor.  I've been drinking coffee forever, and managed an upscale coffee shop for 2 years, and I truly love this roast. I think it's comparable to the pricey brands for sure.  Seriously, can't recommend it enough.

column9: GREAT COFFEE AT A GREAT PRICE!
column10: I remember watching my Mum grinding a bag of 8:00 at the A&P when a mere babe.  Got this on autodelivery.  During our daily doggie playdate mentioned this to my neighbor, then ground up a portion for her to try the next a.m.  The next day she came back and mentioned how great this coffee was and that even her husband (who is used to the Duncan Donut coffee) had commented on the great coffee that a.m. and RRAVED about it!  and, he drinks it black.  So however you take you Joe, this coffee seems to please!

Like other people have said, these coffee beans are pretty oily which makes for a very flavorful, smooth coffee. The price has nothing to do with me rating this high even though that is definitely a plus! I think this is just as good as Starbucks beans, but a much lower price. Love it!
Having tried a lot of coffee we find this to be our favorite everyday coffee. Taste is rich in flavor. As good as starbuck's at a better price.

Eight O'Clock is by far the best whole bean coffee available.  This Dark Italian Roast is great for people who like strong flavour without the bitter bite.  It is smooth and strong with a deep rich flavour but with no bitter taste.  I only wish a store local to me had it.

this coffee tastes like the expensive roasts from all those "designer" coffee stores without the high price.Join the "club" to receive monthly shipments for even greater savings. Can be used for regular coffee making or espresso grind.  Both taste great.
If you like dark roast coffee, this is an excellent choice.  Pricing has gone up recently, but what hasn't.  Still a good bargain considering the quality of coffee.

There is only one store I know of in Chicago that carries this variety of Eight O'Clock.  I mix it equally with the French Roast Eight O'Clock to make my own blend and this was a very economical way to get my coffee. Very happy with my purchase.
This a a very smooth, bold coffee, and is great after dinner.  I have served it to friends who love it.  The beans are rich and dark.

This is our favorite coffee without spending a fortune-A&P closed and got the large bags -been trying to get Big Y store manager to order for me without success for 8mos now. Amazon is cheaper  than from the eightO'clock  site-they charge a fortune to ship  less amounts! The product is in the old logo bags but is very fresh and we highly recommend using the subscription to get the best price.

I was so surprised to see some reviews saying these beans weren't oily enough!  I must have gotten a good batch because mine are so oily they keep clogging my espresso maker!!  Very tasty coffee.  I got a great deal, but since then the price has risen considerably, and with the problems with the clogging, I'm not sure if I'll order again and mix them with a dryer bean, or just choose something else.

This coffee smells wonderful when it's brewing- Excellent to wake up to.While Eight O'Clock Bokar is my preferred morning brew, the Italian Roast is a nice change of pace.Italian Roast is also very nice after dinner with desert.It's best made in small batches as it does not hold well so just brew as much as you will use in 20 minutes or so after brewing.Eight O'Clock Italian Roast is not the finest coffee you'll ever have but it's very, very good for the price.

After reading a number of good reviews, I ordered this coffee.  Was I disappointed!!! It was indeed a dark roast but to the point that it had a burnt taste.  This was the worst Italian roast coffee I have ever had. Did I get a bad batch? I am now wondering what I will do with four bags of burnt coffee beans.

column9: Good Coffee but not the best
column10: It is a good coffee with a good aroma. Good for espresso. It came in 4 separate bags that are easier to store. We usually like to change beans and this, so far, is one of our favorite.After trying coffee beans from Urban City Urban Espresso Coffee Roasters I have to lower the stars from 5 to 3. It is still a good coffee but the foam is not as thick and doesn't stay as long. Also, I prefer the aroma from the Urban City Urban Espresso Coffee Roasters' coffee.
I'm a fan of dark coffee, but this one doesn't do much for me.  It's bitter.  Dark coffee should have less acid.  Coffee preferences are personal, but that's my take.
Excellent roast! No bitterness and has a smooth flavor.The delivery was timely and the packaging convenient.I am not able to purchase this type of coffee locally.

column9: Not great; seems to have a (very) short shelf life once opened...
column10: Good coffee if made soon after the bag is first opened, beans just ground, and coffee freshly brewed; however, the shelf life compared to comparable products seems to be quite short.  And the coffee seems to get 'bitter' rather quickly after brewing.  Since we like to refrigerate coffee to make iced coffee beverages, this obviously isn't a good thing.  I would possibly buy this brand again, but not this type.

Sugar Twin has disappeared from the stores in Washington & Idaho .... so glad we can get it from Amazon.  My husband uses it and hasn't found ANYTHING to compare.Amazon always seems to come across for us when we are searching for things that are no longer in the stores.Thank you ~ JoAnne Sutton, Vancouver WASugar Twin Granulated White: 7.13 OZ

We've been buying Sugar Twin for years.  All the sudden we could no longer find the 7.13 ounce boxes in local grocery stores.  They are so much more convenient than small packets because we make iced tea by the gallon.  We tried substituting other brands of sweeteners, but none of them sweetened as well as Sugar Twin.  We were so glad to find that size still available online.  It's by far the BEST of the sugar-free sweeteners!

I bought these chocolates as an early surprise Christmas present for my significant other to hold her over until she is able safely enjoy sugar again, but her reaction surpassed my expectations. I must admit that, initially, they seemed a tad overpriced, but they are certainly high quality and indistinguishable from a similar product that did use sugar. So my review of these gourmet chocolates is best summed up with the phrase, "worth every penny."

I want to tell you ---- from the get-go ---- that chocolate-covered coconut is NOT inexpensive.I live in Europe. Everywhere around here: LONDON; PARIS; ZURICH; BRUSSELS; ROME; FANKFURT, anything as,remotely, good-tasting as THIS full-pound of candy would make you remember what a plane ticket costs!I'm buying a pound, because it is reasonably-priced, and the shipping [like SOME similar products] ISN'Tfifteen-freakin'-dollars.Great product, fair price

The chocolates are delicious! I was pleased to find an impressive salted caramel chocolate, especially one by Ghirardelli. Unfortunately, despite the fact that the chocolates were packaged in bubble wrap, several pieces were broken, which did not bode well for the caramel filling.

Over the last year our so, we've discovered the pleasures of dark chocolate seasoned variously with sea salt or black pepper. While neither sounds intuitively pleasing, take my word for it, both seasonings add interesting twists to your chocolate jones.This dark chocolate/caramel/sea salt combo from Ghirardelli is decadent enough that I'm surprised it's still legal.Good stuff. Just be careful...you can eat all 33 pieces much faster than you can imagine (and you'll get plenty of help!).
Absolutely no complaints about this chocolate or the order itself. I just wish I could order the JUST the salty caramel!

column9: About the same as the regular caramel
column10: I was so excited to see a combination of dark chocolate and salted caramel - two things that I love! I do not have complaints about the dark chocolate, that is exactly what I expect from Ghiradelli. However, most salted caramel has a notably tangy, salty flavor and this caramel does not have that at all. It tasted roughly the same as their regular caramel, with no salty flavor at all! I was disappointed.

First, I absolutely loved this product! My mother brought a package from overseas (Latvia) and was highly recommending it.  Of course, it was popular and food tasted wonderfully.  Something told me to check the label again after they actually printed the ingredients of this ingenious seasoning and first thing on the list: MSG (monosodium glucamat).  After much study about MSG, I will think twice when eating food seasoned with ANY products containing MSG.

This product, as originally produced, was an excellent addition to fried chicken. I was advised today by McCormick that this product is no longer available. It has been replaced by McCormick's Perfect Pinch Original Chicken seasoning. The new perfect pinch recipe is different from the old. I liked the original but I don't like the new version.

column9: If It Ain't Broke, Don't Fix It !
column10: When I found the product on Amazon it was Origional Bottle and origional Label from many years ago, and across the page the new label "Perfect Pinch" as you show it. I clicked on the old origional and believed that, that was what I would receive. It was not what I received and I was very saddened to have been deceived.. I received the "Perfect Pinch" which I had seen in stores and tried. It is not even close to the same. The "McCormick Perfect Pinch Origional Chicken Seasoning" is not perfect...much more sage than the origional, totally different taste.The origional was, "McCormicks Fried Chicken or Chicken Fried Seasoning". It was pulled off the market, but came back claiming to be the origional but the name had changed from "McCormicks Fried Chicken Seasoning", to just "McCormicks Chicken Seasoning", but it was okay. Now this "Perfect Pinch" is all wrong. The origional was a perfect seasoningThis is a perfect example of "If It Ain't Broke Don't Fix It". I truly regret this has happened when for 15/ 20 yrs or for as long as the origional was out there, I would buy every bottle on the shelf. My entire family and numerous friends lived by it....If you get one thing perfect...you'd think you'd have the sense to leave that "One Thing Alone". Trust me , it was a top seller..I've searched every store front from The Mexican border to Canada, and East Coast to West Coast trying to find the origional.."BIG MISTAKE MCCORMICK"!TLFLP

*****Numi Tea's Monkey King Jasmine Green Tea is a premium Numi tea, both certified organic and kosher. The only ingredient is fair trade certified special grade green tea that is scented with real summer jasmine flowers from China. There is nothing artificial in this or in any Numi tea. Perfect!On the box, the manufacturer writes: "Jasmine tea is the oldest known scented tea, and ours begins its life in the gardens of Hunan Province. The rich soil and fluctuations in daily temperature yield a fragrant leaf which is further scented with delicate white Jasmine blossoms. During summer, these are gathered daily by the banks of the Min River and repeatedly mated each night with the prepared tea, naturally embracing all of the flowers' scent. When brewed, this smooth, organic green tea has layers of subtle fragrance and hints of moonlight. It is a most romantic tea, and, like a bowl of fresh picked flowers, will bring the joy of summer to your every sip."It sounds quite romantic, and it does certainly taste wonderful. It is a true jasmine tea, and the taste of jasmine predominates, in a both strong and lovely way.If you like Numi teas, get it---you won't be sorry. If you are new to Numi but love jasmine green tea, this will probably be the best you've ever had.Highly recommended.*****

Numi's Jasmine Green Tea is my favorite green tea. It's pleasant flavored and very nice smelling. What I like best is that if I over steep, it doesn't turn bitter like other green teas. I like a little sweetness so add a spoon of turbinado sugar. This tea can be a little pricey and the grocery store, so I like the 3-pack, which helps lower the price. Amazon used to offer a 6-pack, which was nice because I drink this every day and would not have to order it as frequently. Now I just order 2 of the 3-packs. Other details that make this a standout company in tea bags is that it's organic and free trade.

column9: Numi Jasmine Green....just what it says!
column10: Actual jasmine blossoms are laid on the green tea...simple, effective.Numi makes great teas, highest quality. I can actually steep this for quite a while without getting a bitter cup. Cheap green tea tastes puckery after steeping too long. Not so with Numi. Tastes great with a very light clover honey, but go real easy on any sugar so you can taste the jasmine! Make sure to inhale deeply as you sip...be in a quiet place too. Jasmine and green tea - NUMI does it again.
I have been trying different green teas for the health benefits and this has the best flavor I have found.  Especially like it iced.  Very refreshing!

column9: I don't always drink bagged tea, but when I do... I prefer Numi Jasmine Green
column10: I don't always drink bagged tea, but when I do... I prefer Numi Jasmine GreenBefore I switched to full leaf teas a few years ago, I settled on Numi Jasmine Green and found it to be the best tea I could get my hands on in the grocery store. I recently decided to bring some of my old bagged teas to work where I don't have as much time to make full leaf tea all day, and among some others which have been in my cupboard for years the Numi Jasmine Green came along. Guess what? In spite of my tea snobbery, in spite of it sitting on the shelf for several years, this tea is fantastic. I can't recommend it enough. Strong, a little sweet, fairly forgiving with steep time, plus it's USDA organic and fair-trade certified. Currently enjoying a cup with a spoonful of honey!I also recall enjoying Numi's Rooibos being fantastic.Stay thirsty, my friends.
Over priced Tea, Not much Jasmine Aroma or Flavor. I do not recommend this Tea. Will not purchase again. Like I said in the title, "DISAPPOINTED".

I'm pretty budget minded so I thought I would try to find a substitute for the jasmine tea I've enjoyed for many years. It's almost twice as expensive and now I know why. At first, I thought it was because I had a cold; now I see it's just a different tea, much weaker in flavor. For me, this is a case of "you get what you pay for" and I'm a little surprised at the rave reviews here. I'll be going back to Mighty Leaf's jasmine green, which is really excellent and just accept the price tag.Also, a friend taught me to drink that tea with a little milk or cream (and I add a few drops of stevia). I don't know much about tea but I really enjoy that particular blend of ingredients.
This is one of my favorite jasmine teas.  Numi is always a quality product and this, along with the Rooibos Chai are two of the flavors I enjoy.

Look, as far as tea goes, this isn't great stuff. As far as BAGGED tea goes, however, it's pretty dang good. I'll still always preffer my loose leaf jasmine teas, but this does in a pinch and it's a lot more portable.

Let me start by proclaiming two things; First, I am by no means a tea connoisseur like some of the other reviewers here, and therefore in no capacity to speak to the artistry of making tea. Which, brings me to my second point, I will not be able to be as eloquent in my speech regarding a comparison of this particular tea to any other.Now that I have provided my disclaimer...this crap is pretty good! My primary reason for drinking green tea was for metabolic reasons, so I rarely ever gave much thought to its flavor...it was more so for medicinal purposes, not enjoyment. Now, I believe I can have the best of both worlds.After reading the reviews here I realized I was brewing my green tea improperly which caused a bitter taste (this was using the Stash brand). Once I got the hang of the correct water temp and steeping time I realized green tea had a much more delicate and sweet flavor than I had been experiencing.I decided to try this brand as an alternative to Stash and Traditional Medicinal's brands just for kicks. I was a little uncertain of how the Jasmine flavor would effect the delicate taste I had recently become accustomed to in green tea but I have to confess I believe it enhances the flavor immensely. Some of the reviewers noted that after steeping the tea, they could no longer smell the Jasmine and I have to agree with that. But, what they do not say is you can still taste it. It is a very light floral flavor and I love it.It's almost like the honeysuckle nectar that you used to get from the wild honeysuckle flowers in the summer when you were a kid. Its wonderful! I normally sweeten mine with organic light agave so it doesn't overpower the tea. Simply put, in my opinion it is a must try.By the way, the price here on Amazon kicks butt over the price at my local organic market, especially if you sign up for the automatic shipping.
The jasmine in this tea makes it an absolutely superb tasting green tea.  Smells great, tastes great.  My new favorite tea.

column9: Best alternative to loose leaf tea leaves
column10: For a tea bag version, the flavor of this jasmine green tea is superb. I love it so much that since leaving the US for a job abroad, I still order this tea on Amazon and have visiting friends and family bring it over for me. And as much as tea snobs will give you flak for drinking from tea bags, you just can't beat the convenience of them. I keep a couple of packs at my work desk, and can often just grab some on-the-go for short trips. Highly recommended--the quality you get with Numi teas is absolutely worth the extra cost and I wholeheartedly believe that their jasmine green is one of their best.

column9: Numi Tea. Good to the last drop
column10: Getting the right tea delivered to your door is a treat. Getting it at a discount is a super treat. Being able to buy Numi, a line of teas with exceptional quality that is also organic, important to me in the era of the the unknown is outstanding. Their Jasmine Green tea is my current favorite, clean with great subtlety. It is the base Jasmine tea I have ever tried. Numi and Amazon, perfect together.

I have long been searching for a wonderful, not-too-bitter green tea, and this one by Numi has it all!  The subtle scent and flavor of jasmine is just right, and added with a bit of lemon (increases the anti-oxidants!) and honey, you have the perfect cup of hot tea.  Even better, make a large cup and leave the tea bag in longer, refrigerate the extra, and you have a great iced tea to go with your lunch or dinner.  You can't go wrong with this tea, and Amazon's price is the best there is....
My favorite jasmine tea. Smells wonderful and has a nice sweet taste. I generally sweeten my tea, but this one is sweet enough that it doesn't need any sugar.

For a long time I had been buying my green tea directly from China, they have a wide number of really great teas that are among the greatest tasting teas in the world. For many years I had searched the US tea market for some green tea I could get in a convenient tea bag so I can take it to work. I finally discovered this tea, and the reason I tried it was because of the name Monkey King, which is one of the teas I get from China in full leaf form. I also wanted a tea that I would not need any sweetener to mellow the taste. This tea fits the bill all around. It is not overly strong or bitter; I steep mine for 5 minutes, and is perfectly enjoyable as is without a hint of sweetener. That was a plus for me. I have gone through several boxes of it so far, and never tire of it.If you like good green tea, you will not be disappointed. I am at the point now of trying a few others from Numi as well.

It is hard to find green tea that comes in a box like this that tastes good and a nice balance between the green tea and jasmine. After reading numerous review I decided to try this out and I love it. The first thing I do in the morning is grab me a cup of Numi's Jasmine Green tea. It helps that its organic also.

I've been looking for a jasmine tea I could drink at home. This one, as some have said, doesn't get bitter. I can keep the bag in and finish my tea without worrying when to take the bag out. It has a very nice taste and I don't have to add much sugar to it (somehow it is sweet without my massive amount of sugar I like to add). It also blends well with my added milk (I like milk with all my tea). I enjoyed this very much more than the Stash and Bigelow teas. I bought this from Amazon because it was getting hard to find it at my local Wal-Mart.
Excellent product at an excellent price. One of the best tea products on the market. A very soothing experience after dinner - drink a steaming cup after dinner and feel the tension leave your body.

This is my favorite tea! I like tea all around, but jasmine green tea is what I am really attracted to. It's a bit hard to find in stores so I usually buy 2 at a time when i do. To save a little cash since i'm a big tea drinker I alternate with with Twinnings jasmine green tea. Though nothing can really compare to the perfect harmony of the flower and tea. It's just so delicious, not too overbearingly floral either. The only tea i've found that has come close is Migty Leaf's mountain spring jasmine. But Numi is a much better value.

I fell in love with Jasmine Tea while living in Okinawa, Japan.  Since returning to the USA, I've had a difficult time finding a tea that even came close to that made overseas.  Numi organic Jasmine Tea is as delicious if not more so than what I was using as comparisons in japan.  Try it, you won't be disappointed!

column9: not too bad for a floral tea
column10: I should preface my review by saying, i am not a fan of floral teas. At all.Everytime I give them a try, I feel like i'm drinking perfume.My grandpa, who also let me try the Numi Puerh he had, also had me try this Jasmine green tea- thinking he could convert me.I'm not going to say i'm a convert but this is by far the only floral tea i have ever enjoyed. It's the first one that didn't taste like a bottle of Liz Claiborne had been dumped on top of it.If you happen to like floral teas, i would try this one out. If you're not a fan, try it out. You may be surprised. Just like I was!
This is the best Jasmine Tea I have found so far.  I love to put some raw honey with Lemon Essential OIl in it also - so good together!

column9: Not Monkey King which the 'directions' and some 'reviews' indicate
column10: I thought I was getting the Jasmine Monkey King green tea, because both the 'directions' and some of the 'reviews' mentioned it.  But, when I used the first pack, it didn't taste like Jasmine Monkey King green tea I've had before, and the box did not mention it being 'Monkey King' tea.It smells great before it is steeped, but after steeping, the scent is gone, and the taste is just ok.I am disappointed, and I am stuck with 3 boxes of it, as it is not returnable.I wonder if Amazon posted REVIEWS of another Numi tea here by MISTAKE, because the box I received did not mention Monkey King.Not happy.

Numi's Jasmine Green Monkey King is the worst jasmine tea I have ever had.There's no sent of jasmine flowers upon brewing or steeping.If you love jasmine tea stay away from this one.If your new to green tea,never boil your water as it states on the Numi box it will only make your tea bitter.Don't believe me? Try it for yourself.  You want the water just before the boiling point (170-180)degrees Fahrenheit.They got the steeping time right 2 to 3 minutes.Hope this helps you.Beware of prepackaged teas. Buy whole leaf instead.

My Siberian huskies are super sensitive to food.  One will vomit if the food doesn't agree with her, the other gets blood-tinged mucousy stool & vomit. No good, it's been a battle trying to find something that works for them.  Finally tried Eagle Pack and their problems went away.  My boy is also a really picky eater and he loves it.  I think this particular bag has grain in it, which they say not to feed your dog.. But mine do great on this.  I've tried all of the 'grain free' kibble and they barf it up. So, I don't know what it is about my dogs or this food.. but they are a compatible couple!

Maybe these pods aren't compatible with my otherwise ESE compatible machine, a  Francic-Francis, but these pods make a watery espresso. If you like your espresso very long and diluted, these pods might be good for you. They don't seem to be packed tight enough. Same goes for Lavazzo ESE pods, btw. Only Illy's are really tight and work well with my machine. I believe the quality of this coffee is rather high, though, so I intend to try some whole beans.Very expensive also.

This is a serious espresso. 100% Pure Espresso Roast Kona coffee that produces the finest espresso you will ever have.It's extremely smoooooth and rich and not even a hint of bitterness. If you're looking for the best cup of espresso you just found it!!!!
These pods are very expensive, but the taste is incredible. Please reply to this review if you find better (seems hardly possible).

I grew up in Hawaii drinking Hawaiian Coffee.  I have a Handpresso, either it doesn't work well with it or this coffee is too light, I can't get it like I get Starbucks Pods.  Had to return it, my girl friend refuse to drink it.
not happy with the flavor of these expensive pods... prefer Lavazza Gran Crema Espresso Pods over these, and they are WAY cheaper.

column9: One of my favorite styles of Japanese ramen
column10: For the longest time, I've found it difficult to justify blowing $3 on a bowl of instant ramen. Sure, the stuff's imported and most of what you're paying for is the cost of shipping from Japan. You can also get pretty decent domestic bowl ramen for around $1 a bowl. But since most of the ramen bowls coming from SoCal are Korean made (i.e., spicy), it's difficult to find a decent mild flavored Japanese ramen bowl. Menraku Shoyu is mildly flavored (just soy sauce) and not painfully salty like Nongshim, so I don't have to throw out half the flavor packet. The texture of the noodles has a nice bit to it. I don't get these very often since they're relatively expensive, but you get what you paid for. Highly recommended if you want a real Japanese style ramen and want a subtle flavor that isn't spicy.

column9: good for doggy with sensitive stomach
column10: My mini schnauzer, Izzy, loves to chew. However, chewing has been somewhat of an issue for her and us, Pig ears are so greasy they upset her stomach, she broke a tooth on a hoof, and I don't even want to go into the morning I had to give her doggie Heimlich while she choked on part of a bully stick that had come off and she gulped. She won't touch the rubber stuff like kongs. My vet suggested lamb's ears, they are non greasy, easily digested, and won't set off her allergies (a whole other issue) She loves her lamb's ear, and so far no digestive issues. They are not at all greasy and gave her a happy 15-20 minutes of chewing. I will be buying these in bulk.

I purchased these at a big-box petstore locally and I was rather miffed to discover that these are not what they appear. I expected bull pizzles, but it seems all of the "Red Barn" brand Chew-A-Bulls are reconstituted and not real pizzles. They have gone to great lengths to make the product look like a real bull pizzle, but they are not the real thing and do not last like the real thing. I knew something was wrong when my dog had devoured it within minutes. Close inspection revealed flashing from the mold used to form them and the ends were smooth and uniform, unlike a real pizzle.Bull pizzles aren't particularly cheap, and neither are the cheap imitations like these.I truly felt like I had been deliberately deceived, enough so to warn others.

So, completely, irresistibly awesome.  Just came back from visiting friends in Belgium, they made us try it.  Instantly addicted.  The crunchy is my favorite, but the creamy is just as tasty.  Going to give it a shot in a peanut butter cookie recipe.  Hopefully it works.

Move over other spreads- almond butter, peanut butter, nutella, etc. I don't know who invented Biscoff crunchy spread, but I want to give them a big hug. Im happy to easily find Biscoff at our Publix and World Market. Last week I saw the cruncy version (we'd only purchased the creamy before) and decided to give it a try. It's AWESOME! Of course I just grabbed a spoon and gave it a try and I wasn't disapointed. SO good. I've tried it on cinnamon french toast with a drizzle of maple syrup. Crunchy biscoff and jelly will replace the typical PB&J in our house. This spread is awesome with sliced apples, too. Give it a try, you won't be sorry!

This stuff is amazing. Move over, Nutella. This is banana's new best friend.Nice sized chunks of cookie are through it, but it adds a great flavor to anything sweet. In a pinch, just eat it off the spoon! Also is vegan!

Let's see...spreadable cookies... Yes! Bischoff spread is made by the European cookie maker and is available in smooth or crunchy (with cookie bits mixed in). Our favorite dessert these days is thin apple slices with a dab of Bischoff spread on them. Other than with fruit, it difficult to imagine other uses. Since it's made from cookies, it seems like overkill to spread it on toast - but it would probably be good. This stuff is so good that you'll want to grab a spoon and dive right in. Don't, it's a fairly pricy and calorie-rich treat. But for special occasions it's amazingly good.

Why would I call this the worst spread ever? Because it tastes too damn good. I saw this on the store shelf and took a chance. When I got home I wanted to taste it before I would try it on bread. One teaspoon: Yummy! Two teaspoons: Yummy! Three teaspoons.. let's just say three days later the jar is almost gone and the spread never touched a slice bread. This stuff is super delicious, but I can't see it being an alternative to peanut butter in a peanut butter and jelly sandwich. It's too sweet and would not counter the jelly's sweetness like peanut butter does.

I can't say that this is a good alternative to peanut butter.  I think it's a bit sweet for that.  Yes, you can use it the same as you use peanut butter - on fruit, on bread, I think it might be gross on celery though.I made peach cobbler cupcakes which called for this type of spread as the frosting.  SO GOOD and what a great idea.We tried both smooth and crunchy, and I preferred the crunchy.Definitely recommend giving this a try.
Are these strawberries  sweetened?  or have sulfates on them... please list the ingredients.

column9: Organic, and Perfect for Low Sodium Diet
column10: My husband and I both have very low sodium diets and know how difficult it is to find low sodium products that taste good. This is one. We have had Arrowhead Mills Amaranth Flakes every day for breakfast ever since we discovered the product a couple of years ago. We are vegetarians, and also limit our fats and sugars.What on earth DO they eat, you might ask...well, Amaranth Flakes is one thing : ). We love them, and recommend them as all organic, healthy (zero sodium) and tasty.
Wheat Free, Gluten Free, Low Sugar and Sodium and very easy to digest.  Nice taste and I feel great afterwards. Excellent for a Healthy Lifestyle.

I eat amaranth as both a glutten-free food and as an excellent nutrient for my blood type (A).  The Arrowhead Mills brand is the least complex, mass produced and thus widely available, amaranth cereal product I've found and I highly recommend it for blood type As with intestinal challenges such as Crohn's/Colitis or other less challenging IBS issues.  Slightly less excellent, but more crunchy and tasty, is the Arrowhead Mills Organic Maple Buckwheat cereal which I also recommend for those seeking a glutten-free breakfast.
Very dry with not much taste.  I hate to waste them but I will be glad when I finish the last box.

If you buy these after buying the Maple Buckwheat flakes, you'll be disappointed.  If you're looking for gluten free PLAIN cereal with protien, then you'll be happy.  We're currently mixing it together with our maple buckwheat flakes to use up the boxes and won't purchase anymore.  It's like eating Total or something.

I like to carry mints in my purse, have one in the car, have some at work, my husband carries them so I find it better to order from Amazon.  It is cheaper then the 1.90 price in stores but the main thing for me is the convenience.  I always have them and don't have to worry about running out.  Also, you never know when you might feel quizy or a little ill and a peppermint settle the stomach.  This has helped me many times. Not until I was going through a medical situation did I learn carring mints is not an option when not feeling well.  It does make a difference.
I must have a tin of these mints near me at all times, I an addicted!  This is a convenient way to buy them.

column9: great value and fun to use
column10: We have been producing our own family sausages and weiners for many years.  There is nothing like stuffing your own sausages with a special family recipe even when the recipe isn't that good to begin with.  These sheep casings are very handy and easy to use.  Just follow the directions and take your time.  Your family too can enjoy delectable homemade sausage and weiners.

Would recommend Superior_Kitchen_Gadgets to everyone, had a problem that wasn't their fault and when I contacted Sharyn, she handled it "right now". I plan to buy all my cooking supplies exclusively from them.Thank you,Pete

this product is good quality just like their hog casings. The only drawback is these are harder to thread on the stuffer due to the smaller size. A little patience goes a long way with these. If you prefer breakfast links over patties, these are for you
I initially had a problem with the first package and Sharyn rushed a new product out immediately. Great customer service.
These arrived on time. Smelled horrendous. Followed instructions. They continuously ruptured and were unusable. Could have been my fault but I won't buy them again.

The customer service is terrible.  Do not purchase if you are stuffing hot dogs.  This company thinks a wiener is a tiny breakfast sausage and not an American frankfurter.  The casing is too small for a standard hot dog tube.  Oh yeah, they'll keep your money.

Imagine Chicken broth is as close to homemade stock as I can find. Cooks Illustrated rates it very high also. My only complaint is I am unable to get it in a larger size. A 1 Qt. box would be nice.Having family members with MSG allergies is what prompted me to start making my own stock. Slowly I started finding stocks/broths with no MSG added but the taste was not always true. I re-order this often so I can always have it on hand in my pantry.

column9: Most Excellent amazing organic chichen Broth avaliable. 2012 and still the best staple for our house.
column10: Imagine Free Range Chicken Broth, Organic, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)Best tasting chicken broth, that I have ever tried. Organic and msg free. Great by itself. Will keep this on the shelf. 2012 and still our staple go to chicken broth.  Makes amazing dumplins and dressing.

column9: VERY disappointed--especially after buying based upon other reviews
column10: While I don't often post reviews, I feel compelled to for this product as it was such an incredible disappointment. I was a food writer and food editor for a number of publications for many years and am happy to invest research time into selecting the right products, especially when you are buying multiples of a single item. This broth had some excellent reviews, and I find it hard to believe that the reviewers had tasted/evaluated the same product that I purchased as the broth tasted watery with little real chicken flavor and had almost an artificial flavor to it. While it may be organic, there is none of the savory warmth most of us would associated with even a somewhat watered-down version of homemade broth. I actually found that to use it, I had to prepare a "side order" of Better Than Bouillon chicken flavor to kick in some semblance of real, hearty chicken flavor. What's interesting is that perhaps this experience comports with a number of blind tastings of organic and free-range poultry wherein the organic and free-range birds often came up quite short on flavor as much as we all would like to think the flavor would be better from a purely philosophical perspective. When you also add in the price premium, I would say this is not a product that I would recommend at all.

column9: Imagine Organic Free Range Chicken Broth,
column10: Great broth is low in sodium and healthy heart.  We use it all the time. I would highly recommend this product.
Love the broth, but didn't realize it was the small boxes.  I use broth all the time and next time will look for the bigger boxes.
Love this broth because it's a good tasting healthy one which I love to use when I am making soups.  Better than using water even in chicken soup.

column9: Great for soups and stews but need larger size
column10: I buy this Imagine brand or Kroger's Naturally Preferred brand organic free range chicken broth which is exactly the same thing (depending on which is on sale) at my local Kroger store in quart size containers - 32 oz.  I wish Amazon stocked it in 32 oz. containers at a competitive price.  A 16 oz. container would never do for us.It is absolutely wonderful for soups of any kind, from chicken noodle with veggies added to vegetable soup to bean soup or whatever.  Since we do not eat beef or pork I use this broth as the base of everything that needs broth.  I also use small quantities of it to 'quick saute' veggies, per the recommendation on whfoods.org and it works as well as oils which break down when heated.Heated in a pan by itself it is not so good.  However, since we don't eat "plain" anything, in my opinion this is THE best broth with no potato starch, bad oils or MSG.
this is delicious! we go through it quickly at our house. it's a staple in my pantry and i panic when we are running low. get it!

As I make a lot of soups during the winter months I like having these extra boxes of broth on my shelves-just add you meat and veggies with the broth and let it stew for a few hours in your crock-pot or on the stove, put bread on the table and there it is, a yummy tasty meal thats good for you! so many snow days to enjoy soup/stew and not having to worry that you forgot/forget the broth when you go to th store.
For those occasions when you need to cook in a hurry, it works wonderful for me. The ingredients are good, too. No hidden added msg.

column9: Lemon Balm Tea keeps the cold sores away
column10: This is a delightful tasting tea with lemon mint overtones, the fragrance is lightly floral and color is a pale green. The Lemon Balm herb is known for its antiviral properties and I drink a cup or two of the Lemon Balm Tea if I feel a cold sore starting to 'brew'.
Smells good, tastes OK, but failed to rid my cankersores.  No one likes cankersores and I read that this should cure them in a couple days, but it didn't work.
needed lemon balm leaves and orderd this , turns out the tea is 100% lemon balm  leaves organic and just what i needed to make my creme D'Mentia !
I love this tea! I will definitely order more!  It is organic and tasty. I have told several friends about this item too.
have been looking for this tea for long finally got it. this will help anyone get a good balance in their system
I love the smell of Lemon Balm. This has a nice hint of Lemon Balm to it and is smooth, but I think that it needs a little more strength to it.
Received producy quickly - nice packaging. Most importantly, it tastes delicious! Highly recommend to people who enjoy honey in their tea...

After discussing with my kids about how lavender honey was he best honey I decided to have them try it.It is as creamy and smooth as I recalled from when I was a kid in France.Only one thing I would have liked to know is that this honey is not from Provence but from Normandy. That being said i could not taste any difference with the one I used to have in France.Along with a slice of fresh sweet baguette and some butter it is a great treat for kids and adults alike.

I ordered these because my father recently gave me one when we were visiting. I asked where he got them, and he told me the price, which seemed scary, but then he said he had had the bag for about 25 years, and still had some left (and they tasted fresh to me). I figured a product that could last that long, while being used (frugally, I suspect) and still be beneficial must be worth the premium price.I received the product on time, and I am not disappointed with it. I expect this bag may last me awhile, although I may share more of it with others. the chips have good flavor, are long-lasting, and soothing to the throat.

column9: This is a delicious, gentle but reliable laxative tea.
column10: I have been using this tea for over two years.  It moves my bowels reliably after taking it for at least two days.  From then on one's regularity is consistent.I think it regulates the water in the system as well. This tea helps weight loss to show on the scale, if you are an every morning weigher when on a diet.Because the weight comes off slowly, one is not apt to crave sugar after about two weeks of using it.  For me, sweets became less desireable while I  was using American Ultra Dieter's Tea.  It is much better tasting than Laci Le Beau, in my opinion.It is not the whole answer to success while dieting, but I reccommend it as an adjunct to a good diet program.

column9: Pumpkin Puree is awesome "as is" for low cal meal on the go!
column10: I was using the Pumpee Puree for an ingredient in a soup recipe that also included beets,poached pears and butternut squash. I saved some plain to taste "as is" and discovered it was so good that I preferred it that way. I added some spice with a little ginger, turmeric and cinnamon for healthy  benefits. This will be my favorite easy meal to take along on a trip or flight. It's so low calorie, organic, healthy and delicious. I can enjoy it with or without other ingredients.

I keep these bars in my office and when I want to thank someone for a job well done, or a service rendered (i.e. restaurant reservations, doctor's visits, etc) I send these to the people I have contact with. This small touch goes a long way to expressing my thanks for their extra attention and effort without making a huge dent in my personal pocketbook. It is always so well received, its a pleasure to give and then hear how well its received.December 2010 update: I have purchased these several times since the first order because they are received so well. I always have some in my drawer to send off to those whose help is invaluable for those little things like getting a table when reservations are full, helping provide contact information when none is available...etc.

I don't see the purpose of this product. I can't even taste the shrimp. They're tiny, which is fine. I've added it to rice dishes, and even made fried shrimp patties with onion and green chilies. There is just no flavor. I guess there's benefit in that it is a protein, but I won't re-order for the price. I prefer to cook frozen raw shrimp.
Bought these on a whim recently, and was delightfully surprised to learn they do indeed, taste like a Bloody Mary!  They are now a staple in my pantry.

I've always eagerly awaited the Easter season to get my Cadbury egg fix.  The sweet crackle of the shell is awesomely complemented by the smooth deliciousness of the chocolate.  Incredibly the have managed to improve the product by making it with dark chocolate! Perfection...

Standard milk chocolate mini-eggs are easy to find in your standard grocery store.  They are pretty good, but these dark chocolate eggs are better.  I highly recommend these if you enjoy dark chocolate.  Unfortunately they are difficult to find in stores.

column9: Good but not GREAT like the milk chocolate mini eggs.
column10: Easier to resist, easier to portion control! Good flavor but not as good as the milk chocolate mini eggs.Was thrilled to have found them on Amazon

Cadbury eggs are one of the joys of Easter, and the quality of chocolate is excellent. The dark minieggs are wonderful to eat alone or drop into a cup of coffee to enjoy. In my neck of the woods, this product is hard to find, so it was a treat to get it from Amazon with such a short delivery time.

If i could rate this product 800 stars i would....these are the most delicious rich chocolatey eggs i have ever put in my mouth.Better than REGULAR mini eggs BY FAR....tough to find RDME's in stores so you have to bulk order online....ENJOY Anytime of Year8)
I thought I was buying the milk chocolate and started eating this crap. I didn't even know they made a dark version, what a let down.

We picked this up on a whim, thinking it would be nice to not have to dirty a bowl on the occasions that we pop popcorn. In my house, one less dirty bowl is a wonderful thing!This stuff is the most greasy popcorn I've ever had! Not only that, but the big is a pain to open as another reviewer mentioned. You have to hold it at the bottom of the side, then pull the plastic cover off, and even then you only have about a 50/50 shot of it coming off in one piece. Then once you actually get it open, the popcorn has a hint of plastic to it. The top and bottom of the "bowl" aren't paper like a regular bag of microwave popcorn - they're thin sheets of plastic - and that taste comes through in the popcorn.All that said, the popcorn is edible, but it's not as good as regular microwave popcorn. We'll eat this pack, but when it's gone, we'll be back to the standard microwave popcorn!

column9: Sprayed orange grease all over the inside of the microwave
column10: The pop-up bowl sounds like a great idea, but evidently they rushed it to market before all the bugs were out.The first bag I cooked was fine, except the instructions for opening the bag are far from clear, and even after you figure out how to do it it's a lot of trouble and makes a big mess.But the second bag evidently sprang a leak - it sprayed bright orange grease all over the inside of my microwave, even into the tiny vent holes inside the top and side. I always watch popcorn carefully while it pops, but I could not see the grease spray until after it was done and I opened the door. Cleaning it all out was a horrible ordeal, and I'm sure everything I cook in the microwave will come out smelling like popcorn grease for weeks.They released this product too soon. It needs serious redesign. I will not buy it again.

The bowl is a cute idea that is EXTREMELY poorly executed. You can't open it without encountering hot steam, there are a LOT of unpopped kernels, and I just had one explode in the microwave, spewing popped corn, unpopped corn, and oil all over. I never had so much trouble from any other brand. The traditional microwave popcorn bag has it all over these failure bowls.

I agree. I know they have invested a lot of time, money and resources into making the "new" Pop Up Bowl style popcorn and have implemented this feature on almost all of their product offerings as a benefit, but in reality it leaves a good share of the popcorn unpopped and burnt or leaves a burnt flavor for those kernels that popped correctly. I eat popcorn almost EVERY day and would compliment Orville R's popcorn as the best out there but now the experience and product satisfaction is less than desirable now that they've changed EVERYTHING in their product line to the new Pop Up Bowl. It is getting harder and harder to find a multi-pack (6 or 10) that does not use the new bowl. Please either change it back or at least offer the traditional "non-bowl" type of product for us true popcorn enthusiasts.
I love microwave popcorn.  This is not good popcorn.  The packaging is bad, you can't open the top without burning your fingers.  While trying to open the bag the popcorn burns.  Not a good product!

I am a subscribe and save Orville Redenbacher Ultimate butter customer which is fabulous. BUT- amazon sent me this instead this month. Why? Who knows?  I guess it must be defective, because it does not pop very much corn and you ate left with a greasy mess. It is inedible! It is being returned Do not buy!

While the bowl may be a nice feature, the pop corn didn't cook the way it's supposed to.  I know from much experience how the popping is supposed to sound when it's done, but when it slowed down enough and I took it out, much of the popcorn was charred...really nasty.  And even the pieces that looked good, didn't have a good taste.  I think the old cook-in-the-bag way produced a much more evenly done popcorn.  Didn't anyone test this out??  If the old package is no longer available, I'll have to change brands.
Easy to prepare and great taste!  The bowl (once you get the hang of opening it) is handy for serving and cleanup.

column9: Excellent idea and still tastes great!
column10: Love it! What an awesome concept! No more searching for a bowl that is large enough to fit the popcorn. No need to wash the bowl afterwards. Why go through that trouble when the bag conveniently turns into the pop corn bowl? It is very convenient. Tastes great too....just like Orville Redenbacher's always does. I highly recommend it. Did I mention 100% whole grain?Only con I see here is that there could have been a little more popcorn in each bag to fill the bowl up a little higher.

Plastic pop-up bowl? A horrible invention!1. There's much less popcorn in the pop-up bag than in the old paper bags.2. The popcorn always burns.3. The plastic pop-up bags often come apart in the microwave.4. The butter flavor sprays everywhere in the microwave.5. It's too hard to open.6. High heat and plastic? Bad idea in contact with food.(carcinogen)Shame on you Orville, you must be losing a fortune in sales of this bad idea. My store no longer carries the good old paper bags, so it's back to Pop Secret for me!
Not sure why there's so many bad reviews I'm on my second box of popcorn and have had no problems. I think they are convenient.

The bowl bag does not pop in the same amount of time as a normal bag so it makes your microwave's popcorn button useless. Additionally, about half of the bags are faulty and open when popping resulting in very little popped popcorn. Last, I have found it almost impossible to get the bag to pop completely even when watching it pop (since I can't use the popcorn button!). Overall, this new bowl design is terrible and I would recommend switching to another brand until they go bag to the old bags that work.

We like the flavor of the movie theater popcorn which is the only reason we kept buying it.  We used a box and then the next box we had, the bags kept exploding and made a mess.  The company sent us coupons for more free as they said maybe just a bad box.  We had decent luck for a bit and then more bags started exploding.  The last time my three year old microwave quit working after it happened, but I do think that is probably a coincidence based on complaints about the microwave.  The bags are also hard to open and messy.  We have been pouring it into bowls so really no advantage to the pop-up bowl thing for us. After too many explosions of late, I am no longer going to buy the product.

column9: Good movie-theater style popcorn without tons of extra greasy gross-ness.
column10: Please note that I did not purchase this from Amazon, so I am not commenting on the expiration date problem that some people have had.The popcorn cooking process was not as actually described on the wrapper. It says to cook for 2-2.5 minutes on high. I have a 1200 watt microwave and it was done in a 1.5 minutes, perfectly. Granted there were some unpopped kernels but that happens with every popcorn, they are the dried out ones.The butter was, at the bottom, a little gloppy... But as a whole, not too much. It was salty and slightly greasy and delicious. If you want movie theater popcorn that is exactly like at the movies, you are obviously not going to get it from microwave popcorn that comes like this. But for what it is, it's great, and reminds me of the movies.

column9: Good product, and comparably good price
column10: This is a good-tasting product, but the packaging makes for a costly product.  I would suggest that someone try a bag (or two) before making such a large purchase.  If you love popcorn, then you will like this product.

I was amazed at the prize of this versus pop corn even store brands in the super market, my family will go through 2 to 3 bags of popcorn a day, and the fact it came  with a built in bowl was a huge bonus.The first  bag we popped was a disaster, as all microwaves are different, going by the time frame giving on the box, it was to long burnt the pop corn set the smoke detectors off ect..... but once we mastered a time we have had no issues other the very happy children with the movie theater taste popcorn, in a readymade bowl at a wonderful price.  We love it.

I'm confused why there are so many negative reviews.  We love these.  We're on our 2nd box and have had no problems with the bag spraying or the popcorn tasting like plastic.  I did notice that the popping time seems to be less for this than other bags - maybe they are cooking them too long?  The bag is easy to open if you follow the directions - pull it on the side where there is a little cut, but just take it half way.  Then go to the other side's slit and pull it to the middle where you can then remove it.  I love not having to wash any bowls!  We've even melted butter and added extra to it - the bag supported the extra butter well without making any messes.  There are usually about a dozen or so unpopped at the bottom - but I found if I freeze the bag for at least 30 minutes before popping - that number really decreases.

column9: Hot Green Salsa! What A Way to Go!
column10: If you enjoy hot salsas then this product is perfect for you. Hot, tangy and very tasty! My only complaint has nothing to do with the product, only the shipping-shipping costs are high. If I could find this product (or an equivalent) locally (for pick up), I wouldn't hesitate in buying a case or two.I keep looking but haven't had any luck so far. Guess I'll just keep buying from here and sucking it up when it comes to shipping-the product is outstanding!

Green Mountain Gringo makes the best jarred salsa. There are always chunks of tomato; it is not watery at all. It sits well on your chip.The salsa is also made from all natural ingredients. There are no preservatives, artificial flavors or colors. Really, you shouldn't need any with peppers this hot.And -whew- they are HOT. I love spicy food and this salsa is a bit much for me. After one bite I am sweating and my blood circulation has really picked up. This is not a complaint: if you label your salsa "hot" it better burn my tongue and turn my cheeks red.Finally, the jars are great for reusing. I use them as water glasses, a safe container to store my soup for lunch, and also great for fridge pickles. The lids do retain the odor of the salsa for a few washings, though soaking them in baking soda and water fixes this.
This salsa is awesome. Seems to be just about perfect! I love salsa and I'm picky about it too. Green Mountain Gringo is definitely one among the best of them. I recommend it to everybody.

Highly reccomend this product for arabian and persian dishes. The dried lemons(loomi) had a wonderful fresh smell and were the perfect color and taste. Works perfect in arabian rices' such as machboos.
This is a great treat for my 3 dogs. It keeps them busy and full in between meals. Can keep enough on hand. :o)

I love all of the Beefeaters products but this is the very best according to my dogs! My four labs love really these treats!  I believe this product is healthier than most dog treats and give them to my dogs often. They enjoy all of the different sizes and it's nice to have options (e.g. quick treat or slow treat).  I highly recommend these treats!
These are the favorite treats for my two Westies. It keeps them busy and they have never had any issues with digestion.

These treats are huge, and they sell them at the boutique dog shops for $4.99 for one, so I'm happy to buy them in "bulk".  They work really well with my dogs because for some reason, my dogs don't like just plain old rawhide.  They like the chicken on top.  I don't buy the flavored rawhide because it usually stains.  And these treats last a long time.

As a professional petsitter, I am always looking for tasty "rewards" for my canine clients. They all love their Beefeater rawhides rolls with chicken meat.  Although they are alittle pricey, seeing how much they enjoy them is worth the extra expense.Beefeaters Rawhide Roll with Chicken Meat, 5-Inch

column9: Dogs love em, owner hates em
column10: My dogs love the flavor of these things and they can spend hours chewing on them.  The problem is they are SO MESSY.  They are covered in chicken that flakes off all over the place.  I like the concept of chicken covered rawhide but I need to find ones that don't require a vacuum!!

Seriously, what could POSSIBLY be in these thing to make them worth so much?!?I thought Target was on crack asking $14.99!!Last time I checked Rawhide was the skin of a cow? Is this beacuse they can't make leather jackets out of it?

column9: GREAT IRISH CREME,  HARD TO FIND
column10: I was so glad to have found this product. My Momfell in love with an Irish Creme Cappucino thatwas put out by Hill Bros and then discontinued.We tried several others and nothing was even close.I bought her a case of this for Mothers day andshe loves it. She has one every morning and evening,and sometimes during the day too. I was so gladto find one that my Mother just loves.Thanks for helping me find it, and for making it available.

column9: Delicious, creamy, and a good value
column10: I enjoy a hot cup of instant flavored coffee in the afternoon. This has an excellent flavor and is a good value compared to the small containers sold in your local grocery stores.
The Gumballs arrived quick & there is a lot of them inside BUT unfortunately their taste doesnt last more than 20 seconds -- after that it feels like ur chewing something thats not gum!

I bought this for my boyfriend's birthday, as he is an avid lover of Double Bubble gumballs. They taste exactly the same as the regular pieces of gum, and arrived safely at my apartment. He is now the most envied person at work with all his gum.To those who say the flavor doesn't last--have you never heard of Double Bubble? It NEVER was able to keep its flavor, that was the fun of it. Silly people!

Waaaayyyyyyy too expensive but I needed to fill my kids gumball machine for her birthday.  I figured since it's Double Bubble they would at least have great, lasting flavor.  First part yes, second no!  Looks great in the machine but very disappointed with the short lived flavor, especially at this price.
I got my daughter a small gum ball machine for Christmas, and this will keep her stocked for a while. It's flavor is not the longest lasting, but my daughter also doesn't chew it for very long.
Was what I expected along with with a replacement globe to put them in.What can i say? It's gum..Shipping was good,packaging was good.

I bought these to fill my Triple Vending machine(Triple Vend Candy & Gumball Vending Machine). They have been a big hit. Perfect choice for our one inch gumball machine in the game room. column9: Great Flavor!-But Beware Somewhat Misleading Xylitol Claims
column10: The other reviews have mentioned the positive aspects of this gum, and they're true! The flavor is sweet but not overpowering. It lasts about 20ish minutes, which is good enough for me. And it's pretty inexpensive relative to a lot of other gum. So overall it's a great value, and I will continue to purchase it.Ok. Here's the Xylitol issue. Yes, the gum contains Xylitol. Accurate. But the assumption Trident is /likely/ guessing you're making is that the gum has enough Xylitol to actually have its highly touted positive effects. The answer is....probably no. Not really. Trident, naturally, won't disclose the amount it contains. This isn't a good sign. Take the following with a grain of salt but Trident isn't exactly trying to deny the claims-it's estimated by more than one source to have roughly .2 grams of Xylitol in a piece. How much should you get to acquire real benefit? At least 5 grams. You can do the math on how many sticks you need to chew every single day to get there. So if you just want a solid, inexpensive gum-go for it! If you are really looking for Xylitol related benefits, you can easily find other brands of gum on amazon that will get you there.

I am a male in his mid 50's, in generally good health, slightly overweight and with no ongoing diseases.  I've used Tom's of Maine's toothpaste containing Xylitol for years without problems but haven't previously ingested Xylitol.I purchased Spry Fresh Fruit gum two days ago, consumed two pieces in rapid succession on an empty stomach that day about 2pm and felt OK.  Consumed another piece on an empty stomach at bedtime late that night.  Next day I felt increasingly ill: stomach (pancreatic?) pain, some nausea, and aches and pains throughout my body as when fighting a generalized infection or recovering from overexercise.  Consumed one more piece about noon of second day.  Peak of above symptoms was about 4pm that day.Of course I had no idea what was wrong with me.  At the time I suspected food poisoning or salmonella.  Rested due to pain much of the second day.  That night I researched Xylitol and found many had experienced nausea from using it (web search key words "xylitol nausea").  From what I've learned so far effects are most acute with first time users for whom there may be a tolerance or adjustment period.  I also encountered at least one recommendation that Xylitol not be taken on an empty stomach or that it be taken with other sweeteners to avoid nausea.Today is day three.  I'm feeling a little better but have abdominal pain and fatigue severe enough that I am taking a sick day off from work.  As I write this my experience is fresh in my mind.On the positive side, this gum was enjoyable to chew, the flavor quite good (though it does fade quickly).  It's probably fine to take after a meal as recommended on the package.  And, if you're trying to evade tooth decay or other sugar-related maladies I commend you for that!  However, please use moderation if you aren't an experienced Xylitol consumer.Bottom line: good product generally but given my experience and the number of similar cases I found in my research, I think a warning on the package to new Xylitol users about tolerance appropriate.

column9: Tastes good, xylitol for prevention of cavities
column10: I have taken a quote off of Wikipedia pertaining to xylitol for dental health:"Early studies from Finland in the 1970s found that a group chewing sucrose gum had 2.92 decayed, missing, or filled (dmf) teeth compared to 1.04 in the group chewing xylitol gums.[17] Recent research[18] confirms a plaque-reducing effect and suggests the compound, having some chemical properties similar to sucrose, attracts and then "starves" harmful micro-organisms, allowing the mouth to remineralize damaged teeth with less interruption. (However, this same effect also interferes with yeast micro-organisms and others, so xylitol is inappropriate for making yeast-based bread, for instance.) This is because cariogenic bacteria prefer fermentable six-carbon sugars, or disacharrides such as sucrose, as opposed to the nonfermentable xylitol, whose antimicrobial properties then "starve" the bacteria, reducing their growth and reproduction.[16] Most of these studies suggest that at least 6 grams of xylitol per day is needed for dental efficacy; for most chewing gum or breath mints this would require 12 pieces per day (op cit)."So according to this you need twelve pieces of xylitol gum per day to be effective.That would mean a one hundred piece jar would last less than ten days, and you would be chewing two pieces three times per day.So you would need three jars or more of this per month.  I may try out buying xylitol in bulk packages here on Amazon and sipping it in water.  The health benefits not only of preventing cavities but also of preventing sinus and flu infections when taken by nosein a spray are impressive.There was also a study done that showed that xylitol can help prevent osteoporosis by remineralizing bones.It seems there are two main companies in the world producing xylitol, in Denmark and in China, and this gum company supposedly gets theirs from China which sends up red flags in some of us.  We can't really trust China not to put harmful ingredients into things, as has been shown.The gum itself tastes good.  I can't complain about it so far, it is similar to Juicy Fruit in taste.  The taste fades out fast but still a hint of it remains for at least half an hour.I plan to do more research on ways to add enough xylitol to my diet.  Chewing twelve pieces of gum a day isn't something I want to do.  I recommend this gum as a way to get xylitol into contact with your teeth where it has a unique ability to kill bacteria.  One star comes off due to the probability the xylitol in this is made in China, and the fact that it or any gum of this nature requires too many pieces to be chewed per day to have the beneficial effect on teeth.  Still, when you can't brush after a meal this is a way tokill mouth bacteria.

High quality coca products do not have a paper wraps since they can harbor dirt and bacteria and the printing ink can change or contaminate the delicate flavor of the tea bags.Organic coca tea bags do not contain preservatives or additives; therefore they must be properly stored. All coca tea Air Tight Bags are re-sealable with zip lock closures and once opened the bags must be kept closed at all time to avoid contamination in a dry, cool, dark place away from strong-flavored foods. An extra airtight container is recommended when the tea is stored over one month.Do not store coca tea products inside a refrigerator if you have produce inside. Many fruits and vegetables, especially if they have been damaged, give off ethylene gas as they ripen. Coca tea bags are very sensitive to the presence of even very low levels of ethylene gas. The refrigerator acts as a trap for the ethylene gas given off by the generating varieties, allowing it to build up to damaging levels. Although not hazardous to humans, the ethylene gas leads to the early aging and rotting of the tea.
