So, even though we used it when we first got it with no ill effect, it is a matter of principal that I was sold TWENTY POUNDS of flour past its "better if used by" date. That's just wrong. So I wanted to give fair warning to anyone who might want to order this item (Sujata Chakki Atta flour, 320-ounce bag, from India Connect).Thanks Amazon for taking care of this.

column9: Direct to door, price is way off
column10: Sujata atta, the whole wheat flour, is great and that was what I always buy from local store. The price is way off in Amazon. Local store sells this for $10. Even after subscribe and save, I am paying ~$6 to have this 20lb package in frontdoor. Not too shabby, but could have been better. Unlike some other short dated Amazon grocery items, the package I received was manufactured in Jan 2011.

column9: The Best Chocolate on Earth and Beyond
column10: When I arrived on Earth shortly after the invention of the Transistor,I was disappointed to find that this particular form of Chocolate wasnot available. While remote scans of the Earth found indications ofthe particular DNA, it was not possible to locate the actual source.I have been very busy focused on IT since my arrival. Therefore, whenI learned that a DNA match and been found for a source in themountains of Peru, I started tracking the transition from the farmto products available for sale. In support of the prime directive,I did not replicate it from my DNA InterGalatic DNA Library.Ordering from Amazon was only natural on Earth. They arrived byUPS 2 Day Express in an insulated container in perfect condition.I am looking forward to confirming the DNA.The taste --- fantastic !!!

I bought this bread elsewhere a while ago, on a chance. I'd recently started playing around with baking breads on a stone, instead of in the bread machine. I'd done the latter for many years, and, while we enjoy the fresh-baked breads, the similarity of their crusts made me try oven baking. (Partly helped by learning that a $2-3 unglazed tile makes a great baking stone without spending big bucks.) This was going to be just for some "cheating", avoiding putting together the necessary ingredients for a more complex bread like this 10-grain one. We were surprised and delighted with the results! Not only did the bread taste great, it consists of all-natural and organic ingredients. I was sorry to see that the store we bought it from didn't have any more when we returned, but had a few other varieties with which we've had similar success. The 10-grain one was still our favorite.

My border collie, Roxy, loves these! I had heard about pigs' ears and got her some before, but she lost interest with them after a few. But, she LOVES these ones! She didn't get bored with them and would scarf them down. My only problem is that I wish I could find them in a 10 or 15... or even 20 pack so that I don't have to buy so many bags or so often...

Our baby girl was a preemie and I was unable to breastfeed.  We started with the Neosure Enfamil and once she could switch to a "normal" formula, we went to Enfamil Gentlease.  Our little girl spit up violently with about three feedings per day, with spit up coming out her nose and spewing from her mouth.  A friend recommended Gerber so I read some reviews and called and talked to their very friendly and knowledgeable staff.  They sent a free sample and once we slowly switched her to the Gerber, her spit up reduced considerably.  She's a much happier baby.Also, I like the packaging of the 23 oz, easy to level the scoop and two ways to store the scoop inside.

column9: It's been good for us so far!
column10: We tried Enfamil, then Similac, then Gerber Good Start Protect for our baby and she seems to like this one the best. However, it does tend to get little clumps when mixing but they go away if you shake it hard and let it sit for 5 minutes before giving to the baby. Also, she gets some gas from time to time but she was a gassy baby from the beginning. Overall, I would say it's working well for us so far!

I really like this product. My son spits up much less than he did on either Gentlease or Similac Sensitive.  It also mixes up really easily. The simlilac used to gross me out because of all the particulate matter floating about after stirring.I actually quite like the container. The little blue arc area on the left hand side of the opening is actually an additional holder for the scoop. You just set the scoop itself into and it holds it upright.  It works beautifully and is much easier to use than trying to snap it into the top of the lid.I like the little lip on the edge of the container. It works great for leveling out the scoop to make sure I have the correct amount of formula.  Yes, it does make it harder to get the dregs of the formula out at the end of the day but in this case, Ill take the lip anyday to use for leveling.

It is likely that each child reacts differently to each formula. Our infant does the best with Good Start.Regarding the new container, we really like the fact that it is square and has a lip. This allows you to scoop and scrape the top of the scooper all in one motion. As for the "circle" in the corner, it holds the scoop!!  I don't know about other people, but I don't like people reaching in the formula with their hands to dig out the scoop.  Nice touch.
The formula is good, easily digested, but this new packaging is just another way of raising price in my opinion.  Higher price and fewer ounces!  I like the orignal better.

We switched our baby to Gerber Good Start Protect from Enfamil Newborn when he was experiencing moderate digestive discomfort. He was spitting up quite a bit of formula after every feeding, passing lots of gas, and was just really fussy. Since he's been on Gerber Good Start, his digestive problems have noticeably lessened and he is not as fussy when it comes to eating. As far as the new packaging goes, I love it! I feel it is much more sanitary storing the scoop in the lid. Then you are not contaminating the entire can of formula like it used to be when you had to fish the scoop out of the powder with your fingers. Also, the scoop has a nice wide handle so it is easy to hold onto. When I am down to the last scoop, whatever I have left remaining, which is basically nothing, I just pour into the new canister of formula I am opening next. Not a big deal at all. This formula is more expensive when compared to the other major name brand formulas. Especially since I can buy the other brands at Costco or Sam's Club at a significant discount and they accept the formula checks that the companies send too. However, my son likes it and seems to be doing well on it so to me it is worth the price. FYI- For those that heat up their baby formula, this formula contains probiotics which is compromised when the formula is heated above 100 degrees. So if you heat up your bottles, the benefits of the probiotics are gone. The Gerber Good Start Gentle formula does not have the probiotics if you still would like to use the Good Start brand. I hear great things about that formula as well, though I have not used it myself.

This is the formula his day care provides so we buy it for him, but I noticed it gets clumpy on the bottom and needs ALOT of shaking unlike other brands. He likes the taste and the scoop placement and leveling corner is nice

column9: Expiration time less than one week.
column10: The expiration date was less than one week after it arrived. I wish I knew this before I ordered two as my kid only needs 1/2 of one a week. Waste of money for me.

This is not our regular formula, but I do purchase this from time to time, when I have coupons. We had such a bad experience with the "Gentle" version of this formula that I was skeptical to try this. But I was very pleasantly surprised by this "Protect" version. No constipation, no throwing up, no spitting the bottle out - just lots of good BMs, happy tummies, and empty bottles. I would definitely recommend this, especially since it has the probiotics in it.

My husband and I really like the idea the 100% whey protein and corn syrup isn't one of the first ingredients as it is in the other formulas. I also really like the scoop they give. It is more narrow and conducive for dumping into the regular width bottles. My only complaint is that sometimes it doesn't shake up as well as I would like, leaving some clumps. However, we shake it up really well and usually put it in the fridge for the next feeding. After warming it up for the feeding and another quick shake, the clumps are usually gone. The good thing is that the formula doesn't stay bubbly after shaking like the Similac did for us.
Baby seems to not mind the taste and drinks one bottle of this per day. it also does not upset her tummy.

I really wanted this formula to work for my son!  I had to stop breast feeding at 7 months and we started him on Gerber Good start Protect.  He did fine at first but I noticed he became gassy and fussy.  Also the formula did not mix well.  We would shake and shake and stir the formula for what seemed like forever (when you have a crying baby) and in turn caused it to create bubbles.  I tried another formula and even went back to this just in case but it was a no go!  Unfortunately we still have not found the right formula.

column9: Good formula..but what on earth is coming out the other end??!!
column10: My son's pediatrician recommended this formula when he was having issues with vomiting up half a bottle of his previous formula.  We tried a sample and soon switched.  Have had no problems since, and he is now a happy non-puking little dude.  All's well right?  Uhhh...nope. WHAT on earth is he pooping out? I swear I have never seen a baby poop that color before, some weird shade of grey/green sludge that has the consistency of tar and stinks like nobodies business.  Great formula but the poop could kill someone!

Well, the baby was already on Good Start, so we couldn't switch to another formula.  This new packaging is a sturdy squarish plastic shell.1. difficult to open the latch -- often the entire lid threatens to come off2. square shape makes it hard to get to corners3. at the lid, the container narrows (the lip), so if you try to turn the can upside down to empty it out, formula gets stuck on the ledge.  It's really a pain in the ass to use every last bit of powder.4. decreased amount, increased price.  Bleah.5. I almost forgot, there is an asinine blue plastic circle at one corner that appears to protect the foil lid.  You have to carefully remove the foil under this blue plastic, and half the time the foil rips and you waste time removing the rest of the foil.6. The scoop holder in the top of the lid works but it's totally not worth any increase in cost.

This formula was easy for my 5 month old to digest, but it was extremely clumpy.  I will not buy this again.

We discovered this grilling sauce at Williams Sonoma several years ago. Unfortunately they took it off their shelf. We were so sad! I began searching the web and found the product on Amazon.com. It is the best grilling sauce and makes the best rack of lamb you have ever eaten. It is also good on chicken or pork. Easy to use and you will impress everone with your culinary skills.

Have to admit I doctored the sauce a bit by adding Cruzan Coconut Rum (1/3 rum to 2/3's sauce) and used it on shrimp.  Excellent!  With the added rum I'd rate it a 5. I actually bought the sauce at Williams Sonoma which they have since discontinued.  I was thrilled when I read the label and saw the Restaurant Lulu info.  I'll certainly buy more now.

column9: I actually spent $60 on candy, so sue me
column10: I LOVE this candy more than anything in the world. Originally bought it at Trader Joe's many years ago, was given them at a restaurant recently and looked for them again...could not find them in stores. So I actually blew $60 on this. Well, the candy is delicious and great but I actually took the time and effort to count them, only to be just under 200 short. :( I got 1414 candies in this.  I feel kind of gypped considering I paid $60, and for it to be missing an eighth of what was supposed to be in it kinda sucked. Great candy, though.

column9: Wholesome hides seem a little weak
column10: First rolled hide that hasn't given Moose explosive poops. So good there. He is able to completely consume one 9-10" roll in one day. So bad there. At least I think he's not getting toxic waste. But he is a compulsive chewer at 7 months, and I'm saving the kitchen cabinet fronts, table edges, legs, chair feet and any book or paper in the room from being shredded.

I wanted a product that was made in the US rather than China. Most raw cow hides come from the US and are shipped to China for processing. Rawhides produced in the US generally should be fresher and not packed in crates and preservatives for months. I have a higher level of confidence there are fewer harmful chemicals if any when made in the US and with this brand. For our 5 month old German Shorthair Pointer puppy this product can outlast her need to chew. I like the roll better than the bone style. With the wrapped style, she was able to rip the wrapped ends off quickly and I had to watch her carefully to make sure she did not ingest large pieces. I am sure a larger dog could quickly devour one in a setting, but for our 30 pound dog it is lasting a good while. I will most likely reorder this product again.I don't think there is a perfect chew toy for dogs, but this one is working out for her.

column9: Drink for Diabetics, just add water!
column10: Robinsons sqash/cordials has been on the market for Years in the UK, I am just over the moon, to be able to get in these quantities over here in the US.Just add to water, to taste, with ice and you have a great, flavourful drink.

column9: Worth the Price but hard to find!
column10: My cat gets a combination of wet food in the morning and dry in the evening (sometimes dry in with the wet in the morning if we don't have his normal wet food). I don't know that I would call him a picky eater but I do know that since I put him on this dry food minimal hairballs, his weight has come down (he was at 15lb now down to 11), his coat is beautiful, and the vet says he is super healthy. I did go with a cheaper, easier to find dry food when we ran out of this once before and never again! His coat got duller and hairballs galore! Now the biggest problem is actually finding this brand and specific type for him. Because he doesn't get tons of this, a 7lb bag will last at least 2 months so I don't get the bigger bag, but if you try it and only feed dry food, I would go with a larger size bag. All in all, we love it!

column9: Doesn't matter how healthy the food is...
column10: ...if the cats won't eat it.I bought a bag of this, and neither little kitty will touch it.  I mixed it with their usual SCience Diet and Nutro food, and they picked around the Avoderm to get the good stuff.  I stuck to my guns for about 5 days, and they still won't eat it.  I am not saying don't buy it, but be ready for them to refuse it.Back to my old faithfuls.

column9: Great for weight control and hairball control
column10: Both my cats love this Avoderm food but when one started gaining too much weight I switched them to the weight control formula and they still seem to love it.  The older one has less hairballs and the younger one has lost a little weight too.

My cats are picky eaters, but I've never seen them completely snub a brand of food!  I mixed it with their old food so they could get used to eat, and they would literally eat everything in the bowl except for this food.  If I put a bowl of just AvoDerm out, they would not eat anything.  I thought they would eventually get desperate and try it, but they refused to even do that.Maybe some cats like avocado, but mine certainly don't! It was so bad, I actually had to return it (never had to do that before).

column9: Great tasting pistachio nuts. Better than Calif. pistachios
column10: I HAVE ORDERED THESE PISTACHIOS FOR THE 3RD TIME. i LOVE THEM. THE TASTE IS A REAL NUTTY TASTE AND NOT A FAKE CRUNCH I HAVE HAD FROM OTHERS. YESS!

The shipment arrived and was very well packed. However, the nuts are not salty enough for my liking. They are very fresh but lack the roasted/salted flavor I enjoy. The company does a good job but I will not order again due to the lack of flavor.
Bamboo looks just like the picture, and 6 months later it is still growing strong and very green!  Awesome!

I used it for a present and the person loved it. Is growing up ok and the shipping went through without problems to DC. Looks good on top of a table and the ceramic pot matches with almost everything.The only thing I didn't like it's that the ceramic pot doesn't have some stones that can give more support to the bamboo while growing. I didn't think about it when I bought and though is something easy to get and not that expensive, it would improve the presentation.
Can't have just one or two. Seaweed lovers must have. It is a bit pricey but hey, if you don't have an Asian store around carrying this brand, you MUST order from here. Fast delivery service.

My husband had brought some of these home with him from his trip to China.  Needless to say we devoured two bags within a very short time leaving us craving more.  It took some searching because I couldn't find the exact bag nor brand that he brought back with him.  I took a chance and ordered these hoping that they would be similar and they were.  These are on the expensive side and don't come in flavor but they satisfy the cravings....delicious!  I'm just glad I didn't know about these when i was pregnant :)
Honey is a natural health food. Sourwood is complex, tangy sweet and has a slight bitter aftertaste. Really outstanding on toasted breads.

I was pleasently suprised by this Honey.Very good taste, stronger than clover honey and slightly sweeter.I bought this when Isaw it on line because I had never heard of it.I will buy more of this, for sure.
Excellent, clean taste with honey flavor lasting throughout the pallet.  Taste is worth the money.  Delivery was timely and packaged for product protection.

Our dog LOVED the edible bone, and the floppier brown rubber bone was a favorite for a long time.  The floppy brown bone survied her puppy teeth with almost no damage.  The white bone is really stiff and hard, almost plastic feeling, and she had no interest in it then and as she has aged, doesn't like it now either.  She ignores it completely, not even bothering to bury it in the backyard, which is her favorite thing to do with all her treats and toys.  Maybe other dogs will like it better.  2 out of 3 bones were great!
It took my 3 minature dachshunds about 5 minutes to eat the bone.  I was hoping that the bone would be more of a challenge to eat!
For a long time my one greyhound could not have any treats due to Inflamatory Bowel disease. These do not cause any relapses and it is really nice to watch the hounds enjoy these
My dog loves these sweet potato flavored bones. She's a vegetarian dog. They're hard enough but not too hard and she likes that.
My little dog really loves these.  However, she can go through one in about 15 minutes.  I was hoping for a few hours of chewing at least, that's why the 4 stars.  Will probably purchase again.

Our dog absolutely loved these! I loved that there were no inedible parts that I had to keep an eye on. Daisy's a big chewer, and these gave her something safe and delicious to gnaw on. Highly recommend. Would have been five stars, but each bone lasted less than 10 minutes. I found them to be a bit expensive for 30 minutes of fun.
The 2 hard bones worked very well with the puppies, but the softer, chewable one broke easily, so I watched the puppy with it.

I got the "souper" size version. Let me remind you my dog is a 1yr old, 25lb male Boston Terrier. I bought this as an alterenative because it was edible. I bought the "souper" size thinking that he would take FOREVER to chew this. I had gave it to him, and at first he was a bit scared of it. Once he got started there was no stopping him. He ate 90% of it in an hour! If your looking to buy this to keep your dog busy, beware. If a small Boston can chew a "souper" size in little over an hour imagine what bigger dogs could do. For the price, I wouldnt recomend this to anyone. It's just like a "souper" size cookie.

I bought this product for my mastiffs and while is took them a couple of hours to eat it, it only took 20 minutes for my Boston to eat it. I was hopeing that it would last months not minutes or hours. Great product for light chewers and for dogs with allergies to meats.
It smells absolutely great and it looks like diarrhea. What more could anyone ask for in a personal grooming product?

column9: Good Lathering. Nice Fragrance. Strange Appearance.
column10: I recently purchased a 12-ounce bottle of AXE Temptation Shampoo and Conditioner I've liked other AXE products, so I tried this one. Well, there was a big surprise. I poured some out into my hand and it was brown. It looked like Hershey's Chocolate Syrup. Really. You put this stuff on your hair? Well, of course, and I did. It had a real good lathering ability and a nice fragrance. Furthermore, I think it did a nice job on my hair. To be honest, my hair isn't the best test. It's only about an inch long and wouldn't even need a conditioner. Ah well, it worked fine and I really like the fragrance. Just be ready for the appearance.Gary Peterson

I really like the smell of this for my husband.  He likes the product.  It had become hard to find in the variety stores.  I was happy to buy it from this seller for a great price and timely delivery.

I was searching for an at-home alternative to Dunkin Donut's white hot chocolate and bought other products that just didn't cut it, this one surpassed it! This stuff is soooo good, I make it with milk (with water wasn't as tasty) but it is delicious! The bag doesn't come with a scoop, so I just used a big kitchen spoon (tablespoon) and I used 2 heaping spoonfuls! I have had a cup at least twice a day for about 5 days and I'm not even halfway through the bag. It is an incredible value and is Oh-So-Tasty! If I could give this product more stars I would, and also with the prime shipping it came to my door exactly when expected within 2 days! Awesome!Two weeks later:  I have to add to this review because although I still love the product, I do not love how they increased the price and made it not prime eligible, this means with shipping I would pay more than double what I did two weeks ago!!

column9: Same stuff I used to drink from latte stand
column10: This is the same stuff my friends mom used to make her and I at her latte stand like 10 years ago before they had to move.It's divine with milk not with water I normally drink soy or almond milk and sometimes skim or 1 percent but for this use 2 percent and it's heaven.

This product was disappointing.  It's basically regular cocoa mix with a large amount of coffee creamer added (in such that it becomes the primary ingredient).  There is no cocoa BUTTER in it, which is the element that makes "white chocolate" what it is.  Very deceptive and not like white chocolate mix.If you like milk chocolate cocoa with lots of coffee creamer, you'll probably like this product.  :(

column9: If you don't like milk or dark chocolate...
column10: this white chocolate mix is for you. I like the idea that by having the mix in bulk,you can use what's good for your taste. The price was great; I may be ordering this sooner than expected.

Sometimes it's hard to find just that special drink that brings the warm cozy feelings but this item does the trick. Smooth and a great price, easy to make sure all the family gets to share in all those feelings.

Add a little of this syrup to ice water and you get a fantastic refreshing drink in the summer.  Incidentally, the 0% sugar version is just as delicious!  Growing up in France, I spent many afternoons sitting at cafes sipping this mint drink.  35 years later, it's still as wonderful!
I discover the mint syrup in France and really I love it ! the taste of mint is so great !!Don't hesistate to try it....

I had to have this mint syrup for my home ! Whenever I am in France I order a "menthe au l'eau" which is mint syrup and water and it is a very refreshing and pretty drink ! Fast delivery and nice memeories ! Great seller !

When I received this product, there was a small dent in the bottle.  I wouldn't care, but I was giving it as a gift, so I called to see if I could exchange it.  They were VERY helpful, and in fact sent me another bottle very quickly!! :)  Great service!!!

I tried writing a review previously but I focused on how recieving a bottle w a busted cap and dents on my product didnt make me super happy. I wasnt going to have a container once I took off the foil cause the cap was busted...so I got a plastic container and dumped syrup in there for storage. Tonight,  I made a mint julep w the syrup. Its wasnt a HORRIBLE drink, but its not a mint julep to me. It just didnt taste like the ones Ive had. Taste combined w a shabby bottle didnt work for me.
Friend came back from France and brought 2 bottles of this. He let me try some, and lets say I'm addicted. I drink it with milk it reminds me of peppermint in the winter.

Yes it's bright green, yes it is full of sugar, but by gum is this mint syrup delicious! Like several other reviewers, I grew up in Europe where this can be considered a fairly common drink. Most cafés in France, Belgium and even Italy will carry a mint syrup, and no, they don't use it in coffee! Add a dash (or four) to cold water (flat or sparkling) and you have created what is easily one of the most refreshing drinks imaginable. The mint tastes is not overly sugary, making it excellent as a cocktail mixer/modifier (alcoholic or virgin). Use Teisseire mint syrup to add a punch in flavor and presentation!I highly recommend that you give this sirop de menthe a try!!

First of all, I want to start off by saying that I'm not crazy!!!  I am a homebrewer and in my free time I enjoy day dreaming up the next great beer.  One day after eating girl scout thin mint cookies, an idea hit me.  I could add this Mint Teisseire to my Chocolate Stout beer and have a perfect Mint Chocolate Stout!!!!  I've got to say, it turned out perfectly!!!  This mint syrup did not disappoint, even in an odd use such as mine!  To me, that's the mark of quality!  Yummmmm!

Teisseire is a French company that still makes the best syrups out there, with no nasty ingredients in them. High quality products for at least 20 years!Mint syrup is my favorite, and I used to drink a ton of it when I lived in Belgium and France. Add it to ice water or, even better, to sparkling water for delicious, refreshing soft drink. Highly recommended! And if you'd like to try another flavor, get the grenadine flavor (that one can be added to vanilla ice cream for a delicious treat).

We all love Teisseire syrups in our family. I grew up in France and my grand-mother used to serve me these drinks during summer. Now, my parents bring these when they come visit from France for my kids. I love that I can find the syrups on Amazon too as they're pretty heavy to carry in a luggage! My favorite flavors are mint, grenadine and anis. These are the classic flavors but the truth is that they are all amazing. All the fruity flavors are great: strawberry, red fruit, orange, lemon, etc...

Though many of our customers liked seeing some of the retro candies, the price is, I feel, outrageous.  Even if there were 200 pieces (as claimed, which I very much question), you're still talking over 22 cents PER CANDY. I know the days of penny candy are long gone but 22 cents per piece of candy is steep. Plus one of the 'candies' was actually a sizable quantity of cinnamon flavored toothpicks.  When is a toothpick considered candy?  If you count the individual toothpicks, then maybe you might hit 200 pieces (the toothpicks appear to number about 60 individual picks but they come in packages of 6 so, unless you're going to break open the package and dole them out one-at-a-time, you can't count that as 60 pieces of candy - especially when it doesn't even qualify as candy.)  An intriguing combination but not worth the cost.  I bought this assortment in mid-August and I still have quite a bit of it left because the customers have picked over what they liked and left much of the rest - including all those darn toothpicks.

Wanting to do something special for the local Fire Station...they flipped for this candy. Some were not old enough to remember, but others were or they had remembered seeing these at a relatives house. Either way they were a big hit. Plus, it's fun to enjoy a Mary Jane and Sugar Daddy again.What are you waiting for?

Life is funny sometimes.  In high school I used to make fun of shoppers outside of Nordstrom paying outrageous prices for a tiny cup of Italian style coffee.  A few years later in college I answered a help wanted ad from my local coffee stand.  I wasn't picky, work was work and helped pay for tuition and books.  The owner opened my eyes to the world of gourmet coffee, he not only introduced me to espresso he turned me on to it.As part of the job we would take classes on how to make coffee and go to coffee tastings.  The appreciation of artisan made food and beverages has continued through the years.  I enjoy local bakeries, micro-brews, and regionally wineries.That being said I think it is possible to get decent to good quality out of mass-marketed and pre-packaged items.  I was against pod coffee for a long while until I tried the Keurig coffee maker my girlfriend got for Christmas.  I still enjoy making coffee with fresh beans but I will occasionally enjoy a K-cup.The Tully's Kona blend makes a mellow relaxed cup.  I can almost see it giving me the "hang loose" sign hearkening me back to its place of origin.

column9: One of the Better Keurig Coffees
column10: Let's face it, with so many different flavors for the Keurig machines, how do you pick the best?  Simply, trial and error.  The Tully's Coffee Kond Blend actually tastes like coffee, in addition good coffee.  My wife and I were pleasantly surprised to get a few samples of this and it quickly became our standard K-Cup.  The brew is very nice just black, or it can provide a deeper palette with some milk/sugar added.  Great coffee, great taste and great K-Cup.
This is the best coffee and my favorite by far, I just wish it was cheaper!  Best price on web here though.
liked this one very well, especially for morning coffee where you'd don't need a slap in the face! recommend this one

column9: Tullys Coffee Kona Blend for Keurig K-Cup brewers
column10: We like our coffee bold and this is perfect. A good wake-up in the morning and mellow enough to relax with while socializing or reading. I would definately recommend it to anybody who likes their coffee strong.

column9: I am not a fan of super strong coffee.
column10: Kona is a wonderful coffee with a smooth taste, yet a slightly strong taste.  Kona fits my palet perfectly and is a joy.  Order larger quantities as depending on the weather in the South Pacific it may not be available.

This is one of my favorite. It smells so good while brewing and leaves you satisfied with no after-taste. I have been buying it for quite awhile and also send it to one of my daughters because they enjoy it also.

I am out of this coffee and not happy about that. I forgot to order more! Now, I can say that I enjoy the coffee and don't want to recommend it because of my fear that it  will sell out before I get a chance to reorder.I enjoy the bold flavor of  real coffee and the intense aroma that it has. I do not find the bitter after taste that I have found in other dark roasts. I was a little unsure of ordering the Kona because I had thought that the talk about it was just hype, well it is just darn good coffee. It may or may not appeal to you, but give it a try. It is really good.
If you like Kona coffee, I would recommend Tully's.  It's a bold but also milder coffee, so it has a rich flavor but isn't bitter.  Would recommend.

This is maybe more about the ad copy than the coffee.  When it's BOLD iut should say so in big letters.  Very BOLDLY stating this quality.  I was mis-lead by the medium roast into thinking this was a mild coffee and it was a great deal but it's so strong I can hardly drink it.  Of course if you like strong coffee, you'll love it.  I've tried adding a little cinnamon or a little cocoa mix to try and soften the taste but so far have not hit the right combination.  It was an excellent deal money wise but not so much for the drinkability factor
This coffee has a good flavor and a good strength.  At first it seemed strong but then I got use to it.  I recommend this flavor coffee.

Kona is my favorite caffeinated coffee. It has a strength and flavor that I really enjoy. It does not have a bitter taste, it is quite smooth, and it does not leave a bad taste in my mouth.It has a flavor that I look forward to in the morning for my first cup of coffee.

This is one of the tastiest offerings for my Keurig, rivaling the Gevalia products for myTassimo. It gives you a large, fragrant cup of coffee at a better price than my Tassimo products which are great but expensive and harder to find.
Great Product! I don't believe it was bold enough to be called Extra Bold but still strong enough. Will buy again.
This is the best K-Cup coffee that I have tried.  I've sampled quite a few types of K-Cups, but keep coming back to Tully's Kona Blend. Great taste and aroma.  Love it.
Love this coffee, but it has gotten too expensive. The coffee is smooth and full of flavor.  The only problem is that I need to buy it in spurts--when I have extra money.

column9: Tully's coffe Kona Blend 12 ct for Keurig Brewers

column9: Taste is good, but portion is too small
column10: Milka is one of the top chocolatiers in Germany. So I was really excited to find out that they are making T-disc now as well.Unfortunately I must say, that this excitement has been replaced by a kind of sober disappointment.Yes, the taste is good, although a bit too sweet - I still prefer the hot chocolate from Suchard (one of the top Swiss chocolatiers ...).But what really annoys the heck out of me is that you actually need two syrup discs and two milk discs to get the same amount of liquid as with the Suchard discs. I am a big man and need a big mug), or you spend twice the amount of discs to fill the usual mug. Annoying.I will not buy this ever again, the Suchard stuff fits my needs much better.

First and foremost, this is great stuff. In fact, it's one of the best tasting Tassimo products on the market -- rich, creamy...basically everything you could expect from a hot chocolate (and much better than Suchard, which is lousy and tastes synthetic). However, it's just too expensive. Run-of-the-mill powdered products such as Swiss Miss cost one tenth as much, yet are nearly as good. So unless you're a hot chocolate snob, this just isn't worth the exorbitant price premium. Great product, horrible price. Hence the 3 stars.

column9: DO NOT BUY. TASTE IS HORRIBLE
column10: Ok folks, so I didn't listen to the other reviews about how poor this product was and decided to buy it anyways. My girlfriend likes hot cocoa, so I figured, what the hell, give it a try. Boy, the others were right. This stuff tastes foul. It doesn't even have a chocolate flavor at all, especially once you add the milk disc in. Really. This stuff is crap. If you want some, I will send you mine.

Only two hot chocolate brands for the Tassimo and unfortunately neither one is made with real sugar.  Milka has the artificial (Sucralose) and the Suchards has HFCS.  The Milka is pretty bland with very little chocolate flavor, while the Suchards is decent.  Although, I prefer having milk in my hot chocolate, I will stay with Suchards until hopefully something better comes on the market.  I will use the rest of my Milka for Mocha Capuccinos and leave this one for the "Hot Chocolate Snobs".

I received this as a gift and I'm thankful for the thought but really glad I didn't waste my own money on this stuff. It's terrible. Carnation cocoa from a paper package is way better by comparison. I love chocolate and this stuff is watery and flavorless. Don't waste your money.

I generally enjoy all types of hot chocolate - sweet american and deeper european... this was neither. It was watery and undrinkable. I would not recommend purchase and actually threw mine out. Hope this helps!

Whether you prefer the Milka or the Suchard is simply a matter of personal preference.  Personally, I didn't notice that much difference between the two.  And frankly, neither one is outstanding.  With the Milka, I had several problems.  As others have mentioned, it produces a very very small cup.  The first time I ran it through, I thought my machine had malfunctioned because there were only a few mls of chocolate.  I opened up the machine and checked out the pod and discovered that clearly half of the chocolate syrup had been left behind in the pod.  So I ran another batch of water through the same pod.  I then ran the milk pod through.  The hot chocolate is definitely not creamy.  Part of this could be that I'm always running two lots of water through the chocolate pod, but it's a fact of life with these Milka pods.  One of the other issues I have is that these pods often leak.  I'm finding chocolate syrup all over the place.  And the milk pod ALWAYS leaves milk around the pod holder.  I have to wipe the machine down every time.  Since it doesn't do this with any other milk pods I use, it therefore has to be a design flaw with the Milka pods.  I bought one package of Milka pods to try and quite honestly won't bother buying any more.  For the difference in price, the Suchard is just as good.  But my preference would be to going back to making hot chocolate the old way, not with the Tassimo.
Lacks chocolate flavor, tastes watery, and doesn't hold a candle to Tassimo Suchard hot chocolate T-discs. A total waste of money and calories.

I love milka chocolate but this drink is just plain nasty. If I cound give it a negative star rating, I would. If I could spare just 1 more person from wasting their money on this horrible drink, writing this review would be worth it. One more sip, I would have been turned off of hot chocolate for life. I will continue to buy milka chocolate though. Wonder what went wrong with this drink.

column9: Sweet, somewhat thin, but perfectly prepared
column10: The Milka Hot Chocolate is $1.24/serving. My usual approach to Hot Chocolate is to melt a small bar of Valrhona chocolate, mix in some milk, and continue heating while adding sugar to taste (depending on the type of chocolate I've chosen). The richness of the hot chocolate is controlled by the milk:chocolate ratio and the sweetness controlled by the amount of sugar. I find mixes with water to generally be too thin and of poor overall taste (e.g. Swiss Miss, Nestle, etc.)Here, you use your Tassimo Brewer and place two T-Discs in, one at a time, to "brew" hot chocolate - you have a syrup disc and a milk disc. You end up with a delicious appearing hot chocolate which is neither too watery nor too syrupy. The overall texture is somewhat thin compared to my homemade variety but richer than the water-based mixtures such as Swiss Miss. The taste is a solid "good." It's a little on the sweet side - my 6 year old, who prefers bittersweet chocolate, turned up his nose after a taste. I rather liked the taste. The serving size is small. My standard coffee mug ended up about half-full after going through the two-disc process.If you want quick and easy hot chocolate in a serving for one, this produces a superior product to the water-based mixes out there albeit at a significantly higher price point. My homemade approach is in the middle from a cost perspective, requires more cleanup and some greater investment in preparation oversight and time, but results in superior taste.

The product description says 16 count discs, but the package only has 8 servings (one milk disc+one chocolate disc=1 6 ounce serving). Our family found the taste to be mediocre (at best). I agree with those that suggest any decent powdered mix will match its taste (and at a lower price point). Skip it.

column9: Be aware of the actual weight
column10: Pounce Chicken and Turkey Flavors Tartar Control Crunchy Cat Treats is described as 6.4 ounces, but is only 4.5 oz, and it is not a 5-pack.

I bought this product hoping it would help keep my cats teeth clean and their breath fresh. I wish I had read the ingredients before I purchased it because it doesn't seem to have any enzymatic ingredients found in true, working dental treats. It also doesn't have any breath freshening ingredients. I think the only reason why they are "dental" treats is because they are crunchy and not moist treats, which is very good. These are MUCH better than the pounce soft and chewy varieties or any soft and chewy treat that can stick to cat teeth and cause bad breath and tooth decay. Another issue I have with these treats is that my cats only like this product while its very fresh. They seem to go stale really easily, like within a week, and then after that my cats don't care for it. I always close them tightly and I've even tried putting them in a separate bag- in container, but still no luck. If your looking for a real dental treat I would Crunch n' Clean with DentaShield. Greenies brand doesn't have many beneficial dental ingredients either, but they are another pretty good one as they too contain vitamins but with a little bit of added breath freshening ingredients in them, so they are much better than these. YES we will never run out of this again !I cook a lot of shall we say "robust" foods at home - from smoking my own BBQ with chili's flown in from New Mexico (the Dixon Hatch, can't be beat) to making my own gumbo.  One of our favorite dishes is blackened salmon - it's healthy, very flavorful and most importantly the kids love it.  Paul Prudhomme's spices have always been my favorite although I have to admit I was raised on them (as now are my kids) so I'm probably biased.  I've tried other seasonings (even by other 'celebrity chefs') and I have found them to be too flavorless, or waaaaay too salty.  Mr. P's is definitely my favorite, and for decades we've been buying the teeny glass bottles in the grocery store.  I go heavy on the spice, and these jars would only last 2 meals and all too frequently the wife would come home with giant filets of salmon from Costco only to find out we're out of seasoning.  We like salmon, but honestly once you have blackened salmon it's as hard to revert back to plain salmon as it is to go from home-smoked brisket back to burgers.  Recently I've made several purchases on Amazon and have been totally impressed, so when I saw they carried these giant jars, at a great price, I immediately purchased them.  Now we'll never run out - I'm stoked !Here's how I use this:- cast iron on medium heat, or in the smoker with coals in the meatbox.  Medium because in the past I've used high as recommended and had too much trouble controlling the cooking (flipping before burning, etc) and generated way too much smoke.  cooking on medium doesn't produce as much of a crust as on high, but the kids like it.  I could potentially smoke it with the blackened seasoning, but I actually prefer to grill it instead to at least get a little bit of a crust, and just to get it going.  salmon doesn't need the tenderizing of a low and slow, and I actually don't want the hickory in this dish.- i don't dredge the salmon in butter.  this is also part of why I don't get the nice crust I should, but again the kids like it.  I just coat the pan or grilles with Pam, place the fillets on a plate, and smother both sides with the spice.- throw it on the heat, and cook normally.Like I said, this won't get you the great crust.  I do get some caramelizing action, but nowhere near as much as if I dredged the fish in butter first and flash fried them.A couple notes on the spice itself:1. This is NOT a hot spice.  It's a very flavorful spice.  If you want to heat it up you can add your own ground pepper to the mix (may I suggest the Dixon Hatch).  However, if British food livens up your taste buds, you may consider this to be hot.2. Like any spice, this will last much longer in much better shape if you store it carefully.  Most people put their spices right by the stove, where they are subjected to heat and humidity.  I'm guilty of this, but I'm aware that both are destroyers of spice.  If you can, keep this spice away from both heat and humidity and seal the cans well.  I'll probably place them in a large zip lock once I crack one open.3. If you're new to spicy foods in general, or to cajun/creole spices I suggest you try a small bottle first and make sure it's for you.4. If you're on a low sodium diet, check the specifications first as Cajun/Creole spice blends tend to have quite a bit of salt in them although the Chef Paul brand has much less (by flavor at least) than many other brands I've tried.5. Don't forget the Blackened Steak Magic !!6. I haven't actually received this spice yet.  Chef Paul is a large, very established brand and I presume consistent quality across their product line, but everything I'm writing is based on my usage of the teeny glass bottles.  I've been purchasing Chef Paul for 20 years now though and have no reason to believe that there would be any difference between this giant spice-head sized container and the teeny containers.If you're into spicier foods, or venturing for the first time into Blackened Redfish, you honestly can't go wrong with this guy.  Try a tiny bottle and find out - then get this can, stock up, and never run out again.  I'm stoked at the possibility of being able to blacken up fish on demand without ever having to make another last-minute run for the seasoning.  Thank you Chef Paul and Amazon !

column9: Best Natural and Quick Flea Control
column10: An odd spin on this product is that it rapidly de-fleas an infested home (or apartment), with ongoing maintenance of combing pets for fleas, etc. I researched everything out there and found one small lone reference to silica as a solution. I also learned that fleas reproduce in stool (thus, the litter box). An infestation that rapidly progressed in my daughter's family home was finally cleared, in a very short time, with improvement (my infant grandson's bites) noted overnight, after adding this to the cat box (along with regular litter) and sprinkled around the home in corners, where walls met carpet, and any place that could be "damp" and a breeding ground. In the sprinkling, we were generous and left it there. It has to be silica (in this case, gel), though. The round litter product (sand) does not work. The initial recommendation I found mentioned products available through hardware stores that I was unable to locally find and were very expensive and large purchases online. column10: I love finding American small family farmers doing the right thing and finding a market for their small production on this amazing resource called Amazon.  Nice personal note comes with the beans and lentils, thanking me for patronizing their operation.

All of which makes them easier to add to recipes and provide great flavor.Palouse Brand split green peas were also of great quality. They also cook up easily and hold some of their shape and remain a vibrant green color when cooked.  I use these in a "faux" guacamole dip, and, occasionally, as an additive to regular guacamole which cuts the calorie content.  I've also make some healthy and tasty sandwich spreads using these in combination with basil, tofu and avocados.  Great flavor without the fat and chemicals in commercial mayonnaise spreads.Packing was an unsealed plastic bag (which did allow for some loose lentils and green peas) inside a burlap/hopsack cloth outer bag which was firmly stitched closed. The outer bag fully contained any loose products and makes a unique presentation. The bags can be reused.  I haven't found any rocks, or debris in either the lentils, or the the split green peas.  The product was very clean.Finally, with the drive to reduce the chemical processing and additives added to our foods, GMO free products help fit the bill. I live in the Pacific Northwest and Palouse is, figuratively speaking, in my backyard.  It's nice to support a local producer and to know where and how my food is produced and by whom. Unlike the other review that suspects Twinings is the British version of Lipton's, Twinings was founded in London, England in 1706, and has a long and respected tradition of producing only the finest of teas. Earl Grey tea was named after Charles Grey, Second Earl Grey (1764-1845), and is a mixture of black tea and oil of bergamot (a small acidic orange). It is said that Earl Grey learned the recipe of this delicious tea from a Chinese Mandarin and brought it home to England, where it has been a favorite ever since.Now, it is debated that Twinings was the first to blend the tea, during the time of Charles Grey, but even if it is not, it has a long tradition of blending it just the same.  Like anything else in life, you have people that think they're experts on a subject just because they like something a lot, and they're quick with guesswork.  I will only drink Twinings tea, as other companies insult the name of tea, such as Tazo, who have all their teas blessed by a shaman, and Bigalow, who have no idea what they're doing.

column9: Heaven in a cup of tea
column10: I enjoy a good cup of tea and my absolute favorite is Earl Grey. Twinings Early Grey is among the best on the market, alongside Rishi loose leaf. A traditional English tea, Earl Grey is a black tea whose principle flavor is from the rind of bergamot oranges. Although there are various accounts of its origin, it is most likely was an Indian recipe (China is also a commonly attributed with creating the recipe) which made its way to England in the early 1800s. Named after Lord Grey, the tea is a flavorful black tea that is best served nearly boiling hot with or without lemon. It is NOT served with cream.Twinings is one of the oldest conveyors of Earl Grey and still use the same recipe as they have for well over a hundred years (soon to be two-hundred). Their tea is also endorsed by the 6th Earl Grey and his signature appears on their packaging. Not that this means the tea is superior because of any endorsement; in this case the tea speaks for itself.While I do prefer loose leaf teas, these tea bags provide nearly the same flavor profile as the loose variety and will not disappoint the Earl Grey enthusiast. If you've never tried Twinings, you owe it to yourself to do so. Enjoy!
Good old Saccharin, so glad we found you.  Hard to find this product which is so much better than the new sweetners.

I purchased the Eagle Creek ProTech Cube, size medium, to hold a portable air pump I purchased from VIAIR (Model 85P).  The pump only arrived only with its outer packaging/box.  I searched for something to accomodate the pump and came up with the ProTech Cube which encases/holds the pump perfectly.I also like the fact that the case lacks rigidity.  With the zippers and outer casing having some give to them, it allowed me to squeeze the case and enclosed pump into a space next to my spare tire.  I more rigid case would have not allowed for that.The case is tough enough to protect the contents but again, flexible enough to allow it to fit into some tigher spaces.The case is a bit on the pricey side but definitely does its job well.

Very sturdy, nice padding, easy to use. Note - a bit taller than it looks. Mine fits my Lumix pocket digital camera, portable hard drive, small flash drive, Olympus pocket voice recorder, and all my extra connectors, nice and tight. Recommend for regular travellers carrying a lot of gear.

I bought the medium size for the purpose of protecting and carrying my new Bose SoundLink Wireless Mobile Speaker - Nylon..Well, I was not disappointed!! The case space is wide enough for the speaker and the  wire/plug. The medium size measures about 10.5" (L) x 7.5" (W) x 3"(D).  The dividers(2) inside the case are detachable and can be velcroed either on top or bottom or on the sides to add cushion and protection. The handle is a very big plus for portability.  When I unzip the case open and lay it down on top of a table, the space inside is roomy enough to accommodate my upright Soundlink with its speaker cover flipped down, without taking it out of the case, thus keeping the Bose stand/cover clean.  This will definitely protect my new Bose inside my luggage when I travel next time and keep it dust-free when I am not using it.  Bought mine in Bark color from another website for <$20, so, shop around.

This case is perfect for oganizing small to medium sized electronics. The padding inside is thick, and the case is sturdy so it can sit on its own without collapsing. It zips so you know the stuff won't fall out. And there are separators in the case to keep things from flopping around. Overall the perfect case for small to medium sized items that you want to keep protected with padding and a zippered top.

i was totally satisfied with the product.  i too use the oil for the skin as well as for cooking.  it's great at high temperatures, good to drizzle on salads, and yes it is more mild but if you want the stronger flavour  you should try their toasted sesame oil.

I do a lot of stirfry and sesame oil is a very easy way to get a nice taste and smell with very little. Just opening the bottle, I knew it was already a dud. Used it and it was so bland, I wish I would have been a little less lazy and had just found an Asian market nearby to buy some more sesame oil. Won't make the same mistake twice!

I really like all the other Green Sprouts products, but these are a no-go. Both the spoon and fork were broken easily by my 9 month-old baby. The spoon he easily snapped in half and the fork was shattered by him pounding it on the high chair tray. Luckily I was right there because the utensils broken and shattered into small pieces that were very sharp. I think they could be very dangerous if he swallowed a shard or put the broken end in his mouth. I would not recommend these at all. Instead try the Green Sprouts silicone toddler spoon. It is soft and flexible and has not yet broken for me.

I absolutely love this product especially the malted milk and the vanilla variety. 3 stars though for the sugar/chemical content....its a shame that with this premixed variety, it contains over 7 teaspoons of sugar per bottle, not to mention cholesterol and saturated fat! Not only that it is packaged in #7 plastic which contains BPA.  The powder variety contains less sugar plus you can package it yourself in non-bpa containers if you like. As a note, #3, #5, and #7 containers have BPA in them. I doubt that carnation will stop selling their product in nonBPA containers since they are useful to them and also since its not unlawful for them to use this harmful chemical in their packaging. BPA is an endocrine disruptor, and it is linked to obesity among other health problems. At lest recycle your bottle when you are done with it so that it does not sit in a landfill for over 100 years, leaching BPA into the groundwater like so many other companies bottles do.

It has been tradition to make coffee cake with Solo Cherry my whole life.  For some reason it is very hard to find in the grocery stores lately.  I was able to stock up with this 12 pack!  This is the best filling for coffee cake!  Perfect constancy and the cherries are not sour or tart!!!

column4: Doreen B. Bishop "Doreen Bishop cat parent"
column10: I wish I could afford to feed this food to my outdoor cats in our TNR program .But as life goes my one little indoor cat that the raccoons bought me years ago gets the Turkey Tuscany in savory sauce. Kitty sings it's praises because she purrrs when she starts to eat it. While cats were becoming ill on some food last year mine stayed well and healthy using this product. The whole line is excelent :)
A moist and healthy meal that my 9 year old cat really loves.  And, he is increadibly picky :)  I would definitely recommend it.
My cats seem to like this Fancy Feast flavor better than most; it's possibly neck & neck with the Wild Salmon Primavera of the same brand.

I put i my first order for Tender Turkey Tuscany for my cats in 2009. I have two kitties and one was 3 mo and one 9 mo when I first began ordering this for them. The 9 month old was already a wet food eater, but the little 3 month old had lived in a rescue situation most of her life and was only familiar with kibble. The older kitten began to gobble it up immediately. The little female was not so sure what this stuff was. The first night she had it, she had two or three bites and went back to her kibble. But she soon learned that life was better with a mixture and she began to eat the Turkey also. I could have stayed with the less expensive kibble, but I feed wet food because I want the male to get all the fluid in him that he can to avoid urinary tract problems. So I feed wet and dry.This food lasts for a long time. Both of my kitties are "free feeders." Their wet food is put out and left for 24 hours until the next day when two new cans magically appear for them. The kibble is always available. The get to go outside a little while each day while I watch them, and we play with Da Bird and other toys almost daily. So, even if food is out, they stay trim. But the food stays good for longer than 24 hours. They eat all they want and then I leave left over wet and some dry food for the ferals who live around in the back yard. The ferals eat the Turkey after it is 24 hours old and they do not turn up their noses. When they are through, the birds come in and finish the plate.It is now July 2011 and the kitties still eat the Turkey Tuscany. They don't get it every night, but they do get it about once a week. It has remained a mainstay of their diet while other things have come and gone.So I am really pleased with the Turkey Tuscany. My kitties eat abot 7/8 of a can and leave a few bites for the ferals who gobble it down with their dry food. With my kitties, the feral kitties, and then the birds finishing up any stray bite, it certainly never goes to waste. I recommend it highly as it has a long lasting tradition of being well eaten at my house.

column9: Good Ramen, but Can't Beat Original
column10: Although, I understand that the Goreng part of the name means noodles without broth, I'll never stop calling this ramen (meaning noodles with broth). The Indomie products that I've tried (original, satay, and pedas) are all delicious. Make no mistake, not all oriental noodles do it for me. When our local Asian market ran out of Indomie, the owner told me to get a different brand that he promised I'd like better. I ended up throwing it out, because the taste was just awful. Indomie original, has a mellow taste, with enough spice to keep you interested.This Satay version maintains the classic flavor, adding a strong nutty notes along with a crunchy fried onion packet for more texture and flavor. This is by far the most acquired taste of the 3 varieties that I've tried so far. While it's still a good choice to mix things up, I could not eat Satay every night.

Rather messy this time. The packets seemed difficult to use for some reason. Anyway, the real reason I gave 3 stars: The bar was set very high from the previous fried noodle I've eaten. That is including the Mi Goreng regular flavor and the Pedas. Don't get me wrong,this is still a good product. That is, compared to the crummy ramen us Americans buy in supermarkets. If this was the only friednoodle I ordered, then I could have given it 4 stars.
This is my default ramen, one that I always go back to. They come with five seasoning packets which makes me happy.

When I first received this, I was very surprised at how large the wafers are! I had in my mind that they would be very small and fit for one person! After tasting them with the wine, however, I'm very glad that they are not! They are very delicious & complement my glass of merlot perfectly. My mom, boyfriend, and I were all obsessed with these. I bought the mocha chocolate for red, lemon vanilla for white, and raspberry almond for champagne! I loved all three. Although I have not yet tried the raspberry almond with champagne, I've had it with Pinot Grigio, and it was pretty good with that! I definitely recommend these for wine enthusiasts. Very yummy.
I ordered all the different flavors. Loved all of them. Will order again from Amazon.

I am sensitive and allergic to all kind of chemicals and switched to vinegar long, LONG ago.  I can not live without this essence!  I use it diluted in water for general cleaning around the house, floors, sanitizing and eliminating odors in my pups' room, in RINSE cycle while doing the laundry, etc Literally EVERYWHERE where a cleaner/sanitizer is necessary.

column9: Great as mulled cider for holiday tree lighting in work place
column10: We used this at work for our hospital holiday tree lighting and it was a big hit.  It made the large room smell great and surprised everyone that it was something hot and perfect for a holiday touch! This was our first official tree lighting ceremony and this will be a nice addition each year!

Quite tasty; mild chocolate flavor, good crunch, the right sweetness.  Maybe a teeny bit sandy, but that doesn't stop them from being a good snack or dessert.  Probably perfect for someone who doesn't like too rich a chocolate flavor. Also very tasty with peanut butter spread on them.

Eatting allergen free can be a challenge and sometimes boxed items have a gross taste but these outback animals taste pretty good and pretty close to the real ones. These make a quick,easy & tastey snack.

My son absolutely adores these cookies (I prefer the chocolate)!  These are the first tasty gluten-free animal cookie I've found and I love that he can now have the same snack as the kids at day care on animal cookie days!  (In fact, the daycare kids prefer his animal cookies over their own!)

My son has life threatening allergies to milk, eggs, and peanuts. He also cannot eat wheat. These cookies are great for snacks and he really enjoys them. I don't have allergies, and I think these have a bit of a grainy texture, but they aren't bad. Perfect for kids with allergies, especially since they look similar to the teddy or animal snacks kids without allergies eat.

( cos i boght from amazon  one big box..we have  a lot in stock now )and he sick again...no more  tired or trust..be careful...
