column9: I'm Wild for this Wild Raspberry Tea
column10: Stash Premium Wild Raspberry Hibiscus tea makes great-tasting, refreshing iced tea at a fraction of the price, and a fraction of the footprint, of bottled beverages.Portland-based Stash Tea Company says that this tea is 100% natural.  The ingredients are hibiscus flowers, orange peel, lemongrass, rosehips, raspberry flavor, licorice powder and citric acid.  For some reason, the ingredients also list soy.The taste is crisp and refreshing, even iced and without any sweetener.  A small amount of sugar, stevia (such as Stevita Supreme - 50pkts - 1.8 oz / Packet) or other sweetener is all you need to satisfy a sweet craving.To make great iced tea, bring water (filtered according to your preferences) to a boil, then let cool until bubbles are no longer forming.  Slowly pour the water into a heat-tolerant pitcher (I recommend Luminarc Quadro 2-Liter Glass Pitcher with Lid -- get two, one for the fridge and one for the next batch!) and steep 4 teabags for 3 to 5 minutes, then let cool and place in the refrigerator.One box of 20 bags will make 10 liters of iced tea -- that's a huge savings compared to bottled beverages, which are about 10 times the cost.  The bags and the box can go in the compost, making this option superior to bottled beverages (really just another form of bottled water).  Bottled beverages also require much more fossil fuel use to transport from the bottler to the store.I do wish that Stash would market a licorice-free version.  A recent study showed that 1 daily serving of hibiscus tea can lower systolic blood pressure (the top number) by 7 mm of mercury.  This may be helpful for those with hypertension.  Licorice, on the other hand, is a potent raiser of blood pressure.With your Amazon Prime membership, and Amazon's convenient subscription plan, Stash Premium Wild Raspberry Hibiscus tea can be shipped at customizable intervals to you for further savings.

column9: "Yogurt" raisins? No,  trans fat sunblock raisins!!
column10: Ingredient list on the package (which as we know goes from most to least): California raisins, yogurt coating (sugar,partially hydrogenated palm kernel oil, nonfat milk powder, nonfat yogurt powder, whey, titanium dioxide, soy lecithin, vanilla), confectioners glaze, corn syrup, dextrin and maltodextrin.This "yogurt coating" is basically sugar and partially hydrogenated oil, in other words TRANS FAT, which has undeniable harmful effects on your health. Palm oil is saturated fat, anyways. All the yogurt it conatins is a tiny bit of yogurt POWDER. And it has titanium dioxide, which is also an effective sun block that you wingredientLook at all that sugar named in different ways: sugar, confectioners glaze and corn syrup. As for the titanium dioxide, from Wikipedia:Pigment"...When deposited as a thin film, its refractive index and colour make it an excellent reflective optical coating for dielectric mirrors and some gemstones like "mystic fire topaz". TiO2 is also an effective opacifier in powder form, where it is employed as a pigment to provide whiteness and opacity to products such as paints, coatings, plastics, papers, inks, foods, medicines (i.e. pills and tablets) as well as most toothpastes. In paint, it is often referred to offhandedly as "the perfect white", "the whitest white", or other similar terms. Opacity is improved by optimal sizing of the titanium dioxide particles.In ceramic glazes titanium dioxide acts as an opacifier and seeds crystal formation.Titanium dioxide is often used to whiten skimmed milk; this has been shown statistically to increase skimmed milk's palatability.[23]Titanium dioxide is used to mark the white lines on the tennis courts of the All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club, best known as the venue for the annual grand slam tennis tournament The Championships, Wimbledon.[24]The exterior of the Saturn V rocket was painted with titanium dioxide; this later allowed astronomers to determine that J002E3 was the S-IVB stage from Apollo 12 and not an asteroid.Sunscreen and UV absorberIn cosmetic and skin care products, titanium dioxide is used as a pigment, sunscreen and a thickener. It is also used as a tattoo pigment and in styptic pencils. Titanium dioxide is produced in varying particle sizes, oil and water dispersible, and with varying coatings for the cosmetic industry. This pigment is used extensively in plastics and other applications for its UV resistant properties where it acts as a UV absorber, efficiently transforming destructive UV light energy into heat.Titanium dioxide is found in almost every sunscreen with a physical blocker because of its high refractive index, its strong UV light absorbing capabilities and its resistance to discolouration under ultraviolet light. This advantage enhances its stability and ability to protect the skin from ultraviolet light. Sunscreens designed for infants or people with sensitive skin are often based on titanium dioxide and/or zinc oxide, as these mineral UV blockers are believed to cause less skin irritation than other UV absorbing chemicals. The titanium dioxide particles used in sunscreens have to be coated with silica or alumina, because titanium dioxide creates radicals in the photocatalytic reaction. These radicals are carcinogenic, and could damage the skin.

Several years ago, I went on a tour of the Celestial Seasonings tea factory in Boulder, Colorado. The guide showed us the bales of tea as they arrived, machines that ground and mixed the tea, and a machine that put the tea in tea bags. The tour included a visit to the room where the peppermint tea was stored. Our guide told us that peppermint was stored separately so that it would not contaminate the other teas. He did not tell us what was to come.The doorway into the peppermint room was surrounded by bright red stripes. This should have served as a warning to us. We all innocently strolled into the peppermint room. The smell of peppermint was overpowering. It entered my nose, my head, my lungs, and then my whole being was infused with peppermint. What a rush! The crowd stampeded out of the room in a hurry. For the rest of the day and into the next, all I could smell and taste was the mint.I am now addicted to Celestial Seasonings Peppermint Tea. Every time I have some, I am reminded of that fateful day in Boulder. The events of that day have changed my life forever. Amazingly, the tea is still legal, openly sold in stores and on the Internet. I think that the tea is great, but then again I am not an unbiased observer. On your next visit to Boulder, take the tour. Or go a safer route; buy the tea from Amazon.

column9: Convenient, but middle of the road

So it works.The coffee cake itself after baking comes out pale and fluffy (view my photos). I like a dense coffee cake, so that was a minus. The topping itself didn't really come out crunchy, which is a must for me (ie coffee cake from Boston Coffee Cake, Fantasicakes, or even Entenmann's). It was exactly like if you mixed oil, sugar, and cinnamon and placed it raw on the cake. Keep in mind, I do bake on the regular, have a thermometer in the oven, and use a timer.Will I buy this brand coffee cake again? If i was in a situation where i wanted to bake a coffee cake without a baking pan or bowl, sure. It's convenient that way. Is this a great coffee cake? I don't think so. It's just ok imo. What would I do different if i was forced to make it again? Maybe 1/2 the milk it called for, maybe add some melted butter to give it richness, maybe add some cinnamon or vanilla to the cake batter. I'm making strides at removing High Fructose Corn Syrup (HFCS) from my diet by reading labels and bypassing the offenders while searching for juice from fruit grown in USA. Although this is from USA fruit, I knew cranberries ARE NOT grown in FLORIDA. I expected some of the description to be somewhat misleading when I made the purchase. This product IS NOT as advertised! HFCS is the second ingredient on the label behind WATER. There is only 10% cranberry juice :( Having called Amazon Customer Service, I did receive a refund.THIS PRODUCT probably needs to be labelled "Cranberry DRINK". FYI: This product contains Citric acid and Ascorbic acid, CHEMICAL additive versions of Vitamin C. So if you were looking to get your Vitamin C just from the actual natural fruit juice this is not the product for that!I notice COCKTAIL is now added to the description. A famous brand has 15% juices in their "cocktail", and not necessarily ALL 15% being the cranberry or blueberry juice, YOU THINK the cocktail is. It usually is a combo of juices and they're listed on the label. So please read labels carefully.

Now this may be a seller issue rather than a product issue but none the less the juice I got was not what the ad described at all. The ad states "Not-from-concentrate juices have that right-from-the-grove, fresh-squeezed taste. And, just like fresh-squeezed juice, there's no water, sugar, or preservatives added, only 100 percent pure premium pasteurized juice"In reality the plastic bottles (not cans like the ad says) say 10% juice from concentrate. The first ingredient is water. Second is high fructose corn syrup. Third ingredient is cranberry juice concentrate.

When I searched for this product, I was specifically looking for the watermelon Laffy Taffy with the seeds. When I viewed this product it showed the packaging WITH seeds. However, when I received the product, it did not look anything like the picture and did not have the seeds. If I wanted this Laffy Taffy I would've just bought it at the store.

I love taffy; it's my favorite candy. Next to homemade taffy, Wonka has the best. There's a bit of a history lesson about this kind of taffy, though. It was originally known as Tangy Taffy, and I assume that Wonka bought it it out. Because of this, there are now two separate kinds, but they both go by the exact same name. The major difference between this brand and the more common version is that this brand of taffy is in a thin bar shape form; it's about the length of candy bar, and about double or triple the thickness of an Airhead. The other more common version is usually in small, bite-sized, individually sealed packages. Originally, this brand, also formerly known as Tangy Taffy, came in three flavors including: Grape, Cherry (with candy sprinkles), and watermelon (with edible candy seeds). I believe the Tangy Taffy version has expanded to include a few more flavors, but I couldn't tell you what they are. The more common version comes in many flavors such as but not limited to: banana, strawberry, raspberry, sour apple, and grape. Personally, I prefer the Tangy Taffy version because the taste is vastly superior, but that isn't to say the more common version isn't good. In conclusion, it's great taffy, and unless you go to a specialty candy shop where the taffy is made fresh daily, you really can't beat it.

Overall I'm happy to have these nostalgic cherry taffy bars that I haven't seen for years, but for $20 it's a steep investment for a bunch of extra taffy that doesn't do much for me.  Oh well.

column9: not what i was hoping to get
column10: I purchased these bc the picture showed the taffy with the monster face emblem on the front. everyone says theres no difference but there is! what I recieved is the plain new packaging. i was sad. im sure they will taste fine but i hope the watermelon has those black seeds on it like the ones with the monsters!

I used to be able to find Tangy Taffy just about anywhere candy bars are sold.  It slowly disappeared, and all I could find was the Laffy Taffy in the little individual chews.  They are "ok" but nothing close to the "tangyness" of Tangy Taffy.  One day I decided to look for it on the internet and Wha La, based on the reviews, I was able to determine this is Tangy Taffy packaged as Laffy Taffy.  I have even found it now occasionally in a few stores, but a box like this is the way to go.  I felt ridiculous ordering it, but it sure hits the spot when you want something tangy and chewy for a treat. These are big bars, nearly a $1 in the store for one.  I recommend eating half at a time to satisfy one's craving due to the fact they are full of useless calories! One taffy that is kind of similar, that I have only found in assortment bags with other SweetTarts (sp?) is the SweetTart taffy.  It is delicious but unavailable most of the time, and always in a mixed bag.  They are in bar shape too but much smaller.  Enjoy this product in moderation!

First, as others have noted, the picture doesn't quite match the product.  As of 10/24/12, what you will get is a mix of cherry, watermelon, and grape taffy.  They also do not have those disgusting watermelon seeds or sugar crystals (EDIT: Apparently I hadn't eaten a cherry one yet, they DO have the sugar crystals, in my book that's one star off) that some of the Laffy Taffy has.  For some this is a disappointment, but for me, it's exactly what I wanted.  My only complaint with the product is again, as others have mentioned, this Laffy Taffy has been in a hot environment and melted into irregular shapes, not the nice flat "bars" that they normally are.  What this means is that little drops of the melted taffy have made it into the corners of the packaging, then when they cool down, they turn into crumbs that make a mess when you open it.

This package that is sold on amazon for $20 is $5 less in the big box stores if yours have one. Another thing to think about is taffy get very soft with heat and these things are transported in a non-airconditioned UPS truck. Mine were all smushed and melted into different shapes and no longer resembled the starting product. Still tasted fine just hard to open the package.

This product is perfect for Laffy Taffy lovers! The flavors are great and it is absolutely wonderful to be able to buy them in bull like this. This is something that I order a couple of times a year for the candy fiends in my life and, I quite enjoy them myself every once in a while. So glad this is available to order!
One of the best candies ever made. If you like the little Laffy Taffy's, you will love these!

Listen to me!  I've got nothing to gain by writing this, but I need to tell you to give this chocolate milk powder a try.  I lived in Spain for a year and had been craving this for 5 years until I stumbled upon it here at Amazon.  This stuff is amazing.  It's very rich and real cocoa.  Almost tastes like you melted a chocolate bar in hot milk.  Great cold, but hot is where it really shines.  Give it a try, you won't regret it. Just think how cool you'll sound when you have friends over who try it and say, "Man, what kind of hot chocolate is that?  Where'd you get it?"That's when you look them straight in the face and say, "oh, that stuff, just a little something I picked up in Madrid last week."You 1, Friends 0

column9: The product is good, the price is NOT
column10: I am from Spain. The product is the best, but the price is outrageous, and the shipping and handling fee a robbery. This thing sales in Spain for half the price.Buy without a doubt if you have it available in your local store, but I won't recommend you to pay $11 for cocoa and almost $9 for shipping fees.

I have been craving this since I returned from Spain 4 years ago. It is truely amazing...much better than any chocolate drink mix you can buy here in the States! I highly recommend it above any other gourmet hot chocolate or cold chocolate drink mix!

This chocolate mix is absolutely delicious!!  I have lived in Spain twice and drank it every morning for breakfast!  I only wish that I was smart enough to buy it before I came home.  Alas, now I cannot find it anywhere in the United States...if it becomes available on amazon.com, you should buy it immediately!  Its perfectly creamy and chocolatey :)

I fell in love with Cola Cao while pregnant in Spain. Over the last 12 years I've managed to keep a container in my pantry at all times. My container is running low, however, and I have no trips planned and no friends headed to Spain. Having it delivered to my door would be almost too easy. (but I'll take it)
I usually order the regular or original spice blend.  I actually ordered this cider one by mistake--but it is very good as well.

It tastes like liquid cotton candy, delicious... I love the little words inside the lids :)I love Jones, it's something outside the 'mainstream' and almost every flavor is wonderful. Definitely love the crisp flavors and the classic glass bottles. You can't beat it!
This is definitely the most delicious cream soda available. It tastes like... liquid vanilla cake! The bottles are gorgeous too and really good quality. Nothing to complain about at all!

Jones is known for it's quirkly flavors. So it's a little surprising to see them come up with cream soda, which is a pretty regular flavor. It's not bad, the only thing is that Jones comes up with their own take of cream soda. To me it tasted a little metallic, certainly it's not your regular cream soda taste. So if it's your run of the mill cream soda flavor you're after, this isn't it. If you're a fan of Jones and want their take on their cream soda flavor, then it's definitely for you.

column9: Ordered Amazon 4/3/11 $64.44 Never received. Charged Visa 4/6/11
column10: 24 bottles Jones Cream Soda ordered from Amazon 4/3/11 charged to my Visa 4/6/11 $64.44 Amazon via Red Tag Sales. Product never received.  stanmignyc@yahoo.com

column9: Who knew ChickPz would make for a healthy and tast snack?  They are great!!!
column10: I was sent the follow ChickPz flavors to samples:  Chai Vanilla, Honey Roasted, Dark Chocolate and Pepper and Spice. Out of the 4 flavors, I have to say my favorite was the Dark Chocolate.  Again, I am a sucker for chocolate, so usually lean towards products with chocolate as favorites.  A close second was the Chai Vanilla.  At first I was hesitant on eating these "healthy" snacks, as I had never thought of ChickPz as a snack.  And, throwing flavored ChickPz into the mix only made me question sampling them even more.  But, needing to provide my readers will an honest review, I tried each and every flavor.  After the first bite, I couldn't believe how tasty these ChickPz snacks were.  Like the company website says, you can't just eat one.  I ended up finishing off 2 sample packs in one sitting, and then that night ate the two other bags with my husband.  He, too, thought they wer addicting, and get reaching into the bag to get more.  His favorite was the Pepper and Spice, as it had a little kick to it, with Chai Vanilla being his 2nd favorite.My favorite part of this snack was the crunch factor. As for the flavor profile, you could really taste each flavor.  These two combined made for great snacking.  And, because they tasted so good, you wouldn't have thought that they were actually good for you.I have since ordered more of these snacks from Amazon.com, as my husband loves grabbing a bag or two to snack on at work and during his commutes.  And, if we are heading out for a weekend drive, we will throw a few bags in the diaper bag in case we get hungry on the road.  This prevents us from stopping at a convenience store to pick up unhealthy snacks just to feed our hunger pains.With the holidays around the corner, why not pick up a few bags to serve as appetizers/snacks at your planned holiday parties, or to have on hand for those unexpected guests.  They also make for great stocking stuffer gifts!

These chickpeas are perfectly roasted. My favorite flavor is Tuscan Garlic & Herb. And my wife liked Sesame crunch the most. They also have chocolate flavor chickpeas (not in this sampler) and they are awesome. The best part is that all the tasty treats are healthy and we don't feel guilty after munching all the packs! They are an excellent healthy alternative to potato chips.

Great snack when your trying to eat healthy but still need to have something salty and tasty. It is a bit pricey but still worth the money.  I would recommend the Sweet and Spicy Chipotle as it is very flavorful and satisfies the craving for sweet and also salty.

I thought all of the flavors were really good.  As a weight watcher most of them were only 2 points for 1/4 of a cup.  It doesn't seem like a lot, but they were very filling and it was something different to have as a snack.

These ChickPz are amazing.  Other brands of chickpeas tend to be dry but these are awesome! I can't say which flavor we liked best because all the flavors were great.  You can't go wrong with this product.  These ChickPz are also very versatile, add them to salad to ice cream to any meal and they add tons of flavor and crunch and protein.  We added the Tuscan Garlic & Herb to rice and it was fantastic.  Then we tried the Chai Vanilla on yogurt ice cream and it was delicious!

These are amazing! They are a wonderful healthy snack that the whole family will enjoy. My 2 year old  loved the honey roasted! We just made a huge salad last night and add the tuscan garlic and herb to it and the whole family raved about it.
The sampler pack is a great way to taste all the options!  The sesame has a nice, complex flavor.

I have always bought Florida's Natural 100% Orange Juice as it has no imported juice and is made only in Florida. The product description states it is NOT from concentrate and only pasteurized as the ones in the grocery store are. It states this TWICE, once in the product description and again in the manufacturers description. I get my two cases and on each and every bottle it states "MADE FROM CONCENTRATE!".  Why bother to state TWICE on the product page it is not made from concentrate? Now I have learned if it is not from concentrate then it has to be refrigerated.Come on Amazon, get it together and save yourselves all the problems from these mis advertising issue and tell it like it is---dang!
I saw this product on the Dr. Oz Show. The audience member that tasted the crispbread said that it was good. I found it dry with no taste. It was a waste of money.

i really tried!  i tried so hard to eat these things for the health beneifts.  but they are really disgusting.  i tried them with cream cheese, smoked salmon and capers as a snack and i still couldn't enjoy the crackers.  i really dont recommend them.

column9: DUCT TAPE, WD-40 AND GG CRISPBREAD!!!!
column10: My husband always said that the two greatest inventions were duct tape, and WD-40, and many people share this view. Now add to this gg crispbread!!! Some people say they make great sandwiches with peanut butter, tuna salad, or cheese, I even heard they make good pizzas, so I tried these. I didn't like any of them, but not wanting to waste my money, I decided to try some other ways of enjoying these. They really are wonderful after all!!! Throw them on the pond and they make wonderful little rafts for the frogs to sunbathe on, even baby turtles will enjoy a nice sun bath on them!  Why not use them to repair holes in the barn where the grand children decided to try out the old brace and bit and drilled holes? I know mice chew through wood, but believe me it is going to take them awhile to chew through these! Cigarette burn on your coffee table? Just sand it down with with these rough little squares, {Just finish with a fine sandpaper to smooth out the roughness) and re-stain. Glue a few packs of these together and you have a great bulletin board, and if you don't have enough muscle to push the pins into it, just lay it outside the front door to scrape mud off your boots. I like to keep a stack of these on my night stand in case a burglar breaks in. Fling a few of these at him and if they don't do serious injury, they will at the least hurt enough to send them flying for safety. I am thinking of putting in a new patio, mm, I wonder!!!

column9: Perfect 'free' food to stop carb cravings!
column10: I use these for several reasons.  They are great if your 'throughput' is a little sluggish, they will help you up your water intake (because they are VERY dry), and they stop carb cravings because they fill your stomach.  I spread a little sugar free jelly or Walden Farms sugar free chocolate sauce on them to help ease the dryness.  Don't get me wrong, you need to like the taste of bran.  They are sort of like all-bran got stomped by an elephant and made into a wafer.  I eat them to stop my pacing the kitchen late at night or to cure the same thing around 3:30 in the afternoon, which allows me to stay on my eating program.

I have been a fan of GG Scandinavian Bran Crispbread for years.  Most people get too little fiber.  Fiber is essential for flushing toxins and other junk out of your system.  Fiber helps lower cholesterol and reduces the impact of high glycemic index foods.  While some people choose to take supplements like psyllium, I prefer actually eating food...or the next closest thing.The crispbreads have a somewhat cardboard taste, but mainly tasted like toasted grains, with maybe a hint of cinnamon (but i'm probably imaginging that).  They are not sweet or salty or anything else appetizing.  However, they work great as a vehicle for just about anything. My wife and I enjoy making little peanut butter and jelly sandwiches with them for a filling snack.  If I just want to get some extra fiber, I'll eat a crisp or two with some cheese or honey.  So the flavor is not an issue at all if you put something yummy on top.  What is an issue is how incredibly dry these things are.  make sure you have something to drink with these; that should go withotu saying though, when you are eating something that's mostly fiber.Overall, I recommend these to anyone looking to get a little more fiber, which should include a ton of people.  I got into them because I was drinking protein shakes after working out and thought i should increase my fiber on balance.  Fiber really does have a noticeable benefit to your health and well-being, so definitely give these a try!

I have been on low carb for years and have never really found a replacement cracker. The fakes are too eggy..or taste terrible. I love these. Now granted they really need something on top. But so what. Most crackers do. They are great with a slice of cheese..I have made them into little pizza's..wonderful. Will definitely buy again

Got it in less than a day. Product itself was good -- not broken up at all even though they are crackers and getting packaged around everywhere. Really fills you up and gets your daily dose of fiber! Good mixed with cereal and milk, or with some jam.REMEMBER TO DRINK LOTS OF WATER, or else you'll get the opposite of the intended effect....

column9: Great source of fiber and GREAT with a little apple butter
column10: Not knowing you were only supposed to eat 1/2 bar, when I got my order I ate a whole one.  It was like eating sawdust but WHOOSH!  It really cleans you out & I didn't even have to wait until the next day for it to work.The next day, after reading you're only supposed to eat 1/2 a bar, I ate mine with a little apple butter & my coffee.  It's GREAT like that - tasty, moist and a little nutty.The ones here a too pricey for me, though.  One can buy direct for a much better price.

I tried.. I really tried... I honestly tried...but I couldn't eat these things.  I will stick to the kind i purchase locally int he grocery store as they are crisp (really crisp) and not bad on taste with 19% fiber.Even though these Scandinavian brand was recommended by Dr. Os and lots of others I just can't handle them. Tsate is not good in my opinion, texture is horrible, and Sahara Desert sand would be more moist.  I bought a large quantity of these things so regret doing that.  I though thet would be like my regular Crispbread.  I might be good for others but not for me.

This cracker curbs appetite like no other. I have it in the morning with some low fat cheese on it, in the afternoon with some peanut butter and jelly on it and then in the evening with some cream cheese and salmon on it. I make sure to drink plenty of water too as it expands in your stomach and gives you the full feeling. It truly is a great product and it's quite a deal being sold on Amazon - especially with the free shipping! I'm looking forward to their new product which they are going to release soon called Sprinkles. It's the crushed up version which you can have on salads, yogurts, and ice cream. It's much better than granola, especially if you are trying to lose weight.

I got these to supplement my daily fiber as my favorite powder drink mix seems to be discontinued. they are recommended by Dr. OZ so I bought these. You get a good amount in each package. The serving is 2 crackers a day so they'll last a few days. You MUST put something on it like jelly or butter or something cause if you eat them plain you'll choke! They are incredibly dry (probably cause they are mostly fiber). They don't have much of a taste, kinda like a cross between melba toast and a triscuit. Not bad for what they are, but for me its all about the fiber...lol

column9: Okay - they're awful....but they serve a purpose
column10: Do they taste and feel like you're eating a piece of MDF?  Yes.  I admit it, they taste awful and have a horrible texture.  That aside, I like them.  It's not about enjoying the crispbread, it's about using it as a vehicle to deliver something I DO enjoy for very few calories, and that fills me up.  To me, they're too dry to eat with peanut butter, as some suggest...I feel like I'm going to choke and can't swallow.  But I like to put tuna (mixed with light mayo and mustard) on them instead of bread. I had been eating my tuna sandwiches on thin buns - which are 100 calories per bun.  By substituting 2 of these, and having my "sandwich" open faced, I save 76 calories, and am left much fuller.  Same goes for breakfast...instead of a piece of toast (100 or so calories) with jam, 2 of these with jam saves another 76 or so calories.  They fill you up and save you some calories, but do NOT try to eat them on their own - you'll wonder how anyone can say they "like" them.  Add a topping that you like...tuna, jam, Laughing Cow light cheese wedges (the French Onion is great), etc.  You'll take in fewer calories than you would with bread or crackers, and feel fuller afterwards - meaning you'll probably reach for even fewer calories elsewhere.  I've even dunked them in salsa when I was craving chips and salsa, and it satisfied the craving.  Just think of them as a vehicle for eating something you DO like, and don't judge them on their own.  I will continue to purchase these and substitute them for bread, crackers, chips, etc. whenever I can.

This is definitely a health-nut's choice for getting in extra fiber. As a stand alone snack, they are okay. Add a thin layer of natural peanut butter with dried blueberries ... yum!  Be sure to drink plenty of water as adding in fiber to your diet requires this :)

I have found if you smear your crispbread with a little spicy mustard, or flavored mayo, salsa - or any favorite spread - even a thick low carb salad dressing - and let them sit for about 5 min before you prepare your sandwich with meat or cheese or tuna salad, etc - the dryness is reduced by about 75% - and the cracker itself takes on the flavor of the spread you used, as well as picking up a lot of moisture. Doing this makes these crispbreads really edible and on par with regular moist crackers.  Until I started doing this pre-spread thing, I thought I would never be able to eat these on a regular basis, and now I actually look forward to eating them and keeping my carbs low.  try it!!

I have been eating these crackers in place of chips for the past 8 months or so.  They taste pretty dry by themselves, but I usually eat them with a wedge of Laughing Cow lite cheese - 2 of these crackers with one wedge of cheese is a very filling snack for only 50 calories.  I have also had them with hummus, a slice of light swiss cheese or piled my eggs on them in place of toast.The best part about these crackers is that they are filling.  I am trying to lose weight and constantly fight hunger - these are excellent healthy snack that keeps you filled up for quite a while.A great snack if you're trying to lose weight.

column9: A Great Option for a Low Carb Snack
column10: You're likely here because you're considering this as a healthy snacking alternative as part of your low-carb, or otherwise low calorie/low-fat diet.  So I won't waste time mentioning the health benefits of the crackers.. they obviously meet the "specs" for the answer to low-glycemic cracker snacking. (if you were looking for taste, and not health, you'd be checking out the chicken in a biskit or something, right?)Ok, the Taste: I'd recommend adding something, like cheese or low sugar jelly, etc.. I personally add avocado most of the time.  The first time I tried one, right out of the package, I couldn't nail down what this reminded me of, though I knew it tasted familiar.Then I realized what this was:I used to eat All-Bran, during that time when I was a cereal-eater a while ago.So These crackers are basically like you got to the bottom of your bowl of All-Bran and the milk is gone, and you're eating the small amount of dry All-bran that never got touched by the milk.  So it's really not that bad a taste, is what I'm saying. They're 1.) healthy, 2.) cheap, and best of all, 3.) they help you stay committed to your low-carb efforts( but please don't provide this at a party, on a snack tray -- if you do, you're braver than I am )

Eating these crackers by themselves is not pleasant, but eating them with low-carb spreads or dips makes them extremely palatable, & with only 2g net carbs per slice, they are a godsend to those of us who can't forego snacks altogether, even when dieting. For those who are trying to lose weight by counting calories, it would be better if these could be flavored with some herbs & spices to make them more appetizing. But for those of us doing the low-carb thing, these are terrific!

Yes, on their own they are a little cardboardy, but with a little lite cream cheese or peanut butter or other creative toppings they are great. I love the way they fill me up and fill the "NEED" for a carb attack. At first I thought they were awful, but then I started craving them and even thinking of them at night and what I could put on them.  Now I don't really even need to have any topping, but I always have to have some with me as they are my addiction.  I have to thank my boss for turning me on to these and now I'm hooked.

I absolutely love these crackers!  I am following the F-factor diet, and they were recommended in this plan.  Amazon is the only place I can find to purchase them, so thanks Amazon for stocking these delicious, fiber-filled, tasty crackers!
Not only is this a great sorce of fiber, it's a great weight loss tool.

column9: Type 2 Diabetic - Helps Keep My Blood Glucose Stable
column10: I have type 2 diabetes and I eat one of these with a wedge of light Laughing Cow cheese about a half hour before dinner and the fiber helps fill me up and keeps my blood glucose from spiking after I eat dinner.I agree with one other reviewer that these can be tough on your digestive tract BUT ONLY at first. If your body isn't used to so much fiber at once it will "rebel" a bit but after eating one a day for about a week, all unpleasantness passed for me and they really do fill me up and help me eat less at dinner.Fiber helps keep my blood glucose stable without all the spikes that can stimulate appetite as well as cause my blood glucose to be above normal limits. Fiber acts like "brakes" to carbs and sugar.I always keep these in my pantry. They aren't the most tasty cracker I've ever had but they are palatable with the Laughing Cow cheese and it's an easy, quick way to add more fiber to your diet even if you aren't a diabetic.

Ok, so they may be good for a low-carb diet, but you have to choke them down first! Please do not order a lot of them like I did before you try them. I wasted a lot of money, could not even choke one of them down! They are dry and tasteless, kind of like eating cardboard!

Now, I must state my opinion as a woman whose weight has gone up and down over the past 15 years. Unfortunately I am on the upper end again. I know there are no magic pills, weight-loss suits are a scam, and the only way to lose weight is to cut calories drastically and get off the couch by walking/running and doing some weight training.My problem is my appetite. Cutting calories and "bad" foods sounds easy but if your stomach is screaming it's NOT easy. I read about these crackers in a book, that those anorexic looking models eat these to stave off hunger. OK, I gave them a try.They work for me. If I have a couple if I feel hunger coming on, with a bottle of water, it really does take that hunger away. Give it about 30 minutes. I could have skipped dinner last night from a few of these crackers in the afternoon.The taste isn't awful, just bland. They are SUPER dry so have some water or coffee/tea at least with them.Something about these things satisfies me and makes me less hungry. That's how I'll lose some of this weight, by not stuffing myself.I'll be back here for more when I'm running out!

column9: If you want to eat healthy
column10: These crackers are the greatest to stop your craving for carb.  They do taste bland by themselves since the majority of the ingredient is wheat bran.  I usually eat it with my favorite spread which is  the artichoke parmesan dip.  Most importantly they are healthy and you can satisfy your hunger without eating too much with these.

column9: Pretty much what I expected - dry as dust but good for you
column10: After reading many of the reviews and hearing about these on Dr. Oz, I decided to give them a try. They are pretty much what I expected. Others have compared these to WASA crispbread, but at least WASA puts a little salt, rye, oat bran or some other ingredient to make them more palatable. I know these are good for me, but when I'm looking for a snack I seem to bypass these more than not. Maybe GG company could add something to make these a bit more tasty.

I received my package promptly and without damage. I love these crackers/crisp bread. I call it fiber bread. It is great with cream cheese and lox as an alternative to bagels. Taste is good and the crunchiness is nice. I would eat them even if I wasn't a diabetic. Definitely 5 stars.

column9: These do NOT taste good, but they do fill you up.
column10: These are not a tasty little snack to help you stay on your diet.  They taste terrible.  The first time I tried one, I couldn't believe that they were actually identified as food.  As a friend of mine said, "these don't even taste like they are supposed to be edible."  I was motivated to lose weight, so I ate them with peanut butter or almond butter.  After a couple of weeks of losing weight, I could eat them straight with a large glass of water.  Don't get me wrong, I still do not think that they taste good, but they are edible, with some effort and patience.  More importantly, they really work.  I've lost 30 pounds and have 15 left to go, so I'll be buying one more case or so.

If you need more fiber in your diet I recommend these. They are NOT good by themselves and are quite dry. With that being said I follow a fairly strict (no fun/boring) diet and find these help me with fiber and to satisfy my need for crunch. This will likely sound gross to many but my favorite way to eat them is drizzled with sugar free pancake syrup, a little cinnamon and topped with a big pile of cottage cheese - LOVE this! I also spread peanut butter on top or  a laughing cow blue cheese triangle. For 12 calories and 2 net carbs these are a great base for a low cal snack.

Break them up and add them to your cereal.  Or break them up and add a bit of milk or dried blueberries, nuke them in the microwave and enjoy "hot" cereal.I break them into little pieces, add some milk, and sometimes some fruit and microwave for two minutes.  For festive occasions add a tiny ort of butter!As others have mentioned, you can add toppings.  Just chewing one of these is an exercise.  But it's not a bad one.Getting older is sometimes about making prudent decisions about what to put in your body.  You won't find these at a gourmet restaurant, but they are excellent in your arsenal of low-carb, low-fat, fibery, filling foods.

I bought a pack of these crackers at Whole Foods Market.  The cracker tastes awful by itself.  I honestly could not have ate a whole one dry.  I covered the remaining part of the cracker with a thin layer of peanut butter and it became tolerable.I agree with the other posters that you need to drink water with these crackers after every bite because they're dry.  As advertised, they do help tame the appetite, so that's a plus. However, I'm not sure if it's the cracker alone, if it's the cracker in combination with all the water or if the terrible taste tricks the body out of hunger.Because I already have a package, I'll continue to eat the remaining crackers with peanut butter as long as they haven't passed their expiration date.  But at this point, I don't think I'll buy another package (but stranger things could happen).

4 words: GG crisps, peanut butter, no sugar smuckers jam (has splenda) and real butter. De....friggin...licious. I just bought these little slices of heaven from netrition and tried them out using the previously mentioned ingredients (and in that order too) about 3 minutes ago. Thrilled. I'm just thrilled. I bought them at netrition, but with the shipping costs, it's actually cheaper to buy them here, if you get the free shipping. Let's get one thing straight. I would never eat these things if I was not on a low carb diet. They were not meant to shoot your dopamine levels through the roof while eating them, if you know what I mean. But if you've got problems "going", or if you're on a low carb diet and need a pretty decent alternative to the cracker, or if you just like throwing packages of health foods in people's faces and telling them how much healthier you are then them, these are the crackers for you. I just plan on using them for LC diet purposes. You won't be disappointed.

Okay, so everyone knows the crispbreads aren't the most flavorful thing in the world, but so what? They are offering you a huge percentage of your necessary daily fiber intake. They honestly aren't bad topped with peanut butter (I use Jif natural) or cream cheese. For a low carb PB&J, try with the peanut butter and a sliced strawberry on top, it's awesome! I think spreads are the best, but you can top it with anything. My mom breaks it up and uses it as cereal. Be creative!
good amount of fiber for only a few calories!  Put peanut butter or cheese on them.  Make sure to drink a large glass of water with it to work with the fiber.

...because it tastes like I raked up my leaves, wet them, pressed them flat, allowed a bit of funk to start growing on them, and let them dry for a year.I eat a lot of healthy food and a lot of low carb and high fiber products and these are the first thing I just couldn't eat.  I didn't even make it through one of them, and they measure just 2.5x3 inches.  There's just something horrible going on in that little package.I'm feeding these to my chickens.  (But they eat bugs and stones.)Update: Tried feeding it to the chickens and they won't touch it.  I conclude this is not a food.

I tried one and it was very difficult to make myself eat it, even with peanut butter on it. Tried another one the next day and they had already gone stale even though they were in a baggie. Opened another package and tried one more time to eat one but it still tasted like ground tree bark! I threw the rest of the packages away! What a waste of money.
I was so excited to have a low carb snack to get me through the day at the office. Too bad, this stuff tastes like cardboard, or what i would imagine cardboard tasting like.

I don't usually write reviews, but I do read them... So I feel it necessary that you know that this taste nasty!  I chocked one down thinking I had to get use to it.  It does fill you up because it takes so long to chock down and you are drinking water to make it go down faster.  The reviews helped me make this purchase.  PLEASE NOTE that you CAN NOT return this item, so make sure you are ready for the not so wonderful taste....Best of luck.

This stuff's expensive but this is probably the best price you're gonna find if you get free shipping.  My wife loves them....she calls them "ZOOBISCUITS."  I would simply bake some bread and add some fine sawdust to the dough for a similar effect.

If nightmare had a taste, this would be it! Why torture yourself for vanity?! Go run on a treadmill instead of eating this (or eat celery or whatever good-for-you real food for God's sake!). You'd be much much happier and healthier! Can't believe I wasted my perfectly good money on this rubbish!

OK- these taste very similar to cardboard and should not be eaten by themselves! With something on them, like an egg or peanut butter and jelly, they aren't too terrible. The calorie count is SO LOW and the fiber is SO HIGH that the Weight Watchers Points Calculator says they are ZERO POINTS! For a cracker? They are worth their weight in gold! Wonderful!! I've lost over 10 lbs since discovering them.

column9: 5 crackers with strawberry topping = 25g fiber, ~120cal, 10 net carbs! Delicious! Happy customer! Completely calmed anxietytoeat
column10: I bought this at the local health store near where I live but I came to Amazon to leave a review for others to read.I read the reviews on amazon and when I bought this (paid $3.50/pack there) I knew it would taste like cardboard - well - it's true - it tastes like cardboard! It was very difficult to finish eating one single cracker, and when I went to the second I just could not - it was impossible to eat the cracker by itself.I then ran out to the supermarket and bought Sugar Free Smucker's Strawberry Topping (2tbsp = 25cal, 0 net carbs, 9 sugar alcohols,0 fat, 0mg sodium, 0 protein), and in a matter of a few minutes I had already eaten 5 of these crackers! Delicious!!!Each cracker is 2 net carbs (and 12cal), so 2x5 = 10 net carbs, 25g fiber, 60cal (only downside of this combination is that it is too delicious and it's hard to put down the darn crackers/topping!!!).After eating them, it completely calmed my hunger (I WAS genuinely hungry). Don't buy this at Amazon because of the shipping cost, so get them at your local health food store instead, but don't eat them w/o a topping.Conclusion: if you eat one cracker by itself, it'll destroy your appetite or any cravings you have - it does taste like cardboard though. But, if you add a carb-free sweet topping or any other topping of your choice, you're in for a fantastic low-carb snack, packed with fiber!I am currently in Ketosis (I am on a ketogenic diet) and this works for us wanting to stay on a 20-30 carb diet. But even after I'm done cutting weight (I'm only 10-15lbs away from a perfectly flat abdomen!) I'll still buy these because they are so ridiculously nutritious (0 fat, 0 cholesterol, 30mg sodium per cracker, 2 nt carbs, 5 fiber, 1g protein).This product makes an excellent addition to my low-carb/carb-free foods in my kitchen (includes breads/tortillas).I can't believe for 5 crackers and 4 servings of the strawberry topping, I consumed 25g fiber for just about 120 calories and 10 net carbs!!!Happy with this! (P.S.: I wish GG created a carb-free crispbread).

This really fills you up.  The taste is neutral, so you can put peanut butter or cheese on it.  It you want to go low carb, high fiber, low calorie, there is nothing else that comes close to this product.  Just be ready to drink water while you consume.  I not saying the flavor or consistency are great, I am saying it hits high marks for a delivery system for your spreads.

column9: mild and crispy, but  too harsh on digestive tract
column10: My first impression of these crackers was that they kinda looked like some sort of fiberboard and tasted  funny.  At the second tasting, I decided they tasted okay, just mildly like rye.  I liked the crisp crunchiness of them.  So the second impression was good.  However, an hour later I found they did not agree with my digestive tract.  I only ate a half of one, but all that day every time I ate something I would feel overly full even though I didn't overeat.  I wonder if there is some unlisted ingredient in them that does more than bran to make you feel full, because why would that effect happen at the next meal when none of it was eaten? Maybe bran can have that effect.  I don't know.  Anyway, I would suggest trying someone else's or buying the smallest amount possible to see if these 'agree' with you as well as to see if you like them.  Also, try no more than half a cracker at first to see how your body reacts.

I don't understand why so many reviewers are being so negative about the product. I mean anyone can tell by doing just a little research these are dry and tasteless on their own and many tell you to add topping.So I ordered the 5 pack and knew what to expect and was NOT surprised..actually I was a little, they weren't as bad as I thought they'd be.My two teenagers and I tried them when they came in today. We topped 3 crackers with a thin smear of cream cheese and a little diced onion and than we each grabbed a cracker and tried it. It gave us that crunchy feeling we had been missing since going on Atkins and the toppings helped even more.So we will keep them and add more low carb toppings as we experiment with them.

These work like a charm!Ive tried everything!Just got back from SIngapore and Bali totally constipatedI was taking 2 pills a night of fiberI ate one cracker with almond butter on it and it did the trickThe next day I tried 2 crackers and it worked even more!!!!It doesnt taste good but I cover it up with low calorie cheese and or peanut butter!I do a lot of weight loss and quit smoking programs and I will highly recommend this product for people who have constipation problem!

Okay, I get it. They are not like eating Nabisco Honey Maid Graham Crackers!  However, they are palatable!  Remember folks, you are eating 85% unprocessed wheat bran, bran flour, and a teeny bit of salt!  Its not bad, but not awful!That said, I've eaten them on the go, straight up and like the crunch.  They are good with strong flavored spreads, especially. They do fill you up very well when paired with a good source of protein.If you are use to eating bran flakes in the morning for breakfast and like it, you will enjoy these.  That said, if bran flakes are not for you, these wont be either.  These crisps are great for low-carbers, vegans, people doing the HCG diet, and diabetics.  Or if you just want a boost of fiber!

column9: Without topping, yukkie!  With topping delightful!!!
column10: Each slice of this cripbread supplies 20% of my daily fiber at only 12 calories and ultra-low carbs making it a fantastic bread replacement for my diet.However, this is not your normal cracker that you should just eat out of the package. If you try, you will gag and search frantically for something to wash it down.So, don't eat it like that. Instead, try it with your favorite toppings. Here is mine. I spread a thin layer of peanut butter on a wafer. Then I spread another layer of Nuttella on top of the peanut butter. The result to me is unbelievably good.Other toppings you might like:cheesestuna saladetc.enjoy!

column9: Only 12 Calories...& it Tastes like it!!
column10: So I've been trying to lose weight & eat healthier.  I saw these on the Early Show & thought "wow! Crackers for only 12 calories? This would make the perfect snack to keep me from eating all day!"  The talk show host tried one & was saying how much he liked them so I figured they couldn't be all that bad...well, after tasting them I think he's full of you-know-what!  They are VERY dry & flavorless & not in a good way.I thought they would be a little less tasty than the high fiber crackers at the store, but no...they're way worse, but I guess that should be expected at just 12 calories.  First I tried them with laughing cow blue cheese & the flavors didn't go well at all.  Then I tried them with veggie dip (made with 16oz light sour cream & 1 pack of Cugino's veggie weggie dip mix).  This was at least edible.  I have some PB2 on order to try it with & update my review if it's better.Right now, I wouldn't buy them again, but at least I only paid $6.69 for a 5-pack through Amazon with subscribe & save & a $3 coupon.

I just opened the box last night while waiting for dinner.  The crackers are dense with a good bitey texture. The first bite I ate plain, and it was like eating sand. FIRST TIMERS, DO NOT EAT THEM PLAIN; YOU WILL BE TURNED OFF!  I hurried to get some almond butter on the cracker.  That was fabulous. I plan on eating these daily as part of a weight management plan. Right now I am eating these crackers SOLELY for the nutritional benefits and absolutely NOT FOR THE TASTE. But they are edible and are supposed to be really good for you. I hope so...
These and WASA are my two favorite fiber crackers. These are a little pricier than WASA, but they have so much fiber, you don't need to consume as much. Thanks for the great Sub. & Save price option.

column9: Move a ton of food with minimal calories.
column10: I have to be honest... I was on the fence about these for a while before I finally bought them and now I gotta say I'm happy I did.  On their own they are a bit barky in flavor (there really is not nice term for mashed bran in the form of a dense cracker).  I have since learned to put some low calorie jam on them or put them in my salads and they are extremely functional.  You can have a few of these with some jam and get a very low calorie snack that is backed up with a lot of fiber (nice for all you Weight Watchers out there).  So you have to put this into context.  You are buying bran crackers, pure & simple that have next to no calories.  Don't expect more than you are buying.
Heard about this from my cousin. Decided to try and really glad I did. AWESOME tasting! Hard to believe low in fat and calories.

Although they do not taste good, they are a healthy, low cal snack.  When you add light cream cheese or Laughing Cow cheese and a slice of lean meat, the taste improves.  Then you have a great snack for less than 100 calories that will keep you satisfied throughout the afternoon.

I have been using these for years. They are so versatile, absorbent (great with sugar free syrups), and function in every type of recipe imaginable: sweet or savory. I rarely use them as crackers. They are great in "protein ice cream shakes", crumbled in so they can soak up the flavor. They add a great crunch to anything you put them in, from salads to puddings. I highly recommend these.

column9: 1/2 of these will keep you full for hours
column10: I bought this after seeing them on Dr. Oz. I don't understand the reviews about the bad taste.  To me, they have no taste.  I eat 1/2 one for breakfast with peanut butter (I also eat a banana).  It is an unusual texture that will require a lot of water, but I promise you that it will be after your lunch time and you still will not be hungry.  No food has ever made me so full for so long.  Amazing!  I can't wait to see if I loose weight.
These crackers are delish! I love them with a wedge of light laughing cow cheese on top. I wish they were more affordable. My local health food store sells them for $4.75 per package.
I love this product!  Don't eat it dry, you can spread the cracker with laughing cow cheese, peanut butter or jelly.

I bought these because dr Oz recommended it for a healthy dose of fiber in your diet.Boy does it work. It curbs your apetite and it helps you with a healthy bowel movement. By itself it's very dry and hard to swallow. But if you have it with some kind of dip it works great. Just make sure to drink plenty of water.I eat these crackers with hummus, varieous cheeses, yogurt dip,avacado,salsa, etc.....

column9: Hunger Be Gone!!!!! This really works!!!!
column10: I love this product!!!! Very dry but it really does work!!!! Drink lots of water and the hunger will be gone!!! I use a smear of peanut butter and honey!!! Love it!!!!

I think this product tastes like probably cooked dirt (?), but does the trick for a snack.  2 of these with just a bit of low fat peanut butter and sugar free honey drizzled on do take the edge off.  I will probably buy them again.

This bread is great for when I'm doing a liver cleanse and need an alternative to bread. It's tough and crunchy, but it's good with cheese or hummus or almond butter and a guilt-free snack. I wish it was sold in stores around where I live.

These crackers are high in Fiber content but the taste takes a little getting used to. Once you get used to them you can put different toppings such as peanut butter, jams, cream cheese, Nutella or what ever you like. Our favorites are apricot or raspberry jams. My whole family have gotten used to them we eat them for breakfast or snacks.

I love these.  These crackers are very coarse and not for people who are not into whole grains.But!! for low carbers, they are great! 5 grams of fiber, 2 carbs and 12 calories each.  They are about 4" by 2",so they are a nice size for 2 carbs.They taste really goodwith tuna salad, egg salad and cheese spreads.  I am so grateful for these crackers because theyhelp me to successfully maintain my low carb lifestyle. These would be great for the health conscious as well.

I ordered these elsewhere because I didn't want to be stuck with several packages in case I didn't like them.  If you're doing Atkins or another low carb plan and have been missing crunchy crackers, this may be just what you're looking for.  The taste is not bad but as  other reviewers have mentioned, these crispbreads are extremely dry.  You have got to put something on them - butter, cream cheese, jam, anything and you should have a beverage with them too.  If you consider them to be a vehicle for great toppings, I don't think you'll be disappointed.  Low calorie, 2 net carbs per slice, plenty of fiber and crunch.  What's not to like?

These are perfect for in between meals or when you're on the go. I eat them with whipped cream cheese and cinnamon and they taste like cracklin oat bran cereal. Plus they only have 12 calories and 5g fiber.. It's like a miracle cracker;). I also carry justin's almond butter with honey packets in my purse to spread on them when I'm traveling for a snack. Also good with laughing cow cheese, cherry tomatoes, salt and pepper. They definitely need something sweet or savory on top or else they are pretty bland but it's the perfect base. Awesome way to get fiber.

They have a nice crunch, and they really do fill you up!  (Drink some water when you eat them)  They taste good with cheese or peanut butter on top too.  I make little sandwiches with cheese and turkey... a 10 gram of fiber sandwich is pretty impressive!
Love it! Take some hummus, cucumbers and tatziki and you have the perfect snack. They also are great as a breadcrumb!

I'm at the age, a mere 61 years old, my digestive system has gone a bit out of whack.  I have to regularly consume extra fiber to keep my "output" at a good consistency.  GG fiber crackers to the rescue.  I notice a big negative difference when I go off the crackers for a few days.  I had to learn to befriend them, I admit.  After eating my first one plain, out of the package, I knew I had to come up with a better way to get these things down.  My routine of late has been to have a cracker every other day, with light cream cheese and jelly, or broken up and used as crackers in my soup.  Peanut butter is good also.  An added plus is that these crackers are only 12 calories with no fat or sugar.  A dieters delight.

I use to buy the bran crispbread in my health food store but never realized the possibilities that they offered from pie crust to pizza. Discovering the possabilities I now have them delivered monthly. They are awesome with hot foods or cold and they soften with moist spreads when allowed to sit for a while. For those on special diets they are a low glycemic index food, low calorie and high fiber. At first try people may cringe because of the abundant fiber and dryness. The trick with this high fiber item is to eat them with another food and or beverage even if it's just water. The beauty of this food is their health giving properties. They work inside out.

I ordered this product because I was looking for a cracker with high fiber and low carbohydrates.  This product has both, and it is very filling.  It goes well with any topping.  However, it is VERY fibrous and dry, and not very tasty.  I find myself taking very small bites, just so I don't have to consume a lot of fluid with each bite.  If you have chronic consipation, like I do. . .eating two of these crackers daily will surely cure your problem!  The benefits of this product do outweigh the fact that they don't taste very good, so I will continue to purchase them.  The taste and texture take a little getting used to, though.
I liked them very much. I use them with ham and cheese, ricotta, chicken salad. Be sure to drink plenty of water during the day so that the fiber works.

Purchased this 5-pack because I heard so much about them.  Yes, they taste dry, but with a nice topping it's not bad at all.  And, as we all know, fiber, fiber, fiber is good for you!  It's great for a late night snack or I pack one for lunch for a mini-sandwich.  I top it with anything from peanut butter, nutella, mustard or bologna.  Whether sweet or savory, you can use it for whatever snack you like.  I just lost quite a bit of weight and this is one item I really don't have to worry about the calories - only 12 each!  Highly recommend it.  Is it dry?  Yes, indeed, but with a beverage (tea, water, etc) it's just fine.  I'm ready to purchase again.

column9: Perfect if you like a little dry, alot branny!
column10: Atkins diet recommended and one cracker is perfect for breakfast with peanut butter - tastes like a piece of toast. For lunch, add a couple of tbsps. of tuna or chicken salad.  The cracker is too dry to eat by itself but is quite filling and tasty with a topping on it.  Since it is packed with fiber, don't forget to drink water!  Only problem, it's hard to find in local stores and it's easier to just order online.

I find this a good way to get fiber into my diet.  They are dry but with some peanut butter - they're pretty good.  I eat them just about every morning for breakfast and it's only 12 calories per cracker. They are now part of my regular diet.

This is ok, I know it would not have much flavor and is use "fill you up" before a meal or in between meals. I would put cream cheese, ham & pickle or PB & Jelly. This would help but still can be hard to swallow. You have to be creative on how to use this.
Not bad! Very helpful when you're on a diet! I usually melt some lowfat cheese or make a snack pizza, but helps you stay on track when you need something crunchy,other than carrots and celery sticks!
Pretty difficult to eat this stuff straight but if you put some natural peanut butter and sugar free jelly on it it makes a nice snack that sticks with you for a while.

column9: It's not magic, but it sure seems to be!!
column10: If you are trying to keep your weight under control and keep away from the junk food, GG Scandinavian Bran Crispbread is just the thing you need to turn off the hunger and cravings.Alone, they taste like plain bran -- not much taste at all. That is a plus because you can actually doctor them up with whatever low-calorie topping you would like. Reduced fat cheese, peanut butter, fat-free cream cheese, sugar-free jelly, etc. Use just about anything you like in moderation on these crispbreads, along with a large drink and you will soon feel ready to push yourself away from the table.It's certainly worth a try. Fiber and water expand in your stomach -- it's as simple as that! (By the way, these were recommended by Dr. Oz.)

column9: Nasty but a great appetite suppressent
column10: I agree with all of the other reviews. Dry, dyr, dry.  I am a night time grazer.  I am surprised by lack of desire after eating one of these crackers.  It takes a lot of water to get it down.

I wasn't expecting to receive my order so fast, received before the date that was given!Who'd  know that something so good for you would taste as good as it does!!Thanks for the Healthy Addition for the New Year 2011 !!

The crackers I received were stale and one package had tiny insects crawling out.  Amazon refunded my money but it was very upsetting and it has spoiled my taste for the crackers. However, when these crackers are fresh they are a very good diet aide.  I used them in the past between meals to cut down my appetite.  They are very low calorie and spread with a little peanut butter, tasty.  Unfortunately because of my bad experience I am no longer able to eat them.

Although this product was recommended by Dr. Oz, My husband and I couldn't get pass the taste and dryness. We tried it with cream cheese, jellies, jams, etc. but nothing helped. Too bad - I was really looking for this to help us with our diets.

These crisps may be full of fiber but the taste is about the same as a cardboard box. The only way to get them down is to doctor them with Nutella or Jelly, which kind of defeats the weight control aspect.

If you're out for sheer health benefits without taste and without desirable texture, this one's for you.  I did not expect much out of it except health benefits, so I wasn't surprised.  You should only try this product if you have excellent salivary glands AND lots of liquid handy.

I know this stuff is very good for you, and normally I will tolerate foods that are very good for you regardless of taste. But not this. Really, seriously, it's like eating fibrous cardboard. No joke, not even almond butter makes this stuff good. And really, it's the texture...VERY dry. I read other reviews that said this, however I figured I'd be ok because I am normally not very picky and like healthy foods. But not this. It's still sitting in our pantry. My suggestion is to buy a little of it first to see if you like it before you buy this pack.

-1 for taste....Like many mentioned, this really tastes like cardboard. But it does what it claimed. It really fills me up. I can eat one at lunch & not be hungry 'till 6. Also, it has helped me w/ BM. I especially would recommend this for those who are on a high protein low carb diet (i.e., Atkins).

I had seen these on a TV show,they ate them on the show and made them seem pretty tasty.  I wont buy again, they are like eating sawdust!  I had to drink so much water to get them down.  I did find that if you put cream cheese on them its a lot better but I would rather eat my fiber bars, even my daughter likes those.

column9: I would rather eat the shipping box!
column10: I love Amazon and will still love the ease of shopping.  Infact I always check reviews before purchasing most anything.  But these crackers, I guess you call them are the most awful thing I have ever put into my mouth.  I have to think the shipping box they came in would have more of a pleasant flavor. (Since the box rolled around the UPS floor for a while)  So I will feed them to the fish in the lake.  :)If you are looking for something tasty or salty or just to chew on, find something else!

Nasty! I would rather eat cardboard. 20 people at work tried it and none could even swallow the first bite. The only reason it has one star is because amazon would not let me continue with zero stars. :(

I have bought these in the health food store and although they do not taste the best, they are the greatest for dieting and digestion. Unfortunately these were horrifically stale. I will not buy online again.
These taste horrible even putting jelly or something on top of them didn't help.  I wouldn't even give them to anyone that's how bad they are...

column9: Does what it should, but tastes like cardboard
column10: It sure is healthy and good for you. Helps in High Fiber diets too. Unfortunately, it tastes like the cardboard boxes that homeless people live in. Tried to make it taste better by dipping it in milk, coffee, or tea and imagining it to be cookies. It worked until I put it in my mouth, and I am pretty sure that my uvula went into throes of spasms, and my tongue refused to taste anything else for the rest of the day.But it is good for you...

I ordered these because Dr Oz said they were a good source of fiber and they help you feel full. As soon as they arrived I tried one. OMG, it was like eating a mouth full of compressed wood. Tried it again with a little almond butter (also Dr. Oz recommendation) Didn't help. These things are ghastly! Would still eat them if they helped me feel full, but that didn't work for me either. I'll stick with quaker rice cakes as a snack. I actually like those.

column9: Taste Great, but Sold in a 12-pk Not a 6-pk
column10: I'm not sure why this is listed as 6-pk.  It's sold as 12-pk.  I assume the price is based on half of a case.

column9: The Best tasting pepper sauce you'll ever eat.
column10: Some pepper sauces have only HOT going for them. Matouk's Pepper Sauce is full of flavor and heat. I lived in Trinidad, WI for six years and got addicted to this stuff. Glad to see Amazon is carrying it now--I won't have to go through withdrawals.

I first had this sauce in Jamaica.  I was raving about it to one of the servers, so he gave me a bottle to bring home.  It has been a year since then, and I have already finished that and most of two other bottles I ordered.  I brought one to work and many agreed.  One of the best hot and flavorful sauces out there.
This is the best sauce I have ever had. I wish that I could get it in a larger size.

I lived in the Caribbean for a number of years and tried many hot sauces from the region. Miss Anna's is the best. It's not the hottest - not even close - but do not be fooled. It is still plenty hot. Caribbean hot sauces are generally several degrees hotter than Mexican, US Tobasco-styled ones or commercial Asian varieties. One too many shakes will induce hiccups and copious head sweats. What sets Miss Anna's apart is the flavor profile of scotch bonnets, garlic, saltiness and curry spices and the near perfect balance of those flavors. Once you have rice and peas with Miss Anna's you will never want it without.

column9: Perhaps the tastiest hot sauce I have ever used.
column10: The sauce I have used the most in the past has been Melinda's XXX. It is very tasty and full of heat. However, Miss Anna's is by far the tastiest hot sauce of them all. It has moved Melinda's to the second place spot on my top ten list of favorite hot sauces. Miss Anna's Hot Pepper Sauce packs plenty of heat while providing maximum flavor. Highly recommended.

The 5 lb. bag of Good & Plenty was shipped and received in just 3 days. I have ordered the candy fromother sources, and never had it arrive in such good condition, nor as fresh. Other sources are slower inshipping, and often the candy arrived either stuck together or very dried up. Three cheers for Amazon.Keep up the great work. R Read, Vista, CA

This was the second time I've ordered the 5lbs bag from Amazon. Both times I've gotten the freshest Good & Plenty's I've ever gotten. I get them at the store or at the movies and they are tough even hard. I loved them and thought that's just how they came until I had them soft and chewy. Awesome!

February 14, 2012To: D&S Office Supply and Amazon.Com,I would like to retract my previous review, as I believe that I jumped the gun. I received a defective bag of candy. Thinking that it would be taken care of in just a few days was unrealistic as this company does a lot of business and responded within a reasonable amount of time. They not only sent me a replacement bag but they sent two bags.I feel terrible for assuming that I was going to get taken, that was thoughtless of me. Amazon does an excellent, AAA job of protecting our purchases against fraud while assuring the highest level of quality and customer service.I would like to not only retract my last review and complaint, but apologize to D&S Office Supply and Amazon.Com for my hasty complaint. It was most certainly unfounded!Kind regards,W. Woodward
If you like licorice you will love this candy.  I can remember eating this candy from a box at the local movie theatre when I was a kid and it is still just as good.

column9: WHERE IS THE BUY IN BULK SAVINGS ????
column10: IT IS FAR CHEAPER PER POUND TO BUY THIS ITEM IN WALMART @ 0.99 PER 6 OUNCE BOX........DO THE MATH......
Great! The only downside was the fact that the Good & Plenty sack had a hole in it and they were slowly spilling out into the container box.

My best friend just sent me these as a gift.  We are both always on  a quest for the softest G & P's .  These are maybe the softest I have ever had, there is nothing more disappointing than tucking into a box or bag of these babies and find them old and hard (though I still manage to eat them)!.  So I highly recommend these (and thanks to my buddy for a great gift!).

This was my husband's favorite Christmas gift ever!  He loved being able to dig in and get as many candies as he wanted each time!  We will be ordering this again - in fact, I think I'll do that right now!
I sent these as a gift, and the recipient was pleased. they were fresh, and delivered on time. Since he did not rave about the taste, I gav e 4 instead of 5 stars.
I'm not a fan of orange slices personally, but the recipient said they were tasty and they arrived as described and punctually. So, no complaints here!

Due to food allergy, we don't do dairy, nuts and peanuts, wheat and gluten, egg, soy and other legume and, sesame in our house.needless to say there aren't many tasty snacks out there that we can enjoy( unless I make thing myself in my kitchen)But their line of rice snax are wonderful!We love all the flavors( haven't tried BBQ due to allergies), I even served at my child's class party And the little guys like them too!We LOVE them! This was the best finding ever! Thanks guys for making such wonderful snacks!!!
If you like salt and vinegar also ... this cracker is for you!  It is great with smoked fish, or, not.  It is tasty and easy to mix with a variety of other goodies:  dips, salads, soups, etc.

When looking for this product online (since I couldn't find it in ANY stores) I was concerned because the picture of the product did not match the product name.  After doing much research I found out the UPC number & used it to determine if this was indeed the product I was looking for.  Once confirmed, I ordered it & kept my fingers crossed that it was what I was looking for.... it was!! I was delighted because I absolutely love the Kraft SWEET Balsamic Vinaigrette on my spinach/strawberry salad.  NOTE ~ I spoke with an Amazon representative & he could not verify that this was indeed what I was looking for... thus the reason for the research I had to perform.But, I am happy to report after all this I am happy to have my favorite dressing so that I can enjoy my favorite salad!

column4: Erica D. Galusha "real girl, real world"
column9: Finally!  A balsamic that isn't sour!
column10: I'v been a balsamic lover for years, but I could never find a pre-made one that I liked.  I tried cheap ones (Newman's, Ken's) and expensive ones (fancy glass bottles is the only thing I can remember), but nothing was as good as what I could a) pay a lot for in a restaurant OR b) make myself by simmering balsamic on the stove and dissolving raw sugar in it- time consuming!I was so happy when we went to my in-laws for Christmas and they had this (ok, it was the ONE benefit of Christmas with my in-laws).  Although I can't find it in the stores where I live, I'm so glad I can find it online.

I bought this product and it is delicious!!!! I could drink it from the bottle,no kidding. I usually don't write reviews, but I am soooo disappointed that I cannot find in stores in my area. I called Kraft foods ans was told there is no store within a 50 mile radius, I am very disappointed; but I can buy it on amazon.com. I hopr the stores will start selling it because it is a keeper!!!

Ordinarily I do not drink sweet coffee, and all the iced k-cups I've tried have been gooey and bitter. I tried this one when Green Mountain had a special, and now I'm ordering more for my daughter! It is very sweet, and makes a relatively small amount (the "iced" setting on my Cuisinart brewer is sends only 4 ozs. over the ice, and I wouldn't recommend more than 5-6 cubes in the glass). But brewed that way you get a refreshing, sweet, nutty drink. It's really rather strong this way, and has a surprising caffeine kick, which I don't get from my hot hazelnut brew. With record-breaking temps in Atlanta this year, it's a welcomed treat!
I was very excited to try this product but what a disappointment!.  Very  weak watery coffee flavor. And also much too sweet. Wouldn't buy this product again.

This is a great value if you drink green tea daily and want convenience. We order it this way to save gas, time, money and still drink the tea we like without the hassle of loose. Finally, we have enough tea to last a month with less packaging to store. Price it out! Good value.
This tea has a smooth and flavorful taste.  No bitterness. Cheaper buying it this way,than at store. 40 bags $3.50 great way to save. and always have them on hand

As a Green Tea Lover... I do not want to recommend this tea bags.The taste of this tea bag is NOT closed to green tea at all... It is more like lightened black tea...Also, this open style paper package is not good for Green Tea. The taste of Green Tea is getting worse if contacted by direct sunlight, heat or humidity. It should be kept hermetically sealed.If you want to enjoy real green tea with moderate price, I'd like recommend Kirkland Signature Green Tea Matcha Blend 100% Japanese Tea - 100 Tea Bags. It is made by Itoen as well-known Japanese tea company. Taste and clear green color is excellent with well sealed package.

column9: Handy Size - Great for Iced Green Tea
column10: I prefer iced tea and I picked this tea up the last time I was in the US and liked it a lot. I've switched from black to green tea because of the health benefits I've read about with green tea.I can also find this particular tea in Mexico, which rocks because good non-herbal teas are hard to find.The directions state that for iced tea, you should brew 4 bags per quart, which is probably accurate, but I just use it with cold water the way you would for sun tea and it takes a few hours, but it works just fine with a lot less hassle. Try it that way, I've had excellent luck with it.  Anything that will cut yet another step out of my day is great. :DDo I think that this is the best green tea ever? I'm sure it's not. I don't find it at all bitter the way some green teas can be and it is definitely priced right. Please refer to other reviewers for how it tastes hot, because I honestly can't speak to that.

Very good tea but I prefer the tea without bags. I'm kind of spoiled by fresh tea and Asian tea so I'm a bit picky. These are very convenient though which is why it deserves the high rating. Lipton has done a wonderful job selecting and packaging the tea. This is a great alternative to coffee during deployment.
