The price on subscribe and save is generally great, so overall we like this product and it is easy to purchase it from Amazon.

Love the convenience of having this dog food delivered once per month, every month!Love the healthful effects its had on my 12 year old prancing and still lively love of my life standard poodle!He got very sick on blue buffalo and it cost around 300 to have him checked out.....nothing wrong, except his food!Loved getting the free treat pack with the dog food....but they stoopped doing this!  Why Newman's own stopped this, I'll never know.But, I like it so much I've ordered the treats to be delivered every two months, and have just subscribed for their cat food to also be delivered.What you spend on good food you save in vet bills!Love Newman's!!!!

column9: Looks healthy but cat won't eat it
column10: The first thing I noticed about this cat food is that it doesn't smell horrendous. I poured some into my cat's food bowl and she ran over and started devouring it. She didn't do that with the other brands I've given her (IAMS, Hill's science diet, the goodlife recipe). She seems to really like this food and she hasn't thrown it up. I'm not a vet so I don't know how nutritionally sound this product is, but it lists a lot of organic ingredients and it has chicken as one of the first ingredients. I'll post pictures of the bag with that information. I know Newman's Own is a quality brand (I use their pasta sauces and salad dressing) so I imagine this product is high quality as well. It sure seems to be.Update 8-16-12: My cat does not seem to like it anymore after the first week. I mixed it with her old food and she picks around to avoid the Newman's Own pellets. I tried putting just Newman's Own in one dish and the other cat food in another. She won't eat the Newman's Own when it's separate either. I guess she prefers the cheaper cat food.
Sorry to say, my cat refused to eat this stuff. I am sure it's good but my cat wouldn't eat it.

column9: It's not the same product as before
column10: My cats used to love this product, but Newman's has changed it and now they won't touch it.  I had to cancel my subscription.
To expensive, I don't know what I was thinking. My cats didn't seem to excited about the food either.

My cat hated this food... won't eat it.To be clear... he also hates IAMS and Blue Buffalo. But he loves Hill's Science Diet.I try to buy him food that he will like that will be good for him. That usually means that it costs more... but a price can never be put on good health.

For alcohol-free vanilla, this one is both delicious and healthy.  It is great to cook with or to add to your 'raw' recipes, and the flavor is very true.  There is no 'off' flavor that some vanillas can have.  It has only glycerine and water as additional ingredients.  Some other alcohol-free vanillas have corn syrup, and who wants corn syrup?  This can be hard to find in some stores.  Our local organic grocer seems to have trouble ordering it for me (that would be on them, not on Frontier), so ordering through Amazon has proven to be very convenient.  Enjoy!

This has a very strong vanilla taste to it, but the glycerin has a strange after taste to it. If you are using it in recipes where it is not very diluted (like a beverage) you might notice it. It's a little thicker than normal vanilla extract too. But if you are looking for a vanilla extract without the taste of alcohol (like a milkshake) it's a good choice. I've been using it in my protein shakes and it tastes good.J.Ja

column9: Wonderful for Lattes and coffee drinks
column10: I use this all the time in lattes and frozen frappe coffee drinks.  Very smooth and doesn't have that alcohol bite regular vanilla extract.  A very small amount goes a long way.  Seems expensive, but it lasts a long time.  I highly recommend this if you want a smoother vanilla flavor for drinks.  I have not tried it yet in baked goods, but it should work there too.

Mild vanilla flavor but nothing special.  As I make my own ice cream, I'm very fussy about my flavorings.  They need to be more intense than this one to get the flavor I want.
This vaniila is the best . It's thick and syrupy. It has a greater flavor than any other .I would recomend this for anyone . This is also great for anyone who has food alergies .Thanks a bunch .

It was great in my cakes and cookie and creme brulee but it had a weird smell sort of like an oily smellI was worried at first but after I baked my goodie the smell was magnificent :)

column9: A little bland, but otherwise good
column10: Thinkens up nicely, decent flavor, but a little bland. Make sure you have some salt and pepper available to season it.

column9: Can't go wrong with Spice Hunter brand.
column10: My son is in college up north, where it gets cold. The is the one and only soup that I sent him, that he really enjoyed and asked for more!  This is always in his care package. Just pour in hot water, wait and eat...no mess, no fuss. Get some today!!
I LOVE the single servings of elf grahams! I use these for my childcare business!  What an absolutely convenient item!
Great product, my Dobbie loves these! It satisfies her need to chew and really be able to bit down on something. And I'm much more comfortable about the content knowing they are made in USA.

My 20 pound Xolo loves these treats, but if you're looking for a long-term chew treat, these will not suffice. She manages to get through one in a few mins and she is not a particularly strong chewer.

Although I've never really tried these my schnauzer, Hailey Jo, says she loves them.  She knows she gets one when she goes out to do "her duty" and I see her make a quick loop on the patio, never even attempting to do anything, and then running back to the door to be let in. She immediately heads to her treat jar and waits for her bitty bones. This is the 2nd time I have bought them through Amazon since I can't find them in my city.
Royal Canin dry food for pug is a food my pug really loves. He is able to eat it much better than other sizes. we are hooked on this brand.

We have a year old pug and have always been mindful of nutrition since pugs have a tendency to become overweight.  When I saw this food, I thought it was just a "hype", but after reviewing its contents, we decided to give it a try!  Our dog absolutely LOVES this stuff and I feel it is nutritionally balanced.  Odd that it seems to have the same caloric value as other foods not designated for the needs of this breed, but perhaps it is simply absorbed differently.  Our vet advised us to feed him 1/4 cup twice a day which is considerably less than is suggested on the bag, but he seems to be doing great.  I would highly recommend this food to any pug owner!
The type of pug food is wonderful! My pug has been on it for a while now and can't get enough.

This food is great. My pug had become a bit of a picky eater, so I switched to Royal Canin Pug food. Now, I never have a problem getting him to eat.  He has also lost a few pounds since starting on Royal Canin Pug. All pug owners know that this is a major plus, as it is hard to keep these guys slim.

I have two dogs with different tastes- one will eat anything and one prefers meaty products but even meat flavored dry food doesn't do it for him.  except royal canin.  we bought it bc of its claim to be special for pugs and the jury is still out on whether that makes a difference.  all I know is my dogs love it and when the puppies who are too little to eat it yet smell it they go crazy! I would recommend it and amazon definitely has the best price but you still are purchasing a higher cost product here. for how much my picky guy loves it, it's worth it for us!

After having the most perfect pug with absolutely no issues for years, I recently took in a rescue pug who was overweight and has a slew of problems with his skin, ears, eyes, etc. I tried a couple of different medications and foods to try to help. Royal Canin Pug food was recommended to me because of the weight management and the ingredients to help with skin conditions. My little guy LOVES this stuff. He is harping at me every morning and night for his food. He is slimming down but the best part is that his skin is clearing up. He no longer has the hotspots on his back and his face is quickly healing as well. I am using ear drops, but believe that combined with this food, he is healing better. He no longer itches all day and he's noticeably happier. Love this stuff and love that the price on Amazon is cheaper than the local stores.
Every time I order this, it always arrives quickly and packed nicely and my puggle loves it.  I mix it with the regular Royal Canine for adult dogs.

My pug had been overweight for a long time, I have switched his light dog food from brand to brand and his weight just not good down. I later had him tried the science diet (prescription light diet) and he did lose weight but it is expensive and the ingredients are not as good as royal canin in my opinion, they later come up a royal canine for pug and I started feeding my boy that and he absolutely loves it! He continue to lose weight even though this is not labeled as diet food.  He is healthy and active and I would highly recommend this to any pug lovers.
Best price you can find!Food is fresh, I love that I don't have to schlep it more than from my door to the kitchen!

Since I tried this product my pug is happy to eat . The size, the taste, the presentation, the formula, all match with herand with me.  But the most important thing is that after a complicate episode of my pug was very sick, the vet told me totry because she can't have any other food beside as diet prescription. had some when i was over in hawaii...love this stuff, however couldn't find at my local storeshas a great spam flavor, with the extra heat, not too spicy...maybe not spicy enough

column9: Hot stuff for the Islanders!  Yo!

column9: So much better than I expected
column10: I had never seen this anywhere before, so I tried it out of curiosity. It's just like regular SPAM, but with a slight spiciness (about as hot as Tabasco sauce). If you are craving that euphoric pain/pleasure feeling, this will not be spicy enough for you. However, I find the level of heat is just right so as to not overpower the SPAM's delicious porkiness.

This stuff is the best.  We tried it first at the Minnesota State Fair but was told that you cannot buy it in the US.  Haa-we found it on Amazon!  We grind it up with mayo, onion and sweet pickle for a ahhhhsome meat spread for sandwiches.  It's got just the right amount of kick.
Just as I have expected it, tasty and spicy just enough not to burn the tongue. Will order it again, soon.

I've tried many spam varieties, and this has got to be the worst one. I prefer the hickory smoked spam, spam classic, or spam lite. Whatever floats your boat, though. It's just not my cup of tea (or can of spam).
Melinda's is an eye-opener. Perks up anything that you would use ketchup on. Makes even gefilte fish exciting. Does not have that harsh jalapeno bite.  Need to avoid that shipping charge.

I bought these to take to a party at which one of the guests was a vegan. She later e-mailed me to thank me so much for bringing these delicious vegan mints. I confess that I didn't even notice this feature when I was buying them; I just wanted something a little  different from the run-of-the-mill after dinner mints. Try them, you'll like them.

Mother's pickels are a real treat on a cracker...maybe with a piece of cheese. Very rich spice flavor. When I make a curry dish I have found if you add a table spoon of Mother's to it it will be much better. A must have.
LOVES MUSHROOMS AND THESE ARE GREAT AND COST ALLOT LESS THEN THOSE SMALL CANS...I FREEZE ANY EXTRA TO USE LATER..

I bought these because canned mushrooms have been out of stock at my local Wegman's for a long time (Upstate NY).  These are very beefy sized pieces & stems; Fabulous Beef-Steak Restaurant size & quality.  Unfortunately, they are rendered inedible by one major flaw- WAAAY TOO heavily salted: 550 mg. sodium/serving... (A normal bowl of mushrooms is a double serving = 1100 mg. sodium/bowl!)  1/10th that amount, would be PLENTY of sodium (salt).  USDA RDA = 2400 mg. daily (max.).  All I can taste is salt salt salt.  I ordered 4 cans, & am going to try soaking an entire can overnight in a giant bowl of water, (in fridge), to see if the water will dilute the high salt content.  If not, I'll have to give the 2 remaining cans to a food drive.  I will never order these again, due solely to the exhorbitantly high sodium content, which completely ruins these otherwise extra large mushrooms. Obviously I should have checked the sodium content, before purchasing.  My bad.

column9: Roland adds a pinch of ascorbic acid (vitamin C)
column10: Thanks to Roland for adding a very small amount of ascorbic acid (vitamin C) to these sliced button mushrooms grown in China.  Vitamin C not only helps to preserve the freshness of these mushrooms but also blocks the formation of cancer-causing nitrosamines, which tend to always form in all salted foods. Bag weighed in at 5.2 pounds.  Boxed with ice packs. Candy was not melted - not even soft - its 85° here today..  Quick shipping.  What more could you ask for?

There are only a few ingredients in these cookies, so they are very simple, but hey... simple is good! They have a buttery flavor with a crumbly texture that goes very well with coffee or tea. They arrived very fresh. The cookies are about one inch square each. I thought it was nice that they come in 5 oz. portions, sealed in individual cans; they don't have a chance to go stale before you get a chance to eat them all. My three year old really loves them as a treat.
I consider myself a shortbread aficianado...and this just didn't cut the mustard.  Very nice packaging,but more bitter than the "tart" taste I had expected.

I bought this 5 pound bag to give out to trick or treaters both at the office and at home.  I also gave some to my bf and kept a bunch at the office just to munch on.  My colleagues love it!  Some even come in to my office just to pick out their favorite flavors!  My favorites?  Wet face watermelon and tango mango!

These are individually wrapped with "organic" and the flavor on each candy wrapper. This way, parents know what they are getting. We handed out 3 to each trick or treater. We didn't count out each flavor like some reviewers did, but it seemed like a decent assortment of each.

Yes, these suckers are not enormous balls of candy, but they are a terrific option for those of us who want to buy organic, non GMO sweets for ourselves and our children.  We are handing these out for Halloween this year, even though it would be cheaper to buy the jumbo bags of chocolate candy at the warehouse stores.  I personally want to support companies that don't use artificial colors and flavors, and are not contributing to the obesity problems in our country. The 5 lb. bag also comes nearly evenly disbursed between flavors (we checked).  The blueberry is our favorite, but they are all tasty.

I have to say that i am generally skeptical of things that have healthy or organic labels on them. I thought they'd be a good idea though as I started a new semester in college that consisted of all adults over 21 but they're also all under 25. I did not know any of them or what they might be allergic to so I decided to get a sweet treat that was allergen free. I also know the organic thing is big especially among young people. I know it was slightly risky but I ordered the big 5lb bag and I was very pleased admittedly. The distribution of the flavors was pretty even I got 40-50 lollipops of every flavore listed. I know this because I divided them into individual bags each with one of each flavor of lollipop in them and got 40 bags with a few leftovers of every flavor. I handed them out and they recived a great reception. Some of the flavors are more subtle than others because they're made from natural fruit extracts and some people didnt care for certain flavors as others but they all seemed to be mixed and based on individual preferences but over they were a really big hit. I was instantly popular right away and some of them stated even the kids in their families loved them. I immediately tried every flavor and I like them all, some more than others, but again its just a preference thing. I'll be ordering them again for future occassions and just wanted to relate my positive experience to those considering the purchase. I hope everyone has as pleasant an experience with this product as I have.

this product taste great and is organic. my favorite flavors were the cherry and all of the red ones (watermelon etc.).  i got alot of red color ones and a good assortment of the other flavors.this was a big bag that by the end of it i was done with lollypops for a little while lol.
Flavors are bright and "yummy".  No corn syrup.  Good value.  Have purchased this product before and will again and again.

My husband is an art teacher for high school students and I was looking for something he could have in class as a treat but that wasn't corn syrup laden or full of food dyes. I was happy to find these at such a great deal!

column9: Excellent way to let kids have something sweet

Cherry, Grape, Sour Apple, Pomegranate, Strawberry, Blueberry, Watermelon and Mango.I did not receive some of the flavors mentioned by a few other reviewers such as Lemon, Ginger, blood Orange and another one something...Cocktail. these lollipops are my new favorite thing! they are so flavorful, perfectly sized, and are a successful solution to pregnancy nausea. I am enjoying all of the flavors. Kids and adults are both loving them! I will buy these again.
Read the other reviews, bought them, and wholly concur.  They are addictive for those who like tart suck candy.

These suckers taste way better than anything synthetic.  I agree with others regarding organic choices for common things, that they don't always live up to it, but these exceed those standards.  I am a family physician and bought these for my practice to replace the splenda sugar free suckers and am proud to be rid of those chemicals that were being distributed to my patients.  yummy

column9: SO GOOD!  Helped a lot with morning sickness :D
column10: I had morning sickness so bad it lasted all day and for 5.5 months, ugh!  I called it baby flu since there was little relief.  Ginger ale and YummyEarth organic candies were the only two things that settled my stomach enough to eat a small meal.  The assorted bag was nice to switch it up depending on my taste that day.  After I delivered my baby girl, I still enjoyed these when I have a dry mouth or would like a little sweetness.  It was so nice to find a tasty organic hard candy, so much tastier than Preggo Pops!

These are the most delicious lolly pops!!  I've purchased them from several places (Vegan Essentials online, Whole Foods store) and never found them anywhere near this cheap. At Whole Foods, a container with 30 pops was $7.50- on sale!  These are great, and especially with the automatic re-order, they are really an excellent and unmatched value. I keep them on my desk at work so when people stop by to visit they can have a snack. Thanks for the great product and price.

column9: YummyEarth Organic Lollipops, Assorted Flavors, 5-Pound Bag
column10: These taste very good. I didn't count up how many of each one but it looked like a fair mix. I like that they don't have a lot of sugar and they have a strong fruity taste.
Lollipops with natural sugar, natural flavors, and no artificial colors.  My boys love them, and the kids at synagogue also enjoy.  The other parents don't mind so much, either.  Great value!

These are truely delicious. Every flavor is good except for the watermellon, which is a bit lame...not much flavor. The only thing is that you do not get even amounts of each flavor- but at random. Despite these small details, these are really really good!

My son, who is allergic to food dyes, LOVES these lollipops. He can eat these colorful treats all day if he wants to without any allergic reactions (that was the draw for me)!! Now, I love these lollipops too.  They are the best!!My son's favoriate flavor is the Cherry.  The Sour Apple is a great flavor too.  They taste just like Granny Smith apples!  I got a lick of my husband's Mango lollipop and wish there were more of them in the five-pound bag, they're too good to describe.  Pomegranite, Strawberry, ...LOVE-EM!In short, If you are looking for a great treat for your little gremlins, these lollipops are it.  They are easy to take with you wherever you are going, and it seems to get quieter whenever the kids stick them into their mouths!  I keep a couple in my purse.

column9: Flavor can vary from batch to batch

Some (not all) of the TooBerry Blueberry in this bag do indeed did taste like wet dog! Most tasted fine though. All of the other flavors taste fine. I keep a bunch of these on my desk at work and people are always amazed at how good these are. The flavors are amazing.
these are the best organic pops i have tried so farthis 5 pound package is the best value around, especially with subscribe and savehighly recommended

If you have to have a lollipop these are pretty good ones to have. Natural. Organic. Free of most allergins(safe for most "allergy kids"). Great flavors (Mango, Pomagranite, Watermelon, Apple, Blueberry, Cherry, Grape). Colors from beets, carrots, berries, etc. Kids and adults love them. I have been using them for years at schools and public events, and people ask for them over every other major brand lollipop I try.
My kids love these suckers and I bought them to give away at a home show my company was involved in. Some people even came back to get another because they are so good!

column9: a big fan of these candies
column10: This was our second order of the 5 pound bag and we are still delighted with these lollipops.  My son has multiple food allergies and sensitivities and these candies have never caused a reaction.  It is so nice to be able to give him a treat like every other child.  There is only one flavor in the mix that he does not care for, but I like it so it works out well!The bag contained 323 pops and all the flavors promised.  All candies and their wrappers were in good condition.  I find it to be a fair assortment.  The wet face watermelon had the highest percentage at above fourteen percent, the lowest was a tie between sour apple tart and googly grape at almost eleven percent each.
Bought these for kids at church as 'motivation'...  Parents love that they are organic!  Kids tell me they are the best suckers EVER!!

column9: Everything you could ever want in a lollipop.

I was just looking for candy without dyes for my children.  We were excited to find some.  Now I make sure to never run out of these!  They are absolutely delicious!  So much more flavorful than any other lollipop I've ever had.My kids don't get stuff with dyes so if someone gives them something, they bring it home and trade with me.  I used to eat their stuff with dyes but then I realized they were getting the great stuff and I was stuck with the mediocre.  So now we just throw away the other stuff and all have a good, dye-free lollipop!

Who cares about the ratio of flavors - I'm just glad to have a healthy alternative for my kids.  Ordering another 5-pound bag to get muled down here (and isn't ironic that I can't get it here in Mexico even though it is made here???)

column9: Great Lollipops.  Even Grape tasted great!
column10: These lollies are delish.  I love all the flavors, even grape, which is usually not my flavor of choice.  It just might end up being my favorite flavor of these.  But then again, it would be hard to choose, because they are all just so darn good.  Watermelon is my least favorite, but my son's #1 request, so it works out perfectly.I got a pretty even assortment, ranging from about 30 to about 50 of each flavor.  I counted about 320 pops, so pretty close to the estimated number. But, these are based on weight, not quantity, when packaged.I am on weight watchers and 3 lollipops are 2 points on the new points plus program.  So I get to satisfy my sweet tooth, without a lot of guilt.I bought this 5lbs assortment and also the smaller container, so that I could refill the container from this bag.  Let's just say, I have enough lollipops for the rest of the year!  (but I don't see a problem with that) :)

I didn't want to buy them something with a lot of added sugar - which these don't have. What's also great about these lollipops is there are a lot of flavors to choose from. My nieces love the variety and love the taste. And since this was a 5 pound bag and thus there were lots of lollipops I took some for myself and I love the taste as well. There isn't a flavor I don't like.

Yummy Earth makes awesome lollipops!  It is so nice for my daughter to share these with her friends who have food allergies and know they are safe for our gluten free needs too.  The only flavor that has gotten a thumbs down from our family and most (all?) of her friends is Tooberry Blueberry.  Though they are organic, that flavor tastes artificial and rather unpleasant.  I figure at some point, there will be nothing left but TooBerry in the bag.I have used these to melt and mold with my own hard candy molds and they came out great!  It is so hard to find special occasion candy that is organic/natural, allergy friendly and reasonably priced.  None of the kids get left out on special days!

I love these little suckers! I ordered 2 bags for my wedding last June, and my friends all still ask about them so I ordered another bag for Christmas. I use them to dress up wrapped presents or to include in gift bags.

OMG these are soooo delicious!! I bought them solely off of positive reviews on Amazon and I am NOT disappointed in the least! These are tiny but pack soooo much flavor AND they are healthy! I am eating a Very Cherry one as I write this and my mouth is so happy! I will be buying these for the rest of my life! You HAVE to try these just once!

Kids love them.  I keep them in the same place and my grandchildren and visiting children know where they are and run to them as soon as they come over.  I buy them buy the 5lb. packages for the value.  Nothing artificial in them and they are gluten free which is great for our family.  Ordering is easy and product usually gets to me faster than promised.  Will definitely keep ordering this product.
My girls adore these suckers. They are fantastic and taste like the real fruit. They will toss down another sucker just to have one of these yummy earth suckers.

First of all, I just want to say that I hate lollipops. And I do mean HATE. Even dumdums seem to taste really artificial and just like colored sugar. I got these originally because I was intrigued by the organic label. I love that you can actually understand what's in these items and they have a video showing it being made. Great unique taste as well. Definitely well worth the price! My family and friends love it. The assortment is great and they actually taste like different things rather than a lot of candy that's out there.

I've learned that sharing these lollipops has made me more popular amongst my classmates. I've also discovered that by sharing these delectable treats that I am running out faster than I had anticipated. Everyone loves them. Just be careful that you understand that once you share them than you will have less to enjoy for yourself  because people keep asking me for more.
This lollipops are rather tasty and have some unique flavors such as pomegranate and mango.  We get then every year for Halloween.

Love these lollipops and every child I have given them to always want more. It is exactly what any mom would want in them too. No sugar or anything artifical. You cant even believe what the ingredients are because they taste so good. Several flavors and the sour apple isnt to tart by the way. Amazing and thumbs up to the makers of the product!

I first started buying these when they only had three or four flavors. Now they've expanded their flavors and I like the new assortment, especially the blueberry and strawberry flavors. All the flavors are yummy. There isn't one that we don't like. Also, the ingredient list is more specific than it used to be. No corn syrup, which is the main reason I purchase these. I also like that they are organic. Sure, they aren't exactly like "normal" lollipops, and they contain sugar, but I'd much rather give my children these than artificially colored and flavored candy.

This was the second time I had ordered Yummy Earth Organic pops.  Like so many people these days, my husband and I want to satisfy our "sweet tooth" without consuming nasty chemicals or high fructose corn syrup.  You won't find anything like that in these pops.  They have natural ingredients and taste fantastic.  Believe all the hype in the other reviews.  I finally did, and trust me.... it's all true!!

I love that these lollipops are organic.  I bought them to give as treats to my son.  He loved the one I gave him and then he saw the whole bag...I think the small size is perfect, as it gives me the ability to control the amount of sugar I am giving to my child.  Overall, this is a good organic treat and at ten bucks it was a great value.

column9: Fantastic Lollipops and flavor ratios since I'm a geek :)
column10: These are fantastic lollipops!  And I got a fantastic deal.  Keep an eye on these because they are worth the regular price.  Here is the flavor breakdown in my bag:Pomegrantate Pucker 71 (22%)Mango Tango 49  (15%)Wet Face Watermelon 47 (14%)Strawberry Smash 43  (13%)Googly Grape 40  (12%)Sour Apple Tart 29  (9%)Booberry Blueberry 25 (8%)Very Very Cherry 20  (6%)
Just got these today and sampled a few.  Very yummy and not AS bad as other suckers.  Sugar is sugar, but no corn syrup, artificial colors, etc.  Will keep a bag handy.

These lollipops are a great treat for the kids and for me too.  I have a corn allergy so I can't eat most types of candy but it is nice to finally be able to share something with my kids.  Their loving them more then any other type of candy isn't too bad either.  The flavor in these are just amazing and it is never a bad move to get these.  I have turned so many parents on to them and they agree the flavor is amazing and so far everyone has loved them.

I ordered these to hand them out for Halloween this year, so of course I had to sample some for myself.The lollipops them self are good. In my opinion, they are very sweet and even though some people say they are small... I think they are just the right size for a quick sugar fix.My problem, and I'm probably just nitpicking, is that the stick is so frail. By the end of sucking down a lollipop, the paper part that the stick is made out of would get wet and fall apart, and I'll end up eating some paper at the end. This happens every time.Maybe, if I bite and chew the candy I wouldn't get to where the stick would fall apart... but I suck down and let it sit in my mouth while doing stuff, like playing video game, or watching TV, etc.Other than that, the candies taste great... but I really wish the stick wouldn't tear apart every time, and I end up having to spit out the paper at the end.The flavors in the bag is pretty evenly distributed. So far, I tried all the flavors, and they all taste great. I like the Mango, and the blueberry the most. I think I will keep some for myself and not give all of them away for Halloween.

I don't leave home without them.... they've helped me cut down on smoking, and they taste awesome.  Natural, and clean... real fruit flavors.  Offer them to people thru out the day and get smiles.  what could be better.  the big bag is MY resereve...  got the 30 pc candy jar packs to give out as small thank yous.  Everyone loves them...

I was a bit skeptical about these lollipops because I know certain things just don't taste good when they are organic especially sugary indulgences. So I would always pass up on the buying them. The other day I happened to come across a bag of assorted ones at TJ Maxx. I was craving something sweet some it was just perfect timing that I happened to come across these. I purchased a bag of these and I will be totally honest with you guys!!! These are by far the best lollipops I have ever tasted in fact the best hard candy!!! They are just bursting with flavor!! The best part is that you aren't consuming artificial laboratory made candy. In response to the post bellow, the size is actually just right because a lollipop isn't supposed something you splurge on. It just a little simple indulgence that is good to have from time to time. Kudos Yummy Earth!!! :D

I have bought these for 5 different people and they all love them.  I can't say enough about how yummy they really are!  My students in my classroom will pick these 9 out of 10 times over any other candy.  That is the best review of how good these are!
These lollipops taste great.  Our son loves them and I love that they are made of natural ingredients.  We will definitely get them again!
I bought the bag for Halloween.  Now in 3 weeks, half of them are gone.  :)

I purchased these suckers on the recommendation of several friends. They all raved, but to be honest, I had my reservations. All I can say is WOW! Not only do my children (4 and 2 years old) love them, so do my husband and I. They have flavors that you don't see in your mediocre pack of Dum Dums. The Pomegranate Pucker and Mango Tango are our favorites, which is good because it seems they are in the majority in this bag. I do wish the flavors were a little more evenly distributed but, overall this is a great product and we will def. be back for more!

My title pretty much sums it up.  These lollipops taste amazingly fruity.  They kind of remind me of the Charms Sweet & Sour Pops I used to eat as a kid. They're sweet, but they also have a little bit of a sour flavor.  And they don't taste "off" like some all-natural foods.  They're just yummy.
We absolutely love YummyEarth Lollipops. My son is gluten free and dairy free and I ordered these soon after we started his diet. He particularly likes the grape, but all of the flavors are yummy.

I thought my son's eyes would pop out when he saw all these suckers arrive! 300 suckers are a lot! We got a good assortment of flavors and love them all. His favorite is mango, mine is the blueberry! We have a niece who is allergic to just about everything, yet here was a treat she could enjoy with no worry, it was awesome! They taste great and don't leave that yucky taste in your mouth like so many other suckers.My husband never eats suckers and now he has one of these every night after dinner! They are a hit!
These are so yummy, my kids love them! Comes w/ variety of flavors. Very pleased with order, will order again!
These taste wonderful and are a great reward that I can give my kids with out worrying about what is in the candy.

I bought these when they were the deal of the day so the price was really reasonable. These suckers are not only tasty and organic, this huge bag completely filled up a large vintage candy jar that now sits and looks whimsical in my kitchen. The flavors are delicious and unique and I like that they are organic.

I purchased the Vit. C ones and it really is a relief to me as a mom to give my kids a lil special treat that tastes good and isn't full of fake crap.  Can't wait to try the other flavors they offer (and neither can my kids!)

I would normally buy the organic lollipops at Trader Joe's but one of the 'mommy blogs' I read said that these where on sale for like $13! and that everyone should buy them - I am SOO glad I did! These taste amazing! Def worth the money!

column9: Great taste with a great assortment
column10: They arrived with prime shipping in August perfect - not sticky, not melted.  The distributor for these tells in one of the reviews that you have to order where it says "Ships from and sold by Amazon" to get an even number of all flavors. Look over to the side under the cart and see the vendors listed.  That's what I had to do to find the ones sold/shipped by Amazon.They taste great.  The wrapper for each lollipop tells the flavor.  Three suckers are 70 calories.

I have picked them up at the local health food store for my daughter a couple times before I ordered them. We love them, they are delicious (without the guilt of a usual lollypop).I was concerned they might have melted in the mail, but they arrived in excellent condition.I will be ordering these again! (its going to take us a while to get through all 5lbs of them though)

I read all of the reviews before getting these, and wasn't expecting much. I was pleasantly surprised to find that they were really good!  I think some people's expectations are just too high. I was very happy for the price.

I just received my suckers today and they are really good. Here is the breakdown of what I received:68 mango tango46 tooberry blueberry22 pomegranate pucker24 googly grape20 very very cherry37 strawberry smash56 sour apple tart47 wet-face watermelonI like 4 flavors more (grape, apple, cherry, blueberry) than the others but they all taste good. The best is the sour apple tart! I would recommend these to others.
Best of all, it taste great with cane based sugar and it is organic without any additives.

column9: A tasty treat for the whole family!
column10: The name says it all...  These lollipops are definitely yummy!  My two year old loves them and I do too.  They're delicious, fruity, not too sweet, and contain no artificial colors, flavors, or nasty HFCS. And at only 20 calories per pop, what's not to love?For those of you who are concerned about the new "even assortment," here's the break-down of flavors in the package I just received:Blueberry - 54Mango - 48Apple - 42Pomegranate - 39Strawberry - 39Watermelon - 38Cherry - 30Grape - 28So, it's still not a perfectly exact assortment, but it's close enough for us.(Incidentally, for any expectant mothers who might be reading this review, please note that these lollies are just tart enough to take the edge off that pregnancy nausea. The "Pomegranate Pucker" flavor seems to be particularly good for soothing my queasy tummy.)

My kids love these suckers! I think they have not tried the sour apple but they love all the other flavors. I love that it is vegan and all natural. Will buy again but it will be a while before we can eat all of these.

I keep a box of these out in my office. Just about everyone makes (multiple) daily trips to the box to grab a pop or two. Everyone says the same thing when they try one for the first time, "Wow these are good!".

My kids had tried these at our local health food store and had really enjoyed them. When I saw these in such a large bag, I thought it would be a great idea to save some money and have a yummy, not-so-bad-for-you, treat on hand. I was very pleased when the package arrived! Lots of different flavors and the bag is much bigger than I thought it would be! This will last our family for a long, long time as we are not big on sweets (well, I'm not big on giving my kids sweets I should say! ;).  My daughter reacts poorly to artificial food colorings so this product is a great way for me to reward her, without a total melt down later.  Overall, we are extremely pleased with these lollipops!
I bought this to share with my co-workers and in one week they are gone.

column9: Great product, lots of flavor choices
column10: When these went on sale (5 lb bag for $13.50) I jumped at the opportunity to get a bag.  I have two toddlers, so the small size of candy is great for them to hold and their little mouths.  Good portion size, too.  I use them for rewards, special treats after a meal, or to throw in as party favors.  There are SO many, I'm sure it'll take us at least a year to get through them all!  The taste is pretty good too, not too sweet or bland, and I just love the fact that they're organic of course.  They definitely have more flavor than your run-of-the-mill lollipop, though they get just as sticky :)  We love them and give them 5 stars!
These small treats are great.  Flavorful, not too sweet, give one taste "orgasms."Priced right, good for sharing with co-workers, students, etc.

These lollipops are delicious, to which my toddler aged daughter would readily attest, as would I. It is nice to have a treat that is organic and free of the myriad of chemicals found in most modern candies. Be forewarned: if you have these available, your child (or you) will clamor for them constantly.

taste great and a good buy.  Sugar is all gmo from my understanding now.  We are now moving away from all gmo products.  They contain roundup poison in them permanently and carry it to the next seed.  This will destroyyour intestines.  Thoughts of concern for those who want to listen.  Even if organic if not labeled no gmo or heritage it is gmo.

The pops are great tasting and there has yet to be a flavor that my girls do not like.  They are are better for them than the sugar filled pops you get everywhere else.  The 5-lb. bag will last forever and my girls love them.

I ordered these little organic lollipops to have on hand for my grandchildren when they are here.  I don't think the 4 of them can eat all 500, so I decided to share some with others including each one of their classes at school.  All the children loved the flavors.  They are not just the regular strawberry, grape, lemon and so forth.  Once you try them, you have to have another because they are really good.  I feel good about giving them to the children since they are organic.  Thanks for offering these!

column9: A big hit with my customers!
column10: Based on the reviews, I purchased these lollies to give to my customers even though I had never actually tasted them.  I sell natural beauty products so, I thought they would be a good fit for my boutique.  Well, they are very yummy and my customers can't get enough.  I swear I've had a couple of customers come back in just for these.  Because of popularity, I had to increase my subscription from three months to one month just to keep them on hand.  What I like about them is that they all have full flavor which is unexpected from candy that does not have any artificial flavors.

It's great to have candy that (while probably not good to have as a daily diet) is not bad for the family.  Not to mention the lollipops actually taste great, and are cheerful colors.  Everywhere we share them they are well received.  All natural colors & flavors, yum!  Many repeat orders mean more to share :)

These are the best lollipops ever! I mean...I thought all lollipops tasted all alike until I bought these. I can really tell the difference in the quality of the ingredients!! The flavors are so YUMMY!!I love all the flavors, but my kids are a little more picky as they didn't like the more "exotic" flavors like pomegranate or mango.

I am so very lucky to get this bag full of yummy treats for my family and friends at such a great price (only ~13 bucks!) Unlike some other reviewers, my bag was better in terms of the ratios of the flavors (amounts ranging from 25 to 50) The only flavor I didn't like is Very Very Cherry. But I never liked this flavor anyways. When we had a large picnic, I brought some of these and they were a hit! Everyone was asking about where I got them and commenting how tasty they were, etc. The kids were thrilled and they kept coming to ask for more. All in all, I am very happy with the quality and the features of this product. I'd recommend and buy it again.

I bought these as a potty training incentive. We'll see how that works. I didn't pay anything thanks to gift cards.These are very tasty. They do not taste artificial at all and are very fruity tasting. I am pleased with this purchase, and of course, my two year old loves them! I don't feel bad about letting him have one because I know they are better than alternatives.

column9: Wonderful flavors that all my students love
column10: I bought these to give out to my students at school for rewards, and they love them.  They always ask where I got them because they want to go buy them.  I have always given out candy, but used to give out those little Dum Dum pops.  With those I always had the yucky flavors left at the end of a bag that no one wanted.  With these I never do because there are no yucky Yummy Earth flavors!  They are delicious and the kids love them--plus I don't have to be concerned about allergies to food dyes or anything.  My own kids at home love them, too.  The 5 pound bag is a great deal for the quantity I give out!

I bought these on Amazon special for Haloween and brought the leftovers to work. Everybody is stopping at my desk for one. They are the best tasting lollipops I ever had, nice little lift in the afternoon when you need little sugar.I will be buying another bag when these run out.

We love these! Flavors are excellent, tart and sweet. After eating one of these pops, regular store-bought candy tastes kinda like medicine - yuck. Now if I could just find a place to hide them so my boys don't eat them all at once...

These are the only lollipops that my youngest son will eat or ask for.  I like them too!  Flavors are very good and I appreciate the organic aspect.  Had previously purchased these both individually and in a smaller (150 ct) pkg size at my local whole foods store, so I already knew the quality before purchasing this bulk package.  Good flavor assortment, although as in the 150 ct pkg, the grape and cherry flavor pops seem the least common.  Thankfully, my kids are not grape obsessed - they prefer the sour apple and pomegranate.  I am most impressed with the blueberry flavor, since that is not a common lollipop flavor in general and the flavor is very true to real blueberries.  Will definately purchase again - if I ever find the end of this bag!

I have a son who is allergic to red food coloring and these suckers are great for him. I like the fact that they are all natural and organic. All the flavors taste good and all of my children like them really well. The bag last for several months and is definitely worth what I pay for them. I highly recommend this product and I will continue to purchase them.

YummyEarth Organic lollipops are the best thing that we could have done for the kids that come to see Dr.D.  We treat lots of kids with behavioral issues and learning issues and the whole spectrum of autism and most of them have food allergys and they can't have so many of the treats that most people take for granted.  These are not made with oils from nuts or wheat or corn. So the kids who never get treats get a treat. I use to get them at the organic stores here in Dallas but they stopped selling them in bulk where I was at so I decided to see if you could get them on Amazon.  Not only did they have them but they had them at a great price so I get them in 5lb bags and my kids love them and it makes them feel like someone is thinking about their needs too.

column9: Not just for kids -- Thank You!!
column10: As someone with a number of food allergies, I can tell you these absolutely yummy lollipops hit the target with surprisingly great taste!  This grandma keeps them on hand for the grandkids (and their stockings), and somehow one manages to disappear each night after dinner ...  Saves a lot of calories from not ingesting other types of indulgences, and satisfies that sweet spot!  Great job, YummyEarth!  We'll be back for more -- with our deep appreciation for a safe, allergen-free treat!

column9: YummyEarth Organic Lollipops, Assorted Flavors, 5-Pound bag
column10: I love these lollipops.  Every flavor is great except for pomegranate pucker it has a slight medicine taste.  Besides that these suckers are delicious.  I got an even amount of each flavor in my bag.  I don't know what the other reviewer is talking about when they say you get like 5 of one flavor and 100 of another.  My favorite flavor is wetface watermelon.  With the 5-pound bag and the super-saver shipping you end up paying like $0.07 a sucker.  What a deal!  I highly recommend these suckers.

column9: Great for giving to the kids but better to keep for yourself!
column10: These suckers are yumalicious! We bought 10 pounds of them to pass out on Halloween. We already knew we liked them, sweet and sour fuit yum yum, so we were pleased to pass them out on Halloween. Only we liked them too much......A couple pounds made it out the door and the rest...muahh ahhh ahh, too good to give away!LOVE these suckers, especially the sour apple...and strawberry smash..ohhhh and the wet face watermelon........Can't type...gots to go get me another sucker!
These lollipops were VERY tasty.  We love the fact that they don't contain a lot of the 'junk' normally present in most candy.  Highly recommended!

These are wonderful treats for kids and adults alike. Everyone who tries one, loves it. It doesn't even matter what flavor, as they are all delicious. I ordered a container for the office and had to get the 5-pound assortment for home to hand out for trick or treat. Thankfully, there were plenty left over for my family to enjoy. You won't go wrong buying this delicious organic candy.

There are over 300 small lollipops in this bag, and each one of them is a sweet little treat.  Mango Tango, Blueberry Tooberry - excellent flavors.  The kids we handed them out to for Halloween loved them, and I certainly enjoyed the twenty or so I squirreled away for my fellow employees and I.  I honestly couldn't tell you what was (or wasn't) in the lollipops that made them taste great, but I can tell you I didn't feel like I had been sweetened out after eating one of them.  If you like fruity candy and not feeling like crud after eating some, these are good way to fulfill a craving and deny some sour stomach.
I really enjoyed the 5 lb bag of lollipops. They are so tasty and it was a great price too! I definately recommend these pops to everyone.

I bought these to give out to trick-or-treaters, but had to do a little quality control before handing them out. :) They taste great!  My 10 year old and husband and neighbors agree.  We had almost 2,000 trick-or-treaters (no, that's not a typo) and it made me feel good to give them healthy candy!  Will definitely order again.

Great price and will get again and again.  Excellent flavor.  It actually tastes like the flavor it says.  Not a big variety in colors due to only a few natural die colors but who cares when they taste great, you can't see it when its in your mouth anyways.

PROS: This 5-pounder packs up heavily for the entire family (or even the office) to enjoy. Yummy flavors, that's surprisingly all natural & organic (how can anything so delicious be so organic?).Not too sweet, and really intense flavors, as well.CONS: Packaging needs heavy improvement, as some of the sticks protrudes on the thin plastic packaging. Also had 2 opened pops, and 2 sticks (without the lollies) inside.Varieties were inconsistent, had way too many watermelons, and too few blueberries....but who's complaining anyways??? :)

I LOVE these lollipops, and have never tried a flavor I didn't like.  I definitely appreciate the lack of high fructose corn syrup and artificial colors when I'm looking for an occasional treat to satisfy my sweet tooth!There is a nice mix of flavors, but for those who are picky, they are not evenly distributed.  Of the 330 lollipops I received in my 5-lb. bag,64 (19%) Tart Sour Apple58 (18%) Googly Grape39 (12%) Mango Tango32 (10%) Strawberry Smash28 (8%) Ginger Zest25 (8%) Wet-face Watermelon24 (7%) Pomegranate Pucker22 (7%) Cheeky Lemon17 (5%) Orange Squeeze11 (3%) Blood Orange Cocktail8 (2%) Very Very Cherry2 (<1%) Tooberry Blueberry

column9: flavor ratios - NEW and EXCLUSIVE for Amazon (but not for "fulfilled by Amazon")
column10: UPDATED 09-02-10 - We hear you loud and clear, amazon lolly lovers!!! We have changed to an almost even assortment of flavors per 5lb bulk bag and Counter Bin EXCLUSIVELY FOR AMAZON so make sure you are buying from Amazon directly (it will say "Ships from and sold by Amazon" under IN STOCK).  Sorry, the assortment is still random when buying this item via a 3rd party, such as DAB Nutrition "fulfilled by Amazon". Please note that the assortment is ALMOST even as compared to a completely random flavor assortment. Your feedback drives this company from ingredient requests and allergy needs to flavor requests to flavor ratios. We appreciate your feedback and hope that you know that we are listening. I am truly sorry for posting this note here with a 5 star review since I do not want anyone to think that we are trying to mislead anyone with a "fake" product review, but I could not really figure out any other way to communicate this to our Amazon friends. Thank you again for your wonderful reviews!

Dealing with an allery to corn isn't easy, but these lollipops sure make it seem a lot easier.  They're wonderfully flavored, organic, and made by a company who honestly cares about its customers.  These are a great find and a staple of my house. They're just awesome, its hard to believe they're corn-free.

I am a BIG fan of lollipops, and I have to report that these are, hands-down, the best I've ever tasted. The flavors are original and tasty, and the shape of the pop is just right.  And, I don't have to worry about ingesting the great unknown yellow #5 or red #2.  Go Yummy Earth!  I can't wait to see what these guys come out with next!

If there is a great sale on an Amazon product and I have amazon gift certificates, invariably I will make a purchase if the reviews are up in the sky.  And just as often, when the product arrives, it does so fresh from it's crash back to earth.And so it goes with Yummy Earth's Organic Lollipops.  I am now the owner of 700 of them, and while they aren't disgusting, they definitely aren't deserving of the praise received.  Most reviewers have given them 5 stars, a constellation I now refer to as "Ignoria-Major."The flavors are OK, ranging from the avoidable Grape and Strawberry, to the sparse but good Sour Apple and Blueberry.  And despite the photographs, these lollipops are relatively small; more like small pieces of hard candy thrown on a stick for lollipops sake.For the reviewer who claimed they lacked sugar, the primary ingredient is Evaporated Cane Juice.  That's sugar, just not refined in the way sugar usually is.So my suggestion is simple, and one I address more to myself than perhaps you:  Don't be afraid of missing out on the sale, because it might actually be a good thing.  Find the item at a local store, buy a small amount, and go from there.

Can't go wrong here.  Intense flavor and impressive ingredients.  I love 'em and everyone I give them to loves them.  Get a load of these ingredients:  organic evaporated cane juice, organic tapioca syrup (no sulfites added), non-GMO citric acid (from non-GMO sugar beet), organic & natural flavors* (watermelon, pomegranate, orange oils, lemon oils, raspberry), organic & natural colors (red cabbage, purple carrots). * = Cheeky Lemon, Wet-Face Watermelon, Pomegranate Pucker, Orange Squeeze, & upcoming Mango Tango flavor contain some amount of orange or lemon or citrus oils (0.58% of the natural flavor formula of watermelon is derived from lemon oil). Safflower oil is in the Wet-Face Watermelon and upcoming Mango Tango.  HOLY COW!!!  AND THEY'RE REALLY REALLY GOOD!

They are sweet without being just another blob of solid corn syrup.  They have a wonderful fruit flavor and smell divine.  They don't have that fake smell.  They smell like real fruit.  Their smell has prompted several people to stop us and ask what our kids had because they wanted to go an buy some too.  They are a hit with kids and adults here.

I bought this product after reading the reviews.  And I must say they are sooo good.  I thought Jolly Rancher flavors were great, but these are by far better than ranchers.  They don't burn your tongue, and the size of the lollipop is perfect - not to little, not too much.  I took it to my workplace and folks loved it.  I also shared it with a friend who's a teacher and she passed it to the kids in her class as treats.  She told me the kids loved it as well.The reason I'm giving 4 stars is because there is room for improvement - I wish they add more flavors.

column9: the best lollipops I ever had
column10: my friend told me how she loves these YummyEarth lollipops, so I bought a bag to share at work.  everyone loves them like crazy and we're almost done with them in just a few days.  really packed with great flavor.  different than other candy.  very fruity and real tasting, not like overly sugary fake flavor of regular candy.  just awesome taste.  pretty cool, too, that it's organic.

I loved the product, however the flavors listed were not the ones in the package. There were no Razzmatazz Berry, or Orange Squeeze in the package. either the item should be relabeled with the correct flavors or better packaging needs to happen.

I bought these lollipops mainly because I have a child with food allergies and these were a safe candy alterative.  They are delicous.  I love the flavors (pomegranite is my favorite) and they are unique.  I highly recommend these, they really are tasty (and great if you have food allergies).
These were good suckers but you get more of some flavors than others.  They're not evenly packaged.

These lollipops are GREAT!  We bought them from our local grocery store for a while, but they were a bit expensive.  When I found them on sale on Amazon (a little over $0.04 per lollipop), I bought 2 bags for us and more for our friends.  Everyone I've given some to LOVES them.  It's great to see even picky kids who normally eat the artificially flavored candy, saying that a pomegranate lollipop is delicious! :)In the latest bags I ordered (and my friend found the same), I'm sad to see there are no ginger or lemon flavored lollipops.  I love the ginger and she loves the lemon.  I hope they haven't discontinued them!  I am excited to see more blueberry ones now, though.I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THESE!
It's a giant bag of tasty lollipops that also happen to be organic.  What's not to love?

column9: YummyEarth lives up to it's YUMMY name!
column10: I bought these for the office.  One person in our office has to have gluten free products and we have people with allergies. column9: Good, but flavors are hit and miss--uneven distribution of some flavors
column10: I for one like that they're smaller--It's by weight, not by lollipop, and if you really want you can have more than one anyways. Who wants their kids eating such big candies anyways? The flavors tend to be hit or miss.Pomegranate Pucker tasted like cough syrup, Too Berry Blueberry tasted exactly like blueberry, with a hint of creaminess. Mango Tango tasted like dehydrated mango pieces that they put in organic cereal--it tasted stale, like dried mango that has been on the shelf for far too long. Strawberry Smash tasted like strawberry Fig Newtons which if you haven't had before don't really taste like strawberries. On the plus side, Very Cherry tasted like any other cherry lollipop, Sour Apple tasted like a fresh pear (probably sweetened with pear juice) and Wet Face Watermelon comes close to Jolly Rancher's watermelon with a slightly muddled flavor that isn't as crisp as Jolly Rancher's.I've gone through the entire bag and sorted them to find out approx how many of each there are in the bag. Note that I didn't count each one (sorting them took long enough as it were).Sour Apple Tart- 25%>Very Very Cherry- 20%<Strawberry Smash- 20%>Pomegranate Pucker: 10%>Mango Tango: 10%<Wet Face Watermelon-10%>Too Berry Blueberry: 4%<Googly Grape:1%>Blood Orange Cocktail- 0%I'm not sure why I didn't get any Blood Orange Cocktails but the following flavors seem to have been discontinued and will not be included in future bags (unless you get an older bag)Googly Grape (being phased out, only got 8 in the entire bag--tasted like any other grape candy)Mango TangoGinger ZestCheeky LemonStar for Star explanation:+1* for organic ingredients+1* for invested founders+1* for cherry, apple (just call it pear!) and watermelon flavors-1* for mango and pomegranate-1* because premium gourmet lollipops still take the cake in terms of flavor. It's hard to beat the cherry/strawberry/blueberry cheesecake and raspberry lemonade flavors other brands offer.Looks like most of the grosser flavors like pomegranate are going to the neighborhood kids this halloween. The best part of these is that they don't splinter or cut your tongue like a razor blade and don't leave a chemical aftertaste that some lollies do. Hopefully my kid nieces will enjoy these tremendously, as they're the ones I originally bought them for.Notes to the founders of Yummy Earth:I'd like to mention that the naming of Wet Face watermelon is very unfortunate as it reminds me of an offensive racial slur in case the owners of the company happen to come across this review.I'd love to see the following flavors added to the line: cinnamon, lemon and a true sour green apple (add a citric acid to the apple recipe). Keep pear and reintroduce it as "Perfectly Pear", or whatever wacky name you guys like. Create a cheesecake line and I'll single handedly keep you in business!Now if you excuse me, I'm going to brush my teeth furiously and eat some saltines to calm my stomach after taste testing everything.

I was very excited at the thought of being able to be able to enjoy "candy" again though so I went ahead and ordered them. After getting them, I ate a couple the first night and woke up the next morning congested and with a sore throat. I thought nothing of it other than that it was spring-related allergies. I ate a few in the next few days or so though and had the same reaction. I then read the ingredient list and discovered brown rice syrup on it. I am really tired of companies that market themselves as "organic" and "all-natural" sticking GRAINS into everything! Rice is not good for you - and if you have an intolerance to grains like I do - DO NOT buy these lollipops. I have Celiac disease and my body does better without grains and these lollipops!
