column9: Our family, all grown-ups, really likes these candies
column10: I bought the 5-pound bag of organic lollies on a whim; I hardly ever buy candy. But I know my son and my DIL do like to eat sweets, and so I gave them a bunch of these, thinking that these candies might be less toxic than most. Best of all is that there is no high-fructose corn syrup (HFCS) in them. (They are sweetened with cane juice). HFCS is linked with diabetes and it is in virtually ALL the sweets in the US. I'm also glad that here are no GMO's--another ubiquitous "yucky" thing we have here so much. Also, none of those artificial dyes which anyway come from petrochemicals, so why should they be "edible"? They made all the colors and flavors from PLANTS! Of the flavors I have tried so far, I like "sour apple". Tart and tasty, and not too sour. The strawberry tastes nice and fruity. The grape tastes basically like every other grape candy. There's lots of flavors.Here's a list of the ingredients, in case you want to know: Organic Evaporated Cane Juice, Organic Rice Syrup, Non-GMO Citric Acid (from beet sugar-not corn), Natural Flovers, may contain Organic Black Carrots, Organic Black Currant, Organic Apple, Organic Carrot, Organic Pumkin, Organic Alfalfa.Recommended. Enjoy!

So, I bought these to suck on during my natural labor.  Boy were they tasty!  They are delicious and organic, what could be better?  Also, I have used them for my baby when she gets her vaccinations.  The hospital staff dripped sucrose (sugar water) into my newborn baby's mouth to distract her while taking blood samples from her heel. I was shocked at how she didn't make a peep, but focused on the sweet flavor in her mouth.  Now, any time she gets a vaccine, I put one of these into her mouth for 10 seconds and she doesn't even notice the shot.  Then I get to finish the lollipop.  It's amazing!  And, for those that are wondering, I do exclusively nurse my baby and the sucker hasn't affected that at all.

column9: I am nothing short of amazed!
column10: I found the 45% off deal on a "daily deal website" I check often and after reading that they were Organic...the only thought crossing my mind was GROSS!  I am big into fruits & veggies but every time I try some food that is labeled as "organic", I am almost always disgusted by the taste OR the texture.  I read the reviews on this product on Amazon as well as the other site and pretty much everyone RAVED about how great they were!  I watched the informative video and figured I'd give them a shot.  I figured that if they were horrible, I could always give them out at Halloween (yeah...I'm mean like that sometimes...sorry!)  I just received my lollipops today and I've already tried four of them!  I was absolutely FLOORED by the taste, smell and texture of these lollipops!  Not only did they smell great and the texture wasn't funny...they taste FANTASTIC!  I HIGHLY recommend these to ANYONE that is looking for an alternative to the "big box retail/dollar store" candy that you often give your children.  I plan on sending a bunch of these to my husband and his unit that is currently in Iraq as they will go nuts over these!  The ONLY thing that I can find to "complain" about (and it's really not a complaint...it's more of the single, minuscule difference between these and regular lollipops) is the fact that they opaque whereas regular lollipops are more clear.  Again, that's REALLY nitpicking and it doesn't bother me in the least but I thought it was worth mentioning.  Even the variety of flavors is amazing!  I highly doubt there is a child on this planet that won't be able to find at least one flavor they like!  Another great thing is the fact that the expiration date isn't until January 2011 so if I really stretch out the two bags I ordered, I have the next two years of Halloween covered!  SHORT VERSION: JUST BUY THESE AS THEY ARE FANTASTIC!  YOU WOULD NEVER BE ABLE TO TELL THAT THEY ARE "ORGANIC" AS THEY TASTE BETTER THAN THE INORGANIC ONES WE USUALLY BUY!  Thanks YummyEarth and keep up the great work!  I can't wait to receive the Candy Drops I ordered along with these :)

I am very pleased in the quality of your suckers.  I am a big fan of organic foods.  I had to try one sucker even tho I purchased them for Halloween.  They do have a lot of great natural flavor.  I purchased three 350 count bags, they arrived in excellent condition too. I would  purchase them again.
These lollipops are intense & delicious.  My kids love them, and so do my co-workers!

While these taste great, I can't give it 5 stars due to the fact that I got mostly  blueberry flavor. I was expecting more of the mango but I only counted 7 of them, a bunch of the sour apples and cherry.Once they do a better job at the variety, I will buy more but not for now. They should probably sell them by flavors.

I decided to try these out after seeing a promotional price, and I am SO glad I did.  At first I was wondering what in the world I was going to do with FIVE POUNDS of lollipops, but I now realize that won't be much of a problem around my house (expiration date is two years from now, so there's another plus).The flavors are very unique - not too sweet, not too tart.  My children love them!  I also like the size - I don't feel too guilty giving these to my children when three lollipops (serving size) is 17g sugar.  They're the perfect size.According to the package, they are organic, no artifical dyes or flavors.  I've started taking them to work and they go fast - much, much better than your run of the mill store-bought treat.

These are the greatest lollipops ever! I wrote to them regarding the variety of flavors and the fact that they are made in Mexico. Here's the feedback from the company:The standards are set by our co-founder, Sergio Bicas, who proudly grew upin Mexico City.  We have very high health and quality standards and proudlyhave over 60 fair wage workers as well.Thanks for asking!!!  Every assortment is packed randomly.  Those are surelyextreme, but probably real, examples detailed on Amazon as they have soldzillions of bags.  after seeing those reviews, we have worked hard to makeour flavor ratios more predictable, but the assortments are still random.Otherwise our cost and the retail will go through the roof.Sounds good to me!

Like many reviewers, I bought these when they were on a gold box special. I thought not only are they a great item to give out on Halloween but the company sounds great. I am eating one right now as I am even typing this review! (Mango Tango)I think the flavors are great, but not every flavor is for everyone. One reviewer said he liked the blueberry but hated the strawberry, well I love the strawberry and hate the blueberry. The one reason I am not giving this product 5 stars is because of its sourness. Every flavor seems to have a small level of sourness to it, maybe its because of all the organic ingredients but it does not ruin the flavor of the lollipops.Now I do not have any allergies, nor do I have anyone close to me with allergies but I bought these anyways just to give it a shot. For those who have children or are allergic to corn, glucose etc. themselves, this is the PERFECT treat.(oh and I did not realize how big a 5lb bag was until I got it in the mail, HOLY CRAP! a lot of lollipops!)And in contrast to what another reviewer said, I like the small size of the lollipops, makes me eat less =)

Ok, so now these are the latest and greatest thing around our house. We LOVE these suckers! The size is perfect and the flavors are delightfully simple and fresh.I went through and counted every single lolly after I opened the bag and they contained exactly the right count.I enjoy introducing them to people while telling them that they are 100% natural. They're always surprised!

these are the best tasting, with nothing artificial! can't go wrong.  i keep these in my bag when we go to the bank so i can give my daughter a healthier lollipop.  the watermelon and pomegranate is my favorite.  lemon is a bit overpowering.

column9: The kids love the... and so do the grown ups!
column10: This is the candy our two boys ask for the most. And their friends (and their parents) love them, too.  We gave them out for Halloween and had rave reviews back from neighbors. It's great to be able to give out candy to trick or treaters and to guests that we know won't hurt anyone (no peanuts, no corn, no artificial anything). Just great taste!  Rock on, Yummy Earth.

I discovered a small bag of these Organic Lollipops or "Organic Lollies" as I call them in a supermarket isle (in the cough drops section) - I grabbed them, a bit worried at first cause I thought perhaps they may have been tampered with or a hoax etc.All my fears dissolved as the first lollie dissolved in my mouth!  These things are delicious - I particularly love the TooBerry BlueBerry and Pomegranate!I immediately came to Amazon to see if I can find more - grabbed the 5-pound bag as quick as I could!The only suggestion I could make to the company would be to come out with a set that uses >>ZSweet<< instead of sugar.I feel guilty since I've been trying to cut down on my sugar intake to help lose weight (that was blown out the water by these Lollies) - if I could buy these lollies made using ZSweet, ALL my guilt would be gone - pure, guilt-free pleasure!  Please consider this!Anyway, I'm here again for more - that 5-pound bag is GONE!Simply Delicious!PS - FYI, ZSweet info:"Won't raise blood sugar, Zero calories, 100% Natural, Kosher, VeganSugar-Free, Gluten-Free, Zero Net-Carbs, Zero Glycemic Impact, GMO-Free, Natural, No Artificial Ingredients"Perfect for these delicious lollies!

column9: Great Tasting Organic Candy - Oxymoron?  No!
column10: Wow, this is a lot of lollipops!  Here's what I got:36 = Very Cherry59 = Pomegranate Pucker32 = Strawberry Smash40 = Wetface Watermelon40 = Blueberry Tooberry48 = Sour Apple Tart33 = Mango Tango34 = Googly Grape====================322 Total LollipopsShipping was free and relatively fast.At $30 for a 5 lb. bag with free shipping, this is a good deal and cheaper than if you purchase through YummyEarth's website directly.It mentions this in the item description but I'll mention it again this assortment does not include Hot chili Pops :(Sometimes I can find these at TJ Maxx of all places

So happy you all made these because my child is very sensitive to dyes.  I think there are probably lots of kids with this problem but they aren't even aware of it.  I bought a huge bag and split it up between my two children's teachers to give out as rewards instead of lollipops with dyes.  The kids all love them!  I wish everyone would get a clue and realize how bad dyes are for them.  Thanks for making these.  Please make different kids of candies - like sweet tarts, skittles, starburst, or m & m's type candies.  That would be awesome!  Thanks!

I always put a bowl of candy on my desk, so when people walk by my desk they will say "HI" and grab a candy. This makes everyone happy. I always change different kinds of candy. These lollipops are the most popular. I get many good comments with these. The favor taste great and it's healthy. I think I will stick with this product for a while since everyone loved it so much.

The best part of these Lollipops is that they are made with "Real Fruit Extracts."  Also, there are so many flavors like:*wet-face watermelon*too berry blueberry*sour apple tart*pomegranate pucker*mango tango*googly grape*strawberry smash (5 stars)*very very cherry (4 stars)They are also made in Mexico and coincidently would be a great piñata stuffer.  They are hyped as "the BEST lollipop I've ever tasted" by a TODAY show food editor.  They are about quarter sized and 3 quarters thick sized lollipops hence the large amount in a bag.  At only 17g of sugar for 3 pops (5.7g for 1 pop), they are pretty guilt free without compensating taste. I will update this review as i try all the flavors and rate the lollipops individually from 1 to 5 stars.

I am not a die hard candy person, but these are great!  They do cost a bit more; but they're not that much more.  And besides, you ARE putting it in your body, so I think you're worth it.They are made from real fruit extracts; ironic that that is so rare.  The taste has loads of flavor.  They taste like real fruit.  Nice and tart, not like that sicky sweet that I can't identify in the artificial flavored pops.  Blueberry and cherry are my favorite, but all are excellent.  While not health food, they are a healthier version of junk food.Enjoy!

column9: Disappointed at the company's claimed "even assortment"
column10: The lollipops are definitely yummy. My two little girls love them. I first ordered the counter bin and had only three flavors, very disappointing. Seeing that the company claimed that they made an effort to provide "even assortment" of flavors, I ordered the 5-pound bag. It is not true. Among the different flavored lollipops, my bag had 108 mango lollipops and only 28 grape ones. The order was directly from amazon and not fulfilled by amazon. So, it is not improved at all.

I wasn't sure what to expect as I had never had "organic candy" before.  We own a small family farm and are currently working on transitioning to healthier foods.  However with 5 kids you occasionally need a bribery tool and I like lollipops.  The best part is that my husband likes them.  Though he makes fun of the fact he's eating organic lollipops - he still eats them and likes them!  I already had to buy a 2nd bag as I plan on putting them on our table at farmers markets and such knowing that almost all the kids can eat them!

column9: Very tasty, perfect size for little ones
column10: These are absolutely delicious!  They are the perfect size for little mouths, and the perfect size to curb a sweet tooth.  Haven't found a flavor in the bag that I don't like!
Gave 1,000 out for Halloween.  Gave two to each child.  Will need to order more next year.  Kids loved them, even the parents wanted some.

column9: Delicious and ALMOST an even assortment...
column10: I had to try these for my family. I love that they are organic and made with all real ingredients!! Our kids love them and so do we. I can't say that they're MAGICALLY better than every other lollipop I've ever tasted, but their ingredients win me over when it comes to choosing a "healthier" sweet option for my kids. I'm always trying to stress to them that there is candy out there that isn't full of dyes and chemicals. You don't have to poison yourself to enjoy something special. If you're gonna have a sweet treat... these are great! My ratio of flavors (and I bought them "Ships from and sold by Amazon" under IN STOCK) was:17 x pomegranate20 x mango33 x cherry36 x grape42 x sour apple44 x blueberry52 x watermelon75 x strawberrySo... not TOTALLY even, but I still got a nice assortment. I only felt cheated on the mango because they're my favorite of the bunch. Luckily we also love strawberry! Nice lollies.

This is a great product... my kids love it as much as the tootsie pops/blow pops, and I love how healthy it is.  Nice to see such a tasty product without the junk food coloring... thank you yummy earth!!

I am a high school teacher and I have been giving these to my students.  They love these lollipops and I also enjoy them too.  I feel better knowing they are organic and have no artificial flavors or ingredients.

These are the best lollipops I've ever had!  Sadly, they are not available via Amazon directly at the moment, so no "guaranteed" flavor ratios.  The bag I got was:65 Strawberry Smash60 Tart Sour Apple39 Googly Grape35 Tooberry Blueberry33 Wet-faced Watermelon32 Mango Tango30 Pomegranate Pucker28 Very Very Cherry1 Mango (no Tango; was only one of the colors ;) ...)So, a total of 323, pretty close to "as advertised".  I was surprisingly fond of flavors such as the strawberry and watermelon, which I generally don't like in other candies (artificially flavored ones).  However, the blueberry and mango fell a bit flat.  In general, though, these are the best approximations to real fruit flavors I've come across in hard candy before.  Hope the trick-or-treaters enjoy them as well!

These are SO good.  I had heard of them from someone, but wasn't sure that something that sounded so good for you could really be good as candy, but I was pleasantly surprised!  Each of my 4 kids love them and ask for them daily, although I try to reserve them for special treats.  My husband has taken them to work to eat at his desk and now the guys he works with are asking him about them.  GREAT product!
a great little candy - tastes good - really fruity and not too sugary! my 2 yo son loves them (allergic to wheat and dairy)

I purchased these as a nice treat for our 4 children. I try not to buy foods with artificial colors or flavors so when I saw these we tried them. All the kids and adults like them. I will certainly buy them again.

column9: great taste but poor mix of flavors
column10: I had purchased these once before, in a health food store at a premium price and really liked them so I didn't hesitate when I saw this big bag for a great price (the price seems to swing quite a bit so you may want to watch it for a few weeks until it lowers before you purchase). It's great to find something for a small treat that is free of corn syrup and is naturally flavored and colored. They're just 22 calories each but are on the small side for a sucker. I would like to see them made in the US (they are made in mexico) or at least have this fact noted so I would have known before I bought them. All of ours but one had wrappers on and only a couple were cracked so it seems that they have pretty good quality control.The other big issue is the flavor distribution. Our favorite flavor is blueberry and our least favorite is apple. Nearly half of the over 300 suckers were apple and only three were blueberry. With two adults and three kids there wasn't even enough for us each to have just one blueberry. There were also only about five of the watermelon. The remaining flavors were reasonably evenly distributed. I still like the product so I'll likely purchase bags of individual flavors in the future and use the surplus of apple as halloween handouts. I contacted the company after receiving them and they were very nice about it. They said I could send back the apple ones and they would replace them with other flavors but I realized that it would cost half of what I paid for the whole bag plus and hour of my time to do this so I decided to hang onto them. If the flavors could be a more even distribution this would be a five star product. So many reviews say there were only a couple blueberry in the bag that it makes me wonder if they use these bulk bags to get rid of the flavors that aren't selling well in the individual bags.Keep in mind before you buy these that there are about 325 suckers in this bag, it's the size of a throw pillow.

Imagine a yummy treat to hand out to all your friends, BUT its organic and healthy. Well they've invented these lollipops that are allergen free, gluten free, egg free, soy free and dairy free. So anyone can eat them. Don't worry about a thing, these tasty treats come in a 5 pound bag approximately 350 pops. These are all natural and are good for your kids. Keep them away from the white sugar they get too much of.

This is the second YummyEarth product I have tried and I commend them on their efforts.  Purchasing a 5-pound bag is not something I usually do, but I was able to pass the wealth around to friends and get their comments as well.  My biggest compliment for this product is their ingredient list, it does not get better than that when you look at most other products out there.As for taste, I enjoyed about 75% of the flavors in the bag.  That was also the general opinion of others that tasted them.  The Very Cherry, Mango Tango, Strawberry Smash, and Pomegranate Pucker were among the favorites.  The Tooberry Blueberry did not rate very high on the scale and unfortunately the bag I received had a ton of them.  But I guess you can't like every single flavor.  ;)  Generally speaking though, these were well received and I look forward to trying other YummyEarth products.

I am part of a sustainability group at my university and we used it as a prize for our marketing events. The flavors are good, except for the blueberry one oddly. I love blueberries, but this one just doesn't taste that great. I also wish that since this is organic, they would go all the way to make it sustainable from the plastic wrapper and stick.  I know it's not really a strong implication of being organic, but it would be nice.

column9: Long Lasting Great Taste! Organic Sweets!
column10: I got this bag of 500 organic lollipops on a lightning deal at a great price so that if I had any Halloween callers I'd have something to give them by the handful.  The bag of 500 was a much better deal than the tub of 150 lollipops.Was I in for a surprise!  These lollipops are very tasty!  I sometimes have a sweet tooth and these also slow down how much sugar I have... because I eat only one at a time... not like cramming a candy bar or two down quickly. Reminds me of the picking the old penny/nickel candies by what would last the longest. :)These get my 5 star recommendation. I had an even assortment of many different varieties in my bag... anything orange or yellow was in short supply.  Flavors are delicious!  I'd recommend these for anyone with a family... a sweet in the lunch box... a treat anytime!  Instead of a cookie jar, or in addition to, you could also have a lollipop jar. :)

I bought the 5 lb bag.  Mainly for my cousin who has food allergies, but also for Halloween.  I made 200 treat bags and still had plenty left to bring to work, where they promptly were gobbled up. The flavors were intense in a good way without being over powerful and I didn't feel the usual sugar rush after eating one. A big plus for a diabetic.  They were a little on the expensive side, but as my mom says you get what you pay for.I was very happy with the purchase and will definately be buying these again. wayyy before next halloween.

I bought a 5-pound bag of YummyEarth lollipops when they were on sale as Amazon's Gold Box Deal of the Day. The price was right, and I thought they would be the perfect candy to hand out to trick-or-treaters on Halloween. At the same time, I also bought a YummyEarth Organic Lollipops, Assorted Flavors, 150-Count Container. I figured I might as treat myself to some of the suckers, too. Well, the day the package arrived, I opened up the 150-count contaniner and put it on the kitchen counter. When my kids (they're 13 and 19) got home from school that day, they asked, "What are those?" I told them they were organic lollipops that I got from Amazon. Of course, when they heard the word "organic," they made a funny face and passed the suckers up. Meanwhile, I sampled all of the flavors and was very impressed (and a bit surprised) at how great they tasted. The next time the kids looked at the suckers, I told them that they really should try them because they're REALLY good. Long story short: My kids finally tried the lollipops, loved them, and have now asked if we can hand something else out on Halloween. They do not want to give up their YummyEarth lollipops! The other day, when I reminded my youngest son that the suckers are organic, he replied with: "Who cares? They're delicious!" If that's not a testament to how good these things are, I'm not sure what is!

column9: The best deal on the best lolly!
column10: I bought several of these in the 150 count bins when they were the Amazon Gold Box deal of the day and had them sent to various family members (of all ages) a week or so before Halloween.  They were a unilateral hit!  I also purchased the 5 lb bag for my own household (3 kids, 2 adults) and wow - are they popular!  I haven't heard a negative remark yet and there's not a flavor in the bag that isn't mouth wateringly yummy.  We'll be buying again!

I ordered two 5 lb bags during the Gold Box sale. They really are quite good, I must say. The flavors are true to the fruit, a bit tart....just the right amount..and not too sweet.  I seem to have received a pretty good mix of flavors, but I did not go through and separate each to verify.  My family is enjoying them.

My kids love these, and like a lot of reviewers have said, they don't have corn syrup or chemical artificial sweeteners in them. It's still candy, but treat wise.. it's a treat I don't mind my kids having in moderation.

column9: as good as any sucker I have had
column10: There isn't much to say.  The bag is 2268 grams and each sucker is right at 6.5 grams of weight.  They are very flavorful. I don't know what percentage of each flavor I have in the bag and I am not going to count.

Kids absolutely love these...great flavors without being overpowering...will definitely buy them again.  (Assuming Amazon still carriess them...will take quite a while for us to go through the 10-lbs we bought!!!)
Great buy, always paid a lot for these at the health food store.  Great to not give your kids lollipops with artificial color and preservatives!

column9: A delicious treat for the whole family
column10: These lollipops are so good! They actually taste like the real fruit. I love the all natural ingredients as well as the fun and unique flavors. I keep a handful in my purse for those little moments when I want to treat my kids. The funny thing is I think my husband and I like them as much as the kids do!

column9: Delicious and Best Option Out There
column10: We are very health conscious people and now that our son is 2 and Halloween is approaching we decided to buy this HUGE bag of organic fruit juice lollipops.  We plan on having them so people in our neighborhood can give him this instead of the processed sugar candy bars.  These are great to have on hand in the diaper bag too for when we get haircuts etc and they offer the dum dum lollipops (worst kind in my opinion).  You will be so pleased when buying these!!  Absolutely delicious flavors!!

column9: Not only for G audiences -- Adults love these, too
column10: The YummyEarth Organic Lollipops have exceeded my expectations.  Initially, I was intimidated by the sheer number of lollipops in a 5 pound bag and couldn't decide which flavor to try first.  With my eyes closed, I selected one, unwrapped it and stuck it in my mouth.  Immediately, my eyes teared up with joy as I enjoyed the lovely and tart flavor of the tooberry blueberry.  Although it didn't cry out "blueberry" to me, the flavor was exquisite, the texture was solid and the two-tone color was appealing.  Several of us have tried an assortment of flavors and despite the names not truly reflecting the tastes of some, every single person asked where they could get these lollipops.  We all had similar experiences as the suckers dissolved in the mouth at a uniform rate, no holes developed in the candy, they remained on the sticks until the consumer wanted it removed, the paper stick didn't dissolve with the sucker or give the yuck reaction of other lollipops, and we all wanted another after the first.  Review the ingredient list and you'll see why although not sugar-free, they are free of crummy forms of sugar and if you eat one of these, it's not likely that you'll suffer dire consequences, even if you don't normally consume products containing sugar.  I plan to keep these on hand at all times, carry some in my bag, and share them with anyone who knocks at my door, but it's likely that as the bag contents dwindle, so will my generosity.  I very strongly recommend these if you are in the market for something a little sweet!

We're always trying to find healthier alternatives for our kids, ages 3 and 19 months.  When I saw that Amazon was running a special on them, I decided to snag several bags & am glad I did!  WOW!  These are excellent.  The flavors are incredible and both kids are sold on them as am I.  None of that crap that you find in most suckers ... high fructose corn syrup, all of the dyes and colorings.  Just all natural ingredients with an incredible flavor!  As another reviewer stated, there is no rhyme or reason as to how many you get of each flavor, but that's okay by me.  I would have to say one of my favorites is the mango tango.  Yum!  My son has taste tested all of them and there isn't one that he doesn't like.  :-)  And he's a picky kid!  Try them while they are offering free shipping & 45% off the 2nd bag.  It's like getting 2 bags for one and you can put them back for their b-day party grab bags, send some to preschool for party day and pack some in your purse for a quick treat to give the kids while out & about.  Enjoy!  Mmmmmm!

I purchased these to fill my candy jar at work a few months ago, and I've now placed my third order. People go nuts for these things! They are absolutely delicious and have no corn syrup or artificial ingredients, which makes them a winner in my book. They are especially attractive when Amazon runs one of their terrific specials on them. Yeah, they are more expensive than a big bag of Dum Dums, but they are also SO worth it! I'm not even a big fan of suckers and I find myself reaching for them at least a couple of times a week. Perfect when you just want a taste of something sweet.

Got these on sale.  Not usually an all natural ingredients kind of guy, but must say, these lollipops are amazing.  Bought two 5lb bags.  Donated one to our church health fair that my wife organized.  She wanted something for the kids as give aways.  They were absolutely popular with them.  Personally, I think they are great.  My favorite are the  blood orange flavor.  My least favorite are the blueberry.  The pops are sweet, but not over the top, and have just enough zing (tartness) to appeal to grownups.  This is a nice assortment.  I keep them on the coffee table to grab one when I need something sweet.  Great product that you can feel confident that the kids (and yourself) will like and also know that it is all organic.

column9: Yummy is definately the right name
column10: These suckers are absolutely wonderful.  I have many food allergies, particularly to soy and wheat and so far this is the only candy I have found that is free of my allergens.  It is so nice to have something sweet that is convenient as well.  Thanks for developing such a great product.

It's a great feeling as a Mom to give my children healthy snacks.  My husband even likes these!  We bought the bag that has 350 quantity; my only complaint is that there were empty wrappers in the bag--I don't know if I truly received 350 or not.  I didn't take the time to count.

column9: Neighbor kids couldn't tell the difference!
column10: When other kids can't tell the difference (finally) between "their" candy and your (usually gross) organic, gluten-free, dairy-free candy then you know you've hit a home-run; especially when it also has no artifical flavors or colors!  My husband and I also love these lollipops.  We're hooked.  We've found our candy!
Great lollipops!  My kids love them & since we've made the organic switch with our foods in our home this was a must!  Thanks so much for making them

I bought these because I am allergic to artificial colors.  They have a very strong fruity taste and are quite good.  My only complaint is that the 4 flavors do not seem to be equally represented in the packages.  The two red flavors dominate, leaving only a few of the orange, lemon, and other flavor.  Overall a very good lollipop!
I reordered this item since we all liked it.but be aware not to order them in summer weather.candies are melted and sticky...it was totally fresh and had no problem when i ordered during cool season.

I bought these (5 lb. bag) when they showed up as a Gold Box special since Halloween was coming up & I had nothing to hand out to the kiddies & didn't want to just hand out the usual overly sugared junk from my local market. The sale price ($15) was certainly better than what I get for candy at my local health food store, where most candies run at least 5$/pound (& certified organic usually more). The candy arrived (via regular free shipping) 1 week after I bought them (still in time for the holiday). They were packaged in just a plain clear bag (not very heavy duty, but wasn't broken open, despite Amazon's (usual) lack of any insulation in the box.The label on the bag was very bare bones & gave some idea of the ingredients, but was not up to usual standard for selling in a store.[direct from the label:] Ingredients: Organic Evaporated Cane Juice, Organic Tapioca syrup and/or Organic Rice Syrup, Non-GMO Citric Acid (from beet sugar - not corn), Natural Flavors, may contain Organic Black Carrots [?], Organic Black Currant, Organic Apple, Organic Carrot, Organic Pumkin [sic].Serving Size 17 grams (approx. 3 Lollipops): Calories 70, Total Carbohydrate 17g 6% (sugars)....everything else is 0.The label also states "Certified Organic By Oregon Tilth". 100% Natural Flavors. Real Fruit Extracts. 100% Vegan. GMO-free. Allergen Free. Egg free. Soy-free. Nut-free. Gluten-fee [sic]. Gluten-free. Wheat-free. Casein-fee [sic]. Dairy-fee [sic].  & an additional label that states "Best By 09/23/11".Now, I was a bit skeptical about these, particularly since I am a long-time Organic consumer. There are several organic candy manufacturers near me & I have not seen this label in my local stores. The label only added to my skepticism about whether the contents were really organic. It does use the USDA symbol on the package, but identifies an agency I never heard of as the one that did the certifying. The ingredients listing only added to my skepticism: what is pumpkin & black carrot (?) doing in predominantly red & purple lolllipops? Also, no mention of the actual flavors in the ingredients (except apple) & a rather vague statement about what syrup is used, which all seems rather strange to me. I was also a bit skeptical of the organic claim because these were manufactured in Mexico, which has lower quality control & labor standards than the US (but with the recent scandals about the FDA & USDA's poor regulation of the safety of US food, & with the USDA watering down the "Organic" label from it's initial, stronger standard as created by the CCOF, who knows how food quality would compare any more). Third, the misspellings in the ingredients added to my skepticism.Because of the reviews, I decided to count the flavors of the 325 Lollipops in my bag. Here's the breakdown:Apple 43Pomegranate 39Cherry 34Grape 39Watermelon 50Strawberry 39Mango 46Blueberry 35So perhaps they've improved quality control over the mix breakdown. In the time it took to count the lollipops, I ate 3: Apple was fairly sour, but clearly identifiable as such. Watermelon was also on the sour side, but less identifiably watermelon. Cherry was also a bit more sour than tart or sweet. So far, I liked the flavors (I don't like overly sweet candies, which was another reason I bought these, many of the candies at my health food store are coated in extra sugar & too sweet for me).So the overall verdict so far is pretty good candy in bare bones packagaing. A bit of clarity in the labeling would make these a winner.

Krusteaz Low Fat Oat Bran pancake mix makes great pancakes, even if you don't mix it with any other complete pancake mix.  Once made and allowed to cool, these pancakes freeze well in a freezer bag.  They can be easily reheated in a toaster set on a low setting.  My kids and I all love them.

When we moved from Michigan to Wisconsin, we could not find a store in the state that carried this mix.  We could not find a good subsitute so now we just order four boxes at a time from Amazon.  We really enjoy the pancakes.
The best pancakes with a slight cinnamon flavor, only pancake batter  I have ever tried without eggs and oil that fluffs up.  They in my opinion are the best!!

column9: Not as filling as I would like
column10: I got these pancake mixes for rafting trips to feed a group of 12 and even though the pancakes are very good, they don't fill you up unless you eat of lot of them.

I used these to decorate a Mickey themed baby shower.  They were so cute! Shaped exactly like what you see.  My family loved them! The size of the package is about the size of a small tube of sprinkles.  They go pretty far, one package for a 1/2 sheet cake and 30 cupcakes.  they weren't completely covered with mickeys but it was good coverage.  they were sweet and tasty too! I would gladly recommend using these for Icon Mickey themed pastries. BUT make sure you order them in plenty of time.  I had a last minute order and was sweating their arrival.  Thankfully they arrived just in time!
Loved them!!!!!  Perfect for my son's Mickey Mouse Theme Birthday party.  Size was not indicated when ordered.  It was smaller than I expected.  The container is about 2.5"x1"

The company was great to work with, made it easy to communicate (I was able to track my package).  The sprinkles arrived on time for my sons 3rd birthday and they were a BIG Hit!!  Everyone loved how cute they were and asked about where I purchased them.
These are neat looking.  They melted some in the icing, which didn't look pretty.  Shipping price was a little high.  I got 2 bags but only used half a bag for 2 dozen cupcakes.
They looked super cute on cupcakes and tasted good too!  There were plenty in the package for way more cupcakes then I made.  I made about 24 cupcakes and have a lot left over.
Very cute item. Great for decorating cupcakes or sugar cookies. They were a hit at my twin boy's birthday party.
I was very pleased with the product and the quick delivery. We used it for a birthday cake and have plenty of left over to use of ice cream for my toddler.
These are hard to find and came in record time.Very happy with them.I make cupcakes on the side and they are great for those.
I sprinkled these over the cupcakes and everyone thought it was a great touch.  Loved it.
These sprinkles are the same as what resorts uses in WDW Florida. I made cupcakes like ones at Disney.

column9: okay but less than what I expected
column10: .nothing much to say about them - since it is an item that you can't find in the stores this is the only way to get them! can't wait to make my cookies!

column9: For the price you can't complain
column10: Just looking at the package a lot of them looked broken but once I opened it they weren't to bad. For the price it's not worth complaining and the price is right on.

This spice was perfect for making Punjabi Chhole. The dish turned out delicious and I didn't have to use all the separate spices that this dish normally calls for since it was all in this spice. The spice is quite aromatic and really makes the Punjabi Chhole "pop" with flavor! So glad I bought this. Now I can have one of my favorite dishes anytime!

column9: Great value, great for your health
column10: I'm not naturally drawn to any tea, but for health reasons I've been trying to pick it up for years, mostly trying green teas. I never could make a habit of it until I found a small box of this locally. In the past 5 months, I've averaged 4 cups a day and have officially developed a healthy habit. I'm still not in love with the taste, though I find white tea easier to stomach than some green teas that were grassier, but I do enjoy the experience of drinking white tea and I enjoy its effects. Rather than a caffeine buzz, teas have a balance of caffeine and l-theanine that provide mental clarity and aids focus, and the balance in white tea is just right for me.POP white tea brews darker than a more costly white tea I was given, and I do suspect that darker color means lower quality, but the price is right. The bags also brew more cups than an equivalent bag of black tea, furthering the value. I have no trouble getting 6 large cups of tea from a single bag, and arguably, the second cup is better than the first. I'm on my second box of 100 from Amazon, and having recently discovered this listing that offers subscribe and save, I'm likely to buy much more in the future.  Previously this was an $.08 per day, $.02 per cup habit, but now it could be a $.05 per day, $.01 per cup habit.  How many healthy habits are this affordable?

I really like this tea, but the bags are packed too tightly. The hot water doesn't get into the tea leaves in the teabag. I haven't tried yet but it will probably make a great sun tea. It's a great price for white tea and I have a subscribe and save delivery scheduled. Prince of Peace White Tea is the best.

The Arizona Vanilla Company sent me very rapidly the finest Tahitian Vanilla beans along with very useful general information concerning Vanilla. As soon as I run out of Vanilla beans I will order from Arizona Vanilla Compay again.

Perhaps "Capriefeuille" is a clue especially since I speak French but I have never had completely smooth goat cheese.  Usually it is grainy and I guess that was what i was expecting.  Thinking about it, on a trip to France we were in Lyon for lunch one day at a charming restaurant with some of the best food we had had on this trip.  They served a small portion of smooth goat cheese with herbs but it wasn't as "ripe" tasting as this one I am reviewing.  I will try another goat cheese as Amazon certainly offers plenty to choose from.
This tuna is the only brand that i will buy. i am really picky when it comes to my fish.

This tuna taste the best, imo. And what a bargain it is through Amazon's subscribe & save program! Now's the time to get Tuna Fish, before the sea is too contaminated by radiation, and the fish rendered inedible.

This is bad tuna, can't say it any better. It's flavor and smell tend to be very strong, not what you expect from the top of the line tuna they make. The chunk light they make is slightly better. 1 in 4 cans actually are solid albacore, the other 3 are made up of mush, I can't even call it chunk style. I don't eat tuna in salads or sandwiches, I eat it out of the can. When I buy solid albacore, I expect that, this brand can't be trusted to give quality time after time. DON'T BUY.

My cats love Natural Balance . Chicken & Pea, Venison both limited ingredients. Archie has a chronic dental disease. The canned food is gental on his gums & allows him to get the nutrition he needs. Our boys are big kids, natural balance canned food keeps the calories down. Chicken & Liver is not limited ingredients if you asked them they would tell you how yummie it is.Both cats  7 years old,very healthy & Archie's gums look great.

column9: Cats do not like it but will eat it if no alternative
column10: My cats prefer one prescription cat food or certain grocery store cat food. I have given up trying to improve various illnesses with tailored cat foods until I have the time to feed three different types of food in three different locations or crates.Lesson learned - remove the cats' food bowl when the cat completes the measured meal (stops eating). This prevents obesity. I made this simple change for my large, male cat and he went from 24 pounds to 18 pounds in less than a year.Simply follow the feeding quantity instructions on the package label or what your vet says to feed the cat and remove the bowl when the cat stops eating. Cats on a modified diet will eat all their food at each meal. It's more complicated when you have more than one cat to feed.

Authentic Smokey Mountain origins.....uh no.However, this thick rich habanero elixir has an "instant on" smack you in the face heat factor,and it should cause there's nothing in here except peppers, vinegar, and salt. Lovely!The heat is bearable and the flavor is terrific. I've never seen anything like it, and it makes manythings from Bloody Marys to burgers to Vienna Sausages much improved. I just love the smokedflavor.Now, why the minus one star? These guys are not from the hills of Tennessee or North Carolina, theyare actually up in the Catskills (New York). That ain't exactly what I define as "Appalachian."

At the downtown public market, the hot sauce speciality vendor (who has over a hundred types) recommended this as his favorite. He was correct. Great heat but also a depth of flavor from the fire roasting of the habanero peppers. You'll love it!

column9: Great taste, quite hot but not painful
column10: I've been buying bottles of this hot sauce for over a decade now, enough that I have lost count (which is saying something when it comes to sauces of a given heat level). I think the best pairing I have found for it is with lasagna. Very flavorful, smoky vinegary taste. Heat is maybe an 8/10.
There is nothing better then a broomrape with your manhood....I still can't stop laughing.

These Brownies are nice and cake like, not heavy and fudge like.  They look just like the "normal people" brownies that come in the clear round containers at Costco. I like them even better than I remember those tasting in my pre gluten-free days.  It would be easy to serve the two side by side at a function with the New Grains Brownie Poppers close by with a little gluten free sign. I like feeling like I can have the same food as everyone else. Then there are those times that I hide these in my freezer from the rest of the family and when I want to be really naughty I take one out and and stick it in the microwave for 15 or 20 seconds and then squirt whipping cream on the top before I eat it.  :-)

I love my Galangal powder from Whole Spice, use it in many recipes instead of black pepper since I cannot have black pepper. I like the economic bulk package from Whole Spice.  I keep a glass jar of the powder handy for cooking and refill it from the bag, as needed.  I do keep the open bag and the jar in the fridge but you may not have to do that.

When I quit smoking, I needed something swet to satisfy me, & these did the trick, however they are quite adicting, so I've chosen not to buy them ay more, I do still want the product, I'm now trying to loose weight.

I purchased this boudin in December, kept it frozen for several months and then sauteed it with sliced onions and apples last month. It was delicious and reminded me of the boudin I had in Vendee, France. I recommend this for its good quality and excellent flavor, and am ordering more.Michelle P.

column9: Completely spoiled and even unacceptable for my British family
column10: I was sooooo hesitant about ordering this online, and should have gone with my gut.  When it got to us, I had my British husband open them and see what he thought the quality was.  He immediately insisted on throwing them away due to the rancid smell and told me to contact the seller.  I did just that (TWICE) and never once got a call back or any explanation/refund.  If nothing else, that speaks volumes.
The product has a good strong ginger flavor and is sweet; it is, however, not syrup. Sweet ginger water would be a more accurate description.

Kilimanjaro Foods has created a culinary gem in their Sunrise Ginger Syrup. It's a great mixture of sweet and spicy and my family loves it with fresh fruit. It makes a wonderful tea mix and it we've recently discovered that it tastes great with white chocolate!
Shipment was fast and product tasted good. Not much can be said when you're satisfied with a tasty product except for delicious.

This is an absolute must for Aloe Vera drink lovers. I am so health conscious and in addition to the myriad of benefits of drinking Aloe Vera internally, this particular formula is the best that I have ever tasted. First, it is sweetened with Cane Sugar just like my Boylan Cream Sodas and it has a hint of real grape flavor which makes it go down real easy!  You will be pleased with yourself for this great tasting and 100% Healthy amazing drink.
I have a 30 lb. dog and love these as they are just the right size for her and she loves them! I like that they are just chicken.

column9: Ok, so they're not grown in Italy...
column10: I've tried this brand as well as the "Cento" DOP certified 'grown in Italy" San Marzano, and I'm sorry to say, I do NOT see any difference in flavor. San Marzano is a type of tomato, it is not a locale of where they're grown.Frankly, I almost prefer this brand over the Cento brand because these tomatoes come pre-crushed. This means I don't have to get my hands or a potato masher in there and start tearing up the tomatoes to make them blend inwith the sauce.Maybe if someone is a purist and can honestly distinguish these from San Marzano tomatoes that have been imported from Italy, then they can keep buying the more expensive 'imported' tomatoes.But I just don't see the point in spending $1.50 or more per can to buy 'the real thing' when there's no discernible difference in flavor or taste.Sorry, I just don't feel like belly-aching over something so trivial. I"m baking the pizza for myself and my family, not running a restaurant or trying to satisfy Italian quality laws.I think the DOP designation is over-rated. I'm also not cooking my pizza in a wood-burning oven, so what difference does it make how 'authentic' the tomatoes are?!These tomatoes are just as good as any others. I didn't give them five stars because while I don't see them as being inferior to 'the real thing', I also feel that I can make my own tomato sauce that tastes every bitas good as the san marzano canned tomatoes. So, while these tomatoes aren't bad, they're aren't perfect either. I've yet to find any that are.

This one (sweet sour) and the Kung Pao are very good. Both are better than many Chinese resturants. In the case of the Sweet and Sour the chicken you put in is considerably than the heavily crusted stuff you get at many resturants. I personally stir in a small can of pineapple chunks plus the one that comes in the box and a cut up green pepper and some cut up onion shortly before removing the wok from the stove. Too early overcooks and too soon results in cold spots. I dump the seasoning powder in a large zip lock bag and then toss the chicken in the seasoning. It makes for very tasty chicken. I also go beyond what the box calls for with the Kung Pao. I add some celery, onion and 1" squares of green pepper. I also add a table spoon of red chili sauce to the mix for added spice. It is adequately spicey for most out of the box. I found the spicy garlic to be quite good. I was unimpressed with Cashew chicken.

Great meals for 2!I cut back the 30 minutes the manufacturer states to 15 minutes to prepare this by:Using instant rice and precooked chicken.Also, instead of adding 2 tablespoons of water to the sauce, I didn't drain the liquid in the can containing the water chessnuts and pineapple.Most important are properly coating the meat and cooking it until done. I put the cut up chicken in a ziplock bag and added the seasoned flour mix. Zipped shut the bag and shook until all pieces were well coated. It's simplier and easier than the direction of placing the flour in a bowl and then stiring in the chicken or other meat pieces. Be sure to stir well after adding the sauce and other ingredients, while the skillet is simmering.YUM, YUM, YUM, YUMMY YUM YUM.

column9: Good and Easy to Make Even Better
column10: This, as are all Wanchai Ferry products, is tasty, easy to prepare and very easy to vary.  Since sweet & sour chicken is a little too sweet for our tastes, I add a little Thai fish sauce, Thai chili sauce and some snow peas.  It's easy and everyone loves it.

I bought this product because of the excellent reviews that said it is as good or better than restaurant sweet and sour chicken. The meat turned out good (tried it with pork and chicken) but the sauce has too much vinegar. There is no sweet to this kit. Pineapple does nothing to counteract the sour. I poured the sauce down the drain. So if you like sweet don't buy this product but if you like vinegar then this product is for you.

I bought this because I like sweet and sour chicken. I was not disappointed. Instead of chicken, I use freshturkey breast meat. I also add curry to my rice while it is cooking. I used about 1/2 of the sweet and sourmixture they supply, as I don't like it too sweet. Easy cleanup, as it is all gone!

This product authentically recreates sweet and sour chicken as it was meant to be. Most take out restaurants now serve fried chicken pieces (akin to fast food places)  and a "sweet and sour" dipping sauce. So for many years we made our sweet and sour chicken from scratch.  Directions are simple, and you need only to provide the chicken. The kit is very creative and includes pineapple and water chestnuts,seasoned cornstarch, white rice, and the sweet and sour sauce.  It is nearly fool proof, most delicious and enables you to create an authentic dish at home.

column9: Very Good Any Way You Cook It
column10: Well pretty much any way you cook it anyway. These Wanchai Ferry meals are excellent. They advertise that all you have to add is chicken but that's really just a start. You are free to throw in any additional veggies that you think might go well with the sauce. I usually add mushroom and onion chunks at a minimum. The sauce in this kit is very good. The flavor is respectable and very tasty.The rice also has a very good flavor to it. I rate all the Wanchai Ferry kits like this very high but the Sweet & Sour is one of my favorites. Another nice thing about this kit approach is that it allows you to add as much or as little meat to it as you like. You can also change the type of meat that you add or opt for tofu instead. I've also tried shrimp and pork with this version. Both were very good as well. It's hard to go wrong with it as just about any meat tastes good in sweet & sour sauce.

column9: no sugar added and tastes great
column10: I recently purchased the Carnation no added sugar drinks, the "with sugar" version, a 4 pack of Kellogg's version as well.  Decided to test drive them all.  Label comparison puts Carnation's no sugar added breakfast drink on top.  A third the carbohydrates as all the others, fewer calories by far, same vitamin content basically, and Carnation's no sugar version came out nicely on protein.  And, here's the surprise, it tastes really good.  So why down 20g more carbs, less protein and a lot more calories with Kelloggs or Carnation's sugared version, when this is available.  Yum.
Have found this to be a great tasting additional source of easy protein in my hectic day.  The screw on resealable cap is very convenient for me if I don't finish it in one sitting.

I am a very picky eater which seriously limits my protein intake.  My trainer, yoga instructor, and physician both recommend that I start drinking a protein nutrition drink.  Of course, being a purist perfectionist I set out on a quest to find the "best" drink on the market.  I literally tried everything, including every powder mix.  Oh, I also forgot to mention that I am a "super taster" (lucky me).  I have long since deduced that when looking for nutrition bars or meal replacements, go straight to the brands that have been making unhealthy options first.  They know what they are doing when it comes to making something taste good.  Take EAS nutrition bars versus Snickers nutrition bars.  Snickers is in the good taste business and they know how to engineer a tasty treat.  For them it is taste first then nutrition chemistry, whereas EAS is chemistry first and taste second.  EAS nutrition bars don't even need to be taken out of their packaging to be eaten, since there would be no noticeable difference in taste.  Same for this drink, Carnation has been making Instant B'fast forever (at least since the Stone Age when I was a kid) and they know what tastes good.  Regardless of the stats, what makes this drink the winner of my taste quest is that it really tastes like chocolate milk.  Just to mention a few items, it has "no sugar added" which means that it only has the natural milk sugars...it is NOT sugar free.  It is a reasonable 150 calories, whereas most protein drinks are well over 200 (which is a plus for those watching their calories).  The bonus is that it provides 13 grams of protein, which makes it competitive with the other drinks on the market.

column9: Wonderful Product without the Sugar and extra calories!
column10: Purchased this because I fell in love with the regular (yellow bottle) version of this and was buying it in a convenient store at $3/bottle.  This version tastes almost the same with no noticeable "sweetener" flavor and saves many calories (due to the lack of sugar, but NOT sugar-free).  You may find cheaper in the store (locally was $5.99/4pack while amazon is $22.71/12pack), but the convenience cannot be beat.  And my last purchase (March 18, 2012) was good until Jan 2013.

column9: Great for Breakfast or after exercise
column10: This has a very good taste and the number of calories is about right for breakfast or as a protein shake after exercise.They are hard to find in our local stores so this is sometimes the only place to find it.
I have this breakfast drink every morning.  I only buy the sugar-free variety.  I like to mix it with iced coffee for the perfect start to the day.

column9: Best tasting high protien drink low cal drink
column10: I've tried them all over the last six years and CIB is the winner.  I lost over 40lbs using CIB as my diet staple.
Like Carnation drink way better then one that has been pulled of the market..This seems to have more goodies ya need..

I have used the powered version of this for a long time with good results. I find this much easier to use and handy. I might also add that this is in my daily ritual and i find it helps me to keep my blood sugar in a good range. thanks.
I buy these occasionally and drink them for breakfast when I don't have time to sit down for a meal. They taste pretty good and give me the vitamins that I would otherwise miss out on.

Great chocolate milk, no weird aftertaste at all. i don't normally like company produced health food/drinks but this is good stuff. i wouldn't of tried it, had my sister not bought me one, one day when we stopped at a gas station and grabbed 2 bottles(chocolate for me vanilla for her).If you also don't but need/want something healthier in your diet, or even if you just want a good tasting drink pick some of this stuff up today you wont be disapointed!
This stuff is great! I'm glad I found it here since I can't seem to find it in any stores at all. Special K has a similar drink that I also like but this one is the best one I have tried.

Considering that this is made by Nestle's I was disappointed at the lack of chocolate taste. The sugar added (yellow) version tastes better but it's also 100 calories more per bottle. But Nestle's should have found a way to increase the chocolate taste without the extra sugar. Still, they're a generous size, not bad & as cheap with free shipping as I found them at Kroger. I just wish they were more chocolatey.

I was looking for a sugar free breakfest drink which i thought this was. After i order it and the powder version i found a web site that showed the label. It has 12g of sugar so if your a diabetic BEWARE! haven't got it yet so can't say about the taste.Update: drank 2 packs of the three so far and i'm very pleased with this. The taste is rather good and after drinking this you can see we really do have to much sugar in our diets. It has a dark chocolate type flavor to me which i guess is do to it being low in sugar, regular version of this has 31g of sugar. Turns out the 12g of sugar is from the 11oz of milk which isn't a problem. I reordered 4 more 3 packs, at the price of $14.64 with free shipping it beats Walmarts price of $4.88 a 4 pack. Looks like it pays to report a lower price when you find it to Amazon, i did and their price dropped for this since my last order.

love this product, it is not availible in any stores where i live, only walmart, the prices at walmart fluctuate alot for this product, and alot of times it is sold out...i am not sure why, but even still, my only problem is buying it here is 4.00 more than buying it at walmart. sometimes walmart is such an inconvience i am willing to pay the 4 bucks but times are tough and i have to conserve where i can, what else can i do with that 4 dollars?
I have been ordering YamaMotoYama Green Tea for years. This is a reliable source. Since I order by the case, it comes neatly packed.

I purchased the Italian Cheese Sampler as one part of a gift to celebrate a trip to Italy.  I have received word that the cheese was excellent and very much appreciated.  I would definitely order this sampler again.

column9: No need to travel to Italy
column10: If you like gourmet cheese this is for you.  Authentic delicious Italian cheese without having to travel to Italy.  Truly wonderful
Just like the first reviewer, I purchased this sampler as a gift to celebrate a trip to Italy. The cheeses are very nice. Good gorgonzola, and the best pecorino I can remember. Recommended.
Delicous and extremely healthy!  I eat them every day for lunch- I add them to a spinach wrap.  They are soft and very tasty. They have a good amount of protein and fiber and are low in sodium.

I got a box of these beans and had a huge mexican brunch at 10:30 last weekend while I was camping. These beans were very tasty in taco's with salsa, sour cream, cheddar, and garlic tabasco sauce. They really fill you up and are surprisingly high in protein because of the soy beans, packed with nutrients and all organic. What a bargain.

column9: Not a black bean substitute, but an interesting legume in its own right
column10: If you think you're getting low-carb black beans: look elsewhere.  Actually, just stop looking, because they don't exist.However, if you have an adventurous palette and are looking for a side dish to accompany Mexican food, or an extra stuffer for your next burrito, give this a shot.  Add some fresh diced onion, garlic, cilantro, tomato or a green salsa and you've got a pretty tasty, high-protein addition to your meal.  If I doctor these up right I find they don't remind me of black beans.Also, my kids love them anyway we prepare them.

If you're a collard greens fan, you know it's a labor intensive, time consuming endeavor - cleaning and trimming the individual stalks and leaves BEFORE the cooking begins. My ex-in-laws introduced me to collard greens and their preparation. I like the collards but not the work effort so Sylvia's product is really a tasty convenience. However the cost is a bit high for the convenience, the reason I gave this product 3 stars. I'm not sure I'd buy it again.Update 6/6/2011: Reduced price to less than FIFTEEN BUCKS gets it 4 STARS. I just ordered via Subscribe and Save at TWELVE+ BUCKS = 5 STARS

I love greens, and these are great. They have just the right amount of seasoning without it being over whelming. I love greens for breakfast with grits and scrambled eggs, these start my day out right. On the subscribe and save, as I can't find the Sylvia brand in the stores around here.

Perfection. Period.  These are the model of what collardgreens should always taste like.  These are so good, Ihave eaten them right from the can!  No kidding!  If youhave a finicky kid in the family who hates everythinggreen, even he (or she) will eat these.  The texture,the seasoning, the flavor - it's all you've ever dreamedof for mouth-watering collard greens.  Heaven on yourplate.
I love these.Well seasoned but not too much. Not over cooked.The taste of the collard greens is still dominant.I'll definitely be ordering more.

I used to grow my own garden of Collard Greens, and ate them regularly.  Since I travel more now, I just buy them cooked in cans.  I've tried Glory Collard Greens and a few others, and these have to be the best for the price with subscribe and save.  Yes, they do contain sodium (under 1200mg for the entire can) but that's pretty much typical of canned foods anymore, especially if you're looking at pre-seasoned products.  Regardless, these greens are  D-licious, and compliment almost any meal without any effort.

These are great greens. The only problem is that they have gluten. It would be nice if amazon, and all other sites, would provide both ingredients lists as well as nutrition information. A simple snapshot of the label would be good enough. Anyway, the taste of Sylvia's food is a definite five star. I don't eat gluten though, and it is added as an ingredient for some reason, so only four stars from me.

column9: One of the best out a half-dozen brands tried on Amazon.
column10: Less is better with Sylvia's brand products. Less seasoning, and less pre-cooking before canning. I have tried so many other brands and really have not felt comfortable picking out one, until now. Sylvia's collard greens strikes the right balance between the two cited variables. I am buying not just Sylvia's collard greens now. I want to try just about all of her products sold here. But, you need to shop for the best price here not just the first vendor you see. I will not buy any product that weighs that much without receiving free shipping too. Shop for the best price & shipping combo!
A recurring problem when reading the product descriptions.  Even though Amazon's description doesn't mention it, this stuff contains GLUTEN.  It may be delicious, but please, Celiacs, beware!!

We've tried several different types of edible chews for our lab and most last about 25 seconds.  It took her about 20 minutes with the Booda Bone however.  Had to keep a close eye on her at the end of them though.  Once she gnaws off both ends of the bone, the middle is still hard and pretty much perfectly sized for choking.  Definitely will only be giving them to her when we can supervise.

I have been drinking this brand for as long as it has been available. I enjoyed that I could order the 8oz boxes in bulk as the savings is enormous compared to what I might find locally, plus you can mostly buy vanilla flavor as a three pack, and I just find that too sweet. Great for travel and when you just need the Calcium dose, without the soy or dairy which I am allergic to.Every morning, with so many diet restrictions, I look forward to a hot bowl of the rice milk, into which I add two gluten free cereals that I buy in bulk from Amazon.Thank you Amazon for making this product available in the smaller quantities. I know in a week the family will be going away for a few days and I know longer have to think of taking the large container and worrying whether or not there is a refrigerator.Is this taste delicious? I would say that it is a taste I have grown to love and that it feels good to have options that my health situation can tolerate.....this make it even more tasty!

column9: 8 oz boxes are great, but other rice beverages are healthier and tastier.
column10: I used this product for many years. I favored Imagine for high quality ingredients, excellent flavor, reasonable price, and wide availability. I find milk and soy products cause digestive distress, rice beverages have no such effect, no cholesterol, very little fat, and taste great. I prefer the vanilla flavor for everyday drinking, chocolate for treats, and original for cooking, but the original is closest to milk flavor. The 8 oz boxes are perfect for taking along for lunch or infrequent use, since once opened the product does not last a really long time.However, Imagine now uses the cheaper canola oil in their rice milk products. Canola oil contains erucic acid, a toxic chemical. The FDA has limited canola oil to no more than 2% erucic acid to protect our health, and do not allow it in infant formula. In addition, studies show the erucic acid it contains is toxic (see below). I have not been able to find any long term longitudinal controlled studies on humans to prove its safety as far as all the adversely affected organs.Good Karma Whole Grains Ricemilk is organic and also canola and sugar free. It has a thicker, richer and creamier body and flavor, less watered down. The vanilla flavor is a delicious drink, it tastes more like fresh whole milk straight out of the cow (if you have had that) than what is sold in cartons in the US. Westsoy Rice Beverage has similar consistency to Rice Dream, but is canola free. I realize that in a society that has food for sale everywhere--so much of which is laden with salt--that public demand will be for more of the same.However, the very first ingredient listed on the back label of the Dean Jacob's Sicilian Blend Bread Dipping Seasoning is ... salt. In fact, the serving size recommended for dipping bread is: one teaspoon of this seasoning for every two tablespoons of olive oil. Now this stuff may work wonders in various recipes, or if used sparingly in other ways. But that very teaspoon of seasoning has 200mg of sodium in it. That might be fine for most people (and for purposes of comparison, a teaspoon of table salt will typically contain nearly ten times as much sodium).For me, however, this Sicilian Blend seasoning is far too salty to use in an oil for dipping bread, as the salt is just too overpowering. If I were to use more oil or less seasoning, the flavoring would be substantially lessened, defeating the purpose of the product. I recognize that this is a matter of personal taste, and I also, while searching here on Amazon, discovered that Dean Jacob's dipping seasonings come in low-salt versions:Dean Jacobs 4 Bread Dipping Seasonings, Low Salt  and No Salt, 3.71-Ounce Large Jars (Pack of 3)I have not yet tried these low/no-salt versions, but I may.I very much like the concept of dipping seasoning since I usually consume the first serving of bread (that comes out of my bread machine) with high-quality olive oil. And since I now know there exists a low-salt version of this seasoning, I have given the product two stars instead of only one.

When the red coating wears off it seems that they just get hotter. And you can hear the tell tale sound of people crunching to get it over with. Then they come back for more.
