One of the best flavor K-Cups available. Fast, accurate delivery and a great price for the product. Would like to see this same deal available in the French roast version

This is my absolute favorite coffee. When I see a sale like this I always order a box. I am very particular about the coffee I buy and this has never disappointed me. My only complaint is it seems to take a bit longer to arrive than other companies I have ordered from.
Have selected this coffee several times from Amazon because it is perfect for my tastes. Can't see any reason to change. No problem with timing of delivbery
This is my favorite dark roast, maybe my favorite all time.  Nice rich flavor without bitterness. Perfect morning or after dinner
This coffee is bold...but not too bold...it is my very favorite...If you like a strong coffee that is not bitter...you will enjoy this coffee...
This is my favorite coffee for a K-Cup machine. It's rich and strong and good. If you like strong Italian coffee, you should try this.

We loved this coffee. The "K" containers they come in are AWFUL! Out of 14 boxes we have used 21 cups have leaked and spoiled the brewed coffee. Tullys did send us a  box to replace the cups from our 1st order of 4 boxes from Amazon. 3 of those containers leaked. We tried 2 local food stores for 6 boxes at various times and the cups in those leaked also.We have stopped using Tullys, we are sad. :((the foil lids become detached from the container causing coffee grinds and water to leak out and into the coffee cup)
Finally a bold coffee that is bold will good flavor as well. If you like a good strong but smooth coffee this is for you.
This too is excellant as a tall iced-coffee.Tully's Italian Roast, K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) Also like it as a med/lg hot coffee.
very dark roast, strong coffee, very good.  Sorry, the rest of message is fill in to make it to the new rule by amazon of at least 20 words.
This is the best coffee I have found so far. A lovely blend, dark and rich (which we love), and smells delightful. The taste is full and flavorful not at all bitter. I will be purchasing again.
The coffee is excellent and the service was too!  So was the price with the cost of Keurig K-Cups rising weekly.

Tully's Italian Roast Coffee had an excellent bold flavor which was perfect for my morning brew.  Lately, I have been buying all my K-cups from Amazon. I like the price and having it shipped right to my home.

I have tried all of the Italian K-Cups and this is by far the best. Great rich flavor. My only complaint is this brands K-Cups don't always deliver a full 8 or 10 ounces, it seems to either be how Tully prepares their cups or that the tops of some are flattened when they arrive via the mail.
I love this vendor ~ the price is very reasonable and I get free shipping.  What more can you ask, great price and it being delivered to your door.  Also, quick shipping, thank you!

I actually came to this coffee because Amazon took all my coffees off Subscribe and Save.  I actually like this coffee.  It's a good coffee for morning time.  I find the Breakfast blends to light for me and this one is a bit stronger.  Not a favorite of mine but is good enough to keep since it's still on Subscribe.

Before we got the Kuerig brewer, my husband bought starbucks coffee which is pretty strong. This coffee is his favorite and he tried quite a few k cups. If you like bold coffee, you will like this one. Enjoy!

I buy this and a Kona blend for my brewer. I have tried many other brands and flavors but I always come back to this one. I "drown" my coffee with flavored coffeemates but still get a coffee taste from this one.

This is my favorite K-Cup!  I keep trying others but I always come back to this one. I'm not a coffee snob and I really don't know much about coffee but I know this tastes great! It smells amazing and isn't bitter.  This is a little harder to find in stores but amazon's prices beat the stores anyway.

column9: My All-Time Favorite Tully's K-Cup Flavor!
column10: I usually drink Tully's French or Kona, but decided to get this since I had seen some really good reviews on it. It seemed like a lot of people were buying it, so I wanted to find out why.It's great! Of course we all have different tastes and taste buds that we're dealing with, so my "Great" coffee may not be someone else's choice. However, it's GREAT!1) I love the taste!2) I love the aroma!3) I love the combination of the taste and aroma!I know that I'll be getting this one again and again.UPDATED 3-4-12 to say that this is my absolute favorite coffee. This is the one I always want to drink when given a choice. I try not to run out of it.
Excellent coffee, very smooth yet full bodied flavor. I wish it also came in decaf. We also enjoy other Tully's coffees.

column9: One of the better K-Cups for the Kuerig
column10: I generally find that many of the K Cups lack the flavor and strength I like. This is one of the few I keep in the rotation.
Like this coffee alot. It is robust and not bitter. We drink it with milk and sugar. I have ignored any other flavors I have left over in the cabinet.

The dextrose shipped quickly and arrived well before the delivery estimate.  The bag I received is identical to the one pictured.  The powder is soft, fine and fresh which is of course what I was looking for.
this was a good price, and was shipped out very quickly.  it works great when making apple wine, and is enough to make 20 gallons, so it lasts quite a while.

This is the most I could find at this cheap, and it gets the job done. I actually ordered it for my post workout shakes to have a good 4:1 or 3:1 carb to protein ratio for recovery. Didn't receive the first order for some reason, emailed company, and they replied and had a new shipment mailed out on 2 day priority the following day.

Was very pleased with this.  10lbs of sugar was well worth it, its a huge bag.  I was even more pleased with the shipping, ordered wednesday, shipped thursday, arrived friday! (expedited choice).  Highly recommend this compared to other dextrose sold on amazon, best price for quantity!

Jelly Belly's are hard to find in bulk any more in my area. I like the cinnamon jelly beans best. I ordered a pound of them. They arrived quickly and were nice and fresh. I am doling them out to myself sparingly and savoring each one!

column9: Whatever happened to HOT cinnamon candy?
column10: Valentines Day is one of those rare holidays where I join the Philistines whose favorite candy is not chocolate.  Forget the heart shaped box, the chocolate chip roses, the cakes.  Give me cinnamon that's hotter than a scorned woman's temper.Except, where did it go?  Somewhere in the past few years, cinnamon candy got namby pamby.  Someone told me that people complained.These are not the red hot Jelly Bellys I used to get. You know, the ones that made your nose run?  And in a cold February, there's nothing better. (Well, nothing I'm going to talk about here, anyway) They're sanitized, expurgated, dare I say it?  MILD, kiddie candy.Still looking for my sinfully hot cinnamon for the year.  Any suggestions?Rebecca Kyle, February 2009
I order this 10 pound box of jelly bellys and they came very quickly.  The  box is heavy and the jelly bellys were perfect.  If you are a cinnamon jelly belly fan this box is for you!

I bought this a few years back and loved that the product was originally from Holland and was full of chocolatey goodness and also came in a cute package. I just found it again at my local supermarket and looked at the ingredients. Unfortunately they have replaced the tasty all natural chocolate sprinkles with your run of the mill ordinary sprinkles. Now it's really waxy. Nothing special worth going out of your way for...the container remains the same...which is pretty adorable still. But going to look for real dutch sprinkles now...
I consider myself to be a Jimmies connoisseur. These are the best anywhere. Very chocolate.

I've been eating Boboli for years.What can I say?It's really the perfect pizza crust.Not too fluffy, not too flat.Great taste, great price.I like this much better than the "crust in a can" varieties.Boboli's been around for years now for a very good reason...they gave us a great product that has withstood the test of time and at a reasonable price to boot.I usually brush mine with melted butter with a hint of garlic for added tastiness.Pile on the Boboli sauce, a ton of cheese and your favorite toppings and you have a home run for the whole family.Highest recommendations.

This and the sauce by Boboli is amazing. Perfectly chewy, crispy, and dense.Crust/sauce, then mozzarella, real parmesan, a little sharp cheddar, provolone, and then thick cut Bridgford Pepperoni.$5-6 for a grocery store though, not worth the price here. The stars are for the product only.
A disgusting substitute for pizza crust. Tastes nothing like crust or bread. Always has this burned, chemical taste to it, even if you eat it without heating.

column9: As horrid now as when I tasted it 15 years ago
column10: This is garbage. If you: Think Wonder bread is good bread and Diet Soda actually tastes better than regular then you may like his chemically tasting garbage. My mouth and tongue actually violently rejected my ability to swallow this poison. As an aside, Freschetta recently came out with their version and believe it or not it is VERY TASTY!
Maaan, what happened to the Boboli breadsticks?? That was like MY DINNER for years. I can't beleive they discontinued those. My heart will go on...

I bought these b/c I felt a sinus infection creeping up on me...spring allergies are wreaking havoc once again. I love drinking anise tea so I saw these "Jakemans Throat and Chest" lozenges, anise flavored, and wanted to give them a try. They are deliciously smooth and have helped soothe my sore throat and another great side effect, they have really helped clear my sinus passages too. Great little lozenges, I will keep these in my medicine cabinet for sure.

tastes great! loved it, only problem is the serving size on label is quite small, so instead of having a 20gr serving with 2gr of carbs, i used a 65gr serving with 6 grams of carbs, if your using it for baby back ribs you wont be able to cover the whole thing with the recommended serving size, so be careful! almost forgot, the price is quite high!

I will have to say that this BBQ was pretty good, I like the idea it had Xylitol as Natural Sweetener, that's really healthy for the body.  No problems with it what so ever.  It goes great on chicken, pork and ribs.  Great stuff I would recommended this to people who are looking for healthy alternative to HFCS (High Fructose Corn Syrup) and Artificial Sweeteners.Thank you for reading my review on this product

I think its sad when I read reviews and they give a product a bad rating because they don't like Maple flavor. Hopefully, you won't buy a Maple flavored product and give it a bad review because it said it was Maple flavored and it was. What a shame.There is an extreme Maple flavor to this sauce but that is OK with me because I love the contrasting sweet Maple flavor combined with the smokey taste that comes with BBQ food. I found this BBQ sauce to be thin but that is just fine because I don't like thick BBQ sauces anyway. I am happy with the flavor and consistency but I do find the price to be very high but that comes with the territory when dealing with Natural/Xylitol products. Maybe as more people branch out to Xylitol they will drive the pricce down to reasonable levels. If it weren't for the price I would use this BBQ sauce all the time!

column9: The Worst BBQ sauce I've tasted!!!
column10: I've tried many Nature's Hallow products and loved them all but this one.  I threw it out after one use.  Enough said.
It came And it was already open. It was spilled all over the package it was mailed. It was quite a mesa

column9: Better than nothing, worse than most
column10: As a low carb condiment, this is barely adequate.As a BBQ sauce, it kinda sucks. The flavor is not very good, the texture is meh (Specifically, poor response to heat while cooking). I just couldn't recommend it to anyone, given that there are better alternatives out there. I did not really get the maple flavor, or a BBQ flavor. Over glorified catsup that was left out too long flavor, perhaps.

I am on a low-sugar diet for weight loss and wanted to try this xylitol sweetened bbq sauce.  I didn't go for the honey mustard flavor because my husband hates mustard.  He said he could live with this one.  I am having a problem with it solely for the maple taste.  I don't care for it and will only have it in pancake syrup.  We don't taste the xylitol but it is on the thin side.  BBQ sauce is extremely hard to replicate naturally.  I looked at 'every' other sugar-free brand and they are 'all' sweetened with Splenda which is a shame.  So I am now ordering the honey mustard flavor to see if "I" like that one.  I am a honey mustand dressing fan.  I'm crossing my fingers.

column9: Great substitute for coffee - healthier and very tasty
column10: I bought one of these and liked all three varieties.  I had tried the "Choffy" brand and that was good also - these, however, were a TAD bit cheaper.  I couldn't really tell much difference between the taste of each, since I added creamer and Truvia to each cup.I'm looking forward to a long, healthy relationship with brewed cocoa beans.

column9: Good non sweet cocoa ,better than coffee
column10: I make it in a press and add cream it is quite tasty and not bitter like coffee,I had heard of a drink called choffy and I think this came very close, I enjoyed it .

column9: No wonder the Mayan Kings drank this
column10: This is so good it is hard to explain. I have been mixing this half and half with my morning coffee. Even straight it is very good. I will be buying again.

Saw an advertisement for Choffey and was very interested.  On Amazon.com I found Crio Bru.  I first tried the Cavalla -- it was wonderful. I drink my hot tea black, so for my brewed hot chocolate I add just a 1/2 teaspoon of sugar.  Makes it just right for me.  This time I purchased all three varieties.  Each taste slightly different.  I'm hooked.

I use it for photography (dying liquids to photograph water crowns and dripping it in a tank of water to photograph it) and it serves its purpose. It is vibrant, the colors aren't weird, and it comes in a nice eyedropper thing. I don't really know much about food coloring but, like i said, it works well.
These bars taste very good.  I am a big fan of them.  I use these as my morning pick me up.

These are very tasty and I couldn't tell that they were sugar-free. However, the price is absurd. I found the same thing at the local large discount store for half what is being charged here, even before shipping is added.

I just recently purchased these candies in hopes that it would be a great substitute for sugar filled candy and to accommodate my low carb diet.  I found the candy to be delicious and I am a real chocolate snob!  With only 1 net carb per piece, I can enjoy without guilt!

Well I have been type two for about two years and have tried about all the candy, cookies, etc. These are by far the best yet! They are almost as good as regular candy! The peanut  butter is smooth and creamy, and the chocolate has a smooth flavor. If you are looking for something to satisfy that chocolate craving, especially with Halloween coming ( it and easter kill me lol ) you will be happy. Now if they can only figure out beer..... ;)

I really like this and my roommate who generally does not go for peanut butter, he actually likes it as well.  Oddly, the packaging seems to be trouble for Dove, got some with 2 pieces in each wrapper (woohoo!) and some with partial pieces only (not so woohoo).

column9: The best sugar free chocolate I have ever had.
column10: This delicious chocolate/peanut better Dove candy is by far the best sugar free chocolate I have ever had, and I have had lots.  The best way to eat these chocolates is to let them melt you mouth...savoring that incredible creaminess.  These chocolates could lead to serious addition problems.  Amazing.  Puts all the other famous sugar-free chocolate makers to shame.  Give your self a treat and buy a bag of these chocolates.  You deserve it.

column9: Dove Sugar Free Peanut Creme Chocolate Candies
column10: Extremely good and a whole lot less calories than the sugar variety. Very good substitute for those trying to cut back on sugar. I am a repeat customer.
Dove Sugar Free Peanut Butter Creme Chocolates are amazing.  Smooth, creamy, sweet, satisfying.  They come individually wrapped, so great for a candy dish.  Highly recommend!!

column9: Awfully expensive for just being plain ol' fortified cereal
column10: For example, if you want something that will keep an older baby quiet on a plane ride, or a cute little finger food that travels well in the diaper bag and is already bite-size and tastes good and so on, I give these a 5.  If you want what the packaging is trying to sell -"super" foods, "eat your colors", "made from real organic fruits and veggies", "vibrantly colored fruits and veggies hold many beneficial vitamins and minerals.  Serving your baby a rainbow of colors will not only help develop a healthy taste for a variety of flavors, but will also provide a wide range of nutrients" -then I'd have to give it a 1.  This is, despite their efforts to dress it up, just 1.5 ounces of fortified cereal.  That's it.  Every type -no matter what the combination of fruit and vegetables- has the exact same proportions of the exact same vitamins, even though they try to make it look like the purples are good for vitamin C and the oranges for vitamin A and the greens for calcium.  Whatever was good in the organic veggies and fruits got taken out and forgotten somewhere; the only purpose the 'superfoods' serve in these concoctions is to be a colorful dust sprinkled on the outside of each piece (seriously).  So like I said, if you're just looking for a good portable snack, these will work great.  If you are trying to feed your baby vibrant colors so they can get those benefits extolled on the package, it looks like for now actual food is still your only option.

column9: Do you want blue stains everywhere?
column10: Now I know what "natural" food dyes are used to make things purple.  Pretty, but not so fun to clean up.  The purple dust gets all over my baby's face, hands (even under his fingernails!), and clothing, plus whatever surface he's eating them off of.  The yellow and orange ones in this line aren't so bad, but now I'm regretting that I bought one of each color, because I'm betting the reds and greens will be just as messy.  Skip the purples!!!

We tried the purple, green, and red puffs, and we liked them all.  They smell great and are quite tasty.  My son eats a serving in just a few minutes.  They aren't as sweet/sugary as other brands of puffs we've tried, which is a good thing.  They're organic so you don't have to worry about any pesticides in the grains, fruits or veggies used to make them.  Do I think they're worth $5/container?  Definitely not.  I got them on sale.  I'd buy a few containers for $3 each every month.  The bad thing about these is that once the container is opened, you want to use them in a week because they get stale that fast.Unlike previous commenters, I didn't have a problem with the purple powder (which isn't just natural food coloring, it's dried and powdered blueberries and purple sweet potatoes) making a mess.  You put your kid in a high chair with a tray and a pocket bib on, and let him eat.  Then you wipe his hands and face before you let him get down and walk around. Voila! no mess!

Why coat the puffs with messy purple powder that gets all over everything? What's the point? To make it look pretty? Please! The worst idea ever; it's just super messy for no reason. The purple one is the worst but this whole line of puffs is like this (and the green one smells exactly like baby poop). Get the other organic puffs, the kids love them just the same.
We bought these for traveling 12+ hours on a plane with our 19month old. He LOVED them! They are pricey for a regular snack but for an occasional treat to keep a toddler happy they are so worth it.

My lil kitten loves these toys! Perfect for quiet entertainment!To small for the dogs to steal from her, and too big for her to swollow. Its her own perfect lil toy. They work on hardwood or tile, desks or any hard surface. She likes it when I make them spin and the she prounces on them! They are a great toy! I wish they came in a higher count!
these were TINY and made out of very lightweight plastic. i gave one to my cat and in under a minute, she had chewed off the ball tip and was choking. STAY AWAY.

column9: Great product at a great price
column10: When Amazon has a deal and coupon on the cereal sets, they are well worth it.  This is one of our favorites and the price was even better than the Buy 1, Get 1 free deal that the grocery store runs.

This is the ONLY granola I use in a yogurt/fruit casserole recipe (my co-workers request it!).  Unfortunately, I can no longer find this cereal anywhere near San Antonio, Texas--believe me, I have looked.  The Kellogg's replacement granola (Special K) sold in our area turns mushy whereas this Low-fat Granola stays crunchy.  So, thank you Amazon--I am now able to enjoy our favorite Kellogg's Granola cereal once again.

With its great crunch, flavor, and nutritional values, this cereal is truly a staple in our home and has been for years. We use the variety without the raisins, because they tend to dry out a little much in Kellogg's processing. We just add fresh raisins. Best of all, we previously had to go out of our way to find the raisin-free variety. Now we don't even have to go out, because Amazon delivers a five-pack right to our door on the schedule we choose -- and for a good price. A great partnership -- Kelloggs and Amazon!!!
I love this cereal, it's the best!  I go through about a box a week and eat it in my yogurt!  Wish more grocery stores carried it, but I can't find it in Texas!

I first fell in love with this cereal when I was travelling and tried it at a hotel breakfast bar.  The taste is so good just as cereal or with yogurt.  My local Kroger store used to have it on their shelves a couple of years ago.  I was totally bummed that they discontinued it.  On a whim, I googled the cereal name and found it on Amazon.I thought it would be weird to buy cereal on the Internet, but it has totally worked out.  Once I'm about done with the last of the 5 boxes, here comes the next shipment of cereal.  Even my finicky teenagers love this cereal!I highly recommend this cereal and the subscription service.  If you have too much cereal, you can just pause the delivery.  Greatness!
Thanks for making this cereal available online. It is my favorite and always like to keep it in stock at home. Enjoyed it!

column9: Good tasting and good for you
column10: I don't like raisins in my granola and I don't want a sugary high calorie granola and this one meets all my criteria. Very tasty and I just hope Kellogg's keeps making it.

this cereal is no longer available in the southeast texas area so the plus is that it is available, however, the price for this box is about fifty percent above other cereals.  Not a good value.  Searched around and found a local brand of granola at much better value.

I have had this product delivered to my house. Can't find it in the super market. But, it is the best tasting, healthy, cereal I have ever eaten. I am already into my second order and I will keep them coming. I mix the granola with fruit and almond milk and create the most wonderful breakfast.Kellogg's Cereal Variety Pack, 52-Ounce Box

Kellogg's low fat Granola is my cereal of choice for breakfast.  Unfortunately, it isn't the most popular cereal and therefore only one grocery store near me continues to carry it.  That's well and good, but the price is 50% more than what Amazon offers it for.  Within days of placing my order with Amazon, I received the cereal and will continue to purchase it from Amazon as long as they continue to carry it.

This cereal is impossible to find in grocery stores.  Fortunately I discovered it on Amazon and at a fantastic price.  It tastes better than any other granola that is available.  And the cost on Amazon is a steal.  At less than $3 a box, it is a great buy and shipping was immediate.  I had a $25 order so shipping to my door was free.  What a deal!!!!!!

This granola is awesome....You cannot buy it too many places, so I am happy Amazon sells it...I work for Marriott Hotels and that is the Granola they use in the mornings...I prefer to add my own raisins or dried fruit, or make a wonderful parfait, by layering granola, strawberries, and yogurtDo yourself a favor, and try this cereal just once....You wont' be dissapointed...

I bought this granola because I was searching for the granola that they have at the Marriott hotel in Napa, Ca., which is THE best granola I have ever had. I searched google for it and found a link to this granola from another reviewer stating it was the one they use at the Marriott. This is not the same one that I had and this granola is not remarkable in any way. Just an ordinary granola. So, if anyone knows the recipe or commercial product for the Marriott granola, let me know.
This was a good purchase for us, because we chew flax seeds as a snack. Usually the seeds are dried out. This product was soft, so the seeds were freshly harvested. Really nice flavor.

Make sure to grind them in a coffee grinder just before you eat them. Only grind what you will eat since they go rancid very quickly. In order to get the benefits of the seed it must be ground or you will just pass them.
I order this through Amazon now because Amazon makes my ordering  experience so convenient.
I made these brownies with nothing  but one cup nonfat yogurt. The came out very chewy and rich minus egg and oil!

I whipped up a box of Ghiradelli Dark Chocolate brownie mix yesterday and was very pleased.I substituted the half cup oil with half cup unsweetened applesauce.  The brownies turned out a little fluffy, but they tasted great.  Not overly moist, but certainly not dry.There's plenty of chocolate taste in them, and they're nicely sweet.  There are large dark chocolate chips throughout the mix, though personally I'd like more (but I'm a chocolate nut).  I like that this mix has no high fructose corn syrup or invert sugar, two ingredients we avoid because they're bad for the body.I baked my brownies in a 9"x13" metal cake pan.  I coated it with a thin layer of shortening first, and the brownies come right out with perfect ease.  It took 35 minutes in this pan size, which wasn't labeled on the directions.Highly recommended brownie mix.
We bought a box of six boxes of these and they went very fast---everyone loves them!

column9: Fudgy, clean tasting (no acrid chemical aftertaste) and very easy to make but too sweet
column10: I followed the recipe on the box, substituting nonfat greek yogurt for the water and the brownies came out dense, fudgey, rich and normal tasting.  There was no unpleasant result. I found it too sweet but not as acrid as the standard brands.  It was on sale for two dollars a box at my local supermarket because I think my neighborhood passes over this product thinking it might be too new and fancy (and therefore untried and untested) compared to the standards - DH and BC. The recipe is the same procedure for making baking soda based quickbreads such as bananas.  This brownie mix contains sodium bicarbonate aka baking soda and no baking powder.  I added some inexpensive French brandy because the best brownie I ever had (not too sweet) contained Bailey's Irish Cream.  It's all Western Europe to me.  This was not a regrettable purchase for me but it was too sweet and the chips in the mix were unnecessary.  I should have added more cake flour and yogurt to lower the sweetness according the the High Altitude adjustment on the box.

I always bake from scratch, but decided to make an exception with Ghirardelli brownies. I tried two kinds - the first was the "Double Chocolate Brownies," and they were excellent. Then I tried these, and they were horrid. I thought both mixes would be close, since the ingredients are very similar, but nothing could be further from the truth. These tasted like burnt coal.

I have to admit I'm a bit of a seaweed snob.  I grew up eating seaweed so I'm not a stranger to it.  I've been on a health food kick lately and started to cook a lot of miso soups, legumes, etc.  Kombu is the quintessential ingredient for majority of the dishes I cook.  It lends that famous savoriness (umami) that only comes w/ Excellent quality harvested seaweed from Japan (see, I told you...snob) ;-p.When I first started back to cooking macrobiotic and raw food meals I purchased Kombu and Wakame from a lot of different vendors (coops, organic markets, asian groceries, online vendors, etc).  As I started cooking with all the different brands of seaweeds, I noticed there's a distinct difference in taste between the brands.  I have to say - Eden has one of the BEST seaweeds out there (texture, taste, no additives, clean).Everything I cook has that hearty savoriness with the Eden brand.  With other brands - the seaweed texture, color, and/or taste is subpar compared to Eden.  I don't know what it is but when I cook w/ the other seaweeds - seriously - it just tastes as if something is "missing".Since noticing the taste difference I wanted to know why Eden had one of the Best seaweeds...  I went to Eden's website and read all the stories and research that go behind their products.  I'm very impressed by their dedication in bringing Quality, Healthy, and Clean food to us!  I'm now a Huge fan of Eden!Since I grew up eating a lot of seaweeds - I know what good quality tasting seaweed is... and I have to say - Eden has one of the best out there!  You have to try it!

column9: BEST KHOMBU out there, from a very reputable company.
column10: Eden Foods is a great company if you ever research up on them.  They take care to ensure that the products they sell are pure and clean.  This is the only brand of Khombu, seaweed, and nori that I use, and it comes from Japan, not China.  These strips are great for adding into soups for extra flavor...the umami like the previous poster said.  I would not trust the other brand of seaweed I see at the coops...the Emerald one, because it comes from China, and there is hardly any oversight over there.  Eden Foods also makes a good gomasio blend if you ever have a chance to buy it.

column9: Quality Kombu that Makes Delicious Dishes -- High in Iodine and No Fishy Taste
column10: I've used Eden Foods Kombu for years to make Japanese soup stock for Miso Soup and as a natural flavor additive to any dish. It's very shelf stable and keeps for years, if you just want to have some in the pantry. I used it recently to flavor the stock for my standby Portuguese kale soup, with no fishy flavor at all unlike you get with nori -- my soup was delicious as ever.With the concerns about getting iodine in your diet naturally, I used this kombu to cook rice and make a meat chili with canned kidney beans and diced tomatoes. Adds more flavor to anything boiled (it does contain a natural MSG from the sea) and sea minerals like potassium and calcium to your food besides the big iodine boost -- I completely recommend it.

As a vegetarian who loves Japanese food, I'm often stuck in a difficult position - even supposedly 'vegetarian' sea vegetables taste more fishy than I'm comfortable with (aesthetically).  Eden's kombu is just fabulous pure unami, though:  deep, complex, almost vaguely smoky, in a word - awesome, with absolutely no 'fishiness' whatsoever.  Obviously, this is very high-quality kelp/kombu.  I also have to express total mystification at the review that mentioned the 'green slime' - my kombu is nicely dry and chewy and just ready for munching, tossing in a vegetarian dashi, etc.  Yum!!!

Another quality product from Eden.  Great for seasoning any type of soup or broth.  Since the seaweed is from Japan I wonder if we should be temporarily wary of as a result of the tsunami / nuclear radiation disaster.

Kombu is great in soups, stews, anything really. I feel it gives my family extra minerals that are essential to good health. I put it in with the other ingredients to cook and afterwards just discard it before dishing up the meal.

I had been using Eden Kombu for years and always had good results. But the last time I bought some it was very different, and not in a good way. Within just a few minutes of coming into contact with water it oozed a green, gloopy slime. Edens Kombu had never done this before so I threw it out and started over with a fresh batch, same results, green slime. I had contacted Eden about it to see if there was something different about the product but never got a reply that explained in any way what could be the cause of this problem. So.....Eden! See Ya! I think they just dissmissed me as a quack or something but I,m quite serious, this stuff was NASTY.There is better quality Kombu out there than Edens, you just gotta look for it.
I find that most black teas are boring. Not this one. It has a fresh flavor that I love. I only drink iced black tea and I never use sugar or cream. You may love it, too.

Being a diabetic for 29 years, I have tasted virtually every sugar free candy on the market. These are wonderful -- hard to tell from the real thing. No more watching my friends indulge without being able to join in! Use with caution, however -- excess consumption (like eating half the box during a really good movie -- not hard to do) will make you rather ill. On the whole, though, these are great.
The order arrived fairly quickly - but I was disappointed because the candy was stale and there were not many "recipes" included in the box for mixing the flavours

I bougt these for my diabetic girlfriend and they were not the hit I was hoping they'd be. She ate less than half the box in matter of few weeks and threw the rest away. The taste wasn't good and she stated they left an aftertaste. I would not recommend this although I don't know of any sugar-free candy that does taste good.

column9: Some flavors work better than others
column10: Of the ten flavors, only the juicy pear, licorice and sizzling cinnamon are worth eating. The more subtle, pure fruit flavors are spoiled by the hard, chalky shell IMO.
I am 56 years old and a type II diabetic. I have taken my blood sugar before and after taking this tea and my blood sugar has gone down by 30 to 50 points.

I am truly amazed!!!! A friend of mine told me about this tea. Yesterday I was feeling like crap and my tummy was also bloated and I couldn't button my jeans. My tummy is so bloated I actually look pregnant when I get my period.I drank 2 cups of the tea with 2 tea bags. My period came on today and I woke up this morning with no cramps and a flat tummy. When I get my period I am bedridden the first day with a heating pad on my tummy. I usually have such terrible cramps for the first day and sometimes the 2nd day that make me cry from the pain. My day consists of diarrhea, nausea, and throwing up. I also have a bloated tummy, swollen legs, and ankles during my period. I didn't even know my ankles and legs were even swollen until the doctor told me and tried to give me a prescription for water pills.All of my adult life, I have had to miss 1 day out of every month from work because of my period and miss out on being able to attend a lot of other events. Thanks to my friend and Triple Leaf Sugar Balance Tea, I will be able to go out the house today and to an event tonight that I thought I would have to miss because of my period.
Seems to regulate my blood sugar and control PMS symptoms.  However, it also appears to contribute to heavy bleeding when taken too close to the start of menstruation.

I bought this because i have PCOS and i could use something to help keep the sugar under control. Also I just got off the pill and i'm trying to get pregnant. The reason i got off the pill was to regulate my period. now that i'm not on the pill i need help getting back to a regular cycle.i noticed i'm getting ovulation symptoms but i'm not sure if its the tea or just nature. one thing i really noticed though is that both times i drank this tea i got sleepy and fell asleep right after. and slept great. it was like what happens when i eat too much sugar and go into a food coma. has anyone else had this effect? my husband thinks maybe its lowering my blood sugar and making me sleepy. i have no idea. i'm a little worried that maybe it might not be good for me if its making me sleepy. the sleep is amazing though. has anyone had this experience?the taste is definitely not for everyone. its very strong smelling and tastes kind of like grass. i got used to it pretty quick though. it really makes you feel like you're drinking something good for you. it helps to add some splenda or stevia.i'm trying to do some research to see if anyone else had this effect and if its something thats not good for me. i like that its doing something, thats pretty great. just need to find out if its safe for me.  if i knew that i would give it 5 stars. but this tea definitely does something.
I don't know if it does what it claims; the taste is not bad but it does take getting used to it.
Bought this for my dad as this is his favorite.  He loved it.  Great price for the quantity.  Would buy again.

We had used this product before and know it's of great quality. We use ground coriander a lot in our cooking. It's always fresh smelling. The subscribe and save price at Amazon was excellent, and will continue to buy again.

I just reviewed the white wine mustard and the same review is also completely fitting for the whole grain mustard as well. As I said in the last one, I was fortunate to be able to attend the 30th annual Food & Wine Classic in Aspen, CO and was also fortunate enough to find two guys that were representing Ameline mustard. They had samples of the white wine mustard and the whole grain mustard to taste with crackers or salami. The falvor of this whole grain mustard is unparalleled compared to what you normally find in your grocery store and after being given a sample of this product I don't think I'll ever go back to what you can find in your average grocery store after having such a high quality product! I know it is hard to purchase a food item without tasting it first, but I'll tell you first hand that I truly enjoyed this whole grain mustard and would strongly recommend it to anyone who loves a high quality mustard as well! ENJOY ... and thank you Ameline for the sample jar I was given at the classic!

I bought this brand at a local shop.  It tastes excellent on Turkey and ham sandwiches. I have gone through two jars and went back for some more, but the store didn't have any.  I checked Amazon and here it is.  I am buying some more.

It's hard to go wrong with any Fischer & Wieser product, including this scrumptious mustard.  I am sort of a mustard and sauce gourmet.  So I look for and try a lot of different mustards and sauces.  In my opinion, Fischer & Wieser make the most consistently superior mustards and sauces than any other company I am aware of.  Not only are they all really yummy - they are also creative, so you get new taste treats with each one.  For example, who else offers a Papaya Lime Serrano Sauce? Papaya Lime Serrano SauceThat's my overall big thumbs up rating for all Fischer & Wiesner products, but now on to this specific mustard product.  There are some equally good mustards, but none that I would consider better than this one, especially in its special niche - a smokey mustard.  Not too strong, just the right amount of smoke flavor without overpowering the mustard.  After all, why eat mustard if the real taste of mustard is so disguised you can barely taste it.They also offer another mustard that is just as good, but for different purposes since it's a sweet and sour mustard.  It has to be good to win first prize at the Napa Valley Mustard Festival. Sweet, Sour and Smokey Mustard SauceI recommend getting one of each, so you'll be covered for a wider range of mustard recipes.  In fact, I just ordered two more bottles of each today, to make sure I don't run out.
Nothing else out there that can compare to the Old El Paso enchiladasauce. I use it to season soups, make enchilada even in my homemadesalsa. You need to try it

These slipped by me for years and then a recent visit to a conference where these were around the room reminded me how good these are.  This is my favorite old fashioned hard candy. why, because of the flavors offered and the taste. It says fruit but the fact that blue mint and licorice are included with the realistic fruit flavors just makes it even better and my all time favorite hard candies.

column9: Had these in a Hotel and had to have more
column10: Same candies provided in a major hotel room during a recent stay.  Nice size bag.  Will be ordering more when these are gone.

This is a superior form of hard candy which I usually find in 5 pound bags.  There are approximately 450 pieces in that size bag, i.e., 90 pieces per pound.  It tends to be in the range of nickle candy (penny candy being an item of the dim past).  This may seem like a lot of candy, but it is good Halloween candy and also good candy jar candy.  Some businesses keep a bowl full at their reception desk, and some people use it to fill candy jars.

I eat very little sugar and no unhealthy oils. I just found these at the market and have eaten two small bags in just a few days. They are very delicious! My teen daughter loves them too. I would not, however, pay the price charged by Amazon and hope this product becomes a "subscribe and save" item soon. I definitely need to purchase this in bulk-- it's a snack I can give my family without feeling guilty. LOVE these!

column9: If you like Blue Diamond Nut-Thins Crackers, you'll love these.
column10: Made with brown rice, almonds, & sea salt - they're baked to a yummy crunch, gluten-free, and stand up well with dips.  These tortilla shaped chips taste like they shouldn't be healthy, but they are,

column9: Perfect alternative to regular powdered coffee creamer
column10: My husband and I are big fans of powdered coffee creamer and we use a LOT. After realizing that the regular stuff is chock-full of partially hydrogenated oil (and also flammable, apparently) I started looking for an alternative. Nature's First is good stuff. Since there is no corn syrup solids it lacks the subtle sweetness of the regular non-dairy powdered creamer, but if you use sugar you probably won't notice anyway. If you're a fan of powdered coffee creamer and you're looking for a healthier (or at least a non-hydrogenated) way to lighten your java, I highly recommend this stuff.

We have switched to organic, natural foods and have tried to eliminate hydrogenated oils from our diet - that meant finding a replacement for Creamora. I was excited to find this product. Sadly the taste does not live up to the name. Instead of Creamer it should be called Milker. There is no creamy taste, frankly it is the equivalent of adding non-fat dry milk to your morning coffee. True, no hydrogenated oils, but also no cream, so what is the point? They need to do a version that is not non-fat, using real cream. Oh well, live and learn. I'm still using it by mixing it with Creamora until I can find a true replacement. Will not be a repurchase.

Save your money. Might as well buy Carnation's instant milk because that is all that this product is. It is very misleading, suggesting a substitute for creamer but being no more than powdered, non-fat milk in a convenient shaker dispenser. Hat's off to the seller, as thy have simply repackaged dried milk and sold it as creamer. Oh, well, I fell for it. But you shouldn't. Save your money and buy real creamer, and just go very lightly; the taste will be than worth it. I have bombarded by coffee with this worthless powder, and still find it undrinkable.

We love this natural creamer!  I couldn't get my husband away from the creamers that tasted so sweet and are full of corn syrup, etc...but he will use this creamer.  It's not as creamy, yes, however, it does a great job...dissolves quickly, no bitter taste and no strange color.  It fits great into our organic life-style.
Based on some reviews I was a little hesitant because I like my coffee to be creamy.  This natural alternative is fantastic and makes my coffee nice and creamy.  Will continue to purchase!

I was also looking for an alternative to the creamers with either fat or sugar in them.  This works for me!  For a tsp, you get 7 calories, no fat, 1 carb, 1 gram sugar (from the milk, not from added sugar), 4 mg sodium, and 1 gram protein.  I'm putting 1 tbsp in my coffee, so I'm getting 21 calories and 3 grams of protein per cup of coffee.

column9: Just powdered milk, not creamer. Not even sure it's organic.
column10: I just bought this an listed under ingrediants is dried milk. I am not a milk fan so I should have checked it out better before I purchased it.  I don't even know if it's organic or if cows that ate GMO corn produced this milk.  What's worse? drinking chemicals in creamer or chemicals from GMO infected cows?  I can't even return it because 2 of the canisters broke open in transit and I threw them away.  I should have kept them and returned them as damaged.

column9: it is exactly what it says it is
column10: I started writing reviews because reading silly people's reviews is frustrating.It specifically says that it is instant dry milk. It lists the ingredients. How is "milker" a negative.I actually can't believe people want their coffee to be "creamy". This product is perfect for me. All I wanted was a little milk for my coffee at work and was tired of having to keep a small milk bottle in the shared fridge and having to bring a new one every week. This stays in my drawer and is easy to use.If you want you coffee to be "creamy", you obviously don't like coffee. Just go get a coffee flavored ice cream or smoothie or something. And you obviously don't care about your health, so just go get the fake hydrogenated oil artificial creamer powder like everyone else gets.

column9: Excellent tea in a minute with no mess.
column10: We have a Keurig in our small office, and since we got it in December half the office has taken to making themselves a green tea pick-me-up in the afternoon. I find the Bigelow K-cup green tea to taste the same as that brewed from most green tea tea bags. It is not quite the same as green tea brewed from loose leaves, but for what it is, it is great.
This green tea has great strong flavor even when brewed at the largest size. We love it!

Service was very good received the coffee in a timely manner, we did have one small problem this was not the coffee we ordered we ordered the Donut Shop Decaf and though we did receive Decaf it was an Extra Bold which was still some what strong...It is possible that the order was mixed up w/someone else's I would use this vendor again the price was great....Thank you, Wally
I was a huge coffee drinker until I had some heart complications.  I no longer can have caffeinated coffee.  Therefore, I was thrilled with this product.  It has a punch of flavor with no caffeine.
Excellent coffee and fills my need for decaf after 3pm!!! I love my Keurig coffee maker for the ability to have so many selections at hand....

I love the scent and flavor of this tea.  I have moved away from a city where my favorite tea shop sold only natural, hand-blended teas; their version of jasmine green contained dried jasmine petals and was a little more fragrant. What I appreciated about that blend was the subtlety of the green tea and that the jasmine was "front & center" in both flavor and aroma.  Tea Nation's version is the closest I've found so far.

I am a huge fan of Jasmine Green tea but this one is just plain awful. it tastes like if they would have just spilled a bottle of cheap women's perfume all over the green tea bags. the smell is totally artificial and so is the taste. would not recommend to anyone unless you like the idea of drinking perfume!!

While on a wheat-free trial diet for a month, I needed wheat pasta substitutes, and one kind of pasta I tried was this one from De Boles.This is my favorite shape of pasta.  This variety cooks up pretty fast, 5-7 minutes and it's great.  Because of the starch in the rice, it will boil over fast if you don't watch it!  You also need to rinse it with cold water after draining.  When this is done, it does not stick or clump up together.  It also doesn't turn hard or gummy.It does taste different than standard wheat pasta.  It has a brown rice flavor, and while it's not my favorite flavor in the world, it's tolerable.  I don't plan to buy this now that I'm back on wheat, but if you cannot have wheat or gluten, then it's a decent pasta.We had this brown rice pasta for mac -n cheese and for tuna noodle casserole.  In both you could taste the noodles' brown rice flavor, but the other flavors overpowered enough to compensate and the pasta didn't ruin the meal.Kids may find it disgusting, depending on how picky they are.I did not try this pasta with cold pasta salad, but it may not be half bad.

I have two dogs, a basset and a corgi, and they are total chewers. If they don't have something to chew on then they're running around the house like little mini-tornadoes. They don't like rawhide chips, get bored of unflavored bones, and are only occupied for ten to fifteen minutes with all other forms of chew toys.  Keeping them in flavored rawhide gets expensive.  These things are a great deal.  Big bones, flavors that make my dogs happy, and way less expensive than anything I could get at the local pet store.

column9: Too big for my 4.5 lb. Yorkie!
column10: These are probably ok but supposedly I was ordering the "small" size ones and they are HUGE!  My Yorkie can't enjoy them at all.  Will give to my GrandDog.  Need to advertise these better!
I bought the large size for my min pins because they last for days while they might chew up small sized rawhides in less than an hour.

column9: Great variety at a good price
column10: I ordered the small-sized bones for my miniature schnauzer.  He's not a big fan of the natural rawhide bones, so I decided to order a flavored variety pack.  What a success!  According to the package the flavors are hickory, beef, and chicken, and it comes with a mix of twelve bones and rolled rawhide.  The price isn't much better than a local pet store, but I would buy these bones again.Also, if you are concerned with the country of origin, these bones were made in Brazil.
These corn nuts are awesome!!!  I like to buy in bulk so I don't have to order as soon. Since these are original CORN NUTS, I know what I am getting. I wish that they would process the orders faster.

column9: Tastes Great, but not low carb for "nut chips"
column10: This sour cream flavored snack is a savory delight...but could use a boost in fiber and protein to offset the carbs.  It may appeal to the gluten free crowd, but is not a snack I can "afford" carb and calorie-wise, to make it a regular "go to" low carb snack for me or my family.

These chips are extremely tasty, very good snack! I wasn't sure I would like them but was pleasantly surprised.  I had the Sour Cream and Chive, they are out but I enjoyed them so much I think I will try another flavor.

My 6 calico cats gobble this food with no hesitation.  The kibbles are triangular, thin and about 1/2" small. I like to feed them food with no artificial colors, fillers, preservatives, etc.  Too bad my first (7 of them!) cats died (of cancers) long before organic cat food (or even natural food) was available.Great food.

These treats made my dog seriously ill with kidney failure.  We had been feeding our dogs these treats for months, then suddenly both our dogs became ill.  We almost lost our smaller dog, a Cavalier King Charles.  While the FDA is still investigating, these treats continue to be sold.  In our small town there were four cases diagnosed within one week, and our newspaper, the Longmont Times Call, ran a front page story on it.  Since then I've been contacted by people from across the US who have been affected, and we have created a web site dedicated to this issue: [...]

All of my dogs LOVE this product, however, with the recent recall and problems that have occurred with this product and others just like it (different brand names) I am sorry to say that my dogs started to get sick when they would eat these. I contacted my vet who insisted thatI stop giving my dogs these treats immediately. She stated that these, and others, were on a recall due to a chemical that was used in China.  Yes, these are made in China and I did not know this until I received the product and after the vet brought it to my attention. If you can find this type of product, but NOT made in China, then it should be okay to give to you dog.  I am still looking for one that is not made in China, because my dogs truly did love this product to have as a treat.  Contact your vet before giving your dog any kind of treat like this.  I am now giving my dogs a jerkey duck treat, and so far so good.  None of them have gotten sick.  I am sadden by all of the problems we are having with our dog food and dog treats coming from China.  Now, when I shop, I DO NOT purchase anything made in China, only made in the USA.

DON'T GET BURNED...2 of the 3 jars seals were broken when shipment arrived...i was so excited when my search for training treats for my new yellow lab came up with these, that i didn't realize they were made in china...i don't think these are returnable items...BEWARE

my chihuahua mix has renal failure because of these treats.  Here is an FDA warning:The Food and Drug Administration is cautioning consumers of a potential association between development of illness in dogs and the consumption of chicken jerky products also described as chicken tenders, strips or treats.  FDA has received more than 70 complaints involving more than 95 dogs that experienced illness that their owners associated with consumption of chicken jerky products.Please DO NOT GIVE THESE TO YOUR DOGS.I don't know if my dog is going to live.

My vet has my dog on a very limited source of low fat treats due to her impaired fat metabolism.  She suggested chicken jerky, but specifically said to avoid those made in China due to all the contimination problems they've had.I searched here on Amazon for "chicken jerky" and one of the suggested searches that popped up was "chicken jerky dog treats made in usa." Great! I used that search and this was listed at #8 on the list. Nowhere in the product description did it say it wasn't made here.  I ordered it and was unpleasantly surprised to find "made in China" on the label, when it arrived.The FDA has several warnings out on dog chicken jerky treats made in China.  The latest ones were Nov. and Dec., so it's an ongoing  problem.  I never even opened the jar, as I didn't want to harm my dog.Had the country of origen been in the product description, I never would have ordered these.

column9: Good product, but made in china so there are risks
column10: As far as I can tell, these chicken jerky strips are a good, natural product.  Even so, they do say clearly on the label that these are made in China, making them somewhat risky (because of the quiet jerky-poisoning cases of 2007).  Another concern - between Dec. 2008 and Feb. 2009, the costs of these went from about 11.00 to about 16.75 on amazon.  At that price, it becomes both safer and more cost effective to just make jerky yourself from USDA grade chicken!

Fed these to my 40 pound jack russell/beagle mix male dog.  He got sick and threw up.  He is a tank and can eat pretty much anything.  I had purchased them in 2007.  I put them away in my cupboard and then heard about the recall and never took them out till tonight.  I just wanted you to know that if your dog starts to vomit or not feel right, STOP FEEDING THE TREATS TO HIM.  Bag says PRODUCT OF CHINA.  And is one of the recalled items from PetSmart where I bought them.  Listen to your instincts and stop feeding him the treats at any sign of illness.

After reading the reviews, I searched the web and found info regarding this product.  I had been feeding my dogs this treat once in awhile.  After reading the very negative info on the Vet Medicine sites and several recall sites,  I chose to throw these away.Sadly, on Thursday, while I was out, one of my dogs, Kio, broke through the barrier where the trash was waiting for pick up and got into the bags.  He ate several pieces of these strips at one sitting.Today, Monday, he went to the vet with acute kidney failure.  He will die.DO YOUR HOMEWORK BEFORE YOU FEED THIS PRODUCT.I didn't and now my Kio will pay the horrible price.  Like the other poison food, it's made in China..even though it gives the impression it's American.Several stores have pulled this product and refuse to sell it.I THINK AMAZON SHOULD DO THE SAME THING.Amazon has a responsibility that includes not selling foods that kill our beloved pets...I know it's a money maker for them, but there's evidence that it might be a killer.  And it should NOT BE SOLD until the final verdict is is.

When I searched in Amazon for "chicken jerky treats made in USA" this product was listed. No where in the product discription did it mention the country of origin. I purchased this product in a smaller size from a local retailer and the package said "MADE IN USA" so I naturally assumed that the 20 ounce tub would be the same. What a surprize. When the package arrived I opened it and gave a piece to my dog, then I noticed that the label said "PRODUCT OF CHINA"! I cannot give this to my dog as it causes severe symptoms.Either Amazon is misrepresenting the product as Made in USA or the manufacturer is. In either case, I have learned my lesson, NEVER BUY DOG TREATS FROM AMAZON.
[...]Please check this out and DO NOT feed these to your pets.  Take them back to where you bought them and make them aware, MADE IN CHINA.

My dogs (all 6 of them) absolutely LOVE these chicken strips! It is a guaranteed treat for any dog. The only drawback is when you order from Amazon, they wait 5 days before considering shipping your ordered item. So when you see "Free Shipping" count on 10 days before receiving your item. The dogs didn't care as long as they got their chicken strips though  ;)

The bagged product from Smokehouse proudly states it is made in the USA. I naively assumed all Smokehouse products were the same. NOT! I only noticed this 20 oz tub is from China when I went to reorder it. I am not happy at the company misleading its customers this way! I will keep purchasing the bagged product from the company because they are my dog's favorite treats and moderately priced, but I lost some confidence in them.

When I ordered them,amazon made it sound like the treats were made in th US. They were not, they were made in china. Will not buy anything made in china because of the report on dogs treats.Will not be ordering them again.

column9: dogs love em, so does the post office....
column10: If you really want to give your dog a treat, get some of these.If my dogs had opposing thumbs I could get them to help me paint if I promised they could have a couple of these afterwards.Only disappointment is that this seller does not offer discounted shipping for multiple orders.  2 tubs ordered came in one box, and almost $20 in shipping... will probably try and find a different seller for the next order, but will certainly buy this product again.

WHENEVER I BUY THE SMOKEHOUSE CHICKEN BREAST, JAKE(BOXER/ROTTWEILER--127#'S--10 YRS YOUNG) HE SEEMS TO KNOW WHEN THEY ARRIVE AND WILL NOT SIT STILL UNTIL HE HAS HAD HIS FIRST TREAT.  WE HAVE TO BE CAREFUL OR HE WILL EAT UNTIL THEY ARE ALL GONE.

My dogs loved these but I stopped getting them because they came from China and the issues related to chicken and dog treats from China.  I'd like to get them again.  Can someone that has used them recently tell me if they still come form china?
I have been giving these to my dog and he just loves them, they are low fat and high protein treats.
My dog loves these, and they look good enough for me to want to eat.

column9: snack for dog on low-fat diet
column10: This product is a great treat for my dog who has diabetes and pancreatitis. As far as I can see it is a all natural product.
My dog loves this treats.  As a mater of fact, I've yet to meet a dog that does not.  We have several furry family members and chicken tenders are the treat of choice.

I've been giving these to my dog for the last 6 months and these are his favorite treats. However I thought these were not irradiated but it turns out they are. I think I will look into the all natural breast tenders even though they are more expensive. In the long run it's better for your dog.

The reveiw by Evelyn jumped to the conclusion that all chicken tender products from China are bad when in fact it was only one retailers private label that was recalled.I have used Smokehouse Chicken Tenders for years because of the low fat high protein snack that is great in the field.When I first heard of the isolated problem I contacted Smokehouse to see if I need to be concerned. They said they have always quarantined and tested all imported ingridents for quality and contamination and only release those that meet their high standards. My dogs will continue to enjoy this great product.

column9: DO NOT BUY - This product KILLS
column10: Look at the small print on the bottom back of the package is "product of China", the same source of other products that have been killing our pets. I sat beside my vet and read along with him.Following are primary repeated findings:- severe damage to the kidney often resulting in complete renal failure  and death- numerous reports in the past four to five weeks, a larger number on the  East Coast- chicken and beef treats promoted as all natural- it does not matter what the label is, if it is a product of China- if caught early enough, hospitalized on IV hydrating and flushing the  kidney over days with nutrients may help the kidney heal itself and the  pet could then live with the damaged kidney- if not caught early complete renal failure is expected- most cases reported are related to small dogs- initial symptoms indicate diabetes- mold is often found when flushing the kidney

column9: My dog loves them, and they are safe.
column10: This specific product was never on the recall list of products with a known problem.I have been giving them to my dog for 4 years+ and he is the healthiest dog my vet has ever seen.They are his favorite treat that I give him as a special reward.

I received the first container of Smokehouse treats for my lab, Willie as a gift from a friend.  I searched and found I could purchase from Amazon.  Willie loves these dog treats and I use them as a special treat.
A very good product but, a little overpriced and I don't recall if it came from China.

column9: good stuff but 1 doesn't last too long.
column10: I feel bad when leaving my pet so I usually give her a treat b4 I go out for the day.  It would be nice if they made treats that lasted atleast an hour each so your pet is happy and so are you.  this lasted about 1 minute, almost completely gone before I can even lock the door behind me.  But she loves it.
Our dogs love these treats. If I would let them, they would eat the whole bag with no problem.
my animals love this product and compared to local store prices it is a good value!

column9: Smokehouse Products, Pig ear strips & chicken breast tenders
column10: My Italian Greyhounds and fosters love both of these products.  The pig ears strips are nice for the smaller dog and is a good treat for the dog you are trying to keep trim because you don't have to feed the entire ear.  They love the chicken breast tenders too.  The 8 month old puppy foster I took in yesterday worked on one while acclimating to it's new temporary home.  Great products, good company. I would prefer it not be made in CHINA.  Big yuck there.
I purchased this item several years ago and discovered that it comes from China and is not something that you want to feed your dog unless you want it to catch bird flu.
Our dogs just love this product. It keeps them from chewing other items like furniture!
My dogs love these and my smallest shar pei is a picky eater; turns her nose up at most treats.

My 2 1/2 year old dachshund loves these chicken tenders.  We give them to him as a treat.  He loves them and we like to give them to him because they are healthy.  No added preservatives or anything artificial.  Just chicken.  Also a great price for such a big tub.

My yorkie almost died!  He has eaten ONLY organic food his entire life.  I purchase a bag of these (the only store bought food or treat he has ever eaten) and within weeks he became lethargic and refused food of any kind.  He was admmitted to the hospital Nov 2007 for 6 days and was administered IV fluids to prevent his death from*****************Acute Renal Failure*********************************These treat causes kidney failure which can be deadly and there is no medication available to prevent,minimize or repair the damage. The damage is IRREVERSABLE!!!!!! My dog is now damaged for life!!!! If you love your pet DON'T BUY THIS PRODUCT! The FDA has received over 100 complaints and UC Davis is following over 40 cases....how many have dogs have to die before big corporations stop allowing this toxic stuff from China to be sold in their stores AND stop allowing very deceptive labeling practices that trick consumers into thinking the product is safe and made in the USA?????????????? Save yourself the heartache DON"T BUY THIS IT"S DEADLY!

column9: Good for me, good for you!
column10: This product is a very good purchase. The price is cheap vs all the other competitors and my dog loves them.. You can't go wrong..

I gave them 1/4 of a can at first of the venison brand to each of my 2 cats(bought a can of each flavor to test first).  They polished it off like they were starving, and then continued to nag me until I gave them the rest of the can! (believe me having a cat constantly meowing in your face can be pretty annoying, LOL).  They didn't show such gusto with Proplan canned.  I like that it doesn't have corn or wheat gluten which is hard to find with the regular foods on the market.  Also, one of my cats has IBS and has trouble with some foods irritating his stomach, he had no trouble with this.  My cats give it 4 paws up each!

column9: Best Rated Cat Food on About.com ...
column10: Natural Balance Ultra Premium was rated #1 Canned Food for cats on [...]reviews, and scores high on other rating sites as well [...].  Chicken & Liver Pate variety is FISH-FREE, and they offer GRAIN-FREE varieties now too for sensitive/allergic cats.The best canned cat food on the market, in my opinion... affordable and great....

This is a safe, nutritional food for cats.  My cat vomits frequently, and we have changed cat food over and over.  Our vet recommends wet food, so I searched the labels for the ones with the most meat, fish or poultry, and without corn filler and other additives.  This one is very fine, she likes the taste, and vomits less frequently.  I also feed her the Natural Balance Chicken and Liver Pate.

column9: Top Choice for Cats with DIGESTIVE ALLERGIES
column10: Okay, I'll be blunt: Diarrhea. We bought 2 Siberian pure bred litter mates & brought them home to comfort me when our very old Maine Coons died. One of them can eat anything and is not particularly  picky. The other cannot ingest gluten of any kind and there is SO MUCH STUFF in a single can of cat food. I worked with these boys for months and couldn't solve poor Merlin's problem. I was at my wit's end, even yelled at my husband to take them back to the breeder because I so exhausted by this horrendous problem. One afternoon on a trip to Petco, a young man who was working in the store came up and started talking with me. Turns out, he used to manage the big cats diets at our local zoo until the budget cuts took his job, so he knew quite a lot about Dick Van Patten's line. He also happened to have a house cat with the same problem as Merlin.He advised me to buy the DVP Ultra Formula (NOT ultra PREMIUM formula) and feed only this food! I did, and our problem was solved! Poor Merlin cannot have table scraps or vitamin treats or any other canned food because his problem returns right away (and its compounded many times over by his long haired triple fur coat and his massive size). He does get DVP Limited Ingredient Diet dry food in rotation with his canned breakfast, but that is it for him. He and I are extremely happy together. He's a Romeo, for sure. I often think of that kind young man and the note about "angels unawares" and I give thanks for that most helpful moment.If your cat has tummy trouble, you need this food and a SpotBot. Thank you, Amazon, for bringing this product to my door! BISSELL Spotbot Pet Handsfree Spot and Stain Cleaner with Deep Reach Technology, 33N8A

I have been using this cat food for about a month and I have purchased 3 flavors. Now, I'm not a cat, and I've never eaten it, but both my cats eat it right up. I have a 14 year-old cat with tiny kidneys, who was an outdoor cat until July, when I took her to the vet, and he gave her a 25% chance of still being alive in 2 years. He told me that I need to get her on good, wet cat food. So I bought this, after doing a lot of research. Since purchasing this, she seems to have filled back out (she's very tiny, maybe 4 pounds). She is also peeing a bit less, which is also a good sign that her overall urinary tract is working better.Another good sign for this food comes from my younger cat who is almost 2. I am feeding this to her, as well, and her solid waste has become much less stinky! She has had a VERY stinky litter box from the moment I got her. I've tried different foods (even mixing in some pumpkin, per a vet)to no avail, but since giving her this, her smell is not as strong.So, this is a little bit pricey compared to some foods, but well worth it for the health of my cats, and the sanity of my nose :)

Hermes grew up on Fancy Feast, and he seemed to like it depending on how hungry he was. He only ate a few flavors, seemed to get tired of it quickly, and almost never finished off his potions entirely. Plus he had a problem with frequently throwing it all up. On my hunt for something healthier and more stomach-friendly I came across the recommendation for Natural Balance on About.com and gave it a try. HE LOVES IT! It's always completely gone within a couple hours and his stomach problems have seemed to settle considerably. And I love that it's so much more healthy than the dirty scraps and chemicals and sawdust found in many cat foods. It's definitely worth it.

I bought Natural Balance canned cat food on the recommendation of my sister.  She feeds her cats the limited ingredient Natural Balance.  Well this stuff is great! I bought the Ultra Formula product and I have never looked back.  My youngest cat is almost two and my oldest is seven.  They have never, ever eaten any type of canned food without rejecting it after a while.  They ate little bits of other types but, either right away or shortly after, stopped eating it.  This was true even of other premium brands. Natural Balance canned food is the answer.  They gobble it up and have not grown tired of it.  They have shinier coats and you can tell the difference in their muscle structure.  Good stuff!!!

Our seven dogs love the Paragon chews. We love the fact that they are made from plant material, have no nasty additives and that they are NOT made in China. They come in many different shapes and sizes.
Our two dogs love all the different plant-based chews made by Paragon...but these are their favorites. And I love that they're cruelty-free!

I was looking for a hard treat for my dog so she wouldn't just have rawhide. These fit the bill. My dog loves to chew, and  she loves these Twiggies. They are gluten-free,low fat,and highly digestible. While they are not made in the US, they are made in Holland by a company that seems to care about what goes into their products. A twiggie will occupy my dog for 20 to 30 minutes. Be forewarned....a twiggie will change the color of your dog's stool.

During my trips to Italy, it became a habit of mine to enjoy this tea every afternoon due to its wonderful balance of flavors - tea, peach and sweetness. Its quality reminds me of the difference between ice cream and gelato. In other words, the difference between something good and something great. When I ordered this tea, I was not sure if the plastic bottles and shipment from Italy would cause the taste to change, but it was exactly as I remembered it.  From now on, I expect I will be enjoying this tea for summers to come, whether in Italy or at home.To be sure, this tea is not cheap, especially when you include the shipping. However, it is much better than other peach teas you can get locally and if you compare its price per liter to wine, the price is quite reasonable.I should also note that the delivery service was great. I ordered the tea on a Saturday morning, it was shipped a couple hours later by MondoFood and arrived on my doorstep on Monday afternoon. I do not know if this is typical for the standard shipping, but I was impressed.

I absolutely LOVE this tea. I first discovered it while living in Germany. Once I returned stateside, the only place I could occasionally find it was at the commissary (military grocery store). Yes, the price is steep but it's hard to find and tastes absolutely amazing.

I was first introduced to this product while I was in Iraq in 2003-2004 and drank it constantly. I would hazard to guess I drank this tea more than any other drink I had available, I was able to get it at pretty much any PX in the country, and it came in 1.5 liter bottles which was fantastic. Anyway, it's a fantastic tea with great flavor and I couldn't recommend it more.

column9: A great small thing that you will love it.
