Typically, we have this rice with pork or chicken recipes.  Leftovers lend themselves to a variety of uses such as casseroles, soups and even fried rice dishes.  I love to add a bit of salsa to a bowl of leftover rice and heat it for a quick lunch.  I cook this rice in a basic rice cooker with no problem at all - it is fully cooked and fluffy every time.

I have used this brand for years and love the red beans and rice packet. But last night we were cooking up the yellow rice for the first time and my husband discovered MSG as one of the ingredients!!!!!!!! I was shocked! Lesson learned... I will read all of the packets ingredients before buying in the future. It will be sad if we can't enjoy these easy and delightful side dishes in the future. Though they list ingredients on this site, notice the disclaimer below. I would rather not support a business that uses these tactics. You decide for yourself.

column9: Best Rice I have EVER made
column10: I have made this rice since I was a teenager in Boston. It has the most delicious flavor goes PERFECT with any Chicken or Seafood dish. If you cook it just right it should come out very moist and flavorful... the trick is to use butter and stir the seasonings often (make sure it is throughout the pot) I used to only find the rice this rice back home in Boston or in Florida when I would visit my Mom now you can get them here on Amazon this is GREAT!BTW whenever there is a potluck I like to make this rice because EVERYONE loves it and you couldn't you just buy it anywhere.Respectfully Reviewed
Absolutely the best - cooks up perfect, very close to the yellow rice and chicken dish I enjoyed in Tampa as a kid.

I'm so impressed. No matter if I prepare this rice in a rice cooker or in a pan it always comes out light and fluffy. And the taste is amazing. Never again will I ever make my own Spanish rice from scratch - this is much better and much easier.

I was hoping for some bulk inexpensive quality peanuts to make pb. This was not the case. They come in really cheap packaging that was spilled all over the inside of the box. The nuts were stale and rancid tasting. Will not order again. Bright side, amazon was great about refunding me, so no real loss for trying. All my other amazon grocery purchases have been a success!

column9: The best bottled barbeque sauce I've ever tasted
column10: This isn't just great for a sugar free sauce -- it's great, period. We tried this because my meat-loving husband is dieting -- he couldn't believe how good it is. If you are watching carbs or just trying to eat less sugar, and you love barbeque, you are going to want this in your pantry.

I ran upon this in the grocery store and it looked like it would be good. I love spicy sauces.I thought it would be good but this is WOW! It isn't just a hot sauce, it has flavor. It is so good. It's good on chicken and eggs. It is out of this world on cottage cheese, sounds like a strange combo but I haven't tried anything that it tasted so good on, the cool of the cottage cheese, the heat of the chili sauce, yum!It does have a good bit of heat to it. I have to have something close by to drink because it does burn the tongue a little.I'm addicted now and will be a lifelong lover of this chili sauce. I find myself looking through the refrigerator just looking for something to put my chili sauce on.Yes, it's that good.

I have been eating this stuff for a decade and a half, ever since I worked in a teriyaki restaurant slinging yakisoba and udon soup bowls at the tender age of 18.  There are lots of good reviews on this product already and I agree with all of them... this stuff is HOT but also TASTY.  I ALWAYS have a bottle of this on hand.  My latest favorite thing to do with this sauce is to mix it with an equal part of Frank's Red Hot and a splash of vinegar and use it to drown a plateful of pelmehni (Russian dumplings).  That mixture, by the way, is also fantastic on wings.  On it's own, Rooster sauce is a MUST for me in ANY curry... it adds heat and complements the flavor perfectly and I also love to drizzle a bit (just a bit) into my chicken soup (not weird....I used to dump truckloads of Rooster into my Udon noodle soup!).  Really, the uses for the Rooster are endless.... but if you regularly cook things like stir fry or curry (any style) and you like a bit of kick.. this is a MUST HAVE pantry staple.  Plus, it's fun to dare people to eat spoonfuls of it.  :)I'm hungry.

column9: Rooster Sauce! --  A condiment you can't put down!
column10: UPDATE: Andrew Knowlton, restaurant editor at Bon Appétit magazine, predicts sriracha will be one of the biggest food trends of 2010!Knowlton was a guest on the CBS Early Show on Dec. 30, 2009 and shared, "If you walk into any chef's kitchen or home, you will find sriarcha. Sriracha is a hot sauce with flavor -- it livens up every dish you put it on."----Once only found on Thai or Vietnamese restaurant tables, a bottle of Sriracha (sree-RAH-cha) Hot Chili Sauce is now a telltale sign of a great eatery, whether it be a sidewalk hot dog stand, a family hamburger joint or my favorite Asian restaurant.New York Journal News reporter Kara Newman provided some background about the condiment nicknamed "Thai ketchup." Here's an excerpt:[[The two most commonly-found brands are Huy Fong, which sports a white rooster on the label, and Shark. (Supposedly, the shark is in homage to the shark-infested waters off the coast of Sriracha). Shark brand is made in Thailand and is used widely there as well as imported to U.S. stores and restaurants. Huy Fong is made in California by a Vietnamese immigrant, David Tran, and is the U.S. favorite.]]Sriracha is made of sun ripened chilies that are ground into a smooth paste with garlic. The sauce is nearly as thick as ketchup, which makes the squeeze bottle a handy way to deliver a spicy kick to your favorite foods. Speaking of ketchup, a little sriracha can add a nice kick to ketchup or your favorite dipping sauce without overpowering the other ingredients.Newman's story featured recipes were adapted from Greg Gilbert, Jackson & Wheeler.Sriracha Remoulade1 cup mayonnaise1/4 cup sriracha2 tablespoons red wine vinegarWhisk together until smooth. Serve as a dipping sauce with fried calamari rings.Fried Calamari1/2 cup calamari1 cup milk1 cup flour1/2 cup semolinaVegetable oil for fryingSalt and pepperSoak calamari rings in milk for about 20 minutes; drain.In a bowl, combine the flour and semolina. Dredge the calamari in the flour mixture, and shake off the excess. Heat the oil to 350 degrees, and fry the calamari until golden brown. Season with salt and pepper and serve with Sriracha Remoulade.Sriracha Spicy Buffalo Wings6 chicken wingsOil for frying3 tablespoons Frank's Red Hot Sauce1 tablespoons sriracha1 tablespoons butter, softenedBaby mache or other lettuce to garnishFry the chicken wings until crispy. In a bowl, combine the red-hot sauce, sriracha, and butter. Toss the wings in the sauce and serve. Garnish with baby mache or other lettuceSriracha is also an excellent value. Amazon offers six 17-ounce bottles for about $20, or less than 20 cents an ounce. That's a lot of flavor for your dollar.In summary, I grew up with pepper, salt and Tabasco pepper sauce on the table for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Did sriracha replace my bottle of Tabasco? Yes. Sriracha is hotter but with a light, sweet finish that sets it apart from the vinegar tang of other pepper sauces.Rating: Five stars.

column9: Not a Condiment, More Like a Sacrament.
column10: This bottle, or more appropriately, This Chalice, contains the true blood of the creator.  This bottle is culinary mescaline. It is a life changing sauce of the gods.  I pour nickle size blops on the back of my hand and slurp them off.  Maybe I should rephrase that. Nah... I mean it, if you are even slightly spice friendly, get this. Some hipster dope will tell you that this is not "real" or "authentic" sriracha. You tell that ironic fixie riding trustafarian to go to hell.  This is better.  This is some next level chit, mang. Its not an abusive hot, you can really taste peppers, and garlic, Its not a macho, "blew out my o-ring" hot, but it gets the endorphins flowing, elevates your conscience and we become one with the universe. No, really, I like it. It is good.

column9: Perhaps the greatest condiment known to man!
column10: Certainly the best to feature a rooster on the jar.Seriously, though, this is a spicy delight which, unlike many hot sauces offers a wealth of flavor. And a rooster.Should I be stricken with an ailment and locked into my body unable to move, just pump this wonder through the feeding tube.
YUM, OH MAN THIS TASTES GOOD. WOAH IT'S GETTING HOT. OH MAN MY MOUTH IS BURNING BUT I LOVE IT.Yep, it's good.A++ WOULD BUY AGAIN!!!

When having some Asian cuisine one day, I noticed this fiery concoction sitting on the table. I put some on my plate and started eating it with an with egg roll. I was instantly hooked :-)...This is a very tasty Asian-style hot sauce. It has the consistency of ketchup, but packs some nice heat. It is not like a vinegar based Louisiana style sauce, nor is it like a Mexican style sauce (typically more smoky flavored). It has a unique flavor profile, and it's great! It's sweeter tasting, with a very pronounced chili pepper flavor and just a hint of garlic, that really compliments a variety of foods. I use it on eggs, sandwiches, Asian foods, chicken, salsas, pizza, etc... Also, for the size bottle you get, it's a good value. I bought a big 17oz bottle of it for less than $3.50 at my local Walmart. Recommended!

column9: Great Flavor and Heat - Highly Recommended!
column10: Huy Fong "Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce" is offered in just about every Chinese and Vietnamese restaurant in my area, and with good reason! Unlike at lot of hot sauces, this has a great chili pepper and garlic flavor that compliments most of the dishes I like (particularly good on Pork Lo-Mein) and also provides a good amount of spicy heat. This is not the hottest of the hot sauces but it is on the boarder line for several of my friend.This is really good stuff and we almost always keep a bottle of it on hand to liven up or cooking or when take-out doesn't have enough "zing". It is also great spread on chicken when grilling but watch the smoke when opening the grill lid, it is like OC spray if it gets into your eyes.Highly Recommended!CFH
I love spicy food, I've had various chili sauces, but this is the best ever. I agree, it's addictive and HOT.., so be warned.

Huy Fong Sriracha is liquid fire when ingested in large quantities.. has a very mellow burn at first that builds up over time into a total sting.  Its not so overwhelming that you cant taste anything afterwards,  which is what makes this so deceptively good. A little goes a long way.Some of my favorite recipes;Mix a can of Tuna with 1oz of Sriracha in a bowl and serve on a sandwich, over rice, or as the core of a Spicy tuna Maki roll.For Wings,  Simply coating them with Sriracha will put an epic bite on anyone eating them, a solid 6 on the hot scale, but lets the chicken flavor come through.  For EXTRA hot,  add a 2oz jar of powdered Wasabi Horseradish to the mix and get ready for the pain.Lastly,  Mix a fair amount of Sriracha in with your Spaghetti sauce for some really nice kick.

As everyone else has already said, this is the best hot sauce on the planet!  We always called it "rooster sauce"...and my first exposure to it was this little bar/restaurant that was local to the college I was attending at the time (quite some time ago...lol).  Anyway, I used to put this sauce on EVERYTHING - pizza, burgers, french fries, marinara-based pastas....even omelettes/scrambled eggs.  But once I graduated and moved, I didn't run across Sriracha chili sauce (the original Huy Fong version, that is) for years.  I stumbled across it recently on an Asian food website and promptly ordered 4 bottles.  I just ordered 6 more today!  And just so you know, the Amazon price for the 6-pack beats anything I've come across thus far (especially considering that it's eligible for free shipping if you spend $25 or more).While I love anything spicy, I suppose that some folks might find this to be a bit much (so if you don't like spicy food, stear clear).  But for those of you who enjoy "spicy", this is the ultimate condiment!  I disagree with the reviewer who stated that they don't taste much of a difference between this and Tabasco.  This sauce tastes like chili peppers and garlic.  I think Tabasco has more of a vinegar taste to it.  Plus, Sriracha sauce is THICK - which I like much better, as it stays on food like pizza or french fries.  Tabasco is watery...and isn't as hot as Sriracha.Anyway, this is a great deal - so stock up!  You won't be disappointed!
No hot sauce fanatic should be without this addition to their collection. Sweet at first then suddenly hot. Nothing else like it. Simply the best.

column9: Lemme hear ya say, HOT HOT HOT!
column10: Delicious, but hot.  I didn't believe any of the reviews that I read, and now I find myself trying to sneak this sauce into anything I can.  And I had to try it in cottage cheese after reading that one person's review, and it's actually not all that bad.  It would take some getting used to.  Anyway, really hot, but it's a weird sauce because for how hot it is, it has this delicious flavor.  It's good by itself, but I love putting it on things that already have a sauce, or mixing it with a sauce.  MMmm yum.

Like many others, I can't say enough good things about Huy Fong's Sriracha Hot Chili sauce. There are other brands (some of which blatantly copy the bottle design) but stick with the original.If you've never tried this you probably want to know what all the fuss is about. To summarise, Sriracha adds a kick to just about everything - it's a tasty slightly sweet/somewhat salty chili heat, with a gradual burn that gets better the more you consume. There are hotter hot sauces but often you want to enhance what you're eating - for this Sriracha is great. I find it's especially good with Chinese takeout or anything fried. Pizza, noodles, even a Salad benefits from Sriracha.The only slight disadvantage is that sometimes the chili heat is a bit inconsistent from bottle to bottle. There have been bottles I've tried that aren't all that hot to others that were hotter than normal (and no, for me that isn't a bad thing!)Anyway, I am pretty much addicted to this sauce. You may also want to try Huy Fong Vietnamese Chili Garlic Sauce, 8 Oz. which is better suited for cooking with but you can use it as a condiment.UPDATE: Check out Huy Fong Sriracha Chili Sauce, 17-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12) for the 12 pack instead of the 6 pack, it's a better value. Hope this saves you money!

column9: The best hot sauce, but perhaps not the best pricing from Amazon
column10: This is the best hot sauce ever created.  If you have never tried the rooster sauce, please, do yourself a favor, and go try it.  It even appeals to people who don't typically like hot sauce.  It's got a bite, but it's got great flavor too.  And when you get that ratio of pain and pleasure just right, you get a hot sauce as addictive as sriracha.  And it is ADDICTIVE.  I put it on everything except sweets.  Unlike other hot sauces, it has a thicker viscosity and sticks nicely to anything you squeeze it on.  And a squeeze bottle is far superior than those bottles you have to turn on their side and smack from the bottom and make a mess all over the place with.My only complain is that I'm pretty sure I'm paying more than I should be by buying this product on Amazon. But the convenience of having this come to me in one-click is worth it, and I try not to think about how much Amazon might be fleecing me over this purchase.

Just kidding about the toast. I love this stuff, I put it on almost everything. I think it is addictive. Yum yum! It makes your mouth and lips burn. If your wife (or husband) is a horrible cook just say to him/her "it is great honey" and reach for the Sriracha. No more will you taste the horrible food you just put into your mouth and yet you will be crying with delight! lol Ok so this is a silly review, but hey I really do love this stuff.

I love, love, love this stuff, and put it on everything.  It's not *that* hot, at least not to me (when I want "really hot" I use something like '100% Pain' or just crumble a bunch of dried hot chili peppers), but this stuff is complex and "sweet-hot" in a way that's REALLY addictive, the way Thai food is addictive.  Other sauces are too bland, too vinegary, too sour, too sweet, but this is perfect.  This is my ketchup, my mustard, my relish, my salt and pepper.  I douse it on breakfast, lunch, and dinner.  For some reason it seems to go with food of every ethnicity.  It's especially awesome on burritos, and on fried rice.  And on pasta sauce.  And in soups (especially lentil).  I probably go through a bottle every five to ten days.  One week my grocery store ran out of it, and I was despondent.  Nothing tasted right that week, and I was so elated when I finally found some again.  Whoever came up with this stuff deserves a Nobel Prize in saucerie.Buy the way, vegetarians note: this sauce doesn't contain any fish extracts or any of that other stuff that can ruin some Asian sauces for us.  Yay!
Simply the best hot sauce available right now. I was hooked the first time I tried it and haven't looked back since. Great great sauce

column9: Great stuff for that authentic Thai and Vietnamese heat
column10: This Huy Fong rooster brand sriracha sauce is very popular in Asian communities. Its distinctive shape and green top is the kind you see in Vietnamese, Thai, and Chinese restaurants all over. Named after the Thai city of Sri Racha, this bottle is on almost every table of every Southeast Asian restaurant I've ever eaten at, next to the soy sauce and napkins. The squeeze bottle and pointed nozzle makes dispensing very easy. The sauce is smooth, so a gentle squeeze will give you control and precision. It looks like ketchup coming out, but is a bit more viscous.It's great on chicken or beef satay skewers and just about any food. It made with chili peppers and garlic and has a wonderful flavor on its own, not just heat. I enjoy it regularly with Vietnamese beef pho. It dissolves easily into the soup and adds a wallop. It's hot, but not insanely so, and the heat doesn't stay on your tongue and keep burning you like habeneros. American-styled hot sauces like Trappeys and TABASCO brand Pepper Sauce are typically very drippy with a dominant vinegar taste and smell. Sriracha is not.The product contains preservatives, so it needs no refrigeration. Refrigerating can cause the ink on the label to come off over time.

column9: The Real Deal All the Way Around!
column10: Sriracha is a chili garlic sauce. Any good Sriracha should have a very short list of ingredients (Chili, sugar, garlic, salt, distilled vinegar, potassium sorbate and sodium disulfite as preservaties, and xanthan gum). As far as many are concerned Huy Fong (with the distinctive rooster label) is the best of the best. It has a crazy good fresh chili taste, with a good bite of garlic and a sweet background. This is not "heat" for "heat's" sake. You eat this sauce for the flavor and either enjoy, or deal with, the heat. If you're a chili head this sauce rates about a medium. For everyone else it is quite hot.

column9: A Little Heat & A Lotta Flavor!
column10: I like spicy food, but not just for the heat. I love good taste, too!! When you add garlic to the mix of anything, it catches my fancy. For that reason, I really enjoy this sauce.

I was just commenting today on how Sriracha sauce is the new catsup.  It has become so mainstream that even Wally World sells it...........for much less, I might add.The best thing is to mix it with catsup and eat it with french fries.  Yummy.  Actually, you can put this on everything........burgers, falafels, deviled eggs, etc.  I wouldbe tempted to buy little individual packages if they made them and carry it in my purse for Sriracha emergencies.
hot, garlicky, spicy, sweet, tangy, and salty. really well balanced, works with everything, de-blands anything.. i even blogged about it! [...]
Siriracha Sauce is the greatest!! As soon as I couldn't find it where I live anymore I turned to Amazon.

column9: The Best Chili Sauce I've Ever Tasted
column10: This chili sauce is different any I've tasted before. It's not only very spicy but it has a delicious flavor; it's sweet and tastes good on everything.  You'll want to add more because it's so delicious but be careful because it'll continue to sting your mouth after your done eating. Again, the BEST chili sauce I've ever had. The price is also fair; $3.99 for a 17 oz bottle.
I Love this stuff!! Always have it in my fridge..awesome on so many different kinds of food besides Asian food.

column9: Insanely addicting, has a nice kick after you finish eating
column10: Put it on anything. Love it on anything. That's pretty much my philosophy on Sriracha. I have a decently high spice tolerance. This hot sauce just tastes amazing (imagine my voice singing in a high pitch). It also has a nice kick after you finish eating. Know that feeling you get while using alcohol-based mouthwash? Take that, multiply it by ten, and make it spicy (and delicious) and that's the aftertaste. I wouldn't give it up for the world.My family thinks I'm weird for dumping massive amounts of this stuff in everything I eat. Pssh, wimps.
I absolutely love Sriracha - this is, in my mind, the best all around hot sauce out there.  I put it on everything from sandwiches to seafood.

If you've ever thought, "If a nuclear war started and I could only take one bottle of hot sauce with me, which one would it be?"....this would be your answer.It's hot, with excellent chili and garlic flavor, and makes average food good and good food insanely delicious.Absolutely, absolutely recommended. More than any other.(And yes, this is all a little gushy, so to prove I'm human, I will mention this stuff is more fun going in that coming out...but nothing too major. The garlic and chili can do a number on your stomach if you're not used to eating hot sauces)

Not sure why I haven't tried this until recently but it came with a taco kit and since then I have been addicted! Makes everything taste better, noodles, chicken, potatoes you name it... Not sure though about the price on here, can get at my local grocery for around $2 a bottle, but gotta factor in shipping- Love this chili sauce!

column9: If you Like Hot Sauce You'll like this
column10: I was having a hard time finding this sauce locally.  I was able to buy from this vendor at a decent price a 6 pack of delicious Siracha.  Recently local vendors are selling this product for about a dollar less.  I would love to purchase again online in bulk, but, only if I were to save compared to buying locally now.  If this is not available in your area and you love hot sauce.  Don't delay.  Purchase this and enjoy.

I discovered this tasty condiment in the asian food section at the grocery store, maybe it was the rooster on the front of the bottle...or the word SRIRACHA!! I don't know, but it has now replaced tobasco and red hot as my staple hot sauce.  I like how it's more like a paste, the thickness makes it more user friendly on burgers and fries.  It's more flavorful too, and not too spicy in my opinion.  It's excellent on just about anything, I made some awful bland chickpea burgers.  I doused them with some Sriracha and then added some zesty bread and butter pickles, sounds weird but I'm telling you this stuff can make anything taste awesome.  I'm looking forward to actually trying it on something asian, I think it would be great on seafood. Anyhow, this stuff rocks.

column9: A Potent Hot Sauce, similar to Tabasco, just Better. Buy the 28oz which costs only a few cents more
column10: This hot sauce has become a staple in my kitchen and replaced my bottle of Tabasco. Like Tabasco - it is primarily a hot (cayenne?) pepper delivery device. A few drops add a considerable amount of heat to any dish. This is NOT a watered down hot sauce like Franks, etc.While Tabasco seems to impart mostly heat along with a heavy amount of vinegar - this sauce has far more subtle tastes going on beyond the heat, yet the heat is considerable and dominates. It also lingers, on your taste buds, longer than Tabasco. There is a subtle amount of sweetness to this sauce along with faint garlic notes. While Tabasco can taste quite harsh if you add too much to a dish ---- this sauce, no matter how much you add, tastes fresh and just a bit sweet.I wanted to say in my review that this sauce had a hint of tomato yet there are no tomatoes listed on the ingredients. I suspect what I thought was tomato was simply the "sun ripened chilies" and the added sugar listed on the ingredients. But to be clear - heat - lingering heat - is the primary tasteWhile I really like this product and certainly recommend its purchase --------- I'm not sure it rates 5 stars because the overall flavor does not seem TRULY exceptional - only VERY GOOD. There really is just one major taste evident and that is heat - and after that only a vague hint of something else which seems to be chiles, sugar and garlic. But chiles, sugar and garlic certainly beats (by a very wide margin) --- the heavy vinegar aftertaste as evidenced in Tabasco and many other hot sauces.For the $5.99 I paid locally for a 28 Oz bottle --- I'm glad to always have it on hand and it is a true staple.Amazon prices the 17oz at $5.19 and the 27oz at $5.89. It is a true no-brainer to purchase the 28oz size.As another reviewer recommended - given the potency of this stuff - you probably ONLY want to have a single bottle on hand. Larger quantities will deteriorate over time. I'd recommend you purchase this locally and not in the 2/3/6 packs offered on Amazon. I doubt many households will go through a bottle in a year. As I said: this is potent stuff.Update (July 2010) - a formal taste testI put 4 ounces of tomato juice into two glasses and progressively added 1/8 teaspoon of Tabasco or Huy Fong Sriracha into one of the two glasses until they both became too "hot" to tasteResults: With Tabasco - with each added dose the juice became not only hotter but harsher. With the Huy Fong - it became hotter yet retained a very fresh and sweeter note

column9: Most disgusting thing I've ever tasted
column10: I have no idea why this tasted SO bad to me... I normally am a fan of hot sauces, and I'm a pretty adventurous eater. But all I remember is this taste being revoltingly bad in my mouth. I can't even describe it to you, though I wish I could. I guess if I had to put words to it it would be a bizarre combination of FISHY peppers, vinegar, and tomatoes. Did I get a bad batch or something? Ew.

Ha.  You think you can handle your Meth?  Your Vodka?  Your Smack?That stuff is Cream of Wheat compared to The Ratch.  One day, it's a little dab - you know, for kicks.  To look cool.  Fit in with the hipsters.  A month later, heck - for me it was half a day - I'm a certified Ratch Head, holding a bottle of the Red Devil upside down like a plasma bag, sucking the heat from a clear plastic tube that I ripped from my little girl's aquarium air pump.  The fish died, but I didn't care.  They tasted sooo goooooood.I lost everything.  My faith in ketchup.  My faith in Chinese mustard.  My cutlery (no pride, I'd just face-plant onto the plate and suck.)  When the intervention happened, they found me curled up in the Specialty Foods Aisle of Target with a fiery cake of Ratch and oyster crackers pasted to my face and clothes.Rehab taught me that once a Ratch Head, always.  I met people there who assured me that I was ok without Sriracha.  That I didn't NEED heat.  The doctors, Mr. Heinz and Mrs. French put me on a new diet of quiet, soft condiments that - well, sure.  They don't have flavor, but they're certainly not making me think of them every hour of the day, either.I have a steady job now, new friends and tonight, we're getting together for Tuna Helper and instant lemonade.Stay away from Srirach sauce.Wait.  Did someone say chicken fingers?  (sniff sniff)Those ARE chicken fingers!SRIRACHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA TIME!!
The sauce was a little too spicy for me.  I like hot where it would compliment foods, but this one over powered.

As much as this sauce is the most definitive and delicious spicy chile paste in existence. The price on this six pack is ridiculous. I bought a 28 oz. bottle of Sriracha at the asian supermarket three weeks ago for $3.00. Weak.

column4: Lonnie E. Holder "The Review's the Thing"
column9: Crunchy Cookie with a Hint of Chocolate and Orange
column10: Pepperidge Farm is one of the few national companies that mass markets distinctive cookies.  One of those cookies is the marvelous Orange Milano cookie.  When you bite into this crunchy cookie you get a hint of chocolate as you reach the center, and as you chew the orange flavor spreads throughout your mouth.  Yet, none of the flavors is overwhelming.  The problem with Orange Milano cookies is that it is hard to stop after eating only one.These cookies are relatively expensive compared to other brands.  However, one of the hallmarks of Pepperidge Farm from the beginning of the company in the 1930s is quality.  For an alternative to the sweeter cookies typically available in the cookie isle, try Pepperidge Farm's cookies.  If you are looking for a good cookie to try first, this one is a winner.

I ordered several items from Barry Farms to make a holiday dish and my order not only arrived too late but was incomplete.  I got a note inside the box saying my ingredient was not available but I would have appreciated knowing that prior to getting my order so I could have placed an order elsewhere.  I live in a remote area and have to order a lot of ingredients online so I was just out of luck.  A simple email would have sufficed.

column9: Wisdom of the Ancients Pau d' Arco
column10: This is the only brand I buy for my teas and mixes. I can trust the quality and mfg. by this company. I have checked other sites and this is the best price around. I have used Wisdom of the Ancients for well over 10 years, you can trust the label.

Lapacho tea is little known in the west but if you are looking for an herb that will heal your ailments then this is the tea for you. It possesses, by far, the BEST antioxidants on the planet. Give it a try and see what I mean.

This is great stuff, used it for years.But the title says 4.4 ounce boxes and the description says 3.5 ounces.Our current (empty) box says 4.4 ounces, and the box in the picture here says 4.4 ounces.Which is it?
My wife and I are pleased with this purchase.  We will surely buy from this company again.
The smell is enough to put you off - it's like drinking mulch, utterly disgusting.

I have been a huge fan of the dark chocolate chip version of these cookies and tried the ginger for variety.  They are very good as well.  Crunchy, gingery--a nice, healthy, portion controlled snack.  If buying 7 boxes at a time on Amazon seems excessive to you, you may be able to find them at a Walmart near you.  Our Walmart started having the ginger and the chocolate ones, much to my delight, a short time ago.

These cookies taste good to begin with, and yes, they really *do* help your immune system.  I got hooked on them when a store near me started carrying them.  Since the store stopped carrying them, this is the only way I can get them.
This really works.....not long ago I was working in close proximity to co-workers who had colds and never got one.I take one bag a day.....I will never miss a dose......

column9: Went over big as a gift!
column10: Would have loved to give five stars, but this shipment was scheduled to arrive on a specific day (it was ordered as a birthday gift for my Dad) and it was a day late, despite tracking saying it was on time(??)  I cannot say whose "fault" that was, but otherwise, the product quality is absolutely great.  My Dad is quite the Cashew Connoisseur and he was very impressed.  Slightly pricey, but turned out to be well worth the cash.
These cashews are very tasty.  I like them, my 3 year old likes them, my husband likes them, and guests like them.  Just the right amount of salt.

I have purchased these bones for my dog in the past, and they've worked great. The three that were sent to me this time were not "fully pressed". If I can pull the pieces apart with my fingers, what are the chances my dog could bite off a sharp piece, swallow it, and become injured? It's terrible to put dogs at risk by having such poor quality control.

This is a nice big bone. The one I received was very heave and dense. At first my 8 month old puppy wasn't sure he could grasp it. But he quickly went at it. Kept him busy for nearly 4 straight days. For reference he is a 45 lbs and growing boxer mix.I bought similar 8' bones from Target. Granted they were much cheaper, $10 for 8, but they did not have the same density or weight to them and my dog could plow through one of those.
I bought the Gingerbread to get some christmasfeeling....they delivered fast, but the  gingerbread seemed not really fresh, normally i love these but they where quite old or something...
I'm very happy to have bought this product...it's a little expensive, but it is worthwhile...

My second favorite Jelly Belly flavor is Green Apple.  I ordered a box of 12 (3.5 oz) bags (perfect size for snacking).  Item arrived quickly and in excellent condition.  Would/Will order from this seller again.

column9: Friends and students love these, and the price is nice too
column10: I bought several varieties of these Cavendish & Harvey Drops in the ten-packs, so that I'd have plenty of individual tins to give to co-workers as part of Christmas baskets and to share with my university students (sugar helps them stay awake during those evening classes), and I'm very pleased with the price (as long as it works out to less than $2.50 per tin, which it does for this variety if you buy enough to get the free shipping).The pink grapefruit flavor is particularly popular with my friends and family (some of whom love grapefruit but can't eat the fruit itself anymore because of medicine interactions) AND with my students.  The other clear favorite (judging by which tins get emptied the fastest when I set them out at the beginning of each night class) is the Wild Berry variety.Personally, I enjoy the sour cherry and the orange flavors I bought, as well (though possibly not quite as much as I like the grapefruit and wild berry), so as long as the price stays nice, I'll order more of these, probably, in time for Valentine's Day!

This is absolutely my favorite flavor of KIND bars.  I am allergic to wheat, and I love that all of the KIND bars are wheat free.  This kind is totally awesome and worth the slightly higher price than the other bars.  Unfortunately since it's not currently available with Amazon Prime shipping, the shipping costs mean that I could buy two boxes of a different flavor for the same price as this one with shipping added.  I still get this flavor, I just don't keep it always on hand like I do the others.  And I always get a bar when I see it in Starbucks.  Yummy!!

column9: Could not taste much peanut butter
column10: Did not have much peanut butter taste.  There were peanuts that were fine. Guess I was expecting a stronger taste.

I had a craving for strawberry cake with strawberry icing & saw this. At first the price stopped me but I ordered it anyway. Came well packed & fast. The taste is fresh & good. The only thing I think I would have liked better is if the cake wasn't so dense but I don't think it can't be anyway else because it is being shipped. I think next time I'll try to make it myself & see if the cake is lighter.
bought this product when we were on island. wonderful, their island spice and peper blend are also very good.  can I buy their 1 lb. bags here? I want more then the 2 oz. can.

Arrived quickly and intact.  Is so beautiful that it you have to touch it to see that it isn't artificial.  Just arrived today, so we'll see how she does with someone who lost their green thumb years ago.  As of now, I plan on ordering another one very soon!

I HAVE BOUGHT SIX PLANTS FROM HIRTS GARDENS. ONE WAS INFESTED WITH MEALY BUGS & THRIPS, 2 WERE SENT BENT ,BROKEN DUE TO NOT PACKING THE PLANT CORRECTLY, MOST OF THEM HAD BROWN DRY LEAVES AND EVEN LEAF SPOTS. IVE POSTED THIS REVIEW BEFORE AND I RECEIVED AN EMAIL FROM HIRTS STATING PLEASE REMOVE MY REVIEW CAUSE IT HURTS THERE BUSINESS, I WASNT EVEN OFFERED AN APOLOGY ON ANY OF THE ISSUES.
