column4: Michelle Korn "Book Worm always looking to Learn"
column10: I've been buying this product for years & I have tried others, but this the best, especially for the price.It hardly has anything unnatural in it, & it's not real chicken which is great, even though it tastes just like it.I highly recommend it even as the other reviewer said, if you aren't vegetarian. I'm only a part time vegetarian.Michelle[...]
Great beans used to make extract, vanilla sugar, and kept a few to make cakes and frosting with.  It has only been a couple of weeks and the extract already smells like the store bought stuff.

I cannot speak for the alcohol versions, but this wine (in contrast to other alcohol-removed products) is very watery. I was unable to detect anything.  I am glad I had obtained this as a gift. It is not something which I would have been proud of purchasing for myself. And I really would not have wanted to serve it to others.

column9: Great alternative for those who can't drink alcohol
column10: This alcohol free wine is a great alternative for those who cannot, or choose not, to drink alcohol. Highly recommended, wish there were more companies producing alcohol free wines.

column9: Pregnant and missing the flavor of wine
column10: I am 20 weeks pregnant and really miss the flavor of wine, especially with my dinner. I searched the web , read reviews and finally gave in and headed to a local liquor store in hopes of satisfying my craving.I was VERY disappointed. The first sip was horrible... I tried it along with my dinner and it was just as bad. It's  like very flat VERY old Baby juice. It has no flavor AT ALL it is cheap but not even worth the $8.00 i paid for it.I wish i had better news for all the expectant moms out there missing that glass of wine with dinner.... BUT this did NOTHING for me.
This stuff is delicious and is a hit with our baby! Interestingly, she doesn't like Pear and Mango from other brands. The packaging is fun to squeeze too.
very good product will order more in the future it really keeps you from dehydrating if out in the sun or during physical activity

This cherry pie filling was the best I have ever tasted. I am not kidding, here. It had just the right tartness and sweetness. I am fussy about this kind of stuff. I don't like some things to be too sweet, and this was just perfect. I will be very particular about which recipes I use this in (that is if it makes it to any recipe at all, actually, meaning I'll eat it straight from the jar). The price is worth it. Don't forget, you are getting about 12 ounces more than you are getting in the cans. Barry Farms has some awesome stuff, and this is one of them. I don't like paying the shipping and handling, but as I said before, it is worth it. This company has been on a trial and error basis with me from reading some of the reviews and experiencing the shipping and handling. The quality of this product just zoomed them straight to the top of my list. Don't hesitate any longer. Get this cherry pie filling. It's the best, and the flavor is perfect.
Best pie filling in the world!!!!! Always receive my pie filling packaged excellently. They are the greatest

column9: Back to Nature Crispy Wheat Crackers - 8 oz.
column10: These crackers are made by Back to Nature Foods located in Madison, WI--made in the USA! I give these crackers 4/5 for flavor, 5/5 for texture, 5/5 for maintaining Earth conscious integrity, 0/5 for truth in labeling--score 3.5The carton is made of 100% recycled paperboard and the ink is derived from vegetables. The company supports the Nature Conservancy (Protecting nature, preserving life).These are crispy wheat crackers with a sweet and mild flavor.  These are super crispy crackers that will hold up to any dip or topping.The sweetness adds just enough flavor to make your toppings pop.  I personally serve them with fish dips (salmon) and cheese toppings--yummy!The crackers are made of unbleached enriched flour and contain wheat flour, niacin, reduced iron, thiamine mononitrate (vitamin B1), riboflavin (vitamin B2), folic acid, safflower oil, raw sugar, defatted wheat germ, cornstarch, brown rice syrup, sea salt, malted barley extract, leavening (monocalcium phosphate, baking soda), natural turmeric flavor.The 8 oz package contain 8 servings--17 crackers.  Each serving contains 130 cal., 4 g fat, .5 g polyunsaturated fat, 2.5 g monounsaturated fat, 230 mg sodium, 55 mg potassium, 22 g carbs, 1 g fiber, 4 g sugars, 2 g protein.The package states that the crackers contain no artificial perservatives or flavors and no hydrogenated oils.  However, the product does contain Thiamine mononitrate which is a 'synthetic form' of vitamine B1, and medical and nutrition experts recommend a daily potassium intake of 4.7 g per/day.Don't forget to recycle the box!

column9: Sorry to give these up -- afraid of cancer recurrence
column10: The flavor of these bars is very, very good.  They are filling and have many good nutritive qualities.That being said, we have to stop buying these bars.  They are using soy protein isolate, which probably met two of the manufacturer's goals:1) Vegetarian/non dairy2) Save money -- that is one cheap-o source of proteinAlthough we all know that an alternative -- WHEY protein from cross-microfiltration -- is the highest form of protein available right now, it is expensive.  It is more easily assimilated than soy, causes fewer GI issues (gas, indigestion, etc.), and has a better amino acid profile, etc., plus has little to no lactose remaining."Instead of using destructive chemicals, cross-flow microfiltration uses filters to separate protein from undesirable fat, cholesterol and lactose, based on molecular size and shape.(18) The low-temperature process isolates the native protein of whey at its biologically natural pH, carefully preserving its biological activity. GMPs and other immune-boosting components remain intact."informational reference:  www <dot> sportswhey <dot> com/science_ion_exchange.htmAside from the problem we have with the grossly inferior form of protein they are using, our main reason for stopping with this product is this:>>>>> We don't want our cancer to return. <<<<<<<We have had breast cancer, and it was estrogen positive.  Our oncologist has indicated that while foods containing soy are ok in reasonable amounts, SOY ISOLATES ARE NOT SAFE FOR THESE TYPES OF CANCERS.Research backs this up.These bars are possibly cancer-promoting in the sense that they have estrogenic-effects.Women who are at risk for breast cancer (and who knows how much of the population this includes -- we don't know until after we have gotten it most of the time) SHOULD NOT BE EATING THESE BARS.Maybe they can put a warning label on them to say women should check with their doctors before consuming them.The research on this is readily available on the Internet, and my oncologist has studied this issue extensively.We are sad to give these bars up because they were our favorite in terms of flavor.

I have been purchasing Large French Vanilla Iced Coffee's from Dunkin Donuts for at least 12 years now.  Recently I've become frustrated at the stupidity of the workers that they employ and their inability to make my coffee the way that I ask for.  They also sometimes give me decaf without telling me simply because they are out of regular, too lazy to make more, and think that I won't notice.  Couple that with the fact it cost me $2.75 for every iced coffee I purchase and I simply have had enough.  I found out about this on a deal website and figured hey why not.  It tastes great, gives me a good pick me up, and doesn't have a lot of the bad things that are in energy drinks.  Sure it has the energy blend that most do and also (some of which you might not need) but other then that it has all natural ingredients.  It has real milk and real coffee and I don't miss my Iced Coffee one bit.  I order 3 12 packs and already have an order placed for when they are back in stock.  At 65 cents a can (after the coupon) you can't go wrong.  Only problem was some of the cans of the second shipment were pretty dented up but its not a deal breaker.  I even wrote the company about the freshness of the product seeing how there was no expiration date and they told me how to read the code on the bottom of the can.  Turns out the ones I received had a born on date of 12/14/2010 that is perfectly acceptable.

Cafe Energy (Vanilla Sky flavor)by Blue Sky,when kept chilled,is a wonderful drink for a mid afternoon break when working outdoors in the heat.  The vanilla coffee taste, the texture,and chilled temp have become addictive; replacing protein shakes.  Great product, and their customer service is just as wonderful!

I learned about these on Slickdeals.net and after reading the positive reviews/comments of others, I decided to take a chance and try this product and placed my first order on March 20th.  I've enjoyed Hansen's/Blue Sky's natural sodas off and on for twenty years and looked forward to their energy drink.  Wow - I did not expect to like it as much as I did/do!  I've been on a quest for a good energy drink, and thus far, this is my favorite.Pros:Hansen's/Blue Sky's reputationDelicious, smooth coffee and vanilla flavorEnergy and focus without caffeine jitters and crashGreat anytime pick-me-up and doesn't require a coffee shop stopBeneficial vitamins, low cal (please see Blue Sky Soda's website for nutritional info.)Gives me a positive pre-workout energy the specialized mixes and drinks do notEasier on my stomach, doesn't have the acid burn some of other energy drinks I have triedCons:Cans have arrived dented (I do not know if that's Hansen's or Amazon's responsibility.  Amazon refunded our first order, thank you kindly Amazon.)Can be a little spendy - I contacted Hansen's to see if we could purchase these locally, they gave me contact info for our nearest retailer carrying them (60+ miles away), they sell Vanilla Sky for $3.19 each, clearly Amazon has the best price.  The folks at Hansen's were a delight to work with, one of the most positive customer service experiences I have had in a long time, this pretty much seals the deal of my continuing to be a loyal customer.Bottom line:  I love these (my sweetie does too now!), I will buy them again (we've not been without them since my first order) and I recommend this product.  Thank you kindly for reading, I hope this review will benefit others.

column9: Latte--not a typical Blue Sky product
column10: The advertisement showed Vanilla, the can showed coffee on arrival.  Tow different flavors.  It is a quality product from Blue Sky--a highly creative and interesting company.  I do not care for coffee flavors and would not have ordered this product--however, on giving it to some friends, they enjoyed it.

A wonderful smoked mozzarella cheese. Delicious by itself or on pizza. The cheese itself is a firm cheese that holds up well and shreads easily in a shredder. It seems to have a very good shelf life and if you are looking for a smokey mozzarella cheese you should try this one, it is delicious.
My intention was to buy in bulk and save money in lieu of purchasing at a local store. Not enough savings to justify processing the order and waiting several days for delivery.

column9: Delicious in most iced drinks, a little tricky to make, worth the effort
column10: If you follow the instructions on cooking boba/tapioca/bubble tea, the consistency and taste is amazing. The only downside is that the pearls tend to crumble in the bag and are generally fragile before they begin to cook and darken. Also, if the water is not hot enough in the beginning, you get the same problem of the pearls dissolving and things getting a bit messy and/or sticky. If you are patient and dedicated, these are the best choice, but if you want a simpler alternative, try the black minute pearls instead. Less delicate, easy to make, and just as tasty in the end, they are a lovely alternative. It's your choice, though. Either way, boba/tapioca pearls are a deliciously addictive addition to most iced drinks, especially milk teas, but also quite a few juices.

I liked the taste and texture. However, one of my packages arrived with the vaccuum broken and the balls had turned to complete dust. I wrote to customer support, but have yet to hear from them.You have to boil the balls for 30 minutes, covered, let them sit for another 25 minutes, still covered, then rinse them in cold water. Then you coat them in sugar syrup, which you make by simmering equal parts of sugar and water.

I don't what is up with the picture but what I received was a 2 lb. bag of the black instant pearls. It was exactly what I wanted and cooked without problem. I've been trying it out on different Thai deserts without much success though because the instant kind of tapioca doesn't soak up juices as well as hoped.

I'm definitely a satisfied customer.  My DHL package got to me damaged and the box was wet. The Bubble Tea customer service representatives where wonderful about replacing it.  I will buy from them again!  They have excellent customer service in my book! Thanks.Angel

column9: Good taste! But buy flavored Boba Tea powder too if you want to make decent boba tea
column10: I cooked this product last night and even though I muddled the directions a little bit, the boba tasted pretty good. You get a good deal for the price.RECOMMENDED COOKING INSTRUCTIONS:- Boil water in pot with lid- Pour some of the boba in (the amount you plan to use, since leaving boba unused for long makes the boba stick together and not as appetizing)- Put lid on pot and cook boba at MEDIUM HEAT for 15 minutes- Turn off the gas and let boba sit for a couple of minutes- Drain the water from the boba- Run boba under cool water for about a minute, then drain again.- Mix honey, sugar, or sugar substitute (ex: Splenda) with boba- Let it coolMy number one tip for ANYONE buying boba is to buy the boba tea power too! That's what makes boba tea taste so good. Trying to make your own at home (like a did) will probably result in disappointment.

I followed the directions on the package, cook 5 minutes then let sit for another 10-15 minutes, for pearls with great taste and texture.  They also reheat well.  Microwave for 1.5-2 minutes to get the chewy texture back after refrigeration for a day. I will definitely reorder.
Overall good quality.  These tapioca balls aren't as large as what I sometimes get at the teahouse, but they have a good flavor and texture.
Luckily I have made bona before because these pearls come with no instructions. also be warned they are not the quick cook variety they take the full time.
These are not what I was expecting, I was expecting to get the larger tapioca pearls. And it was not the ones shown in the picture, will buy from somewhere else next time.

column9: Looking for this for so long.
column10: These are the closest I could find to the quality boba places I got so used to in LA. Others either never boiled through or had a different taste. I was worried about these at first with all the brown powder in the bag, but extremely satisfied. For those not getting good taste, remember to add sugar( 1/4 to 1/2 cup) to the boil and maybe a little honey. They are still about 80% as large as the boba places but the straws I have couldn't handle full size anyway.

column9: Terrible. Got no use out of the entire bag.
column10: When I received the bag about 40 percent of the beads were already crushed to power and the others appeared to be so old that they crumbled thereafter. It was like no version of tapioca I have ever dealt with before.

These were just what I wanted! Nice and chewy, and easy to make. I didn't notice any weird smells like the other reviews said. They didn't crumble either. If you want the pearls immediately, boiling them for 5 minutes and then rinsing is enough for a nice soft, chewy texture. Although they do dry out rather quickly. If they do, just put them in the microwave with some sugar syrup until they're soft and chewy again. It works.

column9: MAKING BOBA AT HOME IS THE BEST!
column10: I go out to get bobaDrinks 2-4 times a week, now I make it at home!This boba is soft and chewy add your own sugars or honey after you cook it!EASY EASY EASYBOIL, POUR, and WAIT 5mins(for a chewy texture) or 5mins+/desired amount of time for a softer texture. (I prefer the softer texture so I would keep it in the boil for 3+mins and then turn off the heat and close the lid and let it sit for another 5mins. (Clear instructions are also on the back of the bag)This boba doesn't even fall apart! Like the other ones would.GREAT PRODUCTWOULD AND WILL BUY AGAIN.
These are small and crumbled in my hand. They also have a weird maple syrup-like smell and taste. I'll be ordering more expensive pearls in the future.
It's interesting when you find out that tapioca pearls are actually those little bubbly round things you find in pudding.  They are REALLY good.  This is a great product.  I recommend it.

I read ALL the reviews from other people and ugh.  I made a mistake on this one.  I should have order the ones with coloring and flavoring.  I thought I would be frugal and a little more healthy. This has "maple syrup" taste and the cooking smell is just AWFUL.  If I hadn't been the one cooking it and someone made it for me... maybe I could have enjoyed it.

I love smoked paprika. It's near impossible to find in my area.I have used another brand from another site, and loved it.When I came across this one here on Amazon, it sounded like a good try.Not.This paprika has absolutely no smoke flavor, no smell.On the plus side, it's a perfectly fine regular paprika.There are much better options out there.
This was received with some damage but the company replaced the problem bags immediatley. Good baking flour too. all natural and organic.
Shipped very fast, and packaged for any kind of weather.The best flour for organic, whole food pastries.

What's in the box:Organic, buttery-rich crackers:  6 crackersGourmet Asiago cheese spread:  .75 oz.Salami Slices: .8oz.  enough for a couple of slices per cracker (or else you will have a lot of salami and no more crackers)Cashew medley, containing yogurt chips, cranberries, cashews and raisins:  .75 oz.Organic Dark Chocolate sandwich cookie with antioxidants:  1 cookiePlastic knifeIt all tasted so good!  I was shocked at how great all the flavors went together.  The cheese spread easily on the crispy, butter crackers.  The salami didn't taste salty, but was well-textured and very natural.  The cashew medley is awesome and I wish there was a bigger bag of this item.  The organic sandwich cookie was fine, but not outstanding.  Overall, this is a great tide-me-over until dinner or my next meal.  For a child, this would be fulfilling for a lunch box.  I only wish there was a little juice box to wash it all down.

I first tasted the Asiago cheese in this snack box when I got one of the larger boxes of snacks in the mail. I'm still impressed with the smooth buttery texture of the cheese that goes very well with the crisp crackers. This box also contains delicious slices of salami that you can put on the crackers and cheese for a meal in itself. The best part of this snack box is the Cashew Medley which is a mixture of creamy yogurt chips, dried cranberries, raisins and cashews. Then for dessert there is a dark chocolate sandwich cookie which really finishes the meal off nicely. This is one of my favorite GoPicnic snack boxes. You can easily take these boxes to work, on a picnic, when you hike or if you need a snack in your car. Delicious and convenient!~The Rebecca Review

Each part of the meal comes in its own separate package; all together in a small box.  Most of the packages are easy to open, but the salami required scissors. Since I wasn't traveling when I opened the package, I found that I like the salami better refrigerated for a sandwich The Asiago cheese spread was a little too bland; I really like the taste of Asiago.  The nut snack and the dessert were good.  For the use most buyers will put it (food for travel), I think it's a decent product at a reasonable price.

column9: Healthy tasty meal for a breastfeeding new mommy
column10: My daughter is now 7 months old, and I only now am getting time to write a review :) but these are my FAVORITE GoPicnics! I have at least 5 in my car at any one time, one in the diaper bag and I throw one or two in the stroller, when we go on long walks because I constantly need the calories (I am breastfeeding), and when she is sleeping in her carseat and I want something healthier than drivethru, and don't want to wake her up to go in anywhere, these save my bacon. I usually start with the surprisingly sweet and salty chocolate and move on to the salami then cheese and crackers (carefully balancing ratios), saving the nut mix until the end. Even if the chocolate melts in the car, it is still yummy :). These really come in handy when my grand food plans have fallen through because she is still not sleeping through the night... but that is another story...

I work outside in the summer and spend days hiking and working in remote locations. It is great to have shelf-stable gluten free lunches that are light-weight and contain a variety of food items. For long work days or strenuous hikes, these meals do not provide enough calories, so plan to supplement them as needed. I'm thrilled to have ready made gluten free food and avoid the worry of celiac complications in the back country!

column9: Great snack meal except for the dessert
column10: Comparable to the turkey pepperoni this one has awesome flavor.  Great crackers, asiago cheese goes perfectly with the salami and crackers and the fruit/nut mix is wonderful.  I find a flaw in every meal I've tried and in this one it's the dessert.  It was tasteless like cheap drugstore chocolate..reminiscent of wax but not unedible.  Otherwise I enjoyed this particular snack meal enough that I bought several cases for lunch-on-the-go.  Beware the pricing...Amazon's price is way too high, I bought mine on warehouse deals and won't pay anymore than that for any of these.  Too small of a meal to cost that extreme regular pricing.

We all love this one, but my 7 year old is the biggest fan. She goes crazy over them. She literally swoons and says things like "The salami melts in my mouth" and "This must be what happiness tastes like." Over the top? Yeah. She's dramatic. But she loves her meats and cheeses. And she's right. The salami really does sort of melt away on your tongue. It's all good, from the fruit and nut mix to the chocolatey cluster. I wish there were more of it, obviously. Like 30% more would be perfect. A Hungry Man version. But that's my only complaint. I can't think of a better snack to take on a trip (air travel, midnight snack in your hotel), but we usually just eat them at home because they're just too good.

column9: Perfect to take on the go!
column10: These ready to eat meals are perfect on the go and in my daughter's lunch.  Always delicious and so easy.  The cheese is the best part.
I love these the go picnic meals - I will be ordering them again.  These are great if you work at a place where there is no refrigerator to keep your food.

My 7-year old absolutely loves salami and cheese pack for her lunch. She even eats dried fruit, which she wouldn't touch if it weren't in a GoPicnic box. It's a very convenient way to have a snack on a go, especially with kids. However, I found the combination of cheese, salami and crackers a bit too salty for my taste. If only crackers were not sprinkled with salt, it would have been perfect. But otherwise, a very nice snack box.

I love GoPicnic meals for their convenience & variety. The salami is a bit oily/salty but otherwise the meal is great. I highly recommend these for adults & children. I will caution that my son has a hard time opening all the little packages so may be best for older kids.

I bought these to have as a backup grab-and-go lunch on days when I don't have time to make a sandwich, or alternatively, for traveling. Much tastier than I expected - the salami is very good (it is a little oily as some have said), the cheese spread is good, the crackers are good, the trail mix is very yummy, as is the chocolate cluster. These are not lunches for the large appetite or those on salt-restricted diets. But they are better than edible, very portable, shelf-stable and with some neat diverse flavors. Beats the heck out of a Powerbar, that's for sure!
If you're looking for something for your kids' lunchbox, this may do the trick.  If you want something good, keep looking.  It's the cheapest imaginable food.
I have only tried the GoPicnic tuna meal and I did not not like it.  The concept is good and I hope the otherchoices are better but for me the product is not worth the price
Product is considered the national sauce of Costa Rica and is wonderful.  However, the vendor delivered the product three weeks past the promised date.

I was so excited to see that I could purchase some Salsa Lizano!  Ever since my trip to Costa Rica 10 years ago, I've been longing to taste the flavor of some authentic Tico food!  Salsa Lizano has brought that flavor home to the States for me!

I have been trying to find Lizano Salsa in stores for many years. I discovered that I could buy it from an on-line company and was very excited to find that it was reasonably priced and just what I was looking for. It's a favorite in Costa Rica where it is found in every home and restaurant.

WE fell in love with Lizano salsa on a trip to Costa Rica years ago, and brought some back with us.  Since then we've used several  companies to order it, most recently Costa Rica Products, who never sent the product despite many conversations with them.  So when it came up on Amazon, I immediately jumped on it and ordered, received it promptly and am very happy to have a reliable source for this excellent salsa!

I went to Costa Rica with my family back in June and wherever we went to eatthey had Salsa Lizano on the table. We all enjoyed it and wondered if we could get it back in the States.  I checked on Amazon and was happy to see that it was available.So I ordered it and we use it all the time!
Lozano is wonderful salsa. In costa rica it is the condiment on every table. It's unique flavor is a fun change to other asWas.

column9: Lizano!  the secret salsa off my gourmet burritos!
column10: I have been cooking with Lizano's for year. It is my "go to" for many dishes. Discovered it in Costa Rica and my children and grandchildren rave!!  Now that I found Lizano on this site, I plan on ordering for everyone!
I love this salsa and will keep on using it for years in so many dishes

Lizano Salsa Sauce, 23.7 Fl Oz We loved this product since the 1980's when we discovered it in Costa Rica.  It really adds something extra special to your food.  In particular beans & rice (Gallo Pinto).  Now we can share with our kids this delicious treat!  I would recommend it to anyone who likes that add a little more flavor to meats or beans - anything really.  It is not spicy just very flavorful.

I was lamenting the low level of my bottle of Salsa Lizano this morning so decided to 'google' it, and to my suprise it was available on Amazon:) I use it on eggs, rice and beans w/kale, and so much more. Visited Costa Rica 3 times and always stocked up. Now I will have an extra bottle to share with my daughter and one to spare.Salsa Lizano is a tad salty and a little goes a long way. I used to use worchester sauce on eggs but this is so much more flavorful. I had previously thought there was a fruit base to the salsa, but after reading the ingredients, realize that I was misinformed.
A staple at the Costa Rican table this is a must for that authentic Costa Rican taste.
I have always loved this product and was glad is was available in this country.

THIS POWDER IS VERY MILD,I bearly get the chili taste,I only used it twice, each time I increaed the amount I have not reached that good chili taste that I like yet,I am undecided as to ordering it again

column9: Call me crazy, but this is available in the store for 1.99.
column10: I love TJ's and I'm a frequent shopper, but the price for this reusable shopping tote online is very high.  I don't want to discourage anyone from buying and carrying this great, sturdy tote (I have two), but getting it at the store will save you some money!

I got this bag at a Trader Joes in NYC three years ago.  The handle became frayed from over use.  I saw it for sale on Amazon.  it was more expensive but T Joes doesn't have this particular bag anymore.  It came quickly and is soooo worth it.  It's the right size and water proof and I can throw lots of stuff in it!!Thanx Amazon and the seller

The bag is more sturdy than I had expected and roomier too. It would make a great product of different sized luggage!! I'm using it for an overnight bag, something easy that fits the bill...try it and see for yourself.

column9: Great taste and healthy food. They finally listened!
column10: I love this ketchup without corn syrup! It tasted much better. It's not as thick as the usual one, but that's totally fine with me.

I've been feeding this along with 2 other Natural Balance canned flavors to my 3 cats for about 6 months now and they absolutely love this stuff. I feed the two girls each a half a can in the morning and another in the evening, my 15lb boy I feed 3/4 can twice a day. I also leave them a bowl of Blue Buffalo kibble out to snack on, which honestly they eat very little of and I am thinking of removing it from their diet. They can't wait to dig into the Natural Balance and once the bowl is down they inhale every last bit in less than 5 minutes. Their coats are super soft and shiny and their eyes are bright and shiny as well and they have crazy amounts of energy, annoyingly so at times as they sound like they're going to tear the house down with all the running, jumping and wrestling they do...even my 12 year old calico has developed much more energy and has been participating in the mayhem.

This is a very healthy cat food (at least what was recommended to me by my vet) and my cats seem to truly enjoy it. According to the ingredients, it's made with real meat, not by-products, which is what I try to get for my critters.So far, no complaint with the seller or the quality of the cans of food (which I normally buy at the pet store, but have found is much easier to be ordered online and delivered).

I stwitched my 5 cats to Natural Balance canned products when I learned how dry food is processed. I knew this may be a hard change for them and tried different brands. They would not touch any canned  food until I tried Natural Balance. They now eat this exclusively. I feel better knowing they are eating healthy food with no meat by products and additives that are not designed for feline consumption.Kudos to Natural Balance!

I use this and the strawberry variety to top berries.  It's so tasty.  I either fill a large graham cracker crust (or the small mini ones), or I use the premade puff pastry shells, and then top the berries with whip cream, a single berry and a sprig of mint.edit- for Thanksgiving I made the cream cheese pie with the recipe on the box.  It was GREAT!  I topped the pie with blackberries, and everyone who came to dinner loved it (and one guest said the pie was exactly like the pie her grandmother made).
This product is terrific.  Delivered on time.  Will buy again.Brings me back to my childhood.  This is one of the best comfort foods.

I have used this for years, especially at holiday time.  Most often for raspberry pie:  Drain a couple bags of frozen raspberries, saving the juice.  Use the juice as part of the water to make the glaze.  Cool slightly and add drained raspberries.  Turn into a graham cracker crust and chill.  Serve with whipped cream.  I have also used fresh raspberries and sliced fresh strawberries.  This makes a thick, beautiful glaze, with a good clean flavor.
This is a great product to use in pies, cakes, desserts, anything.  Easy/quick to make and delicious.  Bad thing, is hard to find in stores, so stock up here at Amazon.com

column9: Great Dessert available now from Amazon
column10: Junket dessert is a fast, easy, and delicious topping for cake or fresh berries.  Always a hit with family or guests.

Having grown up near the French border, I've had my share of wonderful Sauces Bearnaises. And as I don't trust myself in making it myself, I often bought all kinds of ready-made concoctions over in Europe. This brand here though is an absolute disappointment. The structure of the sauce is so pasty, that you can actually cut it with a knife. The taste is of a non-descript mayonaise; if it were not for bits of tarragon and chalots, you wouldn't even make out that this is supposed to be something special. I'll certainly not spoil my salmon or steaks with this; a burger might just cover the fatty taste enough with all its other ingredients. Sorry, I feel my money was wasted, especially so after I had some wonderful freshly-made Sauce Bearnaise by a French chef yesterday.

I love sauce Bearnaise;  it's not actually hard to make this at home, but it does involve standing over a hot stove while slowly stirring in pieces of butter so the sauce doesn't curdle.  In a very hot summer, I thought I'd just order from Amazon instead.  Unfortunately, because I was looking to save with Prime shipping, I ordered from another seller and these reviews didnt pop up.There's no butter at all in this; instead, canola oil which tastes so stale that this resembles only very low quality mayonaise.There must be good pre-made Bearnaise out there, but this is definitely not it.  After one use we're throwing it out.  Just a pity we wasted a good rib-eye steak by putting this on it.

column9: One of the Better Prepared Bernaise
column10: We have been trying different prepared Bernaise products, and this is one of the best. While home-made is almost always better, this hold its own quite well.

The taste of this sauce is good but it is not Bearnaise sauce. I have tried different Bearnaise sauces and I know what Bearnaise should taste like and this is not it. I give this product two stars because it does taste good although it claims to be something it is not.
This seasoning is fantastic! I use it on fish, steak, lamb, shortribs, salads, veggies, beans, soups, etc. No other seasonings needed when using. I highly recommend!!

I suppose a gringo like me would think this is something completely different.  The peppers from which this paste is made are familiar, but you don't think of turning them into essentially a puree and cooking with them.  My favorite is mixing aji with olive oil and basting a good steak while grilling - gives it a whole new dimension.  It seems that even high heat won't break it down or make it bitter.  If you're not into spicy food, this isn't for you.  It's caliente, but not ridiculous.  Yeah, the shipping will probably cost more than the product - but unless you're in a the very big city, you won't find anything like this as your local grocer.

I bought seeds to grow this product and they were not fertile so I guess I'll just have to buy more of this. It's FABULOUS! Not sure how to describe it... it's a hot pepper, but has a distinct flavor. lasted quite a while (less if you like it spicy!)

I CANNOT believe some people giving 1-2-3 starts JUST because the shipment/packaging was not good. This is a PRODUCT review, not a place to review UPS,FedEx or whatever company Amazon uses. Sure, put your comments there about this but why take away starts from this DELICIOUS best chili paste ever!

I've bought this before in the local store.  It is hard to find.  I use it a lot in stir fry, beans and rice and other dishes.  Received all of the bottles intact and it was fast shipping.This is a great bargain cause they generally cost 3 to 4 dollars each when I could find it.Will order again when I run low on it.

Sambal oelek chili paste is the best. We add it to salsa, salads, soups, hot dogs, you name it. This stuff is spicy but it is a totally different kind of heat than tobassco or other hot peppers. The best I can describe is that it sits on my palette in a different way than other peppers and is just a better product. Love it!

I live in Georgia, where collard greens and fresh vegetables are eaten and loved by just about everyone. I like trying new things and went to the local Oriental Market and purhcased this product. I decided to put some on some collard greens and WOW, I couldn't believe how good it was on the greens, and from then on I put them on just about all my cooked greens (collards & turnips) and peas, they are especially good on vegetables cooked with okra. This chili paste just brought out the flavor of the vegetables and added some umph to them. If you like spicy foods, then you should try adding some of this chili paste to your vegetables. You can adjust how spicy the vegetables by adding a little or a lot. Huy Fong Sambal Oelek Sauce, 18 Ounce Bottle (Pack of 6)

HOT STRONG TASTE aside from being hot it imparts flavor, has character. Discovered it in Asia and glad to be able to purchase here in the USA. PROBLEM is that an 8oz bottle lasts only for 2 to 4 days in this household. Dont know bout other shipping options but with Prime its always on time, perfectly packed, and ready to receive a spoon and be dished out.
I've been using the Huy Fong sauces for years & they are the best you can find. Try some:-)
I agree with the others that said this is the "best chili ever." That is all I want to say, but the program asked for more words.  To repeat, it's the best!Madison Bill

Not great.  Was looking for the Paste I had at my favorite Chinese restaurant, which has a paste with almost no liquid and thick and very hot.  This product shouldn't be called a paste, as it is really runny and vinegary.  Way too much tangy flavor and not at all what I'd call a paste.  I'll have to stop at the restaurant to find out what they use.

column9: Somewhat Bitter - this company offers better products - I'd pass on this one
column10: The overall taste of this sauce was a disappointment to me. I love many of this company's products so I was a bit surprised that this chili paste didn't taste any better. There are bitter notes to this sauce which I attribute to chile seeds, vinegar and an excessive amount of salt. Buy some dry red pepper flakes and you'll eliminate the bitterness of this sauce but otherwise replicate it almost perfectly.I much prefer the Huy Fong's Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce. It is not only hotter but it has a wonderful sweetness to it combined with some pleasant garlic notes.This is a fine company but not every one of its products hits the mark. This chili paste misses the mark by a wide margin in my view.The product label lists (in this order) chiles (with seeds), salt and then vinegar. The vinegar and salt add a lot of bitterness. As I said - I like this company's products but not this particular one. Salt and vinegar do NOT complement chiles all that well - at least in my limited perspective.

My local target often runs out of it so I ordered by amazon. First batch came with the box crushed. Amazon sent me a replacement Asap.The product itself is great, if you like hot and distinct flavor this is worth a try!

column9: Great deal, but one container broke during shipping
column10: This is really a great deal for the amount. I was happy to find such a good deal on Sambal Oelek, and was excited for my package. When it came, I opened it up and saw that one container of the 6 had "leaked" from around the rim. It wasn't packed well at all and the contents were able to move around the box with almost no padding to cushion any jarring the box would inevitably encounter during shipping. It didn't leak too much, luckily, since I also ordered 2 books that came in the same box. The rest of the jars were intact though. Anyway, Amazon just needs to pack this item more securely and away from the "walls" of the box (with some sort of cushion) so it won't move around during shipping, and it will remedy the problem. I'm still happy with my purchase! The quality is great and the price can't be beat.

One of the bottle is broken after it arrived but amazon is very nice to credit back to me without return. The product is ok, not good as the garlic one of the same brand, will buy the garlic one in stead of this in the future

column9: Sambal Oelek Cellophane packaging and shipping
column10: This chili sauce is wonderful, with a fresh chili taste. It's served in many Chinese restaraunts. The problem is the way it's shipped, not the product inside the (hopefully) sealed jar. I bought a six pack of Sambal Oelek from Amazon. When I opened the box, the six pack had broken out of a flimsy cellophane wrap that tears easily. One of the jars had been jostled around so much from coming out the packaging that the safety seal had broken on the lid and there was chili paste spilled in the box and all over the containers. The six pack packaging probably would have held up if there would have been adequate air packing in the box, but unfortunately there was only one air pillow pack in the box, with lots of open space in the box. So, with the flimsy wrap and the lack of packing around it, it created the perfect environment for the jars to break open.I called Amazon, and they were very understanding and sent a replacement 6 pack of Sambal Oelek right away. Unfortunately, this shipment had the same type of flimsy wrap and not enough packing air pillows. But luckily the jars had just broken away from the packaging wrap without opening in the second shipment.You take a chance of getting open products with the shipping preparations with this order. I wouldn't take my chances with it again. I'll just buy it at an Asian market in town.

Just wanted to say that my son was premature and had severe reflux and allergies to the milk protein.  This formula was better than any other, even the Neocate.  Just a side note, the liquid formula IS different than the powder.  The liquid formula doesn't contain corn solids and the powder does.  I had my son on the powder and he would arch and pull away after two ounces (his twin sister could take about 5-6 ounces at this point and his weight was much less than hers).  I switched to the liquid and he sucked it down like he hadn't eaten in months.  It's very expensive but totally worth it in our circumstance!  The only reason it doesn't get five stars is b/c, yes, it has a horrible smell... but he likes it so I don't really care what it smells like!

column9: INSURANCE WILL PAY for hypoallergenic formula!!
column10: Hypoallergenic formula was necessary for our daughter's acid reflux.We found out from a friend that most insurance companies will completely cover the cost of hypoallergenic formula, either by reimbursing you what you've spent on it, or if you get it as a prescription through your pediatrician. Ours did!Many doctors don't know this, so they don't know to give a prescription for the formula. Call your insurance company today!

My son (who is 7 months old now) has been on this formula since he was 2 months old..it was a lifesaver for us! He had colic and acid reflux. The first 2 months of his life were hard. He screamed almost constantly and my husband and I were so desperate to help our little guy feel better. Finally, our pediatrician recommended this over the phone. We braved a snowstorm to run to the store and buy this expensive formula. It took a couple of weeks but we did finally notice a difference! We found this product on Amazon and immediately signed up for Amazon prime to have this delivered straight to our door with 2 day shipping. Imagine my surprise when I went to order it today and the price has gone from $53.94 for 6 bottles to $61.20! It is no longer cheaper to purchase here on Amazon. It now equals about $10.20 a bottle and we can get it at our local large chain grocery store for around $9/bottle plus we can use coupons that Similac sends us! Very disappointed..we loved the ease of ordering through Amazon while also saving money. We've also found it cheaper to buy diapers at the store with coupons as well. Sad day for my family when Amazon lets us down!!

column9: PLEASE READ: This liquid is different than the powder form!
column10: My son was having so many problems with food, we were going to a few different doctors and unfortunately had to keep switching his formula (not by choice, trust me!) I had to stop the breast milk even because he just was not tolerating the milk protein or really much of anything.  I have a super bad stomach and I was so worried I had passed it on to my son even at one month of age.  Our pediatrician gave us a container of the similac alimentum powder form and it did make a small difference however my son was still crying like he was in pain after each bottle.  I read a lot of reviews online and noticed a few people mentioning that their child could tolerate the liquid form over the powder form.  My doc knew nothing of this and i was so discouraged but figured I would give it a try.  Not joking, the first bottle of the liquid form he ate, no crying after.  I cried because I was so happy to not have my son in pain after eating for the first time.  At one point I was up north and ran out of the liquid so I HAD to give him the powder and sure enough, crying and pain immediately after.  My son is now almost 6 months old and has not had one single problem and is the happiest baby on the planet all day long now.  PLEASE spend the ridiculous amount of money for this formula because I KNOW first hand how  miserable life can be when your baby is in pain and you don't know how to stop it.  The powder form does have a corn ingredient in it that the liquid form does not have, please give it a try so you and your child will be pain free.  If it works as it did for me, you really should let others know because it is such a helpless feeling to have to go through.  Good luck!!

My daughter has a milk protein allergy and we had to switch to this formula. It's been great so far. Yes, it is more expensive than all the other formula, but there are not a lot of options if your child is allergic to cow's milk. Right now the formula is on sale (about $6.50 per bottle vs. $9 per bottle). I think it is due to the Similac recall that everything is on sale. I would stock up now if you are able! We have tried the powder version and to be honest it smells disgusting. It makes me want to vomit although the baby does not seem to care. I just can't handle it and we only use it when we are out of the house and can't keep a cold bottle with us.

column9: Great Product --- BUT BEWARE OF ORDERING THRU AMAZON!
column10: We struggled to find a formula that would not upset our newborn's stomach.  He would grunt and squeal with stomach issues throughout the day.  We tried Sensitive and Soy... nothing really worked.  This finally did the trick.  We didn't encounter any issues with him rejecting it because of taste.  Although I will say that it smells a little more than the other versions of formula.One thing to beware of - Amazon offered this product through AMAZON PRIME and I ordered it.  They have yet to fulfill the order (almost a month later).  There are numerous vendors who are selling this on Amazon and I have had fast shipping through all of them.  For some reason Amazon just keeps stalling on shipping this product and does not give any reason when asked.  I've never had this issue with Amazon before and I am completely surprised.  The only reason I can think of is that Amazon offered it at a cheaper price and then afterwards decided they did not want to honor the cheaper price.

My son (who is 8 months old now) has been on this formula since he was 3 months old! He had acid reflux. We found this product on Amazon and immediately signed up for Amazon prime to have this delivered straight to our door with 2 day shipping. However the price has gone from $53.94 for 6 bottles to $60! It is no longer cheaper to purchase here on Amazon. It now equals about $10 a bottle and we can get it at our local large chain grocery store for around $9/bottle plus we can use coupons that Similac sends us! Very disappointed..we loved the ease of ordering through Amazon while also saving money. Sad day for my family when Amazon lets us down!!

column9: great for babies with milk protein allergy
column10: We switched our baby boy from the regular similac to this after we saw bloody stool. It is more expensive than other types of formula, but the blood cleared within two weeks like the pedi said, so it was well worth it. Our son also had reflux but this formula did not seem to help any. FYI for anyone wondering if this is cheaper than the powder- yes, it is. However, if your baby eats 32oz a day, you're basically saving $0.80 (yes, cents!) a day using powder($162.79 for six 1lb cans) vs Ready to Feed ($53.94 for six 32oz bottles). IMO I'd rather pay the $0.80 and not have to mix the stuff myself.

This formula is the only one that will allow my little one's digestive system to work.  The only negative is the smell/taste.  The price on Amazon is great, but check with your insurance about covering it through home heath.  We now get it shipped monthly to us through our insurance.

Our son had very very bad congestion until he started on Alimentum and now it is completely gone and we are so relieved.  We used to hear him wheezing all night long and worry all the time about him.  Now he can finally breath.  It took about 8 days for us to see results.  We couldn't get him to take any of the other hypoallergenic formulas - he would gag and throw them up but he liked this one right away.  Our only complaint is the price!  We wish it wasn't so expensive.  But it's well worth it.

My baby was breastfed for several months, but I decided to wean her because I was exclusively pumping. She has a milk protein allergy so we were limited to the type of formula we could give her. We tried the Alimentum and Nutramigen powder and she hated both of them and cried, spit, and choked through a bottle if there was one ounce of either of them in it. I tried the ready to feed after I read that it didn't have corn in it and the first time I gave it to her, it she drank it without an issue. Some reviewers talked about the smell, which hasn't been an issue. I think it smells fine. It is expensive, but we are able to submit the cost difference between this and regular formula for reimbursement through our health care flex spending account.

I switched to this formula to help my son's eczema.  First we tried the powder, and he hated it.  But he doesn't mind the Ready-to-Feed at all.  His ezcema really has improved on it.  I am doing the paperwork to ask our health company to help with the cost.

After 4 months of screaming, spit up and extreme reflux-- AND 9 formulas later-- we finally found our solution!  Alimentum ready to feed was a life saver!  My baby tolerates this forula VERY well!  There's still some spit up, but it's not projectile.  And, he doesn't cry while eating.  It digests very well too!  Yes, in the beginning we did notice it had a slightly different smell from other formulas, but we got used to it quickly.  And, I don't think it's nearly as bad as many say it is.  Plus, how can you complain about smell when this formula is clearly the only one on the market that works for reflux babies or allergic babies?!?!  This saved our son and our sanity!  Great price on Amazon too!  Oh, and insurance will pay for it if you work with your doctor and insurance company.  LOVE THIS PRODUCT!!!!  So grateful it exists.

column9: Too Expensive & Little Help From Abbott
column10: Excellent formula for babies with protein allergies like ours. She must be on this premixed version formula but at about $10/bottle at most retailers (Walmart has it for $6.97 but doesn't always have it in stock), the cost is WAY too high. Insurance won't help, don't qualify for WIC, and when we called Similac to try to get more coupons (already a strongmoms member but coupons decreased from about 4 to 1), they were not cooperative but offered to send a powder sample. Amazon's price wih subscription is excellent, and only .64 cents more than Walmart which is a nightmare to visit and wait on line!!!! With free shipping and Amazons trustworthiness and service, Im glad to pay a little extra to get it shipped right to home! Yay!!! No Walmartians to battle!!!!!

Although I am very unhappy at how much Alimentum is, I love that it worked wonders for my newborn son.  We used this until he was 4 months old.  He was just colicky and seemed to have digestion problems with regular and sensitive formula.  Once we switched to this, there was NO spit-up and no digestion pains.  He was a happy baby - and as Similac clearly knows, parents will do anything for a happy newborn!

column9: Great for the baby, but still a scam
column10: Our baby handles this better than any other formula we've tried.  Very little gas and spitups, plus she's growing like a weed.  Her acid reflux went away, she sleeps better, its great.My complaint - this stuff should not cost as much as it does.  Its a scam that they jack the price of the only formula that works for certain children, knowing parents who have no choice will have to pay for it.  Its costing us nearly $500 a month for this stuff.  The businessmen at Abbott Labs who decided to profit off children with special dietary needs should be ashamed.  I'm *certain* it can't cost twice the price to manufacture this.
This formula works well for my son with reflux issues.  However, I wanted others to be aware that this exact same product is available at Babies R Us for $54!

column9: This does wonders for reflux -> happy baby
column10: If you've been struggling to give comfort and nutrition to a baby with serious reflux issues (what many call "colic" is in reality, very often just severe reflux) please try this formula.  It doesn't smell good, no, but your baby will LOVE it.  And there's a great chance you will end up with a happy, relaxed, smiling baby just a few days later.  It worked wonders for us.

I agree wholeheartedly with some of the recent reviews below.  My son has a dairy intolerance and I had to stop breastfeeding when he was 4.5 months old.  This product was a lifesaver!!  He drinks it happily, and his symptoms, since switching to Alimentum, have subsided (knock on wood).That said, beware of ordering through Amazon. I ordered several cases for my baby through Amazon Prime almost one month ago & have received multiple emails telling me that the product is unavailable for shipment. Meanwhile, several vendors list the product as available on Amazon (including Amazon's subsidiary, Diapers.com). I've contacted customer service several times, but have continued to get the runaround.  I suspect that this has to do with an attempt to avoid honoring the lower list price (the Amazon prices drastically increased recently).  It's a sad sad day when Amazon disappoints.  Notably, when I've ordered the full price product through Diapers.com, it's arrived the next day.In any event, the formula itself has been great!

Extremely happy with this product. Both my children had to use this formula due to gassy, fussy, crying, upset stomachs. Tried different types. This works best. Also the shipping and handling was awesome from seller. Thank you.

column9: Great Stuff - really helped w/ Fussiness
column10: Our little man was extremely fussy - our Ped's Dr. thought it might be a milk & soy allergy, & recommended this formula. Within a few days, the hours upon hours of fussiness ended & turned into 20 minutes here & there.  He got so good we thought, "maybe he's not really allergic to soy" - so we tried a dfferent (and less expensive forumla) - mistake - we're back on the Alimentum & the little man is back to his low state of fussiness.  He's also put on quite a bit of weight, seems generally less constipated, & has less spit up.  I think we're hooked.

column9: Works great, stopped her midnight screaming
column10: My daughter was allergic to all other types of formula that we tried and did nothing but scream after feedings. She does not do well on the powdered version (she aspirates it) but the liquid does wonders. I'm not looking for a year of the extra expense, but she's worth it. :)

column9: Great formula, easy to use -- wish it was available through subscribe-and-save
column10: We discovered after trying to use a dairy based formula that our daughter had a dairy sensitivity. My sister-in-law suggested alimentum and it worked wonders. I hate having to mix the powder so we use the ready to feed and it's fantastic. We just use a sharpie to mark when we opened it so that we can keep track of the 48 hour limit. I also love that the top has a mechanism to help with opening the foil top.My only complaint is that I wish it were available through subscribe-and-save through Amazon; I have to remember to re-order every two weeks.

My 2 month old began having screaming and constipation problems while I was using the orange similac powder.  We decided to switch him to the blue similac powder, nothing changed.  We even had abd x-ray done since the constipation continued to last for 7 days at a time each time, all normal.  After reading I found alot of the reviews were saying powder was different from the ready to feed.  We switched to this and within 12 hours had a pooping nonscreaming baby.  He was happy and not crying or pulling legs up constantly.  The ingredients in powder are different then the ready to feed.  Definetly worth the extra money to make our baby feel well.

My daughter has reflux and many, many food allergies. We've tried so many different formulas and this is the ONLY formula that works for her corn allergy. The powdered version contains corn (not much, but it does contain some) the ready to feed one (this one) contains none. She no longer screams when she eats and poops and her tummy is doing so much better! This is truly a formula for the most sensitive of tummies. If a sensitive formula like Nutramigen or Elecare didn't work for your baby, I would suggest trying this one. Hopefully it'll work for your baby, too!

Works awesome for milk-soy-corn allergy in my 4 month old son.  But did take a while to notice a difference:  5 days until colic started to disappear, 2 weeks before eczema started to improve, 2 weeks for blood to be completely eliminated from stool samples given to dr's office.  It does make him more gassy and his poop does smell horrible now, but overall he is so much happier!! :)  And the blood is gone, so that is great.  One downfall is that it is soooo expensive!!!  About $70/week and my insurance will not cover it unless he has a positive blood allergy test, which he doesn't, as the tests aren't accurate in babies so young.  And even with coverage, they would only cover 50% through a medical supply company which charges 3x as much as you can buy it at the store.  So yes, insurance coverage is a pain, worth a try though if your child needs to be on this formula.  Would try Nutramigen first to see if that works, as it's a lot cheaper.... my son had an allergic reaction to it (hives, blood in stool, colic, swelling, etc), due to the high corn syrup solid content and had to change to a corn-free formula. This is the only corn-free formula that you can buy at the store.

My son developed an allergy to regular formula and his pediatrian recommended putting him an elemental formula.  We tried Nutramigen first and found that it had a very strong smell that my son did not like.  Alimentum was the answer.  I usually buy the Alimentum from Amazon, but if I get coupons from Similac, then I will purchase them at Babies R Us.  As other reviewers have stated the formula is pricy, but it works for my son.

I was very nervous about introducing formula to my 10-month-old but I added this to her bottle (mixed gradually with breast milk) and she's had no issues digesting it and she seems to like the taste. the anticipation of introducing this formula was emotionally upsetting to me, but since my daughter accepted it without any problems, it was a very easy transition for everyone.

When we discovered our son had food allergies we put him on this formula right away and it worked.  His colic symptoms disappeared in 2 weeks and he began to gain wieght.  I gave it 4 stars because it is so pricey.

Tough to find a formula that works for a child that has FPIES but this one does.  It really does stink, doesn't taste all that good either but my son, now after a couple of tries, sucks it down, but only the liquid formula.  He does however spit up a lot more than he ever did but he was only BF until about 7 months.

We got this formula for our 2.5 month-old boy.  He has been fussy and gassy, although his milk consumption is about 40% formula and 60% breast milk.  We were hoping this would be the solution, as sometimes he cries out in obvious pain before passing incredible amounts of gas.  It is heartbreaking.We immediately tried this as soon as it arrived, and it seemed like it was easier for him to pass, but then he had diarrhea that smelled terrible.  No wonder!  The product is completely foul smelling, and I tasted it and it is probably the WORST thing I have tasted in my LIFE.  I read reviews about it, and believe me, they are NOT exaggerating.After three days of using this formula, my son completely rejected it and chose starvation over this formula.  We had to go back to our previous formula, Similac Sensitive for fussiness and gas, which after three days of Alimentum really didn't seem to cause him much more difficulty than the Alimentum.We thought maybe it would help with the gassiness, but honestly, it is so terrible that I really wouldn't recommend it unless your child has an actual milk allergy and really needs it.  It smells and tastes terrible and is on the expensive side because of the processing required.

It's hard to review things like formula since every baby is different and what works for my baby may not work for yours and vice versa.My baby was having a lot of eczema and seborrhea so her doc recommended this formula. After a month I decided to switch it to the regular one because it wasn't helping her skin at all, and it's almost twice as expensive as the regular formula! It stinks really bad, and my baby spit up a LOT on this formula and was extra gassy.

I ended up throwing out the entire shipment (at a cost of over $100) because my baby kept spitting up the milk and when I compared the smell to same type of milk I bought at Target, the smell was not the same.

As others have noted, this stuff does seriously reek, even more than the other formulas made from dying cattle.  It does, however, stay down better than the powdered products, even the powdered Alimentum, perhaps because it's thicker.  If circumstances leave you no alternative but to supplement your baby with formula, the ready-to-feed products are handier and perhaps better-tolerated until you can get your baby onto fruits, vegetables, and grains.  If your baby tolerates the RTF soy formula, that's an obvious better choice than this stuff.

My chihuahuas loved the taste and size of this food.  They are pretty finicky about taste and size.  Some food I've tried in the past they couldn't eat because their mouths were too little.  But this food they liked!

This is a wonderful tasting marinade for chicken and pork. We love it. I had a hard time finding it in the local grocery stores, so I was glad to get it from Amazon, 12 packets, which I sometimes give as gifts to friends because it is so good.
This is a very tasty marinade for chicken or fish.  Hard to find in grocery stores (at least in my area) so I stocked up on line.  It is excellent!

I've tried most, if not all, of the Kona k-cups out there and I think this one has the best flavor by far!

I too have made a hobby of tasting most of the k-cup's brewers' offerings, and have found this one to have the best flavor, balance and boldness without being overly strong and dense.  I ordered other blends just to have a choice, but keep choosing this one!  For decaf, my favorite is Timothy's Columbian Decaf - again after much sampling.  Oh, and just for the record, I LOVE my Keurig K-cup brewer!

After getting a Keurig I did a massive taste test of the 20 or so bold/extra bold varieties from different brands.  This was definitely my favorite - nice smooth taste, with none of the bitter/acidic/funky tinges many of the others had (stay away from Green Mountain 'Espresso').  The only other k-cup to come close was Coffee People K-Cup Dark Roast, Extra Bold Jet Fuel for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count Boxes (Pack of 2). (Green Mountain's other extra bold varieties - Kenyan AA, Double Black Diamond, Dark Magic - were a distant third; didn't find anything good from Timothy's/Emeril.)  If you want to do your own sampling without committing to a whole box, I definitely recommend Keurig's site - you can get 'extra bold' variety packs, as well as 5-cup samples of individual flavors.

column9: This Kona is better than most
column10: I really like Kona coffee and this brand is better than most because it has more real Kona in it.

column9: Kona is my favorite coffee & the only coffee I truly enjoy!
column10: After my first taste of Kona coffee there was no going back to regular.  Even now when I drink any other coffee it just doesn't taste very good to me.  What is it about Hawaiian soil that makes this coffee so good???  Not important, the only thing that matters is that the problem with the borer beetle mentioned in the article below will be solved so that Kona coffee prices won't increase any further!http://www.bigislandvideonews.com/2011/12/07/video-kona-coffee-buyers-adjust-price-because-of-beetle/

Great coffee!  The aroma is enticing, the flavor is bold, all in all, a great coffee experience!  Will make this a regular part of my day!

Not bad for the price.  I have had better coffee but as far as Kona is concerned, this is by far the best.  The bold is not as bold but bold enough to wake us up in the morning and keep us up through the day.  I guess it depends on your level of desired "boldness", this coffee may or may not satisfy you.  We are very satisfied.

Delighted to have had the opportunty to buy several of these Kona Blend K-Cups before they became "no longer available," - anywhere!  Thank-you Amazon.Com, you were right on the ball and the K-Cups are wonderful!

column10: Purchased on a lark, thinking we could add to our desire for bold coffees.  Jet Fuel is our favorite bold with Black Tiger coming in second.  Not bold enough for us!

column10: I Love my Keurig, and have tried many flavors of K Cups...10% Kona is by far is another one of my favorites, and getting them through Amazon is quick and priced great!!

Green Mountain is a great blend of coffee.  It has a flavor that I like.  We especially enjoy it in our Keurig Brewer.  This coffee doesn't taste weak but has what they call an "Extra Bold" taste. This was a good deal all the way around.

column9: Absolutely the best in this category of waters!
column10: I have three of these now, the Pear, Tropical Punch, and the Raspberry-Lime,,,,all three are good, but this one is sooooooo amazing,,,,,,IF I was a dictator, when I overthrew the government, I would make this water mandatory for everyone,,,,,then everyone would be on a high!  It has the most sensational aroma,,,,when you uncap it, it's like WOW!  I have to limit myself to one a day, due to cost, but it is a treat I look forward to,  As you can tell, I love this stuff, can't recommend it highly enough,
Hint water is more flavorful than plain water, but not syrupy sweet.  I could drink it all day.  My favorite flavor is Strawberry-Kiwi.  Highly recommended!

For people who want a change from boring water but still want to take advantage of all the health benefits of water, this is a perfect fit. It is light and refreshing. It does not have a heavy flavor, or sugary taste. It does not have any negative or harsh chemicals; just an all natural, wholesome product. I have tried most of the flavors and have not found one I dislike.Do not buy this product if you are a person looking for more flavor or a sugary taste; it will leave you dissatisfied.

I am trying to cut soda out of my diet, and I do not like artificial sweeteners. I had seen Hint on Facebook and decided that I would try it. I love it. It has a great smell with a very subtle flavor (like squeezing a lemon in your water).  I like all of the flavors that I have tried, but the Rasberry Lime is one of favorites! Great water!
I ordered this for our office and everyone loves the taste and that it is flavored water with no calories.

My wife loves this water.  I have tried it and to me it is very underflavored, but she likes it really well.If you want a water with lots of taste, don't buy this.  But if you just want a 'hint' of flavor, you will probably like this water.

I have been a big fan of Hint since I first discovered it at the grocery store. My favorite had always been watermelon. I'm leery about trying new things, especially when they come in a case. Based on the positive reviews, I decided to give Raspberry-Lime a try. I am glad I did. I LOVE this flavor! It is now my new favorite. It's not at all strong. It has just the right amount of essence. It's terrific for a refreshing drink. It's a nice change of pace from over-sweet water beverages (even the no sugar variety). I can't recommend this enough! Try it. You won't regret it.

Loved the product. It doesn't have that odd 'candy' flavor most fruit based waters do. Delightful taste, even the kids thought that it made good popsicles, great no calorie treat, and wonderful flavor.

Very slight flavor as the name indicates.  Just a hint of flavor.  It has a good smell.  I like that it is not carbonated.  I have budget issues now so will not purchase again.  But good for a little taste to help get enough fluid in a day.  Much better than buying a soda or energy drink.

column9: Fresh, flavored water that you'll down like ... water?
column10: I purchased Hint Raspberry-Lime flavored water on sale (~$8 a unit at the time!) to give to my father after he made a very unrealistic request - something healthier to drink at work that tastes better than plain water, without any sugar or artificial sweeteners.I was surprised that there were any drinks that exist that do meet these standards, and the Hint brand is one of them.If you drink it down quickly, Hint is really expensive water that won't taste or feel any differently than plain water.  If you savor it a bit, you can definitely catch that hint of ... something.  I'm not sure I would pinpoint it as raspberry-lime, but I can definitely taste the additive, and it's not a bad flavor.If you're as picky as my father about what you'll allow into your water, and you won't drink it plain, then Hint is definitely a good alternative.  I would suggest waiting for another sale, though, because it's ridiculously expensive for lightly flavored water at full price. ($1.83 a bottle!)

I decided to try this water after reading the rave reviews. I have only tried the Raspberry-Lime, so I cannot comment on the other flavors. I cannot understand how anyone could enjoy drinking the Raspberry-Lime flavored water. It's awful. I bought it for half the usual price, and it is still way too expensive for water with a barely perceptible (or "hint") of unpleasant flavor. Do you yourself a favor, buy Fruit20 instead. It tastes much better, and costs 75% less.

My kitty eats all the flavors of Natural Balance Platefulls on rotation, and loves all of them equally. He gets dry food in the morning, and a pouch for dinner every night. His coat is GORGEOUSLY soft and shiny, and these pouches don't give him nasty gas or rowdy bad breath like some other canned/pouch foods. When I first opened a pouch, I saw that it had peas and carrots in it, and I figured those would be left behind in the bowl. Cats just...don't eat vegetables. To my surprise, the bowl was licked clean! And after 3 months, he still licks the bowl clean every night!

My cat is pretty picky and I have tried every kind of natural/grain free/expensive wet cat food there is. She typically turns her nose up if she is given the same wet food two days in a row. The Natural Balance pouches are the only wet food that my cat will eat every day without a problem. I bought cases of two flavors and I alternate them every other feeding. We are going on a couple months now and she still loves it. It seems to be a great brand for people who care about natural, high quality ingredients, and for the relatively low price, it can't be beat.

It's a great product. Our cats loved it, but in Walmart we can find cheaper brands with real fish in them. But no Cod or Sole in Walmart. I would buy the same kind with real crabs in it, but at the same price Walmart sells it.

Although the listed ingredients on this product appear to be ideal for a food that is NON-organic, there is one significant area of MAJOR CONCERN. These pet foods are produced in Pecoima, California, in Los Angeles County and thus contain potentially very harmful FLUORIDE in the water the foods contain! Fluoridated water has been linked to bone cancer in humans and animals, and from my own sphere of acquaintances, two have lost their pets to bone cancer. Even though your pets may love the taste of this food, we would not advise exposing humans or animals to any source of fluoride!

column9: Pink Diamond sea salt, lovely color!

Sweet basil is a basic in my cooking.  I ordered this product and was amazed at the huge quantity I received (being used to smaller containers).  It is as fresh as drying your own home-grown basil.  Perhaps this is a life-time supply, haha.  It adds so much to fish, soups, just about anything if you are a sweet basil lover.  I give this product more than 5 stars; it is well packaged and promptly delivered.

I also loved the frontier black pepper!

I prefer using fresh basil, but this is quick, easy, and inexpensive. I like the bite this basil has. Like Egyptian basil with a bit of a mint note. Really good and a great price.

column9: Long lasting, and safer in my experience.
column10: My dogs, and many of my client's dogs, inhale regular rawhides.  I was always worried about them swallowing big chunks.And I really hate flavored plastic bones, as well as veggie bones, since I've seen chunks of those being swallowed whole right in front of me a number of times.These have been by far the best solution for me.  It takes the dogs much longer to chew them, and they really have to work at it.  For all my medium to heavy chewers, these are my first choice.Having said that, nothing is 100% safe.  After chewing up most of the bone, a very food motivated chewer could the remaining hard chunk - which could be a serious problem.  That's why I tend to choose the bigger sizes (8" or 10") over the little ones (4"), and take the bone away when it gets to a swallow-able size.  I buy these in bulk.  The value compared to other types of rawhides is huge, even without a bulk discount.These come in flavors also.  This plain style, as well as the the chicken flavored ones, have not been messy at all.  The beef ones are not quite as tidy.

column4: B. Smith "The giant on whoms shoulders your c...
column10: My 6 mo. old large breed puppy really likes these. Its definitely better than a regular rawhide and apparently safer for puppies too. So better value, lasts longer, and safer for your dog. Worth buying.

These bones are amazing and my dogs love them. I have two vigorous chewers so these bones are a much better option than regular rawhides or other treats. They are much more expensive at retailers though, so I love being able to save some money by purchasing them online.

I'm so glad we found out about these. Our 6 month old puppy was going through a bag of chew sticks a day. He is on hour 3 of one of these bones and is only about halfway through it. He has been chewing on it non stop for those 3 hours, too. Off to order some more!

This Tassimo Maxwell House Large Cup T-Disc makes a decent cup of coffee. I think it tastes as strong as a regular cup of Maxwell House brewed coffee, and it is 100 times more convenient. I enjoy making an instant cup of this coffee and taking it to work in my travel mug. I enjoy Starbucks as well; however, it is unfair to compare this coffee to Starbucks, as they are two very different blends. One doesn't criticize an apple because it doesn't taste like an orange. If you like an everyday good cup of coffee, I think you will like this.

i don't believe i will buy any more mh morning blend. you get a couple squirts of coffee and a bunch of water. have to turn the machine off early to get a decent cup. if you like it mild and let the machine do it's thing, ya better have a 16 oz cup or you will have a mess to clean up.

Well after Starbucks stopped selling t-discs my friend picked up a Keurig for the wider variety of coffee available with it and gave me their old Tassimo. I as they know am not a coffee snob, lol.Anyway long story short they gave me all of the extra discs that they had left over with their machine and I have been trying them all. Most of them are for small or medium sized servings (which I didn't know) and I have been using 2 discs to fill my travel mug that I take to work. Well this morning I decided to try the Maxwell House Morning Blend coffee and I was pleasantly surprised when I came back and my coffee cup was full. Then I actually tasted the coffee and about 30 seconds later I was looking for the best place to stock up on it!I was excited to find out that I only had to use one disc to fill my mug but it was the flavor that sealed the deal. To me this is a fantastic coffee, I have been drinking Maxwell House breakfast blend coffee from a drip machine forever and this absolutely blows it away! It is a mild flavor but it is very tasty. I always drink my coffee black or with just a small amount of sweetener and many coffees are just too harsh without a bunch of creamer and stuff added to it but this one is just about perfect by its self.Maxwell house, you've definitely (still) got my business.
The coffee flavor is what I find perfect in the morning using T disc from Maxwell House. Also it is 14oz a good size  & is so convenient one cup at at time no stale coffee...

If you order this on the "subscribe and save", you will save more than by ordering it from the Tassimo Direct Order. I absolutely love this morning blend because it makes a HUGE cup of coffee to get me going in the mornings.
