I've never been a big fan of hot apple cider until I tried Motts!  The Caramel flavor is absolutely delicious and it has just the right amount of sweetness.  I add a cinnamon stick for a stir and I have a nice cozy drink on a chilly day.

I've tried a lot of different packaged apple ciders, and Mott's caramel apple cider is the best I've ever tasted.  I keep a ridiculous amount of it on hand at my house since you just never know when the urge for cider will hit.

I had never tried this brand of tea & there are not very many reviews on it. But recently they ran a $10 off promo so i snagged this flavor along with some of the regular white tea.  It arrived yesterday & so far i have brewed 2 teapots with the same leaves.  Not sure how a third steeping will go but the 2nd one was as strong as the first.There are whole dried rosebuds mixed in with the tea, which consists of tightly rolled whole white and green tea leaves. (yes, there is green tea in this. it's not 100% white tea)There appears to be very little if any (i don't see any) broken pieces or tea dust like i see in many of the loose leaf teas i have purchased in the past.  This was a VERY nice surprise as usually a lot of little pieces of tea escape the strainer & end up in my tea cup. Well, not with this tea. :)The packaging is cute, it comes in the pink tin pictured here.  It has a metal lid that screws on/off.  Inside there is another lid (made of flexible plastic) to help keep the tea fresh. This inner lid has a tab so that it can be easily removed.The tea has a nice delicate flavor with a hint of jasmine in it.  I'm not sure if i detect rosebuds in the flavor (hard to say....what do rosebuds taste like???)  But they are definitely in there.  While the jasmine is there it isn't real real strong.  So if you prefer your jasmine tea to pack a punch this may not be for you.  I really like a nice cup of strong jasmine green tea. Of course i realize that this is a white & green tea mix.  Since white tea is much lighter & more delicate than green tea too much jasmine would probably overpower it.  Strong jasmine flavor or not, this tea is yummy. All i know is that i enjoyed everything about brewing & drinking this tea.  It is well packaged, has a pleasing aroma & flavor, and the leaves seem to be rolled with meticulous care.  It's a great quality tea & a nice addition to my collection.  I'm glad i bought it.
We LOVE white tea, and this one is no exception.  We have to keep sharing it, and everyone LOVES it!

column9: Plain, harsh  tea; no aroma, not worth the price
column10: No perceptible floral aroma at all (neither jasmine nor rose), and the tea itself is harsher than it should be.The tin is pretty, and there are pretty rosebuds mixed in with the tea, but if you want gentle white tea that actually smells like roses as you drink it, and resteeps well, get the Rishi (Rishi Tea Wild Rose,Organic White Tea 1.1-Ounce Tins (Pack of 3)) instead.

I have tried many flavored teas and many if not most have flavors that overwhelm the actual tea. This tea is an exception. It is an elegant tea with slight overtones of jasmine and rosebuds.I was a bit apprehensive seeing the actual rosebuds in the tea since I have had tea with rose flavoring that was unpleasantly powerful. The rosebuds here blend in appropriately.As a plus, the stacking canisters are great.

This tea is very light and has a delicate flavor.  It is a VERY pleasing taste.  It tastes the way a flower smells.  This tea was my first experience with loose leaf tea, and I must say that I was pleasantly surprised!  I am eager to try other flavors too!

Been eating this cereal for about a year now. For a couple of years I had been eating a brand that's sold in our area, but it was not organic. Once I saw this on amazon I had to try it. I eat it five to six mornings a week. I substitute once or twice a week with organic eggs, cheese & vege's. When I eat this cereal I mix it with organic frozen blueberries & a banana. What a way to start the day. My blood work at my last yearly physical was excellent, and my doctor let me know. I'm 52 years old and abused my body for 25 years with drugs and alcohol. I now live a clean life, spirit, mind, & body and this product fits right in. Have plans to try a few more of Bob's products in the future.

column9: A miracle food. I can eat it all day.
column10: This is an amazing hot cereal. It has no artificial ingredients. It is very high in fiber, which means it should lower cholesterol. Since I have started eating it, my high blood pressure has dropped nicely. I try to cook it as little as possible, so I put it in a bowl of hot water, and then microwave it for only one minute. I add a little sweetener, usually stevia and/or Splenda, and then I eat it. Some people may not like the taste (a few might say it tastes like sawdust), but I think it's delicious. Cheap, healthful, easy to fix, filling, and delicious ... what more could you want?

We feed this cereal to our 27 month old son every night.  It seems to help him get a full stomach and he sleeps longer at night.  It has also helped with his constipation.  It has 10 grams of fiber and 1000 mg of OMEGA-3 per serving and he loves it.

column9: Filling and tastes great with a few additions
column10: As a big fan of Bob's Red Mill products in general I thought I'd try ordering this since my grocery store does not sell it. I don't need to talk about the health benefits as you can all read the nutritional label.I do find the taste/texture of this cereal takes some getting used to. It's a bit like eating sand. In order to make it taste better, the following healthy additions work for me: 2 packs of splenda and cinnamon to taste 1-2 Tbsp of fat free vanilla yogurt, greek yogurt or cottage cheese to make it creamier optional: dried fruit or stewed prunesI sometimes mix this 50/50 with regular oatmeal, which also gives it great texture.

easy to make stove/microwave/adding boiling water and let sit.  very tasty, nice texture - my 1.5yr old eats it even w/o sugar.  the expiration date was a ways off, so the 4pk is no problem.  keeping it in the freezer maintains a fresh taste.

column9: My breakfast fix for years now!!
column10: A few years ago, I lost 50 pounds and this was a big reason why... a  high fiber breakfast that held me for hours!  I've used it to keep the weight off, and enjoy how quick and easy it is.  Sprinkle it into a bowl, add some water, throw it in the microwave... I enjoy mixing in thick rolled oats, flax meal, bananas, berries, anything for variety when needed... soymilk on top and you're good to go!  Love it!!!

column9: Good hot cereal for one who doesn't usually like cereal
column10: I'm not a cereal fan in any way, but my roommate was diagnosed with high blood pressure, cholesterol and borderline diabetes, so I thought I'd introduce this to him. He puts raisins or prunes or fresh fruit and vanilla soy milk on his. After a couple of months, I tried it and was surprised how good it is. I put olive oil, nutritional yeast, and Bragg's Liquid Aminos on mine and actually look forward to eating it, which is pretty good for a person who doesn't normally eat first thing in the morning, and certainly not hot cereal. It's a good, healthy start to the day, and though I don't have a roommate any more, I'll keep eating this cereal. Subscribe and Save is a great convenience and it's better priced than local stores.

If you like good hot cereal & not the microwave 'quick oats' mush, you'll like this.  It has a nutty flavor that's especially good when mixed with old fashioned oatmeal (5Tbsp Oats to 3Tbsp Bob's, add hot H20 & microwave for 2 minutes...I add ~1Tbsp chopped walnuts & ~1Tbsp raisins).  It keeps me going till lunch.  I have not tried it by itself as I like to mix cereals whether hot or cold.

column9: Doesn't work for me as a cereal...Maybe as an addition to bread recipes
column10: The taste and texture of this cereal just doesn't excite my taste buds.  I would agree with another reviewer's point that I would need to add fruit, nuts and sweetener to make this tolerable as a cereal.  However...I tried a recipe on the bag for whole grain muffins that ARE TO DIE FOR, so all is not lost.  Another reviewer adds it to her bread, so today's experiment is with my honey wheat bread recipe.  Might also be good in my whole grain pancakes. It is excellent as a source of whole grains and fiber, but not a winner in the unadorned cereal category.

What I don't like about instant oatmeal is the mushy texture.  I thought I would have been able to get away from that with this product, but I was mistaken.  My fault for not looking at the image more closely, I guess.  I now make this an addition to my steel-cut oats after it cooks for about 10 minutes.  I find this also a little on the expensive side, but I cannot afford to store large quantities of the separate components of this cereal because my housing is temporary, so this product is good for that.  Otherwise, if you can afford to buy the components separately, I'd recommend it.

So I bought this for the killer nutritional stats.  Opened it up and found I couldn't stand it.  What reviews taught me?  This item blends amazingly well with other items.  So I now bump up my oats by doing half and half with this cereal.  I might have needed more mix ins (the taste of the cereal overpowered mine), but I'm happy to mix with oats.  Eventually I'll have to try baking something just to add this in.

This cereal has a slight earthy flavor due to flaxseeds. After first two bowls I got used to it, and now I like this cereal a lot. I cooked it on the stove (which takes 10 minutes). Then I decided to cook it in the microwave (it takes 3 minutes), and found out that it tastes exactly the same and saves me time. I put raisins, craisins, nuts and honey in this cereal, and it tastes great! It has 10 grams of fiber per serving and keeps you satisfied until lunch. Besides, it is all organic. What more can you wish? Great breakfast cereal.

column9: Great-tasting, high fiber breakfast in 2 minutes!
column10: After learning what was really in my Quaker oatmeal packets, I decided to go for something more natural and more full of wholegrains and fiber. Bob's Red Mill has never let me down with a product. I make this cereal in the microwave at work everyday and it only takes two minutes. I add in a bit of brown sugar, honey, or some fruit pieces and really enjoy a filling, healthy breakfast. I'm not one to get all worked up over cereal, but really, it's a thousand times better than anything I've ever had in a packet and the price is right!

column9: Perfect, well almost.....if you don't mind sweetening.
column10: I really want to like this cereal. It reminds me of the hot mush my grandma used to make which was a mixture of oatmeal, cream of wheat, and wheatena. The texture is excellent, not at all gluey like pure oatmeal. Mixed with maple syrup and yogurt I was very very pleased.However there is one problem you need to know. This cereal has a slight bitter aftertaste when you don't add anything to it or mix it with anything. I am not quite sure what it is due to, and I can't taste the bitterness if I mix it with a good amount of honey, or brown sugar, or butter or maple syrup. However if you like to eat your cereal without any sweetening added at all then I think it is not the right cereal for you.I think if you mix this hot cereal with other cereals it will improve their texture and you probably wont notice the aftertaste.
Great cereal to eat when you want a change from oatmeal, also like the additional health benefits.

We really like this cereal. My whole family eats it almost every morning, even my preschooler. I mix it equal parts with rolled oats, and add dried/fresh fruit and nuts. It is bland by itself but great with the fruit. I also replace a portion of the flour with it in many baking recipes like banana bread and similar items and you cant tell the difference. Very good.

Since I have a hot water boiler in the kitchen, my process of making this is to pour 2x boiling water over the high fiber cereal, mix it up, and then stick it in the microwave for a minute. I let that stand for a minute or two to cool down, then pour in milk or yogurt to taste and mix it up. I find dried cranberries are sweet enough to let me forgo any other sweetener. Other good options are granola, dried apples, or sliced bananas. I do notice the bitterness of the wheat germ if I have it plain with no milk product, but quite like the result once I add milk or fruit.

column9: Bob has never let me down!
column10: LOVE this cereal!  I eat it as cereal almost as much as I use it in my breads.  Read the ingredients - everything in it is what should be in a loaf of bread.  When I make bread, I sub in 25% of this cereal for all purpose flour, sub another 25% of the all purpose flour with whole wheat and the flavor is wonderful.  Try 10% the next time you use Mark Bittman's No Knead Bread recipe.  AMAZING!  For the people in my life who prefer their oatmeal in flakes, I use about 30% of this to 70% Bob rolled oats.  We buy it regularly.  Try it!
What can I say? It came on time, was packed perfectly, and tastes great. No reason to buy this stuff from the grocery store, buy from Amazon!

Everything from Bob's that I have tried has been very good, and this is no exception. As some reviewers have mentioned, it can taste a little bland by itself, but as there is no law that I have to eat it plain, I add various things and it is delicious. My current favorites are some huckleberries and/or blackberries (picked last summer and frozen). When I run out of them, raisins or craisins with some banana works very nicely. A sprinkle of cinnamon, some butter and brown sugar and I am set for hours. Add some walnuts, pecans or hazelnuts and it practically qualifies as a dessert!In addition to the great taste, the high fiber content is a real plus. Most of use don't even come close to eating enough fiber, and this is an easy, healthy, yummy way of fixing that.

I've been eating this for a few weeks now--so pleased that I found it! I combine it with Bob's Red Mill Extra Thick Rolled Oats--2 parts oatmeal to 1 part of this. So delicious and it ups the nutrition substantially. I throw in a small handful of raisins (20g) and a sprinkle of light brown sugar (8g). Keeps me full and satisfied through lunch, and did I mention it's DELICIOUS!?

column9: Bob's Red Mill Organic High Fiber
column10: I have always purchased Bob's Red Mill Organic Oat Bran Hot Cereal, I wanted to try the high fiber with flax. It is very bland and dense (needs to be mixed with something like the Oat bran cereal or roasted flax and blueberry).I will stay with Bob's Red Mill Organic Oat Bran Hot Cereal in the future.

I had been looking for a healthier breakfast. This has worked great for me. I can add a variety of food items to this to add variety. I prepare a large quantity in a rice cooker and store it in the refrigerator. When it is time to eat, an amount can be dished up and various ingredients can be added. Chopped walnuts, blue berries, honey, cinamon, brown sugar, etc. Not all at once. Milk is added and then re-heated in the microwave. I think it makes a great healthy breakfast or any time meal.

Having grown up in a Chinese household, I love me some congee.  However, like anything made with white rice, the nutritional benefits of congee are rather limited by its glycemic index.I've found that Bob's Red Mill Hot Cereal is a more-than-acceptable substitute for congee.  I make up a bowl of this (with a little extra water, since I prefer it a little soupy) and have it with some fish or Asian pickles, just as I would with plain congee.  I make my congee Taiwanese-style (whole white rice, lots of water), and find that if I add just a little sugar to the hot cereal, I get an equivalent hint of "white rice" sweetness.  This has made my breakfasts much healthier than before.Good stuff.  I recommend it.

column9: expiration date was too close after product was received
column10: i received the product and it had an expiration date for a bit over three weeks later. Even if I was to have this every day, there is no way I could finish four packs in three weeks. Greatly disappointed. The seller cares more about selling the product for profit than customer service. the health benefits of the product make it worthwhile, although I personally gagged the first two times I tried to have this without additions like stevia, honey, and some dried fruit. but that is just my personal taste, i dont like bitter things and this is extremely bitter on its own. when stevia or tablespoon of honey is added with some fruit, this is not bad at all. just need to find it in the stores.

The cooking instructions state to cook this cereal with water and a pinch of salt.... Oh boy, the taste is bland and a little bitter. However, after some experimenting I have found, that after cooking as described on the package, if I add  some flavored yogurt, it becomes nice and creamy and tastes not bad at all. Perhaps some berries too and it is quite nice and of course it is good for you.I found that I now actually enjoy it.
I find this to make a good hot breakfast.  It is also loaded with Omega 3's.I add blueberries to it and it is very tasty.

column9: Definitely use the large bowl like the directions say!
column10: Its an awesome, healthy day starter! I like to mix in a little greek yougurt and some dried cranberries. But make sure you use the big bowl! I have yet to make it in the microwave without it overflowing my bowl during heating!
I have never had a Bob's Red Mill product that was less than 5 star.

This is a very good product and the taste is OK too. I blend it with honey and eat as breakfast. The best thing I like about this cereal is that it's extremely high in fiber and it's organic. I think everybody should switch to this for breakfast. It's really the most healthy choice.

As soon as we recieved the shipment my 3 year old twins wanted to try the cereal. I made them a bowl using the microwave method. I added a little bit of their vanilla soy milk to cool down and sweeten a bit. They LOVED it! I took a couple of bites and am looking forward to adding this to my regular morning routine. Glad I have another healthy food to feed my family!

I eat rolled oats mixed with a little breakfast cereal most mornings and thought this would be a great to use to switch things up a little bit.  It is probably very healthy but tastes pretty bad, for me.  Even if I add just a little bit to my oats or cereal, I can taste the bad flavor.  I have tried it with different combinations and I just can't make it taste good.  Too bad it was four packages :(  At least my order qualified for free shipping...

Of all the other hot cereals by Bob's Red Mill this one is my favorite.  Every morning I have some of this cereal and sometimes at night too.  It's really good and family enjoy it too.  Packaging, shipping and price are all great, especially knowing I can get this here on Amazon.

column9: Tastes good and good for you
column10: Our family loves this stuff. We cook it with some milk and some water and serve it with plain yogurt and fruit. It has a bunch of fiber and vitamins and still tastes great.

this cereal is the most healthful that i've found.  ingredients are perfect, and there is no added sugar in any form. that's the hardest to find and what i most appreciate. why can't other organic cereal producers omit the sugars?  consumers can always add sugar if that's their preference.  for those who like the oats softened, just add milk and nuke for 30-40 seconds. i sometimes add this brand's milled flaxseed and some walnuts and make it even more heart healthy.

column9: Updated Dec 2011 - Incredibly Delicious and Easy!!
column10: This is my favorite breakfast cereal and Amazon Subscribe and Save means I don't have to hunt for it all over town.Contains no salt or sweetener, so I control what goes in.  I prepare it stovetop in a small Corning cook/eat bowl, just large enough to make my portion and top it with milk when it's ready.  My 'formula' is 1 cup water, 1/2 cup cereal, 2 pinches of kosher salt and a drizzle of maple syrup - stir.  Bring to a boil, turn the gas down to the minimum, stir again, partially cover and time for 5-6 minutes.  When I want a heartier breakfast, I'll stir in some almonds, cashews, dried cranberries (Trader Joe's) before topping up with milk.I used to think that cooking cereal would be too inconvenient, then realized there are always a few morning chores that have to be taken care of anyway, so now I get them done while it simmers.  Love it year round, except on the hottest summer days.A few friends who swear by steel cut oatmeal now buy this as well, to jazz up their routine.P.S. Update:  My cook and eat bowl is an oldie - the current versions are NOT usable on the stovetop.  Many thanks to S. Sims for pointing this out!!
This high fiber cereal is a great way to start the day. Because of its high fiber, it keeps the stomach and the intestines happy and healthy.
I love this yummy hot cereal!  I fix it in the microwave every morning as it is very quick and easy and it stays with me for hours.

I had high hopes for this cereal based on others reviews.  But I was very dissappointed - it's like eating sawdust in my opinion!  It would take a whole lot of dried fruit, nuts and sweetener of some kind to make this taste anywhere near yummy.  And that doesn't fit in to the kind of diet I'm supposed to eat.

column9: Blandest thing I've ever tasted, and I'm hard on those who complain about their food
column10: I've seen a lot of products on here and not only do I cringe but I criticize people when they complain about the taste of food for various reasons. I purchased this, solely for awesome, healthy, thick and colorful bowel movements. I wanted them, but wasn't getting them. So I ate this and in terms of flavor, any flavor, give me a snap crackle or pop, I received nothing. My tongue and body were analyzing it as if it were an alien. I thought, the solution was easy, grab some toppings and that should take care of the problem, right? So I put peanuts in the cereal, like an elephant, and the cereal was so strong in its stubborn ways-like kryptonite, it made the peanuts bland. So I said, ok fine, we're going to have to get the big guns here. I went out and purchased honey. The major religious books talk about milk and honey all the time, you can't get more sweeter and flavorful than honey. I put a significant amount of honey in my bowl and the forces were so strong with this one, it devoured the distinct flavor of honey like a fat kid devours a cake when left alone in a room. So, every time thereafter when I consumed cereal bowls of this product, it would be like a contest. I'd have a contest with myself. The contest would be, how fast and efficient can I be in consuming this with a spoon? And I'd set a record and the next day, when I'd eat it again, I'd try to beat that record-like a marathon. Training for the Olympics. Ten big spoonfuls one day, maybe nine or eight the next. And the thing is, I didn't notice any bowel improvement. I expected unicorns and vibrant rainbows to come out of my a** and it was like a wasteland just decimated with poverty, hopelessness and abandonment. I gave the cereal two stars instead of one because I presume this has some healthy benefits with the flaxseed and the whole grains and whatnot. If you don't believe me that's fine. Purchase this and bring a sword to the table. You're going to do battle with the dragon, my friend.

This product is made from coconut sap, yum! Nice flavor too, it taste a bit like maple syrup with a hint of vanilla. The consistency is like a very thick molasses, but the thickness is not an issue when using it to cook with. Coconut necter is delicious in smoothies, on oatmeal and also mixed in with peanut butter for an extra energy boost. Good quality nutrient content, low GI of 35 and is gluten free.Nitrogen (N)2,020Phosphorous (P)790Potassium (K)10,300Magnesium (Mg)290Chloride (Cl)4,700Zinc (Zn)21.2Iron (Fe)21.9

I have been in search of an unrefined sweetner to replace agave sweetner (for my baby's nut milk - dairy intolerance).  I did the research, and this is it.  The health benefits are fantastic.  However, the price is so high I will unfortunately have to go back to raw agave sweetner.  The taste is very similar to agave, a little less sweet, leans toward maple syrup but not as rich (a bonus in my book).  My 3 year old and 1 year old both like the nut milk sweetened this way.  Other down side, it takes almost twice as much as the agave to sweeten appropriately, though I haven't used for anything but nut milk.  I think it's significantly better than brown rice syrup.  If you have the money to support the "habit," this is definitely the real deal.

column4: Tommie "An expert is a former drip under pres...
column10: I have to ignore my coconut nectar in the cabinet. It is wonderful! I have been known to eat it by the spoonful all by itself. I'm still on the first bottle (I have more), so my ignorance is proven to be valuable. The next batch of fudge I make will be sweetened with this. YUM-ALICIOUS!!

column9: Wonderful nectar  and substitute for honey, agave, or maple syrup
column10: This coconut nectar is delicious and has a unique tasty flavor.  I am a type II diabetic and the coconut nectar does not raise my blood sugar at all. I am using this as a sweetner in baked goods, as a syrup on gluten free almond and coconut flour pancakes and waffles, as a dressing for fruit salad,sweetner in whipped cream and homemade cheesecake.  I also used this along with Coconut Secret's Coconut Aminos in making homemade ketchup and barbeque sauce.  The flavor of the coconut nectar really enhances both.I only wish it came in a discounted 4 or 6 pack or a bigger bottle.  It can be a bit pricey. That being said, a little goes a long way for sweetner. I also use coconut palm sugar regularly for baked goods but I find the flavor of this raw coconut nectar much more flavorful and the texture of the baked goods more moist.

column9: Exactly what I was looking for!
column10: I needed to severely cut down on my sugar intake, and also want to stay away from artificial/chemical sweeteners. Stevia is ok but still gives me that aftertaste that I don't find appealing. It's good for some things, but not everything. This product is amazing! I'm so glad to have found something that is sold in its natural, organic, raw state that is low-glycemic and actually good for you!
Looking for a natural alternative and found this stuff.  Works great to sweeten tea, kind of disappears in coffee.  Still playing with it.  Worth the buy!

I tried this as an agave substitute, since I'm not a big agave fan. This is thicker than agave. It has a pleasant mild, almost maple-like flavor (and I believe I can taste a hint of coconut). I like the low glycemic index. It does taste a little less sweet when using spoonful for spoonful in replacing agave. But I'm trying to kick the sugar habit, so it's both helping me get accustomed to things a little less sweet while not overpowering the flavor of whatever I make it with. Ounce by ounce it's probably similar in cost if not less than maple syrup. Since I only use it in occasional recipes, I'm willing to pay, although that was the reason I did not choose five stars. But health isn't free!

Coconut nectar ia a great substitute for "bad sugars".  I use it in baking because of its low glycemic index.  Look for receipes on line for this product & try it, you will not be disappointed.  I made apple muffins with raisins that turned out great.  Just one of the many things that I use it for.

I totally love this product and use it in place of sugar or honey or syrup on cereals, waffles, and desserts.  I like it above Stevia which sometimes can leave a bitter taste. Coconut Secret remains sweet. It was created for diabetic use, having  a low glycemic index.  It's actually made from the flowers of the tree rather than the coconuts themselves - just a great and tasty product.

I've only used the nectar on pancakes.  It's actually quite good.  It has a nice smooth consistency, like maple syrup, but is thick and stringy like molasses.  It also has a slight buttery taste that makes it quite excellent on pancakes. But what I like best about it is that 1 serving = 1 Tbsp (15ml) and because of the intensity of the sweetness, I don't need more than a Tbsp- 1.5 Tbsp for a stack of pancakes!  Each serving is 55 calories, 20mg of sodium and 13g of sugar. I'm only adding this information, because I didn't see it in the description.A previous reviewer identified this as an unrefined product.  Ridiculous and literally impossible. Please don't fall for the raw hype.

column9: This is healthy and tastes good
column10: I am ordering the coconut Sacret raw nectar again becasue of the health benifits, and i like it in my coffee. The last package was packaged very well, but the last bottle has begun to crystalize, which means its not as fresh. I have purchased this product before in bulk in my community, and never had a problem with it crystalizing.  I hope this next shipment will be fresh.
I use this as a sugar/agave alternative in desert recipes.  I react poorly to sugar and agave, I don't feel any adverse side effects from this nectar (and I have it quite frequently).

i purchased this after reading the fantastic reviews and description about the product. It might just be me, but I did not like it. It smells sweeater than what it actually tastes. I got a  headache just by the smell. I was looking to replace agave nectar and wanted a vegan solution (not honey anymore)... but i found that to achieve the optimal sweetness i had to use more than of the previously mentioned products. I am a bit dissapointed with myself because i love sweet and i thought i would like this. But this wasnt the case.

While I have several of the Torani brand sugar free syrups at home, and love them all, I would have to say out of all of them, the mint one isn't "minty enough," especially considering I'm using it as an add in to coffees or actual recipes. In short, I find the minty-ness a bit muted and diluted when in a mixed drink.Torani provides a flavorful, sugar-free alternative. All their syrups are of high quality and consistent. But the mint one, IMHO, isn't my favorite, even though I want it to be.
It wouldn't be Christmas and wintertime without peppermint cocoa.  We add this syrup to hot chocolate, along with 2 oz espresso, for a great treat at much less cost than coffeehouses.  Enjoy!
I've been using this to make my Peppermint White Mocha's at home and it is great!  Cost me less money that the coffeehouses and taste just as good!
Very delicious Torani Sugar Free Peppermint coffee syrup.  You can't even tell it is sugar free.  Delicious with cocoa too!!!!
I do not eat sugar so the sugar free Torani Surups are a go to product for me.  I make my own version of the popular Peppermint Mocha coffee sold at coffee shops.
This syrup is so good! I use them when I have an upset stomach and put the syrup in the teas to settle my stomach. Or they are good when you want a little touch of mint in the teas! Thanks!

I LIKED THIS BRAMBLY APPLESAUCE BECAUSE IT IS SO DIFFERENT FROM THE RUN OF THE MILL.  IT HAS NO CINNAMON OR SPICES OF ANY KIND, JUST PURELY SIMPLE AND DELICIOUS.  I COULD EASILY RECOMMEND IT TO OTHERS OR TO TUCK IN A GIFT BASKET.  THE CONTAINERS ARE SMALL, BUT THEY ARE VERY VERY GOOD.  THANKS.

column9: A great flavor for adding to your coffee or to your baking!
column10: If you are a diabetic and have ever attended a nutrition class for diabetics you probably have heard of this product. We have a whole collection of the different flavors and I have posted a photo of some of the ones we use the most. This is an ideal additive to diabetic cooking, baking of foods or the mixing of drinks. It is sugar free and calorie free and extremely low in sodium.These mixes are ideal for use in coffee, tea drinks, Italian sodas, cocktails, pancakes, waffles, diabetic cakes, over shaved ice and muffins. You can find a lot of diabetic recipes and substitute these flavorings for ingredients that have more sugar and calories. The result is surprisingly good and it will help reduce your sugar and calorie intake while helping you add more flavor to your food.This flavor is good in your coffee an also for baking low calorie muffins or cakes.  It jazzes up the flavor without adding calories or a lot of salt. It only contains 5 mg of salt.  I have attached a photo of the label for your review. You can add more flavoring to suit your taste.Flavorings like these are nice to spice up your low calorie drinks and food and the Da Vinci Gourmet brand is the best we have found. They are internationally recognized as the highest quality flavoring made and one tablespoon = a free food exchange for a diabetic.I strongly recommend this to you as a great product!

I love JIF Peanut Butter, especially since it's one of my favorite peanut butters that I grew up with during my childhood years since I used to use it a lot for peanut butter and jelly sandwiches.As a matter of fact, JIF is my 2nd favorite peanut butter in the whole wide world, but PETER PAN is my favorite in the whole wide world, but when I can't find PETER PAN in a 28 OZ or 40 OZ size jar, I end up buying JIF in that size as a 2nd alternative, especially since I can never find PETER PAN in a 28 Ounce or 40 Ounce size at the stores anymore and only carry PETER PAN in the 16 OZ size for some reason which is perhaps due to PETER PAN being outsold by JIF and SKIPPY since I can always find SKIPPY and JIF in a 28 OZ or 40 OZ size at most grocery stores.Additionally, I find it hard to understand why Amazon sells JIF and SKIPPY in a 40 OZ sized jar individually and wont sell PETER PAN in a 40 OZ size individually, plus it baffles me why Amazon charges you $12 bucks to buy this size product online to buy one 40 Ounce jar of JIF when you can buy it at the grocery store or a retail store in this exact same size for under $8 or $9 bucks too.
The winter weather was bad & I didn't really want to go out shopping. The Jif arrived at the time stated, and with homemade bread & biscuits, kept the kids happy until the roads cleared.
I ordered three 40 oz containers of JIF creamy peanut butter. I received a single container of creamy and two containers of extra crunchy.Beware of receiving items you did not order.
Ok the soup tastes great but is buy no means east to make. Plan on having soup the next day.

I love black bean soups of all types, but this is the first perfectly awful recipe I've ever encountered.  First of all many additional ingredients are required (whole purple onion, quart of chicken broth, orange juice) and it is very labor-intensive and time-consuming to produce.  The seasoning packet is way too heavy on the cumin, which I think is a Tex-Mex aberration.  There are almost as many black eye peas in the bag as black beans and they don't taste the same.  The final result is that the potentially lovely black bean taste is completely overwhelmed by the cumin and orange juice.  The soup just taste funny.  I've got three remaining bags to give away. Frontier Soups Hearty Meals Texas Wrangler Black Bean Soup, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)
Eat it with salads, brown rice, roasted vegetables.... Love this product! I am a big fan of Go Raw and have subscribe and save to their Spicy Mix and Chocolate Cookies as well.

We love these chips because, unlike most "baked" potato chips that are made from mashed up potatoes extruded into potato chip shapes, these chips are actually slices of potatoes--which means they're very minimally processed.  And because they aren't laden with oil, they actually taste like potatoes.  Try these, then try any other baked potato "chip" out there.  There's just no comparison.These babies are pretty expensive, but we can't eat any other chips now because they all taste artificial or too greasy.
these chips are great if you like the harder kettle type which I do.  I can have chips with my sandwich every day and not feel guilty - only 100 cal and they are only 3 WW pts!!!

We love these chips. First, lets start by saying that they aren't smashed and broken but nice big chips. YUM!!! Much better choice - less salt and fat. Very tasty. You won't be disappointed. We love them and buy them by the case on a monthy schedule.....gotta have them!!!

I ordered these chips for my husband's lunch as they are a relatively healthy snack and low in calories.They arrived very quickly, which was the good part, but the bad part is they taste a little stale (expiry date at the end of this year) and every single one of the packs (72 in all) is covered in grease, so that when they are handled, they leave grease all over one's fingers - and he has to carry them to work inside a paper bag so that the grease doesn't get all over his briefcase.Not good!
In Arizona, salsa reigns supreme.  In our house, Mae Ploy has the crown.  Best stuff ever!!!
This is the best.  It tastes just like the sauce that comes with the crab wontons at P F Changs!!

column9: A great sweet chilli sauce for seafood and chicken!
column10: I love it on catfish, chicken and even use it on plain white rice.  A must-have-ingredient in my kitchen.  In general all the Mae Ploy products I have tried are very good.

Anytime you buy frozen spring rolls, or egg rolls, (or any appetizer!!!), replace the sauce that comes with it.  Pour a large bowl of this sweet, succulent, mildly spicy sauce, and you'll find yourself spooning down the sauce long after your egg rolls are gone.  Think hot pepper jelly in a larger jar.  Pair with cream cheese and you will experience gastronomic heaven!!!!

column9: This is NOT a specialty sauce ................
column10: It's a NECESSARY sauce for just about everything from ahi (tuna), Mahi-mahi, salmon, catfish, pork, chicken, ribs, brats, you name it.It's sweet chili taste is not hot (for me), but it does have the chili taste. My GF doesn't like hot chili at all, but I suspect that this stuff is the reason she dates me. Every good sauce should make your mouth water, and this stuff does.It's so good, I buy it by the case, and I always have guests ask where they can get some.I've a buddy in Hawaii that brings a case to the mainland when he comes back to hand out.This stuff is so good, you'll eat it on everything, very often. I put it right up with Smoky Jon's BBQ sauce (Madison, WI http://www.yelp.com/biz/smoky-jons-no-1-b-b-q-madison), and lest anyone think I hand out too many compliments, those two are the high ground for me - period.If you have one bottle of sauce in your refrigerator, this should be it.

column9: This should always be in your kitchen
column10: This is an integral part to any barbecue sauce, hot wings... and so much more.  Love this stuff.

This chili sauce is great on my lumpia, but what I like best is the size of the bottle since I can travel with it much easier, making it great for family picnics and bbqs away from the house this summer.
Amazing flavor It's the best Sauce ever!!!  I need 10 stars to describe the quality of this product.  Excellent with any food.

went to a nearby restaurant and begged the waiter for the sauce they were using for calimari. thank goodness he gave me the name and i've used it ever since. i use it on fish as a marinade. try it you won't be disappointed. tried other names....no comparison

column9: Skookum - Shut up and drink coffee
column10: Perfect roast of coffee for someone who likes coffee - will turn you into someone who loves coffee. I cant get enough of it - shared a bag at work and started a line at the coffee pot from the smell as it brewed.

column4: Shut up and drink the coffee
column10: Full body, great flavor and a great cup of coffee. The only coffee my wife will drink. We have tried other Raven's Brew blends but really like Skookum.

column9: Great brew -- rich, full bodied and smooth
column10: I make mine in a french press, course grind w/ a burr grinder, 3.5 to 4 minutes brew time.I've found this blend to be very rich, full bodied and smooth. I have tried one other blend from Raven's Brew and was similarly impressed. I plan on trying many more from this company and highly recommend giving this one a shot (or two or three). This is definitely one I will order more of in the future.
I drink a lot of coffee and am always trying something - Raven's Brew coffees are outstanding.  Full bodied without being acidic.  Raven's Brew Whole Bean Skookum Blend, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)

column9: right amount of sweet and sour
column10: excellent product with the right amount of sweet and sour; not easy to find in the grocery store.  Great with a few candied pecans or walnuts on top

I love Crystal Light and I love Mojitos, so I had high hopes for the new Crystal Light Mojito mocktail.  I was not disappointed!  It has a lovely lemon-lime taste with a hint of refreshing mint.  Just mix, add ice cubes, and it is a wonderful summer treat.  Unlike lemonade, it seems to quench my thirst rather than increase it.  It mixes easily and has a very light mint green tint and a tart lime scent.  It brings back visits to Disneyland for me, since they have Mint Juleps in New Orleans Square by the railroad.I wouldn't even consider this to be a wonderful substitute for when you don't want the crazy calories of a real Mojito (an 8 oz glass is 5 calories vs a Mojito at 160 calories), when you are the designated driver, or any other reason to stay away from the version with alcohol.  It's just too delicious in its own right and you don't need an excuse!I found them at my local grocery store for three bucks each, but I'm sure it isn't easy to get these everywhere.  Each canister has 5 packets, and each packet makes 2 quarts.UPDATE: this is the response I got from Kraft when asking if these would be available.We are delighted to hear of your interest in our CRYSTAL LIGHT Mocktail Powdered Soft Drink Mix. As you may already know, this product is only being manufactured and distributed for a limited period of time. For that reason, we are unable to provide any additional information on the stores that may still have the product in stock.

As other reviewers have stated, it taste good as long as you keep chugging it, but as soon as you stop it has a horrid aftertaste.  The only way that I can describe it is that it taste like black licorice.  Yuck, I'd rather eat a bar of soap!!!

As some other reviewers state nice going down but in a minute or two comes this really strange chemical taste.  Opened one package to make this pitcher but that is it.  Took it to work for others to try.....we were done with it.  Yuk.

I've only tried the Mojito flavor and was somewhat disappointed. It starts off well; no real alcohol flavor or smell (so it's safe for work-- ha!).  The problem is the unpleasant aftertaste.  It took me a couple of minutes to pinpoint a toothpaste flavor as the skunk in the rose garden.I'll finish the rest, but won't buy it again.

they had this on a special display at my grocery store in Texas.  i got one of each (Mojito, Marguerita, and Appletini) -- the Appletini was my least fave, although still tasty - i'm just not that into apples.  the Mojito is AWESOME and the Marguerita flavor really captures the essence of the drink without the tequila.  I went to three stores today looking for this product and NOTHING.  I'm so bummed and the price on Amazon is really high.  I'm hoping that Crystal Light will decide to market these items widespread so i'll be able to get them again.

I love this Crystal Light Mojito mix and cannot find it anymore.  I am very disappointed......When I make this mix I add a little less water and add pineapple juice and serve it real cold.It is absolutely delicious.  For New Year's Eve we added some ginger ale as well and floated frozenpineapple rings and maraschino cherries.  It was so good and refreshing.  Hope the company reconsidersbringing this product back. Really love it and the almost zero calories is a added perk.

I would give this 3.5 stars if I could. At first I was delighted with the flavor. It does taste similar to a mojito, which was their purpose in making this. The problem is if you drink too much, that mint (as in the leaf) flavor will start to overpower the drink. So if you want to try this out, I would advise not to drink too much of it at one time. I poured a small glass and enjoyed that first glass, then poured another, but was unable to finish it. And I believe the mint leaf is what the other reviewers were talking about when they mentioned an after taste. Also, adding ice cubes to your glass makes the drink taste better. So drink it cold and drink it in moderation!

I am a "Plus-Size" person and between my Dentist and every other Health Professional I encounter, I have gotten it through my head that reducing my sugar intake and putting away at LEAST 2 Liters of water each day are both Really Good Things. Plain water is boring. When I mentioned that each morning I fill a 64 - ounce Insulated Mug with Ice, Water and Crystal Light, my Doctor said "Perfect!". I have been looking for a nice, tart Limeade mix that doesn't involve squeezing mass quantities of limes, buying and measuring out dried lime powder or buying bottles of Lime juice. This stuff EXCEEDS my expectations. It reminds me - strongly - of the taste of a "Mint Julep" beverage sold at a certain local theme park. Use Club Soda in place of water, and it's a dead ringer (Minus the Sugar). Run out and try it! (AFTER I stock up, of course.) ;-)

I recently Mixed the Mojito Mix and the taste was ok but soon after drinking it for a little longer my stomach started to hurt a lot. I actually ended up pooping 2 times and I would have pooped again but I'm waiting for my relief so I can get off of work & eat LOTS of chicken & then enjoy a great poop afterwards. I'm also upset that my internet is extremly slow which didn't allow me to buy the newly released Jordan IV's :..(

column9: Great tasting cappucino in a convenience can
column10: This is cappuccino in an 8.45 oz can, just a bit more than a regular 12 oz soda can. You won't get the, "You got milk mustache" or some cute latte art, but you can really taste a nice combination of strong coffee flavor and milk - tastes great. 100 calories.The milk comes from rBST free cows (I first had to Google it to know what it means), meaning no injection with artificial hormones to increase production of milk. RBST is already banned in Canada, Japan, New Zealand, etc., but not in the US yet.Not better than the hot cappuccino served with the traditional atmosphere, but if you need to run, you can just grab one and throw it in you bag.Product of Denmark.

Illy issimo cappuccino Italian espresso style coffee drink with lowfat milk and cocoa is a nice little 100 calorie treat in a 8.45 fl. oz. (250 ml) can.1930s Italy under the rule of Mussolini greatly contributed to the development of modern coffee culture, improved coffee-making, and new types of coffee-making equipment. The Horn of Africa (where coffee originated) was under Italian colonization and companies such as illy and Bialetti were founded.In that tradition, this drink is now made in Denmark under the issimo brand from illy and distributed in the U.S. by Coca-Cola.This canned cappuccino has a pleasant taste with a good balance of the coffee, milk, cocoa, and sugar with lots of visible solids. To be sure, it's not as good as freshly made cappuccino but it is what it is.

column9: Very good food for dogs with allergies...
column10: I have allergy-prone 2 French Bulldogs.  I buy this & combine with: California Natural Grain Free Kangaroo & Red Lentils Formula Adult Dry Dog Food.  Kangaroo works because they have never been exposed to this meat! Excellent mixer. I keep this in the fridge (doesn't have to be) and mix with warm water & rice.  My dogs have been doing very well on this!  I am very happy.

I am not a huge potato chip fan so I was suprised by how much I love with these Lentil Chips!  They are light, healthy and absolutely delicious!  Also nice that they are Gluten Free and can be easily shared with my Gluten Free friends.  My kids also love them!  Favorite is Sea Salt & Cracked Pepper, but also like the Parmesan Garlic.  My father really likes the Cucumber Dill too.  Try them!  You'll love them too.

Ordered this almond emulsion with some hesitation because it is kinda pricey. But am well pleased with it despite the price. Was upset about one of the bottles being completely cracked inside the box though, which made it even more expensive for me. However, I do like the product.
This is delicious in cake batter or icing- I just use about 1/4 teaspoon for batter and 1/2 to 1 teaspoon for icing...so good.
LorAnn Almond Emulsion is fantastic. It is far better than run of the mill almond extract with a well defined almond flavor and aroma. Yum!

column9: Price IS for 4 boxes of 4 pouches each
column10: Our kid loves these pouches, but due to another reviewer saying it was for one box of four pouches, the only reason I purchased these was because they were priced at four dollars and change.When the box arrived from Amazon, I was very pleasantly surprised to find that I paid under five bucks for 4 BOXES of four pouches each (for a total of sixteen pouches). So thank you other reviewer, for driving the price down ;)I'll definitely buy them again in the future, even back up at the full price. It's certainly a better price than our local Safeway/Raley's has.

My 4 and 6 year old love these, because they are easy to hold, fun to eat and taste good.I love these because they are mess-free, easy to grab on the go, and healthy.  For my picky 4 year old, this is the only way I can get blueberries (or any other blue/purple) food into him.My kids do need some help getting the last little bit squeezed out, but more likely because of their inability to squeeze and roll up the bottom at the same time than a package designe flaw.

We love Mashups and buy then at our grocery store. I was so happy to see them in the Subscribe & Save option. Based on price and description, I thought I was purchasing 4 boxes of 4 Mashups each (so 16 total). Instead I received 1 box. I called Amazon customer service and they confirmed that it was only 1 box. At a cost of $16, I could buy 3 boxes at my grocery store. Amazon did refund my money no questions asked though.

column9: Great way to sneak in fruit and veggies
column10: I purchase these through subscribe and save. My kids love them. They are a great way to incorporate fruit and veggies into their diet. They are also portable and great to throw in lunch boxes or picnic coolers. I love having them delivered to my door and not having to worry about running out.

My 2 year old loves any of these easy to squeeze snacks!  I was happy to find some that were both fruit and veggie.  These taste great too - I tried them!  They are a great portable snack for on the go!

Yummy and nutritious treats for anytime. I put one or two containers out on the kid's table so they can choose a healthy snack when they want. I like how convenient and clean they are. Easy to transport as well.

I was searching for healthy, no-mess snacks for my on-the-go lifestyle. I LOVE the new packaging for so many of the fruits/veggies! No spoon, no spill or drip... and very, very convenient!These taste like flavored applesauce - they have the applesauce texture, but also include veggie puree. Yum!

column9: As expected, although Elixir instead of React....
column10: It's gum, that's all you need to know. Disappointed that there was Elixir in the pack, instead of React. Seems like something that shouldn't be screwed up.
I quit smoking and was told to get mints. I now chew alot, and the variety is nice. I also dont think I'm harming my teeth with sugar free.
I made a ice cube tray of Ice Pups for my four dogs. The Husky, Rottie, Australian Shepherd and German Shepherd loved them. You'll want to feed them outside....they seem a little sticky.

I weaned my 3 cats from a Science Diet menu that they've been on for the past 2+ years.  I've been disgusted with the whole pet food debacle of late and figured that if I could treat my diet well that my cats deserved the same.  The cats were not keen on the Newmans right away.  In fact, they would pick through the mixture and deposit the Newmans on the floor and continue to eat only the Science Diet until I finally transitioned them over 3 weeks onto only Newmans.The things I've noticed -- they are not eating the same quantity of food.  I have a bowl that sits out all the time and so they are free to eat when they want. I add 1/2 cup increments throughout the day.  They seem to enjoy the food the best when it is first put in the bowl - not wanting to eat the stuff that's been in there for 12 hours or more.  I've been keeping track of their weight as I was worried about weight loss from not eating but they are all the same weight as before.The litter habits have decreased.  The two youngest cats used to use the litter box twice a day but now only once.  I read on Newmans website that  the digestive system can take up to 2-3 months to acclimate itself to the new diet.  The only downfall for this food is the accessibility.  I can easily get it at Whole Foods here in Florida if I'm in a rush (if they have it!) but when I return to my summer home in the middle of nowhere - i'll be forced to order it online.  Just checked today and most places don't have it in stock now.Other things worth mentioning - my cats never had fur balls on the Science Diet.  There have been 3 fur balls in the past 4 weeks with the Newmans.  Also, the cats fur tends to be a little drier than on the S.D.  Other than that, i'm happy for the moment with the Newmans and have recommended it my friends.

Newman's Own® Organics Adult Cat Formula, 76-Ounce Bag  After trying several good quality cat foods, this is the only one that my two cats will eat.They will paw around anything else- as if to cover it up.  Have noticed they maintain good body weight, good appetites, and their fur is healthier and softer. Also notice a difference in stronger eye color. (one cat is Himalayan, and her eyes are getting better color- even tho she is 10 yrs. old)  Am also adding Tiki Cat salmon or chicken, oncea day, in separate dish.  This can be found on the internet. No vomiting, no hairballs, no foul smelling litter boxes.

I carefully researched "natural" brands of cat food and decided Newman's had the best ingredient list of all the competitors out there. They didn't have questionable ingredients like Wysong, and some other "natural" companies that I would never buy. I was happy to find an organic cat food and began switching my cats over from a high quality, but not organic, commercial cat food. All of my cats except one seemed to prefer the taste of the Newman's, while the one cat tried to refuse it. So, no real problems there. However, like some other people have mentioned, my cats began to throw up. A lot.I am very concerned about the digestibility of this cat food. My cats are not throwing up hairballs - they are throwing up the food which looks like it hardly broke down, if at all, in their digestive track.Also, you have to feed larger quantities of Newman's to get the same amount of vitamins to your cat that are supplied in smaller servings of brands like Iams. So, don't compare this to another brand pound-for-pound.I have never tried the Newman's canned cat food, but perhaps cats would have an easier time keeping it down.I was very careful in switching my cats over to a new brand, which shouldn't be a health issue if the brand truly IS "high quality," so I have grave concerns about this dry cat food. I was really hoping I had found an organic brand that my cats would eat for the rest of their lives.My cats have never had problems like this before (they are all around 4-years-old) and I feel horrible that I made them sick by trying to give them what I thought would be a healthier food.I wouldn't recommend this dry food to anyone.
I love coffee, but can only drink decaf.  It's very hard to find a good decaf French Vanilla, but Baronet makes it right.  Works well with Black and Decker or Senseo single cup coffee makers.
I don't like decaf, but this is the BEST decaf I have tasted so far..I still will try the hazelnut and chocolate fudgecheers;)

I'm the only Decaf drinker in the house so to brew a pot was not happening very often.  Bought a Hamilton 1 cup coffee maker that uses these pods.  It's certainly convenient and "good" but I definitely prefer a brewed cup. A brewed cup has more taste.  Using 2 pods per cup doesn't work for me, just too strong that way.

column9: Great coffee, works perfectly with our pod coffee machine.
column10: My wife and I were a little worried about finding the correct pods for our pod coffee machine and when it came time to get more coffee it was either go expensive and stick with the manufacturer's brand or try out Baronet.  Fortunately it works perfectly, there's no problem with the pods fitting and the taste is very smooth.  Even the aroma off this coffee is very nice, you might even be fooled based on the aroma that it was fresh ground.  So overall a good coffee at a good price!

column9: Baronet Decaf French Vanilla..the best ever!
column10: It's amazing how much better this coffee is from other brands.  The flavor is rich yet mellow. The coffee tastes wonderful and the room smells delightful. Just brewing one pod in the morning starts my day off with pleasant feelings.  One important thing though....the pods are not individually wrapped, so flavor is lost quickly; after several days the coffee develops a stale, bitter flavor.  Keep the pods in a plastic zipper bag and you'll be OK.
This coffee is delicious, and very affordable as compared to most flavored pods.  I would recommend it.
I like this but it sure stunk while making it.  The smell was awful, but after cooking it was gone.
Decaf is so hard to do right. These pods are just so-so. When I really want a cappuccino in the afternoon I use one because caffeine after noon doesn't work for me.
IVE BEEN USING ILLY FOR 6 YEARS SINCE MY DAUGHTER INTRODUCED ME TO IT WHEN I VISITED HER IN ITALY.......GOOD COFFEE.....HIGHLY RECOMMEND.......DELICIOUS

illy pods are the best ... consistently good and so easy .... very little clean-up.  With loose grounds, I hesitate to make coffee because of the mess so I generally run down to the corner coffee shop.  With illy pods, I know I will get an excellent cup for less money and the clean-up is fast ... win, win, win.

Now you may ask why pay to have H20 packed and shipped half way around the world just to be guzzled in a mater of seconds, minutes at the most?Well "nothing" is the reason. Everyday you hear about the odd stuff that is in local water supplies. My favorite statement is "it may look nasty and taste awful but it is perfectly safe." So we turn to bottled water that is everything from the same local water just packaged to fancy mineral water that needs lime to mellow it out. Included in this category is a concoction called drinking water; they take everything out and put back what they guess makes water drinkable. The worst sort of stuff is items packed in colorful plastic bottles that taste like colorful plastic.Evian on the other hand is water the way that nature intended. It goes down smooth and has no after taste. It is refreshing when cooled but can work well even at room temperature. Gourmet coffee locations use this as the base water because it does not distract from the taste. The water is even used externally for applying and removing makeup. I keep a case in the car incase of any emergency that may come up.There is "nothing" more satisfying.

These not only taste great but very satisfying in the midst of a hectic day and no time to eat. Fits easily in your bag, only 280 cals for 2 oz bag and has 6g of fiber. Much healthier and better tasting than anything found in a vending machine. I love them all but Soledad is my fave.

Sahale snacks are nutritious, delicious and addictive: low in carbs and sugar so diabetics can enjoy them, and SO much better than typical trail mixes. They have quality ingredients, a wonderful variety of flavors and are the perfect snack for kids and adults.

These are the perfect size!  The bigger bags you can buy in the grocery stores lead to the temptation of eating the entire bag!  But with these portions, you could eat half the bag for a snack or the entire bag for a meal replacement and not feel bad.  They are actually 2 servings per bag.  They were fresh and delicious when they arrived.

I tried these snacks in the store because they looked like there were healthy ingredients and unusual flavor mixtures.  I LOVED them!!  I like getting them delivered t my door because the price is right and the smaller sized bags help prevent over-indulging!

I found the Sahale snacks while on vacation and fell in love with the unique flavors.  When I got home, I couldn't find them at my local store, so was thrilled to see the sampler pack on Amazon.  We love the small bags - easy to take anywhere and don't sit around long enough to go stale.  The cashew combo is a good sweet snack, while the others give you great flavors and a little spicy hit.  Yum!

column9: Put down those Planters and grab a bag of this!
column10: I was introduced to this line of snacks when I bought a bag of Valdosta Pecans a couple years back.  For some time, I didn't realize they offered other nuts.  Valdosta is still my favorite today but they are all delicious! Darn you Amazon for making it easier to fuel my addiction!The ingredients are all high quality...nothing unnatural, and nothing listed that the lay public wouldn't understand.  Don't be deterred by the strange sounding combinations. They create a gourmet tasting symphony in your mouth, but do not detract from the natural flavor of the nuts.The only downside is that as always the case with nuts, if you're dieting, portion control is necessary since they are naturally high in calories.  But at least its healthy calories, right?

These are a delightful gourmet treat.I don't know why my store is not carrying them.I was very pleased to see I could buy them online.  I got the smaller sized bags so I could send to and share with my friends.Thanks!
We love every variety of these sahale snacks.  They are a little pricey, but they are also made from high quality ingredients.
Great tasting and healthy snacks and the small size helps you from over eating.  Use them also for little gifts to the grandkids.
My husband pays a lot of attention to what he has every day. He really likes them as snacks during work breaks or before workouts.

column9: Taste Good, love it, do not forget Subscribe and Save
column10: Taste Good, love it, do not forget Subscribe and SaveJust a little expensive. But it's super super good, delicious if your teeth can handle it.Remember to subscribe it, so you can save $5 for each order.
These snacks are great. I first tried them last year in December in Virginia Beach, VA and foundthem hear in Illinois. Best snack on the planet.
They come in convenience small package.  The flavor is good.  When I'm hungry, one pack gives me all the energy I need.  I would recommend it to other because it's worth the money.
Great, healthy snack.  The combination of fruit, nuts, seeds, and spices is a great idea.  The flavor combinations are excellent and not the norm.  Tastes great!

column9: Good, But None Measure Up to the Valdosta!
column10: I fell in love with the Sahale Snacks Valdosta Blend, 5-Ounce (Pack of 6) (or any of the various other package size and number options, like Sahale Snacks, Valdosta Blend, 2-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12), Sahale Snacks, Nut Blend, Valdosta Pecans, 4-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6), or even the "economy sized": Sahale Snacks, Valdosta Blend, 15-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 2)!), and so thought the other Sahale nut snack flavors were worth a try. They are all pretty darn good, really. Yet, while all do have varying degrees of the the chewy, crunchy, sweet, spicy blend of textures and flavors I appreciate so much in the Valdosta mix, none qute measures up, for my money.The Sing Buri Cashews seem to be the most spicy in their eastern kind of way. The Soledad Almonds are pretty good, but slightly brittle or dry (while being stickier than others, which is fine taste-wise, but which can be messy), or *something* that I'm not quite totally crazy about. The Cashews with Pomegranate and Vanilla are a bit sweeter of a treat than the others which have more savory and/or spicy notes. (Sorry, I'm far closer to gourmand than gourmet, so I don't have the most sophisticated taste nor the specific foodie terminology to go with it!)As they say, "There's no accounting for taste," and so I don't know if anyone else would agree with my pooely proffered preferences here. I just know that I don't see any reason to buy any of the other varieties when I always seem to be comparing them to the Valdosta and finding them wanting.
These snacks are absolutely delicious!  If you haven't tried them, you're missing out!  Other than Amazon, I've only seen them at Starbucks (this is much less pricey).

These were a great snack! My entire family loved them, including my children. (9 and 6) Not too spicy. I think this is a great alternative for those looking for more in a snack. I highly recommend this product for those looking for great tasting, unique flavored snack. It would be nice if they had different variety packs avail so that we can try them all.
Nice nut snack.  Great travel size.  Favorite is the Valdosta Pecan, second is the Almond snack, least favorite was the Cashew.  Give it a try!
Love these tasty little snacks. Yes, they're high in fat, but provide lots of energy and I take them with me to work. The flavour combos are great!

These are wonderful snacks.  I put them in my car, my purse, my briefcase.  Great for when you are unable to eat a regular meal or to hold you over.  They are delicious!  I have celiacs disease and all but one of the snacks are gluten and wheat free.  One of the snacks has soy sauce but the rest are all safe.

I bought these last week after debating for months. I had to think about it.  :o)They have a very unique flavor(s) A refreshing change from the everyday type of snack!To fully enjoy these snacks , one has to like their treat(s) mildly hot. Just enough to let you know, it's not all sweetness.For those folks that like to try a new ( adventurous ) taste , this is for you !You won't be disappointed !
Very good and nutritious too.  Nice as a snack.  I love the fact there is no gluten as I have allergies.  Wonderful combination of flavors.  Thanks!

column9: OK - not worth the price though
column10: These were okay - but not worth the price even at subscribe and save for what you actually get.The flavors are interesting, but not all that great tasting.  Worth a try once, but I would not purchase them again.

column9: Warning! Not Gluten Free as listed
column10: The Sing-Buri flavored nuts contain wheat. Even though the other flavors are very good, this could be dangerous for someone like myself who has a serious problem with gluten. Stick to the individual flavors if you do not know what you are buying.

So I accidentley purchased these and decided to give them a try since they are non refundable and boy do they taste bad! I gave them to my younger 2 younger sisters and they can not stand the taste either. I really have no idea what to do with them. They are quite overpriced for something that I had to rinse out. Not happy with I could return them.

column9: A gift that worked out perfectly
column10: I orderd the weisswurst from saag`s as a surprise for my sister and brother in law because they liked it very much when I served it during their visit in germany. And - what a surprise - they were thrilled to get the saag`s weisswurst because as they say: It is the best you can get in the US. They used to buy it years ago in California but moving to MO. they lost track of saag`s. As always: It was a pleasure to shop with amazon.com and an even greater pleasure to get the sausage they like in an excellent quality. Thank You! I will definately order again.
I don't know that I'd have tried this sausage, except that it was served to me by a friend. It is excellent, and is now one of my favorites.

I first discovered Bentley's tea by purchasing an assortment of tea like this in order to have a nice container.  What I was surprised by was how great the teas are.  The teas (except for the green tea) are black-tea based and all but the English Breakfast are flavored (none are herbal like a previous review implied). The black tea base is the smoothest black tea I've ever encountered.  It really has an outstanding flavor.  The flavored versions seem to use this tea base and add a flavor above it.  The flavor isn't as strong as in many teas.  However, given how good the black tea that Bentley's uses tastes, it shouldn't be.By ordering this off Amazon, I'm not paying any more than tea costs in the supermarket on sale, and getting far better tea.  Hope you enjoy this tea as much as I do!

column9: Not quite as good as I thought
column10: I've had Bentley's teas before and enjoyed them very much.  I thought these tasted a bit stale.  I will use them for Sun tea and put double the amount I usually use to bring out the flavor.  The flavor is very light and as the tea bags are paper wrapped and not foil, the flavor inter-mingles with others in the tin.  I would not order these again.  Louise

column9: Flavors are good, if you like it all tasting the same...
column10: The flavored teas are the reason I purchased this item. While the flavors in the peach and raspberry are some of the best I've had in black tea, the Earl Grey is only ok.The problem is that the teabags are loose packed in the tin and the flavors all blend so that the English breakfast and even the Earl Grey do not taste like they are supposed to.  In my opinion it becomes rather yucky tasting.  Also, the teabags have rather a small fill, so they really are only suitable for a 6 oz teacup to be strong enough (for this reviewer) with a 3 minute steep.  That may sound nitpicky, but by comparison some teabags are sufficient for much larger cup sizes.
If you cannot tell the difference between Earl Grey and English Breakfast something must be wrong. Either portions are to small all tea is too old and lost its flavor. Triumph of form over content!

I've been drinking lots and lots of tea over the past few months as I work through a low carb diet regime.  I had been buying varieties at the grocery store and decided it would be economical to simply buy a large sampler.  With that in mind I randomly chose Bentley's Finest Tea Classic Collection.  I couldn't have been more pleased with the quality of the tea.  The peach tea is in fact my favorite in the collection but the English Breakfast Tea made me a fan of that flavor where I never had been before.  I'll be watching for other tea collections from Bentley's.

I bought this as a Christmas gift, only needing one, but it was great to get two for this price and have a spare on hand for last-minute gifts. The tin is nice enough for a gift and there are many flavors to choose from, so the person you give it to is bound to find some they like!

Bentley's 120ct assorted tea tins:This is a good product, I drink alot of tea since surviving terminal throat cancer in 2007. Good tasting tea, good flavor, nice reusable tins. I'd prefer to buy one tin at a time instead of 2 tins though. Amazon ships fast and so far trouble free.

Bentley's Finest Tea Classic Collection, 120-Count Tea Bag in Assorted Tins (Pack of 2)These teas are full-bodied with a wonderful flavor that satisfies the taste buds any time of day or night.  I am very happy I found them.  They were also a good value on Amazon

I bought these for gifts, so I can't speak on the quality of the tea. However, I will say of the 4 I ordered, 3 of the tins had minor scuff marks or dents/dings, and one had rust on the outside. I kept it because there was no time to order another. I will say, price wise, these are half the price of the best price I could find on a similar item from a retail bath store...
Excellent!  Very happy with the product.  I am a big tea drinker and definitely love this tea brand.  Will order this classic tea again.
I will NEVER buy this tea again. Earl grey smells like orange spice, peach and rasperry flavours hard to recognise.

column9: Excellent selection as well as value
column10: Always have enjoyed tea, this selection was well put together. They all are very drinkable. Been using the coffee maker to brew the tea, haven't brewed coffee for quite some time. Tea is sooo much better for one's health. Highly recommended alternative to coffee.

column9: Well, maybe the tins are a keeper.
column10: This tea is terrible; cheap store tea bags taste better. All of the flavors blend together to make the green tea taste like a mixture of earl gray, raspberry, and peach. This tea is Picard's worst nightmare; maybe only Locutus would drink this. Even Neelix would be repelled. Sorry for geeking out, point is, the tea is not worth your money.

We had a Bridal Tea at a Tea House for a Bride. We gave out the assorted Teas as gifts in a box for favors. They were in expensive and had a plethora of variety in Teas. This is a great favor and will not break the bank. The teas were great tasting and they even had Green Tea and healthy Tea's! Awesome buy!
These are the worst teabags I have had. It smells and tastes like artificial flavor and tea color.I'm not sure what I can do with two boxes of these teabags.

I don't know why I haven't written a review before this. I have been drinking this tea about five years.  I first tasted it when my daughter gave me a tin for Christmas.  After I flew through that tin, I wanted more.  She told me that she got it from 5 Continents so that's where I purchased more.  After a few years, that chain closed in my area.  I tried supermarket teas but the taste was weak and had a paper taste.  These are full bodied.  I was thrilled to find my favorite tea on Amazon and at such a good price.  I love getting two tins at a time.  The tins are pretty.  I use them for a number of things.  One I use as a sewing box, another as a tool box, one for cosmetics,ect. My favorite flavor is the green tea followed by the raspberry. They also make excellent iced tea.  As much as I drink, I should subscribe and save.

I really like this collection.  The peach is my favorite, but the rest are pretty good as well.  I wish it didn't have the Earl Grey (I'm not a big fan).  The peach and raspberry make excellent iced tea, and I'm guessing the orange spice would as well :)
Nice addition to a gift with various other food items. This tea tastes excellent and the box is a good base for a gift buildup.
i purchased this tin of tea for the tea lover of our family. she says it is very good and aromatic. thank you.
Worst tea. You could not even call this one a tea - it is a water with a little bit of color and essence. No tests of tea at all!
THe tea is packaged well and can be used as a good tea source for a tea party. The proiduct is fresh. presented well. The tin is very attractive and steardy enough to find future uses for.
Great product, great tasting teas. Great service, the package arrived in less than two days. The peach tea is orgasmic.
The tea is very good with a nice variety of flavors. The tins are great to use for storing things like cookies or chips to help keep them fresh.
This is not your gourmet tea. I liked the variety and for the price you get great value. As it turns out it makes very good iced tea and it's nice to have the tin to store all your teas in.

I was excited after reading reviews of this product to receive it and "enjoy" the teas as much as others said I would. I drink a lot of tea and have tasted teas that taste a lot better and was really disappointed with my purchase. The teas are not strong and really mild in flavour. If you are a tea lover and have tasted teas from Europe and Asia and enjoy the stronger blends, then pass on this item as you will be very disapointed.

My wife gave me a Bentley's Tea Collection for Xmas. It is the best tea I have ever used and the only flavored tea that I have ever liked to drink. This Bentley Classic Collection is a great buy. I have used one as a refill source as I empty my Tea Box. The other tin could also be a great gift for a tea drinker. I hardly ever put the coffee pot on anymore.Highly recommend the product and the price on Amazon is very, very good.

column9: VERY Gift-able, My Mom Loves It!
column10: Bought this for my mom for her birthday, along with a book (Chicken Soup For The Tea Lover's Soul) and a tea cup and saucer. My mom loves a cup of tea either in the afternoon or after dinner, and she likes to have a selection. This set comes as two complete tins. My mom also hosts dinners frequently at her house, and this will look lovely as she offers a selection to her guests.I actually ordered a membership for myself. I've received the first shipment--Amazon provides amazing fast shipping--with the next shipment following in six months. If you've prices tea bag tea at the grocery store, you know the prices have climbed for good quality teas. Yes, you can (and I have) get boxes of tea from the dollar store. Sometimes you get what you pay for.Serious tea lovers will find this very impressive and giftable. The tins are also reusable.
Great product, delivered on time for Xmas.  Users of the tea bags are enjoying the product.
I am enjoying this assortment of teas. My favorite is English breakfast in the morning and Earl Grey in the late afternoon. Thank you for a quality product!
I have purchased several different teas, but the Bentley tea is always smooth and tasty.  This collection makes a great gift for anyone. Give this ago to try 6 wonder flavors.  You won't be sorry.
These are flavored teas, unlike the herbal teas found in supermarkets which are not really tea. They are thoroughly enjoyable if you like real tea.

After reading the previous reviews I bought this as a gift for a friend. I decided to keep one for myself to try, and I'm glad I did. I never was a tea drinker before, but once I tried this tea I was hooked. I would recommend this to anyone who is thinking of trying tea for the first time (plus two-60 ct. tins -- can't beat that for the price).

I ordered a few different Bentleys Tea items - some for myself, some to give as gifts.  This is a very nicely presented tin with a great assortment of teas.  It is nice to know which teas I prefer before ordering them (I really like the orange spice and peach so far!)These are very, very nice teas.  Highly recommended!  I think it's a great deal on tea, and you can currently order it to arrive every month, or every couple of months (or every 6 months!) and get 15% off.  Definitely a value!
Bentley's is the best brand of tea i've ever come across. High quality! Great taste! Also, a great price offered here on Amazon.

I ordered this for a friend, and it comes with two nice sized tins of tea...and the tin is just beautiful.  I immediately ordered another set for gift-giving later.  Very good deal...you can't beat the price!
