this was nicely pkg in a tin can that is beautiful and the selection of tea is great...we love different varities of tea and this is certainly the one that will give you a great selection...will buy again. Great for a gift to give someone.

column9: Some of the finest tea in the world.
column10: I am so delighted I found this great deal on amazon. I love this tea and the local stores that carried it charged the earth for it. These tins are such a bargain. As for the tea, it is all delicious. I especially recomend the Earl Grey. Some of the best I have ever drank. Lovely flavor and aroma. The peach is exceptional as well.

I first learned about Bentley tea two Christmas's ago when I received a "6-flavor" tea chest.  I also soon discovered it was impossible to find this great tea in local stores.Amazon had one of the best prices, and I was able to buy 4 of these tins for Christmas presents (actually, I kept two tins for myself).  This is a cost effective way to keep my teabox filled!Amazon mailed the item quickly and accurately!

I too purchased the tea as a gift. I wanted to get the office something that everyone might enjoy. I'm sure they get tired of the same 'ole coffee & plain tea. Since cold & cough season is coming, the herbal blends will be perfect. I might give both or keep one for myself...tee hee!

column9: No keepsake, but great afternoon tea.
column10: Don't plan to use the tin as a keepsake unless crimps and small scratches are not an issue for you!  But, for a pleasing presentation of select tea bags, it's perfect for the deck, patio, or other outdoor event.  Each of the teas has a distinctive, pleasant flavor, none of which are strong or bitter.  They make a great afternoon sipping tea, served either hot or iced, with light snacks, but won't pair well with heavier foods or a meal because of their mild flavor.

column9: Don't get these if you have a sweet tooth.
column10: I tried the carob-cocoa flavor. These are not at all sweet, even with malted grains, honey and raisins in the ingredient list. They have the texture and appearance of very dense, nutty brownies, but not a lot of chocolate flavor, rather a kind of carob/raisin/grain taste. These are for active people who want a quick, calorie-dense (440 calories per bar) meal from a bar made with natural ingredients. They are NOT weight-loss bars.I like my coffee black and my iced tea with no sweeteners of any kind, so maybe that is why I like these bars. My wife won't drink those beverages without lots of sugar, and she HATES these bars. So, I'm guessing if you like sugar in your coffee, you should stay away from this product.

column9: Better than what I had at Philmont
column10: Got the idea to purchase these for a backpacking trip as a result of previous trips to Philmont. The bars were moist, but the carob is by no means chocolatey. The weight to nutrient ratio is ideal for backpacking, and in some cases can be used to replace a breakfast of lunch.

These bars gave me a stomache and indigestion. I am lactose intolerant. Nonfat milk is listed prominently as an ingredient on the package, but not on the website.  This is unfortunate, because, otherwise, I think that they have a good high-caloric-density backpacking product. As for taste, on the trail, everything tastes good.

My husband tells me that these do fill him up, providing that he drinks a lot of water while chewing on one.  One bar kept him full from breakfast until dinner which we eat about 5PM.  He did drink a lot of water as others suggested, and he said he felt no hunger all afternoon.  He is a believer that these will work for a day in the woods.

I think this Carob Cocoa flavor has edged out the Fruit and Nut version...it has a nice chocolatey taste but none of the sugary (or saccharine-ish) like taste of other "chocolate" granola and energy bars.  And like the rest of the Bear Valley bars, it is a complete protein and has an unbeatable dollars-per-calorie value.  I'm a very physically-active male with a high metabolism, yet I really CAN eat this bar as a meal replacement, it keeps me feeling full but never bloated or gassy (unlike many others) for a good 3-5 hours...that would normally require at least two ClifBars or at least 3 of a cheap grocery store granola bar.  Anyway, if you just need a little snack to tie you over for an hour or so, have just half of a bar at a time.I've also eaten 1/4 to 1/3 of these bars at a time just before a long run or during (about every 45 minutes) a long run, and with no ill effects stomach-wise.  That, in my opinion, is a good testament to its digestibility and quality, organic ingredients.The only TINY gripe I have about these bars is that it's damn near impossible to tear open the wrapper with your bare hands unless you take something sharp and slash a hole first...so I just use a pair of scissors, quick and easy.  But then again maybe that's a good thing, means you are assured of these things staying fresh for a long time without needing a bunch of artificial preservatives.

column9: Fantastic to use as a filling, delicious, breakfast (or other quick meal). Have water on hand
column10: I bought these to be used essentially as breakfast. First off I find these delicious. They have almonds, raisins, sunflower seeds, and just enough of a cocoa taste. They are very dense and you will want to have a lot of water or other liquid available. They are also amazingly filling. Yes 440 calories (2 servings/ one par) so more of a meal replacement than a snack. But for breakfast a whole par gives you 16 grams of protein. Protein really helps get the mind/body going in the morning so they are excellent for that.But you are also getting 24 grams of sugar. A little high. But at least it isn't from corn syrup or even sugar as a separate ingredient. I do highly recommend these for meal replacement, especially breakfast. I have them 3 times a week for breakfast and feel really good and satisfied until lunch. This is usually 4.5 hours away for me. I think they would be excellent for backpacking and camping as well. Or other meals in the day. Tasty and satisfying, with good ingredients.

In what can only be called an act of desperation, I consumed one of these for breakfast this morning. It can best be described as "dense" and "nonpoisonous." I feel that these would make an excellent diet food, as after attempting to eat one, most people would assuredly give up on eating except for what was absolutely necessary to consume in order to maintain basic bodily functions.

These are fantastic. It's true, they're not as sweet (or as low calorie) as many other meal/snack bars out there. But in my slow transition to a nutritional lifestyle that keeps unpronounceable ingredients to a minimum, I'm so glad to have these on hand. And they are FILLING! I keep them in my car with a small piece of tupperware so I can enjoy just half if I don't want to fill up, or just need a little something.

Use these for lunch at work. Easy to store. Just open and eat. Use as a meal not a snack. Freeze very well. I use the Carob-Cocoa to give my taste buds a break from the other 3 flavors (Fruit & Nut my favorite).
pretty solid bars.  provides energy and something in ur stomach for hiking... took these for a hike on katahdin... provided plenty of energy, but they don't take too many--they weigh you down.

I have tried three of the Dare Cookies - Lemon Creme; Whippet with Raspberries; and now the Ginger Snaps.  I Love All Of Them!  The Ginger Snaps are not hard.  They have a little softness to them which I like.  And the ginger is strong and hot.  I will buy these again and again.  They remind me of my Grandma's cookies.

Love this coffee! I wish they would offer it all year long.....don't agree with other reviews that the coffee is too weak.
